Highly recommended! || My wife and I have enjoyed fabulous Portuguese wine over the years as we’ve been coming to Lisbon since 2017. We are now spending six months a year in Lisbon.  We had just finished our supper and noticed this wine bar close by. We were just checking out wine bars and thought we would check out Wine Not? for a future wine experience.  We were greeted by Andre. His picture is in one of those photographs that we attached to the review. He was very friendly and gave us a long list of wines that were available at the bar. The place is very beautiful. It has a definite lovely wine theme in the decoration. I have attached some photographs to show the decor. We were quite surprised that the wines were quite reasonably priced.  We decide to stay and enjoy a glass of wine in the bar area at the back. We explained what we are looking for, and the staff member asked if he could choose what we should have. We said yes. We had a taste of the wine and it was absolutely fabulous and something that we had not experienced in Portugal.  We decided to have that wine. It had a lovely complex taste.  It happened to be a Malbec wine from Portugal.  Andre explained that the callback plants were sent to Argentina. Portugal the Malbec vines became extinct. Portugal then brought some of the vines from Argentina and graphed onto a Hardy stock. We have experienced the Argentinian Malbec wine. This was far better than what we had experienced in the past.  We were so grateful for that explanation of the wine history. We enjoy sitting at the bar and hearing this lovely happy voices in the restaurant.  They have absolutely beautiful looking desserts are served with a beautiful presentation on the plate.  We will definitely come back. Our regular wine bar has changed hands and has completely changed the atmosphere.  It is wonderful to have a new go to place. || This is an amazing place.  First it’s a beautiful setting.  But above all both the food and service are amazing.  There is an extensive menu of tapas.  We loved them all.  The wine was excellent but if you don’t like wine, no worries.  Go there anyway for the food and service.  Plus the night we were there it’s was quiet and peaceful.  Can’t recommend it enough. || Great food experience, tastes all great, even a bigger choice for wine || We visited this place during our trip to Lisbon two weeks ago for some wine and snacks. Everything was absolutely delicious. I especially want to highlight how attentive and friendly the staff were — very knowledgeable about both the wines and the food they served. We were really pleased with the experience. Definitely a great spot to enjoy a pleasant evening in a lovely atmosphere! || We will definitely return! Staff are very knowledgeable and fun! Wine prices are reasonable and delicious. We had some appetizers and the bread stew with shrimp. It was one of our best meals here. || Absolutely loved our experience here last night. Everything was perfect. Now I know it's a big statement, but I mean it. Food is awesome, service was so helpful with both food and wine selections. Even the soft background music was well matched. These guys have managed to get everything right. We even bought a bottle of champagne 🍾 to take home. This is my new 10/10 restaurant, well done team || This is a "small" restaurant in the heart of Lisbon with a focus on an informal atmosphere and diverse food, especially to share. The food is very good, tasty, and unpretentious. They have a very LARGE range of options in wines. The staff is very nice and accessible. The prices are... Ok... In our case we paid 45eur per person with drinks and desserts. Very good option! || Great sea food, nice stuff. We were here for lunch, wondering why no one is here in garden. || We had anticipated a wine bar offering an array of local wines paired with delectable food, but our expectations were not met. The wine selection did not stand out from what you'd typically find in any other Lisbon restaurant, and the food was subpar. Our octopus salad was predominantly onions with barely any octopus, prompting us to send it back. While the setting was cozy, the noise level was unexpectedly high for what one would assume to be a tranquil wine bar. || We wanted a Portugal wine experience and hence we chose Wine Not? for our evening and it was perfect. The restaurant has an extensive wine collection from this one winery and they each is better than other. Their dessert wine was especially exceptional. For food we mainly had entrees - Fresh cheese, olive oil with thyme and bread basket Corn chips with guacamole Vegetable tempura with yogurt sauce  They paired really well with wine. For dessert we had tangerine crème brulee which was yummy but the chocolate mouse was a bit disappointing. This was our best evening in Portugal. || A very nice wine bar. We sat outside on one of the three small tables. Pretty nice atmosphere and delicious wine- we tried the typical Portuguese green wine- amazing! The waiter was super friendly, with perfect English. It was a very nice experience. I would definitely recommend this place for an aperitivo. The inside of the bar is very nicely decorated and has a wonderful atmosphere. || Just flown in from France where we live to stay at browns downtown hotel and found this great wine bar 5 mins from the hotel Had a great time food was great and tasty and the wine options were a lot so wanted the waiter to offer some options as to wine as we live in France and have a vineyard we were interested as to what he would select for us but he came up trumps and knew his wines to the selection of the white for the first three courses to the switch to a lovely red for our final course of stuffed mushrooms was on point well done and we will be going back again !!! And he has a secret to tell you about his love of wines but that’s for you all who visit to find out || Modern vibrant setting with a plethora of great local wines from their partner vineyard with a budget for everyone. Friendly enthusiastic staff to help you with wine and food selections and some of the best tapas style dishes I've had, pork cheek with mash and the sardine loin on toast were highlights for us. Ended up revisiting based on our first experience being so good. || Very nice and typical Portuguese restaurant. Extremely friendly service, good quality food and reasonable prices. || This spot is a gem and we’re lucky to find them during our trip because they closed for the holidays right after our visit. The decor (note the hanging bottles), food and service all top notch! We had an array of great foods, but my personal highlight was the buurrata salad. The chicken, fish, fries, and pretty much all else on the menu are taste bud tinglers! Thanks and enjoy your vacation.  For more reviews, recipes and food ideas check out @nazaris_touch on Instagram. || Best food ever! Lot of Portuguese wines, excellent one! All recommendatiins! || Clever name. The wine is very good and the service attentive. However, the codfish cake and alheira croquette are average at best.

place_name: Bico Cultura do Vinho | Wine Bar Lisbon

reviews_content: All staff are extremely friendly, always friends and willing to help, excellent cozy atmosphere. Great drinks selection from wine, gin, whiskeys, and traditional Portuguese drinks. Will definitely come back when next visiting Portugal again. Thank you guys for such hospitality! || Absolute rip off charged €27 for a bottle of wine that costs no more than €6, I can understand business need to mark up prices but this is ridiculous. Not a cheap wine bar, absolute tourist rip off!!! || We had a great time here. Lovely service with  great sangria and cheese boards. We were brought complimentary drinks at the end of our meal as well! We will be returning! || Excellent Wine Selection and Knowledgeable Staff I had a fantastic experience at this wine shop. The selection is impressive, with bottles from both well-known vineyards and unique, hard-to-find labels. The staff was incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to understand my taste preferences, making thoughtful recommendations that were spot on. The atmosphere is welcoming and relaxed, making it easy to browse and explore. Whether you’re a casual wine drinker or a serious enthusiast, this shop is definitely worth visiting. || Very nice place, for this price a lot of porto and Wine. And a big plate to eat.  Nice place, good music and lovely barman. The place to be || What an amazing find, such a help with the wine selection and paired it with an amazing food board. And the music 🔥 || Had a great evening, Anged was a super host. Some delicious sangria, cured meat and cheese and nice conversation. Tried some port wine and ginga. Awesome place and fantastic staff!! || The best bar in Alfama. Monty is the most kind and generous host that you might ever encounter. Drinks are fantastic and sangria made by Monty is magical. || Again another knock out experience in Lisbon. I only write good reviews. Or bad ones. Nothing in-between. This wine bar is friendly, helpful and a great night  I guess if your a genuine host with nice help. Your winning. Couldn't ask for a better few nights here. I will be back and he will remember me and you when try the place. || Great wine selection. The 10 year port wine is very good.  Best olives I had in Lisbon. Only sad we were always too full to try the cheese or meat plate- they looked delicious. Ronnie was so helpful, great service. You’ll find all different people here which makes the atmosphere fun. You can sit inside or outside. They are very accommodating. We were fortunate to stay close and visit often during our trip.

I absolutely loved the place. From the very start, entrance until I got to the bar the ambient was elegant, classy and boutique. Great interior design and the smell was super pleasing.  The staff is polite, friendly and really care about your experience. The view is great, even though there is a wall of buildings in front. But it made you feel inside a hidden, exclusive place that nobody knows about.  For some reason I really see this place as a great option for white wine with oysters. It would fit their concept perfectly, I believe.  Glad that I found this place after 4 years in this amazing city. I will def come back soon with more friends.  Keep in mind that I ordered a beer and a coffee, that's why I selected 5-10 euros per person. However the place is more pricy than this.  Cocktails 13 euros on average, and dishes for 20+ || O Jardim wine bar was a pleasant surprise! The atmosphere felt like a fancy palace, and the service was both polite and knowledgeable. Considering the top-notch food and the beauty of the place, the prices were surprisingly reasonable. Overall, a great experience that won't break the bank || Great drinks and delicious food but quite on the expensive side. You do get to sit in a lovely garden || A hidden Gem in Lisbon. Big and beautiful outdoor terrace with relaxing music on the roof of “The One Hotel”. As the name says, it’s more a Wine / Cocktail Bar with some smaller plates to share. The waiter “Eduardo” was very attentive and friendly, for that a big thank you. || Great location. Nice and quiet to go for a glass of wine. There are also small tapas which are pretty good. Great service especially Eduardo. || Very nice open terrace. Good service. Friendly to all customers. Salad ingredients were good. (Polvo/octopus, tomatoes, greens). But pity they don't know how to make a world class modern salad. Common problem here in Portugal... || A little pricey on the foods but drinks were great! || Stopped by for a glass of wine and to chill.  Met by very nice members of staff, had two lovely glasses of wine and the price was extremely reasonable. || Oxtails is amazing. Not the biggest wine selection for the name, but nice atmosphere. Medium price. || Lovely experience at the O Jardim Wine Bar! The bartender, Jackson, was awesome and made the tastiest drink. Definitely try the “Dear Lisbon” drink if you stop by. In addition to nice service the decor and aesthetic is very nice! Would highly recommend to others.

All the dishes were amazing and I couldn’t get enough of the chorizo butter. Quick friendly service and superb wine. Not one to miss || WOW! Discovered this place almost by accident just up the street from where we were staying.  It's an amazing space. We sat upstairs outside and had the absolute best service all night long.  The wine recommendations were spot on. We wanted to eat everything on the menu. Everything we decided on was top notch and so delicious.  We started with the tempura green beans and the roasted carrots. Delicious! Then we moved on to the octopus stew and the braised pork cheek. Could not have been better! || Absolutely loved this place and will be recommending to everybody. I stumbled across it as I had struggled to make a last minute booking whilst waiting for a friend to arrive into Lisbon. From the start we were made to feel incredibly welcome, and Antonio was our waiter. In fact, he also was cooking all the dishes and owned the place, so the fact that service was beyond exceptional was mind-blowing. I had the pork belly on fried rice, and my friend had the octopus stew, both of which tasted incredible. Portion sizes were medium and filling, it’s the perfect spot prior to continuing your night elsewhere. We definitely didn’t leave feeling hungry! Above all of this, it was very reasonably priced, including drinks. I’ll be coming again when I return to Lisbon next. || Such a wonderful place, offering high-quality local wines and delicious food. I especially loved the Kimchi & Goat Cheese and the lemon cake - both were outstanding! I’ll definitely be coming back :) || We always find the best spots away from the main bar/dining areas and Caruma is by far one of the best so far,  service food wine ALL excellent, we will definitely return before we leave. There’s a hidden terrace out the back with a beautiful atmosphere we were greeted so warmly we felt right at home. There’s natural wine is amazing but be warned the hangover from to much is quite unique! || Great wine and even better food! Table of 5 had wine, small plates and dessert for a very reasonable price! All 5of us said they make the best chicken cutlet sandwich we’ve ever had (try not to overlook it!). Great mix of flavors in every bite of every dish. We were only in Lisbon for 9 days and we planned to go back for dinner again before we headed home. We couldn't try everything! When you go, make sure to pay sufficient attention to Gigi. || Delicious food and great service ❤️ also a good selection of wines. An absolute must in Lisbon! || Off the beaten track place with really good food and wine. Knowledgeable and friendly service. Kind of wish they had some music and more art on the walls (though there is a great historic poster from the Carnation Revolution). I would definitely go back || The food is fantastic. I highly recommend the octopus stew and the pica pau || We loved our dinner there. Delish small plates. The owner is vey passionate about the food and wine he chooses , and everything was great. Only 3 for atmosphere because it was very quiet but maybe it was because it was rainy. Would definitely recommend fora low key, delicious dinner.  Thank you || Beautiful restaurant with kind staff and excellent food and wine. I highly reccomend It. || I was fooled by all the random 5 star reviews. All the food is laced with paprika, EVERY SINGLE DISH. if you order 5 dishes from the menu, it all tastes the same... We couldn't finish even one dish, that never happened to me before. I was actually in shock. Left to find something edible nearby. Any lists that have Caruma on their must go to is VERY suspicious to me, virtually impossible to eat the food. || We stumbled across this place and were blown away by the dishes! We were a table of three and had 7 plates and every single one was 10/10. Already planning our return to try the remaining things off the menu. Service was great and the ambience on the terrace was lovely. Thank you for having us 😊 || We love coming here.  The food is excellent and well prepared.  We love the natural wines.  Very delicious.  Highly recommend. || This is a lovely local place with high quality food yet to be discovered by the big crowd. Enjoyed every bite, amazing wine and great service. It’s that hidden local spot you want to find in the creative Graça area ❤️ || AMAZING EXPERIENCE ! I have no words. The food was amazingly cooked, innovative and so tasty. I never put Google comments but this restaurant DESERVES one. || We stumbled upon this hidden treasure accidentally, and I'm delighted we did. The wine was excellent, the food even more so, and the hosting was delightful. I would definitely return on my next visit to Lisbon. || Lovely spot. Great waiter. Amazing food. Some of the best food I’ve ever had type of good. || Wandered in late night for dinner and they happily sat a group of 6. The food and wine were both delicious. The pork cheek with sweet potato and blueberry was the highlight. || Fascinating small selection of natural wines with original food. Charming service. || Stumbled upon this spot and they changed our night. Incredible food, kind servers that knew what they were talking about, and great space. Can’t stress, great food. || A precious finding! Delicious and exquisite snacks, memorable and peculiar white wine (Palmirinha), accessible snacks, nice, patient, sensitive staff, the sweetest dog!  Whish you all the best, full heartedly! || Great place with amaziiiiiiiing food and even greater service!!!  We will be coming back, again and again ☺️  Thank you so much 🙏 || Lovely wines, excellent service and delicious petiscos! Really nice ambience and space to relax, chat and enjoy. || Don’t miss out on this original culinary experience with fresh produce and friendly service! || Great selection of wines and tasty food, nice chilled vibe. Well worth a visit! || Great food and wine. Relaxed atmosphere and awesome people. Definitely recommend it || Great and different wines, tasteful food and a nice place to be with friends. I’ll come back for sure! || Great and knowledgeable service hope they can up the game, food it's great || Wonderful food, original dishes

place_name: Retro Wine Lounge - Wine Bar & Tasting Room
reviews_content: This is the best bar you could ever find in Portugal. What makes it truly special is that it offers the most unique Portuguese wines you won’t find in stores and would probably never even hear about otherwise. Daniel explained each wine to us: how it was made, its techniques, and what makes it unique. He was always warm, friendly, and welcoming, doing so much to create an incredible atmosphere. I have never left a place with such warm feelings as I did there || Such an offbeat bar you won’t find anywhere else in Lisbon. Today, it stands as one of the most authentic spots for Portuguese wine. At the heart of it is Daniel, a man with deep knowledge of Portugal’s wine culture. If you’re looking for more than just a glass of wine, come by and experience his expertise in the craft. And no matter what, after the first bottle the setting itself won’t surprise you anymore — the place has kept its 1974s look, which only adds to its charm and character. || A hidden gem in the city! Daniel, the owner, is one of the most welcoming and knowledgeable hosts I’ve ever met.  The atmosphere in the bar feels cozy, making it the perfect place for an evening with friends or even a solo glass of wine.  If you’re in town, this is not just a bar , it’s an experience. Everyone should visit at least once and meet Daniel. Highly recommended! || I found Retro Wine Lounge on a whim as I was seeking local wine bars to spend an hour or two in while visiting Lisboa. I am SO happy that Retro Wine Lounge is the one I discovered on Google Maps and ventured to. This neighborhood gem is incredibly authentic and has a warm, inviting atmosphere and a tremendously hospitable and knowledgeable host in Daniel. Daniel went out of his way to tell me more about the origins of the green wine I enjoyed, as well as the premium cheeses! Everything was sumptuous. Retro Wine Lounge is a must if you're visiting Lisbon and looking for a proper local wine bar with a cozy atmosphere. Not to mention: Daniel has great taste in music! He was playing American soul classics when I went. I will definitely go back next time I'm in town. || Thank you so much for your kind words and review, Natalie. It's nice that you mentioned the music also as it's the soul of our place, together with the wines. We'll be truly happy to see you at our lounge again next time you'll be in town. || Beautiful, cozy atmosphere, welcomed by a great host and flavorful wine. This place is a must if you’re looking for an experience like no other. || I came with the idea of getting to understand Portuguese wines, and what a better place to land than Retro Wine Lounge. Wide variety of high quality native wines, all explained with passion and expertise. Cheeses meticulously selected to pair the wines. Friendly owner keen to share his knowledge with passion. Highly recommended! || I recently visited this charming wine bar with a friend, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. The selection of wines was exceptional, offering a variety of unique and intriguing options that delighted our palates. We paired the wines with a selection of cheeses, which were simply outstanding – perfectly curated to complement the flavors of the wines.  What made the evening truly special, however, was the warm and attentive service provided by the owner. He went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, sharing his deep knowledge of the wines and ensuring we had the best experience possible. His passion for his craft was evident in every recommendation and in the care he showed throughout our visit.  If you're looking for a cozy spot to enjoy high-quality wine and cheese with exceptional hospitality, I cannot recommend this place enough. || Thank you so much for your review and such kind words. So glad that we didn't disappoint you. We'll always do our best to provide the most authentic wine experience and we truly hope to see you again when you visit Lisbon someday. You'll always be welcome here. || The best place for the most special experience ever. Authentic, traditional and very original products. Best host ever, lots of knowledge and passion. || This place is amazing. A true gem off the beaten path with a very knowledge wine owner. He only opens occasionally to the public and we happen to come during that time. He was welcoming and the wine was fãulous! || We had a very nice wine tasting. You can expect special wines, unique and rare. Daniel explained a lot and knows his business. We enjoyed it a lot and hope to come back!

Quaint little wine stop up the hill. Food was excellent. I had the Muxama, oysters (which were fresh), and the cured ham. Glass of white then glass of red wine. They helped me pair everything really well. || Thank you for your kind review Matt. See you next time! 🥂 … || Local wine shop that offers light bites like oysters, cheeses and meats. They offer local wines and have a rotating monthly wine special. It’s a small space but people but they make it work with tables both inside and outside. Friendly service and helpful with the wine selections. We had a glass with some cork in it and the server immediately replaced it with a fresh glass which was highly appreciated. || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time! || A very nice and eclectic place where patrons will be able to discover the best Portugal has to offer in wines. Very discrete wine tasting house in the street coming up to Miradouro de Graça , but a stop there (mind you, only when you go downhill ! ) is more than justified. Will definitely come back . || Thank you for your review. See you next time! 🥂 … || This place is awesome. I’ve come here two nights in a row. Their wine selection is fantastic. I asked for recommendations and got something better than I had hoped for. Service is super friendly and knowledgeable, the wine is fantastic and the cheese I had was perfect. I’d come here every night if I lived in Lisbon! || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time! || Located pretty uphill we walked 40min- Nice n cozy little wine bar. White sangria was refreshing and sweet Porto wine flight was sweet but stronger than we thought.. Oysters were good with my white wine. || Thank you for your thoughtful review. See you next time! || For wine lovers in Lisbon, this bar is a must-visit. The great wine choices are a real highlight, and the delicious food and snack options perfectly accompany them. The ambiance is lovely, especially with the addition of a small outdoor terrace. What truly sets this place apart is the owner and staff, who are exceptionally attentive, lovely, and pleasant. Highly recommended! || Thank you so much for your kind review, see you next time! || This is an amazing place, we ended each night of our stay here. The owner is wonderful and is happy to make recommendations on which wines we ordered. The food is very good and the atmosphere is cozy and relaxed. There a many wines to choose from and try and he is very knowledgeable about each one. We loved coming here and hope to go back! || Thank you for your thoughtful review. See you next time! || The definition of an amazing place: very good wine selection, delicious small plates to share, and great service. The interior styling is also amazing. It's an old drug and grocery store very well preserved. Definitely recommend it! It's the perfect place to enjoy a good wine with friends or lovers. || Such a lovely place to have a wine and some oysters in Lisboa. The guys were really nice and helpful! Totally recommend it! || Thank you for your kind review. See you next time! || Very cozy wine bar. Super kind owner who can recommend wines for your taste || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time! || Very friendly and knowledgeable people! We had few glasses of vinho verde, which was delicious! We didn't have anything to eat, but food that was going to other tables smelled and looked really nice. Definitely worth a visit if you're in the area! || Thank you for your kind review, see you next time! || Laura and Miguel and Francisco were awesome. Laura was especially knowledgeable and it turned an enjoyable drink into a real experience. I had orange wine and an organic Portuguese red. Just divine! || Cozy wine bar with a short food menu that’s hand prepared behind the bar. Great wine selection and good recommendations. The mocktails were also very good and not just sweet (as they often are unfortunately). || Thank you for your thoughtful review 🥂 see you next time! … || Great wine, great recommendations and great atmosphere. A true Portuguese spot to enjoy a night out || Where do I start? Maybe the incredible wine list or the knowledgeable staff here that explains every glass you buy? Maybe it’s the oysters that rival some of the best I’ve had in bar harbor Maine. This place should be on your short list of must tries. The area is also wonderful to walk around. || Absolutely LOVE this place! Excellent service, delicious vinhos and fresh food! The staff is stellar! Highly recommend! || Beautiful spot with outdoor seating. Delicious wine. Everything reasonably priced. Oysters were F R E S H. Spent about 17€ for two glasses of wine, bread and olives, and an oyster. Staff was very friendly and suggested great wines. Will be back! || Great place - really good recommendations and such nice guys 🫶🏻 best wine bar we habe visited in one week of culinary lissabon! || Best wine bar in Lisbon!!! Amazing and extensive selection of wines. They have delicious cheeses and meats charcuterie to pair. The staff is amazing and super helpful. I had the pleasure of getting served by Marco and Caetano and they were absolutely amazing and helpful. I had more questions than normal and they were so gracious answering and provided helpful insights which made me want to stay longer and try more things. Came back here a few times and can’t wait to go back again! 10/10 || Found this place, on the last few hours ov our last evening in Lisbon. Great find. Friendly and helpful staff. Wine and port were excellent. A definite highlight. We didn't eat, as we had eaten earlier, much to my regret.

place_name: Grau Douro Tapas & Wine Bar (Portuguese Tapas and Wine)
reviews_content: From the friendly atmosphere to the delicious food my wife and I loved our experience here. The music is a perfect level, the blue theme was enjoyable too. We had their Moira Sausage (charred and exquisite) and their Salada Calypso. Those bites, coupled with a glass of Valle Pradinhos Reserva and their Quinta de Ventozelo Syrah was perfect for pre dinner. I highly recommend this restaurant & when we visit Lisbon again, we’ll be back. || A very nice restaurant with some Portuguese dishes. The staff is extremely polite and helpful, the atmosphere is lovely and the flavors are outstanding! Every dish we tried was wonderful and unique. || Best restaurant I’ve been to in Lisbon! Food was outstanding, wine was excellent, and the atmosphere was great! Staff is super friendly & the owner is a great musician. I would definitely go back if I return to Lisbon! || A very cool atmosphere and a very cool attitude, as well as the decor, I highly recommend visiting this place, both the food and the wine are simply wonderful || I first visited here in Sept 2024 and it was our highlight of Lisbon. We spent basically the entire year after bringing it up on a weekly basis, so when we were back in Lisbon in 2025 this was literally our first stop upon arriving. It was somehow better than we remembered. The food is all SO GOOD, but the part that does it for me is the environment. Everyone is so friendly and warm, and it's just so fun. Both times we've ended up chatting with people and having just the best night. A must stop in Lisbon, and is worth an Uber if you aren't in reasonable walking distance || Definately a 10/10 bar. Food is really really good. Make reservation in advance or come early if you want a table. || We had the perfect light meal here during our first evening in Lisbon. The Sardine Tiborna with Cherry Tomato Confit and the Calypso Salad were delicious. Add a pitcher of red sangria, and this was a great start to our Portuguese vacation. Friendly service, too, and very affordable! || This is a fantastic restaurant! It is a welcoming, cozy place to chill and have a wonderful meal. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable about the wines, helpful, and responsive. The owner is friendly as well, and you will probably see him. The food itself is exquisite. We left entirely too full, and I don't regret it at all. Everything we tried was delicious. The olive tapenade was the best I've ever had. I have no idea how they got it so flavorful and savory but not overly salty. I've never had sardines as delicious as the sardine toasts. The lime mousse was like nothing I've had before, and regrettably, probably won't have again outside of this restaurant. The wine selection is good, the white sangria was tasty and not too sweet. If you want to relax with a friend or friends, have some wine, and share some plates, I don't know that you can find a better place to do it! || One of my favourite restaurants we tried in Lisbon. Between the food, wine, atmosphere, and service it was amazing. There was wonderful live music - an artist singing and playing guitar and then the owner played an accordion. On top of this, I love restaurants where the owners are present and passionate about what they do. You can tell these owners love their job. When people love their job and are passionate, the atmosphere and service come effortlessly.  Decor was also cute, I loved the portrait of their dog! || Amazing restaurant with great food and incredible service! We loved this place, highly recommended!

Me and my friend had a lovely time here! We asked for the cheese board and the squid with ink and I was pleasantly surprised when I found out it was a dish made out of tinned squid. The flavour profile was absolutely perfect and shows how creative you can get with tinned goods. Service was friendly and the offering is great. Great also for people wanting to just grab a bottle and a snack for dinner. Place is beautiful and looked like a neighbour favourite. I also overheard some of the wine reccs given to other customers and they were very knowledgeable. Congratulations for such a great space with a different take on Portuguese food. It’s great to see some tin fish appreciation done so beautifully! 🐟 Would definitely come back || We were looking for a shop were we could learn more about Portuguese wine and we were recommended this place by a local. It's an unusually-shaped building as it's at the apex of a narrow-angled intersection, and you step down into the main area from the sidewalk. It's casually appointed, with high tables and stools. We were greeted and invited to sit - we asked for details about the country's wines and our host was very knowledgeable and patient with our questions. We were able to try some excellent wines from different regions, and had tasty cheese and charcuterie boards as accompaniments. It was such a good experience and we came away with perhaps too many bottles to take back home... If you're interested in wine, especially from Portugal, this is the place to come! || Very cute local wine bar that is perfect for a first date, after work drink, or a place to read and have a glass solo x || As someone who speaks only English, I was super nervous coming into this wine bar. My worries were quickly erased as we were welcomed, had a great wine recommended to us, and had a lot of fun! Will come back everytime we are in Libson || I am a big fan of Casa Farta. They have a great selection of Portuguese wines, most of them are natural or bio-dynamic even if they are not always labelled as such. The owners are charming and knowledgeable about wines, food and local places to eat at. And they have a small selection of sandwiches and toasts. I personally like the pork cheek. || Graça’s newest gem awaits your visit. Beautifully minimalist surroundings welcome you to celebrate Portuguese wines (alongside a modest, yet perfectly paired plates menu). Wonderful selection of local products that will satisfy every pocket (so: range of wines and prices). And (to be fair) the owners’ charm, pride in local products and down-to-earth attitude will leave as great an aftertaste as the delectable wines.  PS: Lovely place to escape the afternoon heat and ease into the night. || Nice wine selection but food is overpriced, and nothing special.. €15 for 6 thin slices of cheese (no bread or crackers) .. €8 for (packet) crisps with 6 small slices of charcuterie .. and we had to order (not great) bread to eat with the cheese. Sorry, these are not Lisbon prices! We had a feast up the road at a (more trendy) place for the same price. || Awesome owner who was so friendly. Explained the wines and made us our charcuterie board. Very very lovely spot for a date night. || Lovely little wine bar with delicious cheese (and charcuterie) and lots of options for pairings. Owner is very knowledgeable and friendly. || One of the guys were excellent and provided us with a throughout explanation of all their wines by glass. Super enjoyable and very fair prices for the quality. If anything negative - it is a bit bright inside during the evening hours. Would be cozy to sit outside of the weather allow it. Overall a great wine bar :-)

place_name: From The Vine: Port & Wine Tasting Bar - Port & Wine Tasting In Lisbon
Portologia Lisboa, La Maison des Porto
reviews_content: A really nice spot. We had a great tasting and really enjoyed the visit. A friendly place with good amounts of different tasting sets.  What really stood out to me was how professional the owner was. We took the premium tasting and were considering to get another tasting as well, a vertical. But he told us it would not be fair to do it today since we already tried his best and the other would compare unfavourably. Instead we should comeback another day with a clean palate. He clearly respected both us and his bottles. || Update: We returned for another tasting. This time a vertical Tawny tasting: 10, 20, 30 and 40 year old. Really delicious. And very nice that cleaned water is served along the tasting.  We noticed this time that the restrooms could need a cleaning and repair - for instance mold is to be found several places in the restroom.  Old review: This is a great place for a taste of port wine. You can also buy port wine here - and have them shipped home. My wife and I dropped by for a taste of port wine. They have many choices: 3-8 glasses, same style, different styles, vertical and horizontal. We chose to share a tasting of 6 port wines of which 2 were white, 2 were Tawny and 2 were Ruby. Four of them were 40+ years old, the LBV from 2016 and the Vintage from 2018. It cost 66 EURO for these very fine samples.  Definitely a place to visit and revisit! || Came here to buy me some port wine. I had no knowledge of this type of wine, so I really appreciated the fact that I was able to taste different ones, understand some fundamentals and make an informed choice. Enjoyed the talk and help from the manager. 100% recommended. || I and my wife visted here 3 years ago, and i just tasted the wine that the owner recommeded. You should have been reccomeded more than 3 bottles more. The wine you sold me is one of.the best wine that i have drank. Thank you for giving me good memory and wider speculation || I went here for a tasting. It wasn’t until after he started pouring the wine that the server casually informed me that i’d have to pay in cash because their credit card machine was broken. But no problem, he said, there’s a cash machine next door, which i used. I then returned for the tasting and wound up buying an expensive bottle of port. It wasn’t until i returned to my hotel that night that i realized that this “bank” took a THIRTY PERCENT MARKUP on my money, charging me $60 to withdraw $200! If they gave any warning of this i certainly didn’t see it. Moral of the story: make sure you have plenty of cash if you visit this place, or better yet go somewhere where the credit card machine is working. || Really great port wines here. Incredible flavours from both the white and tawny that we tried.  Somewhat expensive but more than worth it for the excellent service. The man behind the bar was very friendly and clearly enthusiastic about port wines. || I stumbled upon this gem by accident, was actually just going to get some cash out from the atm machine across the street.  So glad I walked into the shop. I was greeted by the very friendly and competent Diogo. We chatted for a few minutes and then I called over my relatives and insisted they meet me. We spent the next hour learning about the different wines, estates and had the pleasure of tasting some incredible Ports, which of course led to bringing some back home.  Definitely recommend this place. It’s quaint and intimate, you learn, you drink, you nibble , what else could one want. || Great experience, staff sociable and happy to share their knowledge and personal opinions on port. Great that you can both taste and buy port here from producers not usually seen outside of Portugal. Tastings are designed so that any port lovers taste can find something to appreciate and explore.  You can find white, tawny, ruby, and various vintages available including late bottled from 5 producers with select bottles from a couple of others. || We had a port tasting, and the staff was very friendly, explaining everything in detail. It was a great experience to try different kinds of port. Definitely a must-try if you have the time! || Really enjoyed the atmosphere here for our Port tasting. The host was amiable to us having different tasting menus, you could pick from 3 to 8 ports including menus of only one type. No rush to leave and was very attentive. Helpful via text to arrange! || The owner was not helpful, and the tastings are not good. The port that is sold is way too expensive for the quality, a standard lbv costs 30 euros, where €15 would be standard.  I will warn anyone, do not buy or taste here. Better go anywhere else. || Amazing  place to taste porto wines in Lisboa. Impessive selection of different degustation sets from small wineries, that worth a try. || Enjoyed an hour here.  Had a tasting session, just a small one though there were several other options.  Had a big and varied selection of Port to buy.  Would happily go back again. || If you want to try some small producers of Porto wines you should not miss a quick stop at this place. Just go in and do a wine tasting from the several wines available on the shelf. These wines are difficult to find in other place around Lisbon and worth it every € and drop of it. The Portuguese snacks are also something you should try while enjoying your wine. Great variety of cheeses and smoked meat. Staff very friendly and knowledgeable about what they are selling. Will definitely go back  for another wine tasting experience. || Had an incredible tasting here. Did the white, tawny, ruby mid level tasting and then the vertical tawny 10, 20, 30 and 40yr tasting. The waiter was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. Would 10 out of 10 recommend. I only wish their place was down by the water. Muito Bom! || I had a wonderful experience with Nuno back in November when I was in Lisbon. He was extremely helpful, patient, and generous as I tried several ports prior to placing an order of 6 bottles to ship home.  Portologia had a fantastic selection of smaller producers, which is exactly what I was looking for (move aside, Sandeman & Taylor's). One area of improvement, however, would be to carry more mid-range bottles. It did seem like many bottles were either young (~7yr, not as special) or very old (~30yr+, expensive). I would love to see them expand the 10-20 year range.  I was a little nervous about shipping to the United States and the shipping cost felt a little higher compared to other shops at 130 euro, but my port arrived at my doorstep less than a week after placing the order with no damage. I'd say this was worth it!  I am returning to Lisbon this year and plan to place another order with Nuno! THANK YOU, Nuno! || This quaint little shop contains within in a depth of knowledge and breadth of experiences in Port wine that I had never experienced before. Nuno was an amazing guide with excellent instruction in the history and background of the wines we tasted. His English is absolutely fluent. If he'd told me he'd spent a decade in the US I'd believe him! All in all amazing experience and I can't wait to go back to Lisboa to visit again. || Stumbled on this great little place and had the most delicious meat and cheese. The owner was friendly and spoke English and suggested a plate of “tapas” and a couple of ham and cheese sandwiches. The tapas was a beautiful prepared meat and cheese platter with a basket of bread and olives. Excellent quality and just perfect. Got beers and wine - a perfect lunch after walking all over Lisboa for hours! Picked up some sardines and port too from his wonderfully curated selection. Reasonably priced! || Wonderful flight of 6, really useful info,  happily recommend || Went here to find port that isn’t available back home, and was not disappointed. I was immediately greeted by the staff who speak excellent English and are highly knowledgeable about port wines. Bought a bottle after sampling a few options including their own “in house” label. They sell lots of labels representing small caves, which is a surprisingly difficult thing to find in Lisbon. || This isn't listed as a "wine bar", but as a shop - however it is THE place to go for port tastings and education.  Nunu is very knowledgeable and they have a variety of tasting menus to choose from.  If you like port, as I do, make sure you put this on your itinerary! || Good selection of port wine. The man at the counter could have been nicer to us || Highly recommended, Nuno has been absolutely amazing very warm, brilliant and knowledgeable. This is something that you have to do! || Mixed experience. Staff is nice. Small shop. Prices seem too high (the bottles i have bought there can be found at least 30% cheaper abroad). || Three stars because they were closed even though they claim they are open every day. We arrived around 7 pm and found it shut || Fantastic curated choice of fine ports to taste and purchase. This place provides excellent information on port and guides you through tasting. Well done! || EDIT: the owner changed and it's not the same anymore. Not the same selection. delicious Portuguese cheese, sausages and wines. the seller advises great. You can eat also on the spot or ask for vacuum packing - perfect for taking a piece of Portugal with you. || Great setup - 'flights' are vertical or horizontal... so all tawny 10-year varieties or tawny 10, 20, 30 or 40-year, for example. Really helpful staff who try to cater to your specific tastes... we will definitely go again! || Aweosme sausages grilled on flamed schnaps. Friendly food knowledgeable owner able to fix you a plate of cheeses and meats to pair with an smooth wine. In addition nice selection of n canned sardines and wine you can  take home. A perfect lunch place! || Excellent Port tasting. No nonsense recommendations on what to try and buy. Nunu is a great host.

Lero Lero is one of those spots that you insist your friends go to, it’s the entire package.  The walls are lined up with some of the best biodynamic producers (the type of bottles that make you dance once you taste them); don’t know what you might be into, don’t worry, ask the staff and they will point you in the exact direction.  The pizza, the pizza was so good, we ordered 5 and every one HIT. Our group was arguing about who got the last slice of pie from each.  Above all; the vibe. Lero Lero is gorgeously set up. Whether you want a corner to gossip and drink or be in the middle of the action. We came on a DJ night and ended dancing the night away by the booth. The staff is so warm, gave us so many recommendations as to where to go next. Lero Lero is full of life and one of the highlights of my recent trip to Lisboa.  You’ll see me on this street corner again one day and someone better save me a slice and a glass of wine. || Lero Lero is the epitome of a good bar/ restaurant. The staff is warm, the music had my friends and I shazaming every five minutes, the selection of wine was impeccable! And the pizza? Unreal. The team is so knowledgeable and eager to speak about the product. Love going to places where the passion and love is evident, I’m coming back to Lisbon just to come here again :-) || Incredible place ! It's a must if you are into wine ! The waitress was so nice and giving us nice advices for good wine ! The pizzas were also amazing, was worth every single penny ! Shoutout to the nice jazzy decoration too ! || One of my favourite places in Lisbon! Delicious pizza (fav one: Santa Marina). Excellent hospitality and service by lovely staff, especially Felipe who not only is a highly qualified professional when it comes to wine but also a caring host, a sweet person who welcomes everyone warmly. The place is beautiful, cosy and thoughtfully decorated. The music is always on point, curated with care and never too loud. Recommended to every lover of good (natural) wine, pizza, music and beautiful things. || Best Pizza in the city, bar none. Place is beautiful, bohemian chic. Lovely warm, low lighting, such a nice vibe. The only thing curated better than the playlist is the wine list. Lots of super intersting references. Obviously focus on low intervention and natural wines but plenty of clean, well balanced options here too. Felipe is rockstar and his team are super professional and friendly.  Ps great date spot! || ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Great food, excellent natural wines and a beautiful, relaxed atmosphere. Everything at Lero Lero is high quality! Definitely one of the best spots in Lisbon! || The best in Lisbon!! We had the best time from wine recommendations, music and vibes, the best pizza, and to top it off Felipe the owner and our sever Bia. Everything was top tier with so much soul and love. We ended the night with limoncello and tiramisu! Come, you will not regret it! You can feel the passion as soon as you step into the place! || Good wine selection. The guys know a lot so we got really well oriented on what to order. The place is beautiful and music was perfect || Beautiful atmosphere with beautiful people, with one of the best tasting pizza and wine! Don’t forget to try the pistachio shot at the end. Definitely recommend to try this place! I’ll be there soon for sure! || If you're looking for an authentic pizza experience with genuine, warm service, Lero Lero is absolutely it. They keep things traditional—no annoying QR codes here or ordering from an iPad— the service is wonderfully personal. You get expert guidance from the sommelier, apart from a very attentive staff.  The pizza is 10/10 Neapolitan style. The dough is super light, and you can genuinely taste the high-quality, fresh ingredients. The value is spot-on for what you get.  And seriously, do not skip the tiramisu. It’s incredible.  They have a great natural wine bar with a thoughtful selection, perfect for anyone who enjoys excellent wines. Highly recommend this for a genuine, delicious meal. || Such a nice place! They serve delicious marinated olives and the pizza is really good! They also have different types of wine that are definitely worth trying! || Such a lovely lovely place. I went here often and I will visit again. Staff is super sweet and welcoming, food is amazing and the wines are always so interesting. Great thing about the wines is, that a new selection is made almost every day, so whenever you come back there is new stuff to try. Great place to go with friends, or just by yourself. Superb spot, highly recommend. ❤️ || Such a nice place!! I went there a few times and aways flawless!! The crew and Felipe take care of the people, with rare and funky wine!  Good date environment btw 😉 || Incredible place! Celebrated my birthday there with friends. Everything was top level: pizza, wines, and especially the service (which is so rare in Lisbon!). Big cheers to the team and the owner! || Best pizza in town! Shoutout for the orange wine, it was my first time and I just got in LOVE with it! Highly recommend! 🍷 🍕 … || This place is amazing. It’s a pizza and wine spot. The pizza is unbelievable and the wine is delicious. The atmosphere is cool and chic yet casual. Felipe (the owner or manager of sorts) is fantastic; he made the whole experience. He chatted with us, gave recommendations on food/wine, suggestions on other places to go, was super friendly and so welcoming. I highly recommend!! || Fantastic pizza place with a phenomenal wine list and super friendly staff. The pizzas are excellent and I only wish I had more than one stomach. You’ll definitely need a reservation.  Two warnings: there are no paper menus. They bring the list out on a chalkboard. Study the list carefully. They mix in the no cheese pizzas with the rest of them so you can’t really tell what it is. It’s my biggest pet peeve about pizza places where they don’t explicitly call out cheeseless or white pizzas.  The other thing is that bar seating is uncomfortable. Either the stools are too high or the bar top is too low. If you’ve got a bad back, book the normal seating. || This place was one of the main highlights of my Portugal trip. The wine selection is perfect. The atmosphere is so cool and relaxed. The pizza is OUTSTANDING. Felipe the manager was incredibly welcoming & accommodating. I would highly recommend checking this spot out if you like chilled wine and great pizza! || If you're looking for an unforgettable pizza experience, Lero Lero stands out in every way. The pizzas are extraordinary, with perfectly baked crusts, fresh, high-quality ingredients, and an incredible range of flavors that make each bite unforgettable. It’s easily the best pizza I’ve ever had. Their selection of wines is outstanding, perfectly curated to complement the food. The tiramisu you really need to try it. Service is impeccable—staff are attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about making your dining experience perfect. It's more than just a meal; it's a must-visit for any pizza lover. And on top of that all...the blonde pizzaiolo, is veryyy cute! || Amazing selection of wines and very tasty pizza. I’d say the best in the neighborhood. Filipe and his staff are very attentive… And the music selection is just perfect.

Had my first (and last) drink and small plates here, they have a brilliant selection of natural wines, with plenty available by the glass. The staff were incredibly friendly and helped me choose the perfect wine. The small dishes were absolutely delicious! When I come back to Lisbon, I’ll definitely visit again. Good luck, guys! 💜 || A cozy place to reunite all of your friends to celebrate your birthday. It was an amazing experience for a Sunday rainy afternoon, super chill and comfortable. Great wines to taste and also great options for people who don’t drink alcohol. The host is incredibly kind, welcoming and genuinely attentive. Highly recommend ! || We had a great time at Nata Wine Bar. They had an excellent choice of different wines and the service was great.  The only downside was ordering their focaccia. Upon paying I noticed the bill was quite pricy and I already knew what the wine cost so I assumed the difference was the focaccia which, if I remember correctly, was like 14 eur for a little slice. I asked for the receipt after paying but they couldn't give me an itemized receipt with the explanation that it doesn't print itemized receipts.  Other than that, I definitely recommend this spot for great wines and good vibes. || Hi there — thank you so much for visiting Nata Wine Bar and for the lovely words about our wine selection and service. We’re really happy you had a great time! We’re sorry for the confusion around the bill and receipt. Our focaccia is €5, so it sounds like there may have been a mistake. Please send us a message on Instagram and we’ll look into it right away and arrange a refund if needed. We can also share an itemized breakdown for you. Thanks again, and we hope to welcome you back soon. — The Nata Team || Phenomenal! There are no words to describe my happiness that I found Nata and they exist here in Anjos during my lifetime . Nata converted me to natural win having tried quite a few places in Lisbon and just never convinced. That’s before Nata entered my life. The team are outstanding and Abbie the owner has done an amazing job. They have the most delicious sparkling chilled red and recently I tried this orange wine and my god - it was like drinking the nectar of the orange wine gods. Don’t get me started on the sourdough. It’s a must! My only issue is they are closed on Mondays but it also gives my liver and wallet a break. Cheeky red after work- Nata, few glasses with the gals - Nata! Hoping Nata #2 opens up in santos. || We highly recommend the Nata Wine Bar! We often spontaneously go there for a glass of wine in the evening, and last week we also did a wine tasting, which was very well organized and we all enjoyed it very much! We will definitely be back often 😊 || I had the most wonderful experience hosting a brunch for my pilates community at Nata. The space was perfect for our group, Abbie thought of everything- and the food, drinks and special touches made it such a perfect morning! Everyone left beaming and full. The wine pairing was also perfect for a Sunday afternoon. I would absolutely recommend hosting an event at Nata, Abbie is a total expert- organised, creative, communicative and caring ❤️ can’t wait to work together again! || Thank you so much Imo! We definitely had the best time with you and the pilates girlies and we’re looking forward to next weekend! 💚 … || Nata Wine Bar offers a lovely, intimate space in Anjos with about 120 natural and organic labels, many from small Portuguese producers. The interior is modern and welcoming, the staff are knowledgeable and helpful, and the tasting flights are a great way to discover new producers. Good spot for a relaxed glass or a low‑key meet‑up || I have hosted two events at Nata, and would love to host more in the future since it is the most PERFECT venue for my creative workshops; such a beautifully considered, warm, cosy space - but still enough space to seat large groups with enough space to comfortably draw and paint. Abbie and her team are the most accommodating hosts, the wine is delicious, what more is there to love!!! || Lovely bar with an interesting selection of wines by the glass and a great shelf full of bottled options. The menu is small but delicious. The girls behind the bar are fantastically welcoming and passionately describe the wines to help you choose. || So far my fav wine bar in lisbon. Such a vibe. Only thing is there is really limited spot in the outside area so you might need to sit inside. But wines are crazy good. || We had such a fabulous time hosting a sketching meet up at Nata! The wine and snacks were very tasty. Abbie was easy to work with, responsive, and welcoming and accommodating to our group of about 20! The space is beautiful and was a perfect atmosphere for our meet up. || The space is super cozy and the wines are very good and well priced. There is a wide selection of wines to choose from.  Nata is also the perfect space to host a birthday party or a private gathering. Had my 30th birthday there and I couldn’t recommend it more! Everyone praised the wines, food and space! || Nata hosted a birthday party for three of us and it was amazing! Their team are so professional, super kind and very flexible around our ideas and the number of friends we invited. Highly recommended || I had such a lovely time at Nata. The staff  are so friendly, sincere and knowledgeable. The prices are super reasonable for such well curated wine. I really recommend if you want a chilled evening with a great vibe, and friendly faces. || A Hidden Gem – Perfect for a Relaxed Evening  We visited Nata Wine Bar last night as a family, and it was such a memorable experience. From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere felt warm, welcoming, and effortlessly stylish — the kind of place where you can instantly relax and unwind.  The vibe was just right for a laid-back evening — cozy yet vibrant, with great music and a beautiful space that invites conversation. We had the pleasure of chatting with the owner, who was incredibly friendly and passionate about the wines on offer. You can tell there’s a lot of care and heart behind everything here, from the curated wine selection to the thoughtful details in the decor.  Whether you’re a wine lover or just looking for a chill place to spend an evening with good company, Nata Wine Bar is a must-visit. We’ll absolutely be back — highly recommended! || Really cool wine bar in Lisbon. Staff were friendly and had a great selections of wines and local beers. Super chill vibe and great atmosphere. I will definitely be coming back on my return to Lisbon soon !! || Cute bar. Managed to grab a drink before it was closed for the night. Often reserved for parties. would recommend for drinks and dates || We held a bday gathering here for a group of 20-ish a few days ago, and it was absolutely perfect. The team could not have been sweeter - so kind, helpful, and genuinely friendly throughout the whole evening. The space is lovely: intimate without feeling cramped, with a relaxed and open atmosphere. The natural wine selection was fantastic, and the staff were incredibly knowledgeable, offering great recommendations that everyone enjoyed. The food was also delicious and complemented the wines beautifully. Whether you’re planning a group event or just dropping in for a casual glass and a bite, this place is well worth a visit. A real gem! || Thanks Adam! We really appreciate your kind words, was a lot of fun hosting you! We hope to see you guys back soon! 💚🍷 … || I hosted my birthday at Nata, I had reserved a large table for 18 people and we all had a supper fun evening. The staff was super flexible and accommodating as I had some specific food restrictions for my guests. They were also very responsive and it’s been super easy to organize the whole evening. Not to mention the wines are delicious and they gave us great recommendations! || We spent a weekend in Lisbon and had an amazing evening at Nata. The atmosphere is super cool and stylish and they offer a great selection of wine and finger foods, which was exactly what we were looking for on a saturday night. Highly recommend this spot!

In short, the night girls are not pretty and the place is exploitative. I went to the place by myself and ordered food and drank. In short, I had 2 beers and a shrimp dish. The price was 80 euros, but the reality was 30 euros. I do not recommend the place. The treatment is very good because of the money. It is normal. || Best night club in Lisbon. Must try the menu. Awesome food at late hours. Especially the pica-pau with cream sauce and the prawns in garlic. || Nice place but the waiters are not helpful and the girls are not the best || Excellent restaurant and club!! Highly recommended! || Ok but as all nightlife in lisboa is fulled of dealers || very nice , a bit expensive || Great club, interesting selection of girls || Nice girls & drinks..😁 … || I don’t recommend this place || Expensive but interesting....😁 … || The service was terrible; you always had to call the employees who were in the service area, always chatting, over ice. Bottles cost from €150, you only get two Coca-Colas per bottle, additives were charged separately, they didn't have the more expensive rums on the menu, and half of the drinks on the menu were never replenished. The appetizers were the only concern, and we were very bored. || A club with lots of beautiful girls and good company... the best in Lisbon... || Always a good atmosphere for a drink. || During a private event, I noticed that there are not enough wall outlets if additional equipment is needed. Otherwise, it seems to offer good quality and conditions. || One of the most elegant in Lisbon, with "spicy" but somehow justifiable prices. The "hostesses" are gorgeous, top-notch, it's a shame that one of them took advantage of a trip to the bathroom to steal money I had in my wallet.

A really cool club for alternative/rock/goth music lovers . The entrance fee is reasonable. The bar prices are a bit expensive but the bartenders are very nice. There is a small nice dance floor . The place is decorated with all kinds of pictures of famous rock singers. A place worth visiting if you are looking for night clubing in the alternative/rock/goth genre ^.^ || Was on last track to transzentral when Leon Mussxhe pf inovertedsummoned me for a bedon adventire that slowed down the pace to chill. || Loved the environment and people. Goth like vibe and nice environment. || I’ve been there just once, and it was a really nice surprise! Ok it’s a bit tiny, the decoration is a bit cheesy, but that’s also part of the charm. Staff is friendly, entrance and drinks are cheap, and overall music was really great, and not the kind of music you usually have in night clubs (a lot of cold wave music!). I definitely will come back ;) || Pretty decent place. Only problem I faced was that no one spoke English; if you're traveling by yourself I'd say you reconsider. It's a pretty chill place otherwise!  EDIT: my bad, by 'no one' I meant the customers there (nothing reflecting the management) The bartenders (and bouncers?) spoke pretty decent English. I came here for the techno/electronic music and was not let down. || Hum...thats strange considering the people working there do speak english and most portuguese do too. I work there every evening and i would say my english is not that bad... || Be aware! When getting closer to this club it almost seems like, there is nothing going on. Quiet part of the town, though still close to the center. No lights outside. No pubs around. But we had a fantastic night there. Really good mix from darker, more electronic music to alternative classics. || Thank you for your review. We are happy that you enjoyed yourself || Very different but cool atmosphere! It's interesting and  enjoyed out time here. Staff were lovely and a couple of locals took us under their wing || Best Alternative club in tonw. Cant miss this one. Best Staff ever, Amazing decoration!  Sound colection is the best !! LOVE IT!! || One of the best Goth / Punk / Nordic / Metal scene clubs to go to in Lisbon! 10/10 recommend || Wouldn't recommend for casual club goers, very small dingy place. I do like metal music myself, but the music was weird industrial Goth music, maybe I got it on a bad night. || Hi. We do have metal nights as well as goth/indie and electronic nights. It depends on the events.We're also quite a large club but on thurdays we only open half of it. Mybe thats when you went?. || Great ambience,  awesome variety of music, cheap quality drinks and a friendly staff. You can't ask for better! || The best alternative music club in Lisbon || Good Alternative music, Friendly people , good staff. Nice place to dance and have fun. || Great music, decent atmosphere, pretty cheap looking place. || Great heavy metal and dark pop club. One of the few in Lisbon! || Beat goth club in lisboa || Nice alternative nightclub to go, different music genre every weekend! || A rather dark club on an underground. Music varies, but the English music from the 80s are frequent. || Feels like home (for goths) || Great club and atmosphere, needs a cloak room || Hi. We do have a cloak room on the left side of the bar counter...did you ask the staff?

this is the WORST CLUB IN LISBON so far, (everybody in lisbon knows, read other reviews), we didnt know so one week ago we decided to give it a try.  there's a dress code for this poorly managed place (if you really cared about image maybe you should've hired professional and emotionally stable bodyguards, but unfortunately that is not the case, clearly), so they were not letting my friend in.  which would sound fair in a normal context, right? wrong.  they started pushing her, insulting her, and when she took her phone to record everything they threw it to the ground breaking it to pieces (50 YEAR OLD MEN VS 20 YEAR OLD GIRL).  THE WHITE MAN WITH THE GLASSES ran to her when she started crying and tried to punch her (just an advice,  in my opinion you should maybe consider punching a boxing speed bag and exercise a little instead, since you're allegedly overweight.), the other 3 bodyguards were still trying to push her/hit her.  my other friend started recording (from a distance) as well to defend our friend who was being attacked, and one of them immediately ran to her, took her phone and threw that as well to the ground, and is completely unusable now. she had a flight in the morning, WHICH BY LAW THIS ALONE IS SUABLE.  it was evident that the security team expected us to retaliate physically so they could attempt to frame the situation differently. Instead, we remained calm and only stated the obvious. two of them though (the short one and the one with glasses) started insulting me (i won't list the insults here) thinking i dont know portuguese.
