Looks like Posh was hosting a high school Halloween party lol just not what we anticipated that’s all !! Bar is nice, staff r friendly and bouncers at door r nice too || Don’t waste your time. If you have a ticket to enter on a specific limited hour. You will have to wait 45min in a 30 meter queue (20 people). And when it’s your turn, they will say that your ticket is not more valid because you “arrived too late”. Even if you arrive 45 min earlier. || We were going to get in the club and we saw a girl that was in a very bad state. There were 3 girls that were passing by and didnt know her and were helping her, while the security staff was standing there. I know that a security staff sees a lot of these things and they get used to it but what pissed me off was that they never seemed to worry about the girl and ignored the situation completely. Very unprofessional, you cant even call an ambulance? || Hi, how are you? Many customers arrive at our door in a state of excessive intoxication. And our policy is not to admit customers in that state. However, we provide full support and information to all customers. In this specific case, the customer did not accept the refusal of entry. Regards 🫂 … || The club itself and music was pretty good but the bouncers were unnecessarily rough and unfriendly. The bar tenders were nice. We paid the full price to get in (10€ each) and had to leave the club after about half an hour because they were closing. Kind of felt like a ripoff... || One of the three largest gay dance venues (along with Trumps and Construction), Posh has a very mixed, mainly younger, crowd. Themed dance nights on the weekends sometimes need to be booked online in advance. || What a dump! 1. If you are after an underaged crowd, this is your place. I seriously question the legality of the crowd in there, 90% looked like they were under 18 or will turn 18 tomorrow…  2. Smoking room is a joke, the smoke goes EVERYWHERE in the club. It was so smoky, i had to get close to the entrance for some fresh air. ironically I wasn’t allowed out of the club to get some fresh air. And that’s while Covid still prevalent🤯 (no masks were worn except for the doormen), they pack you like sardines, let the teenagers go wild in the “smoke room” and don’t let you out for fresh air… Where have I see that before hmmm  3. The event I went for was a drag race party. Club opens 11-06. The doors were not even open at 11. We queued for about an HOUR not because there was such a dream demand, but because the doors were closed. Once we were in, I’m not even sure what time the show started, we waited until 2:30 and left. By then it was insanely overcrowded, ridiculously smoky (they banned indoor smoking for a reason 15 years ago, you know!) and who the hell starts a show after 2:30 am??  Complete and utter dizasta. If you have any respect for yourself, go somewhere else.  I should have known, a club that feels the need to call itself Posh, definitely won’t be that 😅 || We came for July 1st event where OnlyFans creators are supposed to give a great show but not a single creator came up so we left at 3am. Now their page has removed this post. Totally misleading customers. || This assessment does not reflect reality. We never announced that content creators would be performing a show. We only mentioned VIP appearances, and everyone was there. The post is removed every week to make room for new ones. || Seems to work at weekend. entree cost 15 euro and you get 2 drinks. average age was 18-22 I think (maybe less?), or that how it felt. and around half were ladies. was playing pop music when i was there. || Club with pretty decent interior but saddly full of underaged children and only pop music. There is no place for non-smokers and since crowd there is underaged, everyone is pretty rude and ignorrant. Staff is very nice and they have free entrance with bracelet till 3:30am. || Our clients are over the age of 16, as the Law Says! We have no minors here! about POP music! Yes, it is our work and success tool. || I was wanting to have fun, but with smokers all over the place, Funk music during all the party time and expensive drinks, it is quite hard to have fun. I danced like no tomorrow, but I think it would be better if the dj learned how to prepare a good set not to get boring || the club is perfect for the ones who’s looking for something different than tecno or electronic, perfect for pop lovers but need some fans or AC || No place for non smokers, it's really hard to keep there breathing if you don't smoke. Lots of young people, many guards so you feel safe, two drinks included and pop/funky music. || Great venue for a gay night out, from pop to funk, they’ve got it all. Staff are also friendly and every time I’ve been the vibe was good. || Since I can't answer directly to your Answer, I'll write my Answer here: I know people in Portugal speaks Portuguese (Eu sou Português, mas eu prefiro utilizar a língua universal para que todos entendam), I'm Portuguese but I write in english cause I prefere to write in the Universal language so everybody can understand whats your business about. Your local Artists are Portuguese singers and the music playing in the disco is Portuguese- BRAZILIAN not Portuguese from Portugal. I mean, take the bad reviews like an advise, you can turn your business in what you pretend to but you got the chance to get better. I'm not saying you need to change completly the songs but at least half-half. Don't forget there's lots of tourists coming to the area and to the club and universal music is english like everywhere, unless you change the repertoire to an Brazilian Club so people knows they are going to have a Brazilian Night. I forgot to say that I was at the same day in Bairro Alto in Friends Bar and the DJ was the same and the songs exactly the same.  Pay for entry and hear brazilian music almost all the time isnt that great for people who doesnt understand the language and doesnt know the songs. If the music changes I'll come again. || Hello dear, you are in PORTUGAL! here we speak PORTUGUESE! I should know this, so we have a lot of Portuguese music because we value our local artists. I hope you get your opinion on this. || The information published in the page of the club is not trustworthy. You might arrive there, at the precise time required, and even though, you will be charged to pay a lot to get into thete. Be also prepared to spend a lot of money to get a beer there. Much more than other places alike Lisbon. But after all it is still a nice place to go.  Uma pena que a discoteca esteja mais interessada em ganhar dinheiro do que de fato fazer uma boa festa para os clientes. || the staff is wonderful Kevin the best one💯💯👌🏿👌🏿✨✨ Wwe want him in porto city please ✨✨💯💯 || ignorant staff even tho we have purchased tickets in advance, been in the line for almost an hour along with some crowd || 15€ entry on a Sunday evening, definitely not worth it || Hi, you have the option not to go or to find a better place. Good night! || Fun music, handsome barman

This place is one of the place to be. Be aware they have multiple drag-queen shows during the night and the door is locked until the next show. Also after the 11 pm show they gonna remove all the seats to have a clear dancefloor. || Great late night club with a drag show before 11pm great for large groups and then the drag shows start up again at 3am again!! The music is good the vibes are fun and ALL the locals make it to the dance floor. Have Fun!! || I hate to do this but just can't ever go to this place again, i was standing with my friends watching the show and some drunk straight guy walk into me i end up dropping my drink, Went to the bartender to warn them about 1 the drunk straight guy bothering people 2 the spilled drink and broken glass on the floor And to ask for a new drink  The answer was basicly a chrug and thet they cant do anything about it while making me pay for a new drink.  Just horrible service i would never feel safe or supported in a place that just doesnt care. || (category is: EMOTIONAL GLITTERBALL MELTDOWN) 💅✨🌈 Honey. Listen. I came to Lisbon for the pastéis, the sights, maybe a little romance... but I stayed for Finalmente Club. From the moment I walked in, it was giving sequins, smoke, and scandal 💃💋 The queens? DIVINE. Like, serve me talent, serve me body, serve me wigs so snatched they filed a restraining order. I saw splits, dips, death drops, and one queen who made me question my entire gender identity and also my credit score. And then. Baby. It happened. One of the queens stepped out into a single spotlight... ...and started singing "Never Enough" from The Greatest Showman 🎭 I’m telling you right now, I had goosebumps on my goosebumps 🫠 People were frozen. Drinks halfway to mouths. One guy in the back was crying into his mojito. The queen BELTED those notes like her life depended on it. Like the ghosts of Broadway past were inside her, weeping and clapping. And I? I was a wreck. Mascara running. Hand over heart. Soul levitating. The energy? Electric, Living. Screaming. Hugging strangers. The drinks were strong enough to make me believe I could sing Whitney and hit the high notes. I couldn’t. But I tried. Honestly, if you haven’t been to Finalmente, are you even gay? Are you even alive? It’s not a club, it’s a spiritual awakening in heels 👠✨ Ten out of ten. Would sell my soul, my wig glue, and my ex’s Netflix password to go again. 💄🎤👑 And if they sing Never Enough again, I’ll be right there, in the front row, ugly crying like it’s the Met Gala of my heart. 💖💧🎶 || Had a fun night in here, after initially thinking we had missed the show, as everyone was stood around outside, and the bar temporarily unavailable. I think they must put on several performances throughout the night, as they said to wait outside for a bit, and then they will open again. Anyway, we went for a quick drink elsewhere, then came back as they were admitting people in again. Got charged 10 euro each to enter, but this got you two drinks each at the bar (or one cocktail I think) We then had to wait for the place to fill up before the next performance, but it was a fun wait, with great music and a fun crowd. When the performance started, the girls were fab. They put on a great show, and involved the crowd a bit too. Thanks for a great night! || It was Sunday night. The bigger clubs were closed but this one was open till 6 AM! Great Djs playing House Music/Party Pop, drinks were reasonably priced, and the Drag Show was very entertaining! || I didn't have any food so I can't speak to that  however I can speak to their service and the performance. I was there on a Tuesday night.  Got there at 930pm and they staff said the show won't start till 11pm. So I left to eat and came back. Didn't start on time which no problem. The show was just phenomenal. I had the best time there. The drag queens were funny and energetic even tho it's Tuesday night! My last night in lisbon was spectacular due to the place. The songs they choose were mostly in English so I felt like I'm at home. I had forgotten I was in Portugal. They were very entertaining from beginning to end. They were very interactive with thier customers as well. Over all one of the best drag show in Portugal  🇵🇹bravo!!!! Thank you for putting a great show on a weird week night! Xoxo || Thanks so much for your kind words. We're delighted you had fun and we hope you'll visit us again in the future. Have a wonderful day. || Don't go here! We were being physically attacked by a guy in front of the club and the security guard didn't help us because it was in front of the club and not inside and nobody of the other guests that saw us stepped in and helped us. And someone of our group was not allowed to go inside, because they were "too fat and ugly"... This is not a safe space for any human being. Go somewhere else if you want to have a good night. || Hi Leoni, We’re very sorry to read about what you went through. Safety and respect are fundamental for us, and we regret that this situation made you feel otherwise. Please know that we take such matters seriously and continue to reinforce our internal procedures to ensure all our guests feel protected and welcome. Thank you for sharing your experience it helps us improve. 💜 || Be aware of change scam!!!! Late Sunday night, I paid for my drink with a €50, and after intentionally spending excessive time, the bartender returned change for €5. I argued briefly but obviously couldn’t prove it. This is the second time being taken advantage of as a tourist. Unfortunate. 😔 … || We’re very sorry to read your comment and we take this situation extremely seriously. After reviewing the matter internally with our team, we were informed that the correct change was given. We would also like to clarify that Finalmente Club uses change machines to facilitate cash handling and ensure accuracy during service.  That said, if you wish to proceed with a formal complaint, we kindly ask you to contact us by email with a detailed description of what happened. We are fully available to open an internal process and, if necessary, review our security camera footage, which records the service area.  We hope to have the opportunity to clarify this situation and to welcome you back for a better and more transparent experience at Finalmente Club. || A friend of mine who was visiting Lisbon took me to this bar on Wednesday night, and it was a show night.  Unfortunately,  I didn't finish the show because I had a flight back to NYC early the next day. I stayed fir 30 minutes and I really enjoyed the atmosphere, songs, and the dancing. Nice show. || Thank you for your review. Such a shame you couldn't stay till the end. Maybe someday you can pay us another visit. Cheers!

oh yeah go to this one. its like a dancing vibe but more classy. little bit older crowd also lot of couples. €10 to get in but also got a free drink so not even bad. good music good layout would def rec || I felt at home on the dance floor - the DJ played a great array of music with disco influence. The crowd was truly all ages which I adore. Starts to pick up around midnight. If you are familiar with Outer Heaven in Austin or Good Room in Brooklyn this is the place for you! I will be back on my next Lisbon trip. || Bloody love this place! Music as others have mentioned..disco/electric/house/indie mashups ..older crowd who know how to get down! If you're looking for old school inclusive dancefloor vibes this is the place! We danced our socks off, made new friends and left with my faith in dance floor humanity restored. || Great vibes and atmosphere and the music too! One of the only clubs here in Lisbon us girls really felt safe. Good value for money and very nice staff! Would go again! || It’s a club. It was fun. As Newyorker, my opinion is that the music was not great. || Simply the best club to know people in lisbon || My favorite club in Lisbon. It’s cozy, nice people looking to have a good time, the music is special, not your typical rave but more on the synthpop, darkwave, indie, disco. You get a drink for your entry fee, good ventilation, and friendly staff. || We don't like commercial music, and we were looking for a different place, and indeed, it was. The waiters were very friendly, and the people we met at the venue were interesting (some film directors and artists). A special shoutout to the gentleman at the door. Very elegant and kind. There aren't many people like him anymore. || Best nightclub in Lisbon in terms of music (Indie, Synth-Pop, New Wave, Disco, House, Dark Wave, Post Punk, Indie Dance) and atmosphere, near Bairro Alto. || a good nightclub not so expensive. average age is 40 so maybe doorman could have told my 20 yo self I wont find myself in here. Not very cool from incognito. || Delightful local with great seasoned DJ's. A nice digestible experience as an alternative to mega club Lux in a nice neighborhood. Fun friendly staff and affordable drinks. || Great music, drink prices are reasonable and the service is excellent. Not much room, difficult to dance. || Bouncer was really mean for no reason and actually encouraged us to not go in by saying everyone inside is old and it’s empty. When we said we still wanted to go in (as I like the show that was playing) he looked annoyed and didn’t help us at all. I was conversationally telling someone in the queue it was my birthday because it was also his and they told me to be quiet and stopped the conversation. Overall really rude and unwelcoming. || horrible music and vibe and average age above 40 || Great retro club with 80's music, dance hall and 2 bars. Both prices of the entrance and of the drinks are fine. It starts to become crowded at 1:00. || The place could be great, but since the path to the main bar and the restroom goes through the dancefloor people are constantly bumping into you and spilling drinks, which is not fun. || It was really fun, I was worried when I came into Polka electronic music. Definitely improved throughout the night. I had a blast, the bar was quick with drinks, the bouncer was very nice. Got there as people were getting kicked out for smoking in the club... Ya don't do that. Was worried cuz there was a line of dudes screaming at the bouncer. Definitely a fun night stayed dancing till close, I highly recommend. || Told to visit to try to get a dance in. €10 cover gets you a mouthful of beer. Not a great vibe. || Was there on Saturday night. The DJ / music was fantastic if you like electro-pop. I shazamd at least 3 times to collect songs. Atmosphere good A little bit too small space though But had a great time || One of the best nightclubs in Lisbon If you are looking for a more “mature” place to dance or hangout while you drink something nice this is the place If you like indie, rock music you can find it here  My only complaint is that one time I was kinda kicked for dancing to much ?? || Great for couples that wanna go dancing at night ! Nice place, not much Space thought but a Big dancefloor. The entrance is not expensive (5 euros with a drink). The staff is nice even at the entrance which is not typically what we see in those kind of places in France. The age in there is more around 30+, but a few youngers where present. The dancing starts around midnight+. I recommend ! || horrible music and only old people there || Had a brilliant night here couple of weeks ago the music was fantastic, hard to find places playing indie music in Lisbon. Was straightforward getting in just showed covid pass and id.  also i have to say sorry to staff for smoking in wrong place, was misunderstanding. || Stuff was nice overall, charged me 10€ entry and another 12€ for one drink. Mainly old people, over 40.. techno and type of unclear music. Not for young people || The bar is wonderful, but the youngest man at the door doesn't know how to evaluate people, taking everyone for a teenage troublemaker. Another issue you should know, probably for the same reason: you're not allowed to go outside for some fresh air. || Even though the music is mostly good, there is no such an indie club vibe like that found in England, France, Germany or Spain. Locals are too conservative, hermetic and unready to deal with late night jargon or flirting,  while expats and tourists are provincial and clumsy. Club management is authoritarian and intolerant not to mention that the guy at the door refuses entry to groups of guys if the are not handsome or Caucasian enough  (witnessed recently) or tells you "You are not welcome any more" if you drink too much for the Estado Novo National Catholic social standards of politeness and behaviour like those in 1940. || Violence against women, harassment, aggression, misogyny, I don't know what else to write to describe the scene I experienced in this bar when I tried to use the men's bathroom (because the women's bathroom had a huge queue) and I was verbally attacked and physically by 3 men, they pulled me strongly by the arms. One claimed to be a manager and the other two bouncers, all unprepared and violent. Average music and poor bar service. People smoke indoors. Don't waste your time here. || The waiters were nice and good techno but the chief was very unpleasant and people weird. || Nice little club, but they charge you 20€ instead of 10€ if you are a foreigner. Haven't seen this anywhere else in the world but in Portugal. Nice way to welcome foreigners. || Were charged €5 as a "cover" fee on a Thursday night (no drinks included) only to notice the club was literally almost empty. We ordered and had to pay for  the one drink we had and left the place in a few minutes. Worst part was when another couple came in while we were leaving, the security guy didn't ask for a cover charge from them. Utter waste of time and scam of a place (would've been better on a weekend, but still looting the tourists is not a good thing at all)

place_name: The Lisbon Pub Crawl- Discover Lisbon
reviews_content: Leo is the man to do the Pub Crawl in Lisbon with. It was so much fun. Super cool group, stack cup game, dance, karaoke and drinks. Everything was awesome. || Joined the pub crawl twice whilst I was in Lisbon. The MOST fun, such a great way to meet people as I was travelling alone. Leo, Nicholas & Phelps were the BEST 🩷🩷🩷 || Met some cool people I wouldn’t have otherwise. VIP access at the bars. Good times waiting to happen.. Cheers🍻 || First pub crawl experience and definitely a very good one! The bars they brought us to were very nice, good music and space wasn’t a problem since the night was warm so some of us stayed outside. The alcohol included is nice, you get shots and an open bar. I don’t think you can get wasted but a bit tipsy maybe! The guides of the tour, especially Ana and Victoria especially, are nice and organised! I highly recommend 🤘🏻 || Hi Estelle, Thank you very much for  leaving such an amazing review. Lovely that you enjoyed our experiences. We look forward to seeing you again in the near future and party like we never did before.  Best regards, Discover Lisbon team || We had an amazing time with our tour guide Thomas!!! The free shots were trash though from the bars they tasted like juice! It overall was a fantastic time. Highly recommend :) || Phelps he is the best guy ever he is so friendly and funny I think I will try it just because of this. They are friendly and they know how to have fun they are the best || Lovely guide called tiago kept the group together and energetic. Definitely a recommendation. Lots of people and good communication and friendliness! || this was so fun and so safe and all tour guides were amazing!! had fun with us and made sure everyone was having a good time and accounted for. Anna T specifically was amazing and does deserve a raise! please do go on Portugal pub crawl || The pubcrawl was really nice  will sure we will recommend my friends, our tour guide MANNUUUUUU did a great job || Ton was such an amazing guide would definitely recommend if in Portugal for the night.

The music at this place is very good, and that’s what initially attracted us. Unfortunately, the experience was disappointing because of the way the drinks were handled.  At the entrance, we paid 20€ for two drinks, which were supposed to be included. However, when we ordered the second drink, we were asked to pay an extra 5€, with the explanation that the credit from the first drink had already been used and there was supposedly no balance left.  This was confusing and felt unfair, especially since the two drinks were clearly advertised as included. As tourists, we couldn’t help but feel taken advantage of. This is not how visitors should be treated, and it really ruined what could have been a great night with good music. || Hello, sorry to hear you fell deceived, i dont know what happened, but let me just give some informations, when you pay 20 euros at the entrance, you receive 20 euros in credit, normally its possible to have two drinks, since most drinks are 10 euros or less, but there are some, like with vodka with redbull or moscow mule , that are more expensive.  Our clients experience is very important for us, locals and tourists. || I had a great time. But the Dj wouldn’t play any music I requested.  I don’t mind that, but what they were playing made the crowd die out. I came with a hostel group and they all wanted the music I requested from a previous bar. But they kept saying they would and never did. I understand I’m in a different country, but I would think they wanna keep a lively crowd.  Not fully happy with it, but I see potential. || I was there yesterday, and the staff lied to us many times, saying they were going to open the other dance room at 2 am. After 2–3 am., we went to ask again if they were going to open it. They shut the door in our faces and screamed at us when we asked respectfully between songs so we could hear each other. They told us to leave and re-enter from the other side, which would have meant paying another €20, just one hour after we arrived. The staff was extremely rude, even though we tried to remain polite while speaking to them. Thieves. || Terrible against turists. The security wasn’t disrespectful but they denied entry just cuz we didn’t had tickets. Im sure even if we had tickets they would have said something about clothes or anything to not let us in just cuz we were not Portugies or whatever shit they call them selves. Most of Lisbon clubs were just like this one. Same as Lust in Rio. They said we had to buy tickets and make reservations before 22:00 clock but i read on their website day after that we can enter without tickets. And pay 20€ each. But the security told us it wasn’t possible. Not just this club but the whole Lisbon is just a big no, specially clubs. But in Lisbon they hate turists for some shity reasons. I have been in other small cities and they are very welcoming and also very respectful. || The Drinks are okay. The Service is okay. The Club is way too Full and crowded. They charge 20€ for entry and one Drink is 10€. They have different floors for different genres but it’s all the same music. Very commercial very Mainstream. Partially unfriendly Service. Location overrated. Too much tourists. Would Not recommend. || If i could I would give it 0 stars. We went there yesterday for Halloween, extremely complicated to get in even though we had Tickets. Had to pay 30€!! extra (per person) because apparently our tickets weren’t correct. They couldn’t tell us why their website had not charged us the correct price from the start. (At that the bouncers were extremely irritated and aggressive to the point where we felt really uncomfortable. We were very understanding but wanted to understand the extra 30€, as we had already paid a lot) Music is always subjective but for us the best way to describe it is kids club. Early 2000s songs with terrible djs. Overall chaotic, overly expensive drinks and not a good time. || We arrived there and immediately were refused at the main entrance, so a guy that works there came to see us, and told us to go by the other entrance, which normally opens to the main dance floor after 1-2 hours, that same guy told us it was going to open (not only him), but it never opened. We were away from our other friends and the music was so bad (not just my opinion), and every minute it became louder we couldn’t even talk. Several friends of mine were disrespected by a security (physically and verbally), just because they asked to go to the other side. Apart from that situation there was people smoking all kinds of things in there, which was horrible was the ambiance. A little bottle of water cost 4€, which is almost 30% of what I paid for the entry . The door in the toilet doesn’t even close. At the entrance the payment devices don’t work. They just want to make money and don’t care about what happens in their dance floors. They are racist and very disrespectful, so search for other places to go at night because you have high chances of having a bad night in there. || I visited the venue tonight and had an unsatisfactory experience. I arrived at the entrance and was stopped by security, and I still don’t understand how things were handled. Honestly, I felt disrespected, and I don’t say that lightly.  I’ve traveled around the world and visited many clubs, and I’ve never encountered this kind of treatment. I came expecting a good time, especially after seeing your Instagram story saying tickets/entrance would be available at the door.  Unfortunately, it wasn’t clear how the process worked, which left me feeling confused and unwelcome. I truly hope this feedback helps improve communication and the overall experience for future visitors.  Thank you for taking the time to read this. || The light is very good but the music wasn’t good and the price is way too high for the experience. And at the door they tell you 2 or 3 free drinks. But at the bar you only get one free drink. The price for women is 20€ for men 30€ || They charge women 20 euros, white men 30 euros, and black men 250 euros for entry. They don’t want black people in their club but have no problem playing black music. I would never come back here after seeing how they treat people of colour. || Great place to eat and then the doors open to the nite club. Spacious and has a great back yard to the river. This club is one to visit in Lisbon and since it’s big they let you in with some time slightly more expensive door entry. 🥳 || This place is so not worth it. Despite being part of a pub crawl, I wasn’t allowed entry along with another black person. After sometime, I was eventually allowed in. The process to check a coat was ridiculous and the workers weren’t friendly. Some of the security guards gave my friends a hard time and charged them €250 when everyone else had to pay €20. When I went to go help them out, the guard wouldn’t let me back in despite being with a group that was allowed entry already. Someone earlier that night had warned about this place and they were right. Just look at the reviews. DO NOT come to this place. || One of the best club in Lisbon for sure. I went there with some friends and we really enjoyed it. The music was just perfect, if you like 2000s hits and hip hop I highly recommend this club. The drinks are not that good || I’ve been here years ago and when I came back this year (Summer 2024), I told my friends that they gotta experience this “beach clubbing” in Portugal. So we went! My friends and I had an amazing time esp since we got in quite fast and started drinking right away!  When we weren’t drinking, we were just dancing since music was pretty good! Drinks were on the weaker side but it did its job and we were quite satisfied (and spirited) by 4 AM. Club closes at 7 but we were gone at that point.  One cool thing they do is having customer prepay a card so you gotta have a good estimate of how much you’re gonna drink. Initially, the lady suggested 25💶 for us girls but we’re heavy drinkers so we got 50💶 and it was more than enough!  We went back and forth between the inside dance floor and the patio where the pool is. Both areas were lit last night. :)  I highly recommend that you visit this spot! || Went to K Urban with a group of friends. A larger group I was with where all let in earlier we followed behind in a separate uber when we arrived we were told 20 for girls 30 for boys. Our friend was denied entry for wearing sports shorts. We left our friend and returned to the que 10 minutes later when we got to the front we were told 250 per person, when we asked why this changed just 10 minutes later they kept repeating if you don’t want to pay leave the Que. we tried to questions why they wouldn’t give a reason we asked dress code they said no. Others would come and be charged 30. My friend who is Asian asked if it was a race thing the bouncers didn’t even deny it by saying Yes and that Portugal was a free country, they could do what they like. Completely openly racist establisment. DISGUSTING. || A super great night club. A bit expensive : 30€ for men and 20€ for girls but you can spend this money in the club. It seems that it is not very selective. The atmosphere is super, great pool and infrastructure, great sound. And the cherry on the cake is the free popcorn ! || Absolutely terrible experience. We had tickets, but the staff refused to let us in. We stood outside in line for over two hours with no explanation or organization at all. The security and management were rude and unhelpful. Total scam… don’t waste your time or money on this place. || Maybe the music is ok, but the staff? Oh god, I’ve never seen such a horrible behavior, I wanted to throw up when I saw lady at the entrance how arrogant she was or when the bartender throw away our card to us 🥲 do not recommend! … || Absolutely terrible experience at Urban Beach Club in Lisbon. reviews_content: Cute 🌸 one of my favorite pracas of Lisbon … || Feels like a movie set in the best way. || I go to this cafe to play chess; this outdoor space in the middle of the city is spectacular. The Fernando Pessoa Garden, located in the Areeiro district of Lisbon, is a tranquil green space dedicated to one of Portugal’s most celebrated literary figures. Nestled among the urban surroundings, the garden offers a peaceful retreat with neatly landscaped paths, benches, and shaded areas ideal for quiet reflection or reading. Named after the iconic poet and writer, the garden subtly pays homage to Pessoa’s legacy, often drawing locals and tourists alike who are seeking a moment of calm amid the city’s rhythm. Its central location in Areeiro makes it easily accessible, serving both as a community gathering spot and a small cultural landmark. || One of the best playgrounds that I have found so far in Lisbon in terms of amenities, shade, other kids to play with, and safety from streets. We go all of the time. || Nice park. Clean and green. Kid friendly playground. And there is also a football cage. || Very welcoming place. Pleasant. However, the playground only has attractions for children up to 3 or 4 years old. They should do something similar to the Campo Pequeno park, with a lot of variety for different age groups. || This garden, for the long-time residents, is the Roma garden. It has always been known by that name. It was given the name Fernando Peça because he would occasionally go for a bike ride there early in the morning, even though he lived on a different block. || A well-kept garden near our house, where I often go with my grandchildren. The Parish Council organizes some very nice parties for the children. || Excellent park for leisure time. Cafe with outdoor seating. Sports field. Playground. Dog park. Extensive lawns. reviews_content: For me, one of the best spaces in the city of Lisbon. It's a shame it's poorly located and therefore almost always empty. A very insightful investment by EPAL that was well worth it. || A beautiful and peaceful garden, great for children to play and ride their bikes!

Well equipped, clean and entertaining playground. Plenty of slides, swings and play structures for smaller kids plus more challenging play structures for bigger kids. Note gravel surface was fine for 1 kid with no shoes but bothered the other one who kept her sandals on. Toilets strictly for kids only - attendant monitors adherence to the signs! Nice bar nearby - in common with plenty of playgrounds in Lisbon. || We were in Lisbon for vacation. I was riding the tram 28 with my toddler son and we decided to jump off the tram to go to the nearest playground.  It turned out it was a fun playground with little stones on the floor. Kids can play with the stones for a long time.  The playground is situated in a nice green park.  The slides are giraffe and lion shape. There are few swings. There isn’t much shades so it could be hot and sunny during summer days. || The best playground! The animal shaped structures are so cute! This is my first time seeing little pebbles as the playground floor, and my daughter loved it. There are decent swing sets for babies and older kids, and also a climbing structure in another area. The surrounding park is beautiful and busy, and parents can have a drink at the nearby quiosque. || Very good park perfect do go with children because it has a lot to do for kids in a Jung age || Excellent playground for children to play but be cautious going during work hours as the lady who works there will yell at any adult that attempts to climb or sit on a swing and threatens to call the cops on you. I advise visiting after 17:00 when she’s no longer there (plus it’s cooler with the sun going down) || The playground itself is very nice. But the lady who takes care of the toilets next to it is very bossy and kinda mean. The playground was almost completely empty and I just wanted to swing a little bit on the swings. I was not bothering anyone. The lady came out and said I was not allowed in there and needed to leave. Apparently it is forbidden to enjoy a swing set in peace when you're not a little kid anymore. For the rest the playground is nice with cool slides and climbing stuff || Not sure why this playground gets such high marks (aside from the lovely surroundings). The equipment is not actually very kid friendly. Younger children absolutely need assistance climbing, and the rocks are difficult to walk on. || Nice playground. Restrooms are just for kids. There are benches and water fountain closeby. || This is our favorite playground and park in Lisbon. There are two play areas…  The first is quite large with super small, smooth rocks for the surface and enclosed by a wooden fence. There you can find swings, slides, teeter totter, benches for parents, and all sorts of other fun. My kids love the rocks and spend half the time scooping and burying themselves. Bring sand toys and trucks for the ultimate rock experience.  The second play area is a giant rope pyramid! It’s awesome. I’ve even climbed up as far as my old body would allow. This is a kid favorite too.  Next to the play areas is a kiosk/cafe serving up everything you want - tostas, pastries, snacks, ice cream, wine, beer, cocktails. The kiosk has one small bathroom.  There’s a children’s only bathroom that is attended by a park worker to ensure the kid’s space remains safe and clean. There are water fountains around too.  The park has many shaded areas perfect for a picnic or birthday party. There’s another cafe on the other side of the park that is more calm and typically has fewer kids.  There are also peacocks that live there and they wander about and are a fun surprise for the kids. || Great for having coffee seating in nearby coffee place and watching your kids playing on the playground. Spacious, good variety of music from all over and lively atmosphere. || This review is my experience and doesn't try to  devalue anybody else. I had a great time at this club. I am a Black male based in London. My mate is also a Black male. we arrived around 10pm but soon realized that was way too early. we retuned around midnight and there was a line starting to form. I noticed people had barcodes to enter the club but did not think anything of it. When we got to the front, the bouncer casually just asked for 20 euros and let us in.  Th entry allows you to have 2 free drinks at the bar (limited but decent option) I had one of the best nights clubbing wise. From what I saw nobody was lingering in the corner trying to be the main character. Females would actually approach you for a dance. if you are having a good time they naturally gravitate towards you. The music was pretty good most of the time. Hi hop and RnB both international and domestic music. I didn't understand but the vibe was great. I cant wait to return to this club. || All the other reviews here are completely true. Whether you're a tourist or a local, do not go here regardless of your skin colour. Useless security, management that only cares about making money, and incredibly racist environment (even though they play music made by black people).  If you wanna enjoy a good time in Lisbon, this is a place to avoid. You can get  a better experience for cheaper. || Went on Lady's night, my friend who's is 20 got id' but ladies night was worth it. 3 free drinks with our free pass, make sure to sign up the night before. Would fe recommend this club. Plays Afro beats mostly || I landed up getting robbed inside the club by the security guard and his friends partying that night . I don’t recommend this place || I waited for several hours in front of this club last night to enter, I saw that they were making an unreal queue in front of the entrance, when there was no one inside, people they knew were standing in front of the door so that people would think that the queue to enter the club and inside was too long.  It's crowded, and when I wanted to enter with the quest list I had, they asked me for money while also scanning my QR to be counted as an entrance to the club, because they knew that there was no one inside and if I went in, I would quickly leave.  That's why they wanted to steal from the entrance fee by misleading people by creating a fake entrance queue || If I could rate it lower I would. Don't have anything nice to say about this place. The music wasn't even good. Outdated service mentality, wouldn't let me in because I was wearing pants, but men are allowed to wear pants. Have been there before a couple of times and it's always overcrowded and service is very slow. They wanted to charge us 1500$ dollars EACH to come in because we were speaking English. Called my friend who works there to let us in and she said it was 30€ per person. Discriminate based on looks, gender and race. DISGUSTING. DO NOT RECOMMEND EVER. || We had tickets but they didn’t let us go they demand for 1500€ very immature behaviour Don’t go there and ruin your night || Honestly it is the absolute worst representation of what Portugal is really about. How much worse can it get when a person of color discriminates another person of color? It was a horrible experience and honestly this place should fire all those discriminatory people or just close down completely. The world doesn’t need this kind of energy. If you are a decent human being, don’t go, not worth it. || Walked up to the club on a Tuesday evening with my black brother. Upon approaching I removed my hat well in advance of the door. Noticed 3 white ladies standing outside and 2 black bouncers. Upon arriving the front bouncer TURNED HIS BACK on us. We said hi, the then turned around and with a look like we had both got caught taking it in turns on his wife, looked us up and down then told us "It's a private party for Americans", he then banged on 1 of 4 signs by the door then turned and walked away. The ladies being American said something polite to us but stood in amazement. My 1st thought was shock rather than anger, shocked that the arrogance and rudeness without rhyme or reason. They made no attempt to conceal their blatant disregard for patrons who were clearly tourist up for a night of good clean fun. I would rather everyone boycotted this club, colour has nothing to do with it because if they treat a fellow person with such disrespect, no-one has a chance! I'm upset that I didn't read the reviews in advance. Don't waste your money, time or energy attempting to pursue a memorable evening in a place that encourages that style of behaviour from their staff. Truly shocking!!! || From the UK, went out looking for afrobeats and Afro Portuguese music after a lacklustre night elsewhere. Music was great, drinks nicely priced, good vibes and beautiful scenes would recommend || Staff is very rude. You have to pay for entrance and get one free "drink" not even filled, more like one shot. Vibe is really bad.

🇵🇹Good vibe club in Lisbon ☑️Music: Reggaeton, hip-hop, Brazilian funk & house ☑️Entry: €20 with 2 free drinks ☑️Space: Clean bathrooms and plenty of room  I love doing club tours whenever I travel, and I found Lust In Rio by accident while walking around Lisbon. I just followed the crowd in, and the vibe was instantly good. The music selection was great and kept the energy high all night. With two free drinks included in the entry fee and generous tequila shots, it didn’t feel expensive at all. The club was clean, spacious, and very comfortable to enjoy a long night out. I had an amazing time and would definitely recommend it. || Absolutely unacceptable experience. We paid €32.50 per ticket and were denied entry without any proper explanation. The way we were treated felt discriminatory and disrespectful. No refund was offered. Poor management and even worse customer service. Avoid this place. || It's a nice club to spend the night/dawn, some good all arround music, good atmosphere and nice people. On the summer they have the space outside open so it allows a different vibe to it. The drinks are a bit pricey and you may not me allowed to enter if they deem so, but other than that I would recommend you go at least once. || One of the worst club experiences I’ve ever had.  We were denied entry for no legitimate reason whatsoever, while others were allowed in without issue. The staff offered vague excuses, avoided eye contact, and made it very clear we were not welcome. The entire situation felt discriminatory and humiliating.  If you’re going to run a nightclub in a city as diverse as Rio, you should at least pretend to respect people equally. Instead, Lust operates with arrogance, selective entry, and zero transparency. No professionalism, no courtesy, no explanation—just prejudice wrapped in a velvet rope.  Plenty of better clubs in Rio that actually value customers and don’t judge people based on who they are or where they come from. Save your time, money, and dignity. Avoid this place. || Terrible against turists. The security wasn’t disrespectful but they denied entry just cuz we didn’t had tickets. Im sure even if we had tickets they would have said something about clothes or anything to not let us in just cuz we were not Portugies or whatever shit they call them selves. Most of Lisbon clubs were just like this one. Same as Urban beach. They said we had to buy tickets and make reservations before 22:00 clock but i read on their website day after that we can enter without tickets. And pay 20€ each. But the security told us it wasn’t possible. Not just this club but the whole Lisbon is just a big no, specially clubs. But in Lisbon they hate turists for some shity reasons. I have been in other small cities and they are very welcoming and also very respectful. || Hello, we apologize for the negative experience you had with us.  We appreciate your feedback and are committed to improving our services. We would appreciate the opportunity to improve your experience.  If you wish, please contact us directly by phone or email.  Thank you for your review. || This club is a shame. I don’t recommend  for anyone. First, people who are not from Portugal need to pay the triple of the price to enter (30 euro vs 12 euro for Portuguese people). For information the other club around don’t do that. Second, the guard to enter was incredibly arrogant, racist and mean. I showed my card of identity Portuguese because I’m Portuguese but I have an accent. And the guard tell me to go on the other line cause I’m « a stranger »  I speak with him calmly in Portuguese and show again my Portuguese card of identity and he told me « U don’t understand what I’m saying or what ? ». I have a strong feeling that I have been a victim of racial discrimination.  I don’t think it’s a good idea to give money to people who think and act like that when u have other club near which was really nice with us || NEVER go here. The worse club you can go to, its 40€ to get in, we got assualted by the Guards to try ask what the Price was, and the when we went out the guard forced my friend to pay 30€ for ”buying a drink” that he never even paid, they hate men here! PLEASE NEVER GO HERE! || Chill club, but I heard them charging the girl in front of me €10 and when it got to us it was €20 for entry + 2 drink but it is a bit inconsistance || This is the worst place in Lisbon! Don’t waste your time or money here. We were 5 gents who had booked a table for my 40th birthday to have dinner. It took them 2 hrs to get the mains on the table and when we complained about the long wait they threatened with the police! Complete idiots, avoid at all cost, this place should shut down tomorrow! Crappy playlist as well, alot better options around town to favor! || We were supposed to have free entry, but staff kept everyone waiting outside until after the deadline. When we were finally let in—just two minutes late—we were told we had to pay. While we were still deciding, the doorman suddenly acted aggressively: he pulled me by the arm and grabbed my bag so roughly that it ripped. What shocked me most was that he didn’t care at all about the damage he caused and simply carried on as if nothing had happened. This behavior was completely unacceptable. I would strongly advise against visiting this place. || One of the best clubs in Portugal, bouncers may be a bit overaggressive at times, and the music could use some variety || Can’t rate de food as i just being there for a drink. Space is nice & Staff in the bars great. Can’t say the same about the bouncers/security that are Rude and unpleasant, unfortunately the culture of you need to be rude to work in the night clubs still is a must in Lisbon . they are the 1st contact before you enter the club , they should be more approachable and welcoming. || We could not go in due to an almost certainly homophobic rejection of our friend who was simply wearing a highly covering yellow tank top, the security guard claiming it wasn’t part of the dress code (which was not described ANYWHERE, be that on the website or in person.) I asked him what the dress code was, and re refused to tell me and kept turning away. Considering the fact that I was wearing a considerably skimpier vest, other girls in our group wearing crop tops etc, this bodyguard was clearly acting out of prejudice. || I was invited by the company I work for to one of their evenings. they bounced me because I was wearing shorts, but they did it in a very rude way, with the security looking at me as if they wanted to punch me just because I asked why I couldn't come in. Not bad, I guess I didn't miss anything || I wish I could give them 0 starts, because they don’t deserve any stars, me and my friends went there, and my friends were Portuguese nationals. It was disorganized and the staff was rude and racist and they were letting people in but once we got to the front they said that we had to pay €500 for a table for us to get in which is ridiculous and we was not told that in advance. We saw other people pay to enter without having to reserve a table for €500 and I noticed how they were treating other black people, we wasn’t the only ones. This place is racist and I hope they get shut down and go out of business. || went with my friends and as we went in the bouncer told us we'd need to pay 10€ when we were leaving and at the end of the night às we went to pay we were forced to pay 15€ to leave because we were given the wrong card.... and no one cares or tried to sold our problem, only forced us to pay or we couldn't leave. dont recommend and would not repeat || Music was awful, way too many people in there and all the bar staff were terrible like they were on something. You get 2 drinks tokens when you pay entrance and we asked for Malibu and coke, they said no only vodka or gin. The other 2 girls in the group asked for Malibu and got it. The staff just stood at the bar ignoring you until you shouted at them for attention, it was like you were invisible. Will not be going back || Doesn’t even need rating , awfull staff , sh*t treatment from the bodyguard’s like your life depends on them , totally waste of time going there , i’ve never seen a nightclub single normal entrance coast 50 bucks (it’s like giving the monkey a pen) || Worse is the service, arrogance and lack of respect for unprepared employees. Last time I'm going to visit this place when I'm in Lisbon. I don't recommend it. || Service and atmostphere are ok... But security personel is made of some highly profesional individuals and some that are literally pushing for money to give them.Even when u tip them theyre pushing for more every time u pass near them,highly unprofessional and unplesant behaviour. || The worst club I've ever been to... You should visit it to see what I mean XD. Music just like the radio is on. No mixing, just play and stop.They distinguish between locals and tourists. I mean tourist pay more, Portuguese less at the entrance.  It's always full because people wanne feel the vibe of an outdoor club... No more, no less...  I recommend: stay out, go somewhere else and spend your money there. Or just turn on Spotify, gives you more party than this club...  Peace || There was blatant profiling at the gate deciding who can go in or not on the guise of not having a table when tables could be bought on site. Dress '' fancy'' for this pretentious place and they will not tell you till you queue 20 mins to get into the entrance. By the time it was my turn to get a table I was so disturbwyd I left || 20€ for entry with 2 drinks. Had to wait around 30 minutes but there were no issues with getting in. (as tourists who don't speak Portuguese).  I like the concept of this place, HOWEVER music was terrible, there were 5? DJs and they were all bad. 95% of the people were just standing on the dancefloor and talking to each other.  Maybe we were unlucky and got in a boring night 🫣 || Bouncer charged 30€ than the people in front of us and when we asked why, he told us to leave, the place looks nice though. || A very good club. The smoke smell isn’t very strong inside and the DJs are good. The staff were always happy to serve us and as long as you pay a certain amount they will cater a space for you to dance and drink. || Staff is horrible. Rude and dishonest. Music is absolutely horrible. The whole club was dead, no one was dancing. Worst 30 euros I have ever spent in my life. This club was the worst thing in my entire trip. Do not go to this club it is horrendous. Security guards were entitled assholes who did not want to let us in. After we got in, they tried to kick us out 5 times for “not dancing” even thought the music was so bad no one else in the club was dancing. || Don’t mind bad reviews, club is good spacious with great international music. Smoking is allowed inside (might be disadvantage for some people, but not for those who party). Security is kind and understanding (despite lacking some English proficiency). || had a ticket from the boat party. we were ready , but some of the guys had (with very nice outfits) birkenstocks on, which were not allowed, so didn‘t get in. made no sense, ridiculous. || Better than most of the clubs, not perfect but still worth to try. Center area was good. || Discriminatory and Unacceptable Treatment at the Entrance  Our group of friends (Portuguese, Italians, and South Africans) had a deeply disappointing and frankly discriminatory experience at Lust in Rio.  Upon arrival, we noticed two lines. We joined the one on the right, but when we reached the front, a bouncer separated us based on nationality. Non-Portuguese guests (despite living in Portugal for years, speaking the language, and even having Portuguese NIFs) were told to move to another queue. Once we got to the front of that line, we were informed that entry for Portuguese nationals was €20, but non-Portuguese had to pay €30 — and €40 later in the night.  This kind of pricing discrimination based on nationality is unacceptable, especially in a diverse and international city like Lisbon. We were respectful and polite throughout, yet some of the staff — particularly a bald bouncer with glasses — were unnecessarily aggressive.  This experience showed clear signs of exclusion. A club that treats people this way should seriously reflect on its policies and staff behavior

A really cool club for alternative/rock/goth music lovers . The entrance fee is reasonable. The bar prices are a bit expensive but the bartenders are very nice. There is a small nice dance floor . The place is decorated with all kinds of pictures of famous rock singers. A place worth visiting if you are looking for night clubing in the alternative/rock/goth genre ^.^ || Was on last track to transzentral when Leon Mussxhe pf inovertedsummoned me for a bedon adventire that slowed down the pace to chill. || Loved the environment and people. Goth like vibe and nice environment. || I’ve been there just once, and it was a really nice surprise! Ok it’s a bit tiny, the decoration is a bit cheesy, but that’s also part of the charm. Staff is friendly, entrance and drinks are cheap, and overall music was really great, and not the kind of music you usually have in night clubs (a lot of cold wave music!). I definitely will come back ;) || Pretty decent place. Only problem I faced was that no one spoke English; if you're traveling by yourself I'd say you reconsider. It's a pretty chill place otherwise!  EDIT: my bad, by 'no one' I meant the customers there (nothing reflecting the management) The bartenders (and bouncers?) spoke pretty decent English. I came here for the techno/electronic music and was not let down. || Hum...thats strange considering the people working there do speak english and most portuguese do too. I work there every evening and i would say my english is not that bad... || Be aware! When getting closer to this club it almost seems like, there is nothing going on. Quiet part of the town, though still close to the center. No lights outside. No pubs around. But we had a fantastic night there. Really good mix from darker, more electronic music to alternative classics. || Thank you for your review. We are happy that you enjoyed yourself || Very different but cool atmosphere! It's interesting and  enjoyed out time here. Staff were lovely and a couple of locals took us under their wing || Best Alternative club in tonw. Cant miss this one. Best Staff ever, Amazing decoration!  Sound colection is the best !! LOVE IT!! || One of the best Goth / Punk / Nordic / Metal scene clubs to go to in Lisbon! 10/10 recommend || Wouldn't recommend for casual club goers, very small dingy place. I do like metal music myself, but the music was weird industrial Goth music, maybe I got it on a bad night. || Hi. We do have metal nights as well as goth/indie and electronic nights. It depends on the events.We're also quite a large club but on thurdays we only open half of it. Mybe thats when you went?.

place_name: The Lisbon Pub Crawl- Discover Lisbon
reviews_content: Leo is the man to do the Pub Crawl in Lisbon with. It was so much fun. Super cool group, stack cup game, dance, karaoke and drinks. Everything was awesome. || Joined the pub crawl twice whilst I was in Lisbon. The MOST fun, such a great way to meet people as I was travelling alone. Leo, Nicholas & Phelps were the BEST 🩷🩷🩷 || Met some cool people I wouldn’t have otherwise. VIP access at the bars. Good times waiting to happen.. Cheers🍻 || First pub crawl experience and definitely a very good one! The bars they brought us to were very nice, good music and space wasn’t a problem since the night was warm so some of us stayed outside. The alcohol included is nice, you get shots and an open bar. I don’t think you can get wasted but a bit tipsy maybe! The guides of the tour, especially Ana and Victoria especially, are nice and organised! I highly recommend 🤘🏻 || Hi Estelle, Thank you very much for  leaving such an amazing review. Lovely that you enjoyed our experiences. We look forward to seeing you again in the near future and party like we never did before.  Best regards, Discover Lisbon team || We had an amazing time with our tour guide Thomas!!! The free shots were trash though from the bars they tasted like juice! It overall was a fantastic time. Highly recommend :) || Phelps he is the best guy ever he is so friendly and funny I think I will try it just because of this. They are friendly and they know how to have fun they are the best || Lovely guide called tiago kept the group together and energetic. Definitely a recommendation. Lots of people and good communication and friendliness! || this was so fun and so safe and all tour guides were amazing!! had fun with us and made sure everyone was having a good time and accounted for. Anna T specifically was amazing and does deserve a raise! please do go on Portugal pub crawl || The pubcrawl was really nice  will sure we will recommend my friends, our tour guide MANNUUUUUU did a great job || Ton was such an amazing guide would definitely recommend if in Portugal for the night.

Had an amazing night at Posh Club Lisbon! As a gay club, it delivered everything I was hoping for — fun, energy, and most importantly, a space where I felt totally safe and welcomed. The drag queens were absolutely fabulous and brought so much life to the stage! Great music, good drinks, and a crowd full of good vibes. Can’t wait to come back next time I’m in Lisbon! 🌈💃🍸 || Nice modern club but paying €8 for 0.5L beer (more than in Brussels) is a TRUE RIPOFF. Luckily I got a wristband in the city and entered for free || THE BEST CLUB IN LISBON. PERIOD. If you like funk, this is 100% the place for you! I am in love with the club, the bartenders, the djs, the dancers. Everyone speaks English, people are friendly. There are only young people here in their 20s, everyone is dancing, and it feels like a safe space ♥️ || Go here if you’re desperate. The music is horrendous, and the staff and crowd match. We asked the bouncer if it was busy and entered to a sad room listening to 2013 Nicki Minaj. || We were last night there and everything was very expensive. Just to get in was 15€ per person with no drink included. When we got inside, drinks were expensive as well, a gin tonic was 15€ and a mini cider that you could drink by a sip was 4€ || Amazing experience !!! Safe & hilarious, with the anti covid-19 security measures to perfection. The food very good and at a more than reasonable price! Super recommended!!! The best option for the night in Lisbon as the situation is due to the pandemic. || Amazing night club! Bartenders are super nice, security people as well. It was night after Madonna’s concert so they we’re playing only her music, but It was good!! I got a chance to learn more about Madonna, since I didn’t knew many of her songs before that night! Everyone is so nice, met some really nice people and had a great time with them. My friends also enjoyed their time here! I recommend this place! Big dance floor and separate room for those who love to sit and rest for a bit. || Very nice place. Club for party and nice friendly good moments and good Drink 🍹 || Decent club, packed on a Saturday night when we got there at around 1:30am. Music trended pop / Brazilian beats and crowd was on the younger side. 1 drink included with entry. || I love this disco! It’s better lgbtqia+ place of Lisbon! || The music was great, the place it’s not too bad ,i like it but there’s one thing that makes me rate this place 1 star , the worst bartenders and the worst service. As a LGBTQ+ tourist visiting this club i did not felt welcomed by the bar staff , i tried to order and they guys said to me that they don’t speak English ( this is not the problem) the real problem is that they were avoiding me and avoiding to take my order, they were serving other people even though i was waiting next to the bar for long time. Lucky there was 2 amazing girls one DJ which took my first order and another one most likely the dancer team. You should consider hiring new bar staff which are not that rude and unprofessional. || Actually a great bar, great atmosphere…. LGBTQ+ friendly … but perhaps we came in on a wrong night !! Looks like Posh was hosting a high school Halloween party lol just not what we anticipated that’s all !! Bar is nice, staff r friendly and bouncers at door r nice too || Don’t waste your time. If you have a ticket to enter on a specific limited hour. You will have to wait 45min in a 30 meter queue (20 people). And when it’s your turn, they will say that your ticket is not more valid because you “arrived too late”. Even if you arrive 45 min earlier. || We were going to get in the club and we saw a girl that was in a very bad state. There were 3 girls that were passing by and didnt know her and were helping her, while the security staff was standing there. I know that a security staff sees a lot of these things and they get used to it but what pissed me off was that they never seemed to worry about the girl and ignored the situation completely. Very unprofessional, you cant even call an ambulance? || Hi, how are you? Many customers arrive at our door in a state of excessive intoxication. And our policy is not to admit customers in that state. However, we provide full support and information to all customers. In this specific case, the customer did not accept the refusal of entry. Regards 🫂 … || The club itself and music was pretty good but the bouncers were unnecessarily rough and unfriendly. The bar tenders were nice. We paid the full price to get in (10€ each) and had to leave the club after about half an hour because they were closing. Kind of felt like a ripoff... || One of the three largest gay dance venues (along with Trumps and Construction), Posh has a very mixed, mainly younger, crowd. Themed dance nights on the weekends sometimes need to be booked online in advance. || What a dump! 1. If you are after an underaged crowd, this is your place. I seriously question the legality of the crowd in there, 90% looked like they were under 18 or will turn 18 tomorrow…  2. Smoking room is a joke, the smoke goes EVERYWHERE in the club. It was so smoky, i had to get close to the entrance for some fresh air. ironically I wasn’t allowed out of the club to get some fresh air. And that’s while Covid still prevalent🤯 (no masks were worn except for the doormen), they pack you like sardines, let the teenagers go wild in the “smoke room” and don’t let you out for fresh air… Where have I see that before hmmm  3. The event I went for was a drag race party. Club opens 11-06. The doors were not even open at 11. We queued for about an HOUR not because there was such a dream demand, but because the doors were closed. Once we were in, I’m not even sure what time the show started, we waited until 2:30 and left. By then it was insanely overcrowded, ridiculously smoky (they banned indoor smoking for a reason 15 years ago, you know!) and who the hell starts a show after 2:30 am??  Complete and utter dizasta. If you have any respect for yourself, go somewhere else.  I should have known, a club that feels the need to call itself Posh, definitely won’t be that 😅 || We came for July 1st event where OnlyFans creators are supposed to give a great show but not a single creator came up so we left at 3am. Now their page has removed this post. Totally misleading customers. || This assessment does not reflect reality. We never announced that content creators would be performing a show. We only mentioned VIP appearances, and everyone was there. The post is removed every week to make room for new ones. || Seems to work at weekend. entree cost 15 euro and you get 2 drinks. average age was 18-22 I think (maybe less?), or that how it felt. and around half were ladies. was playing pop music when i was there. || Club with pretty decent interior but saddly full of underaged children and only pop music. There is no place for non-smokers and since crowd there is underaged, everyone is pretty rude and ignorrant. Staff is very nice and they have free entrance with bracelet till 3:30am. || Our clients are over the age of 16, as the Law Says! We have no minors here! about POP music! Yes, it is our work and success tool.

We chose this nightclub for our New Year’s Eve celebration, and unfortunately, it turned out to be a total letdown. From the moment we walked in, there was this strong, unpleasant smell in the air—maybe from a poorly maintained AC or just a general lack of upkeep—and it was strong enough to make us feel almost nauseous.  The venue itself is old and rundown, which could have been fine if it had some nostalgic charm, but it was just not well maintained. The toilets were dirty, and it was difficult even to wash your hands properly in the ladies' room.  But the real deal-breaker of the night was the DJ and the overall event organization. We did not enjoy the music at all. The DJ didn’t interact with the crowd, couldn’t read the room at all, and the worst part: they completely missed the midnight countdown. They started counting after midnight had already passed, which just summed up the whole chaotic and disappointing experience.  In short, we were definitely not impressed and wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for a well-organized and pleasant New Year’s Eve celebration. || Our first visit - IT DEFINITELY WON’T BE OUR LAST - AMBIANCE ABOUNDS- wonderful sound system Fantastic DJs - Perfect music mixing (predominately 80s music) Professional reception at the entrance. Drinks, service, general hospitality all excellent & prices very reasonable, especially when taking into consideration they are open until about 06:00!! WEDNESDAY NIGHT IS LADIES NIGHT - My wife LOVED it! || Thank you so much for your feedback 🙏 See you soon and best wishes to you both 💙 … || Lisbon's oldest club is still a true gem. The music is exceptional, blending different genres of the classics. The atmosphere combines historical charm with a lively vibe. Service is impeccable, with warm and attentive staff. A must-visit for a perfect night out. || Nice place to dance. It takes time to get used to Lisabon's DJs but after that it goes smoothly. || It was good but the DJ wouldn’t play Duran Duran for me :( || The place is nice but the dj is super crap with that royal level garbage he calls music 🤮 || Was recommended this place by the young man working the front desk at the hostel I was staying at when I asked where I could go dancing. I had so much fun and I don't even like 80's music. Diverse crowd age-wise with most in their mid 20's and 30's when I went. Everyone seems to be there to dance and sing. I was fine going there by myself and totally danced the night away. In general, good vibes with a nice open dance floor. What staff I interacted with was friendly. There's a cover charge but that also gives you a free drink or two depending on what you order. Also, they offer coat check for a nominal fee. I got there a little after 12:30. By 12:45 it was pretty packed. When I left around 4:30, there was still a line outside. || Good atmosphere, great music. 🤗 || Coming from London, beware, as a male you’ll be required to pay in CASH around 20 euros. If you want to partake in the local tax evasion, sure. If you’re a woman, you’ll get in without paying a fee. || Nice place, we visited past midnight. Had a lot of fun. You can store your coats in the wardrobe. Bouncer at the door.

We had reserved a VIP table weeks in advance. When we arrived, they had given our table away. Then, they tried to set up a table in the exit hallway. It was hysterical. We refused that, so they set up half a table where only 2 people could sit blocking the walkway to the dance floor. It was fine, there was not much need for a table.
