Despite the incredible venue I won’t be coming back because 2 hours for a quick lunch is crazy. || Hi Samantha  We are sorry that your experience with us was so unpleasant  As a hospitality business, we don’t usually make excuses to poor service, but in this case I feel like we should  On Friday, as we were preparing to open, a member of our family, whom also happens to help us in the kitchen, had a medical emergency and for that reason we could not open the restaurant. On Saturday, we were still one person down, and should not have opened our doors, but we we had to, as we are an independent, family ran business, and this is our only source of income.  Saturdays are usually our busiest day of the week.  As hospitality professionals we tend not to bring personal problems into our service and interactions with our dear guests, but sometimes even machines break down . Again, we are sorry we might have ruined your day by taking too long to cook your meal, and when I brought your food to your table and sincerely apologised for the delay, both yourself and one of the other guests at your table smiled and said”no problem”. If there was still a problem we could’ve sorted it out there and then  When you give a business a 1 star review, you have no idea of the negative impact it has on all of the people involved in that business.  And just to put facts straight, nobody forgot to put your order through. I have a copy of the order docket coming in, and when we realised we had no cauliflower prepped, we warned you it would take longer than usual to make it from scratch.  BETWEEN ORDERING, EATING AND PAYING YOUR BILL, 1 hour and 5 mins went by. NOT 2 HOURS  We will issue a full refund for your €41 check, with the condition that you keep your promise not to grace us with your presence ever again. And please, spread the word amongst your peers of how bad we are, as we want to try and avoid catering for inconsiderate shitty people, that lie and diminish others just to make themselves feel better  P.s: the member of staff is recovering well and should be back to work sometime next week. Not that you’d care. Obrigado! || Everything was great! Amazing tasty food with a great view, friendly service and chill atmosphere with nice music and tasty beer. That was definitely our favourite place in Lisbon so far, we warmly recommend the pumpkin & burrata. || Great spot for a bite.  Get the winfow seat || Lovely service and delicious food! They also have a good wine offer. Our favourit place in this area. || We have been there with a one year old,first just to drink some beer,chill a bit after the long walk up hill, and we wanted to sit outside on the steps so the music wont bother the kid plus we could walk with him outside. And the staff was super nice,that we could sit there,also could order sardinia with potato and could also eat outside. The food was perfect, and we were really greatful for the staff for being so understanding with our family☺️🙏🏽 || Lovely view, tasty & fresh dishes, efficient service… Overall, very very good!! || Amazing food, great drinks, spectacular view. || Amazing food, great staff and drinks, we had an amazing experience here! || Very nice place with great view on the church. Great service, delicious food as well as very decent prices for the area.

Almost 5 years in Lisbon and I didn't know this place. What a shame!  I liked the vibe, it's like going to TimeOut Market but more private, and more elegant.  We went for the Matheus Dry, the bottle went for 16 euros, which in my opinion is a great price. We really liked it ans we sat right at the bar.  They have a lot of choices to pick from, and great presunto and cheese to complement the wine. We didn't try that, unfortunately.  Instead we went for a prego with fries and mustard that was pretty nice. However, overpriced in my opinion. It goes for 15 euros, but in my opinion it should be 9 - 12.  All in all is a great place. I will come here for my next date! || Had a lovely evening trying all different kinds of wine with some great recommendations from our waitress. All the wines we had were great and very fun to try a selection! The food was also great, the croquettes and the veal cheeks especially. The interior was also super cool and very different which adds to the experience. Would recommend but probably do have to book in advance! || This restaurant is very pretty & interesting inside and it’s fun to try wines by the glass. I was however disappointed by the food. The tuna & plantain appetizer was much too sweet and over dressed. The octopus w green pea entree was unique and tasty but over salted. Yet the chocolate cake was perfect. Our waitress aimed to please and match wines to our personal preferences. The customers next to us ordered a charcuterie board w mix of meats and cheese which looked much better than our app. || We’d originally planned to do a wine tasting here but didn’t get round to booking this in advance. We turned up, explained and asked if a tasting was possible to which they agreed to let us sample three wines and then share a glass of our favourite from these three. We did this twice, once with white wine and once with rose.  The barman was very knowledgeable and friendly and guided us through our selections with ease.  The striking interior design of this place is centred around backlit wine bottles which cover the arched ceiling. We sat at the bar for about an hour and observed how busy it got. A reservation for dinner would be advised….. || Stumbled across it by chance one night and saw a line outside - returned the following night to properly investigate. Stunning food and excellent and reasonably priced by the glass range. Waiters worked as a seamless team and explained the menu with excellent detail. Highly recommend tuna on plantains, tempura green beans and ribs with polenta. || Sensational interior, hard working team, and compelling offering. Slick. The tuna tartar with toasted plantain was outstanding. So too the carpaccio of octopus. The peixinhos da horta were on point, but the fried calamari were over cooked and consequently tough. Ordered a bottle of verdelho from Açores having tasted a delicious sample of the same by the glass. The bottle ordered was badly corked and bore no resemblance to the thimbleful of a minute before. Sadly, a young man carving ham, who was asked by our clearly distressed waitress what to do, decided to explain to me that it wasn’t corked, but simply not the right temperature and recently opened (he then surreptitiously re-corked the bottle and secreted it under the bar). I’ve been collecting, trading and enthusiastically drinking wine for over forty years and have managed to develop a ‘nose’. These guys should know better than to try and pretend a wine is fine when it clearly isn’t. We ordered a different local bottle, an Encruzado from Dão that was delicious. Similar price range circa €55 - so both quite decent choices. Sadly the only bad taste left was the charlatan behaviour of an employee trying to shaft the clientele. I only pray it isn’t emblematic of a more cynical business and employee bullying culture - we genuinely felt worried for our waitress having merely explained the product was off. True lovers of wine know when a wine is corked - these guys either don’t (which is not a great sign) or worse, the business model says, bully the customer until they give in if the wine is expensive. Caveat emptor if you darken this door. I’d still return believing the lack of grace, good manners and the rude treatment by one particular employee shouldn’t be enough to ruin what is definitely a commendable operation. || Got the chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream, paired with a port wine. The chocolate cake was delicious, albeit probably 100 000 calories. Paired with a really good vanilla ice cream, with some dalt and crumbs, it did not dissapoint! The port was a really good choice by the waiter. All in all good experience! || Excellent wine bar that we accidentally stumbled in. And it was totally a pleasant surprise. The Green wine is delicious. They do have some snack, but not a huge selection. But you are here for the wine, not the food. || Stumbled upon this place, headed to our dinner reservations and decided to stop in for a glass of wine.  Beautiful place with super helpful servers.  We grabbed a couple seats at the bar for a glass of wine.  Great spot to watch the gentleman slicing ham and making gorgeous charcuterie boards.  So the next night, we went for dinner after seeing all the amazing plates the night before.   Food was lovely.  Wine was fantastic.  Service was great with amazing suggestions. || We came here for our last dinner in Portugal and loved it! The food was good but the highlight was the wine and the service. Our waitress was so knowledgeable and let us try different wines while explaining the different regions in Portugal. I would recommend for wine lovers looking for a fun vibe || Good value for money with delicious tapas in Lisbon.  We stumbled upon this place on google search and booked ahead online  Food was fast and service was good.  Highly recommend sardine, octopus, plume, croquette, and mushroom  Overall good vibes and good prices || Decent large wine bar. Food is ok, but not fine.  Wine selection is distributor driven, not curated.  No sommelier, or at least no obvious one. Beer hall vibe.  Great for after work or a quick drink. || By the Wine quickly became my favorite wine bar in Lisbon — and not just because of the iconic wine bottle ceiling. The food is great, the wine list by the glass is solid, but what truly sets this place apart is the staff. They're incredibly welcoming, knowledgeable, and always ready with spot-on wine recommendations. Their warm, attentive service elevates the entire experience. A fantastic place all around — highly recommended! || Absolutely lovely place to taste very good portuguesw wine!! Also the staff was so friendly and the different tapas where a fusion between spanish, portuguese and latin american dishes! The portuguese cheese absolut must at the end together with the lime cake || Great food and great experience. The octopus was incredible. The wine was delicious. It’s a great place to go to for a great dinner! || We went on a walk till I found the perfect place to eat! We were lucky enough to get 4 bar seats as we had no reservation and it was extremely busy!! Atmosphere popping and so much fun. The decor was beautiful and the food and the green wine were impeccable. I had a sandwich that had arugula, beef, and most amazing mustard sauce. I’m drooling thinking about it!!! I wanted to go back and sadly never made it hopefully one day! || We discovered this restaurant in the afternoon and asked to book a table. Unfortunately, it was already fully booked but were given the option to sit in the bar if we came back in the evening which we did and were welcomed immediately the very friendly hostess. A big selection of wines, the food is very tasty but the portions are quite big so ordered a bit too much (we asked the waitress if it was and she said no it is ok). when the food arrived - after a good wait  - we were surprised by the quantity, most probably there has been a mess up in the kitchen cause all our food arrived at the same time and it was much but delicious. Highly recommend the place and the staff is very nice and fun. || We were in Lisboa for 2 nights, and I feel downright lucky to have found this bar. The owner has crafted an experience, from the ambiance of the bar and decor of the gorgeous dining area, to the wine selection. He has found a wine to fit any taste, and is capable of helping you find it with grace and ease, though not every bartender is as adept. The cheese, though its smell overwhelmed when he first cut open the wheel, melted into gorgeous, sumptuous flavors that kept me engaging with it and his selection of wine for several hours.  I know I'll return to this bewitching city if for nothing else than to spend another evening at BytheWine. || We stopped by By The Wine without a reservation and were pleasantly surprised to be seated right away at the bar. The bartender was super friendly and gave us great wine recommendations, each glass hit the spot. We paired them with a cheese and charcuterie board, which was just as impressive. Quality ingredients, cozy atmosphere, and smooth service. A great little stop for a spontaneous wine break, highly recommended. || Great vibes for dinner. They have big table for big groups in the back hall. Food was good, some dishes like the octopus was excellent.

A great hidden gem in Lisbon! The location is ideal, very central. Great environment, delicious drinks. Cabal is that type of bar that will suit everybody: a great vibe inside, and a big open terrace outside.  We tried some classic cocktails and Cabal signatures: Panther Martini, o.f Martini and Rooibos Spritz. All three were delicious and unique.  A definite must-try in Lisbon! || Thank you so much! Which one of the three was your favorite? 👀 … || I'd been looking for a nice cocktail bar in Lisbon and this one is tucked away behind a really busy part of Lisbon! Tried a few different cocktails, favourite being the Osaka Basil - so refreshing!! And the other two cocktails had quirky twists. A martini with tequila infused gummy bears and a purple martini served with purple pickles! Overall the vibe is really nice with a DJ inside and a nice outdoor esplanade || Wow Aimée thank you for such an amazing review! The pics are great, they really capture the vibe. We truly hope to see you soon, thanks again! || Cabal is such a vibe. The space itself looks amazing -stylish but still super comfortable -and it really adds to the whole experience. We tried their Negroni with coffee and wow… it’s one of the best twists on a classic I’ve ever had even though I’m not a fan of negroni ) 🫣😋  Honestly, every drink I’ve tried here has been spot on. The team is awesome too – really welcoming and fun to hang out with. Definitely one of the best drink spot I’ll keep coming back to❤️🙏 || Nastya thank you so much! Great pictures. It was amazing to host you. We agree on the Negroni part || Met some friends at cabal on a Tuesday and we couldn’t have had a better experience. We were looking forward to try the cocktails and treated ourselves with six different options to try.  All of them were honestly great , but if you’d like some ideas, here’s my review of the ones suggested by the barman: - o.f.martini - my favourite; sweat and sour at the same time, perfect taste, served with gummies, 10/10 - old fashioned Portuguese - stronger taste but not overwhelming, definetly try if you’re into “bolder” flavors, - rooibos spritz - if you’re not a fan of aperol spritz like me then this is the perfect alternative, fruity , fresh, not too intense, really liked it  To make it better, the DJ had the perfect set for the occasion, chilled but you could move a little to it if you’d like, and the ambience just feels welcoming overall.  We’ll definitely come back!!  🥰 || Loved the pictures! Thank you so much || I absolutely love this bar! I have been in the city for a while now and this is one of the coolest bars in town. Great environment, spacious, beautiful drinks, easy access and good music. The cocktails are tasty, creative and fun! || Thank you Rafaela! It's an honor || Cabal Cocktail Bar is one of those places that quietly exceeds every expectation. From the moment you walk in, you can tell this isn’t your average cocktail spot — it’s got that perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. The lighting is warm and atmospheric, the music hits that sweet spot where you can still hold a conversation, and the staff immediately make you feel welcome without being intrusive.  The cocktail menu is outstanding — creative without being pretentious. Every drink feels carefully balanced and thoughtfully crafted. I had the whiskey sour. My friend tried the Hugo, and it was easily one of the best floral cocktails I’ve ever tasted (and I’ve tried a lot!). You can tell the bartenders here are true mixologists who take pride in what they do.  What really stood out, though, was the service. Our bartender took time to ask about our flavor preferences and then offered a few off-menu recommendations that were spot on. It felt personal and genuine, not rehearsed. Even when the bar got busy later in the evening, the team stayed attentive and upbeat — you could feel that they actually enjoy what they do.  The ambiance also deserves a mention: stylish decor, a bit of a speakeasy vibe, and a nice mix of people — perfect for date nights, small groups, or anyone who appreciates a good drink in a relaxed setting.  Prices are fair for the quality you get, and honestly, I’d come back just for the experience. If you’re into crafted cocktails, great energy, and a place that treats its guests like regulars from the first visit — Cabal is absolutely worth it. || Wow Dorian, you basically wrote a book here. Thank you so much for such level of detail, and for the amazing review. Come back soon! || We visited Cabal yesterday and really enjoyed this experience. The place has stylish vibe with great attention to detail in the interior and lighting. The cocktails were beautifully made and tasted amazing.  The Coffee Negroni was a real surprise for me – I had never tried anything like this before, and it quickly became my favorite of the night. You should try!! Service was friendly and professional, and the whole experience felt relaxed but special. It’s your sing to visit Cabal if you looking for unique cocktail spot🥰 || Thank you Diana for such an amazing review! Loved the pictures and yeah, the coffee Negroni is quite nice indeed || Excellent bar, well managed and sophisticated, yet casual and friendly. Professional, welcoming staff. Features a spacious elevated patio area to enjoy Lisbon evenings. While they provide nice bar snacks, it’s not a dedicated restaurant as such, but simply a great place to go for a drink or a few drinks. || Thank you for such review, David! Really. We hope to see you soon || This is definitely the best cocktail bar I’ve been to in Lisbon! The drinks were all so delicious, especially the Rooibos Spritz and OF Martini, and it’s super central with a lovely patio. Would recommend going a bit later for more vibes, but overall amazing service and such a fun night out! || Wow Cassidy thank you so much! We're glad you liked our cocktails. We 100% agree with your choice || Super cool vibes with a spacious terrace perfect for chilling! The DJ inside kept the energy just right with great music. Loved their creative cocktails—tried the Panther Martini with pickle (so intriguing 👀) and the Rooibos Spritz, which was my absolute favorite. Everything was delicious and very affordable. Definitely a spot worth visiting! || Such a great review Jade, thanks! We totally agree with you on the Rooibos Spritz! It's a must-have

Quaint little wine stop up the hill. Food was excellent. I had the Muxama, oysters (which were fresh), and the cured ham. Glass of white then glass of red wine. They helped me pair everything really well. || Thank you for your kind review Matt. See you next time! 🥂 … || Local wine shop that offers light bites like oysters, cheeses and meats. They offer local wines and have a rotating monthly wine special. It’s a small space but people but they make it work with tables both inside and outside. Friendly service and helpful with the wine selections. We had a glass with some cork in it and the server immediately replaced it with a fresh glass which was highly appreciated. || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time! || A very nice and eclectic place where patrons will be able to discover the best Portugal has to offer in wines. Very discrete wine tasting house in the street coming up to Miradouro de Graça , but a stop there (mind you, only when you go downhill ! ) is more than justified. Will definitely come back . || Thank you for your review. See you next time! 🥂 … || This place is awesome. I’ve come here two nights in a row. Their wine selection is fantastic. I asked for recommendations and got something better than I had hoped for. Service is super friendly and knowledgeable, the wine is fantastic and the cheese I had was perfect. I’d come here every night if I lived in Lisbon! || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time! || Located pretty uphill we walked 40min- Nice n cozy little wine bar. White sangria was refreshing and sweet Porto wine flight was sweet but stronger than we thought.. Oysters were good with my white wine. || Thank you for your thoughtful review. See you next time! || For wine lovers in Lisbon, this bar is a must-visit. The great wine choices are a real highlight, and the delicious food and snack options perfectly accompany them. The ambiance is lovely, especially with the addition of a small outdoor terrace. What truly sets this place apart is the owner and staff, who are exceptionally attentive, lovely, and pleasant. Highly recommended! || Thank you so much for your kind review, see you next time! || This is an amazing place, we ended each night of our stay here. The owner is wonderful and is happy to make recommendations on which wines we ordered. The food is very good and the atmosphere is cozy and relaxed. There a many wines to choose from and try and he is very knowledgeable about each one. We loved coming here and hope to go back! || Thank you for your thoughtful review. See you next time! || The definition of an amazing place: very good wine selection, delicious small plates to share, and great service. The interior styling is also amazing. It's an old drug and grocery store very well preserved. Definitely recommend it! It's the perfect place to enjoy a good wine with friends or lovers. || Such a lovely place to have a wine and some oysters in Lisboa. The guys were really nice and helpful! Totally recommend it! || Thank you for your kind review. See you next time! || Very cozy wine bar. Super kind owner who can recommend wines for your taste || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time! || Very friendly and knowledgeable people! We had few glasses of vinho verde, which was delicious! We didn't have anything to eat, but food that was going to other tables smelled and looked really nice. Definitely worth a visit if you're in the area! || Thank you for your kind review, see you next time! || Laura and Miguel and Francisco were awesome. Laura was especially knowledgeable and it turned an enjoyable drink into a real experience. I had orange wine and an organic Portuguese red. Just divine! || Cozy wine bar with a short food menu that’s hand prepared behind the bar. Great wine selection and good recommendations. The mocktails were also very good and not just sweet (as they often are unfortunately). || Thank you for your thoughtful review 🥂 see you next time! … || Great wine, great recommendations and great atmosphere. A true Portuguese spot to enjoy a night out || Where do I start? Maybe the incredible wine list or the knowledgeable staff here that explains every glass you buy? Maybe it’s the oysters that rival some of the best I’ve had in bar harbor Maine. This place should be on your short list of must tries. The area is also wonderful to walk around. || Absolutely LOVE this place! Excellent service, delicious vinhos and fresh food! The staff is stellar! Highly recommend! || Beautiful spot with outdoor seating. Delicious wine. Everything reasonably priced. Oysters were F R E S H. Spent about 17€ for two glasses of wine, bread and olives, and an oyster. Staff was very friendly and suggested great wines. Will be back! || Great place - really good recommendations and such nice guys 🫶🏻 best wine bar we habe visited in one week of culinary lissabon! || Best wine bar in Lisbon!!! Amazing and extensive selection of wines. They have delicious cheeses and meats charcuterie to pair. The staff is amazing and super helpful. I had the pleasure of getting served by Marco and Caetano and they were absolutely amazing and helpful. I had more questions than normal and they were so gracious answering and provided helpful insights which made me want to stay longer and try more things. Came back here a few times and can’t wait to go back again! 10/10 || Found this place, on the last few hours ov our last evening in Lisbon. Great find. Friendly and helpful staff. Wine and port were excellent. A definite highlight. We didn't eat, as we had eaten earlier, much to my regret.

Definitely my favorite place in Lisbon. Everything was so genuinely delicious. The homemade almond milk and peanut butter were so fantastic and all the other products we ordered were made with so much care and love. Needless to say that the staff was so welcoming and great. ❤️ || Great Food with top quality great food experience!! NEW MENU RELEASED-for summer 2022-CHECK MY PHOTOS :D. Portuguese food with a fusion touch. Also great place to mingle, group dining and stay for a cocktail ( which are very good ! Frozen Margarita is one font fav). All wines are from organic production with no sulfites ( No sulfites = No hang over) all alternative soda/ beers and ciders brands with great quality… not overpriced at all !! All is shareable ( I advise you to do so ;) ) Great place to eat and socialize. The Staff is really nice too ;) || So happy we have stumbled across this place. The food was a.m.a.z.i.n.g - healthy nutritious, full of flavour and so many different textures. Service was quick and very friendly. We loved this place! || Love this amazing café! For food and breakfast it’s amazing! Love the interior design, those tiles 💚 … || Yummy almond milk cappuccino and Coffee for €4. Nice place full of students working on university assignments. Quiet. Nice staff. Lots of room. || Great healthy food in a nice atmosphere. Both the soup and the dish of the day (chickpea and pumpkin curry) were delicious. The prices are very fair. || Very justified 4.8, food is creative, tasty & healthy. Fast, very kind & warm service. Cozy place, a bit expensive for Portugal. || High quality food and drinks. The homemade kombucha is my favourite. Also a nice place to meet, chill, read and work.  One of my favourite places in Lisbon! || Very nice coffee shop, the food and cakes are very good. Staff IS very nice too 😉 … || Came here a bit later in the night and the interior decor is really cool. Great concept, fun vibes and good drinks.

I recently visited Prado Wine Bar and had a wonderful experience from start to finish. The ambiance is truly stunning – a perfect blend of modern design and natural elements that makes the space feel both elegant and welcoming. The attention to detail in the interior is impressive and adds a special touch to the dining experience.  The dishes were beautifully presented and full of flavor. You can tell there’s a real focus on quality, seasonal ingredients. Each plate felt carefully crafted, and I especially appreciated the creativity in the menu. Whether you’re stopping in for a few small bites or a full meal, there’s something here to satisfy any palate.  Service was another highlight – warm, professional, and attentive without being intrusive. The staff made the whole experience feel relaxed and enjoyable.  Overall, Prado Wine Bar is a gem in Lisbon’s culinary scene. A perfect spot for a relaxed evening with friends, or anyone who appreciates good food, wine, and atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back! || I really enjoyed the atmosphere of this wine bar. The food was delicious and the service was excellent. While the selection of wines by the glass was a bit limited, overall it was a great experience. || Prado Wine Bar is a Lisbon gem that beautifully blends local, seasonal ingredients with an elegant yet relaxed vibe. Their farm-to-table concept shines through every plate, from the vibrant cured rainbow trout to the deeply flavorful Alentejano pork neck.  The wine selection is exceptional, with staff who truly know their stuff and offer spot-on recommendations. The space is stylish, warm, and always buzzing with good energy.  Whether you’re there for a casual glass or a full tasting experience, Prado delivers on flavor, quality, and charm. A must-visit for food and wine lovers alike. || Very good small dish!! Most of Portuguese restaurants or bar are too much portion so we really enjoyed food. We ordered 3 plates. Cod with chickpeas and mussels were amazing. Beer was also very good. Unfortunately there were large groups in the middle of restaurants when we were there, it was very noisy….i can imagine usually this place is not that noisy 😭 I hope my second visit will be enjoy a little more quiet time. || Took me a while to decide how to rate this restaurant/wine bar. The main issues were the price and the portions. Oh the food was delicious, well presented and tasty. But the portions were tiny for a high price. If compared to other places at the same level in Lisbon or Porto, this was the only place we didn’t feel full. Service was great with great wine and the waiters were very knowledgeable. Atmosphere was affected by the fact that we got the worst table, in the corner next to the kitchen where you don’t feel part of the wine bar and you are secluded away enjoying the walls or the bar counter. || We had a great experience at Prado.  Delicious food, a well procured Portuguese-based wine list and a very knowledgeable sommelier who helped us discover some great wines! || One of my favorite meals in Lisbon. The wine bar location of the restaurant Prado. Relaxed with lots of locals coming and going. The food was great and perfect if you’re not super hungry and just want some snack and some drinks.  You can definitely order more food, particularly if you’re hungry or are you going be there for your full meal. We really enjoyed the skin contact and orange wines.  Definitely on my list to go back to . || You have not been to Lisbon until you have been to Prado wine bar. From the minute arrived we were looked after so well, the staff so knowledgeable about the wine and food. Really relaxed atmosphere. THE FOOD!!! Is amazing… each dish was like a party in my mouth…..  the flavours…it was hands down the best food we’ve had in a long time. || Had only 2 glasses of wine because we had another reservation. Great atmosphere. Service was excellent. Reservation is recomended. || What a cozy, lovely place. Terrific selection of Portuguese wines and delicious, creative small plates that highlight local cuisine (especially seafood). The oyster mushrooms in mustard sauce and codfish with chickpeas were outstanding. Best of all was our server, Ines, who was warm and friendly, energetic, and very knowledgeable about both the wines and the food. She made our evening fun and special, and she made us feel welcome. The food and wine are worth coming here for, but the service makes it special.

the staff was very lovely, even asked us to put out favorite song on the speakers. The food was amazing and very generous. Thank you so much we had a really great time here ! see you next time || Really tasty food. You have to go there if visiting the flea market. The best chicken I have ever had!! || Good food, reasonable price; fast service, highly recommended || The chicken in beer back sauce is the most delicious and tender meal!! It’s a 10/10 dish. The food came out very quickly and the waiters were nice. The price was reasonable and great portion sizes too. It’s a must visit!! || Wow, what a find. Great food and service, decent prices. The place was incredibly busy on market days, often you'll need to queue to get a free table but it's really worth it. Our server was so personable and friendly despite the crowd. Highly recommended if you're in the neighbourhood during opening hours. || One of my favorite places in whole Lisboa. It so authentic and you can feel real taste of Lisbon there. Very nice people, whole staff and crew and food is literally delicious 😋 Prices are affordable and normal, I think that portions was slightly bigger before, but you won't stay hungry definitely. Highly Recommend || 5,000 STARS!!!!! We spent our first night in Portugal at Tabernita and we are so glad we did.  After communicating via Whatsapp, we had a special honeymoon table reserved for 2 outside. They offered suggestions on food, rose and even things to see and do throughout Portugal.  It was easy to see why this place had so many great reviews. The vibe was friendly, celebratory and just plain fun. When you can tell the staff is enjoying themselves, you somehow enjoy yourself even more. It's like they've invited you to their private party!  On top of all that, the food is outstanding.  We had the Duck Rice and Cod Fish. Both portions were generous and flavor-filled.  A special thank you to Andre for his stellar service. He really knows how to go above and beyond! || Very friendly stuff, espacially the lovely waitress Nadia. It was a superb first night in Lisbon for us. || If you are person saw so much in whole world, you will be very happy in Tabernita. Staff is wonderfull! Atmosphere, too. You will eat fresh food, prepared today, so tasty. You feel yourself as part of this magic atmosphere, as member of that soul family. Music in Tabernita will make you feel as you retourn to your family and home. Everybody are welcome. I am sending warm greetings, best wishes and part of my hart wich I left there, to every member of staff Tabernita, especially for those who are playing capuera in my dreams even now, for great artist women singer, she sing from deep her hart, and too especially, for young girl, singer too, from, I think from Angola. She and I shared one unforgetable hug. I am huging her again and wish everything the best. Lilly || Absolutely worth the detour ! Gorgeous food and very lively atmosphere for a super reasonable price. Highly highly recommend the garlic prawns…I’ll be dreaming about those for years to come 😂

place_name: Portologia Lisboa, La Maison des Porto
reviews_content: A really nice spot. We had a great tasting and really enjoyed the visit. A friendly place with good amounts of different tasting sets.  What really stood out to me was how professional the owner was. We took the premium tasting and were considering to get another tasting as well, a vertical. But he told us it would not be fair to do it today since we already tried his best and the other would compare unfavourably. Instead we should comeback another day with a clean palate. He clearly respected both us and his bottles. || Update: We returned for another tasting. This time a vertical Tawny tasting: 10, 20, 30 and 40 year old. Really delicious. And very nice that cleaned water is served along the tasting.  We noticed this time that the restrooms could need a cleaning and repair - for instance mold is to be found several places in the restroom.  Old review: This is a great place for a taste of port wine. You can also buy port wine here - and have them shipped home. My wife and I dropped by for a taste of port wine. They have many choices: 3-8 glasses, same style, different styles, vertical and horizontal. We chose to share a tasting of 6 port wines of which 2 were white, 2 were Tawny and 2 were Ruby. Four of them were 40+ years old, the LBV from 2016 and the Vintage from 2018. It cost 66 EURO for these very fine samples.  Definitely a place to visit and revisit! || Came here to buy me some port wine. I had no knowledge of this type of wine, so I really appreciated the fact that I was able to taste different ones, understand some fundamentals and make an informed choice. Enjoyed the talk and help from the manager. 100% recommended. || I and my wife visted here 3 years ago, and i just tasted the wine that the owner recommeded. You should have been reccomeded more than 3 bottles more. The wine you sold me is one of.the best wine that i have drank. Thank you for giving me good memory and wider speculation || I went here for a tasting. It wasn’t until after he started pouring the wine that the server casually informed me that i’d have to pay in cash because their credit card machine was broken. But no problem, he said, there’s a cash machine next door, which i used. I then returned for the tasting and wound up buying an expensive bottle of port. It wasn’t until i returned to my hotel that night that i realized that this “bank” took a THIRTY PERCENT MARKUP on my money, charging me $60 to withdraw $200! If they gave any warning of this i certainly didn’t see it. Moral of the story: make sure you have plenty of cash if you visit this place, or better yet go somewhere where the credit card machine is working. || Really great port wines here. Incredible flavours from both the white and tawny that we tried.  Somewhat expensive but more than worth it for the excellent service. The man behind the bar was very friendly and clearly enthusiastic about port wines. || I stumbled upon this gem by accident, was actually just going to get some cash out from the atm machine across the street.  So glad I walked into the shop. I was greeted by the very friendly and competent Diogo. We chatted for a few minutes and then I called over my relatives and insisted they meet me. We spent the next hour learning about the different wines, estates and had the pleasure of tasting some incredible Ports, which of course led to bringing some back home.  Definitely recommend this place. It’s quaint and intimate, you learn, you drink, you nibble , what else could one want. || Great experience, staff sociable and happy to share their knowledge and personal opinions on port. Great that you can both taste and buy port here from producers not usually seen outside of Portugal. Tastings are designed so that any port lovers taste can find something to appreciate and explore.  You can find white, tawny, ruby, and various vintages available including late bottled from 5 producers with select bottles from a couple of others. || We had a port tasting, and the staff was very friendly, explaining everything in detail. It was a great experience to try different kinds of port. Definitely a must-try if you have the time! || Really enjoyed the atmosphere here for our Port tasting. The host was amiable to us having different tasting menus, you could pick from 3 to 8 ports including menus of only one type. No rush to leave and was very attentive. Helpful via text to arrange!

I am giving this place a 4 star rating because of Regina the server!  She's worth 10 stars to be clear.  The missing star is because we came here for Fado but apparently they do not do Fado??? Thank you to the service staff they were very kind and we did enjoy some wine here! Nice place to watch the old trams roll by as well.  Thanks again Regina. || Thank you very much for your visit. || Super cool wine bar with a fantastic bottle selection!  You'll find great wines with older vintages here for a very reasonable price.  Worth a visit for the oenophiles. || Thank you very much for your visit. || I'm a must try place.. port wine tasting.Good food ..off the beaten path || Thank you very much for your visit. || I had such a wonderful experience at this wine bar in Lisbon! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed—the staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about wine. They guided me through the menu with great recommendations, offering pairings that matched perfectly with the cheeses and charcuterie. The selection of wines is outstanding, with a great balance of Portuguese classics and hidden gems you don’t often find elsewhere. I loved how they took the time to explain each wine’s origin, flavor profile, and even little stories behind the vineyards—it made the tasting feel special and personal. The atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant, making it perfect for both a casual night out and a more intimate evening. I especially enjoyed the relaxed pace—you can truly savor each glass without ever feeling rushed. If you’re in Lisbon and want to explore Portuguese wines in the best way possible, this place is an absolute must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back! || Thank you very much for your visit. || Amazing! The owner was very welcoming and helpful, let us taste different wines before ordering. The food was incredible.  Big portions. Just in general great atmosphere! 11/10 would recommend ✨ || Been here a couple of times with friends. The food is very good, and the service is fast and well done (shout out to the blonde waitress who’s been very nice and professional). The polvo salad and the bacalhau were fantastic, so did the vinho verde. I can only recommend this place (plus if you book via the fork you get a 30% discount) || Thank you very much for your visit. || Fantastic place! We stumbled in during a big rainstorm and were greeted by some great hospitality and pleasant Fado music. The server had great advice on port selection, and we had that and a big board of cheese and ham. The olives were delicious, too. It’s probably no coincidence the place was full of French tourists. Worth a visit! || Ordered a glass of Douro red wine 👍🏻  Piglet and Cod mains were excellent too. Of course dining with Fado music can’t be better 😍 || The ambiance is wonderfully and quiet, boasting a splendid wine collection and a warm, hospitable staff. The cuisine is delicious, but the only improvement needed is in the comfort of the chairs. This minor discomfort is the sole reason we're rating it four stars instead of five. || Thank you very much for your visit. || We went for an aperitivo. The wines were good and the mixed plate was also tasty. Service was super friendly and fast. The only downside is that I found it quite overpriced, e.g. the mixed plate was 19.90€, which is rather pricey for Lisbon.

Amazing food, very good prices, good services. I had a Francisinha, a traditional Portuguese dish that I had been looking in Lisbon for a while, since it's originally from Porto, so I found this amazing location where I ate the perfect one. The place is quiet, it has an amazing view and fair prices. || In terms of food - the worst restaurant I’ve been in Portugal. 1. First of all, they had only one red wine by glass and it was extremely low quality. They know it themselves, so they poor it in a bowl instead of glass and also very cooled like white wine, so that you have no chance to feel repugnant aromas and tannins. And they call themselves a wine bar! 2. The lamb was really bad. Super salty, bitter and dry. They obviously put too much vinegar and salt. And this is despite Portuguese usually put less salt in their dishes. 3. They ran out of octopus so they replaced it with cod fish, which was just average. But the garnish was same potatoes as in the previous dish. 4. Their cheese selection was very poor, like from a supermarket. 5. Desert was presented as a traditional Christmas pumpkin pastry. I didn’t feel any pumpkin in it, and I googled - Portuguese don’t put pumpkin in Christmas deserts.  I should admit, service was good. 3 people were asking me regularly if I’m doing ok. || I had a burger and fries which were really good. Nice Sangria. However, the restaurant area to the rear was quiet. A few of the waiters were wearing gilets which was weird. An okay view of the city but not the best. || I honestly don’t get how other people can rate this place badly. It was the best restaurant I’ve been to in Portugal. Truly golden. The clams are an absolute gem. || I went there with a TheFork discount, that made the dinner to be very cheap. Nonetheless, the prices are fair also without. We took a mixed board entry and 3 main meat-based main dishes. They were good but not super flavourful. I loved the atmosphere. || Very good food and cute place. Our waiter Sunny was very nice and helpful in helping us decide what to eat. The owner was also very kind and welcoming too and we felt very comfortable here. Our first taste of Green Wine and it we all liked it very much. The whole experience was one of the best here. || What an amazing culinary experience! The chef is brilliant. The staff is so helpful in making sure your dining experience is outstanding! This is a hidden gem! Make the time and effort to have a wonderful dining experience! Climb the hill below the Castle in Alfama and enjoy the view, the food and the wine - Seis is inside the Solar do Mouros Hotel. || The food was gorgeous and the prices were reasonable. The restaurant is quiet small but has a nice atmosphere, and all staff were friendly and welcoming. Great experience overall. || On our way to visit the Castle of São Jorge, we were lucky to find one of the best places to eat in the area. We had a great experience discovering Seis. The staff was very friendly and helpful. If you don't know what to choose, you can select one of the predefined menus for 2 persons. || Very nice restaurant with great wine and food selection. Everything we ordered was so nice, the tapas were so tasty. Vast wine selection both local and foreign. Very professional staff. Unfortunately we came after sunset, because the view during the day should be amazing.

I went there for Brunch while visiting National Panteao. I feel like I made a really good decision. Food was amazing so as the owner of the cafe. I will definitely be visiting again. || Thank you so much for stopping by and for your lovely review! We’re so glad you enjoyed your brunch and had a great experience with us. It means a lot to hear you’ll be visiting again — we look forward to welcoming you back soon! 🥞☕😊 … || Very friendly couple running the place, happy to chat and suggest traditional Nepalese food for us, noodles and dumplings were great. Place felt really cosy and the walls were covered in one of the couple's artwork as well. A great mix of Nepal and Portugal. || We’d not heard about this place before but found it after walking around the Saturday market. Great friendly service & great quality food! We really enjoyed our meal, special mention for the tea which was really good!!! Would highly recommend :) || Hi, Thanking you from the corner our heart for your lovely review and enjoying our food. Would love to see you all again someday. 🙏 … || Absolutely amazing and cute cafe! Was searching for drinks around Feira Da Ladra, and found this place that serves white sangria! The cafe is owned by a cute couple who did all the artworks inside the cafe. We had a small chat and they are super friendly! Will definitely come by again in my next visit 💗🍀 || Thank you so much for your sweet review! 💗 We’re thrilled you enjoyed the white sangria, the cafe’s atmosphere, and the little artworks we love creating. It was such a pleasure chatting with you, and we can’t wait to welcome you back on your next visit! 🍀 … || Simple place with very good brunch, specially the toast with tomato, cheese, arugula and mayo! Fair price and very quiet surroundings. Very nice staff 😊 || Thank you so much for your kind words! 😊 We’re glad you enjoyed the brunch and especially the toast—it’s one of our favorites too. Happy to hear you felt at home with our staff and the peaceful surroundings. Hope to see you again soon! 🙏🙏 … || A cool little place right by the Pantheon and the Feira de Padre (theif's market) MoMo dumplings, strawberry smoothie and mojito were amazing. So fresh and tasty.😻  And you can buy beautiful watercolors painted by the very talented owner. || "Thanks a ton for the love and support! We’ll keep striving to serve the best." || Went there with 4 friends and I the day before new years and we found this Very cozy little place, the owners are very friendly and accommodating, food and drinks were fantastic. Would highly recommend this place if you are in the area, 5 stars all around. If I ever return to Lisbon i will visit again! || Wonderful place for breakfast/brunch/lunch. I absolutely enjoyed the breakfast set with toasts, espresso, juice, yoghurt! Yummy! Beautiful view on the Panteon! During the warmest hours you have enjoy the food in the shadow of the building ☀️ highly recommend! || Dear Jakub,  A very good morning from all of us at Olá Panteão!  We are truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed our cuisine. It was an honor to have you with us, and your kind words mean a great deal to our entire team.  Thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a lovely review—it is greatly appreciated. We sincerely hope to welcome you back again soon!  Warm regards, The Olá Panteão Team || Great customer service, very kind and welcoming. Food is made with love as well as peaceful ambience. Easy recommendation || Passing through Panteão Nacional, Right behind it there is a new wonderful nice little cafe/bar pizzeria OLÁ PANTEÃO,that just opened few weeks back it seems and already making buzz around. Tried their house pizza, It was super tasty and different than other pizzeria, Top notch quality, affordable price, great staff and service,cozy environment. Must go place and try out there cusine, very artistic. You can even enjoy the great paintings and art while enjoying your food and drink.pizza is super good with Sagres beer from Portugal 🇵🇹 || Thank you very much for the 5 star review very grateful 🙏 … || Excellent service, good drink, great music. All this in a quiet location. Highly recommended! || Went here spontaneously and it was such a pleasant surprise! The lady was so lovely and all of this food was 10€ per person! Great Value and tasty. Thank you for the pleasant experience. || It was a wonderful pleasure to have you here, See you again 🙏 … || Really nice people and good food for a really good price just next to the Pantheon. The brunch menu is top notch. || Thank you for your kind feedback! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed the brunch menu, our food, and the value we offer. It was a pleasure having you, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon. 🙏🙏 … || Amazing table service, the guy who served us was extremely nice, we ordered the 10€ brunch menu and it was great, especially the toast and the yogurt+honey. We stumbled upon this place my accident, but now I'm very glad we did. Great music too. Best brunch place in Lisbon || Thank you so much for your amazing review! We’re so glad you enjoyed the brunch (and the music 🎶) and that our team made you feel welcome. Sometimes the best places are found by accident—we’re so happy you stumbled upon us and we can’t wait to see you again!” 🙏 … || I had to leave a review because one, the food was excellent, great pizza all had made and tasted incredible. Two the people who own this little spot were so so nice and accommodating. The food took some time to come out because I think they are making everything by hand and one by one since it’s a small place, but if you have time to chill it’s a great little spot. Had to leave a review because of the service and food was equally as good. || Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a thoughtful review! We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed our handmade pizza and appreciated the care we put into each dish. Our team truly values every guest, and it means a lot that you noticed the effort and hospitality. We hope to welcome you back soon for another relaxing and delicious visit! 🍕😊 || Found this randomly. Wonderful food and service. Staff is amazing. Sitting outside is perfect. || Thank you from the core of our heart for amazing feedback 🙏 … || everything is just perfect, the food, service, music, atmosphere. And also good price, A touch of honey mellows out the tang of the yogurt just right — definitely a combination worth trying. good location, near to Feira da Ladra || Thank you na na for the appreciation, hopefully see you again soon. || My favourite place to eat in Lisbon. The owners are a lovely couple, very welcoming, very friendly. The sangria was great and the Nepalese food was even better. Wonderful smoothies also. Highly recommend ! || Thank you so much for your lovely review! We’re truly grateful to hear we’re your favorite place to eat in Lisbon. It means a lot to us that you enjoyed the sangria, Nepalese food, and smoothies — and we’re so glad you felt welcome. We look forward to seeing you again soon! 🇳🇵❤️🍹 … || A truly heartwarming little restaurant run by the sweetest couple, where every dish feels like it’s made with love. Their momos are absolutely delightful, and the pizza is just as amazing fresh, flavorful, and comforting. Highly recommended if you’re looking for food that warms both the stomach and the heart. || Your thoughtful words mean so much to us. We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed both the momos and the pizza, and that our food brought you comfort. Thank you for recommending us—we look forward to seeing you again! 🙏🙏🙏 … || I loved it!! Brunch with Pantheon as the view!! The staff was so sweet and welcoming !! I had the cheese toast brunch and it was really really good! Definitely the second best coffee i had in lisbon ! Id love to see this place expand! Totally recommend :) || “Thank you so much for your lovely words! 🌸 We’re so happy you enjoyed the brunch, the view, and our coffee—it means a lot. Our team loved having you here, and we hope to welcome you back soon for more!” 🙏 …

Cool restaurant on a super cute side street packed with outdoor seating, an awesome wine bar, other restaurant options, and amazing vibes. This place was so busy the first time we went that by the time we got a seat they were sold out of pizza! We ended up getting some pasta dishes which were great but super happy we got to make it back because the pizza was awesome! || Really enjoyable quality place where to sip a good wine while tasting it. Very close to Largo da Graça and 2 remarkable miradouros where to enjoy the sunset view 🪟 from (you will though have to choose what you do ... The sunset watching or the wine sipping !). All kinds of local and international wines available there, in a very popular street where you will be able to eat good pizzas or other food. Recommended (we also visited their other venue in Venice Italy). || I had the dish of the day (briosh with shrimp and maracuja dip) and the white wine from portugal - both was delicious! I had to sit inside at the bar as it was very crowded but it was still a very nice atmosphere. The service was a bit slow but friendly. Would come back! || Lovely wine bar on a super cute bustling alleyway of Graca. Hard to find Sunday night hangouts sometimes and this spot was bustling! Loved it here and will Come back.  Only gripe is pours of wine are small and on the more expensive side. || Perfect small plates and natural wines tucked away in Graca. We ate outdoors and the street was full but not crowded around 7:30pm. Friendly staff that recommended and provided tasting of wine before the glass was poured. French and Italian natural wines with some from Portugal as well. The food was delicious and very reasonably priced. The foccacia with mortadella, pork belly entree, and swirdfish carpaccio was delicious. Must try! || Hands down the best wine bar in town!  Not only do they have the most extensive domestic as well as import wines, the space is very well suited to enjoy a bottle with your friends, in the most picturesque alley way of Graça neighborhood.  And the cherry on top of the cake: the owners are outspoken in their belief in humanity! || To be honest this review is a little bit difficult to write because I like this place but there are just to many things here that simply ruin the experience.  Let’s start with the good. There is a large wine selection with interesting labels from all over Europe. The staff is helpful and nice. Shout out to Chicha who made our experience. We had a really nice lentils dish that I recommended to anyone visiting.  The main problem here is that there are so many tables and so little staff that it took us 45 minutes to get a beer from the tap and another 30 minutes to get our wine. And trying to get a servers attention to order anything else is seemingly impossible if you want to be polite. When we arrived (with reservation)we still had to wait 25 minutes to be seated.  4 out of 5 of the dishes we ordered were poor for many reasons that are unnecessary to detail here.  The bottom line is that yes this place is a great vibe and has so many things going for it but it still lacks basic service to make the experience a good one.  If you find yourself here enjoy and find an extra measure of patience. || Loved this wine bar! It was just the vibe we were looking for - perfect for sipping wine outside with some food.  The wines we had and food were all amazing, highly recommend if you’re after a cute little wine bar! || Found this in passing. Amazing services and truly wonderful wines. I am 100% going to be going back, if you like French wine and champagne then this is the place for you. I enjoyed Portuguese wines all holiday but it was nice to find some beautiful French wines served here. The staff were super brilliant also. I’d love to try some food here next time. || The only Pizza places we recommend to our guests who want takeaway. They are by far Lisbon's best. Their pizzas are made from the best flour you can get in around Lisbon (we know because they buy from the mill we get our bread flour from) - and the various toppings are all made from the best ingredients. Get the Classics or try Antoinne & Mateo's take on this Italian classic 👌 😋 ✨️ - executed by Mario in the kitchen.  Highly recommended! || The atmosphere is really nice, with some tables outside, perfect for summer nights. Very friendly and helpful staff. In my opinion, they should have a bigger offer of Portuguese wines by the glass. Most of the people visiting this bar are tourists and they would prefer to try portuguese wines. || Probably the most visited natural wine bar in Lisbon! Open all week round it offers a mesmerising selection of natural wine gems. Natty universe!  A diverse audience combines both locals and expats, young and elderly. Cozy simple interior or even better sit outside in the street if the weather allows.  Friendly barmen will guide you to the world of natural wines, so don't worry at all when you see hundreds of playful labels.  Food is good and moderately priced. The menu is short and goes well with wines, so can't miss with it.  Expect a 10 percent discount on wines you want to take away.  Gets packed after 8pm.  Ciao and see you soon!  P.S. also check out their sister bar in Venice and soon to be opened another one in Lisbon! || We sat at the bar which ended up being a great spot. Note that we came without reservation. There is an insane selection of wine. The staff is very friendly and helps with the choice of wine. Food is also great. Mostly small plates and some boards to share. I would definitely come back. || Very nice, hip and chill place to go for propper wine and a bite. They have a wide range of wines and taste delicious. Furthermore, they offer small complimentary snack that go really well with the wine. The food is absolutely amazing and perfect to share for 2 people. As stated before a lot of young, hip people come here and drink wine together. There is not much of a view and compared to other places in Lisbon it is a bit expensive, but definitely worth it for a nice wine experience. || Nice place, but there are better ones like this. Above all, it caught my attention that they do not have wines from Argentina or Chile, which are in the top 5 of countries producing the best wines in the world. Furthermore, if you order a glass of wine they serve you very little, less than 8cm, and they charge you a high price. A lot of things to improve, no doubt. || looooooved it. devine wine and good charcuterie board next to it, what else you can ask || Pretty cool bar in Graça, where you can find some great wine and appetisers. Price is fair as well so you won't spend a lot to get satisfied, although it's not cheap either. I had two glasses of wine plus two appetisers and paid around 25-30 euros. If you're looking for a place to have a few drinks and have fun with friends it's worth the time. || Thank you very much for the lovely words !    Come back !  ♥️ || My favorite wine bar in Lisbon. Besides the great selection of wines also a small very good menu of dishes (also vegan options). Great selection of wines, always tasting. Great atmosphere. It is always worth the trip there. || Really cool wine bar with great vibes and nice staff. We also had the ‘vegan dish’ which is whatever delicious stuff they have that day and it was super good. I always take my friends here! Get down early or reserve if you want a seat || Amazing spot. Found us a table even though they were pretty full. Everything we ate was great but it’s the natural wine selection which is the stand out. That and the super helpful and friendly staff.

We love trying cocktail rooms wherever we go, tried this one and it REALLY hit the spot. Best owners, very kind, great vibes - extremely relaxed. The drinks were solid - will hold their own against any cocktail room anywhere. We had the smoky margarita, negroni, a Caribbean inspired drink (forgot the name) and the Black Forest.  Shout out to the Black Forest, that was one VERY well made drink! Completely recommend. Host made us taste her favorite drink - I think it was called the Nikkei Milk Punch and I must say that one was extremely well balanced and beautiful as well.  Best part of the space for us were all the 🐶s visiting, completely made our evening! || Atmosphere: 8/10 Located in Lisbon’s Graça district. Very chill, home-style vibe—cozy, comfortable, music at a good level. Backbar is okay. Seating is limited: no bar counter, a few indoor tables, plus some patio seats.  Drinks: 8.5/10 Recommendation: Black Forrest, Pineapple Express Menu is simple. Selection is decent. Flavors are good. Coasters are nice; glassware is average; garnish is nice. Presentation is okay overall, with unique ice on select serves.  Service: 8.5/10 Water on arrival. Team is friendly, professional, and attentive. Prices are average for Lisbon. Reservations not needed. || Proper crafted cocktails in a small, cozy and we'll appointed space. Joanna and Peter create lovely drinks and provide personal service. I had a lovely milk punch which was perfectly balanced.  Its a good idea to make reservations. We will definitely go again. || Booked Onda to grab a quick pre-dinner drink and we ended up going a bit early and I’m so happy we did!  We got to try four different cocktails and they were so good and so creative! The space was also really cool - loved the decor and the owners were really sweet. || Had an amazing time here and really enjoyed getting to know the owners and hearing their stories and recommendations.  We loved it so much we closed out both of our nights in Lisbon here.  If you are looking for a great cocktail and a relaxing chill atmosphere this is the place to go! || This was hands-down our favorite cocktail bar in the city. It’s a laid back atmosphere where the husband/wife owners attend to the customers with passion and dedication. It’s clear that they love what they do. In my opinion, this establishment is better than Red Frog. The Nikkei Milk Punch was my favorite. You won’t find anything like it elsewhere; it’s one-of-a-kind. Don’t pass up the opportunity to visit, but do make a reservation. || What do you know about cocktails? 🍸✨ Forget everything you think you know! 😎 Because here, a whole new world will open up to you — a world of amazing flavors, aromas, adventures, and people who are truly in love with what they do! 💫🌍💃  Every sip is a little journey 🌴🍹 — through taste, through passion, through creativity! 💥 Whether you’re into something classic, bold, or totally unexpected, they’ll create the perfect cocktail just for you! 🍒🍍🍋  This place isn’t just about drinks — it’s about emotions, art, and pure joy! 💖✨ So dive in, explore, and let yourself be amazed by this ocean of cocktails! 🌊🍸🔥  Cheers to unforgettable moments! 🥂😄🍹 || Thank you so much for your visit and review. We hope you can come by this week for the tasting experience before you go home. 🍸🍸🍸 … || I’ve gone to Onda multiple times, and have always had a nice time.  I lived here as a student (American so do take that into account with my opinions on prices) for about a year and visited multiple times throughout my stay. A few times I went for drinks (sometimes alcoholic and sometimes not, they have amazing options for both) and once for a cocktail making class which was a super fun experience!  It’s a place to go if you want nice cocktails. They’re well made and super unique, so though they aren’t the cheapest, the prices  are by no means unreasonable and are on par with a lot of other places I’ve been to. I loved the smoky margarita, as well as the Thai infused alcohol (I don’t remember the name) which was one of the best cocktails I’ve had.  Would recommend and planning on going again soon as I’m visiting for the holidays! || I can't speak too much to the food but I can speak to the lovely couple who own the place and took us on a journey of many cocktails. Easily a true highlight of Lisbon and something I would recommend anyone who enjoys the finer spirits and what magic they might contain. Do yourself a favor take a friend or six to the cocktail flight, and if you enjoy whiskey talk to Peter the owner into giving you a master class in Whiskeys around the world. || Drinks are crafted with perfection. Flavor explosion balanced with eased shoulders. Cheers for the memorable experience. || We were super pleasantly surprised, they had a mini cocktail tasting flight! All five cocktails were unique and delicious. We’ll be back! Only suggestion would be to maybe serve some nuts or pretzels 🥨 || Not a 1st time but once again it was phenomenal! Joana and Peter took great care of us! We will definitely be back again when we come to Portugal! || What an amazing cocktail place!! The service is incredible, we didn't like one of the drinks and even before we finished the sentence it was taken from us and straight away offered a different (unlike other places in Portugal). The cocktails we had were unique, tasty and one of a kind. I definitely recommend this place for cocktails lovers! || Had the best experience. Went for an amazing cocktail flight, but then did a whiskey tasting and couldn't be happier. Come thirsty, leave happy! || We trekked here uphill in the pouring rain, and the experience was more than worth it! These were hands down some of the most creative and delicious cocktails I’ve ever had. The music and atmosphere were excellent as well, and it was a joy chatting with the owners. I would highly recommend anyone in Portugal take the time to check this spot out! || I’ve been to several cocktail bars in Lisbon, but my experience at Onda was truly on another level. Every cocktail we tried was exceptional — each one had such a unique and distinct personality that I honestly couldn’t pick a favorite. The service was also fantastic; everyone was super friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere was incredible too — perfect for a date, relaxed yet with a great vibe. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to everyone! || Despite celebrating its sixth anniversary in December, Onda Cocktail Room has been a bar that has somewhat flown under the radar of Lisbon’s bar scene, which is a shame because its quality is undeniable. . Led by Peter, owner and bartender. A former trainer and master of whisky at Diageo, he is assisted by his wife and fabulous host Joana, who takes care of the entire room. . A small space with an open door to the street, it is open every day from 5 pm to midnight except on Wednesdays, which is its day off.
