I was reminded recently of how terrible the experience was and realized I never left a review. Just avoid this place, please. It's a dump and the bartender, whom other people have described in reviews here, is legitimately unsettling. My wife and I were there on a Sunday night and there was not a single other customer in the hour we were there. The place is very dark, grimy, dusty, filthy and drinks are way too expensive. My tiki glass was very obviously broken and glued back together at some point. If we're the only people there, they can't give us the unbroken tiki glasses?  We ordered something from the drinks menu and they were prepared in a matter of seconds, pre-prepared, totally generic drinks and weren't even what we ordered. Terrible. Also, there was seemingly no alcohol in them. Complimentary snacks were stale. I felt like we were being watched the whole time. Just an unsettling vibe to the place. Hard to explain the feeling in there (dumpster demon at back of the diner in Mulholland Dr. might be accurate.) Bora-Bora was our only bad experience in a 10 day trip around Portugal. || My mom used to come here as a young adult, and last Sunday she brought me so we could share a drink together for Mother’s Day. This place truly deserves all the praise and more. The staff is incredible—so warm and welcoming—and I couldn’t stop laughing at the fun surprises they kept bringing out. It was such a special experience. Will come back :) || Very beautiful place inside. That's all. The place is very aged. Menues seem to turn into a dust directly in your hands. The waiter behaved so strange, as if we were obliged to him. But all these are nothing. The main thing is that their "cocktails" contained NO ALCOHOL. They must have contained, but they haven't. We were trying to feel even a drop of rum (or something) in our glasses. But all in vain. It was just juice from tetrapack with ice. Not recommended. || It was weird. The server was playing into the "mysterious guide" character.. you can only pay cash.. It was a funny experience but not my kind of place. || After spending almost my all life hearing how cool bar was 40 years ago, I had a try today and I must it was so very disappointing… the cocktails have no alcohol, from the snacks you get the only thing that you manage to eat are the peanuts as everything else was stale!!! The smell of mold is unbelievable, and staff not friendly! Such a pitty to see has it as sooo much potential!! We left without finishing our drinks! || If you want retro, if you want quirky, if you want cocktails then this is the place to visit if in the area! Reading the reviews below, we were excited and hesitant but were not disappointed at all, what a delight! || Amazing staff, service and drinks || We were a group of 8, and two of us didn’t want to order alcoholic drink. The waiter rudely said we couldn’t stay unless everyone ordered and basically forced us to get something. Each cocktail was €8.50 — pricey for a non-alcoholic drink — and I had no other option. His aggressive attitude made the whole experience really uncomfortable. Definitely won’t be coming back. || Cool and unique place for drinks. I got to taste four different drinks and those that we ordered tasted juicy and sweet. They gave salty snacks at the table: chips, peanuts and crackers. || honestly one of the most interesting bar experiences I’ve had. They have all these drinks and you don’t really know what will be in them because it doesn’t say so on the menu there is just like a mystic description and they are all served in these funny trinkets also the whole place just seems like it’s been frozen in the 80s but it was really funny trying to figure out what you got || Service not optimal, cocktail without alcool. Nice environment and experience || amazing, great vice, great price, great drinks should visit while in lisbon

We had lunch at a restaurant with a beautiful view and a great location. The food was really delicious, and the dessert was just amazing. BUT!!! The white wine was awful — it was literally the cheapest supermarket wine, yet they charged €10 per glass.  Overall though, it’s a great spot for tourists. The staff were courteous, polite, and very pleasant. All in all, I’d recommend it — a great and tasty experience! ❤️ || Fancy place, high level of service. .Good athmosphere Not a big choice of food, but sushi the i take was amazing. The prices are more then average at Lisbon. || Only came for drinks but had food as well, glad we did. Amazing view with good food and drinks, can’t beat it. Highlight of my holiday. || The views here are stunning! Great drinks and food, the staff is wonderful. Highly recommend if you want a great rooftop bar experience in Lisbon. || Francisco made my stay very special with his attentiveness and kindness. I’m grateful he went out of his way to take care of me. He also gave me a wonderful recommendations for my solo trip, which I’m so grateful for. I cannot rave enough about this beautiful human being. 🥹 Amy was also great with her check-ins as my server. Service here is top notch…  …give my man a raise, please…!  View here is beautiful and memorable, music and vibes are very relaxed, and food is sure to be a hit given the way people are ordering and how things look. Happy I stopped by here per the recommendation of a local. || Seen - A Beautiful Rooftop Bar & Restaurant  Discover Seen, a stunning rooftop destination offering breathtaking views and a relaxed yet sophisticated ambiance. Whether you choose to dine indoors or outside under the stars, you'll enjoy an unforgettable experience. Savor delicious, expertly crafted dishes paired with refreshing drinks while taking in the scenic vistas. Perfect for a casual evening, special occasions, or simply unwinding in style.  Highlights: Spectacular rooftop views Stylish indoor and outdoor seating Cozy, inviting ambiance Delicious food and signature cocktails  Come and see why Seen is the perfect spot to elevate your dining experience! || Seen Sky Bar offers stunning views from its rooftop restaurant and bar. If you don’t have a reservation, you won’t be able to sit outside, but we were seated indoors and could still step outside to snap a few photos. I had the beef carpaccio, which was excellent, and my drink—a vodka-based cocktail called Suka—was very good. My girlfriend had the do-it-yourself ice cream sundae, which she just thought was the best thing in the world. From the rooftop, you can see the castle and even a glimpse of the river. It is on the pricier side, and the service was a little slow, but overall it was a very nice experience. || A luxury experience done right — warm, welcoming, and unforgettable  As tourists, we sometimes look for the best spots around town and, admittedly, might overlook certain dress protocols—not out of disrespect, but simply in the spirit of exploring and enjoying our time. That’s what happened when we were turned away at Praia no Parque due to my partner’s dress shorts, despite them being clean and tailored. The interaction there was cold and dismissive.  We then went to Seen by Olivier, which also has a dress code—but what a difference. The staff welcomed us gracefully and with genuine hospitality, making us feel respected rather than judged.  We had four exquisite cocktails, fresh oysters, ceviche tacos, and a beautifully plated dessert. Everything was exceptional—flavorful, refined, and worth every cent. The service was attentive without being overbearing, and the scenic rooftop view over Lisbon made the experience even more memorable.  In total, we spent around €150 and left feeling truly satisfied—not just by the food, but by the atmosphere and the way we were treated.  Seen by Olivier is the standard of elegance and warmth that every upscale restaurant should strive for. || Upscale bar but a great view and atmosphere. Even in the cold weather the heater were actually warm! Drinks were a bit pricey but from the moment you walk in you can tell this place requires a bigger budget. Overall a great experience. || Lovely evening drinking wine and watching the sun go.down. well it went down behind one of the many hills but the light over the city was spectacular. We also had two lunches in the restaurant and the food was delicious.

place_name: Retro Wine Lounge - Wine Bar & Tasting Room
reviews_content: This is the best bar you could ever find in Portugal. What makes it truly special is that it offers the most unique Portuguese wines you won’t find in stores and would probably never even hear about otherwise. Daniel explained each wine to us: how it was made, its techniques, and what makes it unique. He was always warm, friendly, and welcoming, doing so much to create an incredible atmosphere. I have never left a place with such warm feelings as I did there || Such an offbeat bar you won’t find anywhere else in Lisbon. Today, it stands as one of the most authentic spots for Portuguese wine. At the heart of it is Daniel, a man with deep knowledge of Portugal’s wine culture. If you’re looking for more than just a glass of wine, come by and experience his expertise in the craft. And no matter what, after the first bottle the setting itself won’t surprise you anymore — the place has kept its 1974s look, which only adds to its charm and character. || A hidden gem in the city! Daniel, the owner, is one of the most welcoming and knowledgeable hosts I’ve ever met.  The atmosphere in the bar feels cozy, making it the perfect place for an evening with friends or even a solo glass of wine.  If you’re in town, this is not just a bar , it’s an experience. Everyone should visit at least once and meet Daniel. Highly recommended! || I found Retro Wine Lounge on a whim as I was seeking local wine bars to spend an hour or two in while visiting Lisboa. I am SO happy that Retro Wine Lounge is the one I discovered on Google Maps and ventured to. This neighborhood gem is incredibly authentic and has a warm, inviting atmosphere and a tremendously hospitable and knowledgeable host in Daniel. Daniel went out of his way to tell me more about the origins of the green wine I enjoyed, as well as the premium cheeses! Everything was sumptuous. Retro Wine Lounge is a must if you're visiting Lisbon and looking for a proper local wine bar with a cozy atmosphere. Not to mention: Daniel has great taste in music! He was playing American soul classics when I went. I will definitely go back next time I'm in town. || Thank you so much for your kind words and review, Natalie. It's nice that you mentioned the music also as it's the soul of our place, together with the wines. We'll be truly happy to see you at our lounge again next time you'll be in town. || Beautiful, cozy atmosphere, welcomed by a great host and flavorful wine. This place is a must if you’re looking for an experience like no other. || I came with the idea of getting to understand Portuguese wines, and what a better place to land than Retro Wine Lounge. Wide variety of high quality native wines, all explained with passion and expertise. Cheeses meticulously selected to pair the wines. Friendly owner keen to share his knowledge with passion. Highly recommended! || I recently visited this charming wine bar with a friend, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. The selection of wines was exceptional, offering a variety of unique and intriguing options that delighted our palates. We paired the wines with a selection of cheeses, which were simply outstanding – perfectly curated to complement the flavors of the wines.  What made the evening truly special, however, was the warm and attentive service provided by the owner. He went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, sharing his deep knowledge of the wines and ensuring we had the best experience possible. His passion for his craft was evident in every recommendation and in the care he showed throughout our visit.  If you're looking for a cozy spot to enjoy high-quality wine and cheese with exceptional hospitality, I cannot recommend this place enough. || Thank you so much for your review and such kind words. So glad that we didn't disappoint you. We'll always do our best to provide the most authentic wine experience and we truly hope to see you again when you visit Lisbon someday. You'll always be welcome here. || The best place for the most special experience ever. Authentic, traditional and very original products. Best host ever, lots of knowledge and passion. || This place is amazing. A true gem off the beaten path with a very knowledge wine owner. He only opens occasionally to the public and we happen to come during that time. He was welcoming and the wine was fãulous! || We had a very nice wine tasting. You can expect special wines, unique and rare. Daniel explained a lot and knows his business. We enjoyed it a lot and hope to come back! || One of my best wine experiences. Great wines, but what I liked the most was Daniel explaining details about the wine we drunk and a lot more about the history of wine in Portugal and in the world . || Just had an exceptional experience at the place. The host is amazing, courteous and has deep knowledge about wines. The experience starts with an introduction to many different types of wines. After that the guests can taste a few selected ones. The final selected wine is served with different types of cheeses, dried fruits n nuts or choice of salads (variety of cured meat is also there but I am a vegetarian). The wines served here are not commercial ones but carefully selected ones. We purchased a bottle of wine for gifting purposes too. This place is amazingly economical and has very good vibes || Thank you so much for your detailed review and very kind words, Tulika. I'm very glad that I could attend your expectations. Hope to see you again at our place. || The wine wasting experience is good, you can describe what flavors and brands you prefer, then the boss will give you recommendations. This wine  in the picture is super refreshing , fragrant and easy drinking, especially when paring with chocolate. || Glad that you enjoyed our fresh red vinho verde ("green" wine), which is so specific, specially with dark chocolate. Thanks for your detailed review and kind words, Carey. We hope to see you again at our wine spot. || Amazing wines! Daniel is an expert but makes it so approachable. His English is fantastic! Perfect tourism spot in Lisbon for tasting Portuguese wines! || Had a nice experience here with some friends last Saturday, the owner Daniel was very knowledgeable and gave insights into Claret wine which was a first for us. Nice cheese and meat snacks and tasty wine. Highly recommended! || Thanks for your review, Arthur. Glad that you enjoyed that claret wine. It's different and at the same time one of the most traditional Portuguese wine styles. Hope to see you again at our place. You guys are always welcome here. || A very interesting selection of amphora wines, a beautiful and cozy place. The host will tell you a lot of interesting things about wine. || I came here for the talha wine, I stayed for the experience. Daniel is incredibly knowledgeable and generous with his time and expertise. The wine was gorgeous and interesting to learn about. I'll definitely be back. || Thank you so much for your review, Conor. That's why we believe we're, step-by-step, achieving the goal of providing one of the best selection and experiences in the field of the Talha and Amphora Wine in general, here in Lisbon. And you're always welcome at our place as a big appreciator of it. || You can really tell that the owner absolutely loves what he does and he takes such a good care of the guests and their preferences. A lovely place for a quiet and romantic evening. || Thanks for your review and nice words, Julia. Those are our goals.  You'll be always welcome in our place. || You are visiting from another country and you want to try Portuguese wines by someone experienced and enthusiastic. This is the place. Definitely worth the trip. The owner is very knowledgeable and very nice. Would visit again. || Thank you so much for your review, honest and kind words, Nazli. We hope to see you again when you'll be in Lisbon. || Daniel was an amazing host!! He served us a plethora of delicious and authentic local wines as well as a plate of nuts and gourmet cheese. 10/10 place. || Thanks for your review, Hazel. It's always a pleasure to host you at our place. Hope to see you again.

The views, food, and service were exceptional. We wanted to see the sunset, so made reservations for 5pm. Even though it wasn’t crowded, reservations guaranteed us a seat indoors if it got cool/rainy (which it did) The cod was amazing! Beautifully plated and delicious. || Dear Lynne Lott,  We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the views, the food, and the service provided by our team.  We look forward to welcoming you back for more memorable moments on our rooftop.  Lumi Team || I had two wonderful people help me! Miriam and Amina, so long as I read name tags right, were amazing with getting me a table even without a reservation. They were professional throughout and handled even obstinate customers with grace. Very impressed and would recommend to anyone visiting. I do hope everyone there feels proud of what they do! || Dear Michelina FuXiang Merriman,  We are delighted to hear that Miriam and Amina helped to make your visit special.  We are thrilled that you enjoyed the service provided by our team and hope to welcome you back soon.  Lumi Team || We had a phenomenal dining experience at Lumi Rooftop! The atmosphere was warm, elegant, and welcoming (we didn't have a reservation).  Every single dish we ordered was outstanding — bursting with flavor, beautifully presented, and perfectly balanced.  We started with the tuna ceviche, which was fresh, zesty, and incredibly well-seasoned. The duck spring rolls were crispy on the outside, tender on the inside, and paired with a delicious dipping sauce. For mains, the pork shoulder was fall-apart tender, rich, and deeply satisfying. But the star of the show might have been the oxtail croquettes — crispy, savory bites of pure comfort and sophistication.  We asked for the wine of the month, a dry red that completely blew us away. It was bold, smooth, and had a wonderfully complex flavor that paired beautifully with all of our dishes.  Service was top-notch: friendly, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about the menu.  This place is a gem. Lumi is an absolute must for anyone who appreciates thoughtful, flavorful cuisine, great wine and amazing service. || Dear Erik Ramirez,  Thank you very much for this detailed review. It is an honor to know that every element—from the welcoming atmosphere to the carefully prepared dishes and selected wine—contributed to a memorable evening at Lumi Rooftop.  Our team is dedicated to creating dining experiences that combine flavor, sophistication, and authenticity, and it is extremely gratifying to know that this was reflected in your visit. We deeply appreciate your recognition of the quality of our service and the attention of our staff.  It will always be a pleasure to welcome you back!  Lumi Team || Cozy rooftop with an intimate atmosphere and attentive staff. The food was good, although on the pricier side and smaller portions - but a good option for a small bite and glass of wine!  No reservation is needed and seating seems to be available even on busier nights like Thursday. || Dear Mrs. Nastaseanu,   Thank you so much for your thoughtful review!   We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed our cozy atmosphere, along with the attentive service.   Our menu is divided between dishes designed for sharing and others that can be served individually. But we truly appreciate your feedback regarding portion sizes and pricing, and we will certainly take it into consideration.   We hope to welcome you back soon Lumi Team || After having underwhelming food so far in Lisbon, the octopus here was really good - what I was expecting for all of Lisbon tbh. The cocktails were also spot on. You pay for the quality and the view and in my opinion it’s well priced for the quality you get. Very chilled vibes. || Dear Reese Murugan,  Thank you for sharing your experience.  We’re glad the octopus and cocktails lived up to your expectations and brought a satisfying moment to your time in Lisbon. It's wonderful to hear you enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere and found the value and view to be well matched.  Looking forward to welcoming you again soon for another great experience.  Lumi Team || Loved getting a few drinks and apps here! Beautiful view and we enjoyed the food we got. We shared the grilled octopus and it was delicious. Highly recommend and the view is great! Make sure to get a reservation because we saw them turn away several people who didn’t make them. || Dear Melissa Sun,  Thank you very much for your visit and for sharing such a positive review! We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the view, the drinks, and especially our grilled octopus.  We also appreciate the tip about reservations. In fact, during busy times, we always advise our customers to book in advance to guarantee a table with a privileged view.  We hope to see you again soon.  Lumi Team || We didn't expect a restaurant offering great views to offer exceptional dishes.  However, Lumi was a surprise.  The views from the rooftop could be great if it wasn't for the humid and smoggy hot air outside.  We stayed inside and chose the following dishes: Spring Roll de Pato, Ceviche de Atum, and Presa de Porto.  Though the waitress insisted Lumi's a  Portuguese contemporary restaurant.  We found the foods were more fusion with influences from Frech, Chinese, and Vietnamese dishes.  The pork shoulder was very tender and tasty.  The sour cream/yoga sauce with the meshed sweet yam was a great compliment to the pork.  The chopped up tuna blended with cilantro, olive oil and sea salt was a delicacy like the one I tried in Paris.  Finally, the duck spring roll coupled with peanut seasme sauce and season's greens was as refreshing as you could get in a hot summer.  Bottom it probably truly reflect the mutifaceted culture of Portuguese foods. || Thank you very much for sharing your experience with us. We are delighted to hear that Lumi surprised you in a positive way.  Although the weather that day was not ideal for enjoying the rooftop views, it is excellent to know that the flavors of our menu provided an equally memorable gastronomic journey.   We are particularly happy to hear that you enjoyed dishes such as the Duck Spring Roll, Tuna Ceviche, and Pork Presa.  Lumi Team || Ok-ish for drinks, a strong no for food. We made a reservation and didn’t have to wait. The burger had cilantro on it, but it was not showed as an ingredient in the menu. The fries had a stale taste. The waiter didn’t even bother to ask why I left my food untouched. || Dear Mihaela Miron,  Thank you for sharing your experience—we sincerely regret that your visit did not meet your expectations.  We take the care with the ingredients described on the menu very seriously, and we apologize that the use of cilantro was not properly indicated. We are already reviewing this communication with our team to ensure complete transparency. As for the potatoes and service, your comment will be shared with the restaurant team to reinforce the attention and proactivity we strive to maintain in every service.  Your opinion is essential for us to continuously improve. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide an experience more in line with our standards.  Lumi Team || This is a very nice resturant to dine while in Portugal. The views of the rooftop over look the other houses and businesses in the area, but it is nice to be outdoors without the intrusion of wildlife that congregate around the street resturants. The food is excellent and the portions sizes are enough for sharing. Seating is comfortable and the atmosphere is no rush. Reservation are a must for dining here. Would definitely recommend this as a lunch option for anyone visiting Portugal. || Dear Batman Linton,  We’re pleased that our rooftop restaurant offered the perfect blend of serenity, comfort, and quality. It’s great to know that you appreciated the generous portions, relaxed atmosphere, and scenic views above Lisbon’s vibrant streets.  We hope to host you again!  Lumi Team || We had lunch here for my birthday and I had the most fantastic experience. Marlene and Tania gave superb customer service in making the reservation and also on the day. We loved the views and of course the food and drinks which were top quality. Looking for  rooftop bar or restaurant in Lisbon? This is the one to visit. || Dear Mark Eastwood,  Thank you very much for sharing your experience with us — and for choosing our restaurant to celebrate such a special occasion as your birthday!  It is extremely gratifying to know that you enjoyed a memorable lunch, with special mention for the service provided by Marlene and Tânia. We have already shared your compliments with both of them and with the whole team.  We are also delighted to hear that the view, food and drinks lived up to your expectations.   We hope to welcome you back soon!  Lumi Team

The drinks were good but what impressed us the most was the service! We came on a rather quiet night that we were the only guests for roughly the first 20 minutes of our time. The musician was closed to finishing his shift, yet still played … || Had the best night out in Lisbon in this bar/pub. The service was excellent and the live music here was very good! Luis was singing that day when we first arrive and he was a vibe!! A lot of the people going there seemed like tourists … || On our last night in Lisbon we went to Zam Live Music Bar, and it was simply outstanding! The live music was amazing, the atmosphere was full of energy, and the staff were super nice, cool, and friendly. We were the only Asian guests there … || Cozy music cafe. In 2 hours,while we were there, 2 different musicians played. Also they involved people to play with them. Cocktails very good. Food average,but you are there for music and atmosphere,not to eat. Cocktails not cheap,but tasty. If you want calm evening as we wanted,then this is good place. || 10/10 would recommend. Really small unassuming spot, but the service was unmatched: the waiter introduced us to those around us, asked where we were from, gave us complementary crisps. Music was great, people were dancing. Also great for solo travellers! || We made fast friends at this little bar and ended up returning every night of our stay in Lisbon. Carina and Eleos made great cocktails. The Jam Shrimp was flavorful and perfectly cooked 💖 || As a traveller chef I love to try food anywhere I go. We ate Jam  burgers and was delicious. Great atmosphere and service. We drink amazing Sangria Recommended 100 % || Great bar. Food and drink excellent. Had the veggie dog and a whiskey sour. Musician playing was also great. Thoroughly enjoyed. || Best bar in Portugal and you know it's true because they won't say it Carina (Karina?) is the best bartender in town and everything they recommend is the best. The live music is always on even if you are the only person in the bar (we came during off season) we very much enjoyed Jean from Brazil who played the best American classics. The next evening we danced to the most beautiful Brazilian tunes. Seriously don't miss this place and definitely have their version of the Bifana! It's over the top and amazing 🤩 || Funny thing, the best meal I had in Lisbon was here in a bar. Octopus cooked to perfection and well seasoned. The vibe with live music is just top notch. Highly recommend this place! 👍 || Great time for everyone, I especially enjoyed the Brazilian singer, his music got me thinking about Brazil. Bar was just around the corner from my apartment. So I visited often, every visit was a great experience.. || Such an amazing bar!! We came for a glass of wine… stayed for 6h. I’ve never seen such genuine and welcoming staff, which makes you immediately feel like it’s not your first time there. On the menu, you’ll find a great selection of wines and cocktails - don’t forget to try their olives. And cherry on top, Erich beautifully accompanies the evening with Brazilian songs and even invites you to play along! This is a must-visit while in Lisbon. Can’t wait to be back :) || Stumbled into this bar by accident because we heard great live music. Staff was super nice and friendly, great cider and beer. Would go again! || The service was phenomenal! I have never had such an amazing experience. The staff are very engaged and attentive. They create an amazing atmosphere, and even the musician really engages with everyone in the bar.  The mocktail i had also tasted amazing! Highly recommend the mocktail.  We wish we had heard about this place sooner as we would have visited multiple times during our trip. || Jam Club, I loved you. It was an amazing experience, and I’m so glad I came. This was the best experience I had in Lisbon. Oh, if only I could remember the name of that lovely woman—you made us feel so special, as if everything was just for us. The drinks were incredible, each one prepared with great care and tailored exactly to your taste, adjusted again and again if needed. The staff were so delightful. And the music—it was as if they could read our minds and played exactly what we were thinking. Even for requests they hadn’t played before, they tried it with us and nailed it. For some reason, the names have slipped my mind, but it was such a joy; we sang almost every song together. I say everyone should go, go right now! Don’t miss it. Jam Club, thank you so much! 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻 || WOW! JUST WOW!! The food is absolutely incredible! The octopus w/ hummus was incredibly cooked and smooth! Service is amazing and the ambiance is so warm, welcoming and friendly! Great live music. This place is THE vibe!! || It’s impossible to not have a good time at this place. The staff are outgoing, lively, and fun! The food (try the prawns in the wine sauce) was delicious, the music was delightful, and the vibe was phenomenal. || Very cozy bar with live music and nice atmosphere. The waitresses are so nice and friendly. Taste of the cocktails I ordered wasn’t perfect it was just acceptable, could be better. Its good place to try ones when you are in Lisbon. || Really great atmosphere and the servers were so nice and attentive! We really enjoyed the live music too! We got the white sangria and it was delicious. Would definitely come back here. || We climbed a lot of stairs to come to this place and boy, it was totally worth it! Such a friendly service and intimate and warm atmosphere, we felt totally at home! Our group was 2 seniors, 1 kid and two adults and we all agreed - this place is awesome! Prices were super affordable.  Our server and the bartender couldn’t have been nicer! We were hungry and though burgers are not usually our go to, the jam and normal burger with fries and the veggie hot dog for me were quite tasty and price was amazing for what you get. I had a cocktail (not sure what the name of it was but it was a recommendation from the server for something fruity) and it was refreshing! They even gave us complimentary their signature pastel de nata shots and they were delicious.  There was live music and the gentlemen who was playing the guitar even took song requests and let our daughter sing a song with him! We had a great time! I am a bit skeptical when I see a lot of 5 star reviews but this place should have 10*! Thank you for the hospitality, we will definitely be back when we visit Lisbon again!

Amazing aperitivo italiano, everything it's super cool here, music, atmosphere, food and Marco he gives an excellent service, cocktail fantastics. For €6 you can have an amazing italian aperitivo with cocktail. || Great Gonzalo! I love you! Thanks so much for the fantastic review! || If you’re looking for the most unforgettable, authentic, and vibrant bar experience in Lisbon, look no further – this is hands-down the best spot in the entire city! Tucked away in the heart of a truly charming neighborhood, this place offers a magical mix of atmosphere, character, and energy that is simply unmatched anywhere else in Lisbon.  From the moment you step through the door, you’re greeted with the warmest, most welcoming vibe imaginable. The staff are incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do – they make you feel like a local from the very first visit. It’s the kind of place where strangers become friends, and every visit feels like a celebration.  The atmosphere is absolutely electric – buzzing with laughter, conversation, and the unmistakable soul of Lisbon. It’s packed with locals, which speaks volumes. You won’t find a more genuine or authentic crowd anywhere else. There’s no touristy pretense here – just pure, unfiltered Lisboeta life at its finest.  And now, let’s talk about the drinks – because WOW. The Caipirinhas served here are nothing short of legendary. Easily the best I’ve ever had – perfectly balanced, incredibly fresh, and dangerously delicious. Each sip is a burst of citrusy, refreshing perfection. It’s clear that they use only the highest quality ingredients and pour a ton of care and craftsmanship into every cocktail.  The location? Absolutely unbeatable. It’s nestled in a prime spot that’s both lively and laid-back, making it the perfect place to kick off your evening or wind down after a long day of exploring the city. Whether you’re sitting inside soaking up the cozy ambiance or enjoying the lively street-side buzz, it’s the ideal setting for unforgettable nights.  In short, this bar is nothing less than a hidden treasure – an absolute must-visit for anyone wanting the very best Lisbon has to offer. I can’t recommend it highly enough. Do yourself a favor and go – you’ll thank me later! || Oh my god Jan! Really thank you from the bottom of my heart for the wonderful review! I'm truly moved by your words and so happy that you and your friends stopped here! I can only be grateful for every word you wrote! I look forward to welcoming you back with open arms and can't wait to see you and all of you again soon! Thank you! || Amazing bar! Will defo come back again!! || fantastic food! the bread is so fresh and warm. highly recommend the prawns, labneh, and fish cakes! great atmosphere to sit and enjoy a bottle of wine with friends || I came across Antiga Wine Bar one night near Castelo de São Jorge and what a great find! The wine selection was exceptional and the food was delicious. The service was great and very accommodating. Would recommend making reservations as it gets very busy, and for good reason! || Everything we had here was delicious. The goat cheese rolls, ceviche, pork belly, seafood board, clams, scallops, duck confit...and on and on...we almost tried everything and we couldn't decide what was best. Our server gave us the best recommendation on wine and we just had a wonderful experience. We got a reservation because we had 5 people but its reasonable to walk in because their service is so efficient. || Our initial server was amazing and did a fabulous job pairing our first 2 food orders with wine. But then he left, and when we asked the next server about a pairing for our pork belly he said “we don’t have a lot of options” and we said that’s okay what’s the recommendation for the pork belly (since this is a wine bar after all?) he came back and described the bottle as “this is 5 euros a glass” lol  Scallops were absolutely delicious! Chicken was a little bit dry but had a good sauce. Pork belly was cooked well but needed a little bit more flavour or sauce. Overall, a good experience. But latter half felt meh and we didn’t feel encouraged to stay for dessert.  Would’ve given a 5 star if we had the same server til the end of our meal! || Stopped by a glass of wine and ended up returning a few hours later for dinner (the delicious food smells won us over). Great wine and food. Highly recommend the scallops and duck. || Loved it here. It was fully booked a day before, so we booked via this app. And it was a nice decision because food and service were sooo good! Anything from menu is good) || Antiga Wine Bar is one of our favorite places in Lisbon. We've had a fantastic dining experience all 3 times and look forward to visiting Lisbon to go back to this wine bar. We are not familiar with local wines, so Rodolfo helped us on our recent April visit select wines based on our wine profile. He also made wonderful food recommendations. Our favorite was the duck confit, but also loved the seabass ceviche, pork belly with guava & goat cheese rolls with honey.  Small place with great vibes and wonderful service in a charming area of town. Get reservations so you don't miss out. || What a delightful find Antiga Wine Bar turned out to be! We stumbled upon this charming restaurant and were fortunate enough to secure a reservation for that evening. Our experience was so wonderful that we returned just a few nights later, eager to relive the magic. The ambiance of Antiga is small yet incredibly warm and welcoming. It creates an intimate setting that makes every visit feel special. From the moment we walked in, we were enveloped in a cozy atmosphere that set the stage for a memorable dining experience. The waitstaff at Antiga are truly lovely. They are attentive and genuinely happy to make suggestions on both food and wine, all without being pushy. Their knowledge and enthusiasm for the menu added a personal touch that enhanced our experience. While the menu is small, it has been honed to perfection. Each dish we tried was memorable, showcasing well-portioned servings that were beautifully presented. The food was prepared to perfection, with thoughtful balance and pairing that made every bite a delight. If I lived in Lisbon, I would undoubtedly be a regular at Antiga Wine Bar. It’s the kind of place that invites you to relax and savor the moment, making it highly recommended for anyone seeking an intimate and enjoyable restaurant experience. Whether you're a local or just visiting, don’t miss the chance to dine here—you won’t be disappointed!

good place to have a drink, and also bigger than other wine bars in the area so it’s great for big groups. we got really good wine recommendations from the girls, who were also super nice. the atmosphere is beautiful, i loved the turntable and the record shelf :) || Great wine bar. We booked a table online. Waitress was very friendly and spoke good English. We had a few glasses of orange wine, the cheese platter, hummus, smashed potato, carrots and it was all delicious. Lots of bread and were regularly topped up if needed (both bread and wine!)Had a good amount of people in for a Sunday night, good atmosphere! || This place is a hidden gem. The food was absolutely amazing. Great service great wine. Highly recommend for the experienced foodie! Antoine was amazing! || BomBomBom is a cozy gem in Lisbon with a fantastic selection of unique wines and a warm, inviting atmosphere. I loved the creative touch of the vinyl shelf – you can buy records or enjoy DJs spinning sets on vinyl. A perfect mix of wine, music, and ambiance. || Stumbled upon this place randomly and we thought it was just a wine bar with great jazz music…turns out it’s our new Mecca for cuisine. Whoever the Michelin star people are they need to get here and give this place ALL of the Michelin stars ASAP. The food was absolutely incredible and of course the wine was as well. We loved it so much we needed to come back on our very last night so we could savor the flavors of the food and wine one last time. || Thank you for your words Aly ! 🙏 … || Wine bar with amazing food in a cosy atmosphere. They have great music, and it is good for both cosy nights indoors and on summer evenings in the terrace. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. I love this place and keep coming back! || Thank you Catarina 🙏 … || Nice choices of food and wine. However not the best place to go when you are hungry as portions are very small. Can recommend visiting for drinks with a little bit of something fancy on the side. Service very friendly. || Lovely spot in Lisbon. Excellent wine selection, great music, and delicious food. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, thanks to the lovely couple running the place ! || Thank you Othman, it was a pleasure to have you with us ! || This can't be a jazz bar! No jazz bars have food this good. So, this is an amazing restaurant that has jazz. Try to make the monthly Sunday session, but come nevertheless. The food is actually crafted by actual chefs with actual taste for balance and constructed dishes...how novel! The wines, by glass or more, are eclectic and thought through...the service, perfectly personal.. not plastic, not clingy. The vibe is as now as the kid on the billboard that you have no idea who it is, what they do, or why they're on the billboard. But that's not to say you'll be judged... you'll be welcomed as if you were a great jazz musician, regardless of age or more age.... or even my age. || Hi, thank you so much for your words! It means a lot to us ! Indeed we are not a jazz bar 😊but we do love Jazz among a variety of music. The live jazz session is a monthly event at the moment indeed. Hope to have you back anytime soon !  … || Would Return.  I really really wanted to love this place. Cool love DJ, amazing small plates for sharing, affordable wines. Perfect. Finally the perfect wine bar.  Unfortunately the server was begging for tips at the very end. "I just want to make BIG clear, service is not included". " A lot of people don't know" Okay. So what? Go work in the US or Canada?  Beef Tongue - sublime. Seared at the very end， tender throughout, perfect wine accompaniment. The sticky rice/potatoes thing at the bottom? SO GOOD.  Peaches and Leek - so so close. Leeks have a very tough inedible outer layer they didn't remove but I think they hoped the grill would soften it (it didn't).  Amazing flavours, 9/10 for execution, just need a little more finesse.  I wanted to come back every night for the next 3 until I was bugged for a tip. He literally looked at my change before he said it too lmao.  Expect 30€+ pp. Cash or card. || Hi Robert,  Thank you for your feedback. There might have been a misunderstanding with our waiter though as it’s not in our philosophy to « beg » for tips. But a lot of customers ask if service is included in the price, so he might have anticipated this question in a clumsy way. Happy to welcome you back anytime soon!

A wine bar literally the size of my bedroom! The guys behind the bar are very knowledgeable and helpful, so a good glass or two or wine is guaranteed.  This is the first stop on my trip to Lisbon and I'm very happy indeed. || As travelers in Lisbon and natural wine lovers, we found this wine bar exceptional. We like the concept of no wine menu, just talk with the very kind, welcoming, calm, and knowledgeable sommeliers about your wine preferences, and they will let you try different wines until you find what you are searching for. I described the sommelier as “calm” because I mistakenly knocked the bottles of wine, which spilled about a glass on the floor, but he was genuinely calm and friendly. Their wine choices are great, and we were super blessed with what we tried. There are few food choices, but it's great for an after-dinner visit. || I loved this wine bar so much! It is vibrant, full of good wine choices, there is a park next to it where you can sit and enjoy your drink. Price per glass ranges from €6 to €20. The staff is cool, they let you sample wines before ordering and they also give you good recommendations. You can take tour glass to the park, but you need to leave a deposit. || Black Sheep Lisboa is a gem — an intimate, stylish wine bar with an outstanding selection and truly knowledgeable sommelier (also very handsome) bartenders. The staff pair wines with just the right notes and stories, making each pour feel curated. Cozy atmosphere, great small plates that complement the wines, and excellent recommendations whether you prefer natural, classic or adventurous bottles. A must-visit for anyone who loves wine and thoughtful service. Highly recommended. || Lots of wonderful memories at my favorite wine bar in Lisboa over the years. Yes the wine is always amazing, but the people even more so. Warm hearts always welcome you at Black Sheep—what makes it special. Obrigada || Amazing place I just discovered with a friend. We went to the side of the bar and were welcomed warmly. The bartender has a real knowledge about wine, switched between English and Portuguese with the two of us without any issue and has even told us more about the history of the bar and the owner.  Can’t remember the name of the bartender, but can’t wait to come back for moments like this || Black sheep is a gem. I loved that when I asked if "we could get weirder" with wine recommendations, we were brought a series of incredibly fun and funky wines. Black sheep delivers on everything -  local art, great wine recommendations, and unbeatable vibes. || What a shame. I moved to Lisbon the year this place opened, and I’ve watched it lose the soul it once had.  Tonight we went to Black Sheep for a friend’s celebration - 3 glasses, a few bottles, nothing complicated. When my friend left early, she returned her glass to the bar and even texted me to say so. Later, the staff insisted one glass was “missing” and refused to listen or consider anything we explained. We were charged for a glass we had already returned.  And here’s the thing: I understand the deposit system and why they use it. But when the system fails, the customer pays - even when the bar will inevitably find the glass later. That’s not just rigid, it’s getting money for something that wasn’t actually lost.  It wasn’t about the amount. It was the attitude: zero trust, zero curiosity, zero willingness to engage. Just a robotic “no.” It feels like customer care has been replaced by profit-first thinking.  If you want natural wine in the neighborhood, go to Magnolia or bring your own bottle to Praça das Flores. Black Sheep used to feel alive. Now it feels indifferent - guided more by turnover than by hospitality. || I cant give less than five stars. I went for the first time and got impressed by the service. They really know what they are talking about! They have a large variety of wines. Black sheep is usually crowded and almost impossible to have a seat on weekends. The tip here is to get there earlier so you can be able to have a full tasting experience while listen to the amazing stories of each bottle of wine you try! || Wonderful tiny wine bar serving “whatever we have open at the minute!” They let you taste a ton of wines to find one you love, and staff are super nice & knowledgeable. It can get packed so visit on a week day or just be patient. Totally worth it— the wine and vibes are amazing.

place_name: Club des Châteaux - WINE BAR - SALDANHA

reviews_content: All staff are extremely friendly, always friends and willing to help, excellent cozy atmosphere. Great drinks selection from wine, gin, whiskeys, and traditional Portuguese drinks. Will definitely come back when next visiting Portugal again. Thank you guys for such hospitality! || Absolute rip off charged €27 for a bottle of wine that costs no more than €6, I can understand business need to mark up prices but this is ridiculous. Not a cheap wine bar, absolute tourist rip off!!! || We had a great time here. Lovely service with  great sangria and cheese boards. We were brought complimentary drinks at the end of our meal as well! We will be returning! || Excellent Wine Selection and Knowledgeable Staff I had a fantastic experience at this wine shop. The selection is impressive, with bottles from both well-known vineyards and unique, hard-to-find labels. The staff was incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to understand my taste preferences, making thoughtful recommendations that were spot on. The atmosphere is welcoming and relaxed, making it easy to browse and explore. Whether you’re a casual wine drinker or a serious enthusiast, this shop is definitely worth visiting. || Very nice place, for this price a lot of porto and Wine. And a big plate to eat.  Nice place, good music and lovely barman. The place to be || What an amazing find, such a help with the wine selection and paired it with an amazing food board. And the music 🔥 || Had a great evening, Anged was a super host. Some delicious sangria, cured meat and cheese and nice conversation. Tried some port wine and ginga. Awesome place and fantastic staff!! || The best bar in Alfama. Monty is the most kind and generous host that you might ever encounter. Drinks are fantastic and sangria made by Monty is magical. || Again another knock out experience in Lisbon. I only write good reviews. Or bad ones. Nothing in-between. This wine bar is friendly, helpful and a great night  I guess if your a genuine host with nice help. Your winning. Couldn't ask for a better few nights here. I will be back and he will remember me and you when try the place. || Great wine selection. The 10 year port wine is very good.  Best olives I had in Lisbon. Only sad we were always too full to try the cheese or meat plate- they looked delicious. Ronnie was so helpful, great service. You’ll find all different people here which makes the atmosphere fun. You can sit inside or outside. They are very accommodating. We were fortunate to stay close and visit often during our trip. || Monty is amazing! So helpful, and shared great information with us! A must stop!!! Best service we have had so far! || Absolutely lovely bar with great service. Monty was a delight and such great fun. Could have stayed there all night! || This place was a life saver. Arrived in Lisbon super late and despite hearing of all of the late night partying to expect, EVERYTHING was closing at 11p, right when I finally found my guesthouse. This place has cheap wine like the name says, but GOOD. The house vinho Verde was *chef's kiss* Perfecto! And they have tapas, stay open until 2a and have free wifi. They also have the "must try" Lisbon cherry liquor , ginja. And, best of all, it was moderately busy, but still found a table. Unlike the only other 2 places open that were mobbed with people and just awful. Laid back and chill. Plus they have a huge selection of wine by the bottle for sale to take away. My server was super sweet and awesome! || thanks and most wellcome || You want local? You want friendly people? Come here in Alfama and enjoy the culture. White Porto is a must, and definitely give a try with the “green” wine! Don’t leave without buying a bottle to take home. Open early, stay until late. || Ronny is a great guy! Had a great night. Exceptional choices in wines but also food pairings. I’d recommend getting the cheese/meat mixed board! || Very hospitable bartenders and workers. Very affordable drinks, wide selection of wine and cocktails with a good local feel! || Treasure of a spot. Cheese board & wine to die for. Very reasonably priced, great music & vibe. Top class service. A must in Lisbon. 5Stars. || Ronnie is a superb host! Great food and port. Air con and wifi. Great way to wile away an afternoon. Highly recommend! || Great evening drinks . Monty was a great host. Gave us great recommendations based on our wine preferences. Would recommend for great value wine on a trip to Lisbon || Awesome wine. Great service. Came for a bottle of vinho verde and stayed for many glasses more. Fantastic lesson on different wines and history. Must stop here, you’ll be happy you did :)

Coffee shop by day, wine bar by night. This cozy hidden gem is warm and inviting, and the wine selection is excellent. The baked Camembert was a highlight. Rich, creamy, and a perfect match with our white wine. || Thank you so much for your visit!💫🖤🥂 It was pleasure to take you to some “travels” around Portugal through our wine! … || We really enjoyed our visit here. The place is tiny inside which really makes you feel like your part of exclusive joint if you manage to get a seat. The cosy spacing also makes it very easy to speak to the friendly owner who was able to tell us a lot about the wines we were trying. The wineries they purchase from I believe are all (mostly?) independent so it was great to try something different! Cheese board a must! || Thank you very much for your visit! And yes, we work with small wineries, garage wineries, and it’s something you won’t buy at a supermarket. Really happy you enjoyed the experience 💫🥂 … || An amazing new place! Run by a fantastic sommelier who knows all about Portuguese wines, from Azores till Lisbon. Katya shows real knowledge and passion for everything she pours. Also loved the little snack, which was pão de queijo paired with fresh muhammara, what a creative and delicious combo. Really recommend this place right in Alfama 😍 || Thank you so much, Lous!🥂💫Was good to see you, waiting for you again, can’t wait to show you my new wines and have a glass with you! Cheers! … || Nothing beats this place in terms of wine in Lisbon! It’s a nice and cozy place with a super knowledgeable somm to take you through the Portuguese wine journey. As a wine lover myself, I was in different places that serve wine but nothing like this place that gives me the vibe of home. Love that chatter, laugher and obvious the wine at this place! || Thank you so much, Cayden!😍🥂 was pleasure to meet you and chat with u! Hope to see you again! … || What a find -small bar easily missed. Specialises in Portuguese wines -the lady running it has deep knowledge and huge enthusiasm. We had a range of stunning wines at really fair prices -just don’t get Portuguese wines of this quality in UK. Track it down and enjoy || Thank you, Chris🖤💫 Waiting for you again to enjoy more wine! … || Do yourself a favor and go here. This was an absolute highlight of our trip to Lisbon. We had some of the most incredible wines we have ever encountered, and learned all about each wine before enjoying them. We were able to learn so much about local wines from our divine hostess, and had an incredible time. The place was beautiful and clean and everything you could possibly want from a wine bar. 10/10 would go here again and again. || Thank you so much, Camille🖤✨ we are so happy we managed to deliver you a good experience and U had some great time with our wine and company! Waiting for you anytime! … || Very nice wine point in the heart of Lisbon♥️ Absolutely delicious Portuguese organic wine, creative appetizers, and the warmest, most welcoming host. Truly worth a visit! || Thank you, Mary😍🥂 Was a pleasure to have you here! … || The passion and expertise of the young woman who runs this charming little spot are truly remarkable. The wine is something special and carefully selected, well beyond what you’d find in typical commercial spots. Highly recommended! || 🖤💫thank you so much, Fabiola! Such kind words and it was a pleasure to have you here! Hope to see you soon 🍾 … || United states folk here girlfriend and I. Just walked down the road and stumbled upon this absolute gem. So Lucky. Hands down the best spot on the street. Wonderful sommelier who talked us through each tasting. Very unique local wines unlike anything we’ve tried before. Very pleasant atmosphere and vibes. We ended up drinking 3 glasses each. 2 red 1 white. Also had the homemade bread, butter, and local olives, delicious. Very reasonably priced. Highly recommend for EVERYBODY! we will be talking about this experience at home. Also they are open for breakfast, we will probably be back tomorrow morning. || Thank you, Sam😍 Was so cool to take you to this little wine adventure around Portuguese vineyards! Please, come back for breakfast and coffee, my colleagues and Volta Coffee won’t let you down too ;) … || The best place to try Portuguese wines! Cozy, caring, and absolutely delicious. Heartwarming! Be sure to visit— the host is simply the best expert in the world. || Thank you, Maria💫 I hope to see you again to try our new wine selection from our small Portuguese wine producers that we carefully choose ourselves  … || Chanced upon this pop up wine bar and absolutely love it. Very relaxed vibe with great service from Katya. Wines are very unique and delicious, and not something you can easily find outside of Portugal.  Have been going every night throughout my trip with no regrets. Definitely recommend || 🖤🥂💫 thank you so much, Zheng! Was super cool to hang out and try wines with u! Hope to see you again to try other wines from all over beautiful Portugal🥂 … || Rare and unique spot in Alfama - from the vibe, through the impressive wine selection, to the kind and knowledgeable owner. Wines change every week - good reason to come often! Winter evening must try: high quality mulled wine with savory snacks. || Obrigada, Marcin💫🥂 We hope to see you again very soon! Thanks for the visit🖤 … || Had a great time! Lovely local wines and typical Portugese bites || Thank you so much, Hidde!🥂🖤💫 Welcome to the Vagalume family, now you are a Wandering Light (firefly) too 🥰✨ … || Very nice! The vest place in Lisbon for vine & snaks. || Thank you very much, Andrea🥰🥂💫 … || Great wine in the cozy cafe! They offer a selection of natural wines from Portugal, everything comes from small local wine suppliers.  Another highlight is the sommelier Katya - she will tell you the story behind each bottle and will help you decide what wine perfectly suits your mood!  Portuguese wines, small terrace overlooking the street of historical area of Lisbon, cozy atmosphere, great snacks - you’ll find it here :) || Obrigada🖤 It was pleasure to have you here and share our passion, please, come back anytime soon to try our new menu that is changing every 1-2 weeks and maybe catch a pop-up with a talented chef and have dinner with us🥂 … || Fantastic selection of wines! Added bonus: getting to taste before committing to one (as any place should do). Staff knows their wines and makes sure that you are happy and comfortable. Lovely spot with lovely vibes! || Obrigada, Kyo!🥂✨ We are always happy here to offer a small wine tasting before choosing what suits your mood better tonight, we believe this is THE way! And, of course, the main idea is to introduce Portuguese wine to our guests and shape an idea about it🖤 Working with small farmers, we are happy to support them by spreading the word about their work, land and ideas 💡 || This wine bar is absolutely amazing and a must visit if you are in Lisbon. The host is very friendly and extremely knowledgeable about all types of wines, recommending to your taste! Highly recommend || Thank you for your kind words, Ted! It was pleasure to have you here🥂💫🖤 Hope to see you again to try more wines and “travel” around Portugal while sitting on a cute terrace in Alfama🥰 … || One of our best experiences in Lisbon. Thank you so much for lovely wine, cheese, bread, olive oil and service! Def coming back ❤️ || Thank you so much, Ida🖤🥂💫  Waiting for you back 😎 … || We had a wonderful time visiting Vagalume wine bar! The service was superb, Kátya's recommendations were second to none! The atmosphere was brilliant and the Portuguese wine selection was excellent!!! Whilst we didn't get to sample breakfast, I have no doubt from the quality of the wine and the smell of the morning's bread baking in the evening, that it is equally as good! I would highly recommend making the trip for a glass or 2 when visiting Lisbon! Thank you for the hospitality Kátya, it was lovely to meet you! 😊 || Thank you very much ✨🥂 … || A very nice wine bar with tables outside. Portuguese wines selection is updated every week. Provides also some snacks. The bar opens at 6pm in the premises of the daytime cafe Volta. I recommend || Obrigada, Andrey! Hope to see you again 🥂 Gonna bring some special wine for you anytime soon! …

All the dishes were amazing and I couldn’t get enough of the chorizo butter. Quick friendly service and superb wine. Not one to miss || WOW! Discovered this place almost by accident just up the street from where we were staying.  It's an amazing space. We sat upstairs outside and had the absolute best service all night long.  The wine recommendations were spot on. We wanted to eat everything on the menu. Everything we decided on was top notch and so delicious.  We started with the tempura green beans and the roasted carrots. Delicious! Then we moved on to the octopus stew and the braised pork cheek. Could not have been better! || Absolutely loved this place and will be recommending to everybody. I stumbled across it as I had struggled to make a last minute booking whilst waiting for a friend to arrive into Lisbon. From the start we were made to feel incredibly welcome, and Antonio was our waiter. In fact, he also was cooking all the dishes and owned the place, so the fact that service was beyond exceptional was mind-blowing. I had the pork belly on fried rice, and my friend had the octopus stew, both of which tasted incredible. Portion sizes were medium and filling, it’s the perfect spot prior to continuing your night elsewhere. We definitely didn’t leave feeling hungry! Above all of this, it was very reasonably priced, including drinks. I’ll be coming again when I return to Lisbon next. || Such a wonderful place, offering high-quality local wines and delicious food. I especially loved the Kimchi & Goat Cheese and the lemon cake - both were outstanding! I’ll definitely be coming back :) || We always find the best spots away from the main bar/dining areas and Caruma is by far one of the best so far,  service food wine ALL excellent, we will definitely return before we leave. There’s a hidden terrace out the back with a beautiful atmosphere we were greeted so warmly we felt right at home. There’s natural wine is amazing but be warned the hangover from to much is quite unique! || Great wine and even better food! Table of 5 had wine, small plates and dessert for a very reasonable price! All 5of us said they make the best chicken cutlet sandwich we’ve ever had (try not to overlook it!). Great mix of flavors in every bite of every dish. We were only in Lisbon for 9 days and we planned to go back for dinner again before we headed home. We couldn't try everything! When you go, make sure to pay sufficient attention to Gigi. || Delicious food and great service ❤️ also a good selection of wines. An absolute must in Lisbon! || Off the beaten track place with really good food and wine. Knowledgeable and friendly service. Kind of wish they had some music and more art on the walls (though there is a great historic poster from the Carnation Revolution). I would definitely go back || The food is fantastic. I highly recommend the octopus stew and the pica pau || We loved our dinner there. Delish small plates. The owner is vey passionate about the food and wine he chooses , and everything was great. Only 3 for atmosphere because it was very quiet but maybe it was because it was rainy. Would definitely recommend fora low key, delicious dinner.  Thank you || Beautiful restaurant with kind staff and excellent food and wine. I highly reccomend It. || I was fooled by all the random 5 star reviews. All the food is laced with paprika, EVERY SINGLE DISH. if you order 5 dishes from the menu, it all tastes the same... We couldn't finish even one dish, that never happened to me before. I was actually in shock. Left to find something edible nearby. Any lists that have Caruma on their must go to is VERY suspicious to me, virtually impossible to eat the food. || We stumbled across this place and were blown away by the dishes! We were a table of three and had 7 plates and every single one was 10/10. Already planning our return to try the remaining things off the menu. Service was great and the ambience on the terrace was lovely. Thank you for having us 😊 || We love coming here.  The food is excellent and well prepared.  We love the natural wines.  Very delicious.  Highly recommend. || This is a lovely local place with high quality food yet to be discovered by the big crowd. Enjoyed every bite, amazing wine and great service. It’s that hidden local spot you want to find in the creative Graça area ❤️ || AMAZING EXPERIENCE ! I have no words. The food was amazingly cooked, innovative and so tasty. I never put Google comments but this restaurant DESERVES one. || We stumbled upon this hidden treasure accidentally, and I'm delighted we did. The wine was excellent, the food even more so, and the hosting was delightful. I would definitely return on my next visit to Lisbon. || Lovely spot. Great waiter. Amazing food. Some of the best food I’ve ever had type of good. || Wandered in late night for dinner and they happily sat a group of 6. The food and wine were both delicious. The pork cheek with sweet potato and blueberry was the highlight. || Fascinating small selection of natural wines with original food. Charming service.

Me and my friend had a lovely time here! We asked for the cheese board and the squid with ink and I was pleasantly surprised when I found out it was a dish made out of tinned squid. The flavour profile was absolutely perfect and shows how creative you can get with tinned goods. Service was friendly and the offering is great. Great also for people wanting to just grab a bottle and a snack for dinner. Place is beautiful and looked like a neighbour favourite. I also overheard some of the wine reccs given to other customers and they were very knowledgeable. Congratulations for such a great space with a different take on Portuguese food. It’s great to see some tin fish appreciation done so beautifully! 🐟 Would definitely come back || We were looking for a shop were we could learn more about Portuguese wine and we were recommended this place by a local. It's an unusually-shaped building as it's at the apex of a narrow-angled intersection, and you step down into the main area from the sidewalk. It's casually appointed, with high tables and stools. We were greeted and invited to sit - we asked for details about the country's wines and our host was very knowledgeable and patient with our questions. We were able to try some excellent wines from different regions, and had tasty cheese and charcuterie boards as accompaniments. It was such a good experience and we came away with perhaps too many bottles to take back home... If you're interested in wine, especially from Portugal, this is the place to come! || Very cute local wine bar that is perfect for a first date, after work drink, or a place to read and have a glass solo x || As someone who speaks only English, I was super nervous coming into this wine bar. My worries were quickly erased as we were welcomed, had a great wine recommended to us, and had a lot of fun! Will come back everytime we are in Libson || I am a big fan of Casa Farta. They have a great selection of Portuguese wines, most of them are natural or bio-dynamic even if they are not always labelled as such. The owners are charming and knowledgeable about wines, food and local places to eat at. And they have a small selection of sandwiches and toasts. I personally like the pork cheek. || Graça’s newest gem awaits your visit. Beautifully minimalist surroundings welcome you to celebrate Portuguese wines (alongside a modest, yet perfectly paired plates menu). Wonderful selection of local products that will satisfy every pocket (so: range of wines and prices). We are happy to hear that you had a pleasant experience at our coworking space. We look forward to welcoming you back soon. || Absolutely Avoid Spaces Marquês de Pombal – Incompetence at Its Peak  If you’re considering Spaces Marquês de Pombal in Lisbon, do yourself a favor: run in the opposite direction. This location is an unmitigated disaster, and the core of the problem lies with their so-called "Community Manager," Olimpia Carregosa.  Let’s start with the basics. You’d expect a co-working space to prioritize professionalism, organization, and creating an environment conducive to work. Instead, you’re greeted with utter chaos and a level of incompetence that defies belief. Spaces boasts about being a premium co-working space, but this particular branch operates more like a dysfunctional community center.  Olimpia Carregosa – The Core Problem This woman is, without a doubt, the most unprofessional and unpleasant "manager" I’ve ever encountered. Her complete disregard for customer needs, lack of communication skills, and condescending attitude make her utterly unfit for her role.  Poor Communication: Emails go unanswered for days, if not weeks. When you do finally get a response, it’s as though she’s doing you a favor by acknowledging your existence. Forget about clarity or solutions; her replies are vague at best and dismissive at worst. Zero Accountability: Have an issue? Good luck. Instead of solving problems, Olimpia is a master of excuses. She’ll blame everyone but herself, never taking responsibility for the messes she creates. Rudeness: I have never encountered someone so hostile in a customer-facing role. She’s not just unhelpful; she actively makes you feel unwelcome. Her arrogance and patronizing demeanor are truly unmatched. The Facilities – A Joke Let’s not forget the space itself, which is falling apart under her "management."  The Wi-Fi is a joke. Expect constant disruptions, making it impossible to have a simple Zoom call. Cleanliness? Forget it. The bathrooms are often dirty, and common areas are poorly maintained. Overcrowded: Despite charging a premium, they cram as many people as possible into the space, with no regard for comfort or productivity. Overpriced for Mediocrity Spaces Marquês de Pombal charges an arm and a leg for what? A glorified coffee shop where nothing works? And don't even think about asking for help – Olimpia will find a way to make you regret ever trying.  Final Thoughts I’ve worked in co-working spaces around the world, and Spaces Marquês de Pombal stands out for all the wrong reasons. The toxic atmosphere, thanks to Olimpia Carregosa’s abysmal management, combined with subpar facilities, makes this place a total waste of money.  If you value your time, energy, and sanity, stay far away from this circus. Also a pleasant surprise came in the form of the possibility of climbing to the rooftop from where you can have a look around the area at a very budget friendly price. Just be sure to be away from the belltowers when the full set goes off at, for example, 11:50 on a Sunday morning. || Known for its beautiful dome and interior, the Basílica da Estrela is one of Lisbon's most impressive monuments. The Basílica da Estrela in Lisbon was the first church in the world dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, built by Queen Maria I, and houses her tomb. It is also known for its large dome that dominates the Lisbon skyline, a remarkable baroque nativity scene, and its impressive neoclassical architecture. || I like to recommend everyone to visit this place it’s very peaceful n nice food with handmade dumpling thank u || Very beautiful and peaceful interior to the church. The floor of the church is particularly stunning in its design. We paid the 5 euros each to go to the rooftop. It was pleasant but for us, not worth the price.  Much prefer the pantheon rooftop.  The climb via a narrow spiral staircase is quite steep with just enough room to pass people - it is fun to go up.
