place_name: Painel de Azulejos Bairro Estrella d'Ouro
reviews_content: Located in the heart of the Graça neighborhood, near Sapadores and the magnificent Senhora do Monte viewpoint where the chapel of S. Gens stands, it encompasses a vast area benefiting from a good location and easy access to the eastern part of Lisbon.  The five-pointed star is the trademark of the Estrela d’Ouro neighborhood, naturally one of the symbols of Galicia in allusion to Compostela, deriving from "field of stars". The star and grand tile panels identifying the neighborhood, the old Estrela d’Ouro cinema, the factory, and other social facilities are found almost everywhere.  Currently, this particular neighborhood is integrated into the urban space of Lisbon, forming part of its historical heritage and being classified as such. For the Galician community established in the capital, it constitutes one of the numerous points of reference that mark its very existence in a city that, after all, is also its city.  The Estrela D’Ouro neighborhood, whose construction dates back to the beginning of the 20th century, is one of the exemplary testimonies of the presence and entrepreneurial spirit of the Galician community in Lisbon. It is an old workers' village that Agapito Serra Fernandes, a confectioner, had built for his workers. He himself lived in the neighborhood with his family. || If you are lucky enough to actually have lunch here, you will not be disappointed.  Doesn't look like much from the outside but the food is incredible, authentic. || A beautiful example of 19th-century tilework, linked to the history of the Estrela D'Ouro neighborhood and the name of Agapito Serra Fernandes.

This is a stunning building. I did not find the tombs nearly as interesting as the building itself. Climbing the stairs (181 to get to the very top) was worth the effort. There are viewing balconies at each level and then you can go outside at the top and look over the city. There was an interesting display on the Mexican custom of Day of the Dead also, though I wasn’t quite sure why it was there. We had no wait to get in on a Wednesday morning. || American Traveler here. We stumbled upon this place as we were at a Saturday flea market. I thought the outside architecture was beautiful. I loved the curves and sharpness. Even on a Saturday the wait time was a little long. They only allowed a certain amount of people in at a time. The gift shop was closed at the time. Absolutely beautiful inside and if you go upstairs you have a great view of the city. A must see! || Lovely building. There are some runs of well known people. . The best views 360 degrees is you go up to around 200 steps. || Even though I have the utmost respect for this place, I cannot shake the feeling that there’s something wrong. It does honor important Portuguese figures who shouldered the foundations of the country and state next to a soccer player. Weren’t there more people to celebrate for their courage against state enemies? Artists that created lasting cultural shifts like fado (there's one)? The history of the place is where it hits home, and I recommend you read about it and visit it for its charm rather than for most of the resting souls it hosts. The terrace is also a thing, if you like stunning views of roofs and the port. || Beautiful! Heads up, if the weather is shitty you can’t go outside on the Terrence. So I would recommended buying tickets when you get there so you know if it is open or not. Still beautiful inside but same price. In November we had no line ups. || Definitely not the most interesting place in Lisbon. The rooftop area is decent, but there’s no particularly beautiful view. || This is a must see in Lisbon. Great views of the city and amazing architecture. Even if your not religious or interested in burial chambers, the views and inside of this building are beautiful. Student discount available and no waiting times || The building itself is magnificent, there are a lot of small rooms, old narrow stairs and tombs, a bit scary. But the rooftop has a great view over the Tagus river || With the Lisboa card, the entrance is free! Go straight up to the top and enjoy the view of the pantheon from the top and also view of Lisbon. || Though smaller than other national pantheons I’ve visited, Lisbon’s National Pantheon is exceptionally well-maintained and offers a distinct charm all its own. What stood out most was the integration of contemporary artistic collaborations, which breathe new life into the space without overshadowing its historical weight.  The structure itself is elegant and serene, and the modern touches serve as a powerful reminder of how history and memory continue to evolve. It’s a quiet, reflective place—less grandiose, but deeply intentional in its presentation.  A meaningful stop for those who appreciate heritage spaces that honour the past while embracing the present. || Honestly, we only went because we had the Lisboa Card, but we ended up having a great time and learning more about the Portugal. The architecture and the views are truly worth seeing. || Included in my lisboa card and well worth it! While not the largest space, it was still interesting and appreciated being able to read the summaries in english. My only complaint is the lack of signage for where to walk (perhaps this is due to only being english speaking) but I only found out I could reach the rooftop from realizing there were people looking down from higher levels. There was also a very small hidden art gallery on the way back down! The 360 degree view at the top makes the whole thing worth it honestly. || Used the lisboa card and came here for free, the ticket machine was easy to use and there was no queue at all! The inside of the pantheon was huge and going to the 4th floor you will see this amazing panoramic view of the city! || The tickets are quite affordable if you compare it with other historical places. The view is just wonderful, even if you don’t go to the terrace of the pantheon, which may take an extra payment. Hence it is located in Alfama, you can keep walking around to visit other touristic attractions in the neighborhood, after here. And it’s very close if you take the metro below. || Arrived 45 minutes before closing but still had enough time to enjoy our visit. Not a huge amount to see but what there is is worth going to, the architecture is cool and nice views from the top out towards the city. || It's on a hill like most places in Lisbon. A collection of graves and memorial coffins for some famous people including Vasco de Gamma who is buried at jeronimos monastery, not here. Maybe you can spend 45 minutes here. || A beautiful structure in the form of a pantheon.   It is now a museum and the place is awesome.   Interestingly enough that this pantheon allows visitors to climb all the way to the top.   One can go outside at the top to get views of Lisbon.   Overall, a must visit in Lisbon. || The National Pantheon in Lisbon is an impressive and beautiful landmark that is well worth visiting. The architecture is grand and elegant, with stunning details inside and out. Climbing to the upper level rewards you with breathtaking panoramic views over the city and the river. The atmosphere inside feels calm and respectful, making it a meaningful place to explore both for its history and its beauty. A must-see spot when discovering Lisbon. || Very beautiful and historical place in Lisbon. Although walking is quite challenging due to steep streets yet it is a must visit place for visitors. You can have a few very scenic view points where you can take a few snaps for your memory. || 🏛️ Where Silence Meets Grandeur — A Monument to Portugal’s Soul ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)  If you're in Lisbon and even remotely interested in architecture, history, or panoramic views — don’t skip the Panteão Nacional (also known as Santa Engrácia Church). It’s far more than just another old building.  Originally designed as a church in the 17th century, this structure took nearly 300 years to complete — and today it serves as Portugal’s National Pantheon, honoring the country’s most iconic figures. It’s where Amália Rodrigues, the queen of Fado, rests — alongside presidents, writers, explorers, and cultural legends.  Inside, the atmosphere is calm and solemn, with towering white marble columns, symmetrical floor patterns, and an incredible sense of scale. The central dome rises above you like a marble sky, and every step echoes — adding to the spiritual stillness of the space.  One of the best parts? You can walk all the way up to the rooftop terrace, which gives you a 360-degree view over Lisbon’s Alfama district and the shimmering Tagus River. The view alone is worth the small entry fee.  Quick Ratings: Historical Significance: 10/10 Interior Architecture: 9.5/10 Rooftop View: 10/10 Atmosphere & Serenity: 9/10 Photo Opportunities: 9.5/10  Tip: Go earlier in the day to avoid crowds, and take your time — this place isn’t meant to be rushed.  📝 If this review helped or inspired your visit, a quick 👍 would be appreciated!  I share real cultural stops across Europe — feel free to explore my other reviews.

We enjoyed this part of Lisbon very much (together with Baixa, hard to see where one ends and the other one starts anyways).  There are several streets which are enjoyable. From some angles you also can get nice views of the Castelo, especially at night a colorful sight! || Very rural area with lots to do! || Great area to stay if you are visiting Lisbon.. || Historical experience. The mild temperature invited serene walks under antique lampposts, in a clean, well-structured, and safe neighborhood, where centuries of history can be felt on every corner. Illuminated centuries-old facades created a stage of warm colors against the cloudy sky, with slender trees and tranquil squares conveying peace and eternity, pulsating with a natural harmony between soft shadows and golden glints that preserve the essence of Lisbon despite modern times. place_name: Equestrian Statue of King José I
reviews_content: The Equestrian Statue of King José I at Praça do Comércio is one of the most beautiful historical landmarks in Lisbon. The location is exceptional and reflects the greatness of Portuguese history, with a very pleasant atmosphere—especially at sunset.  The surrounding area is full of excellent restaurants, cafés, coffee shops, and a variety of stores, making it a perfect spot for walking around, relaxing, and enjoying food and coffee after a great sightseeing experience.  A must-visit for anyone coming to Lisbon 👌 || The equestrian statue of King José I is an impressive centerpiece of Praça do Comércio. The scale and detail of the monument stand out beautifully against the open square and the riverfront backdrop. It adds a strong historical presence to the area and is a natural focal point for photos and orientation.  While it’s a monument you mostly appreciate from the outside, it’s an essential part of the square’s character and worth a moment’s pause when exploring Lisbon’s historic center. || This is a great statue of King Jose I, created I believe in 1775, on a horse facing the river. All depicting a very symbol of power. We walked all around the central part of Lisbon and enjoyed this plaza the most. A must see if you visit the plaza but please note that tourists are everywhere. || One of an iconic landmark in Lisbon downtown. The statue of King José I Portugal is located in the middle of Praca Comércio Lisbon and overlooking the ocean. The plaza is always full of visitors. You can visit this statue for free. || The statue is impressive and rich in detail, perfectly framed by the grand architecture and the sparkling Tagus River in the background. It’s a perfect spot for photos and to appreciate the historical importance of this area and the square || Nice statue followed after the Bilheteira Arco da Augusta which is the main attraction in the area. But if you’re are there I definitely recommend checking it out. Notice: it gets pretty hot around there || This is a statue of King Jose I/King Joseph I of Portugal. He was the monarch on the throne at the time of the 1755 Lisbon earthquake. The king stands on a pedestal. His horse is stomping on snakes. It was built in 1755.  Tourists pass by as they come to the Praça. The architecture around is outstanding.  Follow here and the IG link in profile for more travel and food and drink tips, ideas and reviews! || The statue symbolizes Lisbon’s rebirth following the devastating 1755 earthquake. Unveiled in 1775 to commemorate King José I’s 61st birthday, it was the first equestrian statue installed in a public space in Portugal. Created by Joaquim Machado de Castro, it was cast in a single piece of bronze—an unprecedented achievement in the country at the time. To accomplish this, Machado de Castro founded the Casa da Escultura das Obras Públicas (Public Works Sculpture Workshop) in collaboration with artisans from Mafra. The statue portrays King José I in full armor, holding a scepter, and riding a horse trampling a serpent—a powerful symbol of the monarch’s authority to overcome evil and restore order. || Located in the center of the Comercio Square. After reaching this statue, you can go either left or right to visit the other historical spots of Lisboa given that this is the center. || Big public square with the famous arc and statue in the middle.  On good weather it is quite nice. You can sit by the water.  There are some man offering different types of drugs.  Hmm not good. And other vendors around.  All by all a must see during your vacation.

The square commemorates Portugal’s victory in the Restoration War (1640–1668), which ended 60 years of Spanish rule. At its center stands the Monumento aos Restauradores—a striking 30-meter-tall obelisk built in 1886 that honors those who fought for the nation’s independence. The square’s pavement features traditional calçada portuguesa patterns, adding to its distinctly Portuguese character and historical atmosphere. || This is a large open area in the heart of Lisbon. The area is actually in the shape of a boat Hull and the tile pattern gives the illusion of waves!  One end is dominated by a large obelisk that was built in 1886 and is dedicated to Portugal breaking free from Spanish control.  At the other end is a lovely fountain.  It is surrounded by shops and a hotel. It is also close to Rossio train station || Lovely historical square. I loved the floor which symbolised sea waves. It’s also the place where all guides meet their groups normally so lots of people in there all the time. || It is a square with a nice monument, surrounded by traffic. Not a place I'd sit down to enjoy, ok to have viewed in passing. || This busy beautiful square is a broad tree-lined section of the Avenida da Liberdade. It is adjacent to the Rossio train station.  Restauradores means restorers and commemorates the 1640 uprising against the Spanish.  It is surrounded by very nice restaurants and shops. || Loved this square, very scenic and decorated for the holidays. Loved how the metro and parking were underneath, such great planning! || Another beautiful parkade with a lovely cobblestone pattern.  The obelisk in the center is majestic. || A wide square with an imposing obelisk on heart of Lisbon. || Historical place with many restaurants and public transportation including Metro, buses, etc. Went to Bomjardim for dinner, excellent Portuguese food, including wonderful Piri Piri Chicken. Open 7 days/week, expect a waiting line, or call ahead. || A stunning area that isn't too busy. Keep in mind that there are some pictures showing the arch, which is about an eleven minute walk from here

Lovely architecture. Visited just before Christmas hence the tree. This is the location of Portugals oldest ( continuously open) restaurant. Great service and food at good prices. Definitely worth a stop; even if just for a coffee outdoors || On our last visit to Lisbon, we spent several days touring around the city center including the area around this grand arch and the plaza. Very busy area for the tourists as photo ops in every direction.  Grand beautiful arch and gorgeous buildings all around.  Several restaurants open on the plaza. Maybe the most picturesque spot in Lisbon. || According da Rua Augusta is definitely worth a visit -you can pay a small entrance fee and go up to the top. Once your up there you have a panoramic view of the city of Lisbon. Its a great spot for photos/videos and gives you a birds eye perspective of the city - the praca comercio, tagus river and rooftops of downtown Lisbon. || This magnificent triumphal arch leads you from the city center to the banks of the Tagus River, via the famous Praça do Comércio (Commerce Square). At its summit are sculptures by Célestin Anatole Calmels, a French sculptor who spent much of his life in Portugal, representing Glory and crowning Genius and Valor. Those below, by Vítor Bastos, depict some of the country's most important historical figures: Nuno Álvares Pereira, Viriate, Vasco da Gama, and the Marquis of Pombal. To the left is the Tagus River, and to the right, the Douro River.  These two rivers marked the boundary of the region inhabited by the Lusitanians, and the inscription at the top of the arch refers to the Portuguese colonial empire and the discovery of new peoples and cultures :  “VIRTVTIBVS MAIORVM VT SIT OMNIBVS DOCVMENTO.PPD”, meaning : “The virtues of our elders, to serve as a lesson for all. (Dedication at public spending)”. || It’s a beautiful structure, but it is surrounded by touts selling things you don’t need. It is also a visible human reminder of the economic and housing crisis that exists in this country. || Stunning architecture, well worth taking the time to come and see it. When coming to Lisbon is well worth making sure you include a vist here on your list. It does get very busy, but the street is wide with lots of room so you dont end up bumping into people. I also found it easy to stop and take pictures with out getting in anyone's way, or anyone getting in my way. If you're coming here on a sunny day, make sure you have you're sunglasses. I forgot mine and found it to be extremely bright! || The Rua Augusta Arch is a stone, memorial arch-like, historical building and visitor attraction in Lisbon, Portugal, on the Praça do Comércio. It was built to commemorate the city's reconstruction after the 1755 earthquake. You can take the elevator above the arch for splendid city views || A stunning piece of architecture which is an iconic site to visit when exploring Lisbon. The top of this arch is filled with stunning sculptures and there are so many details you can discover. || The Arco da Rua Augusta is one of Lisbon’s most iconic monuments. reviews_content: Leo is the man to do the Pub Crawl in Lisbon with. It was so much fun. Super cool group, stack cup game, dance, karaoke and drinks. Vibes were amazing especially Daniel best guide ever he made the whole trip worth it. If you wanna have the best time of your life in Lisbon come to the Lisbon pub crawl || This had potential and was fun but some changes need to take place. The value for money is good as there are free shots and an open bar for an hour. However the games promised only took place in the form of one drinking rule (drinking with your left hand) rather than any ice breakers. Also our group was very big, so much so that we had lots of guides, i think there should’ve either been a cap on guests or split us up into smaller groups, as the large group made it difficult to meet people and a lot of the bars were too small to accommodate that number. this also meant that a lot of us spent most of our night outside on the street as it was too crammed in each bar. Otherwise it was good value for money but wouldn’t have wanted to go as a solo traveller as the group was far too large || Hello Lizzie!  Thank you for your feedback!   We're glad to hear that you found the pub crawl to be good value for money and enjoyed the free shots and open bar. We appreciate your suggestions and take them seriously. We're always looking to improve our events, and your comments about the group size and the games are very helpful. We'll work on implementing more interactive games and consider ways to manage group sizes better to enhance the experience. We hope you'll join us again and see the improvements firsthand!  Regards, The Lisbon PubCrawl Team. || This type of thing is very hit and miss, depends heavily on the people and vibe. The bars seemed to be pretty empty and reserved for the tour group so always the same people around which was eh. The final club seemed like a decent place and had better music, but the guards were a little rude to us despite being quite sober, and it was still pretty empty/almost all the same tour people. Overall not a great vibe. You get some shots and an open bar of beer and sangria but the free shots are light juice liquor shots and the 1 hour free sangria was quite watered down so did not really have an effect. I've done other pub cralws in other cities which were definitely a better experience but this was just okay. Best if you're with a sizable group of people that you know and want to try different places without having to choose. || Its really nice experience u have to try it if u will come to lisbon || Pretty poor for the cost. Thank you and we look forward to seeing you again in the near future! || The pub crawl experience was pleasant until we arrived at the final destination. "Included" in the package was entrance to a nightclub. Once we arrived, about half of the group was let in by the bouncers. I was handed my ticket to enter and told to pass by the bouncer until he heard me speaking English, then snatched the entrance card from my hand, and told me to wait outside the gate. The rest of the group behind me (6 or 7 people, men and women) were also told to wait. We politely asked the bouncer if there was a problem, he turned his back and completely ignored us, zero explanation given. A few minutes passed and the pub crawl guides came to enter the bar. We asked if they could get an explanation from the bouncer as to why we weren't let in, and they told us "It's their decision." The tour guides proceeded to abandon us and entered the bar, leaving a group of foreign tourists separated now from their friends who were among the first to enter the bar. We were alone in the street at 3 in the morning. Unprofessional is an understatement as we were left in a dangerous situation.  The area was deserted and poorly lit. I was separated from the only other person i knew in the group and forced to find a taxi several blocks away with help from some very friendly locals. I have never in my life been treated so rudely by any bar staff, and shocked that a pub crawl organized for tourists would take us to a place where we were clearly not welcome. On top of this, we were then completed left alone by the pub crawl staff in an unfamiliar area far from any transportation options. These were the people that were supposed to be looking out for us. If this pub crawl is allowed to continue functioning like this, someone will be robbed, hurt, or worse. This was by far the worst experience I have ever had traveling in any country. This pub crawl should be ashamed of how they treated us and should not be allowed to handle any tourists as clearly they had zero regard for our safety. We did not enjoy the music at all. The DJ didn’t interact with the crowd, couldn’t read the room at all, and the worst part: they completely missed the midnight countdown. In short, we were definitely not impressed and wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for a well-organized and pleasant New Year’s Eve celebration. || Our first visit - IT DEFINITELY WON’T BE OUR LAST - AMBIANCE ABOUNDS- wonderful sound system Fantastic DJs - Perfect music mixing (predominately 80s music) Professional reception at the entrance. Drinks, service, general hospitality all excellent & prices very reasonable, especially when taking into consideration they are open until about 06:00!! WEDNESDAY NIGHT IS LADIES NIGHT - My wife LOVED it! || Thank you so much for your feedback 🙏 See you soon and best wishes to you both 💙 … || Lisbon's oldest club is still a true gem. The music is exceptional, blending different genres of the classics. The atmosphere combines historical charm with a lively vibe. Service is impeccable, with warm and attentive staff. A must-visit for a perfect night out. || Nice place to dance. It takes time to get used to Lisabon's DJs but after that it goes smoothly. || It was good but the DJ wouldn’t play Duran Duran for me :( || The place is nice but the dj is super crap with that royal level garbage he calls music 🤮 || Was recommended this place by the young man working the front desk at the hostel I was staying at when I asked where I could go dancing. I had so much fun and I don't even like 80's music. Diverse crowd age-wise with most in their mid 20's and 30's when I went. Everyone seems to be there to dance and sing. I was fine going there by myself and totally danced the night away. In general, good vibes with a nice open dance floor. What staff I interacted with was friendly. There's a cover charge but that also gives you a free drink or two depending on what you order. Also, they offer coat check for a nominal fee. I got there a little after 12:30. By 12:45 it was pretty packed. When I left around 4:30, there was still a line outside. || Good atmosphere, great music. 🤗 || Coming from London, beware, as a male you’ll be required to pay in CASH around 20 euros. If you want to partake in the local tax evasion, sure. If you’re a woman, you’ll get in without paying a fee. || Nice place, we visited past midnight. Had a lot of fun. You can store your coats in the wardrobe. Bouncer at the door.

place_name: The Lisbon Pub Crawl- Discover Lisbon
reviews_content: Leo is the man to do the Pub Crawl in Lisbon with. It was so much fun. Super cool group, stack cup game, dance, karaoke and drinks. Everything was awesome. || Joined the pub crawl twice whilst I was in Lisbon. The MOST fun, such a great way to meet people as I was travelling alone. Leo, Nicholas & Phelps were the BEST 🩷🩷🩷 || Met some cool people I wouldn’t have otherwise. VIP access at the bars. Good times waiting to happen.. Cheers🍻 || First pub crawl experience and definitely a very good one! The bars they brought us to were very nice, good music and space wasn’t a problem since the night was warm so some of us stayed outside. The alcohol included is nice, you get shots and an open bar. I don’t think you can get wasted but a bit tipsy maybe! The guides of the tour, especially Ana and Victoria especially, are nice and organised! I highly recommend 🤘🏻 || Hi Estelle, Thank you very much for  leaving such an amazing review. Lovely that you enjoyed our experiences. We look forward to seeing you again in the near future and party like we never did before.  Best regards, Discover Lisbon team || We had an amazing time with our tour guide Thomas!!! The free shots were trash though from the bars they tasted like juice! It overall was a fantastic time. Highly recommend :) || Phelps he is the best guy ever he is so friendly and funny I think I will try it just because of this. They are friendly and they know how to have fun they are the best || Lovely guide called tiago kept the group together and energetic. Definitely a recommendation. Lots of people and good communication and friendliness! || this was so fun and so safe and all tour guides were amazing!! had fun with us and made sure everyone was having a good time and accounted for. Anna T specifically was amazing and does deserve a raise! please do go on Portugal pub crawl || The pubcrawl was really nice  will sure we will recommend my friends, our tour guide MANNUUUUUU did a great job || Ton was such an amazing guide would definitely recommend if in Portugal for the night. || Best experience ever. Vibes were amazing especially Daniel best guide ever he made the whole trip worth it. If you wanna have the best time of your life in Lisbon come to the Lisbon pub crawl || This had potential and was fun but some changes need to take place. The value for money is good as there are free shots and an open bar for an hour. However the games promised only took place in the form of one drinking rule (drinking with your left hand) rather than any ice breakers. Also our group was very big, so much so that we had lots of guides, i think there should’ve either been a cap on guests or split us up into smaller groups, as the large group made it difficult to meet people and a lot of the bars were too small to accommodate that number. this also meant that a lot of us spent most of our night outside on the street as it was too crammed in each bar. Otherwise it was good value for money but wouldn’t have wanted to go as a solo traveller as the group was far too large || Hello Lizzie!  Thank you for your feedback!   We're glad to hear that you found the pub crawl to be good value for money and enjoyed the free shots and open bar. We appreciate your suggestions and take them seriously. We're always looking to improve our events, and your comments about the group size and the games are very helpful. We'll work on implementing more interactive games and consider ways to manage group sizes better to enhance the experience. We hope you'll join us again and see the improvements firsthand!  Regards, The Lisbon PubCrawl Team. || This type of thing is very hit and miss, depends heavily on the people and vibe. The bars seemed to be pretty empty and reserved for the tour group so always the same people around which was eh. The final club seemed like a decent place and had better music, but the guards were a little rude to us despite being quite sober, and it was still pretty empty/almost all the same tour people. Overall not a great vibe. You get some shots and an open bar of beer and sangria but the free shots are light juice liquor shots and the 1 hour free sangria was quite watered down so did not really have an effect. I've done other pub cralws in other cities which were definitely a better experience but this was just okay. Best if you're with a sizable group of people that you know and want to try different places without having to choose. || Its really nice experience u have to try it if u will come to lisbon || Pretty poor for the cost. Taken to some small empty bars with higher than normal drink prices. You had to buy a drink to get your free shots. The free bar we went to had a huge queue and served in tiny cups so you just got your drink and stood back in the queue for the next one. Obviously done to limit how much people can drink.  You would be better off wandering down Pink Street on your own. Overall did not feel valuable for money. || Good Opportunity to meet people but in total we experienced way better pub crawls. The three bars are really not worth it, only setup, for crawls. Just the last club was reasonable. Guides were concentrated on their own partying than creating a cool experience for guests. Would recommend to spend the 20 to 40€ in own drinks and deciding on your own where to go. || Thank you for your message and for taking your time to give us feedback. We are deeply sorry to hear your experience was not satisfactory for you.  We will pass this feedback to the team so this engagement between the team pass to the guest and you also can enjoy the Pubcrawl the same way we do.  We take your comment to heart and will provide better guidance in the future.  Best regars, Discover Lisbon Team. || Rosa was amazing. It was her first time being a pub crawl host. And she did a great job 😍 || Had an absolute blast on the Lisbon Pub Crawl, was well organized and the bars we went to were a good time. A special shoutout to our guide Gabriel for leading our group and making sure everyone had a great time! || Fantastic Experience! Our guide Tomas was so much fun, he really went above and beyond to make sure everyone had a blast! Highly recommend doing this if you're in Lisbon! || Dear William Turner, thanks for leaving us such a wonderful review. We are thrilled that you loved your experience; our staff will definitely be happy to know about your comment. Discover Lisbon works very hard to reach the highest level of customer satisfaction, so your review is a confirmation that we are on the right track.  Thank you and we look forward to seeing you again in the near future! || Great experience for a random Monday. I’m so glad I decided to book the pub crawl with them. Met some of the cool folks and we were taken to some pretty great spots with awesome music. Keep up the great work you guys. Definitely recommend them! || Dear Kat, thanks for leaving us such a wonderful review. We are thrilled that you loved your experience; our staff will definitely be happy to know about your comment. Discover Lisbon works very hard to reach the highest level of customer satisfaction, so your review is a confirmation that we are on the right track.  Thank you and we look forward to seeing you again in the near future! || The pub crawl experience was pleasant until we arrived at the final destination. "Included" in the package was entrance to a nightclub. Once we arrived, about half of the group was let in by the bouncers. I was handed my ticket to enter and told to pass by the bouncer until he heard me speaking English, then snatched the entrance card from my hand, and told me to wait outside the gate. The rest of the group behind me (6 or 7 people, men and women) were also told to wait. We politely asked the bouncer if there was a problem, he turned his back and completely ignored us, zero explanation given. A few minutes passed and the pub crawl guides came to enter the bar. We asked if they could get an explanation from the bouncer as to why we weren't let in, and they told us "It's their decision." The tour guides proceeded to abandon us and entered the bar, leaving a group of foreign tourists separated now from their friends who were among the first to enter the bar. We were alone in the street at 3 in the morning. Unprofessional is an understatement as we were left in a dangerous situation.  The area was deserted and poorly lit. I was separated from the only other person i knew in the group and forced to find a taxi several blocks away with help from some very friendly locals. I have never in my life been treated so rudely by any bar staff, and shocked that a pub crawl organized for tourists would take us to a place where we were clearly not welcome. On top of this, we were then completed left alone by the pub crawl staff in an unfamiliar area far from any transportation options. These were the people that were supposed to be looking out for us. If this pub crawl is allowed to continue functioning like this, someone will be robbed, hurt, or worse. This was by far the worst experience I have ever had traveling in any country. This pub crawl should be ashamed of how they treated us and should not be allowed to handle any tourists as clearly they had zero regard for our safety. An embarrassment and a dark spot in an otherwise lovely country. || Great experience:) Daniela was outstanding as a guide. So were Livia, Natalia, Miguel, Goy and Anna. This was my first pub crawl in Lisbon - but definitely not the last one 😇 || Well, the crawl is just okay. The pubs we were taken to were definitely not the best or anyhow unique. In two of them it was just a shot, so take that into account in case you don't like standing for an hour without a drink. In one place there was open bar for an hour, that was nice. Did not stay for the club, so no opinion on this. There was pretty much zero interaction from the guides apart taking the group from place to place. Therefore, amount of fun you'll get pretty much depends on other participants. Passable experience if you are bored, but probably not too hard to find better alternatives. || STAY AWAY from this pub crawl , such a tourist trap ,very bad bars they took us only to the empty bars  ,,I paid for the pubcrawl 20€ (very expensive ) and the tour guide wanted to charge another extra 10€ because I don’t drink beer ,…by the way the worst part are the tour guides that they don’t care about you   and the people they picked up …..plus I got picked up very late from my hostel by The tour guide  to get to the first bar when they are leaving to next bar already ,and I ended up leaving doing just one bar ! I asked the refund and they made fun of me ….!and they refused to refund me ! the 2nd day I did the pubcrawl  with other company and was great ,and the tour guides were absolutely fantastic and they charge you just 15€. || Nice Pub Crawl, Pablo, Tomas and Tomas are great guides, 3 pubs, 1 club, one with unlimited beer. || Dear Ricardo Gonzalez - Rubio, thanks for leaving us such a wonderful review. We are thrilled that you loved your experience; our staff will definitely be happy to know about your comment. Discover Lisbon works very hard to reach the highest level of customer satisfaction, so your review is a confirmation that we are on the right track.  Thank you and we look forward to seeing you again in the near future! || Eduarda is the best host that there is for a Pubcrawl, she knows a lot about local culture and she is incredibly sweet and forthcoming with all of the suggestion about Lisbon. I would recommend this Pubcrawl on any day of the week, you would absolutely love this experience. Worth every penny that you are gonna spend on this. I would recommend this to anyone who is in Lisbon. You would miss out a lot if you don’t do this. || Everyone coming to Lisboa should do a pub crawl, we had so much fun and met lots of other travelers! The guides (Tomas, William, Anna and Luisa) were so nice and fun, they always made sure that we were okay! I would recommend a 100% Obrigada Tomas || Thank you very much for leaving us such a wonderful review. We are glad to hear that it was a good experience exploring Lisbon with our guides. We hope to see you again in Lisbon and help you discover this beautiful city again. Best regards, Discover Lisbon. || Even though I was going alone, I certainly was not because the crowd was awesome. Company employees went an extra mile to ensure everyone was having fun and Maria-Julia Lima was a huge part of that with her spirit. Funny, easy going and good dancer.  Also, it's very affordable tour since you visit many bars, including a club and a bar with one hour unlimited drinking.  I would recommend it to anyone. || Terrible expensive and not what you would expect. The courtesy shot, was not courtesy you had to buy a drink at the bar to get it. The worst part it's that the shot was juice with "vodka".  The courtesy shot they claimed to have was actually a guy pouring you juice with "vodka"from a bottle.  I would never recommend this experience to any one.  Bad service. || Thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. Our aim is to provide a fun and enjoyable time for all participants, and we regret that this was not reflected during your visit. :) We appreciate your comments and will continue to work on providing the best possible experience for our guests. If you would like to discuss this further, please reach out to us directly via email: info@discoverlisbon.org  Regards, The Lisbon PubCrawl Team. || Soooooooo fun. Rosa was an amazing guide. Prepare to meet a lot of people and have a lot of fun!

The music at this place is very good, and that’s what initially attracted us. Unfortunately, the experience was disappointing because of the way the drinks were handled.  At the entrance, we paid 20€ for two drinks, which were supposed to be included. However, when we ordered the second drink, we were asked to pay an extra 5€, with the explanation that the credit from the first drink had already been used and there was supposedly no balance left.  This was confusing and felt unfair, especially since the two drinks were clearly advertised as included. As tourists, we couldn’t help but feel taken advantage of. This is not how visitors should be treated, and it really ruined what could have been a great night with good music. || Hello, sorry to hear you fell deceived, i dont know what happened, but let me just give some informations, when you pay 20 euros at the entrance, you receive 20 euros in credit, normally its possible to have two drinks, since most drinks are 10 euros or less, but there are some, like with vodka with redbull or moscow mule , that are more expensive.  Our clients experience is very important for us, locals and tourists. || I had a great time. But the Dj wouldn’t play any music I requested.  I don’t mind that, but what they were playing made the crowd die out. I came with a hostel group and they all wanted the music I requested from a previous bar. But they kept saying they would and never did. I understand I’m in a different country, but I would think they wanna keep a lively crowd.  Not fully happy with it, but I see potential. || I was there yesterday, and the staff lied to us many times, saying they were going to open the other dance room at 2 am. After 2–3 am., we went to ask again if they were going to open it. They shut the door in our faces and screamed at us when we asked respectfully between songs so we could hear each other. They told us to leave and re-enter from the other side, which would have meant paying another €20, just one hour after we arrived. The staff was extremely rude, even though we tried to remain polite while speaking to them. Thieves. || Terrible against turists. The security wasn’t disrespectful but they denied entry just cuz we didn’t had tickets. Im sure even if we had tickets they would have said something about clothes or anything to not let us in just cuz we were not Portugies or whatever shit they call them selves. Most of Lisbon clubs were just like this one. Same as Lust in Rio. They said we had to buy tickets and make reservations before 22:00 clock but i read on their website day after that we can enter without tickets. And pay 20€ each. But the security told us it wasn’t possible. Not just this club but the whole Lisbon is just a big no, specially clubs. But in Lisbon they hate turists for some shity reasons. I have been in other small cities and they are very welcoming and also very respectful. || The Drinks are okay. The Service is okay. The Club is way too Full and crowded. They charge 20€ for entry and one Drink is 10€. They have different floors for different genres but it’s all the same music. Very commercial very Mainstream. Partially unfriendly Service. Location overrated. Too much tourists. Would Not recommend. || If i could I would give it 0 stars. We went there yesterday for Halloween, extremely complicated to get in even though we had Tickets. Had to pay 30€!! extra (per person) because apparently our tickets weren’t correct. They couldn’t tell us why their website had not charged us the correct price from the start. (At that the bouncers were extremely irritated and aggressive to the point where we felt really uncomfortable. We were very understanding but wanted to understand the extra 30€, as we had already paid a lot) Music is always subjective but for us the best way to describe it is kids club. Early 2000s songs with terrible djs. Overall chaotic, overly expensive drinks and not a good time. || We arrived there and immediately were refused at the main entrance, so a guy that works there came to see us, and told us to go by the other entrance, which normally opens to the main dance floor after 1-2 hours, that same guy told us it was going to open (not only him), but it never opened. We were away from our other friends and the music was so bad (not just my opinion), and every minute it became louder we couldn’t even talk. Several friends of mine were disrespected by a security (physically and verbally), just because they asked to go to the other side. Apart from that situation there was people smoking all kinds of things in there, which was horrible was the ambiance. A little bottle of water cost 4€, which is almost 30% of what I paid for the entry . The door in the toilet doesn’t even close. At the entrance the payment devices don’t work. They just want to make money and don’t care about what happens in their dance floors. They are racist and very disrespectful, so search for other places to go at night because you have high chances of having a bad night in there. || I visited the venue tonight and had an unsatisfactory experience. I arrived at the entrance and was stopped by security, and I still don’t understand how things were handled. Honestly, I felt disrespected, and I don’t say that lightly.  I’ve traveled around the world and visited many clubs, and I’ve never encountered this kind of treatment. I came expecting a good time, especially after seeing your Instagram story saying tickets/entrance would be available at the door.  Unfortunately, it wasn’t clear how the process worked, which left me feeling confused and unwelcome. I truly hope this feedback helps improve communication and the overall experience for future visitors.  Thank you for taking the time to read this. || The light is very good but the music wasn’t good and the price is way too high for the experience. And at the door they tell you 2 or 3 free drinks. But at the bar you only get one free drink. The price for women is 20€ for men 30€ || They charge women 20 euros, white men 30 euros, and black men 250 euros for entry. They don’t want black people in their club but have no problem playing black music. I would never come back here after seeing how they treat people of colour. || Great place to eat and then the doors open to the nite club. Spacious and has a great back yard to the river. This club is one to visit in Lisbon and since it’s big they let you in with some time slightly more expensive door entry. 🥳 || This place is so not worth it. Despite being part of a pub crawl, I wasn’t allowed entry along with another black person. After sometime, I was eventually allowed in. The process to check a coat was ridiculous and the workers weren’t friendly. Some of the security guards gave my friends a hard time and charged them €250 when everyone else had to pay €20. When I went to go help them out, the guard wouldn’t let me back in despite being with a group that was allowed entry already. Someone earlier that night had warned about this place and they were right. Just look at the reviews. DO NOT come to this place. || One of the best club in Lisbon for sure. I went there with some friends and we really enjoyed it. The music was just perfect, if you like 2000s hits and hip hop I highly recommend this club. The drinks are not that good || I’ve been here years ago and when I came back this year (Summer 2024), I told my friends that they gotta experience this “beach clubbing” in Portugal. So we went! My friends and I had an amazing time esp since we got in quite fast and started drinking right away!  When we weren’t drinking, we were just dancing since music was pretty good! Drinks were on the weaker side but it did its job and we were quite satisfied (and spirited) by 4 AM. Club closes at 7 but we were gone at that point.  One cool thing they do is having customer prepay a card so you gotta have a good estimate of how much you’re gonna drink. Initially, the lady suggested 25💶 for us girls but we’re heavy drinkers so we got 50💶 and it was more than enough!  We went back and forth between the inside dance floor and the patio where the pool is. Both areas were lit last night. :)  I highly recommend that you visit this spot! || Went to K Urban with a group of friends. A larger group I was with where all let in earlier we followed behind in a separate uber when we arrived we were told 20 for girls 30 for boys. Our friend was denied entry for wearing sports shorts. We left our friend and returned to the que 10 minutes later when we got to the front we were told 250 per person, when we asked why this changed just 10 minutes later they kept repeating if you don’t want to pay leave the Que. we tried to questions why they wouldn’t give a reason we asked dress code they said no. Others would come and be charged 30. My friend who is Asian asked if it was a race thing the bouncers didn’t even deny it by saying Yes and that Portugal was a free country, they could do what they like. Completely openly racist establisment. DISGUSTING. || A super great night club. A bit expensive : 30€ for men and 20€ for girls but you can spend this money in the club. It seems that it is not very selective. The atmosphere is super, great pool and infrastructure, great sound. And the cherry on the cake is the free popcorn ! || Absolutely terrible experience. We had tickets, but the staff refused to let us in. We stood outside in line for over two hours with no explanation or organization at all. The security and management were rude and unhelpful. Total scam… don’t waste your time or money on this place. || Maybe the music is ok, but the staff? Oh god, I’ve never seen such a horrible behavior, I wanted to throw up when I saw lady at the entrance how arrogant she was or when the bartender throw away our card to us 🥲 do not recommend! … || Absolutely terrible experience at Urban Beach Club in Lisbon. We were two groups of friends — three of us arrived first, all wearing shirts and long pants — only to be denied entry because our outfits were supposedly not “casual chic.” Minutes later, we saw them letting in plenty of people wearing shorts and t-shirts.  Then, when the rest of our friends arrived (also in shirts and long pants), they were allowed in without any problem. I had even already bought my entry ticket in advance. When I asked the security guard what exactly was wrong with our outfits, he wouldn’t answer, wouldn’t even look me in the eye. Eventually, all he said was, “Look at your friends’ outfits and understand” — which made zero sense since we were dressed exactly the same.  I also tried contacting them directly — they replied within seconds at first, but the moment I mentioned that we weren’t allowed in, they stopped responding completely.  The whole thing felt arbitrary, unprofessional, and borderline discriminatory. If you value fair treatment and basic respect, avoid this place. || Great club, cool atmosphere and affordable prices. However, the dj could do way better (not a single good transition, 3 times the same drop...) and the guy controlling the lights is very rude ☹️ || My friends and I recently visited Urban Beach and were initially impressed by the atmosphere. We decided to get a table and ordered bottle service to enjoy our night.  The turning point was when our nearly full bottles were taken away by the waiters who insisted they were empty and that the club closes soon (it didn’t).  This experience left us feeling deceived and undervalued as customers. It's disappointing that such a promising venue failed to deliver on basic hospitality standards. || Horrible service. They do not allow you in if you have a turban even if it’s for religious reasons. Honestly so dumb. They dont deserve your service. They also had the security scanners so they could’ve used that but did not want to. || An old shabby place, with mediocre food, and a wooden floor full of wide gaps where heels get stuck || Me and my family came here after my sister’s wedding and because one person in my family was wearing crocs wasn’t allowed in and wanted to ask a question, the security guards punched my sisters and hit my family and when we called the police nothing was done. Truly horrible place, no respect for anyone and they are racist towards indian saying they wanted us to pay £120 for us to be in the club. Very sad world we live in :( Forever traumatised. || Well, quite a nice club with spectacular view, swimming pool and three main dancing areas. Music is Okayish, usually remixes of the popular ones. P.S. You must pay 20€ for enter, 18 stays in plastic card for buying drinks and 2 is entry fee. || Simply the worst and most racist club experience I’ve ever had in my life. DO NOT GO HERE. They are incredibly rude and racist. Music is also straight dogsh** if you even manage to get in. Avoid this place at all cost. There are much better clubs, this is not the one for you and your friends, for your own good keep searching. || This club is meant for 20 years old and younger. We paid for a section, €700 and when we went to go grab a group of friends outside, they wouldn’t let us back in even though we paid for the section for the whole night. Security was extremely rude, wouldn’t recommend || Great place. Entry fee was €20 for the ladies and €30 for gents. Heard that it was usually 10€ cheaper . But well well!!! Great music. Energy was great on the dance floor. || A deeply racist experience at Urban Beach in Lisbon  I had one of the most humiliating and discriminatory experiences of my life at Urban Beach. My friends and I were refused entry unless we paid €250 per person, while white customers were charged only €20. When we questioned this outrageous and blatantly racist policy, we were told to either pay the €250 or leave the line immediately.  This type of treatment is unacceptable and violates basic human rights. Discrimination based on race is not just morally wrong; it is also illegal. I hope this review raises awareness of the racism that occurs at this venue, and I urge others to reconsider supporting a place that enforces such discriminatory practices.  Racism has no place in Lisbon—or anywhere else in the world. || Good music and a young audience. As long as you behave you won't get a problem with the bouncers. The dress code is more casual. During weekdays you pay a €20 entry fee with 2 free drinks. Girls pay €10. During the weekend it can be more expensive, but you get free drinks.

The team is really nice and professional, and the place is beautiful as well! Even though I don’t speak Portuguese, we were able to communicate easily using a translator. I got a haircut and a hair mask, it was a really good experience, and I’m very happy with the result! They really know how to take care of curly hair! || Amazing Emma, your feedback is very important to us, i’m glad you liked the result, thank you for your visit. || I have no words to describe the experience I had at the salon. They not only treated my hair but also gave me tips on how to style it best. This experience made me love my hair, and for the first time, I'm wearing it loose. Thank you so much, especially to Jeff. || That's great, Erica! Thank you for your feedback, it's very important to us. Thank you, and we're here to help. || The best salon in Portugal, the space is very cozy, the professionals are incredible, they think about the client's well-being from the beginning to the end of the service. I was very well taken care of and they brought my curls to life. Incredible experience and my hair is beautiful. || We were very pleased with your presence and your positive feedback, you will always be welcome Paula, lots of shine on those beautiful curls. || The store is amazing, it has great lighting and is super well decorated, I felt good energy as soon as I walked in! My hair turned out incredible, the staff were top-notch, super friendly and attentive, my hair has never looked so good as it does now, soft, hydrated, and full of movement! I highly recommend it! Thank you Cachos e Arte, I will be back, I finally found a place that knows how to take care of my hair! || We appreciate your feedback, Rita, it's very important to us. You'll always be welcome. We look forward to seeing you 🥰 … || Wonderful team! Excellent professionals! They changed my life! My hair looks amazing! Thank you so much! Kisses, Ani || That's wonderful!! Thank you Anaide, your feedback is very important to us. Come back anytime! || I feel at ease when I entrust my hair to the skilled Kesia, because I know it always ends up looking beautiful, even after washing and losing that special touch that only she knows how to give. || Thank you so much Silvia for your review, your feedback is very important to us, and we are always happy to receive it. || I needed this! I found a salon with amazing service, they explained exactly how to care for my hair, and delivered results that exceeded my expectations! I absolutely loved it. Thank you! || We are very pleased with your review, Larissa; it's very important for us to have feedback from each customer. || Simply in love with the service and the results! I finally found a salon that truly understands curls and kinks. I left with incredible hair and a light heart 💕✨ … || That's great, Izis! Your feedback is very important to us, and we're happy to share it with you. Come back anytime! || I finally got my dream "day after" look!! I highly recommend it! || Thank you very much, Letícia. Your feedback is very important to us. || The best salon I've ever been to in Lisbon, with great professionals and excellent service!! || Thank you so much Marlon for your feedback, it's very important to us. Come back anytime!!!!

Went in August after 2am. No lines, 10€ for females that comes with a drink. Was super sceptical bc of the terrible reviews but music is INCREDIBLE for all Baile Funk lovers (even as a gringa). reviews_content: It was an awesome day, very friendly people, funny and interesting escape rooms. || Very glad that you enjoyed your birthday with us :D We will always have that special chocolate cake prepared for more birthday celebrations and amazing escape rooms and games to explore with full magic :D || I loved the experience!! Even compared to escape rooms played abroad, this one undoubtedly had the most diverse and challenging puzzles! We loved all the decoding, and a super positive factor for its success was that, given that we have team members who don't understand Portuguese, Enigmas Land provided both English and Portuguese versions of all the escape room puzzles, allowing everyone to easily understand and focus on solving each one. In addition, Victor was with us in a super fun character who always helped with translations and communication with my friends, as well as putting everyone's reasoning together. He never gives direct clues like in other escape rooms, but rather makes us think through our own reasoning, which makes everything much better and gives us a real feeling of being the ones solving everything, even when we seemed stuck. It was perfect!! I recommend it so much that we've already bought two more escape rooms and even got a free speed game! Thank you so much for everything!! || Thank you very much, and we'll be here to honor those 5 stars in the next games you'll venture into! || As regular customers of this type of game, we were quite disappointed. Anyone who has ever been to an escape room will find this completely different. It's even worse. The game consists only of a table with props on it. The clues are very complex, long, and don't make much sense. And we also have the constant company of a man who is always directing and explaining everything. Which is not expected in an escape game where the group must decipher the clues on their own. || We realized that you didn't read what you were getting into; the game you purchased was an escape game, not an escape room, something that is even in the Odisseias title and present in 3 different places on the voucher.  And as with everything in life, we couldn't all like the same thing, and fortunately, the game you played is our most played and liked game. As you mentioned, the clues are indeed complex, and when you constantly try to read more than one at a time, it becomes more difficult, and this fact was mentioned several times before and during the game by the game master. In Portugal, and especially abroad, this figure (and you can research it) serves exactly as part of the game and to help guide you during the experience. We understand those who prefer to touch a button and immediately get the answer through the intercom; in our case, we prefer to guide the thinking and only assist in how to get the answer to the customers themselves. For your part, you decided to play as 6 in a game meant for 4 people, and despite mentioning that you weren't in the best frame of mind for riddles due to the few hours of sleep you'd had, thankfully at least 2 members still enjoyed it. Our games are all designed for thinking, not just wandering around looking for keys or objects in rooms like in others, but for reading, interpreting, and solving riddles. That's why we're called ENIGMAS LAND. Have a fantastic rest of your birthday and a great week! || The best Escape Game I've ever played! The biggest surprise is that the game is led by an actor...yes, an actor, Vitor de Almeida... Inspector Carlos Alves.  Get ready because you'll be chatting for a looooong time after the game. Totally recommended. First one I did and I'm sure it will always be part of my Top 3 👏👏  Keep up the good work!  Ah! Door 39 is really door 39 🤣 || Friendly and flexible service. Vibe. The owner is BEYOND LOVLEY.  The coffee was good, they also serve ice coffees. The vibe is very homely, gluten free, nasty ingredients free - does that make sense? A perfect place to have a chat with people from the neighborhood or simply read a book. || Incredible coffeeshop! So cozy, Tereza is the best. So cozy and an amazing vibe! Such a fun local spot- their carrot ginger juice is 10000/10 + their vegan cakes are heaven || really cool hidden gem of lisbon! vegetarian, vegan, gluten free friendly - i think it all might be vegan? plus loads of non-caffeine drinks too.  i got a blueberry iced matcha (i think with oat milk?) which was absolutely superb. i also got a pecan pie cake thing which was delicious too.  the owner is sooooo lovely and friendly and chatty and has curated the coolest, most relaxing and chill vibes in here.  the decor is super cool and interesting. great for catching up with friends or just having a solo coffee.  well worth a visit - im just sad i only found it on my last day!! || This place feels like your family hug after a long trip. Ran into this cute little cafe just before heading to the airport. Lovely space, super kind host and the coffee plus carrot cake was also just perfect. The gentleman running the place serves excellent food, freshly prepared. I had the Acai Bowl with Granola, then Toast with Avocado, Scrambled Eggs & Cherry Tomatoes and finished it off with a coffee. Edit in response to owner: I didn’t give positive feedback in the store, I gave a thumbs up to be polite as the person who made my drink watched me drink some through the window. Perhaps it can be a good drink for someone whose never had a pumpkin spice latte before & didn’t know what to expect. || We're so sorry Portugirl Xo, your drink was carefully dosed by the barista. Receiving your positive feedback in store. We are willing to offer a new drink on your next visit 😉 Regarding the price, we regret any type of embarrassment. Holy moly. Genuinely, the best place in Portugal. I’m from Australia and no cafe there even comes close. We’re thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the food, service, and overall atmosphere at Hygge Kaffe. Your recommendation means a lot to us! Warm regards, Hygge Kaffe Team || We had the worst experience here, first of all we didn’t make a reservation and we had to wait for a table (which isn’t a problem) but after we were seated we waited around 30 minutes to order and another hour to get the food and drinks (there were about 8 waitresses). She also said that when we come back we should order something else so we don’t have problems (we will never come back here) || Hello Zsanette,  Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We will be reviewing this situation internally with both our kitchen and service teams to ensure that food preparation standards, communication, and customer care are clearly reinforced.  While we understand and respect your decision not to return, we truly appreciate you bringing these issues to our attention, as they help us identify where we must improve.  Kind regards Hygge Kaffe Team || Best matcha and brunch place. Loved the drinks and foods. Staff were very nice, would highly recommend. place_name: Kiosk Cafe | Specialty Coffee & Books | Brunch
reviews_content: Stopped by Kiosk Café for brunch and loved it! The place is small but really cozy, with a big shared table that has plenty of outlets - perfect if you want to get some work done while enjoying your coffee. The service was super friendly and the food quality was honestly top-notch. We had the avocado toast and the yogurt with granola - both were very generous in size and super tasty. Even the presentation was on point. And the coffee? Rich, flavorful, and just what we needed. Definitely recommend it if you’re looking for a great brunch spot in Lisbon! || Thank you, Magali!
