Even when we switched a few items around was v helpful .. and great coffee ! Highly recommend ! || Spent 6 days in Lisbon, ate here every morning. The one day it was closed, we missed it terribly.  Great, fresh food, good prices, cozy place, smooth coffee, nice servers. 11-13 euros for a full breakfast with a hot drink of your choice and fresh squeezed orange juice. Never seen a better breakfast deal.  This was also the ONLY place we encountered during our time here that gave us water at no charge. Thanks all, we’ll miss Brooklyn! || Go here for the vibe, not the food.  The space is magical, the most perfect Black diaspora aesthetic. But the food was made for a local palate.  Pictured here is the “jollof and chicken”. 🤔 || We enjoyed the food though we were disappointed from the service which toke time and when served all. Thee orders are mixed up and toke another time to fix it The atmosphere is average though its too american style || Brooklyn Café Resto is a great little spot right near Jardim da Estrela in Lisbon. It has a strong New York-style vibe, from the decor to the menu, and makes for a perfect stop if you're exploring the area.  We tried the cortado and cappuccino, both of which were excellent, smooth and well balanced. They also offer fresh fruit, juices, and warm croissants that were perfect for a light and satisfying breakfast.  The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, with a view of the park just steps away. If you're in the area and looking for quality coffee and a chill vibe, Brooklyn Café is definitely worth a visit. || We had a great breakfast on the last day of our trip in Lisbon at this cozy café. The food was fresh, prepared quickly, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. || Lovely customer service from the staff, helpful and they love to help the tourists highly recommended for morning coffee and breakfast 😀 😊 || We had such a great breakfast here. American and Comfort Breakfast were to the point. We loved both. They come with orange juice and a hot drink of your choice for around €11. Affordable and at the same time of high quality. Highly recommended. || Hi! 😊 Thanks for your review. We hope to see you soon! 🙌🏼 …

A local gem! We enjoyed breakfast here yesterday. Delicious flat, white coffees, a wonderful ham and cheese, toasted sandwich with some extra eggs on the side plus the Melbourne scrambled eggs. We had a lovely conversation with our waiter, and the vibe of the place is very friendly, clean and accessible. Highly recommended! || Thank you Kim! That’s great feedback. We look forward to seeing you again next time you pass by our cafe;) || The best coffee in town! 🫶🏻 My friend and I came here twice for brunch and it was amazing every time. A very cozy atmosphere. The owners are two friends who are incredibly kind and give you lots of great tips for interesting places in Lisbon. Thank you for everything.🩵 || Thank you Marketa :) very lovely to be part of your visit to Lisbon. 5 star guests 🌟 … || Great little breakfast spot. Had yogurt, which I was excited about, and eggs options. It’s very small with no outside seating as it’s on a corner so come early to get a table. Really great coffee and tea. Location is unique though…on a corner. Loved it. || Glad you found us Jennifer! Thank you for the great feedback;) || Amazing place for breakfast or brunch! We stumbled across this place when we first arrived in Lisbon, and ended up having breakfast there everyday!! Owned and run by two Aussie guys - they also served as tour guides, recommending some amazing places for fabulous Lisbon views and food! Get the Melbourne Scrambles Eggs! || That’s great to hear, thank you Mark! || Great spot with friendly and welcoming staff. Had a solid flat white and avocado toast. Fun upbeat atmosphere in a cute historic building. Great for a quick breakfast / lunch or coffee recharge. || That’s great feedback, much appreciated Peter! || Clean, local, fast and delicious - what you need more for breakfast? Really nice stuff, great place (looks like a storage on a sidewalk in a good meaning). Acai smoothie just makes me fantasie about it for years now! || Thank you Asia, glad you had a good time at Kossie’s;) || This place was kindly recommended to us by our Airbnb host. Their creative take on scrambled eggs and avo on toast were both delicious. Coffee was top notch too. Our best breakfast in Lisbon. || Great feedback, thanks Rhodri ;) || Stumbled across this place near to our hotel and we were very impressed! We had a toastie each which were so good. The owner of the cafe guided us through some good local spots to visit and was a fantastic host! We’ve heard they have opened a second cafe and will be checking this out! Highly recommend || Thank you Sam! Was great to meet you;) || This is a fantastic spot for breakfast or brunch! They offer a great selection of beverages, including coffee, fresh juices, and smoothies. We ordered the scrambled eggs, the Praça das Flores dish, and a bowl of fresh fruit — everything was absolutely delicious. The flavors in the eggs and toast were especially memorable. We also tried a couple of the juices, which were refreshing and full of flavor. On top of the great food, the service was exceptional. Highly recommend checking this place out! || Thank you so much, Jeffrey! || This was one of the best sandwiches I’ve ever had, the coffee was incredible too. So simple but everything tasted fresh and delicious. The orange juice was definitely fresh too. They were so kind highly recommend !! || That is so nice to hear, we look forward to hosting you again, Joni!

the service was exceptional, and everything I got was based on their recommendations. the avo toast was a 10/10, and since they don’t have regular lemonade, they offered me this “lemonaid” which I really liked, it comes in different flavors. the place is beautiful, cozy, and super comfortable to work from || Wonderful the most delicious coffee I tasted , very friendly stuff , it has small terrace and nice quiet place to work or come for a brunch ! I am in love . Tried their “crazy meet” - very satisfying || The cappuccino’s are delicious! The quality is exceptional and you don’t even need to add sugar because the owner really cares about the quality and sourcing of the coffee! One of the best coffees in town. || One of my favourite coffee shops in Lisbon, I come here once a week for an avoegg toast and a latte and work a couple of hours. The WiFi is good, staff are super nice and the atmosphere is very chill. || Very good specialty coffee spot in Lisbon! The corn cake was absolutely delicious, and the toasties were a nice touch. Cozy, welcoming atmosphere—perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. Highly recommend! || Love this place!!! Been in Lisbon for two days and ran to this cafe for the second time for breakfast. Very happy I found it!!! The people working here are very nice, and the food is healthy and delicious, plus they have their own coffee style )))  Very much recommend if you wanna have just a nice time in a nice place and relax in a soothing, friendly atmosphere. ❤🫂💫 || I love this coffe shop! Amazing coffee, amazing food, amazing service, cute place! || Great place. They also have a back yard which made it perfect for us who had a baby in a stroller with us. Lovely staff and great food and coffee. We came back a few times. || ## How About Coffee? Caffeinating Your Lisbon Experience with Delicious Delights  In the heart of Lisbon, where the aroma of freshly roasted coffee beans mingles with the city's vibrant energy, lies How About Coffee? - a café that lives up to its name and beyond. More than just a caffeine pit stop, this charming spot offers a delightful culinary experience that tantalizes the taste buds and warms the soul.  **A Feast for the Senses:**  * **Salmon Sensation:** My personal highlight was the **exquisite salmon** bathed in a **luscious hollandaise sauce**. The fish was cooked to perfection, flaky and moist, its delicate flavor beautifully complemented by the creamy richness of the sauce. A true culinary masterpiece! * **Acai Allure:** For the health-conscious adventurer, the **acai granola** promises a burst of flavor and energy. The vibrant blend of acai, topped with fresh fruit and crunchy granola, offered a refreshing and satisfying start to the day. * **Avomelicious Awakening:** The **"Avomelo"**, featuring creamy avocado, savory mushrooms, and perfectly fried eggs, was a symphony of textures and tastes. This dish is a must-try for avocado enthusiasts seeking a hearty and flavorful breakfast.  **Beyond the Plate:**  * **Charming Ambiance:** Stepping into How About Coffee? is like stepping into a warm hug. The cozy atmosphere, with its exposed brick walls and inviting décor, creates a space that feels both modern and comforting. * **Coffee Connoisseur's Paradise:** True to its name, the café boasts a **diverse selection of coffee**, expertly brewed to satisfy every palate. Whether you're a latte lover or an espresso aficionado, you're sure to find your perfect cup. * **Friendly Service:** The staff at How About Coffee? are the icing on the cake. They are attentive, welcoming, and knowledgeable, making you feel right at home from the moment you step in.  **In Conclusion:**  How About Coffee? is more than just a café; it's an experience. From the delectable dishes to the inviting atmosphere and friendly service, this hidden gem offers a taste of Lisbon that will linger in your memory long after you leave. So, when you're exploring the city and need a caffeine fix or a delicious bite, do yourself a favor and ask, "How About Coffee?" You won't be disappointed! || If you want a local, artisanal coffee shop experience with the most delicious coffee you’ve ever had, you have to go here. The owner, Tiago, knows more about coffee than anyone I’ve ever met. He and all the staff are extremely friendly and kind. The coffee is amazing, the vibe is incredible, and there’s a big spot out back that’s great for working/hanging out (along with all the indoor space). 10/10 would recommend.

Not sure if it is a hidden gem but it took us a while and some hunting to find this place, but it was definitely worth the adventure time!  We rocked up for breakfast and the place was empty, so service was quick, the staff were all smiles and friendly, they were patient with us and okay with our lack of Portuguese!  We ordered the chia pudding, a salmon toast, two coffees and some fresh pink lemonade - everything was fresh and well made!  The bill wasn't hefty either, so all in all- a decent start to the day! || Hello Amro Thanks for the review! The team is happy to know you had a positive experience with us. || We had eggs on toast, parfait and a croissant. The eggs were still a bit wet  (which I prefer), the toast was smothered in butter (maybe a bit too much for my liking) and it came with some avocado. I think the eggs and avocado could have been a bit more seasoned, but overall it was very nice. The parfait had some nice bits of fruit in it (blueberry, strawberry and raspberry) and an AMAZING granola! Normaal they sell the granola, but unfortunately they were still making a fresh batch. Otherwise I would've taken it with me, so good! The croissant was freshly made, but a bit undercooked. The flavor was still great though, just a bit heavier than it should be. || Hello Siska Thanks for the review! The team is happy to know you had a positive experience with us. || Was truly looking forward to enjoying a breakfast here. Unfortunately, they were not open at the scheduled hour at 9:00.  Waiting out in the cold until 9:15, an employee walked by and I asked when they open.  With an arrogant attitude and body language, shaking his head, he said ...it's open. Indeed,  they opened,  but his attitude already spoiled my desire to spend money there. A failed attempt to communicate( in clear Portuguese), was only met with " não vale pena "  from the arrogant man to the waiter. Which means...not worth it.  His atitude was that the clients opinion is of no value.  This was after ordering our food.  My reply...not worth eating here, and walked out. Amazing how one bad atitude can cost a good company potentially regular clients.  We will try again in a different location. || Hello Andrew We're really sorry to hear of the difficulties you've had. This definitely doesn't sound like the service we try to provide to our customers. Thanks for the review! || This cute little brunch spot is located beneath a small mall. I ordered a hot matcha latte, which was pretty good, along with the breakfast plate. It came with poached eggs, tomatoes, bacon, sausage, mushrooms, avocado, and a side of rustic bread. It was healthy and tasted great, but unfortunately, it didn’t sit well with me afterward. I suspect the avocado might have been the culprit, as it was the only thing I had that morning, and I started feeling unwell shortly after. || Hello Jamie We're really sorry to hear of the difficulties you've had. This definitely doesn't sound like the service we try to provide to our customers. Thanks for the review! || Great friendly atmosphere , SUPER FOOD AND BEVERAGE AND ESPRESSO , kind and very professionists the personal. AMAZING SURPRISE Antonello Pedicelli Rome🍀 || Hello Antonello Thanks for the review! The team is happy to know you had a good experience with us. || Great cafe for brunch! It’s tucked in the corner of an area with a few stores but definitely a hidden gem. Delicious and healthy food, quick service, and cute atmosphere. Perfect last quick brunch in Lisbon before our flight! || Hello Karlene Thanks for the review we are happy to know you had a positive experience with us! Kafeine ;) || LOVED lunch here! So delicious! Great service! || Hello Ashton Thanks for your review! The team is happy to know you had a good experience with us! || super cool spot in a really cool part of town. the service was fast and the food was great. salmon bagel was a HIT! The coffee had me ready to take on the day. Free wifi and bathrooms near by. || Hello Michael Thanks for the review! The team is happy to know you had a good experience with us. || Food was excellent, best we've had in a long time and service was top notch || Hello James Thanks for the review! The team is happy to know you had a good experience with us. || Great food and service. We had that avocado toast, nachos with guacamole, and bagel. Delicious and simple. Staff was amazing. For drinks, I had the chai latte and my husband had cafe latte.  We loved everything! || Hello Rupal Thanks for the review! The team is happy to know you had a good experience with us.

place_name: Delta Coffee House - Avenida da Liberdade
reviews_content: Interior is very tastefully decorated. Yet having a huge big room did not feel as a small cozy coffee place. I ordered iced matcha latte, for 6 euros, the taste was unfortunately disappointing. Place looks good outside yet I found it overpriced. || A very luxurious coffee experience on the main avenue of Lisbon. The cafe is large and well done. There is a lot of different types of coffees to order from. They have table service. Our flat whites were alright, but the place is cool. || Love the breakfast and coffee was so good The interior, music all made my day🤍🩵 || When I went inside for the first time, they were roasting the coffee beans. That aroma of the coffee was amazing. We had brunch. The food is good. The service is great. Perfect spot to work. However, consider that it is hard to find a spot to work as there are a lot of people with laptops. One down side is some people with laptops occupies the big tables and don’t even bother to move. Atmosphere is brilliant. It will make you to have a good chat with friends. || A fantastic find! I thoroughly enjoyed my visit to Delta Coffee House. The atmosphere is top-notch—very spacious with lovely decor that makes it a relaxing place to spend time. I especially loved seeing the beautiful coffee roasting machine; it adds a great touch. I had a cappuccino and cheese sandwich, both of which were delicious and clearly earned the five-star rating for food. The staff were also excellent. They were friendly, very patient while I ordered, and happy to help accommodate my requests. This place is definitely worth a visit! || The interior design is magnificent for a coffee shop. The location is also good. However,  6,20 € for a tiny cup of cold coffee is too much ! || This is one of my favorite specialty coffee ☕️ shops in Lisbon. The coffee ☕️ is very delicious in all its varieties and the desserts 🧁 as well. The atmosphere is very wonderful. || From what we’ve tried in Lisbon, one of the best coffeehouse experiences. Very good coffee, coffee martini, breakfast, desserts, also friendly waiters and relaxing atmosphere. The 4 stars are because the ordered scrambled eggs took over 20 minutes to be ready. Delicious otherwise. But in case you are short on time… Decided to rate 5 stars in the end for the delicious taste. Thank you! || Real Portuguese coffee. Not for everyone. Snacks was really good. || Perfect cafe to hang around while sipping a coffee, reading news or getting some work done on your laptop. If you just want a quick coffee and return to work, it may take too long for you as they have different staff taking order, preparing coffee and serving (sometimes 5 min matter ;))  The atmosphere and design alone is worth returning!! The chairs and and benches are incredibly comfortable - soft music is playing in the background and tables are spread out on two areas as well as outdoor terrace.  I had a flat white (3€) with oat milk (0.75) and personably, it didn’t quite satisfy my taste. But that’s just my personal experience. Oat milk was quite sweet and served well as an alternative to a croissant.  In terms of food, you’ll find traditional pastries, croissants and cakes. They do have a vegan and gluten-free banana cake which I didn’t try.  Opening hours are daily from 8am-10.30pm.  February 2024 || Hello Daniela Ullmann / Healthy Lifestyle by Design, thank you for your comment and for sharing your experience with us. Customer satisfaction is our priority and your feedback is essential to us.  We hope to welcome you back soon and continue to offer a quality service.

Midnight Espresso is a small treasure tucked into the heart of Lisbon, a place that immediately distinguishes itself with its refined atmosphere and thoughtful aesthetic. The space feels curated without being pretentious, and the music—always well‑chosen—sets a relaxed, inviting rhythm that makes time stretch pleasantly.  What truly defines Midnight Espresso, however, are its owners. They are the soul of the place: charismatic, energetic, and genuinely welcoming. Their attentive service radiates positivity, whether you stop in for a simple cup of tea or a perfectly mixed martini. There’s an ease and warmth in the way they interact with guests that turns a casual visit into something memorable.  The food offering is remarkably well executed. The freshly baked scone, fragrant and still warm, is a standout, and the selection of cakes is equally impressive—simple, honest, and delicious. Given its growing popularity and intimate size, booking ahead is advisable. Midnight Espresso isn’t just a bar; it’s a place where hospitality feels personal, where details matter, and where every visit leaves you wanting to return. || Dear Domenico, thank you so much for this beautifully written review. It truly means a lot to us. We’re delighted to hear that the atmosphere, music and aesthetic resonated with you, and even more touched by your kind words about us as hosts. Creating a place where people feel genuinely welcome and at ease is at the heart of what we do.  We’re glad you enjoyed the scone and our cakes. Simple, honest food made with care is exactly what we aim for. Your appreciation of the details and the spirit of The Midnight Espresso is incredibly encouraging. We can’t wait to welcome you back again soon. || This is an amazing spot. Lots of tea options, some of them not that usual. You can order a Pot and 2 people have enough tea for the whole night.  Desserts are also delicious!  Great spot to have a nice conversation. Maybe a good story can start here. || Dear Minoru, thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted that you enjoyed our tea selection, especially the more unique options and that sharing a pot made your visit cozy and relaxing. We’re also happy to hear the desserts hit the spot! It means a lot that you see our place as somewhere great for conversation (and maybe even the start of a good story). We’d love to welcome you back anytime! || You want a vintage place to travel through the time? It’s the place! A very small cafeteria which used to be a detached living room for a family, with nice tea variety, good cocktails and also delicious cappuccino. We had a great time there but just be aware that there is not enough space for big gatherings. ❤️🥰 || Dear Niloofar, thank you so much for your lovely review! We’re delighted to hear that our little vintage space made you feel like you traveled back in time. It means a lot to us that you enjoyed our teas, cocktails and cappuccino, and that you had a great time here.  You’re absolutely right about the size - we’re a cozy spot with limited space, but we’re glad our atmosphere added to your experience.  We hope to welcome you back again soon! || One of the best date nights we’ve ever had! You feel like you’ve been transported back in time. Lovely cocktails and desserts. I had the crème brûlée which was amazing. This was marked as gluten free, I am coeliac and I had no reactions. Would definitely recommend visiting whilst in Lisbon || Dear Teigan, thank you so much for your wonderful words! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed your date night with us and that everything - from the cocktails to the crème brûlée - made for a memorable evening. It’s great to know our gluten-free options met your expectations too. We truly appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back next time you’re in Lisbon! || LOVE The Midnight Espresso SO much! Definitely a favorite spot in Lisbon—loved it so much that we went two nights in a row. The owners are so kind and hospitable, and the drinks and desserts are delicious. We ordered the Espresso Martini, Love Bird, and Midnight Stinger, all of which were amazing. A few good gluten free options for desserts as well!  Reservations definitely recommended as it is only a few tables, making for a beautifully cozy and warm atmosphere. || Dear Isabella, thank you so much! It means the world to us that you came back two nights in a row. We're thrilled you loved the cocktails (great choices, by the way!) and that the desserts—including the gluten-free ones—hit the spot. It was such a pleasure having you, and we truly appreciate your kind words. Hope to see you again next time you're in Lisbon! || The most special and cozy place with friendly and lovely staff. Their selection of teas is wonderful, they have something for every taste! Highly recommend the high tea experience with the most delicious pastries and their freshly baked warm scones. If you’re not a tea person, they have amazing cocktails! We had the new Cocktail Flight with their best 4 cocktails and it was just divine. Also, their pairing desserts are so unique, you need to try the lime cheesecake. Extra points for the playlist which matches the mood perfectly! || Dear Patrícia, thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed both our high tea and cocktail flight — it makes us so happy when guests get to experience a little bit of everything we love creating. The lemon ginger cheesecake is one of our favorites too, and we’re thrilled it stood out for you. We can’t wait to welcome you back! || We were dazzled by this incredible place nestled in Lisbon.  Serving incredible deserts and a massive range of drinks, the interior is incredibly charming. Long and narrow, great use is made of the natural shape of the building to create little booths which feel cosy and intimate for couples.  The cakes were incredible - both the chocolate and lemon meringue. Incredibly flavoursome and rich, the crunchy biscuit base then really adds a compliment.  The two owners are also adorable. Friendly and fun, with great stories of their own travels, they strike the balance of being perfect hosts and adding to your evening without being intrusive.  We loved the herbal tea and the faced coffee, but the whole experience is elevated by the incredible attention to detail in the presentation of the food and drinks.  Well worth the trip, and we’ll prioritise revisiting when we’re next in Lisbon || Dear Paul,   Thank you so much for your wonderful message – we’re absolutely delighted to hear how much you enjoyed your visit!  It means the world to us that you appreciated not just the desserts and drinks but also the atmosphere we’ve tried to create here. Your kind words about the space and our service truly warm our hearts.  We’re thrilled you enjoyed the drinks – and we’re especially grateful that you noticed the care we put into the details. It’s guests like you who make all the effort so rewarding.  We can’t wait to welcome you back the next time you’re in Lisbon. Until then, thank you once again for your generous words and for making our day! || Delectable is the right word. SO glad I found this gem on the Internet! The espresso martini was perfection. Quality ingredients (especially the espresso!), not super sweet, but just right. I watched the bartender make the drink and it was such an attention to detail to make sure the drink was just right. The apple tart was my favorite and something I’ll talk about forever. Not to mention the service was so welcoming and the music was such a vibe. I’ll be back and I will be ordering my mom’s dessert to go! || Dear Tiffany, thank you so much for your wonderful words! We’re thrilled you enjoyed the espresso martini (Andre will be so happy to hear your feedback!) and that the apple tart left such a lasting impression. It’s great to know you felt welcomed and enjoyed the vibe as well. We look forward to having you back soon — and we’ll make sure your mom’s dessert is ready to go! || tanya was the nicest person ever! made our first experience in portugal amazing! def recommend this place !!! cocktails & desserts 10/10 || Thank you very much Mia! We’re thrilled to hear your first experience in Portugal was a great one, and we’re especially happy that Tania helped make it memorable. So glad you loved the cocktails and desserts! We’d love to welcome you back anytime you’re in Lisbon. || Im going to be honest we all expected more for 25 euros each. Three little savoury bites each, a scone and three little sweet bites and a pot of tea. We left feeling hungry. Could have given more savoury food or sandwiches in that price. Vibe is cute service was good music was relaxing but the cost was excessive for the very small portion of food which was not even mind blowing in flavour texture or taste. The tea was very nice and cocktail too but again at an additional 13 euros; expensive for Lisbon. Total bill 100 euros for 3 people, we were shocked || Dear CS, thank you for taking the time to share your honest feedback with us - we truly appreciate it. We’re very happy to hear that you enjoyed the atmosphere, service and tea, and we’re equally grateful for your openness about what fell short for you.  We always aim to be fully transparent about our High Tea experience, which is why both the price of 25€ per person and detailed photos of everything included are clearly displayed on our website and Instagram. We offer many images so guests can see exactly what the experience contains before booking. Our High Tea is designed as an afternoon-tea style experience (not a full lunch or dinner) and is served during our opening hours for those looking to enjoy a curated selection of savoury bites, sweets, scones and premium tea.  Thank you again for visiting us and for sharing your thoughts with kindness.

I had brunch here several times. The place is chill and peaceful to work. Not too noisy and the service is great. The food is tasty but I’ll say a bit expensive compared to other options in Anjos area. || For sure recommend. We stopped here for brunch - great food portions, great coffee and delicious orange juice. Avo breakfast was delicious, I switched up the scrambled for fried.  The interior is beautiful, however not too practical, a lot of noise from the street and confusing layout. The staff was super nice and communicating.  We will probably return during our stay! || Great little place, relaxed atmosphere and attentive kind staff. We felt welcome from the moment we arrived. Prices are decent for the area, €3.50 for an iced late. We ordered two salmon and cream cheese croissants, along with a Kombucha and ice latte. All were delicious, would happily come back again. || This place is delicious for good breakfast / brunch food and is a really nice environment filled with plants. There are some people working but overall it’s a really nice atmosphere. It was so good I went back 2x and had the same thing. Solid. || We stopped by Curva Café in Lisbon for a quick coffee break and absolutely loved it! The ambiance is super cozy and beautifully designed such a lovely spot to relax or get some work done. Inside tables were full when we arrived, and it seemed like many people were using it as a coworking space, which totally makes sense given the vibe. The staff were incredibly kind, friendly, and fast. Definitely a place I’ll come back to next time I’m in Lisbon! 💛☕️ || This might be our favourite coffee shop in Lisbon! Spacious, friendly calm atmosphere. The coffee and food was delicious. || Very nice spot to work or connect with others! Food and drink fairly priced, great options, generous portions (I got the toast and it was plenty) and lovely service. Great vibe and recommend. || Solid breakfast with better coffee. Atmosphere is very modern and alternative, I enjoyed staying here. I liked their fresh version of Chai Tea. || Beautiful stylish place for eat. I ate toast with avocado and it was great. the place is great full of design. || Delicious food, great coffee and super friendly staff! One of the best breakfast places in the neighbourhood, I'll deffinitely come here again❤️

I generally love Simpli cafés and usually really enjoy their coffee, but this location didn’t impress me as much as the others I’ve visited. My favorite Simpli is the one in Saldanha, inside the Sheraton Hotel — I highly recommend that one if you’re a Simpli fan. This café is okay, but for me the coffee quality felt a bit lower, the food portions were smaller (which was surprising), and overall it felt less cozy. Still, if you like Simply, it’s worth stopping by and trying it for yourself. || Had the best french toast here! Tasted like nothing I had before. Also had a golden latte, would recommend! Very nice cafe with good food and great vibes. || Thank you so much! We’re thrilled you loved the French toast and enjoyed the golden latte too. Delighted to hear the food and vibes made your visit special.  Thank you for the recommendation, and we hope to welcome you back soon! || The food was so good we went back a second day. They had vegetarian options. The staff were friendly and the atmosphere was nice and there were pretty decorations. On the first day there was a guy who did latte art. On the second day the wait was a bit longer and the food was already slightly cold. The coffee was really good and the food was flavourful. The staff were lovely who sooo English. The toilets are either up or down stairs, and there’s a step into the restaurant so it’s not wheelchair accessible. This is an experience you can definitely do more than once. || Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review!  We’re thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the food enough to come back a second time — that truly means a lot to us. We're also happy you appreciated the vegetarian options, the coffee, the atmosphere, and our lovely (and very English!) team.  We’re sorry to hear that your second visit didn’t quite match the first in terms of food temperature and waiting time — we’ll definitely take that on board to improve consistency. And thank you for pointing out the accessibility limitations; it’s something we’re aware of, and we’re always trying to find ways to improve the experience for everyone.  We really hope to welcome you again soon for round three — we’ll be ready with hot plates and great coffee! || A wonderful spot for a healthy breakfast or lunch. The food is simple, delicious, and nourishing — exactly what you need to feel good. Great coffee, refreshing drinks, cozy atmosphere, and genuinely friendly staff. I really love this café — it’s one of my favorites. || Thank you so much for your kind words! 🌿 We're really happy to hear you enjoyed the food, drinks, and the vibe, and it means a lot to know we're one of your favorite cafés. Hope to see you again soon! ☕💛 … || If I could give this Simpli location 100 stars, I would. Having a delicious meal is one thing — but having a place to feel comfortable, always welcomed with a smiling face — is priceless. The ambience was also very on point. Nice music, not too loud. Refreshing and calm, we were able to dinner and work on our laptops afterwards.  And the best part, the prices were absolutely fair and we left the place with a great smile, a happy belly and a feeling of rejoicing that we will never forget.  100/100 ❤️ || This was one of my best breakfest. place_name: The Folks Сhiado - Specialty Coffee, Breakfast & Brunch
reviews_content: I saw this place on tik tok and really wanted to go here after seeing the Turkish Egg dish! They have several locations. We ate at the Chiado location since it was close to our airbnb. There was a line but it wasn’t too long of a wait. The service was good, atmosphere was boisterous & fun. The lattes were really good! One of our friends is a huge coffee snob and she gave this place a thumbs up. We all ended up ordering the Turkish eggs dish. It was so good! It’s really saucy. I wish they gave more bread because there was plenty of sauce to soak up! I highly recommend this dish. This place was so good that we came here twice. I definitely recommend! || AMAZING BRUNCH PRO I never have been to a better Brunch place. Coffee is well done and with special options. Food has a lot of layers and is made with passion. All three dishes were well balanced and so yummy. Definitely worth every Cent. Staff is working well together.  CON Lipstick on the coffee cup. Please clean more carefully in future! || Hi Jay,   Thank you so much for your kind words and for giving us 5 stars! We're thrilled to hear that you had an amazing brunch experience with us. We loved the coffee and their eggs menu. Tried their pancakes today and didn’t really enjoy the thickness and consistency. Would still come back for the eggs and the coffee , though ! || Highly recommend! Good music, good vibe, good food! May come back again this week if possible to try some other goodies! || Hi Blues! Thank you so much for the glowing review! We look forward to welcoming you back soon to try more delicious treats! || Went here 2x during our trip and had good experiences! It has a fully halal menu so def a plus. We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your visits and the fully halal menu. We appreciate your feedback about the music volume and will take it into consideration. We hope to welcome you back soon! || 3,8/5  The Folks is a small breakfast spot tucked into the heart of Lisbon. The service is friendly, the dishes arrive promptly and yet, something’s missing. I had the raspberry pancakes and it was so nice, fluffy, not too sweet, just perfect. It was really good, nice truffle flavor, great bread and eggs perfectly cooked. Also the tiramisu coffee was sooo yummy. The vibe is nice, not too loud. I highly recommend. || Thank you for the wonderful review, we are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the food and the vibe at The Folks! When I came back, it was right there waiting and I thank them so much for that!  Truly nice folks! || Hi Vee,   Thank you for your kind words and for sharing your wonderful experience at The Folks! The cappuccino was underwhelming. The milk completely overpowered the coffee. It felt more like a generic coffee-flavored milk drink rather than something from a specialty coffee shop.  Pastries: The pistachio soft cookie had a slight crunch on the outside but was mostly soft. Simply adding a few nuts on top doesn’t make it a pistachio cookie—it was filled with chocolate and tasted more like a chocolate chip cookie with pistachios rather than a proper pistachio-based treat.  The vegan brownie was too dry and lacked the gooeyness that makes a brownie enjoyable. It felt like texture was sacrificed just to make it vegan, and honestly, a basic store-bought brownie would have been better.  Overall Impression: The price is unjustified for what was served.
