reviews_content: I saw this place on tik tok and really wanted to go here after seeing the Turkish Egg dish! They have several locations. We ate at the Chiado location since it was close to our airbnb. There was a line but it wasn’t too long of a wait. The service was good, atmosphere was boisterous & fun. The lattes were really good! One of our friends is a huge coffee snob and she gave this place a thumbs up. We all ended up ordering the Turkish eggs dish. It was so good! It’s really saucy. I wish they gave more bread because there was plenty of sauce to soak up! I highly recommend this dish. This place was so good that we came here twice. I definitely recommend! || AMAZING BRUNCH PRO I never have been to a better Brunch place. Coffee is well done and with special options. Food has a lot of layers and is made with passion. All three dishes were well balanced and so yummy. Definitely worth every Cent. Staff is working well together.  CON Lipstick on the coffee cup. Please clean more carefully in future! || Hi Jay,   Thank you so much for your kind words and for giving us 5 stars! We're thrilled to hear that you had an amazing brunch experience with us. We appreciate your feedback about the coffee cup and will make sure to improve our cleaning process. We hope to see you again soon! || Went to eat here twice during our trip to Lisbon. We loved the coffee and their eggs menu. Tried their pancakes today and didn’t really enjoy the thickness and consistency. Would still come back for the eggs and the coffee , though ! || Highly recommend! Good music, good vibe, good food! Got here at 6pm, ordered turkey breast Benedict and a coconut water with matcha foam which is recommended by the nice guy! Turns out he has good taste hahah the drink is soooo good. May come back again this week if possible to try some other goodies! || Hi Blues! Thank you so much for the glowing review! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the music, vibe, and food at The Folks. We're glad you liked the coconut water with matcha foam recommended by our team member. We look forward to welcoming you back soon to try more delicious treats! || Went here 2x during our trip and had good experiences! It has a fully halal menu so def a plus. I especially loved their caesar salad with chicken. They have a cool interior as well. but the music is a bit loud for breakfast. Overall I recommend! || Thank you for your kind review, San! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your visits and the fully halal menu. We appreciate your feedback about the music volume and will take it into consideration. We hope to welcome you back soon! || 3,8/5  The Folks is a small breakfast spot tucked into the heart of Lisbon. The service is friendly, the dishes arrive promptly and yet, something’s missing.  It’s not that the food isn’t good; it’s simply… fine. Competent. But in a city that hums with cafés serving character and soul on every plate, mere competence feels like a missed opportunity. At these prices, breakfast deserves a little more than just “fine.” || Thank you for your review, Mateusz! We appreciate your kind words about our friendly service and prompt dishes. We will take your feedback into consideration to continue improving. Hope to see you again soon! || Food was so good. I had the raspberry pancakes and it was so nice, fluffy, not too sweet, just perfect. My partner had the truffle eggs Benedict and I managed to steal one bite because it was so good they didn’t initially want to share 😆. It was really good, nice truffle flavor, great bread and eggs perfectly cooked. Also the tiramisu coffee was sooo yummy. The vibe is nice, not too loud. I highly recommend. || Thank you for the wonderful review, we are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the food and the vibe at The Folks! We appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back soon. || I got the truffle mushroom Benedict - so delicious! The Smoky pine latte had a really unique flavor and was really good. Pablo, our waiter, was super nice! || Wonderful people, good coffee! It is a very popular spot and really busy, so we decided not to take brunch here at the time. Just a coffee. It was nicely made and everything there was very kind.  In my hurry to leave, I accidentally forget a toy that I had brought, and was many blocks away when I remembered leaving it on the bench inside the packed café. In other places and other cities, that would have meant it was almost certainly stolen right away. But the employees there took it, and put it aside safely. When I came back, it was right there waiting and I thank them so much for that!  Truly nice folks! || Hi Vee,   Thank you for your kind words and for sharing your wonderful experience at The Folks! We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our coffee and the service provided by our team. We appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back soon! || I had breakfast here today and everything was really good. The food was fresh, the service was fast, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. A special shoutout to Julia, our server — she was amazing. Friendly, attentive, and made the visit even better. Highly recommend! || Thank you so much for the wonderful review, Alejandro! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed your breakfast with us, and we're glad that Julia provided excellent service. We appreciate your recommendation and hope to welcome you back soon!

A hidden gem. I am sooo impressed with this place. It’s a small café and they don’t even have an oven, only countertops, and yet, are able to produce such amazing dishes. They source the highest quality ingredients for their limited menu and you can really taste the freshness and so much flavor. I ordered a croissant and added on many side dishes to create my own breakfast. It was superb; every element. The attention to detail they give to everything is truly next level. || I loved everything about this place. Tried batch brew and espresso - loved every sip! You can feel these folks care about coffee and love what they are doing. Interior and tableware are charming too || Fantastic place! Great coffee and pastries. The only thing I didn’t like was plum jam which was more like a compote and it was difficult to eat it || Friendly service and cozy environment. The coffee was good and you get a good amount of it for the price you pay. However, they still charge for the oat milk and don’t have any vegan options for food.  Ps: not a negative thing per se but they don’t have wifi or power outlets, so it’s not a laptop friendly cafe (although they allow you to use it). || I could honestly come here every day just for the filter coffee and the insanely good tomatoes. No jokes, the coffee is always perfect, the guys are always attentive and there’s a sense that my breakfast plate is made with the highest quality ingredients possible. || Best croissant I’ve ever had. Beautiful quiet spot - if you sit outside you can see the bridge. || perfect place to chill and journal. everything i tried (cheesecake, lil breakfast plate, and lemon verbena tea) was wonderful. love the approach: minimal aesthetic & plates ~ a thoughtful kind of simplicity. beautiful :) a little place with a great sense of community || Amazing place! Loved the coffee, the staff and the atmosphere. I will definitely come back for more. The owner is really nice and explained us a lot about coffee, and we could tell this was really good quality. Loved it! || TACT is a fantastic specialty coffee spot in Lisbon! I loved both their milk-based drinks, espresso, and filter—it’s rare to find a place where everything tastes great. Their breakfasts are delicious, especially the cherry cheesecake and sourdough bread. The interior is beautifully designed, with vintage furniture tableware. You can also buy a variety of coffee beans. Highly recommend! || We’ve enjoyed the time we’ve spent here. Cappuccino, baked cottage cheese and cookies were really delicious. Baristas are friendly and welcoming

A lovely cafe with delicious food and nice service! We had the tuna salad and tried the passion fruit tart for dessert and both were delicious. It's a laptop friendly location and the wifi works good. The staff is friendly! Will come back here for sure. || Here you will find great coffee and sandwiches, and beyond any words service is so good that I can’t believe it’s just a local cafe across the road. I wish these guys to grow and thrive. It’s a hidden gem in Lisbon! || This banana dessert is straight-up divine — the combo of ingredients and flavors just melts in your mouth. Massive respect to whoever came up with this recipe, and big thanks to the café owners for keeping the bar so damn high. 🔥🍌 || Great food and very friendly staff. I'm coming here every two weeks for their amazing avocado toast 😊 nice coffee and cinnamon rolls as well!! || A café with quality cuisine and generous portions. Very pleasant and fast service. A modern, cozy, and pet-friendly place. My favorite spot for breakfast or lunch in Lisbon with a lovely outdoor terrace. || Generally I love to drink black coffee, and it’s nice to see that the options of beans and varieties are endless at A20. Easily one of the friendliest and well made coffee shops you’ll find in the area. || Had latte and a slice of lemon cake. Seems a convenient place to work with laptop as I saw many of them working there. Service and food were normal and nothing really special. Feel a bit pricy too. || We had an amazing experience at this café! The breakfast options were fantastic, and everything was fresh and delicious. We had the tuna salad, which was perfectly seasoned. My friend had the turkey sandwich, and it was absolutely mouthwatering—so flavorful and perfectly balanced. We also enjoyed two cappuccinos, and they were spot on, with rich, velvety foam and just the right amount of espresso. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, making it the perfect spot to start the day. We'll definitely be coming back! || Was super impressed with this quaint little coffee shop with a trendy vibe. Ordered an iced vanilla latte and enjoyed the earthy wood tones and greenery that gave the space a really calming ambience. Would definitely recommend! || ☕🦄 🐫🧜‍♀️Coffee with personality… and sometimes a tail! This café is pure foam magic! You order a cappuccino — and suddenly there’s a seahorse swimming in your cup or a camel casually strolling across the milk. One time I even got a unicorn🦄  The barista here doesn’t just make coffee — they lift your mood with every cup. Your spirits rise faster than your caffeine levels. If you want your morning to start with a smile — and maybe a mythical creature — this is the place! || Thank you sooo much for such a warm review!🤗🤗🤗 … || Absolutely loved this place! The atmosphere is cozy and pleasant, the staff is extremely friendly, and the food is delicious. But the highlight for me is the coffee - hands down the best in Lisbon. A perfect spot to start the day or enjoy a slow afternoon. Highly recommend! || One in a million in Lisbon where I can work on my laptop and they have air conditioning ❤️ thank you! Also coffee and croissants and passion fruit tart are amazing! || SERIOUSLY good coffee - in the heart of Areeiro and well worth the stop! Heck, I’d even go out of my way for the brisket sandwich😍  Charming little oasis for coffee, breakfast, or a quick pastry. The brisket sandwich (ate it before I could snap a photo) is absolutely delicious!!!  The owners collaborate with all local producers for their coffee and have freshly baked pastries  and bolo (cakes) everyday as well.  Stop and enjoy some high quality coffee if you’re looking for a great vibe, delicious pastry/snack, and fantastic coffee! || We had the pastrami sandwich and the avocado toast. Both were excellent. The pastrami was amazing. Fresh tomatoes and a great sauce. The avocado toast was refreshing with flavorful evoo and the bread was wonderful. Only wish they put more pastrami on the sandwich lol || We tried pastrami sandwiches and a pastrami salad - great taste, pastrami was delicious 😋 I’d recommend the place not only for foodies but for specialty coffee lovers. Double espresso, flat white, espresso tonic and counting. Finally, I’d like to thank the hosts for hospitality and true Ukrainian spirit 🇺🇦 || I recently visited this cozy coffee shop, and it was fantastic! The coffee is superb—rich and perfectly brewed. Service is top-notch with friendly, attentive staff. The food is fresh and flavorful, but the desserts steal the show: the cinnamon roll is warm, gooey perfection, and the carrot cake is moist and spiced just right.  Highly recommend—five stars! || One of the best cafe near here!  I had a smoke salmon morning set. They offered breads instead of croissants, and the toasted breads were crunchy and delicious😋 The salmon and salad also taste good. The price was reasonable.  The staff was very kind, and the atmosphere was brilliant 🤩  Moreover, WiFi is available here🛜 || The pastrami sandwich ❤️ wow  The latte is also delicious! Very good place for a quick breakfast. || I have been here for two times and every of them was incredible. First one was take away latte on oat milk, second one was late and breakfast with salmon salad. Service was polite, friendly and fast. Also looked at this beautiful pictures! І highly recommend you this cafe!) || I picked the place in advance and it didn't disappoint – a great V60 Columbia with tasty pastrami and an excellent coconut cake to finish some old Coldplay tunes and I was happy. Thank you very much for a pleasant start to the day. Muito obrigado || I actually really like this place. Coffee is great. Usual roasteries represented but unlike many other specialty coffee places this one is also a pleasure to be at. Everyone is super nice. I felt welcome here. There are tables outside. Menu is simple and filling. Kiddo got babychino and was asked about his food preferences ❤️Prices are reasonable. Thank you for having us! || Yummy avocado toast and coffee was excellent!  Wish the portions for coffee were a little bigger. Want to come back and try more things from their menu! || We were not lucky enough to have a good coffee here. The waiter forgot about our order and the coffee was decent. The background music (pop hits from 00s) doesn't fit the space. || This place was very nice, coffee was great and we had amazing sandwiches. However the banana bread and orange cake wasn’t the best thing I ever had, but still we liked it. || My first coffee stop each morning. I live the fresh smell of pastries coming out of the oven and frequently greetings. Great coffee to start my day. || The hot chocolate was too small and concentrated/sweet - very sickly. Could be resolved if they served it in a bigger cup with more milk. Was very warm and stuffy in the cafe, despite it being a cooler day. Aircon didn't seem to be working - would benefit from a fan. || This is the best specialty coffee my wife and I had in Portugal, and we ended up coming here a few days in a row while staying in a nearby hotel.  The staff are passionate about the coffee they brew and are happy to talk coffee with the customers, have many bean varieties to choose from as well as many brewing methods available.  The pastries were also very good! || The pastrami sandwich was truly A+. Every ingredient on the sandwich was so well prepared, especially the pastrami. Other highlights were the banana bread and lemon cake. || We had family breakfast and it was  delicious , and as plus hot chocolate comes with a latte art which kids just loved :) || Wonderful staff and a great breakfast option.  The very fresh avocado toast was delicious, the a wide variety of pasties looked really good.

One of the coziest vibes in Lisbon! The staff was friendly and extremely accommodating to one of our guests that had extreme allergies. Food was generous portions and delicious. Coffee too. First time and definitely not the last time. Kudos Brooklyn! || Such a lovely and cozy café with a warm atmosphere and a wonderful view. The coffee was rich and smooth, and the toasts were absolutely perfect, crispy, cheesy, and full of flavor…The place has a relaxing vibe, friendly staff, and is great for a slow morning or brunch with friends. || Absolutely gem of a place behind our hotel visited 3 times for breakfast and had excellent service from staff /owners and fresh ingredients ! Even when we switched a few items around was v helpful .. and great coffee ! Highly recommend ! || Spent 6 days in Lisbon, ate here every morning. The one day it was closed, we missed it terribly.  Great, fresh food, good prices, cozy place, smooth coffee, nice servers. 11-13 euros for a full breakfast with a hot drink of your choice and fresh squeezed orange juice. Never seen a better breakfast deal.  This was also the ONLY place we encountered during our time here that gave us water at no charge. Thanks all, we’ll miss Brooklyn! || Go here for the vibe, not the food.  The space is magical, the most perfect Black diaspora aesthetic. But the food was made for a local palate.  Pictured here is the “jollof and chicken”. 🤔 || We enjoyed the food though we were disappointed from the service which toke time and when served all. Thee orders are mixed up and toke another time to fix it The atmosphere is average though its too american style || Brooklyn Café Resto is a great little spot right near Jardim da Estrela in Lisbon. It has a strong New York-style vibe, from the decor to the menu, and makes for a perfect stop if you're exploring the area.  We tried the cortado and cappuccino, both of which were excellent, smooth and well balanced. They also offer fresh fruit, juices, and warm croissants that were perfect for a light and satisfying breakfast.  The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, with a view of the park just steps away. If you're in the area and looking for quality coffee and a chill vibe, Brooklyn Café is definitely worth a visit. || We had a great breakfast on the last day of our trip in Lisbon at this cozy café. The food was fresh, prepared quickly, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. || Lovely customer service from the staff, helpful and they love to help the tourists highly recommended for morning coffee and breakfast 😀 😊 || We had such a great breakfast here. American and Comfort Breakfast were to the point. We loved both. They come with orange juice and a hot drink of your choice for around €11. Affordable and at the same time of high quality. Highly recommended. || Hi! 😊 Thanks for your review. We hope to see you soon! 🙌🏼 …

Amazing place, loved the food, loved the atmosphere, everything was 10/10. Can’t imagine how much the copper ducting out of the bread oven cost, but they did it for us, for it to look amazing. This thoughtfulness extends into every part of the experience and the food as well. Bread for all menu items was dense, crispy, soft, delicious. Coffees were also top notch. They have outdoor seating with beautiful trees above and a view to the tower, just amazing. We’ll definitely be coming back here every morning as our “default” breakfast spot. || Had a café latte and rye avocado salmon toast — both were absolutely delicious! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was lovely, with a charming patio shaded by trees that added to the relaxing vibe. A perfect spot to unwind and enjoy great food and coffee. Highly recommend! ☕🥑🐟 || The Copenhagen coffee lab in central Lisbon was so chilled, service was good and there were so many sweet treats and wholesome food from croissants to lovely sandwiches.  I got an english breakfast tea with oat milk and a salmon sandwich. A good place for brunch & breakfast.  I wanted to have a try of their popular pizza, but they sold out by 4 pm, so if your thinking of ordering it do it. || The food is really good, their service is the best! And I think I ate the best cinnamon bun I have ever tried!!!! So yummy , The coffee is good too || We stayed at the Hotel da Baixa but we skipped their breakfast to eat here instead. For pastry lovers, try everything!! Their coffee also got us into the right mood to explore the city ❤️ || we came here every day during our stay. everything we got was amazing! the almond croissant was incredible. every employee we crossed paths with was so delightful as well. thanks! || Copenhagen, coffee lab was a great place for a midday pick me up! The drinks were delicious and the staff was friendly! You can find locations all over Lisbon, and there is a good consistency of quality across them all! They have a huge food selection so it’s also a good place for a quick lunch! || This café and brunch spot, which offers baked goods, serves mediocre coffee at a higher price point. However, its breakfast options provide great value for those looking to stay full until evening. The full breakfast plate, priced at €12 and including a drink, feels like a bargain compared to other brunch spots. The stylish, modern setting adds to its appeal, and ordering is convenient with a QR code system or a fast-food-style queue where customers receive a table number.  That said, the food itself is unremarkable, with simple, forgettable flavors. The coffee is passable, and the meal leans heavily on bread—offering three types of flour per plate, which fills you up but not in a satisfying way. While there is plenty of choice, most options revolve around different bread types and egg preparations. A nice touch is the inclusion of jam, but the ham and cheese feel cheap and rushed, resembling something from a kindergarten meal. An improvement in quality or their removal altogether would benefit the overall experience.  Ultimately, this spot feels more like a budget-friendly stop rather than an ideal way to start a day of exploring Lisbon. || The mozzarella and tomato sandwich and the yogurt were really good. The berry matcha, however, wasn’t great - there was too much berry purée and not enough matcha flavor || I really enjoyed the atmosphere. When you are sitting outside, you see the famous Lisbon lift. And especially early in the morning when there are only a few people outside its amazing experience.  Staff is friendly. Coffee and food are delicious. Big plus was for us that our hotel is literally across the street. If you plan to travel to Lisbon, this is the place to have breakfast and good coffee. || Yummy and well priced pastries! The cardamom bun was our favorite. || Overpriced coffee and small portions. You cannot charge 4,5 for a coffee with milk while the espresso costs 1€, so you’re charging me 3,5 for a small cup of milk?🤣 no thanks. Never coming back. It’s made only for tourists. Nice staff lady though. || Great place, great coffee, great service. This was a recurrent place to go for us, we loved it. Chicken and bacon bun is delicious! Totally recommend. || A very good café latte here. Lovely range of pasties, sandwiches and buns too. Disappointed our almond croissants had a lot of chocolate in them, which was not in the description. Seating outside is basic and on a slope. || Lovely little cafe! My wife and I stopped here almost every morning to start our day on our vacation in Lisbon. Delicious coffees, chai lattes, and the pastries were also always fresh. || One of the best decaf cappuccinos! Very cute coffee shop with a patio seating outside. Friendly staff! They got plant-based options too for the beverages. The hot chocolate was also great I hear! Would love to visit again! || First of all the building where this coffee shop is located is very beautiful. The coffee was good and the cardamom bun - delicious!  Barista was very friendly and sweet. And I really liked the vibe here! || Excellent coffee and food, super polite and friendly people working. There was some loud construction happening on a building nearby, so I took my order to go. They put my croissants in nice little boxes. The flavor was as good at it looked. I wish I had taken a picture. || This is a great little café that is worth checking out. The pastries are very fresh and the prices are quite reasonable. There are lots of sweet pastries, but there are also prepared sandwiches and made to order light dishes such as scrambled eggs if you're in need of something more savoury than sweet.  The staff were all very friendly and helpful, making some suggestions when we couldn't decide on our first visit.  There is a small seating area inside in addition to many tables outside. Bathrooms are up a flight of stairs, and were quite clean, but are unfortunately not wheelchair accessible.  Everything we ordered was an absolute delight. We had a soft boiled egg on rye, scrambled eggs on a croissant, a couple of cinnamon cream pastries, and some coffee.  The place also has a nice atmosphere, so if you're looking for a little snack and a break from the day, this place is worth considering. || Copenhagen Coffee Lab - Baixa is not a typical Danish cafe, even if the name suggests. They have a good selection of different things on the menu, but unfortunately no Danish cakes 🤓 🇩🇰 You can also order pizza here and they look lovely. It is possible to eat outside, but also inside. However, you should be aware that the place is not very large, so there are not many seats inside. We can definitely recommend this place. We give them 4 thumbs up👍👍👍👍

Great speciality coffee, it’s the best coffee we’ve had in Lisbon and became our go-to spot to grab a cup in the morning.  Nice ambiance inside if you wish to stay and enjoy your drink inside. It is more expensive than other coffee shops, about US$5.50 for an oat latte but we’re very satisfied with what we paid for. || Fábrica Coffee Roasters in Santos is everything I look for in a coffee spot: consistent, thoughtful, and grounded in real craft.  We ordered two flat whites with their lighter roast, and both were exceptional. The flavor had that clean brightness with notes of lime, caramel, and tropical fruit, but it stayed balanced and smooth the whole way through. The milk texture was silky and just right.  Sofia and Joy were behind the bar and brought both care and kindness to every step. You can tell they love what they do.  The Santos location, tucked on Rua da Esperança near the National Museum of Ancient Art, feels calm and inviting, with a relaxed energy that makes you want to linger. Fábrica roasts their own beans here in Lisbon and helped shape the city’s specialty coffee scene, which really shows in the quality.  No frills, no hype. Just great coffee done well. I’ll definitely be back. || If I could give 0 stars I would. The store closes at 5pm and we arrived at 4:30pm, with 30 minutes left to closing. Was greeted with an eye roll from the barista who said fine to our order but no sitting just takeout, when there were still other people sitting in the cafe using their laptops. Coffee was poorly made, barista said there were no straws and no caps but we also weren’t allowed to stay in the shop to finish the drink. I was also overcharged for some reason (€7.26 for an iced latte and a pastel de nata??? I thought the coffee was €3.5 or €4???) It’s hard not to think that this is some sort of discrimination. I mean I know how people might feel about expats here in the city of Lisbon but damn we’re just tourists traveling here. Is this level of aggression geared towards foreigners or just Asians? Hard to tell. || The coffee is amazing and this is undoubtedly the best almond croissant I’ve had - it is called almond double baked 🥵 Good environment and service from the staff, thank you!! 🥐 … || Really good coffee! The latte is so creamy 😍 The service is one of the quickest here - got my takeaway from entering and leaving in just a minute 👌 Their croissants are also absolutely delicious and feel like they are made by a French croissant artisan. Absolutely amazing! A bit more expensive but definitely worth it. || The coffee was good, leaning toward the sour side with a slightly bitter aftertaste. Service, however, was less welcoming — the owner managed to serve us without even a hint of a smile, coming across as a bit arrogant and unfriendly. It’s a decent spot to stop by if you’re nearby, but definitely not a place worth going out of your way for. || The chocolate croissant was really yummy! Very flaky outside and soft inside, which was the perfect combo for me.  The latte had a nice latte art and the flavor was good as well. We specially loved that it was opened early since most other places open at 9 am. || One of the best coffee I’ve ever had! Highly recommend getting the iced latte with oat-milk! I came here on both days that I was in Lisbon because the coffee was that good. You’re able to sit inside or outside and everyone is also incredibly friendly :) can also recommend getting the croissant which was super soft and delicious! || my most favorite cafe in whole Lisbon! I come here on a regular basis and no coffee is as good as theirs 😇 … || Perfect latte cheers my day  Today, I have a great time in Fábrica, it's so convenient to exchange oat milk from regular milk in Europe without asking. There are several optional for someone who wants to avoid taking milk. Well medium roast with nice temperature milk combination, feeling good🥰 || Disappointed in pastries Baked food lacking in flavor Bought a snail - dry And pain au chocolat - also dry  Seemed like yesterdays goods Not fresh for being 10am  For the price… it was a miss  Sour dough loaf is good. || A fab coffee in Lisboa. This from a self professed Melbourne (Australia ) coffee snob!! Good strong & flavourful coffee and delicious sweet treats with not a pastel di nata in sight. Highly recommended. Oh and they have Prana Chai all the way from Melbourne !! || Great coffee, cozy tables inside, very welcoming staff, nice music. Fresh-baked bread for 3.5€ – right from the stove and really delicious. Unfortunately no WiFi or sockets available, so it's not a place to work from. || Great specialty coffee, can totally recommend it to everyone. After visiting Lisbon and this coffee shop, we started to order their freshly ground coffee for our moka pot online and it also was an excellent experience, very fast next day delivery. || OK, after going here for the last four days I can say with certainty that the beans used and method of preparing the espresso is the best I've had this year even when compared to the specialty coffee cafés in my Paris neighborhood. The Patel de nata had less cream filling than some of the other patisserie shops but it was sweeter. Savory spinach feta brioche was a great balance of textures and flavor. The barristas are friendly and welcoming. || Very nasty food, your typical vegan place run by hippies. they sell pastel de nata for €1.90 while others sell it for 1.40 which are way way better, it tasted like it was from the supermarket, cinnamon rolls are nasty, do not come here it’s a tourist trap || Super nice and modern coffee shop, I bought different coffee beans there for my espresso machine and their taste is fine☺️ || We chose sweet Colombia beans with strawberry notes for V60. The coffee was great. The best was their fresh chewy brownie cookies. Absolutely delicious! || The best coffee (long black/flat white) I had in Lisbon (and maybe in Europe!) Friendly barista, nice vibe. || Great coffee here. I had a decaf flat white with oat milk, and also bought a of the beans

Ivo was fantastic and gave us excellent, friendly service. He even let us know of other places to visit from the same owners. We will be checking each one of them as the food here at Heim was five star quality. Fresh ingredients and excellent skill went into each of the dishes preparation and presentation. Don’t skip the coffee cream pancakes as they are a delicious treat! The lucky avocado was delicious as well and the coffee was perfect. The atmosphere was very laid back and welcoming, we cannot wait to try the rest of the menu on our future visits. Enjoy! || I had such an exceptional experience here I came back twice in one week! Laura and Sangita were both so welcoming both times. They were both very attentive and had such lovely personalities. Not to mention the food was phenomenal! I will definitely be back my next time around back in Lisbon. || Hi Brittany, Coming back twice in one week is the biggest compliment 💛 We’re so happy Laura and Sangita made you feel so welcome — they’ll love reading this. And knowing the food kept you coming back makes us smile big. See you next time you’re in Lisbon! … || Super cute breakfast/brunch spot in Santos area. Food was great with selections of sweet and savoury options depending on what you fancy. We went for sweet this time round. Loved it. || Hi Sahar, So glad you enjoyed it 💛 Sweet brunch moments are the best — happy you loved the food and the vibe. Come back anytime! … || We had a wonderful experience at Heim for brunch today! The service was friendly and welcoming, as well as really efficient. Laura made our visit especially enjoyable! The coffee was delicious, one of the best we’ve had in Lisbon. I had the Avocado toast and was really impressed by the variance of flavours and freshness of the bread it was served on. The coffee cream and cherry Pancakes were delicious. The menu had a lot of great options which made it hard to choose but that just means we’ll be back very soon to try some more! Thanks to all of the team at Heim! :) || Had an amazing brunch here! 😍 Food was really tasty and also looked amazing. Friendly staff. The place can get a bit overcrowded - typical brunch spot. But worth it for sure. || Hi Embraceluna, So glad you enjoyed your brunch with us 💛 Tasty food, friendly faces, and a buzzing brunch atmosphere — that’s very Heim. Thanks for the kind words! … || The matcha latte was surprisingly really good. It comes unsweetened so I asked for syrup on the side and it was perfect. I also got the granola with blueberry yogurt and it was probably the best granola I’ve ever had! The service was also amazing, the staff are friendly and welcoming || I'm a sucker for good coffee, and whenever I'm on holiday, I always try to find the best breakfast spot in town. Heim Cafe is definitely the winner! I honestly hope they’ll expand to other cities because everything here is just as it should be.  First of all, the coffee is amazing (latte lovers know how hard it is to find a truly good one). The breakfast is delicious with plenty of options. The atmosphere is lovely, with great music, good books, and friendly staff. I also loved their design, thumbs up for that too.  The place is always full, and that says it all. Keep up the great work! :) || The coffee pancakes were delicious! I also got the green egg scramble and it was a bit underwhelming with the flavors sadly. The service was perfect however and the food came out very fast! Great place to relax and journal on a Saturday afternoon :) || Heim is a cozy, relaxed brunch spot tucked into the Santos neighborhood. Bright and welcoming, with an easy flow that makes you want to slow down and stay a while. The staff were warm and attentive, checking in without hovering and keeping things moving with ease. Everything felt relaxed but intentional.  We had two flat whites made with their medium roast. I usually go for light roasts, but this one surprised me—in the best way. Smooth, balanced, and gently sweet, with milk that was perfectly textured all the way through.  The almond croissant was one of the best I’ve had. Flaky, golden, and filled with a soft almond center that felt just sweet enough. Crisp on the outside, buttery all the way through, and thoughtfully made.  Heim does brunch well. Great coffee, standout pastries, and a space that feels lived in but still fresh. It’s already on my list to return. || Laura was a lovely friendly host made our experience perfect. Food was incredible and best coffee we had all trip. Salty mocha I will be trying to replicate at home

The single only place I’ve found that does delicious dark roast coffee in all of Lisbon. Tastes deliciously rich and robusta like. Owner mentioned beans from Honduras. I was so excited I drank the coffees and forgot to take a pic. If you like your dark/robusta roasts, come here!!  Food is great too. Gluten free options available. || The food was so delicious, coffee was rich, and they're so friendly! Love this place and the vibes downstairs are great. || Finding this hidden amazing cafe was surprising and exciting. Staff are super friendly and nice. Coffee and matcha were so tasty. They are professionals. The atmosphere and design is fascinating. Couches are extremely comfortable. Can’t wait to go there again. || A wonderfully chill place with a heart. We went there on a Saturday night maybe an hour before closing time and it was fairly quiet (like the whole area). My wife had a tuna tataki, the kids wanted guacamole (the chips, really) and I had the quiche with salad. The gentleman who received us made us instantly feel welcome, and his food was fantastic! The quiche crust was crunchy yet not dry, the salad not overcooked or drenched in sauce. The tataki was beautiful and the guacamole was so smooth! The kids loved their drinks : the yellow smoothie and the iced chocolate. Very generous portions for the drinks, too! Next day I tried the caipirinha and it did not disappoint. Despite all the ice, I could taste the cachaça till the end! I asked for a bit extra crisps for the kids' guacamole and he gave them enough to be sated. When I was still enjoying my caipirinha, he came over and offered the kids some colouring books to keep themselves occupied for a little bit. A gesture i very much appreciated! I only wish I was staying a bit longer to come back enjoy this wonderful place and enjoy another nice drink while chilling in the amazing sofas and listening to the music. I forgot to mention the sofas? Yeah, the place has got normal tables, the sofas and some other tables in the gallery, and for the brave you can also eat outside on the street. It's a tram line, but the area is rather quiet so it's probably enjoyable once the heat and the evening wind calm down. Anyway, saved for next time, and I'll be sure to let anyone going to Lisbon about this place, haha! || 10000000 % of satisfaction! Always good staff, perfect specialty coffee and the price! Thank you for doing your good well || Such a surprise to finally get to this place. It is inside with steps going down. You entre a small shopping centre with an art atelier, two restaurants, some shops and two beauty salons. We tried Mude and it was healthy and delicious, with good prices. || I'm really liking this place. Their coffee and food are both great. Prices are good for the location and quality of what they serve.  The seating is either inside downstairs or outside on the balcony next to the street. They have done some work to make the inside interesting so it isn't bland sitting inside underground.  The chicken salad is one of my favorite food items. It's also a really nice bonus that they give you a large water carafe with a slice of orange. I wish every place in Lisbon did this.  The staff are all super friendly || Really nice food, service and atmosphere. We got the zucchini toast and tex mex toast. Everything was lovely. Very good quality. Congratulations. || food as simple, as it was delicious; the quinoa salad was super fresh, with real, flavourful olive oil and crunchy cucumber. the zucchini toast perfectly combined some fresh, roasted, delicate and robust flavours. what's more, the coffee really stood out || The place is downstairs. It is quite a small cafe but the coffee was very delicious and cheap. The staff was very friendly. They brought out their board games for us after seeing us playing UNO.

Cozy and quiet cafe with really amazing coffee, some of the best I had in all of Lisbon. Their menu has some Asian inspired options and a few good breakfast choices too. We were satisfied with the food and the service was great. They paid attention to us and asked how everything was and made sure we liked everything. I’d highly recommend trying them out!  Quiet, and delicious!  9/10 || One of my absolute fav places for brunch, good coffee and place to work from in Lisbon! Super kind staff, incredible food (love the okonomiyaki and pistachio cookie!) and always a nice calm vibe! || Thank you do you review ❤️ || Cute place to brunch! The okonomiyaki is beautifully plated and tastes great, too. The vegan avocado toast looked in comparison less impressive, although you can taste the avocado has great quality! || Appreciate you review thank you || Love this cozy cafe so much, my husband and I found Dedes on a trip to Lisbon two years ago and came almost every day of our trip. Just came back today and it was still just as great. Great food, amazing coffee, and kind servers. Highly recommend:) || Thank you so much 🧡 … || Really amazing brunch, probably one of the best I’ve ever had. Loved the space and the atmosphere and I hope to have time to come back. I can’t recommend the Japanese pancakes enough!! Definitely check this place out ❤️ || We loved this spot! Cute interior, good music, great service, and food was delicious. We had okonomoyaki, peri peri scramble, and acai bowl. Would recommend them all! || Great flavor. If you come add to your order the Dede brunch, the banana bread is very tasty, the moka it’s a great complement || The best restaurant in Lisboa… I visited three times for breakfast and it was delicious. || A wonderful little cafe with a gorgeous aesthetic! We would recommend the bacon & egg bun with avocado, the coffee was delicious and we loved the mimosas too. || Had the brunch menu (orange juice, choice of coffee, entree, and banana bread) and opted for latte and avocado toast.  The best latte I’ve had so far in Lisbon after weeks of trying out many brunch spots! They take their coffee seriously and it shows :)  The banana bread was so good and the best way to end the meal.  Great value brunch & worth the trip! || Dede’s is worth a special trip! Catch the 28 tram and end up here for brunch. It’s the best brunch that we’ve had, not just in Lisbon, but in over a year traveling through Europe. The coffee was exceptionally good (even by Australian standards), with a delicious ANZAC biscuit to top it off. The food was exceptional - four of us all completely cleaned our plates. They also had terrific beer and wine, and the service was great. My dad loved the okonomiyaki (savory Japanese pancakes) so much. The owner generously shared the recipe with him, and he is going to try to make them at home. Absolute perfection - our only regret is that we wish that we had an opportunity to come back again! || Thanks for your kind review, Stephanie. Glad your dad enjoyed the okonomiyaki and I hope he recreates the pancakes at home for you! :) || We had an amazing time here. The food was delicious, the waiter friendly and kind. He even helped us to choose from the menu. He said that the chef changes the menu often so you cannot find help in the photos from the internet. It is better to ask him and you will choose wisely, as we did. The place is small but cozy. ☺️ || What a gem - and definitely not your everyday brunch! One of our absolute favourites in Lisbon!  A friend recommended Dede’s as a still relatively unknown but extraordinary breakfast spot and we were not disappointed! The brunch menu is an awesome deal for about 15€ with which you get one main dish, a big (and absolutely delicious) piece of banana bread, any choice of coffee from the menu plus a cute little bottle of fresh orange juice - and as much cold water as you like. We loved (!) the iced coffee and the Japanese egg pancakes were amazing. All of the sauces are to die for!  The food is not only awesome in taste and quality but it also looks like a small piece of art. The dishes are unusual and great to try something new. This is definitely for anyone who’s a little bored of the standard granola bowl and pancakes 😉  The place is beautifully furnished and decorated! Unfortunately it’s a little hidden away and there is no outdoor seating but the stunning inside makes you forget about that really quickly. The staff was also incredibly friendly and helpful!  We definitely recommend this to anyone looking for an awesome brunch experience in Lisbon! || Hey Marie! Wow! Thanks for taking the time to write such a warm and detailed review, we really really appreciate it. You'll be pleased to know we have finally been council approved for some outdoor seats, so next time you come you can sit outside! Thanks again for your kind words. :) || Dede’s was a treat. A Friend recommended this place to me and I didn’t know what to expect but the breakfast/ brunch was amazing. The staff were relaxed and helpful. Service was good. The prices were solid as well considering how pricing for food is around Lisbon. The banana bread is delicious and avocado smash toast is delicious as well. It was topped with different ingredients I never had before on a toast. Definitely will return || We loved this space. Took the brunch option with okonomiyaki and the Dede’s bowl as mains which were very delicious and filling (even for my hungry bf). Also great freshly pressed orange juice, banana bread and coffee for a fair price. We‘d definitely recommend 😋 || Delicious coffee. Pleasant service. Unusual vegan dishes on the menu. My order is BBQ KOREAN JACKFRUIT. I really liked it! The special menu pleased me: salad with broccoli and eggplant, fried cherry tomatoes, juicy arugula. Fluffy pancakes at home with berries and syrup || I was boring and ordered their signature pancakes and holy moly they were delish!!! Love this place and will come back for SURE! || Small laid back cafe with great coffee and nice food. Perfect for breakfast or a quick snack. They have vegetarian and vegan options.  Service was very friendly and the Okonomiyaki is a must-try! || Great little original intertwining brunch spot, with Japanese choices alongside eggs and the norm. Friendly staff and nice vibe, recommend! || Gorgeously tasty and creative food with a great ethos and atmosphere! The food was delicious, particularly love the fusion of brunch food with Asian dishes - the okonomiyaki was fabulous! They have speciality coffee too which is a rarity in Lisbon, really good cold brew. Dede was very charming and we'll  definitely come again 🤠🤠 and buy some pickles ! || Thank you for this amazing review

place_name: Mila - Santos - Specialty Coffee, Brunch & Salad Bar
reviews_content: Mila’s breakfast plate and pancakes were delicious. The cafe is very cosy, with good music and nice staff. Thanks to them again for this good moment and giving water to the dog. || Had breakfast at Mila Santos and everything was excellent. The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The service was just as impressive—friendly, attentive, and welcoming without being overbearing. A great start to the day and a place I’d happily return to. Highly recommended! || The place is amazing! The smoked salmon eggs were great! I had them with gluten free bread which is cool they have that option! And the flat white with almond milk was the best! I’ll sure come back || I had breakfast here this morning and everything was perfect. The staff were so friendly and attentive, especially the waitress (Victoria) who was incredibly kind. I have a few dietary preferences, and she was very accommodating. The food was delicious, the atmosphere warm, and I left feeling happy and nourished. Highly recommend! || We enjoyed the brunch with salmon Benedict and the Avocado toast. We received granola and an orange juice with it. It was super delicious and already our second time here. If you are looking for a cute place for breakfast/ brunch/ lunch, away from the tourists, this is it. || Easy to get a table, quite cute round ones and the atmosphere is really nice, quiet even when loads of people there. The service was really sweet, waitor took our order quickly and food and drinks arrived within 10 minutes. The coffee was really really good, a lot of places roast their beans too much, this was perfect. Food looked simple but the flavours was amazing, best yogurt bowl I have ever had and the dressing for the salad with our Eggs Benedict was fantastic. Pain au Chocolat was a little underwhelming as it was under baked, but we got a new one after asking - everything was spot on 😎🤩💪 || The food is healthier and delicious. Portions are good enough. We took the Mila’s breakfast and a large salad and all was delicious. For the large salad, you’ll have to choose among the food that they have at the counter. Juices were not super strong in terms of taste but still good.  The staff is very kind and welcoming and super helpful when it came to suggestions about what to see in the city.  The atmosphere of the area is really characteristic. We sat outside because inside felt a little hot. However, if you are planning a longer stop I would suggest stay inside because it looks cosier. || Such a gem in Lisbon! I came in right after landing and it instantly became my favorite spot. Amazing breakfast, great coffee, and the atmosphere is full of good energy. You feel like staying for hours and I did. Highly recommend Mila! || I’m staying for the weekend for the first time in Lisbon for friends getting married. Staying local and popped in here. So glad I did. Had an early 3am start from the UK. Breakfast was delicious. Poached eggs on toast. Attention to detail and loved the touch of seeds and tomato salsa around the edge of the plate. Comp bottle of water and lovely, friendly service. More of this please Portugal, you’re not disappointing! 🙌🏼👍🏼💫 || The breakfast options are varied and cater to all tastes—everything was both delicious and filling. We ordered a flat white, and it was genuinely one of the best I’ve had in a long time :) The staff were kind and attentive, and the place was spotless. I also really appreciated the open kitchen setup—it made me feel confident about the hygiene. Definitely recommend! || The food is great especially the bacon and egg bun. The environment is chill and relaxed. || Loved the food and service at Mila! The iced vanilla latte was also really good, not too sweet, and something that I really needed for a hot summer day. Would return for more of the chicken kebab and coffee. || Loved this place! I landed in Lisbon this morning and stopped at Mila for breakfast ended up staying through lunch. Great food, cozy vibe, and lots of young, friendly energy. Perfect spot to relax after a flight or work on your laptop. Definitely coming back! || The portion is really big. Fresh ingredients, the scrambled egg was cooked to perfection and the coffee is great quality. I’ll definitely be back! || Amazing brunch deal! Brilliant way to start a Sunday after a run down the coast! Food was awesome and the service was 5 star! || Staff amazing! Food delicious. Definitely recommending. If you’re a tea/coffee drinker - always go for the bigger size cup. Thank me later 😉 || 2nd time here - we LOVE Mila's!! The menu offers pleasantly different dishes and everything we had was perfectly prepared and fantastic! It is the perfect, unpretentious, off the beaten path, local spot. Busy but not full of loud tourists. Staff is really friendly. Place has the perfect vibe. || Very friendly staff and delicious food! I ordered the Chicken Kebab Plate. It's located on a little street not far from Santos train station, super easy to get to! || the food was amazing! we had a chicken mayo sandwich, pink salmon sandwich and double cheeseburger. everything was fresh and nice portions. The interior could use just a little bit of TLC, but overall we enjoyed our meal and experience. || Everything was great! Food was amazing!! I got the Mila Breakfast and it was just 👌 Staff were also very friendly and the space was quiet on a Saturday morning!

I love this place. The decorative theme is on-point (hat tip to the Marshall amp-looking Bluetooth speaker and the skateboard imagery) and the batch brew and chai latte with oat milk were among the best I've had. Great little spot! || One of the best chocolate croissants I had. The coffee is amazing and the place is cute. Unfortunately it’s quite pricey and the iced latte takeaway is not so big. An oat latte is 5.50€. || Absolutely perfect place! As someone who has worked in the specialty coffee industry for 9 years, I can say this is the highest quality of coffee beans and coffee-making. They use beans from the Danish coffee roastery La Cabra. It’s a paradise for coffee lovers, especially after visiting ‘traditional’ coffee shops. Just look at this amazing latte art on the cappuccino! The interior and vibe are so lovely, I don’t want to leave🩵 || Amazing cortado and very friendly barista! One of the best in Lisbon for sure. || The coffee was okay but in my opinion not a “specialty coffee”. Far away from the quality of some other specialty coffee shops in the area. €3.90 is quite a lot for that I’d say.  But what’s no comprehensible to me is the pricing of the croissants. For €6.50 I expected a really big croissant with avocado, tomato and sea salt. Instead it was a tiny one with 2 small slices of avocado. It didn’t taste bad but not even close to special enough for justifying the price. || The coffee and chai lattes are delicious. Good brewed temperature  in other words, task coffee👍🏾  The place is, however, small (buying to be done about that) and had direct sunlight in the morning hours.  Card, only. No cash accepted (and they don't take American Express! || Really good specialty coffee, good vibes. Honestly the best coffee shop in Santos. Oh, and did I say I love their gluten free cheesecake ?! Absolutely delicious. The service is also very welcoming. I just love this place. || Excellent coffee and croissants! Great service from young, cool and friendly staff. We sadly missed the Basque cheesecake, which looked amazing, but wasn’t available the next time we came. Cute mugs with smiley faces on them!! || Cool spot to grab a quick coffee. Decor is gorgeous and loved the photos on the wall (which are for sale if you’re interested). The merch is pretty nice as well. || * The place is really cute * It’s independently owned * Emilie was super nice * I find it admirable that they put the exact same coffee amount in all coffees * The price is the typical nowadays, inflation!

place_name: Escape Rooms Game Over - Santa Clara
reviews_content: It was incredibly interesting, very interactive, and extremely well designed. The special effects, the storyline, and the overall atmosphere were impressive and truly immersive. Everything was well explained and easy to follow, even though the challenges themselves are quite complex — in the best possible way.  The staff was fantastic: friendly, professional, and very attentive. A special thank you to our guide Luca, who helped us a lot and made the whole experience even more enjoyable.  I highly recommend this escape room to everyone — just make sure to choose the difficulty level wisely, as it can be quite challenging but incredibly fun. We will definitely come back and are already excited to try the other rooms.  Book in advance — it’s absolutely worth it! || Great place with a good variety of escape rooms. We had a lot of fun, the puzzles were engaging and the time flew by. Big thanks to Sara - she was welcoming and made the experience even better. We’ll definitely be back to try the other rooms. || We tried the Agrabah room this time and it was a lot of fun. The puzzles were more physical and we enjoyed the different kinds of challenges. Alexis  was our game master and she once again was very helpful. Her hints are just enough to lead you in the right direction. || We've tried multiple rooms and I only have good things to say. About the game masters, I had Luca and Rodrigo. The first one is the best and the latter I found a bit neutral and didn't help the experience itself. I would give 5 stars if all the game masters were at the same level. Apart from this I totally recommend if you like to challenge yourself. || My family and I were very impressed with this location and the number of rooms they offer. The design of the Atlantis room was really cool and the puzzles were decently hard! Alexis was very helpful throughout our adventure, offering small nudges when we looked lost or when we were going too far the wrong way. We're definitely coming back soon! Thank you! || We did the haunted hotel and it was very fun and interesting. The rooms are big and more to explore. Alexia was very nice and helped us along the way. It makes a great day out. || Great experience, really amazing and great fun. Our gane master Vaz was very helpfull and accommodating.  Reccomend and if ever in Lisbon will come back. || We played Illuminati. The rooms are nicely done. The riddles are definitely challenging. The loudness of the sound was for us too much. The two of us didn’t solve it within one hour. Propably it’s better to ask more frequently for help if you get stuck. || Amazing experience! Very fun and challenging room for our first time. The host Rodrigo was very pleasant and explained and guided us very well. Will definitely come back to try another room || What an amazing experience! I've played the scream of Agrabah with Bruna as Host and was amazing, she was a great host, helped only when is necessary! We are going to return very soon. || Wonderful experience with our gamemaster! The room “Iluminati” was awesome! We’ll come back to do their other rooms. || We had such a fun evening at the escape rooms. Our guide Sena was great, he was polite, explained evening really well and set a great scene for the escape room we chose. He was also great with the kids. Thanks for a great evening. We will definitely return! || Amazing experience - very well prepared, challenging but not too complicated. We went with 3 kids (9 years old) and we all enjoyed it so much! And Lucca, our game master, was fantastic - he gave us hints when needed, but not too many, he really challenged us and let us solve things on our own. We played the SCHOOL OF MAGIC room - highly recommended! || We enjoyed our game experience so much! Soares was an amazing game master. From the beginning he was really into character and  we felt like we were inside the Orient Express. The puzzles made sense and even though some were difficult, we were able to solve the murder mystery with success 💪 … || Great place. We did the professor mission. It is very thematic and a lot of fun. Difficulty 4/5. The game master Sena was of special mention as he made the game even more fun :D great job. Would recommend. || Played the Lost City of Atlantis with LUCA. Very cool , lost of automation making the game more reliable and rewarding. The theme was nice too and décor added to the experience. || We went to the Lost City of Atlantis room. The decor and atmosphere was nice and pretty to look at. However, the puzzles were weak. It's was more of a - find this folded piece of paper somewhere hidden on the wall several times and proceed to the next room. The game master also kept interruting our game and giving us hints unprompted. We didn't ask for help at all, but bascially got guided through the room. || It was an incredible experience. The decor is amazing. Just know that if you feel confident before the game, you will for sure feel dumb at the end 🤣 But we were so lucky to have Ruben to help us with so much kindness 😊 Thank youuu we recommend. … || We had a great time doing the Haunted Mansion with Lucca as our game master - just the right amount of clues while leaving you some time to figure the puzzles out yourself. Cool decor as well and great fun with the scares. We were two players and it was perfect. See you soon! || Amazing rooms, great themes, very friendly game master. They speak both Portuguese and English. Had a great time, so thanks a lot ! Team Tati! || Awesome fun! Challenging and interesting experience. Everything was done so well. Game Master, Atlas, was super friendly and helped us have a good time. || We went to the quest illuminati and we didn’t escape it but it was still very interesting and fun 🤩 … || We loved the Orient Express!  It’s tough- we didn’t finish I time with two people!  But it’s super fun.  Leo was a great host || Really cool experience. Our game master Alexis was amazing. It really felt like we were in Hogwarts. I’ll definitely be coming back for other rooms. || Me and my sister played the illuminati escape room and it was a very fun an intellectually challenging experience. Our host Luka was very supportive and kept the suspense of the game alive as we finished the puzzles to get the holy grail. I would recommend joining ‘game over ‘ and their escape rooms again for an intellectually challenging experience . || Pedro was very nice. He did it verry good for his first day. We had a fun time. || The room was really fun and Luca is such an awsome person qnd he deserves employee of the month, his attitude is truly inspiring😇 … || We experienced the Orient Express escape room, and it was absolutely spectacular! The immersive decor truly made us feel like we were aboard a luxurious train. The game was incredibly fun, keeping us engaged and entertained throughout. A special shout-out to our game master, Alexis, whose enthusiasm and passion for the games shone brightly. She was wonderfully kind, offering subtle hints and guidance whenever we felt a bit lost. Playing this escape room was a highlight of our trip and will definitely bring us back to Lisbon! || OMG, you guys HAVE to check out this escape room in Lisbon – it was seriously the best! The theme was all about the Illuminati and the Holy Grail, which is already super cool, right? The puzzles were incredibly clever, and we had to work together to solve them, it was challenging and so much fun. Seriously, if you're looking for an awesome activity in Lisbon, this escape room is a must-do, you won't regret it! || This escape room was so fun, so interactive, very terrifying, and very cool. We had a ton of fun playing, and I cant even count how many times i screamed because they really make the escape room very horrifying. I am going to have trouble sleeping tonight 😂. 10/10 … || We had an enjoyable time with the escape room "Scream from Agrabah". Although we arrived late, our game master Ruben ensured we could play the whole story. Some puzzles were more a "do this, than that" instead hardcore puzzling, but that's to each other's taste, even within our group. 10/10 would book again when I'm in the neighborhood. || Sara was really helpful with the clues and very nice. I loved this experience so much || We had a great experience! La misión del professor was one of the best escape rooms i ever did and Rodrigo made the experience even better! || Amazing! Was scared as hell and still have heartbumping! Great experience, nice gamemaster || We had a lot of fun in the Orient Express Room. The riddles are fun and varied, the decorations are very good - we felt like we were on the Orient Express. Our host, Soares, was also great. He was helpful but would let us experiment on our own, before giving us suggestions. || This is the first time we played in Gameover. We chose the room of Oriental Express. The design, settings, decoration and machine are really good and out of my expectation. Our host today is Alexis. She is really nice. She explained all the rules and story background clearly. During the game, she provided us appropriate hints for us to solve the puzzles but won’t spoiling too much. Will definitely come again in the near future. || Horrible customer experience. At 18h10 we called to book a room for 20h, they confirmed there was availability but told us we had to come in person to book the room. We drove there, and once we arrived at the place 10min later, the room was booked to someone else. To make things worst, the staff was really rude to us, saying it was not her fault that her colleagues gave us the wrong information. And she didn't even suggest other options, other rooms or other timings (which we would have gladly taken).  We have done 9 out of the 12 rooms, and we were their clients since the opening in Bairro Alto. But we do not tolerate rudeness from the staff. After this, we are not coming back. || Our advisor was Lucca. He was really nice and helpful! Really enjoyed! || We had so much fun. Our game master, Vaz, was very helpful and responsive. || Did the nightmare hotel room here. It was very well decorated, good difficulty puzzles, fun and diverse room! Will be going back for more. They should have a frequent customer punch card…  Update: did haunted mansion, had a great time. Game master “SERA” was terrific.

Very nice experience, shared with 3 teens from 12 to 17 + 1 adult. They all enjoyed and used 59 minutes of the 60 allocated to the game. They were amazed by the quality of the scenery, enjoyed the enigmas. They all want to return ! We appreciated the welcome room, with sofas, coffee and water as courtesy drinks. The booking was amazingly easy online, the whole experience deserves 5 stars. || We done the saw room and it was really cool I get scared so it was a bit scary for me there’s a few jump scares. Our guide was Ricardo he was very informative and very attentive. I would definitely come back and try another theme next time || I really liked the room, we finally went to the room called Forbidden Temple of Montezuma. There were 5 of us, a pleasant environment, the decoration was very nice. Our game master Sergio was very nice and when we asked for help he always gave it clearly and precisely. We wanted to go to another room, but we overlooked the location so we had to change rooms. But we had a great time. With interactive tasks and everyone could take part in the tasks.  We definitely recommend the place! || I had such an amazing time at this escape room! The space was immersive, challenging, and so much fun from start to finish. The puzzles were clever and well-designed, and everything felt really well organized.  A very special thank you to Ricardo, he absolutely made the experience. He was friendly, enthusiastic, and incredibly helpful without giving too much away. His energy set the tone and made the whole visit even better. Ricardo genuinely deserves a raise! || Great place, the temple of Doom was challenging and very fun. Thank you even wiser for this great team building experience and Ricardo for being a skilled game master. || We did Jack the Ripper and found it very interesting. We had the help of Sergio along the way and was also very nice to deal with. We will definitely try another game again. It makes a fun night out :) || Amazing experience! I have been to three of their rooms, They were all really great. The atmosphere of them is amazing and top notch production value. The puzzles are very challenging but well thought out. Our host Joana was so nice and explained everything very well. One of the best escape room experiences, and I have been at many escape rooms in many countries. Highly recommend! || Really great puzzles and atmospheric rooms. The scenic design is incredible. I wasn't feeling very well so Salamay toned down the scare which I really appreciated, and I always felt safe. But you can get really scared if you want.
