We’d love to welcome you back in the future and ensure you have a much better experience with us! || best cowork in Lisbon with many phone cabins and meetings rooms || Used today and it was a great experience. Excellent facilities, amazing, caring, lovely staff and a good culture. Really enjoyed working there. Keep up the great work. It has an amazing outdoor space with plug sockets. Happy hour on a Thursday too. My only constructive feedback would be the booths could do with a fan when it's this hot. They get hot quick but at least it encourages people to keep moving. || Thank you so much for your lovely review! 😊 We’re really happy to hear you had a great experience — from the facilities to the vibe, and especially that our team made you feel welcome. The outdoor space and happy hour are definitely some of our favorite highlights too!  Also, thank you for the helpful note about the booths — we totally get it, and we’ll look into ways to make them more comfortable on warmer days. Hope to see you back again soon! || Not only a great coworker environment and space by also has the best parties in Lisbon every week. Ask for Sara for an excellent experience. || Hi Luis, Thank you for your feedback! We are so glad to hear that you're happy at IDEA! :) || Great service, with nicely designed and comfortable interior. We organized a two-day training here and had a very pleasant experience - communication was perfect and everything went smoothly. Thanks a lot! :) || Thank you so much for your kind words! 😊 We're thrilled to hear you had a great experience organizing your training with us. It was a pleasure to host you, and we're always here to support smooth and successful events. Hope to welcome you back again soon! … || This coworking space is SO loud. Everyone takes meetings in the common working room?!!! I'm sorry, this isn't normal. I've tried it 3 times so it wasn't bad luck. I'm paying to be here and I have to listen to 5 people saying "can you see my screen?" pretty much for hours on end? The social area is also in the same space as the main work area, and people have no respect while taking their coffee, speaking loudly. I cannot focus here. Won't return and do not recommend, there are much quieter options. I honestly don't get why people don't use the small free meeting rooms. || Had a pretty disappointing experience at IDEA coworking. We rented a meeting room for 7 hours, and it was a letdown. The video conferencing gear didn't work, and despite the staff's efforts, the issue remained unresolved. The AC theoretically worked, but by the end of the day, it was impractical – the room got uncomfortably hot.  Adding to the frustration, there were only 3 power outlets in an 8-person room, and to make it worse, they were on the wall, not on the table. Seriously? It made staying connected and charged a real challenge.  The chairs were a complete joke, resembling something you'd find on a patio rather than in a professional conference room. As you can see in the photo, they were so uncomfortable that sitting in them for even an hour felt impossible, let alone enduring an entire day.  To make matters worse, most rooms are in the basement with no windows, creating a stuffy atmosphere. Plus, to top it off, the Wi-Fi isn't secure – not cool.  In conclusion, our overall experience was far from satisfactory.  EDIT: after one year my company located again this same place. I must say the space itself has improved since my last visit. However, this time, the coffee machine inside the room doesn’t work.  When I went to the outdoor area near the café to try using another machine, the owner herself told me I couldn’t use it. She was extremely rude and simply told me to find a staff member instead of trying to help or offer any solution.  She just stayed seated, doing her own work, and showed no interest in assisting clients properly. Very disappointed to the price paid. || IDEA Spaces started throwing parties, happy hours and even an annual music festival on the terrace behind their building and facing all the apartments that look inward on the block and turned our peace and quiet into a money making opportunity. Sometimes they forget to turn off the music and it plays all night long. At least I’m only renting and I can move. I feel sorry for the families that bought their flats here. || Hi Ron, thank you for taking the time to share your concerns. We’re truly sorry to hear that our events have caused any disruption. Please know that we take our neighbors’ peace seriously and always plan our gatherings with that in mind. The music festival you mentioned was a one-time event held two years ago, and whenever we host any kind of event, we strictly end by 9 PM out of respect for the community. We also have staff on-site 24/7, so music is never left playing overnight. We’re committed to being good neighbors and truly appreciate your feedback, it helps us continue improving how we coexist with those around us. || Idea Spaces is a well-managed professional space offering quiet shared offices, meeting rooms, a lounge, a terrace and free beer :). It is the perfect setting for my day-to-day activities as a Data Engineer Consultant. I love the people and the vibe of the shared office setting. It really energizes me and at the same time focuses me. The professionals who share this office are dedicated and respectful, which creates a productive work environment.

place_name: The Base Cowork Space - Coworking in Lisbon
reviews_content: Good location downtown but not noisy plus nice desks and design. The Base has a wide ambience which enhances creative work. Good service of the helpful community managers. A lot of call booths and a kitchen. Near Elevador da Gloria || Thank you Cristina. Glad you like our space! :) || Needed a quiet space to get some work done during my recent visit to Lisbon and found The Base. I found the staff to be very professional and kind. The co working space was quiet and comfortable and the perfect place to get work done. The desks and sofas are comfortable. The entire place was very neat and tastefully decorated. The kitchen is well stocked and the coffee was excellent, especially the cappuccinos! I highly recommend The Base in Lisbon! || Thank you very much for your visit Dr. Ashvin. You make our day :) Looking forward to have you back! || Great central Lisbon location, close to a lot of interesting things happening in town. The phone booths are great if you need privacy and there is free coffee and occasional social events for members. Also one of the more competitively priced coworks considering the location, I would recommend it to anybody who needs a coworking space in Central Lisbon. || While visiting Lisbon, I was looking for a community-centric coworking space and absolutely found it at The Base. I grabbed a Day Pass and really enjoyed the space. Highly recommend! || Thank you so much Clark! It means a lot for us :D || I had just landed in Lisbon, city I’m absolutely unfamiliar with, and was looking for a coworking space where to work for a few hours. The Base work space came out as one of the first suggestion and I couldn’t have been more lucky! The place is spacious, luminous, comfortable, equipped with private booths, very large shared tables and comfy couches, plus the staff is absolutely lovely! There was also a set table with delicious things to eat and a fully featured kitchen ready for use. || Thank you for your message Novella, we always try our best 🤩  … || Tried this coworking space, and loved it!! The host Victor is super nice and welcoming - love the positive vibes!  And there are super cute dogs!  They have nice working spots and the area is cooled properly (not always the case at co-workings in Lisbon)  Definitely recommend! || Hi Carolina! Thank you so much for the review! It was awesome to have you here. Have an amazing week. || I checked out a few coworking spaces in Lisbon and this one was my favourite! Community manager Victor is super friendly and helpful, and the premises are comfortable and spacious. It does get cold so bring an extra layer to work. I also would have hoped for more events and community building efforts, now the only regular event is the Thursday trivia which is great but when I went, none of the other participants were actually from The Base. Otherwise I really enjoyed my month at The Base! || Thank you so much Elina, it means a lot for us. *_* We do have many events now. Like EVERY Friday we have Breakfast Corner at the kitchen so can people know each other and have breakfast. EVERY Thursday we have Trivia Night at From the vine which is a wine testing bar and our members can get a complimentary glass of wine, and many more like psychological help every Friday, lawyer meet up to solve doubts about Portuguese law, a Digital Marketing event monthly and the list goes on :) - Guierone || I enjoyed my time here. Spent almost two months at a dedicated desk which was nice to keep my monitor and stuff at. Although I’ll be honest, I used the couch the most I think. It was so comfortable!  But the vibe is great: friendly, chill, and focused. Always felt comfortable.  Will be back for sure when I visit the city again. || Was great have you and your team here at The Base Kyle! Looking forward to see you again soon :D || Great co-working space. They offer coffee and tea as well as phone booths so you can take calls in private. They also host occasional community events and meetups so you can socialize with others. I initially bought a 1 week pass and liked it so much I booked another for the rest of my stay.  Victor and Liliana, The Base's community managers, are the best! || Thank you so much, Serena! It was awesome having you two here with us as part of our community. We hope to see you next time you're in Lisbon! We wish you all the best : ) || Great coworking space! There’s free coffee and some snacks too, and the events are nice. I had very good focus while working there. Victor, the community manager, is very caring and and will do everything he can to make you feel welcomed. || Thank you so much Brunna. Really means a lot to us. Victor is the best ever!  - Guierone

This was the perfect workspace - reasonably priced compared to others in Lisbon, free coffee on arrival, lovely and airy and bright, quiet! And just a lovely vibe overall. They have phone booths which you book at the start of the day (they are free, and you can use for 2hrs a day). Will definitely be back! || Best value for coworking spaces in the Cais do Sodre area. Friendly and helpful staff, very respectful and quiet working environment. Phone booth + call space + meeting room are all excellent spaces to take calls in. || Confusing cafe/cowork hybrid with the worst of both worlds, except it is relatively quiet. … || A Co-working space if you need get out of your home. We liked the atmosphere and tasty food. Great coffee too, very important! || I love the atmosphere! The space is super pleasant, organized, and has everything you need for a productive day. But what really makes the difference is Esperanza — she takes care of everything with so much attention. Always ready to help and make the environment even better. Highly recommend! || Very nice place at great location, good tables and easy to get focus, the staff always make the best to make you feel comfortable and also in the price is included a drink. Chocolate was great option to take I had it in my both times working there. || Alejandra is super nice and makes Outsite a great place to be. Her friendliness and kindness is charming. The place provides a quiet place to work which can be difficult to find in most Lisbon cafes. Great working environment, good food, and coffee. Everything you need to be productive. || Thank you Rohail! We hope you come back soon. || It has the cosy and cool vibes of a cafe, but with everything you need to do your work focused. I appreciate the areas for calls and meetings, so the other spaces are quiet so you won't be distracted while working. Alejandra is super … || Best Cowork in Lisbon! Esperanza makes great coffee, and she is really nice. If you need to get work done, this is the place you want to go to. || A great workspace! Quiet, friendly environment, perfect for focused work, and very well organised. Highly recommend!

Loved working at Second Home during my time in Lisbon. Super unique and cool work space full of great people. If you're a digital nomad, great place to meet friends and find things to do. And can't speak highly enough about the staff, everyone is absolutely wonderful. They take great care of you, more than worth the price to be a member. || Hey Carson. Thank you so much for taking the time to write this wonderful review! I am very happy you enjoyed your time at Second Home. We loved having you here and hope to see you again next year :) Filipa || Such a beautiful place for working. I was invited by friends so i did not actually work there. But the spaces were very nice. Fridays they have music and happy hour for members. || Great place to get traditional Portuguese food.  Prices are good,  12 to 16 €.  Fast service.  Had a great meal for 12.50 €. || Great place, full of people. Excellent staff. The chairs and desks are a bit old, but overall it’s a good environment for work. || Thank you so much Damien! Hope to see you again at Second Home soon. || After visiting many coworking spaces in Lisbon and around this world, Second Home fits me perfectly. I was looking for a work space that isn’t a bunch of digital nomads temporarily staying in Lisbon. I find value in expanding my professional network and the community here has members that are serious about their work. At other spaces, you get the cliche “I’m a freelance copy writer” but in reality they are just in Lisbon to surf and party. At Second Home, you will form genuine connections. The staff at Second Home is amazing as forming connections with members to help their business thrive. A coworking place should be much more than a table and chair for your laptop. The value is the community and culture.  The cafe at Second Home is second to none with healthy food options that is affordable and delicious. Each person of the Second Home team comes into the office every morning asking “how can I help everyone thrive?”  Of course, the office design itself is inspirational with a focus on nature. Not your typical coworking space. If you’re a serious entrepreneur needing a space that helps you learn, be productive, and find inspiration, I highly recommend Second Home. || Loved the space - really organic, lots of greenery, good vibes, friendly staff. It pains me to vote it so low as it's such a njce space, however the air-conditioning is just not good enough to cope with the summer and the place is too stuffy and warm. || Hello Ivan,  Thank you for taking to time to leave us this honest review. While I am sad you found the space too hot, I am pleased you liked the vibe, setting and the Team. Hopefully we'll see you again once these heatwaves passes! || The place is beautiful and pleasant. Very quiet and very comfortable, and on Fridays there are cocktails. That’s great.  But here comes the "but." I was asked by the staff to leave 45 minutes before closing, and when I said I still had time since I often work late, I was met with dirty looks, and something was said about me in Portuguese. This isn’t the first time.  Additionally, there are lots of small things that, over time, become really annoying. The staff chat away at the reception while I wait and wait, even though they see me, and they just laugh amongst themselves.  One time, I had an impromptu phone call, and all the booths where it was quiet were occupied. I quickly stepped into the conference room for one minute to finish my call. It was already 9 p.m., so very late. I was interrupted and asked to leave because the room was reserved.  What’s the deal? I was on the phone, it was almost closing time, and I said I needed two minutes, but they just left the door open. Meanwhile, people were shouting and laughing everywhere, and I couldn’t finish my call. Sorry, but I’ve never experienced anything like this in any other coworking space. || Hey Mathe, Thanks for taking the time to review your experience at Second Home and sorry we didn't meet your expectations. Apologies you were asked to leave 45min before closing and that, on other occasions, the staff kept you waiting -  it may be they were finishing a previous task. This should not happen and I will look into it to ensure it doesn't happen again.  The meeting room was indeed booked for the entire month, so even if it's empty and unlikely someone will show up that late, we still had to honour the booking. I can understand it is frustrating to be interruped during the call, especially when you were about to end it, but kindly note our Team was only following procedures.  Thanks. Second Home Team || A great place to cowork :) bring your own laptop stand if you’re a roaming member || Hey Georgie! Thank you for your kind review, we're really glad to know you are happy with the space! || Complete lack of professionalism and respect!  I booked a tour through the website to visit the coworking space with the intention of renting an office for my company. I arrived on time (2PM) and was greeted by a staff member at reception who had a dirty, empty food plate right next to her – absolutely disgusting and completely unprofessional.  She told me to wait for another employee who would take me on the tour. I waited 15 minutes, and despite there being three employees at reception, no one bothered to assist me or even acknowledge my presence. Completely unacceptable!  After wasting my time waiting, I simply left feeling utterly disrespected. If this is their service before even becoming a customer, I can only imagine the chaos afterwards. Terrible experience, zero commitment to clients. DO NOT RECOMMEND! || Good morning Bia,   We sincerely apologize for the experience you had with us. Our reception team remembers your arrival and did ask you to wait. Unfortunately, due to an unforeseen situation that required their attention, they forgot to inform our membership team that you were already here.   We deeply regret what happened, and although mistakes can occur, we understand that this situation was completely unacceptable. This does not reflect the service we aim to provide, and we genuinely value your feedback. We would love the opportunity to make it right and would be honored to welcome you back for another tour at your earliest convenience. As a gesture of goodwill, we would like to offer you a complimentary day to experience our space again.  Thank you for your understanding, and we truly hope to have the opportunity to make it up to you.  Sincerely, Margarida || It is nice, but the rules are.....they are brainless. If you have a daily pass, your client can not visit you, even for 5 min or something. They force you to pay the higher Option to get this basic privileges. And you see a empty meeting room for like a week and you ask if you can just stay inside and make you call for 5 minutes. It is not possible, because someone booked it for a YEAR. And I am like, no one is there, just 5 minutes. No it is not possible. Sorry but I this is brainless and stupid. || Good afternoon Romik. Thank you for your feedback, we appreciate your opinion. Our clients have some benefits that come with being Second Home Members. Naturally, we need to make sure that those perks apply only to members, as those are perks of being our member. Regarding the meeting room, that room in question is booked as a private office for a whole year, so no one else but the clients that rented it are allowed to use it. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact us.

place_name: Tribe Social Club - Cowork, Bar, Events
reviews_content: Just went to a People of Lisbon event. What a place. Great ambient, good decoration and also furniture. First time ever in my life that I did speed networking.  I hope it becomes a thing!  Perfect place to celebrate your birthday or to host any type of event.  Def recommend!  It also has an amazing view, and it's in the epicenter of nightlife. || When I first landed on October 12, I was running around trying to find a place to work from. My friend Jennifer told me to check out Tribe, so one day while I was out exploring, I decided to stop by. That’s when I met Vickey he showed me around with such a calm, kind energy that I instantly felt comfortable. I signed up for a membership that same night and started the next day. Being open minded truly changed everything for me. From day one, I met such cool, welcoming people. I even met someone special honestly, I never thought I’d find love here so quickly, but here I am. And beyond that, I found a genuinely supportive group who make my days brighter. Working there every day makes me happy. I get so much done, the environment is inspiring, there are great restaurants nearby that aren’t too expensive, and the unlimited free coffee definitely helps. Most importantly, I feel incredibly comfortable in this space. I hope sharing this experience helps someone who’s thinking about trying Tribe. Sometimes one small step walking into a new space, saying yes to something new can completely change your life and the experiences you have. || Great place to work from. The people are so nice! A good place to meet cool people. They always organize cool events and genuinely care about making you feel like part of a community. || This has been my coworking for more than 6 months now and is one of the best ones in terms of price and comfort. View is great, staff is very helpful and the vibe of the people is cool. Happy with my experience so far. || I had to work in Lisbon and luckily I found this coworking space. They were super friendly and gave me a short tour. I could also bring my luggage, coffee/water/tea is for free and the daily rate of 10€ for non members is super fair! many tables and also 2 phone booths can be found there. Thanks! || Thanks Stev, we loved having you at our space and we look forward to welcoming you again here soon || Pretty basic. Says they have food but didnt tell me until after I paid for the day that they don't serve on Sundays. || Amazing space, great drinks and nice environment ✨ I have been there a few times, for different events and it was always a good experience! Oh, and try the pizzas, so good! || I've been at this coworking space for about a year now, and it's a really nice place to work and meet new people. The Tribee team is awesome! I highly recommend it (I've tried several coworking spaces in Lisbon before, and this is definitely my favorite). || Great team and friendly space — perfect for meetings (call booths and space) but with a nice social feel, too. I’ve met great friends here whilst working. The food is good too, especially the salads. || I've been working here for about 2 months now. And I can recommend Tribe. Great atmosphere, amazing staff and lots comfortable place to work or take calls if you need to. || Amazing coworking space. Not only the space is beautiful and quiet, great to focus, but also free coffee?? It’s a win win for me. Will definitely be back || Thank you for your kind words, we are glad you enjoyed and we look forward to welcoming you back soon :) || Cowork, events, bar and food hub, all in one! At the 1st floor of Le Consultat, in the center of Lisbon, you can find this big space where people can cowork during the day, and have a bite and drink after hours. Really recommend it! || This is one of the best coworking places in Lisbon and right in the centre of Chiado. It’s got plenty of space and a super relaxed vibe. It opens from 8 till late. Wifi is excellent. Despite the main area being a very large open room it is surprisingly quiet even when there are many people coworking there. I guess the noise treatment on the ceiling absorbs the sound. The staff are very friendly and welcoming. You can order food from the breakfast/ lunch menu and it’s delivered to your table as you work. The toilets are always very clean which is always a good indicator of how well the place is run. I give it the top rating because it deserves it. Well done Tribe Club coworking. || Thank you Frank, it's been a pleasure having work with us. We take a lot of care in making sure we have the best environment for work and connecting with others || Great environment to work! Amazing staff who are always ready to help. Definitely recommend 😁 … || Keep charging me months after I have left. I have tried getting in touch and not got any responses. Please reach out to sort this out (you should be able to find me based on my name) || Great space. Great vibe for working with a slightly social touch. Great food too. || Great staff, and a really nice space.  They're open late too, so if you're working US hours you can stay late.  The food is really good too, and they host a ton of nomad related events, so it's a good place to meet people. || Amazing place to work with an amazing community supporting you while you do so. People working there are also absolute angels || The place is nice, but I ordered a drink I saw on the menu and I was charged more than the price stated on it. The waiter apologized saying that the system stated a higher price, but still made me pay the higher price. Pretty sure this is unlawful.  Update: I asked for the Complaint Book and they said they don't even have it. I said I'd call the consumers' authority and the receptionist tried to "buy" my silence by offering me a drink, which I didn't accept. || We are very sorry for your experience at our storytelling event. Our menus had recently been updated and we had made an error listing our Ginger Ale as €3 instead of the €2.50. After discovering our mistake we offered you a full refund or €0.50 returned which you refused to accept. Our prices have now been updated accordingly.   We also apologise for the confusion with the reception, the complaints book is available to be used.  Our tribe social club is a community focused space where we put on events to bring everyone together in a safe space - we will continue to improve and hope to welcome you back again soon. || Lovely place to meet people, enjoy events with friends, drink nice cocktail in the center of Lisbon! || such an amazing spot in the heart of lisbon!! Amazing pizza and cocktails and they always have really cool events going on to meet people. It’s a great space to cowork during the day and then get dinner/drinks/party at night. Such a creative use of the space and brings a lot of community to lisbon. || This made our day! Thanks for the awesome review. It's members like you who make our space such a great place to work. Hope to catch up with you soon at our next community event! || Great spot to get work done in the center of Lisbon. Only downside? It's dangerously close to my favorite Pastel de Nata place and at Tribe, they serve yummy pizza too. My waistline is not happy but tummy is haha. || Thanks for taking the time to leave such a kind review! We're really proud of the community we've built here and it's fantastic to hear you're enjoying the space. Looking forward to seeing more of what you create here || Great space to cowork and meet new people. They’ve got plenty of fun events lined up almost every day and the venue is amazing!! || Great space ideal location excellent internet and a welcoming team. || I spend more time at Tribe than I do at home. From the central location and the building's vibe to the daily events, welcoming team, and friendly members, Tribe has managed to give this place its own soul. Thank you! || Great space, great events, great energy. I love coming here for game nights, watching football, a bit of work / a bit of fun. Best cowork in Lisbon. || We're incredibly grateful for your detailed feedback and kind words! It means the world to us that you're finding value in both our facilities and community atmosphere. Our team works hard to create an environment where professionals can thrive, and hearing that you're having such a positive experience makes it all worthwhile. Thank you for being part of our coworking family! || Great coworking, and cool vibe and team. Has everything you need coffee, tea, snacks, AC, good wifi and most importantly great cocktails afterwork! || A beautiful space. Highly recommend for events, co-working. || Great place for coworking, really nice team, super central location and fair pricing. Also lot of cool events. || Thank you for the wonderful review! We're thrilled you're enjoying our space and community. It's members like you who make our coworking environment so vibrant and special. || Great space to work from - calm and easygoing staff that look after you. I’d recommend to anyone looking for a well located co-working spot! || Thank you for such a thoughtful review! Between the reliable wifi and endless coffee, we aim to make your workday as smooth as possible. Love seeing you make the most of the space and collaborate with other members. Here's to many more productive days ahead!

Great coworking space! Very cosy. || The website leaves you with many questions so you have to give them a visit in order to know them as well as you can know the other spaces in the city through their website only. However I want and I must give 5 stars because not only do you discover on site that they offer a lot for a price better than competitors', but you will also find the confirmation of what others reviews say here: Eureka's managers are friendly and helpful. || Thank you so much for your thoughtful review and the 5 stars! We totally understand that our website might spark some curiosity — and while we know there's always room for improvement, we’re glad it led you to visit us. We're delighted you found value in what we offer and that our team made a great impression. It was a pleasure having you at Eureka, and we hope to see you again soon — whether for work or just a coffee! || Great new space to work in the best area of Lisbon! The staff is so nice and the facilities are great! || Great co-working and space, with beautiful garden in the back. || Well located, very professional service. They have a café in the basement that's a lifesaver when you're hungry. || Very attentive team and excellent facilities. I really enjoyed the experience and received good feedback from the participants of my event. I recommend it! || It was a pleasure to host your event here at Eureka Thais! We hope to welcome you back to our venue again soon! || Hello, Eureka Coworking! Good morning, how are you all?  My name is Dardânia and I would like to leave some special feedback for you. I was recently in Europe on a tourist trip, and during my stay in Lisbon, I needed a safe and reliable place to organize my itinerary and buy tickets.  I was very well received by Paula Freire. I would like to register here the excellent service I received from her and the warm welcome I had at Eureka Coworking. Paula was extremely kind, showed me the space and even helped me use a computer, as I didn't have one at the time. Thanks to her support, I was able to organize my final itinerary and make my purchases safely. I was also able to relax with a coffee and spent a very pleasant afternoon at Eureka.  I want to praise the space, which is impeccable, safe and welcoming. Paula proved to be an exceptional manager, always very kind and attentive, truly committed to Eureka. I will certainly recommend Eureka Coworking to everyone visiting Lisbon to work, plan or fulfill any commitment. I know you will be very welcome and will find an excellent environment.  Thank you once again for the wonderful experience!  Sincerely, Dardânia || Thank you, and we are very happy with your comment :) || I loved the experience! The weather is great, the lawn is excellent, and the reception was very good! It even felt like we already knew each other. || The venue is in a beautiful mansion! And Eureka has a great standard of quality that I've already had the pleasure of experiencing in São Paulo.

The churros are amazing. Recommed also club sandwich. The staff are very kind. Beautiful experience and beautiful view || Thank you for your feedback Tanz, we are glad you enjoyed it. Hope to have you around again soo :) || After the Time Out Market Paulicarus found this small roof top venue. Only holds about 40. Madge bought me a cairphreni (?) Pleasant enough cocktail. A nice breeze and a lovely waitress. Toilets on way in on ground floor. || Super great ambiance! The music was so good and perfect for a beer on a sunny rooftop 🌞 As a tourist, I loved the chill ambiance and the good beer. The bartender was super great, service was quick and personalized. I love to chat when I'm traveling and that's what I had. I highly recommend if you want to have a drink to good ambiance on a rooftop. || This place has a soul! This place is a co-opt with the church to fun community initiatives. The owner of the bar convinced the priest to let him  open the church Terrance as a bar to help fund the church programmes like the youth group, drama club, church services and more. || This terrace is the perfect spot if you love good food and great cocktails. It’s cozy, vibrant, and ideal for bringing friends. Highly recommend! || Good to know that the famous San Ginés chocolateria is in Lisbon with their famous churros with chocolate and also a rooftop! Will be back A LOT! 🥰 || Amazing small and cozy bar! Recommend for large groups that want to take over a whole bar! || Head to 1894 roof garden for a really chill vibe, cool people and super friendly bar tender - shout-out to Patricia who chilled our beer glasses to ice cold! It was our first time but we will be sure to be back and we are excited to work our way through the rest of the drinks and food menu!! A relaxed fun vibe in what we think is the heart of Lisbon! We will be bringing our friends next time! || Amazing bar. Carla treated us so well, the playlist was perfect and the drinks were immaculate! || Thank you for your feedback Chris! I will ensure Karla gets it, I’m sure it will make here day ;) || sweet, cozy rooftop bar with great cocktails and tapas. They also serve Madrid-style churros and chocolate. Service was impeccable and very friendly.

We hope that you enjoyed your experience and that you visit us again soon 🤩🫶 … || I've been a Core Collective fan since almost day one! After years of going to different fitness studios, I was intrigued by their unique approach. Now, their workouts are the highlight of my week – I look forward to start my Mondays with Carlie's X-Former class!  The entire atmosphere at Core Collective is fantastic. Kenza, the owner, has created a truly welcoming space, and the front desk staff, including Katya, are always so helpful and friendly.  For X-Former, Carlie is my absolute favorite instructor, though I also love taking classes with Gigi and Mata. The X-Former workout (which is not Pilates) itself is high-intensity and low-impact, relying on slow, controlled movements and constant tension to create an incredibly challenging experience.  When it comes to Mat classes, I'm a huge fan of the heated options. Hot Pilates, Heated Sculpt and Tone & Burn are all incredibly challenging and rewarding. Erina, Jane, and Marianna are amazing instructors who really push you to your limits. Their selection of hot classes is also the most comprehensive in Lisbon.  For a more personalized approach, they also offer one-on-one Classic Pilates sessions. While I haven't tried them myself, my experience with Classic Pilates instructors like Jane and Erina makes me confident these sessions will be excellent.  The amenities are another highlight! The locker room is stocked with everything you could need, from luxurious toiletries to Dyson hair dryers and fresh, fluffy towels. Plus, they have a recovery room complete with an infrared sauna and cryotherapy.  Of all the fitness studios I've visited in Lisbon, Core Collective offers the most complete and exceptional experience. Their dedication to progress and their warm, welcoming staff are unmatched.  Looking forward to my next classes ❤️✨🔥 || Wow thank you so much for this review Sara! We appreciate you! 🫶🤩 … || Core Collective Lisbon is truly a community where everyone feels welcome, supported, and seen. From the moment you walk in, there is a genuine sense of belonging that makes the experience feel personal and inclusive.  The heated classes with Erina are exceptional. They are challenging, grounding, and incredibly well guided. The heat adds intensity, but her clear cues and calm presence make every class feel safe, empowering, and deeply rewarding. One of the highlights is the impressive geometric garden design and the viewpoint at the top of the park, which provides a breathtaking perspective of Lisbon. The park is also very spacious, so it never feels overcrowded, even during busy hours. There are benches throughout the area, perfect for resting and enjoying the surroundings. Eduardo VII Park is great for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. It’s close to the city center and easy to access, making it a must-visit for anyone exploring Lisbon. reviews_content: It is a beautiful park with musicians who play music. || Nice little park with two small playgrounds for kids. There are 2 baby swings. It is a better playground for toddlers than the one in Parque luminosa down the street. || This medium-sized city park has a large fountain and a drinking spout, ample lawns and a couple of playgrounds. These have a pair of swings for toddlers and older children, a small slide, a see-saw, a few rockers and little else. It's a bit close to a busy avenue but a definite advantage is that it's in the shade most of the day. || Small Park with two play grounds for children, which makes it specially very pleasant for them. || Very clean, beautiful and peaceful!! A dream place. || Built in the 1950s, it is a small, quite pleasant garden. Its two lawn areas lead to a beautiful, well-maintained stone lake with working water fountains. Very well wooded with trees of various types, it is a relaxing place. A highlight is the monument to João do Rio right at the entrance of the garden. || A very peaceful little square on the avenue, good for taking a walk with children. || A quiet square, great for taking children both to play with the playground equipment and to ride bicycles. || Praceta João do Rio, as this space is also known, is located in Lisbon, on Avenida Almirante Reis between Praça do Areeiro and Alameda D. Afonso Henriques. || A peaceful garden within the city, offering good shade for those who want to relax a bit 😊 … || Space for children and the whole family. || The rocks sticking out from around the lake are dangerous for children. I witnessed a situation where a child hit their face and had to be taken to the hospital. This situation really needs to be reviewed. The children's park is very dirty, with animal droppings; it seems to be neglected. || Calm and peaceful, excellent for enjoying a bit of nature amidst the urban chaos. It also has a very nice children's playground. || This small square makes good use of space: a children's playground, drinking fountain, plenty of trees, including fruit trees, containers for sorting solid waste, lawns, an explanatory statue of João do Rio, parking, metro, train and bus stops between the avenue and the sandpit. In warm weather it's a mini paradise. || A small square with a garden and playground, good for residents to stroll with their children, with their best friends, or simply to relax and read a book. || A great place to read a book surrounded by trees, the site has two playgrounds where children can play safely. || Me and my granddaughter Maria Rita, who is 20 months old, go there many times and we really enjoy going. Ilídia and I already have many friends. We also really like the Fernando Pesa playground. I, Ilídio, grandfather, and my granddaughter Maria Rita, really enjoy it. || I like the playground for the little ones and another one for the older ones, the slide should be higher, the one that's there should go to the little ones' side, thank you. || I congratulate you on the good preservation of the garden, unlike what happens in other parishes. Excellent for the children. || It has a playground, it's a small garden, near the avenue.

Pleasant green space with coffee shops and bars as well as a children’s play area. One of the bars has live entertainment. At one end of the park, stunning view of Lisbon and the river. || One of the best gardens in Lisbon!! Very chill and relatively less crowded than the other famous parks here, so if you’re looking for a serenity, this might be a good spot. Easy to come here by tram or metro after walking a bit. || Great place for a hanging out - beautiful scenery, centrally located near the bairro alto - I can totally recommend || Bistro/restaurant in the park, perfect for a timeout from sightseeing in the shade, there was a singer singing fado, the food was just es expected, warm, tasty, and the whole experience was just perfect || It’s a good place to sit for some time. There is free access to drinking water and also a place where the public can charge their phones for free. However, you need to bring your own charger. || Lovely park to rest the knackered feet after walking up and down hills all day || A wonderful garden with some lovely plants and flowers to view.  On a hot day, this is a great garden to visit. With many trees to provide some shade, you can enjoy the suns rays as well as keeping chilled.  It's quite a small garden, but with a small fee of 5 Euro it is worth a visit (if you like gardens). There are some cool art displays within the gardens also, which fit into the space nicely.  Overall these gardens offer good value fro money and is lovely to walk around and explore new and interesting plants. || Even at afternoon heat a good place to relax. With small cafe and sometimes live music. Nice! || My neighborhood park. It's awesome. Beautiful trees. Farmer's market on Saturdays. Friendly kiosks for a cold beer or fresh pastry. It's golden! || Wonderful spot to relax after walking all day, or go for a stroll and grab a snack and/or drink at one of two kiosks or the small restaurant. Playground is brand new and has something for all ages. Statues and artwork are a treat to discover and contemplate. Plenty of seating and grass around the park for lounging around. || Most favorite park in Lisbon. It's a perfect combination of nature, art, walkways, grass, benches, and cafe in a free space that's easy to get around. Way better than the botanical garden nearby, and it's free! || I would never give up on recommending this spot in Lisbon. For Saturdays market or to meet with you the oldest tree in Lisbon.. 300 yo ceder. That's the truth story of the city.. you just need to listen. || Amazing small. Garden in very beautiful area for pet walk and child play area there are wooden seat to sit down and enjoy. Very old type of trees looks ancient and historic || Beautiful peaceful park in a nice area with a good kids play area, shaded seating and nearby toilet. || Beautiful place to walk around and enjoy the nice views rot he city. There was live music and a truck to buy some drinks, perfect combination! || I loved the old tree the most and the other cluster of trees that make up the garden. A great place to spot and there are enough vendors to get snacks, beer or a cup of coffee.  Once you are here and you are in for a hike, you can walk to Rato or even Estrella. You can catch the tram 28 to Chiado or do a detour to Cais do Sodre. It is not an easy walk, but yeah, some of the random.things you do in Lisbon and get home walking about 8 - 10,000 steps. || Very nice place to relax. Unique huge tree. Nice vibe music from the park kiosk. Clean and calm || One of the most magnificent trees I have ever seen is in this lovely park. Also has a market on weekend and a cafe that is open daily. || A very beautiful place to sit under a special tree that provides the much needed shade. Find an ice cream parlor nearby and this garden is the perfect place to eat your ice cream. || Just a super place to relax and great cafe in under a canopy of wild looking trees. || Nice garden not so big. Trees, grass and shade good enough for a rest. There is also a small restaurant with a terrace - normal prices. Being in a crowded area specially when are turists it might be hard to find a parking spot. Otherwise there is a public parking (with payment) around the park. || Gorgeous place to stroll in the center of Lisbon. || Very nice and clean garden in the Principe Real neighbourhood.  Lots of shady areas and greenery to sit and relax. Playgrounds for the kids and a small kiosk also available. || Small park in a busy part of Lisbon. Has a small organic farming market on a Saturday and playground for children. There are wooden tables and chairs and seems nice enough || We stumbled across this lovely park while visiting Lisbon for the day. It has a beautiful old massive tree in the middle held up with what looks like a iron /steel frame. Nice place to sit and ponder life. We had the famous custard pie with … || We liked the place. You can just sit and relax for a while before you continue discovering beauty of Lisbon. You can buy coffe, wine or beer; the coffe is in the garden. Enjoy! || Renovated and very organized. Just need fence again to stop dogs entering. Had great time there. Very well organized || Gorgeous Gardens, very beautiful at night, lovely for a gentle stroll with some friends or a loved one. Close to some lovely restaurants and some very interesting features of Lisbon. A beautiful view of the city, fantastic at night. Really recommended... a must. || Maybe my most favorite park in Lisbon. It's a perfect combination of nature, art, walkways, grass, benches, and cafe in a free space that's easy to get around. Way better than the botanical garden nearby, and it's free! || A stunning park adorned with majestic trees – a true haven of natural beauty.

Great beer and their salsa was surprisingly really good! Really loved the atmosphere and the whole vibe. Days later: I did a board with the history and it is in the Middle of the room. Tx for the tip. || 9 year old brewery inside a 280 year old tunnel. Great service, good food, really good beer. Fun little art in the basement and they do a book exchange as well! || Greatfull you got to hit us. Always welcome. And we appreciated you took your time to observe our art! If you’re into draft brews, good music, and great conversation, then this is your place. The staff is amazing and the food is even better. We are in love, place to come back ♥️ || How lovely! Adorable! Come back anytime. 🍻 … || Had a great night trying some craft beers made on the premises along with a burger each. Like a hidden away underground grotto with warm lighting, mismatched chairs, and comfy cushions. || I love the part mismatched chairs 😊 because I also love them... thanks for your attention on the details. A wonderful Portuguese beer pub in Bairro Alto. It has a great variety of Portuguese beers as well as other drinks. The bartender was very friendly and communicative. || Very nice atmosphere.  We've been welcomed by the owner ( I think )  He has been very friendly with us and the service was very quick . Decent prices and all good vibes , definitely worth a visit || Great place to spend time at night,  friendly staff, good food. Perfect atmosphere to hangout with friends. The food is tasty. Highly recommended || When we first went there, two employees outside pretending to be customers tried to pressure us into going in. Through the whole time we're there, they just tried to sell us more alcohol. They tried to convince us to stay when we tried to leave. They had okay drinks, amazing steak sandwich, good music and atmosphere. If the experience wasn't being ruined by their shady tricks and pushy behaviour it would actually be a decent spot. || Absolutely the best bar I've been to in Lisbon!  I come to Lisbon frequently and always find myself back here! Great food, drinks, music, vibe and service! Must try, hidden gem! || Beef burger was so soft and delicious 😋 cod fish also very interesting for the view and tasty!! Porto and wine is high quality, the best bar in this district for sure! Do not go to other places, especially if some people invited on the street. || Neat place with cozy atmosphere to drink and have a chat while listening to rock and 80s music || Perfect bar with quality beers and bar snacks. The ambiance also very nice, I liked the place completely || Went my first time for a quiz night, and had a lot of fun. Everyone was so friendly and was able to quickly find a team to join. Really cozy vibes, great to meet new people. || A perfect place to drink a beer,listen to good music in a really nice place. The steak is tje best,super tender.

It's small, it's cozy, the drinks are cheap and the staff are super friendly.  The "pub" is situated in the Barrio Alto and you're near loads of restaurants which makes this a perfect place to start your evening. Have an apero here and head off to dinner.  I've been here twice on this trip and will be back soon! || Small pub, very nice atmosphere, the barmen is interesting and professional. Very nice place for a drink before dinner or just enjoy for s while  No rating on the food because I just drank  there : || We walked in not expecting much, just needed a place to wait for our table in the restaurant next door. Ordered a mezcal sour, which was excellent, the best we have had, well balanced and just so good we came back after dinner. The bartender was very attentive and nice, I would definitely recommend it and cannot wait to come back! || For €12 you’ll get a beer and a delicious Burrata, the bartender Bruno is great and they have more food if you end up being hungry. Only 3 seats at the bar and a few tables, they could invest in better bar seating to make it a great pub 🍻. || Great little place with a good variety of craft beers. Music is really good! The playlist was very alternative and I ended up being introduced to a few great artists. The pizza is great. It is the only option during the day before the kitchen opens early in the evening. It is very laid back. Good option for a chilled bite and drink. || Like all the other reviews. The staff are very friendly, speak English and the bar will get filled with locals.  On tap you have Sagres, but there are a few bottles of craft beer that you can try. A wonderful selection of spirits (Tequila/Whisky/Gin) and the staff are knowledgable to make any cocktail.  To eat I tried the Montaditas. Go for the Goats Cheese, it’s wonderful. || Great environment, good service and good food.. Quesadillas were good. I would have liked a bit more pico de gallo with it but they were pretty good. || Really good little bar! The place is small so we were lucky enough to squeeze in right at the door. A great selection of drinks, particularly spirits, we had the hot burrata with cherry tomatoes and prosciutto as a snack, this comes highly recommended! If you are in the area it’s definitely worth walking past to see if you can squeeze in. They do pizzas as well at a good price. || Chill vibe, reas' price, an some a the coldest beer this side a town. Much love. Respect || If you're looking for a hole in the wall type of venue that has all the class of an up town bar, this is it. A great cocktail list, friendly bar staff, decent decor. On an evening you can spill out on to the street which is perfect for a cigarette. This is a classy neighbourhood and I echo the thought that if I lived here this would be my local. || Staff were very friendly and prepared 2 cocktails for us - an Old Fashioned and a Smoked Margarita. Both were good. Cosy little bar with a great selection of spirits particularly Tequila, Rum  and Bourbon. || Hipsterish, funky, happy place. We had pizza and quesadillas, beer and wine. Its a pub, so do not expect conventional table service. Staff was funny and nice. The food was good, and cheap. Drinks were great! If its cold avoid the tables near the door - it cannot be closed and it gets drafty. But nothing you cant solve with some glasses of wine! || Stopped in for a quick drink. Great atmosphere and ice cold beer on tap. Best place to rest your weary legs after a solid day of looking at monuments || Loved visiting this little gem of a bar in Lisbon, very friendly atmosphere. They have a really nice wine selection that has obviously had some thought and effort put into it. Food was also tasty. || Read about this place in the New York Times and made it a destination. Great drinks, friendly staff, and wonderful atmosphere. Very local with craft beers and cozy. Will make point to go back! || Best cocktail I've ever had. The bartender guessed exactly what kind of drinks we were looking for!! || Very good cocktails made in front of you with all the professionalism and friendliness. Cozy spot to stop for a drink! A bit pricey tho || Small cute bar, lovely ambience and cosy. The bar tender really tried to understand what drinks you like. I've been back a few times both pre and post dinner and it's a lovely bar. || Great, tiny relaxed bar. Quesadillas were molten hot but really tasty. Interesting bottles of craft beer. Friendly guy behind the bar. || Great ambiance, selection, prices, music. A chill hang. || Best Bar/Pub in Lisbon. Not easy to find a Sagres on tap as the city seems to be devoted to Super Bock. The music and atmosphere were on point and the staff were really friendly. || Non-descript, only popped in as passing. Excellent cocktails, great food. Friendly staff. As a rule I don't give 5/5 or 10/10 ratings but this had to be an exception || Cozy and genuine  place and adorable staff. Very Good food and drinks made with love.  It was a nice first night experience in Lisbon for me and my travel mates. || They are really unfriendly and we paid for two pieces of bread 4 €. The two tattoo girls in the kitchen didn't wear a mask. We are not feeling comfortable here. I can not recommend this restaurant.  It's a Corona Hotspot here stay far away from this place .... || It’s a hole in the wall that only serves one draft beer. But I heard a ton of Portuguese. Nice break from all the tourists. || On our last night in Lisbon before catching flights home, my friend and I dropped by Pub Lisboeta for some post-dinner ginja. We ended up staying all night (far later than we should've considering our situation). When you think of a family run business you automatically know there is some personality to the place. In Bar Olf Vic you will find a father and a son holding up old school bar traditions! Are they a bit overworked.... yes... does it take longer to get a drink than in a McDonalds, yes! Never the less you go there to have an atmosphere you can only achieve by generational dedication to giving your costumer a great bar experience. Coming here is a must if you look for a safe and friendly place to have a couple of drinks. || Terrible experience at Old Vic!  I went there with friends expecting to have a good time, but the service was absolutely disappointing. I waited for over 30 minutes just to place an order. The waiter was rude and disrespectful from the start. When he finally came to the table, he brought popcorn and acted annoyed because I was impatient — after such a long wait, who wouldn’t be?  When I tried to order something, he said they were only serving ham and cheese toasties, without giving any proper explanation or apology. On top of that, the prices were insanely high for both food and drinks. The drinks especially are ridiculously overpriced considering the poor service and limited options.  Definitely not worth it. Terrible cost-benefit. There are plenty of better places in Lisbon with way better service and fairer prices. || I know this is a vintage place & some things come with the territory. With that being said, in terms of visiting, this is more of a living historical relic to visit than a bar to enjoy. If you’re okay with rude service & paying more than normal, then go ahead and check it out. The older man who owns the place is a feature, but he is very rude & particularly rude to foreigners unfortunately. He also tries not to give you a menu so he can charge you more at the end. My friends paid 3.50€ for an imperial (small beer) and 3€ for a Pedras (sparkling water) because they couldn’t speak Portuguese to question him on it, and when I did, he complained about foreigners & paying more for a drink at new places in the city center. I wanted to, but just can’t recommend it I’m sorry. || Great experience! The bar is operated by a father and son who deliver an excellent experience. We really appreciated the care they shared during our visit. I couldn’t recommend it more to those who want to enjoy a drink in a place that’s lost in time, while also preserving the best of interactions we all enjoy. || A place where you can talk with friends without yelling. Loved the entire vibe of the place. Just make sure to bring cash though. When we went there, unfortunately they didn’t accept cards or MBway at least. Would still recommend the place. Loved the drinks! The drinks were really good with reasonable price, and it wasn’t full of ice, like what other bars do. Would definitely come back. || Great snacks. Good cocktails that sneak up on you. Really cool environment with red velvet seats and antiques. Feels like an English pub. A little pricey. || Hidden bar in Lisbon. Older man working behind the bar, and we were one of the first customers to arrive. It's definitely a vibe, and I would recommend it to come earlier. Totally recommended! || We were just looking for a pub that was closing later than most, when we found this hidden gem. Old Vic is not only a pub, it is a place with a kind soul that you feel right after entering. I am very grateful for this experience it was the highlight of my trip to Lisbon. Thank you for having us! || What a great find! A hidden little gem in the heart of Lisbon! My partner and I popped in for a late night drink on arrival to the city where we were greeted with popcorn, snacks and a selection of the most amazing cocktails (The Pina Colada was incredible and their cocktail decorations so cute and delicious, my parther said it was the best Old Fashioned he's ever had!), the service of the father & son team was impeccable, they really made us feel at home... Will be will going back!

A wonderful museum in Lisbon located in the port area. The knowledge presented there is accessible yet delivered in a professional manner. Two temporary exhibitions made a strong impression on me. One was about a photography studio in Goa. Since it was a Portuguese colony, it’s always interesting to see how a country deals with such parts of its history. The narrative was excellent and conveyed these complex events very well. It’s certainly an educational value that museums should have. The second exhibition, about Japanese spirituality, is a brilliant introduction to this very complex subject. I highly recommend visiting this museum — it’s a wonderful way to deepen one’s understanding of the world and the history of Portugal. || Thank you Ra for your visit and comment. We hope to see you again soon. Museum of the Orient || Museu do Oriente  -  Where Earth Gods Whisper and Japanese Festivals Dance  Tucked along the Doca de Alcântara Norte, the Museu do Oriente is one of those places that feels like stepping into a quiet reverie - a space of ritual, rhythm, and reflection. We came specifically to catch the temporary exhibition JAPAN: Festivals and Rituals, and it did not disappoint. From vibrant masks to ceremonial garments, it was a fascinating glimpse into the spiritual heartbeat of Japan, where every object seemed to hum with centuries of meaning.  But the real surprise? The Earth Gods Velar Sculpture exhibition - a collection so awe-inspiring it made us pause mid-step. These sculptures don’t just sit in the room - they command it. You can feel the dedication, reverence, and raw craftsmanship in every curve and texture. It’s the kind of art that doesn’t ask for attention - it earns it.  While the museum houses several permanent exhibitions, our visit was laser-focused on these two. Entry gives you access to everything, but we were on a mission of meaning, and we found it.  Verdict: Museu do Oriente is a temple of quiet power, where ritual meets artistry, and where you can wander through spiritual landscapes without leaving Lisbon. Highly recommended for culture seekers, sculpture lovers, and anyone who believes that art should move you - even if it’s carved from stone. || Thank you, Pearl, for your visit and comment.  We are very happy that you found what you were looking for at the Museum of the Orient.  See you soon. A unique, curator- and artist-run, non-profit art platform based in central Lisbon, NowHere is a space for experimentation, collaboration, and critical reflection. It hosts artist residencies, curatorial labs, workshops, and exhibitions that encourage open, inclusive, and interdisciplinary dialogue.  More than just a gallery, NowHere is a meeting point for artists, curators, researchers, and local communities. It supports artistic development and exchange through public programs that focus as much on process as on outcome. Its welcoming, collaborative spirit has become a cherished part of Lisbon’s contemporary art landscape.  Unfortunately, like many independent cultural spaces in Lisbon, NowHere is under pressure from the city’s rapid gentrification. Rising rents and increasing tourist-driven development have forced the initiative to relocate, and it will soon have to move from its current location. || Great place to see contemporary art in Lisbon! || Amazing art space in Lisbon || A contemporary art space worth visiting in Lisbon. reviews_content: This is a really remarkable contemporary art museum currently presenting a couple of women artists, too. For me after getting tired and sensory overloaded by Lisbon‘s Disney-like overtourism this was the perfect place to calm down on my last day in the city. The interior design of the building with steel and glass bridges under brick vaults is worth the visit, too. I especially enjoyed the Petrified Museum show on the floor. || This was included as a part of my Lisboa card! I am glad I didn’t pay for this on its own as it wouldn’t have been worth it unfortunately. The space is beautiful and clearly a historic building being used for a great purpose. I barely had a welcoming upon entering. I had to ask where the exhibitions started as that was not explained. It was hard to navigate and after reading the reviews now it seems I missed a whole back section of the museum :( Not sure if this was a hallway I missed or if it was an area closed off. I shouldn’t have to pre-read through reviews to find out this information though. The garden looks like it would be a really lovely space as well but it was closed and under construction from the looks of it. Even the washrooms lack signage. Could be so worth it with a few tweaks. || This was a very cool exhibit to see. Lots of great artwork. Definitely worth a visit and price was reasonable. If you are into art make the time to check it out. || Disappointing. The exhibition is very small, not too much interesting works. With a Lisboa Card, it is worth to visit, but not as a come-in option. || Well worth visiting when there are a good range of exhibitions on. Some of the galleries are a bit hidden away and  so you do need to follow signs and be willing to explore. It didn't contain any pieces that were particularly interesting, & even when we did want to know more about the piece, the only information the plaques provided were about who owned the pieces. It's also the first museum I've been to where you have to double-back through the whole thing to be able to get back to the lockers & exit?! Really not worth the price; even if it was free, I'd say it's a pretty subpar exhibit. reviews_content: It was incredibly interesting, very interactive, and extremely well designed. The special effects, the storyline, and the overall atmosphere were impressive and truly immersive. The staff was fantastic: friendly, professional, and very attentive. A special thank you to our guide Luca, who helped us a lot and made the whole experience even more enjoyable. We will definitely come back and are already excited to try the other rooms.  Book in advance — it’s absolutely worth it! || Great place with a good variety of escape rooms. Even compared to escape rooms played abroad, this one undoubtedly had the most diverse and challenging puzzles! We loved all the decoding, and a super positive factor for its success was that, given that we have team members who don't understand Portuguese, Enigmas Land provided both English and Portuguese versions of all the escape room puzzles, allowing everyone to easily understand and focus on solving each one. In addition, Victor was with us in a super fun character who always helped with translations and communication with my friends, as well as putting everyone's reasoning together. He never gives direct clues like in other escape rooms, but rather makes us think through our own reasoning, which makes everything much better and gives us a real feeling of being the ones solving everything, even when we seemed stuck. It was perfect!! I recommend it so much that we've already bought two more escape rooms and even got a free speed game! Thank you so much for everything!! || Thank you very much, and we'll be here to honor those 5 stars in the next games you'll venture into! || As regular customers of this type of game, we were quite disappointed. Anyone who has ever been to an escape room will find this completely different. It's even worse. The game consists only of a table with props on it. The clues are very complex, long, and don't make much sense. And we also have the constant company of a man who is always directing and explaining everything. Which is not expected in an escape game where the group must decipher the clues on their own. || We realized that you didn't read what you were getting into; the game you purchased was an escape game, not an escape room, something that is even in the Odisseias title and present in 3 different places on the voucher.  And as with everything in life, we couldn't all like the same thing, and fortunately, the game you played is our most played and liked game. As you mentioned, the clues are indeed complex, and when you constantly try to read more than one at a time, it becomes more difficult, and this fact was mentioned several times before and during the game by the game master. In Portugal, and especially abroad, this figure (and you can research it) serves exactly as part of the game and to help guide you during the experience. We understand those who prefer to touch a button and immediately get the answer through the intercom; in our case, we prefer to guide the thinking and only assist in how to get the answer to the customers themselves. For your part, you decided to play as 6 in a game meant for 4 people, and despite mentioning that you weren't in the best frame of mind for riddles due to the few hours of sleep you'd had, thankfully at least 2 members still enjoyed it. Our games are all designed for thinking, not just wandering around looking for keys or objects in rooms like in others, but for reading, interpreting, and solving riddles. That's why we're called ENIGMAS LAND. Have a fantastic rest of your birthday and a great week! || The best Escape Game I've ever played! The biggest surprise is that the game is led by an actor...yes, an actor, Vitor de Almeida... Inspector Carlos Alves.  Get ready because you'll be chatting for a looooong time after the game.
