Found by chance, a small restaurant full of charm with well-executed dishes and, above all, an owner with a passion for local wine, who will gladly share with you what he loves. I highly recommend spending an evening there if you want to discover some good Portuguese wines. || Olá G. Thank you to eat In out restaurant and for your kind words.  Best regards Luís Filipe

Absolutely delicious! The cheese they bring out at the beginning is delicious with the crackers and my meal was delicious as well. The older gentleman, who I assume is the owner, was very helpful and brought out a book of fish pictures to show me and my husband what the different menu items were. Super helpful and polite. I particularly liked that there was not a lot of salt or pepper on the vegetables so I could salt and pepper them to my own taste. The garlic sauce that came with the tuna was really delicious on my potatoes as well as the tuna. || Authentic local cafe for anyone looking for a reasonably priced light breakfast. The coffee is a bit burnt but the local retirees seem to like so who am I to judge Love the small business service and atmosphere here, close encounter with the locals morning routine. The tv is in the background with Portuguese music, had a really nice time planning my day here ❤️ || Real local restaurant. I really liked the food. || Owner is here 0700-0000.Great staff and food. They speak very little English here, but that doesn’t matter. Their lunch specials are divided by meat and fish. Phenomenal. || Perfect Nata and nice service, authentic atmosphere || Everything was great! We had breakfast and dinner there. Small prices, good food, perfect coffee and nice Service. || Had here twice a small breakfast. All ok  coffee good, service nice. || Very good! A bit of a hidden place but run by an old couple who do it very well!! French fries not frozen. The meat is superb. I ordered a hamburger and it was very well done: pink without being fully cooked. It is under the fried egg in the photo 🙂. The house wine in a 2 liter jug ​​is €6 and is very good (no soda needed). For dessert we ordered a chocolate mouse and it was delicious. We thought it was homemade. The place fills up quickly but they have an adjacent dining room just as big as the first one. They put cheese and toast on us at the beginning and we already knew they would charge for them but we were very hungry... They charged us €7 for the cheese and toast (in a supermarket it would cost 9) and €1 for the bread, go for it. I can only say good reviews! And they didn't charge us any mandatory tip! || We found it by chance, and both the service and the food were exquisite. If I return to Lisbon, we'll definitely go back.

5 star experience provided by our host Kim. We were seated quickly without any wait, enjoyed the beer and the strawberry cocktail which was lovely. Went for the margarita pizza and pasta arrabiata which tasted great. Kim had all the condiments ready for us in advance. Location is great, just opposite the Rossio fountain. Many tables have gas and electric heaters to keep the guests warm. Portion size for the pasta is a bit small considering the price. || We have been on holiday for the last two weeks from Paris, Madrid and Lisbon. This is the only place that we have eaten at twice in our very short stay in Lisbon. We were blessed to meet our server. Harneet! She greeted us as if we'd been here more than we had! Her service is impeccable. The food is outrageously fantastic! || I popped in here for drinks. It's a great location with outdoor heaters and blankets. Perfect spot on a rainy day. Kim was efficient, friendly and helpful. The hot chocolate was delicious. || Florella:  Located in a popular square surrounded by different restaurants and eateries. We’ve learnt the hard way by checking reviews after having a meal. We checked reviews of 4 or 5 different restaurants and Florella was coming up on top. The vibe, the ambiance and the menu all were great with some great options. The service, drinks and food were fantastic. Definitely a recommended option. After researching the others, in this vicinity, this is the best. Very reasonably priced too. Thank you for the Fiorella experience. 💫 || Don’t have words to describe how disappointed we were. Yes the drinks were lovely hence the 1 star. The salad had a stale smell and the steak was only fat and raw despite us requesting well done multiple times. Adding the images that shows an uneven cook on the meat. We had to turn back the food. What a shame. The restaurant is in such a good location. Would never recommend it. || We had beef lasagna and tacos, and both were just ok. The lasagna didn’t seem to have much beef, but was filled with plenty of cheese and sauce. The flavor was also lacking, but with some salt, pepper and olive oil it improved. The service was exceptional. || I saw good reviews for Fiorella before I arrived in Lisbon. It was definitely what I was expecting with great attentive staff, lovely tasting food (I got the beef lasagne and garlic bread), and cool atmosphere. Buzzing in the outdoor seating area i was in.  Staff were quick to wipe tables and greet customers and were friendly, especially Ana who was my server. What a great restaurant! One Id recommend! || My sister and I are visiting Portugal and I came across Fiorella! So glad that we are here. The atmosphere is beautiful and trendy, the service is top notch. We had a Spritz and Margarita Pizza. It was also located across from a Christmas Market. Great food and place to eat all around. || Beautiful restaurant! They have heaters and blankets outside so it’s very cozy. The food and drinks are yummy and the service is excellent. Kim in particular was very accommodating and friendly. I recommend a visit! || Nice restaurant, we had a pizza, burger, brusketta and a steak (although we ordered ribs, but we were very hungry to wait longer). The food was fine, the staff was friendly. || Great food, excellent atmosphere, great service, took our time, relaxed... Staff very nice and understanding... Would certainly recommend || This has been my favorite restaurant in Lisbon during my visit here. The food has been great and service has been superb. Our server Madhu was super friendly and gave us great recommendations. I love the double burger. The T bone steak was great too. || 5 stars all around; great service, the vibe is really nice and calm right in the centre of the square, and the food, wow. Brilliant food, I got the pizza and my partner got the Picanha, incredible. Definitely worth visiting when in Lisbon. || Absolutely fantastic experience! The food was delicious, fresh, and full of flavor, and the service was just as impressive. A special shoutout to Madhu, our server—attentive, kind, and truly made us feel welcome. She added that extra touch that made our visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this place and will definitely be coming back! || We love this place, we've been 4 times now on our visit to Lisbon. Friendly staff,  lovely atmosphere and fab food. We'll come again too. || Stopped by Fiorella’s in Lisbon for happy hour and was lucky to be served by Sabita—absolutely charming and genuinely great with people. You could feel how well the whole staff connects with customers. Sabita alone brought me back the next night for dinner. Fantastic choice. I had the perfectly cooked steak, (Sabita’s recommendation), and it delivered. Lisbon has endless options, yet here I am having dinner there again tonight. That says it all. || Great place to enjoy your breakfast in front of a Fontaine and enjoy the sun in the beginning of the January. That joy couldn’t happen without Kim, he even allowed me to take Pastel de Nata from another place and add it to my breakfast in their restaurant. If you come to Fiorella - just ask for Kim and you’ll be provided by good service. Thank you Kim! || Picanha was great, however my pasta Arribiata was tasteless and had zero spice to it, a bowl of canned American Spaghettios would have been far superior to the limp noodles and tomato sauce they served me. The server was nice and efficient, the beer was cold. || Beautiful interior flowers design. Friendly staff. Simao was courteous and attentive 👍. Tasty pizzas and chicken wings. || We arrived around 21.30 and got seated outside straight away. I got the burger with a fried egg. It was pretty good. The fries were only okay.  Our server, Madhu, was very nice. Not too pushy and got everything perfect, no issues at all.  We sat at the edge of the outside area, which was probably a bit of a mistake because a lot of people were walking by.

place_name: Antiga Doca Seca da Ribeira das Naus
reviews_content: The “Doca Ribeira das Naus” is one of the best places for a relaxing walk in this part of the city.  With am amazing view of Tejo river and occasional performances of street musicians, this the kind of place you want to go in order to experience the real atmosphere of Lisbon || One of the great place to spend, if you are in Lisbon, you should visit this place. Your eye will be pleased and heart will be fill by Joy. I am highly recommend to visit this place for Friends and Family || A beautiful place to sit, enjoy the sun and sea. 😄 … || Walking along this promenade is one of the nicest things to do in Lisbon - and it's free. Coming from the Praca Do Comercio this promenade takes you along the Tejo, … || Really chill place , and a good option to make some exercises in the morning or just for relax during the night ! || Great place to relax, chat, drink something meanwhile you enjoy one of the most beautiful sunset that I've ever seen in a astonishing scenery! || The “Doca Ribeira das Naus” is one of the best places for a relaxing walk in this part of the city.  With am amazing view of Tejo river and occasional performances of street musicians, this the kind of place you want to go in order to experience the real atmosphere of Lisbon || Clean open area in Lisbon with views of the water! Definitely worth a look! || One great vantage point to see the water, the  popular bridge and to take awesome photos. || Nice place enjoy view and restaurants and walking

Does not worth at the trip or paying the 18 euros. The boat has limited space at the top, and if you happen to get a seat on the right side, you’ll enjoy the view on both rides. The boat goes along one side of Lisbon and comes back from the other. The music that accompanies the trip really puts your nerves on edge, as it doesn’t match the spirit or context of the tour, with a lot of noise and unclear sound. The audio guide, which requires downloading an app, gives only brief explanations of a few monuments, so if you don’t have it, you’ll need to guess or read about them online. In addition, one of the passengers was too tipsy, standing up disturbing around and none of the crew members intervened. The view of Lisbon at the begginning the plaza is beautiful — you can enjoy at the start the beauty of the buildings and their colors. But on the way back, the view is extremely poor as it’s from the other side. Basically, you can do better during the 1h30 than being stuck on the boat and spending at least 20 minutes just to get on. || We got offered a sunset cruise tour and can’t recommend at all. Not sure what this boat was made for but wasn’t for this. We arrived 15 mins early to a big queue and then we understood why. There are a very limited number of spots outside on the back of the boat. The rest of the boat is setup with dinning tables for some reason. So even if you don’t get a spot outside to see the sunset you can try your luck on the first level where you may see something through the windows. Due to the setup you got tables with 2-3people occupying a big space with no people actually enjoying the view. We got the privilege of sitting right up front on the ground level that had the amazing view through the dirty windows you see. We got up to go see the sunset outside standing in the middle of all the people sitting enjoying the view. Not even for free I can recommend this. Just ruined my day. Would have preferred to stay by the river and enjoy the sunset. || We are truly sorry to hear that your sunset cruise did not meet your expectations. That is the opposite of the experience we want to create for our guests. We understand your frustration about the limited outdoor seating and the setup inside the boat. Your feedback is very valuable to us, and we will carefully review how we can improve both the comfort on board and the overall experience for our guests. Thank you for sharing your impressions with us.  Best regards, The FRS Team || We had a fantastic time on this cruise, crew were extremely friendly and let all the kids have a turn steering the boat. Lovely clean modern boat with great views either side for all the passengers. Good little snack bar serving draft beer and sangria as well selection of canned soft drinks and other beverages (wine) and a small selection of chips, chocolates etc. We paid €38 for our family which was great value for a 90min cruise taking in all the waterfront sights and sailing under the 25 April bridge - just the right amount of time. Would thoroughly recommend  - thank you Captain and crew for making our day! || Thank you very much for your great review, the beautiful photos and the appreciation of our team, which is always at the service of all guests with the greatest possible commitment. We are delighted that you enjoyed the trip so much and hope to welcome you on board again soon! Best regards, FRS Team || awesome experience, also cheap for what it is! we payed €15 per person! views are stunning also bar service, views are gorgeous. and you get to go out for an 1 hour 30mins. worth it if you want a chill boat tour :) || Thank you for your great review and your appreciation of our team, who always go the extra mile to assist all our guests. We're delighted that you enjoyed the trip so much and hope to welcome you back on board soon! Best regards, the FRS Team || LOVEDDD THIS BOAT RIDE!!! We took a 2 hour long boat ride with a familt ticket which was really reasonably priced! (34 euros) We originally wanted to take a sunset cruise with Blue Cruises but they had some troubles and had to cancel, however the lovely staff helped us book this boat ride that was going to leave in 20mins, which did not disappoint! We even got a discount with the lisboa card which was even better! Highly recommend this boat ride! || Thank you very much for your great review and for sharing these beautiful pictures. We are delighted that you enjoyed the cruise so much and hope to welcome you on board again soon! Best regards, FRS Team || We booked this last minute as a time filler and unfortunately the weather turned really bad just as we got to the pier, no fault of theirs! The boat was clean and not busy so we had great seats, the staff were very friendly and quickly gave us menus for the on board bar. The playlist was slightly strange but somewhat relaxing, a voice over of the sightseeing would’ve been nice but we were aware there wouldn’t be one, maybe a handout of what we were looking at could’ve been helpful. We set off and quickly made it down the shoreline to the Belem tower, then made a quick U-turn to head along the other side of the river, it seemed that the majority of the sights were in the first 45 minutes as the last hour we slowly drifted back to the pier. It was a good time filler but ultimately if you want a more in depth sightseeing tour then you may want to head elsewhere! || Thank you for your constructive feedback about your experience on our river cruise! We gratefully accept any advice and are always striving to improve our service.  Best regards, FRS Team || FRS River Cruise was fantastic! Professional, polite and friendly service. Amazing experience from beginning to end. The entire crew was amazing, especially Madalena , she really helped us out a lot and was so accommodating for our family visiting Portugal, she helped make the experience very special. I look forward to visiting again in the future || Thank you very much for your review of our river cruise! We are delighted that you found your trip with us to be pleasant and relaxing. Our team strives to provide every guest with a pleasant experience, and we are pleased that you appreciated the friendliness of our staff as well as the value for money.  We look forward to welcoming you on board again soon and wish you all the best in the meantime.  Best regards, The FRS Team || Loved our 90 min cruise.   Boats comfortable, felt very sturdy! Friendly service and good range drinks and snacks on board.  Staff really helpful, swapping me to a cold beer unasked when I picked up a warm one   Left side of boats may be best for views but great views from right (where we were).   Recommend and would repeat if ever in lisbon again. || Thanks for the awesome review! We're really glad you enjoyed the cruise. Thanks for recommending us, and we hope to see you again on your next trip to Lisbon!  Best regards, FRS Team || I had lots of fun by myself jumping in this River Cruise. It just happened to be there when I wanted a boat ride, so I bought the ticket 10 mins before it departed and had so many great photos. No need to choose a seat, you are going to walk around for your photos so everywhere is fine. The Apple Cider is really tasty. Wear lots of sunscreen & enjoy your ride. || "Thanks for your review! Really awesome to hear you jumped on board so spontaneously and had a blast. Glad you enjoyed the apple cider. Hope to see you again soon for another round on the river. Until then, take care, FRS Team. || It was very relaxing trip - perfect to summarise our visit in Lisbon. Boat is very nice with good service. Trip takes almost two hours and you can see most interesting parts of the city near water. If you want there is an option order some drinks during the trip. Big advent age- there is a toilet on the boat. || Nice to hear you had such a relaxing wrap-up to your visit in Lisbon with us! Nothing beats seeing the city's highlights from the water, right? And having the option to sip on some drinks while you do so, plus the convenience of a toilet on board, just adds to the experience. Really appreciate your kind words and can't wait to hopefully have you back on board sometime soon. If you're ever back in town and looking for more adventures on the water, you know where to find us. Take care and all the best!  Best regards,  FRS Team.

It's a huge and beautiful plaza that has been decorated with a Christmas tree and surrounding lights. You can see a beautiful sunset from here too and musicians like to come around and play to entertain your views and videos with sweet melodies! It's a must see in Lisbon and you can also see a gigantic arch and a middle statue in honor of someone important in Portuguese history. || Praça do Comércio considered a historical symbol of political power and manifestation of capitality in Portugal. It's a beautiful place to spend quality time with family, friends & special person. It's quite and welcome people who really wants to enjoy sunset. After the Revolution of 1910 the buildings were painted pink. However, they have recently returned to their original color, yellow. The south side, with its two square towers, is faced to the Tagus. || Lots of fun activities around. We saw street entertainment, vendors and restaurants and even a 360° video booth! Walk down to the water and sit of the steps to enjoy the waves. As long as you don’t feed the birds you’ll enjoy it || History at its best, even when it's busy it is possible just to stand in your own wee world and admire the architecture.  if you have a Lisbon travel card, you can climb the stairs to the top of the monument for fantastic views all for free.  Be sure to visit one or more of the wonderful restaurants round the sides.  Nightime is a completely different experience and one not to be missed. || 🌅 Where the City Opens to the River ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)  After walking down Rua Augusta on that bright June 2025 afternoon, we finally reached Praça do Comércio — Lisbon’s great stage by the Tagus River. Still with my friend, I remember stepping out from beneath the arch and feeling the city breathe wider, as if every street had been leading to this one golden moment.  The vast square, once home to Portugal’s royal palace before the 1755 earthquake, now stands as a symbol of rebirth. The yellow arcades glow under the sunlight, and the sound of waves blends with the hum of trams. In the middle, King José I’s bronze statue, mounted on his horse Gentil, looks forever toward the river — the same horizon that launched the Age of Discoveries. Standing there, I could almost imagine ships setting sail again.  We rested on the marble steps facing the Tagus, watching ferries and silhouettes cross the glittering water. It was hot — the kind of radiant, reflective heat only Lisbon can produce — but the breeze from the river made everything slow down, peaceful and cinematic.  Practical Notes  Visit near sunset for cooler air and golden light on the arcades.  Bring water; shade is limited.  Perfect spot for wide-angle photos or time-lapse videos.  Cafés under the arcades are pricier but worth it for the view.  Quick Ratings Historical & Cultural Value: 10/10 Atmosphere & River Views: 9.5/10 Accessibility: 9/10 📸 Photo & Video Potential: 10/10 Café & Rest Spots: 8.5/10  📝 If this glimpse of Lisbon resonated with you, hit 👍 and follow me — I share real impressions from Europe’s most curious corners. || Praça do Comércio is one of Lisbon’s most impressive and iconic squares. The wide open space, framed by historic yellow buildings and facing the river, creates a grand and welcoming atmosphere. It’s a beautiful place to walk through, especially in the late afternoon when the light reflects off the water and the arcades.  The square is lively but not overwhelming, with plenty of cafés and easy access to the surrounding streets of Baixa. A must-see landmark that perfectly captures the elegance and scale of Lisbon’s waterfront. || We were in Lisbon for a few days while waiting to join a cruise. We spent a lot of time walking around this area as there is a lot to see here. The plaza is magnificent. Beautiful big arch surrounded by beautiful buildings. Outdoor cafes, statues and lots of tourists all around. A must see if you visit Lisbon. || This is not a destination site but it is worth walking through just for the sheer size of it. It’s also on the water and has one of the Lisboa signs (great for touristy photos!) at the end near the water. You can also see the 25 Abril bridge from here. It was pretty at Christmas with a huge tree. || It’s a nice place, but there are too many touts. First, they will try to sell you sunglasses and then they all move onto other substances. I was bothered here at least five times in an unsolicited way. || Get a leg (or foot!) up and go to the top of the entrance to Lisbon! Beautiful views and we were able to appreciate an aerial view of the beautiful tile on the streets. We also saw the castle we were visiting next! || Praça do Comércio is one of Lisbon’s most open and easygoing places. The square is large, flat, and right next to the river, which makes it feel calm even when there are many people around. The yellow buildings are clean and well maintained, and the Arco da Rua Augusta stands out as the main landmark. It’s a good spot for photos, especially in the late afternoon when the light reflects off the water. There are cafés around the edges, but the square itself is mostly for walking, sitting, or meeting people. It’s not a place where you spend hours doing activities, but it works well as a starting point to explore downtown Lisbon. It’s also convenient, since many trams, buses, and walking routes connect from here. || Definitely a must see for anyone visiting Lisbon. Location is right in the centre close to the river, well maintained and very clean given the amount of tourists that visit here and all round impressive but of Portuguese architecture. Highly recommend. || The Praça do Comércio, or Commerce Square, is a large, historic plaza square. It sits on the Tagus River waterfront and features grand Pombaline architecture, an equestrian statue of King José I, and the majestic Rua Augusta Arch. A landmark of Lisbon, this is a must visit. || So much people waking around. I love the ancient buildings in this place, and environment is so lively. We walked along the road until get to Plaza at evening, very beautiful atmosphere, then went through the huge gate to walking street. || Beautiful and spacious area to explore in Lisbon. The historic architecture and vast open space make it a great spot to stroll and take in the atmosphere. Public transportation and taxis are easily accessible, and the impressive equestrian statue facing the seashore adds a striking touch to the scenery.  Tuk tuks are plentiful and convenient for getting around, but it’s worth negotiating the fare rather than accepting the first price offered. Nearby, you’ll find plenty of restaurants serving delicious meals at fair prices.  A lovely and memorable place to visit! || This is the beautiful please with the largest Christmas tree. It is also near by ocean where you can have a breathtaking view of ocean and waves. There is a small area with a sand that looks like a beach. || Praça do Comércio is one of those places that truly captures the spirit of Lisbon the moment you step into it. This massive, open square sits right by the Tagus River, and there’s something instantly calming about the way the sunlight hits the yellow façades and the arcades that wrap around the plaza.  It’s a spot where you naturally slow down — whether you’re watching the trams roll by, taking in the river breeze, or just enjoying the open space after wandering Lisbon’s narrow streets. The Arco da Rua Augusta frames the city beautifully, and walking through it feels like stepping into the heart of downtown.  There’s always something happening here: people relaxing by the water, street musicians playing, and cafés buzzing with energy. It’s scenic, historic, and surprisingly peaceful for such an iconic landmark. If you want a place that truly feels like Lisbon — bright, welcoming, and full of life — Praça do Comércio is it. || I highly recommend paying a visit to the Praca do Comércio area. It's a great neighbourhood, quite safe and the Christmas tree and Lisbon signs gives character to my photos. || A beautiful public plaza on the river right at the southern edge of the downtown historic district of Lisbon. There are multiple restaurants and bars along the sides of the square, many craftsmen with shopping booths along the sidewalks, bus, train, and trolley stops, and the boat docks for river cruises are close by, too. It is beautiful in the daytime, but be sure to visit here at night, also. It is a very popular place for tourist photos! || ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Where Lisbon flexes its imperial grandeur like an absolute boss 👑  This isn't just a square - it's Lisbon's living room, and what a spectacular one it is! Praça do Comércio (locals call it Terreiro do Paço) is pure architectural theatre on an epic scale. Those imposing yellow arcades stretching endlessly around you, the triumphant Rua Augusta Arch standing guard, and the Tagus River glittering just beyond - it's the kind of place that makes you understand why Portugal once ruled half the world.  The sheer scale is breathtaking, especially when the light hits those baroque facades just right. Perfect for a morning coffee at one of the café terraces or an evening stroll when the crowds thin out. The views across to Almada are stunning, and you're perfectly positioned to explore the rest of Baixa.  Just a heads up: keep your wits about you regarding the persistent street vendors flogging dodgy sunglasses and fake designer gear. A polite "não, obrigado" and keep walking works wonders. Don't let them spoil this magnificent experience!  Absolutely essential Lisbon - pure grandeur! 🏛️✨

A beautiful and peaceful spot right by the Tagus River — perfect for a stroll, watching the sunset. You get a great view of the 25 de Abril Bridge and the passing ferries especially with Sunset.  It’s a simple place, but somehow feels magical — especially in the golden hour. A must-stop if you’re walking around Praça do Comércio. || Its a beautiful square on the beach of the river, with an amazing view and on calm days it is peaceful enough to just sit there or have a walk and enjoy the view of the river and Almada across the river. || We were walking around Lisbon for several days while waiting to join our cruise. By the river in front of Praça do Comercio, we observed two stone columns in the water. We were told by the guide that the columns were installed with a dock in 1755 after the earth quakes. It is a nice quiet spot by the water to relax. || Cais das Colunas is one of those places in Lisbon that just sticks with you. Tucked right next to Praça do Comércio, it’s a peaceful riverside spot with amazing views of the Tagus—especially at sunset. Whether you're passing through or looking for a place to unwind, this is a perfect stop.  The vibe here is really special. It’s calm but still full of life—locals lounging around, tourists soaking it all in, occasional street performers, and sometimes even live music playing in the background. It feels like a snapshot of Lisbon’s soul.  I love grabbing a coffee and just sitting on the stone steps, watching boats go by and the sky change colors as the city lights start to glow. It’s also a great spot for photos—between the water reflections and the beautiful architecture, everything looks picture-perfect.  It’s simple, free, and yet one of the most memorable parts of the city. I’ve been here multiple times and always end up staying longer than I planned.  If you’re visiting Lisbon, definitely carve out a little time to come here. You won’t regret it. || The view of the Tagus River, the 25th of April Bridge, and the view is simply breathtaking, especially at sunset. It’s a great spot to sit, take photos, and soak in the city’s atmosphere. A must-see for anyone exploring the Praça do Comércio area || Great area to visit and hang out with family and friends. A lot of restaurants and cafes,  beautiful view of the city and the river. || The place is amazing for walk at end of the day and or just sit and listen to sound of water and birds flying. I think both locals and tourists come here often just to sit enjoy the sunset views, the vibe and view of the other side of the city.  Best time to go there is when it is sunny at end of the day to get relaxed and enjoy the sunset, or in the morning for sunrise. During the day mostly when it is sunny it is quite crowded. || This is a historic riverside pier in Lisbon, easily recognized by its two marble columns rising from the Tagus River. Designed by Eugénio dos Santos as part of the city’s reconstruction after the 1755 earthquake, the columns are said to be inspired by those of Solomon’s Temple—symbolizing wisdom and devotion. For much of its history, this pier served as a key docking point for ferries and ships, connecting Lisbon with the southern bank of the Tagus and functioning as an important transport hub. The original columns were removed in the late 19th century, later restored in 1929, dismantled again during metro construction in 1997, and finally reinstalled in 2008. || As described, past historic entryway to the city. Some nice musicians, but wouldn’t recommend more then 15min here || It was a lovely day for a walk, and this was a lovely place to visit! There is only a small sandy beach area, but it was fairly clean and our little dog absolutely loved running around on the sand after walking on pavement all day! (we didn't see any signs saying that dogs are not allowed on the beach and we kept her on a leash). || Just sitting there is beautiful, you can take boat tour of tagus river next to it. || People come here to see the sunset by the river on the shore. You get a nice view of the 25 April Bridge whilst you sit or stand in contemplation. Worth coming down to visit no matter what time of day it might be.  It is next to the Praça do Comércio. Here important figures, including a head of state like Queen Elizabeth II arrived into Lisbon.  Sometimes there are musicians playing.  It gets very windy, so be careful! Watch any loose belongings.  Follow here and the IG link in profile for more travel and food and drink tips, ideas and reviews! || Such a beautiful place to sit and watch the water, with the street musicians creating impeccable vibes! || What a place to hang out before sunset. What I really enjoyed was the view and all the different people of all ethnicity and background just hanging out.  Nice breeze in the evenings and some guy was playing some music. I recommend coming here during your visit to Lisbon. Amazing atmosphere..... must visit places in Lisbon. Every tourist visits this place...❤️❤️❤️❤️ || Next to the main square of Lisbon. Possible to reach here by metro, bus, tram, and also boat. Also possible to sit and chill under the good weather here. || Lovely public square flanked by these massive columns at one end, from which the main street starts. Open 24 hours. We went there at 9 PM and walked around till almost midnight.  There are musicians playing lovely songs and lots of people, young and old, dancing under the columns. Really lovely atmosphere overall. || Loved this area o the centre! || This is a great place to hang out before sunset. What I really enjoyed was the view and all the different people of all ethnicity and background just hanging out.  Nice breeze in the evenings and some guy was playing some music. I recommend coming here during your visit to Lisbon. || A great place to just chill and relax for a bit. Especially on a nice day where you can just watch the waves and look out across the water. Soothing for the soul! || Near the middle and all the fast trouble of Lisboa you find a small place to relax. You will meet young people in mind and body, interpreting their level of art in different styles. They welcome you and you can do same. Enjoy it! Sometimes it’s hard to see a high proportion of homeless people and the coast isn’t that clean as it could be. Don’t find the tourist traps 🪤… there are many… (we know it, well) 😉

Blue Cruises - Lisbon Boat River Cruises
reviews_content: We were in Lisbon for the day and decided to book a cruise to be able to see more of the sights from the water. We wanted to get a better view of Sanctuary of Christ the King as well as the sunset on the river and just went down to the tourist information and chose the first cruise we saw. It was the best decision we made that day. We weren’t aware that 22nd November is the day that the Christmas tree is lit and that there are fireworks in the harbour. As we were boarding, we saw a police boat escorting a barge but didn’t think anything of it, only when we were on board did we find out that the barge was the fireworks for the Christmas tree lighting. We were lucky enough to see the whole fireworks from the water. We received wine and some nibbles during the cruise.The staff were super friendly and the boat was modern and clean.  What a wonderful experience that was. A definite must do – even if there aren’t fireworks on that night. || A must do for your trip to Lisbon. We went on the sunset cruise and were greeted by the friendly staff. The interior of the boat was spotless and surprisingly very modern. We sat on the top deck where we served a platter of treats despite only paying for the ticket with pastel de Nata and wine. The trip was faultless- I would recommend this to everyone visiting Lisbon. || We ordered online, ate at a nearby restaurant walking distance ( Restaurante Uma Marisqueira) and made it just in time. The cruise tickets were worth the value for the Sunset tour bc we had wine, desert, bread and snacks and a nice sunset. It was very easy to understand which port to board on. The cruises are in the far right either A, B, or C depending on the information on the screen. Although we already saw the main attractions on foot it was nice to be able to take better pictures from the cruise. Its not a yacht so its a little run down but still beautiful view of Portugal. There is a separate cafe shop before you board the cruise but they were way pricier. You’re better off ordering from the restaurant you eat at before you board ship. || Great sunset cruise tour. They get apps n small bottle of wine. Good crew n caption. Wish boat was more romantic but better a big boat on rough weather than a small one. Takes you down both side of the river like a circle for a good view of Jesus n belem || Loved it! Not really! Kinda! If you don't mind long queues to get on this boat it's ok. You have wine included and some snacks in the ticket. People will rush to the upper side of the boat to get some nice photos of the sunset but I would recommend staying inside. Nice lounge area and you can get outside to take photos anytime. The crew is very nice and, well, you have to do it if you're visiting Lisbon. || The ferry ride itself was awesome. We booked the sunset tour, which was totally awesome since you saw the bridge and jesus statue in a very special light. But the food was horrible. The butter has mold on and the olives and also the peanuts tasted like they already had gone bad. || What an amazing trip!!!! Super smooth ride and pleasant! If you want to look at touristic points while enjoying a nice sunny ride on a boat this is the place to be!!!!!! They offer you a complementary drink and everything. Me and my friends are anxiously waiting to come back 🥹🙏🏽 … || Very nice views and great service and atmosphere, and kid friendly. Make sure to bring a sweater , jacket, and a hat because it gets insane cold and windy. Also the STARBOARD boat is the best , it’s not too small and it gives everyone a safe space  to experience the sunset. || Booked online the sunset cruise. 3 stars and not 5 because: - the boat itself seemed quite old and not well maintained on the outside/inside - they said the cruise would last 2 hours but it lasted 1h30 minutes: we departed from the dock at 19:30 and at 21:00 we were already landing back. || This cruise was a great thing to do on our first afternoon in Lisbon. The views from the water were beautiful. Having a glass of wine and seeing Lisbon from the water was a wonderful experience. A crew member named Gonçalo shared some wonderful information about the history of the city when I asked him about a monument. All in all it was a great experience and well worth the price of admission. || It’s value for money and it’s a big spacious boat. They have comfy couches and two inside cabins which are nice. We went in winter and saw very few passengers. Great views from the water and the cruise last for about 100 mins. The top deck offered the best views. We took the 10:40am departure, left the wharf at 11am and came back at exactly 12:40pm. || Excellent trip along the Tagus to Belem Tower. Staff onboard friendly and welcoming. We booked with the brunch offer and had as much food as we liked from a buffet service with cheese/ham and salad, also bread, scrambled eggs, pancakes, bacon, sausages. Also cheese/ham pastries and cake. Better than I was expecting and good value for money. || Great way to see a lot of the main sites in Lisbon. We were given a few drink of either sweet wine or orange juice. Staff were very professional and friendly. Excellent value, highly recommend. || 10000/10 recommend! It was €35 for the cruise tour including brunch (the food was great!) You can’t beat that, the cruise is 1hr 40mins, you get to see Torre de Belem, Padrão dos Descobrimentos, Santuário de Cristo Rei and go under Ponte 25 de Abril. Gonçalo was great, super sweet and funny. || We recently did the sunset cruise with blue cruises, this was one of our highlights on our trip to Lisbon. The staff were friendly and we enjoyed our snacks included in the ticket cost which consisted of bread, peanuts and the famous tarts along with a bottle of beer or wine if that’s your preference. It was a cloudy evening setting off but thankfully the clouds cleared and we enjoyed the most beautiful sunset. Highly recommend this trip. || We bought online tickets to go on a Tagus river cruise with Blue Cruises, departing from Estação Fluvial Sul e Sueste ferry terminal which is a very short walk from Praça do Comércio. We arrived ahead of schedule so had time to relax at a nearby bar.  The ferry itself was very spacious both in the interior and the outer part of the ferry. They had a bar too but we got complimentary, non-alcoholic drinks while the cruise was ongoing. We were taken to see some of the Lisbon’s main sights along the river.  Their wonderful, informative audio guide for the tour is available through their free app, available for android and Apple smart devices, which I would recommend people to download in advance and listen in through headsets or smart glasses. At the time of our tour, the audio guide itself was available in Portuguese, English, French and German with accompanying text (though we found the narrators clear in all four languages).  Excellent value for money and a must-do while in Lisbon! || Madalena, bartender, is THE BEST! She is extremely knowledgeable and informative.  She was so eager to explain the culture and history of Lisbon. The views and excursion were amazing. However, the ship needs updating and a good GI session. The crew overall were helpful and accommodating. Highly recommended cruise for the evening. || I truly recommend it! Great experience, you can see all the most important sights and download an app for more extra information about them. Natacha is the cutest person ever - sooo friendly! If you need recommendations for places in Lisbon - she will help you for sure || Thank you so much for your kind words and wonderful review! We're thrilled to hear that you had a great experience. || Great river cruise! Highly recommend to anyone visiting Lisbon. Staff are very friendly and we got the tour with a free drink! Follow our Instagram for more: @flavorofthetaste || Great value for the money, only 45 euros for me and my daughter, great views, timed perfectly for you to catch the sunset , Belem, and the Jesus statue  Make sure you site on the STARBOARD side, it's the most panoramic views.  And make sure you bring a warm sweater and a hat as it's gets super super windy...

Portugal Ways Alfama River Apartments offer a unique blend of traditional charm and modern comforts, making them an ideal choice for travelers seeking to immerse themselves in the enchanting atmosphere of Lisbon. Located in the heart of Alfama, one of the city's oldest neighborhoods, these apartments provide stunning views of the Tagus River and easy access to the historic sites that characterize this captivating area. With their cozy interiors and thoughtful amenities, guests can enjoy a relaxing retreat after a day of exploring the vibrant streets, traditional music, and authentic cuisine that Alfama has to offer. || Lovely apartment in the old town of Lisbon. Clean and well equipped , although I did not use the washer, dishwasher, cooker etc. Nice view from the lounge over the old town and a glimpse of the sea! Bedroom and lounge are spacious and the shower was great after a day sight seeing. The apartment's position is ideal for exploring the older part of the City and has good transport links to everywhere else. There are plenty of restaurants and bars within easy walking distance. I have not given 5 stars because of my last night, with a 4a.m. in the morning get up for my flight. It sounded like there was an elephant pacing on my ceiling, and their washing machine running until midnight. I only got to sleep sometime after 1a.m. not ideal for the journey home. A look at the soundproofing would have given an excellent review, as in the peak season these apartments would have been full...... || Clean, well kept apartments. If there is a downside its that the walls are too thin but management is very prompt to care for situations that may otherwise spoil your stay..Housekeeping staff are very friendly and regular in caring for apt interiors and towels, bedding. They are sparse but then your here on vacation right? Would definitely stay here again. You are smack in the middle of Fado territory so never far to.go. || Terrible experience in that accommodation. Some of our belongings were stolen when we were away. The access to the accommodation is through a "personal" code given by the company. It is clear that someone else had access to that code and entered in our apartment. Management has not taken any responsibility despite there are no staff there (it was an apartments building), they do not provide safe boxes and there is no CCTV inside the building. Management did not even contact us regarding the issue despite I have been requesting the company to talk to a senior manager. A notification in the police and a complaint form was written. Please beware if you plan to stay there or in other accommodation run by Portugal Ways. || A really clean, well stocked apartment in a scenic part of the city.  Its in a hilly part of town, so if you've any mobility issues, Alfalma in general might not be for you. But this is a great place if you're looking to stay in the area if you're interested.  Theres a great fado bar around the corner and one right below the apartment that is great to listen to on Friday nights. You can open the window and listen to them and take in a great view of the city.  Whatever you do,  DON'T take the first right when you get off the train station and follow the Google map direct route to it. Walk up the coastline to the ferry take a right and walk to the Fado Museum.  This is a much less steep route to the place! || Great value for money; extremely clean and recently refurbished. Fast Internet. Make sure you ask for the door code, especially in case of late check in, as there is no reception. Address not easy to find without a good map. Great location in the heart of Alfama. Way beyond my expectations. || Horrible treatment and inexistent humanity.  I booked this apartment with few friends for a weekend away. Unfortunately we planned way too long in advance. Now we’re going to be unable to spend our holidays because of COVID and they’ve denied us a refund.  Global pandemic and 0 understanding. Good luck with minor issues whilst renting this house. || that was the worst hotel experience i ever had.My family and i arrived at check in time 2.00pm and found our apartment open(it was self check-in so we proceed directly to the room) with cleaning people inside, that probably just started because every room was dirty and messy(check pics)with ikea bags in the front. to my question why room still not ready cleaning lady responded that she was busy with other rooms and said to leave luggage in the apartment and leave for an hour. I kinda find such service upappropriate, first of all  i didn't feel safe to leave my luggage in the open room, second of all i arrived with my grandma who needed a rest before she starts exploring a city, we calculated our arrival time the way she can rest first. furthermore, I left  to pick up rest of the luggage and when i came back i found cleaning lady cleaning other rooms, she just dropped cleaning ours thinking i left and prioritized her activity towards other room , although i was very specific about how fast we need it ready. i called their support number where i was advised to send email, what i did. however they never stress themselves to reply back. also few tips if you still decide to stay in this hotel after reading my review keep in mind if you travel with lots of luggage  and they provide you with upper floor that can be hard to get it up as there are no elevator and stairs are very steep, electricity in the room go on and off, not enough light overall. the only thing i liked is view || It was the worst experience of my life. Before we arrive, the company sent us the code of another room (becasuse there is no key) so we could actually enter there and there were (obviosly) other people. Immediately we contact Portugal ways and they sent us another code of another room. We could enter there and leave our luggage. After that we left so we could see the city but imagine our surprise when we arrive.... And our things were gone. Two MacBook, our clothes, jewelleries, perfumes, a watch, sneakers... Anyway, someone had enter our room but the door wasn't forced so it must have been with our code. As I said before, at first we've been sent the code from another room so we are sure that our code was sent to anyone else. We called to the company and they told us that they couldn't do anything for us... So we contact the police. While we were waiting a person who works for Portugal Ways, arrived and try to convinced us that it was our fault. Once the police arrive we told everywthing and explained them that someone else have our room code. So... We lost our things and there were no responsability from the company. Besides, there are signs in all the place saying that there are security cameras but that's a lie. We report that to the police too. Until now no one from Portugal Ways have contact us. || Decent apartments if a little bland....  Very clean, lots of space but has issues with sound traveling. The footsteps from above woke me up on two occasions!!  Great location!

We were walking by and trying to decide where to eat when we met a lovely woman — maybe the owner, maybe not — but she was incredibly kind and welcoming. Even though we decided to come back another day, the place left such a nice impression on us. Nice neighbourhood garden and vista with some history to it, although little remains of it and no information is available || This is closed place to visit and has no condition to walk around and limited view of river. Just don't waste your time trying to find sth interesting there. || very good, but also very empty, which is good || Nice place. Small and pleasant. Anyone passing by can visit. But don't make a special trip there! || This place could be very well used as a monument that served as a defense for the Tagus River. It's a shame the mutilation this monument suffered with the construction of a residential tower. The rubble remains inside the fort; they destroyed battlements, walls, and guard towers. However, there are some community gardens and a good stick for walking the dog. || A historical landmark in a reasonably clean surrounding area, where some urban gardens can be seen. A meeting place for walking the dog. Good views and unobstructed views. || These are the ruins of the Santa Apolónia fort in an advanced state of decay.  The site is not closed because there is no gate to close the fort.  The local council should redevelop the space and the ruins. || The councilman is ruining all the fantastic projects the residents had to create a pleasant garden. It's time to give a voice to those who have the expertise. || The existing 16th-century wall is in urgent need of restoration and conservation, as is the surrounding area, which requires redevelopment and development.

In short, the night girls are not pretty and the place is exploitative. I went to the place by myself and ordered food and drank. In short, I had 2 beers and a shrimp dish. Awesome food at late hours. Highly recommended! || Ok but as all nightlife in lisboa is fulled of dealers || very nice , a bit expensive || Great club, interesting selection of girls || Nice girls & drinks..😁 … || I don’t recommend this place || Expensive but interesting....😁 … || The service was terrible; you always had to call the employees who were in the service area, always chatting, for ice. Bottles cost from €150, you only get two Coca-Colas per bottle, additives were charged separately, they didn't have the more expensive rums on the menu, and half of the drinks on the menu were never replenished. The appetizers were the only concern, and we were very bored. || A club with lots of beautiful girls and good company... the best in Lisbon... || Always a good atmosphere for a drink. || During a private event, I noticed that there are not enough wall outlets if additional equipment is needed. Otherwise, it seems to offer good quality and conditions. || One of the most elegant in Lisbon, with "spicy" but somehow justifiable prices. The "hostesses" are gorgeous, top-notch, it's a shame that one of them took advantage of a trip to the bathroom to steal money I had in my wallet. || The food was absolutely spectacular. We tried the cabrito (goat), which was up there with the best in Castile. Very attentive and professional service (a little too formal for my taste). Despite the fact that they made a mistake and ordered an extra suckling pig, they served it to us anyway and didn't charge us for it. Be warned: the place isn't for everyone, as it's a kind of club (in fact, you get there by going down some stairs after passing a doorman), where girls hang around, but if you go to the restaurant area, they don't bother you at all (if you want to continue the night, there are reserved areas for a drink). The price isn't cheap (around 40 euros per person), but the food is definitely worth it if you want to treat yourself. It's one of the best things I've tried in Lisbon in over two years of living here, and that's despite the fact that the city's current offerings are very competitive. || The place is listed as an exclusive club where you can have a drink. A quiet place to have a drink, listen to music, and even dance. But with a high-class surprise, it was more of a select club but it seemed, or half the sensation of an alternate. As a local it is fine if you want to have a quiet drink with your partner. || Amazing! I loved the experience, dinner with a show, good food, and all the staff were extremely attentive. I recommend it and will definitely do it again! || It's a recommended place because it has a good atmosphere, "nice people," good food (where you can have business dinners in a relaxed setting), attentive staff, and a lively atmosphere 😊 … || Spectacular service, fantastic food, extraordinary atmosphere... I highly recommend it. || Very nice and refined place, gorgeous girls, mostly Brazilian, what can I say, the best club in Lisbon... obviously quality comes at a price... || 5 STARS Great atmosphere... Wonderful food... FRIENDLY staff... WILL DEFINITELY RETURN || The girls are great, although they are very conceited. Friendly service. The food is good. || I loved it! From the reception to the food and the show!  Top! || Adult-oriented space with many girls, catering to all tastes, impeccable table service. Recommended for adult nights out.

We chose this nightclub for our New Year’s Eve celebration, and unfortunately, it turned out to be a total letdown. From the moment we walked in, there was this strong, unpleasant smell in the air—maybe from a poorly maintained AC or just a … || Our first visit - IT DEFINITELY WON’T BE OUR LAST - AMBIANCE ABOUNDS- wonderful sound system Fantastic DJs - Perfect music mixing (predominately 80s music) … || Thank you so much for your feedback 🙏 See you soon and best wishes to you both 💙 … || Lisbon's oldest club is still a true gem. A must-visit for a perfect night out. || Nice place to dance. It takes time to get used to Lisabon's DJs but after that it goes smoothly. || It was good but the DJ wouldn’t play Duran Duran for me :( || The place is nice but the dj is super crap with that royal level garbage he calls music 🤮 … || Was recommended this place by the young man working the front desk at the hostel I was staying at when I asked where I could go dancing. I had so much fun and I don't even like 80's music. Me and my friends got barbarically thrown out of this awful establishment, and I even got punched in the ear by the bald security guard as he laughed in my face. The venue is large enough and the staff is friendly. And you can dance with grandma's to grease lighting and abba music.. would recommend you find your exiting night out elsewhere, plenty of options in Lisbon. || Chose this place on Wednesday ladies night, just my friend and I, plus size latina woman and Black woman. They told us it was a members only club and didn’t let us in even though it obviously is open to the public…seems like if you’re a tourist or not skinny they won’t let you in. Better off going elsewhere! || (I'd give them 0 stars if I could) Didn't even get in because we refused to pay the prices we were being charged since they were much higher than the ones announced online. Also, the person at … || The bouncer said to me it’s only for members, and the club was empty, I don’t know why the bouncer rejected me . I feel upset with Portuguese clubs. I’m as a tourist i want to enjoy my time in Lisbon. I have got bad impressions about parting in this country. || Great music, great ambience. Furthermore, I had an unfortunate situation happen there and the staff helped me through it, I was put in contact with a representative and everything was … || Nice night club plays 80s & 90s music that it's well mixed. Quite trending these days and it would be great if it weren't for the smoking handicap . Smoking is allowed in the club an within a couple of hours the air becomes unbreatheable. … || got in for free on a friday night.. the vibe is kind of dead if your young as it’s mainly older crowd.. they place disco music which isn’t my vibe so yeah || Description said free entrance upon subscription to a newsletter. Alright, we did it. And still we were asked to pay 16 Euros to get in. Thanks, that's awesome. You deserve one star as a reward for these terms and conditions.

One of the best restaurants I've been in the world. Extraordinary taste and superb service along with great atmosphere and amazing views of Lisbon. Tamvir was a great host and treated us like family. If you love sushi, this is a must visit when in Lisbon. || New Year’s Eve at Silk was very disappointing given the high price and low quality we received.  I usually don’t mind spending a lot of money on special occasions if the experience is good. Unfortunately, this was not the case.  We paid 600€ for a table for four people, which included one bottle of Veuve Clicquot champagne (worth around 50€) and some very low-quality fingerfood served once at 1am.  We were told that they never run out of fingerfood and there is always a surplus. From what we experienced, it was served only once at 1am, when staff walked past with three plates of low-quality fried dishes, which tasted very poorly. We asked several times in advance what type of fingerfood we could expect, but they only said it would be enough for the night. We expected to be served selected fingerfood they show on their website. What we got is a JOKE!!  The drinks were great and good in taste, however they only offered a selection of 4 cocktails that night and it took very long to actually get one as they had two bars and few people to mix the drinks resulting in long queues.  The DJ was very disappointing. The mixing was poor. Sometimes the vibe picked up and people got excited when a well-known song was played, but he often changed it too quickly or switched to a completely different style/genre, which killed the atmosphere. Around midnight and during the countdown, the music did not match the moment at all.  Overall, this bar has a nice view and great potential, however we expected something else from this place. There is so many more great bars and viewpoints in Lisbon. Silk is unfortunately not worth it! || Lisbon's vibrant landscape offers a multitude of experiences, and recently, I had the opportunity to indulge in one of its finest - rooftop dining. My destination for this culinary adventure was none other than the renowned Silk Club.  While the breathtaking panoramic views of the city, including the Tagus River, were undeniably captivating, the true star of the evening was the culinary experience.  A wist on Familiar Flavors: The menu offered a delightful twist on familiar flavors. While some adjustments were needed to fully acclimate my American palate, the steak and eggplant dish proved to be a true revelation. || @silkclub_lisbon ✨  Silk was an exquisite experience beyond words, it effortlessly exceeded every expectation.  💫The ambiance exuded a captivating allure 💫The staff members were attentive, friendly and service with an ever-present smile. 💫The decor exudes a perfect blend of coziness and modern elegance. The soft, low lightings creates an intimate atmosphere, reminiscent of candlelit dinners, with a stunning panoramic view.  The evening was divine 😍 with fine wines that accompanied the culinary masterpiece that was as delectable as it was memorable.  With sushi stealing the spotlight on our table, their menu also offers other great choices, tempting future visits to dive into all its delicious delights.  This spot isn’t just a restaurant; it’s a beautifully decorated hideaway with stunning views of Lisbon. I was lucky enough to soak up all that splendor from the best table.  To @silkclub_lisbon, you have not only met but gracefully surpassed my expectations, leaving me eagerly anticipating future visits. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  Please check out my instagram @queenzee93 for a full video review of this restaurant || Silk is a rooftop restaurant/bar with beautiful views and friendly staff. Unfortunately, we found the food to be very overpriced, especially given the small portions. Would recommend coming for a drink and eating elsewhere. || Great rooftop location with a beautiful view. The food was great, drinks were great. I recommend making reservations as they can get very busy. We called and made reservations. The mojitos were so good & made with Fresh ingredients. || Food and service were amazing, it's definitely a higher end restaurant ($$$).  Service was one of the best we had in Lisbon during our stay, but would recommend visiting earlier, possibly during sunset as we went late (10:30pm), and it was quite empty. || Very small  and intimate place. Kitchen is very well prepared and designed, at the same level than 1star michelin japanese restaurant. All the dishes have to be savoured step by step Very good job.  The roof terrasse is not really well decorated regarding the level of other part of the restaurant / bar / dishes || Thank you for your kind review. We hope you enjoyed Lisboa and look forward to serving you again in the near future. || Very disappointing experience. The food is extremely overpriced and the portions are tiny — definitely not worth the money. The service was really poor, and the drinks were of very bad quality. Totally not recommended. Save your money and go somewhere else! || Hi Jack - sorry to hear that we did not reach your expectations. Please always do reach out to our staff especially if you believe your experience to be a 1 star - that way we can learn from your feedback and also have the opportunity to meet your expectations that night. Its very difficult for us to understand what you mean by really poor service - was someone rude to you? Did you feel ignored? As for "really bad drinks" - which drinks? You had several drinks and they were all very bad quality? 1 star reviews mean you believe the experience was shockingly bad but we would assume you would at least reach out to someone there and give them the opportunity to ensure we at least had a chance of meeting your expectations. Hope you enjoyed Lisbon. || Explosion of flavors in your mouth. Atmosphere was really nice with live music (DJ) during the weekend. Fancy but not those restaurants that everything is so silent. Friendly and professional staff. Sushi was really good. Hazelnut dessert was a bit too sweet and just one texture. I would not get the dessert again, but definitely recommend it for the sushi.

A really cool club for alternative/rock/goth music lovers . The entrance fee is reasonable. The bar prices are a bit expensive but the bartenders are very nice. There is a small nice dance floor . The place is decorated with all kinds of pictures of famous rock singers. A place worth visiting if you are looking for night clubing in the alternative/rock/goth genre ^.^ || Was on last track to transzentral when Leon Mussxhe pf inovertedsummoned me for a bedon adventire that slowed down the pace to chill. || Loved the environment and people. Goth like vibe and nice environment. || I’ve been there just once, and it was a really nice surprise! Ok it’s a bit tiny, the decoration is a bit cheesy, but that’s also part of the charm. Staff is friendly, entrance and drinks are cheap, and overall music was really great, and not the kind of music you usually have in night clubs (a lot of cold wave music!). I definitely will come back ;) || Pretty decent place. Only problem I faced was that no one spoke English; if you're traveling by yourself I'd say you reconsider. It's a pretty chill place otherwise!  EDIT: my bad, by 'no one' I meant the customers there (nothing reflecting the management) The bartenders (and bouncers?) spoke pretty decent English. I came here for the techno/electronic music and was not let down. || Hum...thats strange considering the people working there do speak english and most portuguese do too. I work there every evening and i would say my english is not that bad... || Be aware! When getting closer to this club it almost seems like, there is nothing going on. Quiet part of the town, though still close to the center. No lights outside. No pubs around. But we had a fantastic night there. Really good mix from darker, more electronic music to alternative classics. || Thank you for your review. We are happy that you enjoyed yourself || Very different but cool atmosphere! It's interesting and  enjoyed out time here. Staff were lovely and a couple of locals took us under their wing || Best Alternative club in tonw. Cant miss this one. Best Staff ever, Amazing decoration!  Sound colection is the best !! LOVE IT!! || One of the best Goth / Punk / Nordic / Metal scene clubs to go to in Lisbon! 10/10 recommend || Wouldn't recommend for casual club goers, very small dingy place. I do like metal music myself, but the music was weird industrial Goth music, maybe I got it on a bad night. || Hi. We do have metal nights as well as goth/indie and electronic nights. It depends on the events.We're also quite a large club but on thurdays we only open half of it. Mybe thats when you went?.

Liboakot is genuinely one of the most unforgettable places I have visited in Lisbon. It is not a bar, not a club, not a hostel, but something in between that somehow captures the best energy of all three. The people there are incredibly warm and welcoming. You walk in and within minutes you feel like you have known everyone for years.  The atmosphere is wild in the best possible way. The parties go hard. Music everywhere, laughter, people cooking random things at strange hours, crazy stories starting in one room and ending in another. It is chaotic, but the kind of chaos that makes you smile for days after. They do make a lot of noise, so if you are looking for peace and quiet, this is not the place. If you want to feel alive, you are in the right spot.  You will probably drink more alcohol than planned. It feels like a rite of passage there, so be ready and pace yourself. Once you enter Liboakot, time becomes blurry. You forget the outside world. You meet people you never expected to meet. You share moments that feel completely out of this planet.  It is not a tourist attraction. It is more like a hidden dimension of Lisbon life. Everyone should experience it once. It is unique, warm, messy, human, and honestly one of the most legendary things you can do in this city || Hi, this place is a very welcoming and warm community. You can really be yourself here and express yourself without feeling judged… it’s such a good place for peace and self growth. And there are also amazing chefs who really make food that fuels your body and is good for the soul! I recommend this place so much if you ever feel the need to talk to someone. ✨✨✨ || A truly unforgettable spot. From the moment you walk in, the warm welcome makes you feel instantly at home and before you even know it, you officially become a GALÈREEE, part of the place’s unique spirit. Everything is always impeccably clean, the atmosphere is cozy, and the décor is full of charm. The team is incredibly kind, fun, and genuinely attentive, and there’s often a bit of spontaneous chaos that makes each visit feel special. It’s the kind of place you step into for a break and end up staying longer just because it feels so good. Absolutely a must-visit! || An absolute must-visit. The welcome is so warm. Always really clean, amazing folks, and unexpected entertainment at random hours, zero complaints. A quiet and cozy place with an amazing decoration. I would 100% recommend for anyone who is coming to Lisboa! || A place you really shouldn’t miss. The Team Croûtons is fantastic, everyone brings its own spice which greets you with genuine warmth. You might even stumble upon some spontaneous entertainment at unexpected times. It’s a peaceful, cozy spot with a décor that perfectly reflects this place vibe. I’d absolutely suggest it to anyone visiting Lisbon! || There’s something truly magical happening in this historical place. Somehow 11 of us historical statues ended up here together, and we get along soooo well it still feels unreal. Every day is filled with warmth, laughter, and the kind of growing friendships you don’t stumble upon often.  Every little corner is decorated with our own strange, original touches (nothing fancy, just full of soul) and it makes the whole place feel alive. The atmosphere couldn’t be better, it’s the kind of vibe you feel the second you walk in.  Highly recommend, whatever this historical place is, it’s special.  Sous melo, sous drama, become a galère whenever you enter an orteil in the commu with pumpin🤙🤙🤙 || If you’ve ever wondered what living inside a nightclub would feel like, look no further. The Belgian roommates here are dedicated professionals in the field of partying — truly committed to the craft. Music? Loud. Guests? Many. Sleep? Optional. A great place to stay if you enjoy chaos with a side of good beer. || A human, social and wonderfully unpredictable experience…  Days always more productive than the last: managing to start a load of laundry before noon, spending 45 minutes debating who touched the thermostat, and considering “going to buy bread” a mission worthy of an action movie😭🤣🤣 It was truly a pleasure to spend time in this place; we laughed a lot in an unpredictable atmosphere.  Special mention to Jules, a bit of parmesan in a raclette: unexpected, but we love him anyway😏😄😄 || Good old memories, don’t know if I should add photos and videos as google is offering me to || If Google allowed 100 stars, I’d still ask for more.  I had the best time of my life here and that’s saying something considering I literally opened my arcade sourcilière like a discount stunt double,  Blood? Drama? A majestic eyebrow split? Yes, all included. But fear not: they were the first to heal me, comfort me, patch me up, and basically treat me like a fallen hero returning from battle.  Their vibes were so strong they could probably power the Lisbon tram system for a week. I don’t know what they put in those drinks, but I was seeing colors I’m not even sure exist.  Highly recommend — 10/10 would injure myself here again for the vibes of these magnificent people. || Highly recommend ! Adorable student accommodation ✌️ || Always a warm welcome at Lisboakoot, a cozy yet dynamic and fun atmosphere 🕺 I love coming to Lisboakot to see the regulars and spend quality time together (meals, brunch, evenings out, afternoons playing board games, and much more…) Long live Lisboakot and long live Belgium!!!! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ … || What can I say… I'M SUCH A FAN, MY DREAM IS TO COME BACK!!! Amazing roommates, amazing atmosphere, amazing food, and amazing alcohol (unlimited too)! An iconic Lisbon spot, it's worth the trip! || The room on the far right is the best :) PS: The windows are fragile, watch out for drafts || Hold on tight, you're not going to get out of this unscathed…

NOT RECOMMENDED ! The lady at the entrance told us that we have to pay 10 euros to get in, and that it covers one beer. As tourists, we don't know what to expect. So we asked if … || Hello!  The place is great and we do select the public, hence the thought of emptiness. … More || Tiny tiny tiny club. We were robbed at the entrance. Music is not good. Average age is 50. Just don’t enter and don’t pay anything. You can’t say you weren’t warned. Just go anywhere else. || Dear Lionel, you have paid your entrance. So no robbery there :-) it is small and that's the way we like it. Can you explain about the music? We are an indie club. Maybe it is not your type of music. If you go through our pages you will see … More || I liked how they let me in without issue but they did look me up and down. Charged 10 cover to enter and don’t feel it’s worth the price. The dance floor is way too small. The bar tenders were very friendly and smiling. Might be a good place to grab a quick drink before heading to a “night club”. || Dear D, Roterdão Club  IS a night Club. Yes, it is small. But that's the way we like it. Regard. || I was with a group with more than 10 people and the security guard just stopped me and started to ask for money, when I asked why he just said because he decided When I tried to pay he denied my card and made me go to the ATM and when I back refused my money For me it was a clear case of racism and xenophobic, I don't recommend this place for anyone || Dear Jhonatan,  And our mixed team  proves we are but racists and xenophobics.   If someone is stopped from entering our place, is based on attitude, drunkness or cleanness. And, sometimes, the dressing code.   In your case, entrance was asked because the space was full and the group you arrived with, said that they barely knew you and you were not polite to the bouncer.  It took you so long arguing abput not paying the fee (with a beer included), that when you appeared with the money, the club was closing.  Improve your attitude. All the best! || The bouncer was a very fair gentleman and acted very professionally. Drinks were fairly priced, paid 10€ for entry and a drink. Music was good but transitions were rather rocky like the cobblestone roads of Lisbon. Place was busy, crowd was decent. Other than the fact that we waited 30 min for entry, we had a banger of a night. || If you want to get robbed in the area go here. The place is fine, not amazing not Terrible. Almost no people there and bad music. Excuse was that 2nd floor was not open yet (0130) and they were open until 0600. Have no idea if it’s a good club after 0130 but before it’s definitenly not worth any cover charge! || Dear Aleksander, we love to welcome friendly people with eclectic taste on music. Roterdão plays indie music (rock, pop, synthpop), disco, soul.... which were the ones you didn't like? || Gen X Dance Club. Excellent service, but 80's dance staples exclusively for the 30 minutes I was there, 10€ cover. Unless that's exactly what you're looking for, you can probably find a more interesting dance club while you're in Lisbon that isn't exactly like your local Gen X Dance Hits Club. || Hello Bradley, weird to have so many 80's hits in a row. We are proud of our ecleticism and undated music.  Be happy! || I rated it as one star because I feel there is racism . Everybody was allowed to enter in club but only Asian people stopped by security guards and refuse to enter in club with no reason. Tourists come from London and other cities but they are treated with racism and desrespect. || Hello Hassan, why did you rate the club with only one star? Our team is pretty eclectic and we refuse any accusation of racism or any other type of discrimination related to colour of skin or sexual preferences. We do make a selection at the door: behavior and attitude are evaluated, yes. Best wishes || There is a place with table and chairs in the outside, but when I sat there to chill out a bit the security just kicked me out of the club completely! He was complaining that I took my shoes off (?). Can’t you take you shoes off to relax a bit and get ready to some more dancing?  Such a disgusting thing to do with your customer. I cannot recommend a place that treat you like that. || Many thanks for your report, José.  We do prefer customers that keep their shoes on, specially closed ones that have been dancing for a while. You were asked to put your shoes back on and refused, before being invited to leave, in order to refresh your ideas, right? And taking the shoes off discretly is one thing.
