The only downside: the queue at the ladies... || Great venue! Went to see STOMP. Fantastic experience altogether

A Morte do Corvo is fantastic show. If you have done "immersive" theater before, there is a lot to discover here - if you haven't they do an excellent job of giving you enough information to piece together what is going on and what to do. The venue/space is worth the price of admission alone, but so many of the scenes are fantastically thought out.  Neither Portuguese nor English fluency is required to enjoy! The instructions and rules at the beginning of the show are provided in those two languages, but the vast majority of thw show is presented without language. || Heard about immersive theatre before, but this was my first time actually trying it out.  It was really cool—loved the feeling of being so close to the characters.  Kinda hard to follow the whole story and keep up with the main roles the entire time…  But got surprised by side characters. 😉  The building was really cool too, and the room with stones, coooool vibe.  Happy, we have it in Lisbon 🫶🏼 || This was the most incredible performance we’ve ever seen. Every actor’s story was spot-on — full of emotion and precision. The atmosphere was so immersive we could feel everything — the sounds, the scents, the makeup, the props — all simply phenomenal! It’s true that some smaller rooms were crowded and we couldn’t catch every moment, but honestly, that didn’t take away from the experience. The ambience was beyond words — we truly felt like we were part of the show. Thank you!!! || One of the most interesting and unique experiences. The actors do an amazing job of conveying feelings withiut any  dialogue. It can feel a bit overwhelming at first, not knowing who to follow, but that's part of the experience. If you go with a group or another person don't worry anout staying together, it's better to split up and follow different storylines. Not great if you have troubles walking (there are stairs and sometimes to follow a character you need to rush). Some of the guests could be a bit more  mindful of actors and guests and allow space. Still, would absolutely go again and if you're even remotely interested or intrigued, absolutely give it a try, I'm  sure you won't regret it! || In my opinion, the point of coming to see the performance twice is to try to immerse yourself in it more deeply. For me, the story was interesting, and the details were truly impressive. || Great experience in what regards the actors performance and sceneries. Downsides are the lack of a better story presentation at the start which made us feel lost on what was happening in most of the scenes and not knowing who was who. Worst thing was the abundance of people, making this experience not as enjoyable as it could be as there were swarms of people running around and on top of each other on each scene. || Horrible,  MAYBE if the amount of people was correct I could actually see what was going on, but it was absolutely crowded, and the scenes take place in small rooms,  I couldn't see a bloody thing.  And then the scenes I saw were disjointed,  with no audio, or clue, or anything to let me follow a train of thought.  Waste of time || I can only recommend A Morte do Corvo to whoever is in Lisbon or visiting! My boyfriend and I arrived today and decided to visit - we were left speechless! The atmosphere, the actors and the sheer performance was extraordinary. We will most certainly recommend this to all of our friends who will visit Lisbon in the upcoming months!  To the entire acting team & staff: thank you from the bottom of my heart - you made our first day in Lisbon truly magical! || What an experience! We had no clue what we really booked when we heard what it was about, nevertheless we wanted to try something new (1st day in Lisbon and my gf and I don't speak Portuguese).  These actors were able to convey more with their bodies than we thought possible, it had action, drama, intensity - just everything one could want.  Do yourself a favor and read the play as it will greatly help you understand the nuances.  To the actors, the staff, the people who built the props - THANK YOU for making our first day in Lisbon unforgettable!!!  For people considering to go, my and my gf have booked it again before we leave as this is how absolutely stunning it was. || I recently attended this venue for a show and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. Due to the complete lack of available parking spaces nearby, we spent over 30 minutes searching for a spot. As a result, we arrived 7 minutes late and found the doors locked, with no way to enter. There was no prior warning in the ticket or email that arriving even slightly late would result in being denied entry. Additionally, there was no information about the serious parking challenges near the venue, which would have been crucial for planning our arrival.  What made the situation worse was the complete lack of support or communication from the company. The only person we could find was a security guard who had no ability to assist us. There was no representative to contact, no solution offered, and no effort to help. We were left standing in front of a closed door, feeling like the service we had paid for simply wasn’t delivered.  This experience was deeply frustrating, and I would caution others planning to attend. Be aware that even a small delay could mean losing access entirely. The company needs to take accountability for better informing their customers about these strict policies and challenges, as well as offering proper support in such situations. I hope they address this to prevent others from facing similar issues.

I had the pleasure of attending a performance at Teatro da Trindade INATEL recently, and it was a fantastic experience. The theater has such a warm, inviting vibe, and you can feel the history in the walls. The intimate setting really made the performance feel special, and the acoustics were spot on, making it even more enjoyable.  The staff were also incredibly friendly, and the whole evening just felt like a seamless celebration of culture. It’s one of those places that really captures the essence of Lisbon’s vibrant arts scene. I’ll definitely be coming back to enjoy more shows here! Highly recommend if you love great theater in a beautiful, historic space. || Opened in 1867, this is one of Lisbon’s oldest and most iconic theaters. It was founded by writer and playwright Francisco Palha and designed in the Italian theatre style, featuring a horseshoe-shaped auditorium and classic stage layout. At the time of its construction, the surrounding Chiado district was already a cultural hotspot filled with theaters and opera houses. Since 1962, the theater has been under the ownership of FNAT (now INATEL), which continues to support its role as a vibrant space for performing arts. || Classic theater with colorful light at night. You are unable to watch a show here to schedule conflict. But we probably will come back. || My favourite theatre in Lisbon, Portugal. Absolutely beautiful venue. Really, in Lisbon there are many ancient beautiful theaters, but the are every day closed. || We had a good time in the theater. || Beautiful venue, friendly and helpful staff. Would definitely come back again! || Top! Soo cossy that it seams that we are all family on a concert! Top!

tonight, together with many other people, we waited for an hour outside the Academy of Sciences to attend the Guerra concert scheduled in the library, which until yesterday was certainly included in the program on the official website of the Theatre. The cabins on the second & third floor are really great! || Even with covid the organization is incredible. I stayed at a private cabin at 2nd rank, and when the show was over every cabin on that floor had an emergency door right on front open for you to leave. Good staff as well || Absolutely exquisite theater. Very special can't wait to go back for the opera tonight. || Founded in 1793, it was designed from the ground up to be a place for enjoying opera, choral and symphonic music. Best booked online. || Beautiful theatre, but needs a bit of tlc specially the chairs.... || beautiful location, unfortunately the current opera was underwhelming || A beautiful theatre, however, refurbishment is in place. No bar service at intermission, steep stairs but small elevator service available pre show but not after the show. || Wonderful place. Very beautiful and the concert was fantastic || They don’t answer on mails at all and their website is very bad and confusing when trying to buy tickets. I am taking Pilates classes for over 3 years at this studio! I am very lucky I ve started pregnant and keep on continue twice a week for the last couple of years. Penny || The space is large and full of light and the teachers are wonderful, both technically and personally, with an unfailing positive outlook on your efforts and endless creativity (no two sessions are alike!) place_name: The Reformer Lab - Amoreiras Pilates Reformer, Barre & Infrared Sauna
reviews_content: I booked 3 classes for a week when I stayed at my friend’s place after she recommended this studio. One of the best training experiences I’ve ever had! All the instructors speak English and very attentive to the class. The facilities are very clean, the vibe is very pleasant and all the staff has brilliant energy! They provide shampoo, conditioner and shower gel. There are hair drier, hair straightener and spray deodorant. If you are not a member and just have class pass, you can rent shower towels for €3. Their booking system is working perfectly and they have tons of different types of classes. If you want to build the strong and flexible body you need for long lasting mobility, don’t hesitate joining their classes! || Got it—thank you for clarifying. Here’s the revised version without referring to Eli and Natasha as a team, and fully aligned with your preferences:  ⸻  I’m extremely picky when it comes to Pilates, especially since I train with one of the best instructors in the world back home in Corona Del Mar. So when I say Reformer Lab impressed me, I mean it. I visited both locations in Santos and Amoreiras and had excellent sessions at each, but I definitely preferred the Amoreiras studio. The reformers are slightly higher, which made a big difference for comfort and alignment, and the locker rooms are a bit more spacious, which made everything feel smoother and more relaxed.  Eli took extra time to help me through some injuries with patience and care, offering just the encouragement I needed. Natasha delivered a completely different kind of session—challenging, energizing, and exactly what I needed to feel strong and capable. She pushed me in the best way and made me feel like I earned every bite of my next meal.  Finding instructors who really understand form, energy, and pacing is rare, and somehow I found two that worked beautifully for me. Reformer Lab is officially part of my Lisbon routine. || I love this studio! Historically, I haven’t been someone who works out (besides walking), and I was really nervous to begin my fitness journey since it had been a few years. But the instructors here are so encouraging and supportive that I’ve now been coming for about two months, and I genuinely look forward to every class.  The environment of the studio feels very safe and welcoming. The staff is super kind. I’ve taken classes with several different instructors, and I truly believe there’s a perfect fit for everyone. Each instructor brings something unique: some offer a more challenging pace, while others focus on breath, form, and mindfulness. I want to give a special shout-out to Anna Luisa for always bringing such a positive attitude and energy—I really love her classes. Sofia and Romina’s classes have stood out to me as well, they are super personable, and always keep things fresh and new! If you're thinking about giving this studio a shot, do it!!! || Dear Francesa, thank you so much for your wonderful words! The Reformer Lab has truly been an amazing experience! From the moment you walk in, the whole team makes you feel welcome and supported. There is a lot of variety in classes. The instructors i like the most and would recommend are Sofia and Stephanie. So really try out this studio when you are in Lisbon 😍 || Super nice studio! reviews_content: Wow! What a beautiful studio and experience. My boyfriend booked me a recovery session with cryo and infrared sauna as a post marathon treat. Little did I know what to expect but from the second of entering to leaving the facilities it was just flawless. Thank you to the wonderful receptionist with the beautiful South African/Polish/Portugese for taking care of me and my first time to Core Collective. I will definitely come back when possible. Maybe you can open one in Barcelona || We are so happy to have been a part of your Marathon recovery! We hope that you enjoyed your experience and that you visit us again soon 🤩🫶 … || I've been a Core Collective fan since almost day one! After years of going to different fitness studios, I was intrigued by their unique approach. Now, their workouts are the highlight of my week – I look forward to start my Mondays with Carlie's X-Former class!  The entire atmosphere at Core Collective is fantastic. Kenza, the owner, has created a truly welcoming space, and the front desk staff, including Katya, are always so helpful and friendly.  For X-Former, Carlie is my absolute favorite instructor, though I also love taking classes with Gigi and Mata. The X-Former workout (which is not Pilates) itself is high-intensity and low-impact, relying on slow, controlled movements and constant tension to create an incredibly challenging experience.  When it comes to Mat classes, I'm a huge fan of the heated options. Hot Pilates, Heated Sculpt and Tone & Burn are all incredibly challenging and rewarding. Erina, Jane, and Marianna are amazing instructors who really push you to your limits. Their selection of hot classes is also the most comprehensive in Lisbon.  For a more personalized approach, they also offer one-on-one Classic Pilates sessions. While I haven't tried them myself, my experience with Classic Pilates instructors like Jane and Erina makes me confident these sessions will be excellent.  The amenities are another highlight! The locker room is stocked with everything you could need, from luxurious toiletries to Dyson hair dryers and fresh, fluffy towels. Plus, they have a recovery room complete with an infrared sauna and cryotherapy.  Of all the fitness studios I've visited in Lisbon, Core Collective offers the most complete and exceptional experience. Their dedication to progress and their warm, welcoming staff are unmatched.  Looking forward to my next classes ❤️✨🔥 || Wow thank you so much for this review Sara! We appreciate you! 🫶🤩 … || Core Collective Lisbon is truly a community where everyone feels welcome, supported, and seen. From the moment you walk in, there is a genuine sense of belonging that makes the experience feel personal and inclusive.  The heated classes with Erina are exceptional. They are challenging, grounding, and incredibly well guided. The heat adds intensity, but her clear cues and calm presence make every class feel safe, empowering, and deeply rewarding.  Kenza’s Xformer classes are just as impressive. She is always super attentive, with a strong focus on form, alignment, and individual needs. You really feel supported throughout the entire class, which makes a huge difference in both confidence and results.  I have tried another reformer studio in Lisbon, but nothing compares to this one. The balance between high quality training and genuine human connection is unmatched. Core Collective is a place you come back to not just for the workouts, but for the community. || Thank you so much for this thoughtful review - it truly means a lot to us!  We’re so happy you feel the sense of belonging we work hard to create. Erina and Kenza will be touched by your kind words, and we’re glad the care, guidance, and attention to detail have really stood out.  We’re grateful to have you as part of the Core Collective community 🤍 || I’ve been eyeing this studio for six months— it’s the whole reason I’m in Lisbon. I can not say enough amazing things about it, Core Collective is a beautiful and top notch studio. The instructors are so kind and know their stuff all the classes I’ve taken have been challenging. reviews_content: Best place to fix your posture, body alignment, and joint pain, with guidance through your own efforts!  I personally believe in doing exercises myself and being corrected till I do it properly (rather than be "made to do the moves" by someone else and then not be able to reproduce the same movements later on at home).  If you have a persistent joint or muscle related issue, and you suspect it has to do with the way you repeatedly use that joint or muscle, you should try working with Alexandra!  She has a background in working with high-level athletes in Boston (US), people who are usually looking to improve their performance quickly. So, her techniques are highly effective.  But she also works with regular people (like me) helping them improve their "conscience corporelle" (body self awareness) for better posture and better quality movement.  I've had issues with my piriformis / sciatica for years and thanks to a session with Alexandra, I finally understood what I have been doing wrong all this time, which none of the physio I had seen so far had pointed out.  I wish I could do several sessions in a row in order to develop the full muscle memory. I look forward to coming to see Alexandra every time I am in Lisbon from now on! || Amazing experience in that new wellness studio in Lisbon. Teachers are knowledgeable, patient and always smiling!
