Respect || If you're looking for a hole in the wall type of venue that has all the class of an up town bar, this is it. A great cocktail list, friendly bar staff, decent decor. On an evening you can spill out on to the street which is perfect for a cigarette. This is a classy neighbourhood and I echo the thought that if I lived here this would be my local.

place_name: The Meeting Point Irish Pub lisbon
reviews_content: Stop in for a smooth pint of Guinness and some tasty fish and chips. Nostalgic photos cover the walls. We were served by two super nice young ladies from Turkey and Ireland. Will definitely return on our next trip to Lisbon. Aloha, a hui hou! || Hi Richard Thank you for your review, we hope to see you again very soon! Slàinte! || Im from Ireland and I can tell you there is nothing Irish about this bar at all, would not recommend this place to anyone. The member of staff in the photos section who is seen wearing the smart watch with the pint of Guinness beside her was the nastiest and most ignorant barmaid I've ever encountered! No patience, snatching money out of peoples hands when paying for drink! I would not have someone like this working in my bar! || Fantastic pub!! Undeniably the best fish&chips in town, great Guiness, many big screens broadcasting multiple games and super friendly staff and ambience! || Thank you very much for your comment. We're delighted that you enjoyed your experience at our venue and we hope to see you again soon. || Great experience over three nights. Staff fun friendly and amazing, the staff are a lot of fun and super friendly, hate to pick one out but Rajani was superb but the others were equally fantastic value. And the best chips and fish, evvvvvva || What a great venue when your in Bairro Alto and the staff Rajani is a superb host 😜 … || you are in a hyper tourist area. you realize there are 3 irish pubs in a two block vicinity. and you’re considering them. confirming you are a tourist. that is ok! this is the best one. have a drink and return to google maps || Was wonderful and so homely and friendly  atmosphere was amazing the staff were great and just smiling all the time and the food was delicious. A definite yes yes to go back and enjoy yourself. My granddaughter and her friends and myself will definitely go back and have an awesome time again. 🍻🍻🍻🥂🥂🥂👍👍👍👍 … || Thank you very much for your comment. We're delighted that you enjoyed your experience at our venue and we hope to see you again soon. || Greatest vibes ever. Me and the gf popped in for ONE tequila shot and left 8 drinks later. Great people (early enough), great Guinness, and good music. || Hello Chris Thank you for your review, we hope to see you again very soon! Slàinte! || Great group of servers, fantastic atmosphere!  We will be back to have an Amaretto sour with Danial O’Connor!  Darlene & Mel || Lovely little spot in Lisbon. Great atmosphere and quality Bar Staff. Colm the bar man is a legend . Great Guinness too || Hi Kieron, thank you for your review. We hope to see you again! Slàinte!

Wow. 🤯 this Bar is AN EXPERIENCE! It felt like walking into an escape room themed around the 1920s–1930s (the kind that completely pulls you into its story and atmosphere).The effort put into the design and decoration is unmatched! (You can even catch little sneak peeks of the Halloween elements, so perfectly blended into the space.)  The service was personal and respectful. I wanted a Sex on the Beach, but they didn’t have the ingredients, so I asked to be surprised with something similar and it turned out quite yummy.  Music is always important for me when choosing places, and when we were there, they were playing relaxing sort of jazz, super chill and perfectly fitting for the luxurious, slightly historical vibe.  The cocktails were around €13 each, if I’m not mistaken (not cheap, but not too expensive either). Honestly, I didn’t mind paying that, because it felt like I was paying for the experience as much as the drinks.  Really recommended if this is the vibe you’re looking for it nails it perfectly! || Atmosphere: 8.5/10 The Royal Vessel Bar blends a cozy restaurant-style atmosphere with subtle ship and pirate-inspired design touches. Music is at a good level, the backbar stands out as the focal point, and seating is well arranged with both bar counter spots and group tables.  Drinks: 8/10 Recommendation: Iberica The menu comes in a red book-style format—simple, but stylish. Selection is small, yet the cocktails are well-executed with good flavor balance. Glassware is above average, though presentation overall remains basic with no garnish and no coasters.  Service: 6.5/10 Water isn’t served on arrival. The team is friendly and professional, but attentiveness leaves room for improvement. Reservations aren’t needed. Prices lean slightly above average for Lisbon. || I celebrated my birthday at this bar, and it was absolutely amazing! The atmosphere is incredible - cozy and stylish, with dim lighting that creates the perfect mood for a relaxed evening.  The cocktails are top-notch 🔥 creative, well-balanced, and beautifully presented. I was especially impressed by the wide selection of not only cocktails but also mocktails. the non-alcoholic options are just as flavorful and thoughtfully crafted.  There are also some light snacks available, which pair nicely with the drinks. I’ll definitely be coming back, this place is perfect both for special occasions and a chill night out with friends. || The best non-alcoholic cocktails in Lisbon. I fully recommend to try Virgin porn star and Saint margarita. The bartender was very kind and attentive. I will definitely come back to try the other cocktails || Beautiful, atmospheric bar with décor that feels straight out of a Fitzgerald novel. The Mist of Sintra was fresh and tasty, but the Silk Road was my favorite! || It’s a very classy bar with beautiful authentic interior. Small, but very very cozy. Cocktails were great and the bartenders were friendly, funny and professional. They almost don’t have classic cocktails on the menu but they are happy to make ones if you ask. I loved the atmosphere of the bar and I am definitely going to return! || We had such a great time at the bar, huge thanks to Zhenya from Uzbekistan! He made the evening unforgettable. Every cocktail he suggested was perfect for each of us, like he instantly knew what everyone would love. We ended up chatting in Portuguese, English, Russian, and Ukrainian, it was such a fun mix and the vibe was amazing.  Zhenya even made me a special cocktail, not from the menu, just based on my preferences, and it turned out incredible. 🍸 Definitely one of the bars, we'll come back to and recommend to our friends! || Super sad I discovered it one day before leaving… it is a must! Just share what you want, the atmosphere is beautiful and the cocktails are amazing! Thank you! || I had a fantastic experience at The Royal Vessel Bar. Not only are the cocktails genuinely amazing, but the staff were absolute stars. There was a girl who was clearly very drunk and being bothered by a creepy guy who wouldn’t leave her alone. As soon as the team realised what was happening, they stepped in straight away and were exceptional — calm, professional, and completely on it.  They handled everything with real care and escalated it to the authorities in exactly the right way. I’d gone over to check on her too, and the staff even thanked me and gave me a drink for helping. Honestly, such a brilliant bar on every front — fantastic drinks, great atmosphere, and a team who genuinely look out for their guests. Couldn’t recommend it more. Five stars. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Great cocktail card and lovely staff, the best atmosphere. Besides ordering things from the menu, you can also ask to make a custom cocktail to your liking. One of my favorite places in Lisbon.

The food was AMAZING. One of the best places I have tried in Lisboa, a good variety of cocktails (I recommend the Moscatel and Porto tonic) if you like sweet things.  The menu is short but the dishes are to die for.  We shared the pork terrine and the sardines. For dessert, the sweet pumpkin with cheese and the pear with chocolate, OMG. We can’t pick which thing we liked the most.  The staff is so so so so sweet and helpful. I want yo be friends with everyone here. Truely one of my favorite places in this AMAZING city. || We had booked for wine tasting but ended up ordering food too. Host was absolutely lovely and so friendly. The wines were fantastic with a good explanation of where they came from etc and the food was some of the best we have eaten. Would highly recommend || Stumbled onto this and so happy we did. Absolutely wonderful little historic taverna with fantastic food and great drinks. The atmosphere is so much fun while reserved at the same time.  Highly recommended. Thank you so much for having us. || Sicha great place. The food was amazing!! And was a great way to try a range of Portuguese wines and food. The sardines were my favourite-the sauce was EPIC! The staff were so lovely and tentative in explaining the different cuisines and wines from all over Portugal. And you don't need a reservation and it's very affordable. Will definitely be back.  On a final note the art work is stunning such a lovely tribute to the city. || Had two delicious salads there were new cuisine to us and very tasty. Then had the Pumpking for dessert. All of the staff were so friendly and knowledgeable about all the food and drink menu items as well as local options. Will definitely go back again! || Such an amazing spot! Great choice of drinks, traditional food to share so you can try bits of everything. Most of all, amazing service. A must try to get an authentic experience in Lisbon || Was honestly skeptical given the amazing location and knowing about tourist traps but this was anything but that! Was helped by Camilla and she did a great job explaining the significance and history as well as suggesting items! And the food was properly good. || Amazing. This little restaurant is exactly what you want to find on your first night in Lisbon. So much charm and the food was brilliant and well explained. It was great to have the selection but I could have eaten that sardine toast all day 🤣 😋. They had some live music and the couple playing were extremely talented and played their lovely songs in a very non intrusive way. A really lovely evening, thank you || Very cool and jazzy place. Good food, great beer and drinks. I recommend the Portuguese Abafado Tonic! I will definitely repeat it! The portions are great and do order and share. The music is just nice jazz and oldies that create a laidback atmosphere. Just loved the place. I passed it by on my way to the theater and decided to give it a try afterwards. What a great choice! || Uauuu, amazing review! ThankU || What a little Gem in Lisbon. Right by the water with tables out front for those who want to see the ocean. The inside was comfortable with nice ambiance and live music. The staff and manager were extremely pleasant and informative on the cuisine and the restaurant history. They offer wine, liquor and some nice craft beers (I'm picky as a 🇨🇦 beer lover).  We ordered the tomatoe and cucumber salad with smoke mackeral which was salty in a great way and complimented the ingredients. The mackeral was perfectly smoked and tasted like fish candy (delightful). The pulled chicken sanwich with pickles, olives, and bits of chorizo was so tasty that it left me wanting two more 👍😁  The Urbana Vendaval IPA was nice and hoppy 🍺 and perfect for a nice sunny day. We finished off the pear, port and chocolate ice cream which was smooth and creamy with a nice balance between the chocolate and warm pear. I would recommend this place for couples or a little bite to eat during your walk of Lisbon. || Oh, what a joy to start the day with a comment like that! ✨🇨🇦✨  Reading your words was like revisiting a perfect afternoon at Taverna: sun, good food, perfectly chilled beer, and that vibe that only those who come here understand 💙🌊  "Fish candy" is, honestly, the best description we've ever received of our smoked mackerel — we're officially adopting it! 😂 And knowing that our pulled chicken sandwich made you want to have it three times? Mission accomplished!  We're super happy that you appreciated every detail, from the flavors to the history of the place (we always tell it with pride!), and of course, our selection of drinks — nothing like winning over a true Canadian craft beer lover! 🍻  Come back whenever you want: Taverna is yours. Whether it's for a toast to the sunset, a snack between walks, or just to feel that Lisbon is also made of these little treasures.  With love and many happy sardines,  The Taverna das Marias team || A very friendly sign outside the glass door — Pop in! Let’s talk! Prompted me to go in. Cozy little place, applied to apartments in NY it means incredibly small, but at Taverna das Marias it feels just right. Tonight, just a line: Victor made the most incredible sangría ever. The young girl — I still don’t know her name, so sorry — is friendly and attentive as well. I live just footsteps away, but it is very nice, indeed, to pop in and chat. How do you find it? Go visit the Saramago Museum, lovely as are all tiny museums in Lisbon, then keep on walking. You’ll want to walk right in this tiny Taverna. Cheers! || Amazing staff and food. We went back two nights in a row. The staff were so friendly and made the night for us. || What a brilliant find in Lisbon, the owner so lovely, informative and helpful - the wine discovery, trying 4 different wines, a lovely mixed charcuterie and cheese board and just a lovely atmosphere to enjoy it all in - sat here now  enjoying the tipsy pear dessert. The experience changed our rainy day in Lisbon in to such a great experience, wonderful!! || ThankU so much for this amazing review!!! || We found this place on an AI search -my sister is a chef and she really appreciated the curated recipes with local ingredients. The people were super friendly and homey we loved their recommendations and the relaxed atmosphere. || All reviews scaled for relative cost: Great atmosphere and service. Beer and Wine selections is moderate, but more than serviceable for a meal or casual drinks. Food is honest about what it is: Simple "Nosh" (to quote my wife) and delightful.  Nothing memorable and the heavy dishes relied a bit too much on citrus to balance them out, for my taste, but we were happy with the meal for the price point.  Standout was the pureed sardines on cornbread with pepper: I am adding this dish to my party offerings. I would return. || wonderful dinner here with my sister. We loved the vegetable forward plates. Our sever was wonderful and told us about different Portugal wines. Great music and atmosphere. || Yupiiiiiii, ThankUUUUUUU || 10/10 meal was so so so delicious, one of our favourite meals ever!!! service was amazing telling us all about the menu and tips for lisbon. we will be back 🩷🩷🩷 || We are a family of six who likes to try many dishes and share everything family-style, and Taverna das Marias was the perfect spot for us! We tried many dishes that were all incredible, including dessert. The host treated us so well, guiding us through our meal and the atmosphere was so classy and felt like home! Highly recommend the cabbage, the asparagus, and the chorizo, both Grandma's Specials! Beer was excellent too! || This was one of our favorite meals on the trip. The space is cozy,  the music is great, and the staff is so nice. The beer list is good too if you like that. But the food was incredible.  We especially loved the asparagus, cabbage, and beef. || Thank you so much, Rachel! 🥰  We're so happy to know that Taverna das Marias was one of the highlights of your trip! Our food, welcoming atmosphere, and music have a special way of making moments even more enjoyable. Come back anytime for more delicious dishes and good company! 🍷💙  With love, The Taverna das Marias team || Amazing "Experience Menu" the food was truly delicious and the host Magdalena amazing sharing her passion for the food and wine ! Loved the sardines pate ( you will like it even if you don't like sardines!), the charcuterie board was amazing. I loved the cheese and meats, olive and lupin bean! So unique! And really enjoyed the fortified wine experience menu ( a flight) . Loved the Abafado wine. Will come back!

A wine bar literally the size of my bedroom! The guys behind the bar are very knowledgeable and helpful, so a good glass or two or wine is guaranteed.  This is the first stop on my trip to Lisbon and I'm very happy indeed. || As travelers in Lisbon and natural wine lovers, we found this wine bar exceptional. We like the concept of no wine menu, just talk with the very kind, welcoming, calm, and knowledgeable sommeliers about your wine preferences, and they will let you try different wines until you find what you are searching for. I described the sommelier as “calm” because I mistakenly knocked the bottles of wine, which spilled about a glass on the floor, but he was genuinely calm and friendly. Their wine choices are great, and we were super blessed with what we tried. There are few food choices, but it's great for an after-dinner visit. || I loved this wine bar so much! It is vibrant, full of good wine choices, there is a park next to it where you can sit and enjoy your drink. Price per glass ranges from €6 to €20. The staff is cool, they let you sample wines before ordering and they also give you good recommendations. You can take tour glass to the park, but you need to leave a deposit. || Black Sheep Lisboa is a gem — an intimate, stylish wine bar with an outstanding selection and truly knowledgeable sommelier (also very handsome) bartenders. The staff pair wines with just the right notes and stories, making each pour feel curated. Cozy atmosphere, great small plates that complement the wines, and excellent recommendations whether you prefer natural, classic or adventurous bottles. A must-visit for anyone who loves wine and thoughtful service. Highly recommended. || Lots of wonderful memories at my favorite wine bar in Lisboa over the years. Yes the wine is always amazing, but the people even more so. Warm hearts always welcome you at Black Sheep—what makes it special. Obrigada || Amazing place I just discovered with a friend. We went to the side of the bar and were welcomed warmly. The bartender has a real knowledge about wine, switched between English and Portuguese with the two of us without any issue and has even told us more about the history of the bar and the owner.  Can’t remember the name of the bartender, but can’t wait to come back for moments like this || Black sheep is a gem. I loved that when I asked if "we could get weirder" with wine recommendations, we were brought a series of incredibly fun and funky wines. Black sheep delivers on everything -  local art, great wine recommendations, and unbeatable vibes. || What a shame. I moved to Lisbon the year this place opened, and I’ve watched it lose the soul it once had.  Tonight we went to Black Sheep for a friend’s celebration - 3 glasses, a few bottles, nothing complicated. When my friend left early, she returned her glass to the bar and even texted me to say so. Later, the staff insisted one glass was “missing” and refused to listen or consider anything we explained. We were charged for a glass we had already returned.  And here’s the thing: I understand the deposit system and why they use it. But when the system fails, the customer pays - even when the bar will inevitably find the glass later. That’s not just rigid, it’s getting money for something that wasn’t actually lost.  It wasn’t about the amount. It was the attitude: zero trust, zero curiosity, zero willingness to engage. Just a robotic “no.” It feels like customer care has been replaced by profit-first thinking.  If you want natural wine in the neighborhood, go to Magnolia or bring your own bottle to Praça das Flores. Black Sheep used to feel alive. Now it feels indifferent - guided more by turnover than by hospitality. || I cant give less than five stars. I went for the first time and got impressed by the service. They really know what they are talking about! They have a large variety of wines. Black sheep is usually crowded and almost impossible to have a seat on weekends. The tip here is to get there earlier so you can be able to have a full tasting experience while listen to the amazing stories of each bottle of wine you try! || Wonderful tiny wine bar serving “whatever we have open at the minute!” They let you taste a ton of wines to find one you love, and staff are super nice & knowledgeable. It can get packed so visit on a week day or just be patient. Totally worth it— the wine and vibes are amazing.

Absolutely excellent. Amazing cocktails at good prices. Service was speedy and server was well informed/helpful. Music is awesome and the vibes are great. Atmosphere is conducive for conversation. Great little spot to get some high quality drinks, listen to good music, and have conversations. Highly recommend checking in his place out for a drink or two. Did not get any food but there are a few options. || Best Cocktails we had in Lisboa. Absolut amazing and individual cocktails. The bar offers a good value for money. Very nice and friendly owner. Thank you for this experience. You should visit this bar! || Great cocktails, lovely bartender that takds care to make your ecperience the best. Very good music choices || Super nice place! Really great service, the staff are very friendly and welcoming. A great spot if you want to get away from the chaos of the street outside! Amazing drinks at a really good price! 100% a place I’ll come back to || Great place to visit! The staff was very friendly and welcoming. Good music, tasty Cocktails with a lot of different types and delicious toast for the little hunger. || Fantastic place for a conversation with friends accompanied by great cocktails (personal favourite: French 75, but there are a lot of options!). Friendly and caring staff.  Great alternative to those loud mainstream feeling bars. 10/10 would visit again! || Great drinks, amazing atmosphere! Definitely something to check out when you come to Lisbon. Had a really good evening here. || Natas, music, cocktails, and great ambience—can’t get better than this! (We brought our own natas). A hidden gem on the busy streets of Bairro Alto area || Atmosphere is incredibly cool. You can have cocktails, draught and craft beers and wine from 2 euros. Love the decoration and the service was amazing. Music was really good too, smooth enough to have a good conversation. || Awesome little cocktail bar with a chill vibe. Amazing bartender who takes pride in his drink craft. Loved the pear cocktail and will definitely be back!

Love looking for new local brewries in out of the usual tourist places.  Small, awesome and GREAT beers.  If you go to Lisbon, please stop here if you like good fresh cold beers! || Thanks so much for your lovely comment, Craig! Glad you enjoyed the beers! Hope to see you again soon! 🍻 … || The staff was amazing and welcoming. Their ipa is very well balanced between ibu and Abv with a 6.6% and the blonde is such an easy drink. It’s a little off the beaten path, but definitely worth it if you just want to have a few beers with your friends/date. || Thank you for your review! 🍻 … || Return visit!  Great to be back.  Best craft I’ve tasted in Lisbon.  Cheers 🍻 Vern (La Cabra Brewing)  Legit!!!  The beers🍺 here are tasty and satisfying.  Worth the walk out of the main routes into a neighborhood.   Welcoming owner and patrons.   I tasted 4 beers and all were yummy - wit was especially satisfying.  Cheers 🍻 Vern || Thank you Vern, for the kind words and for taking the time to leave a positive review and photos. We're delighted to hear that you had a great experience with us! 🍻💛 … || Amazing experience at the LisPoa Craft Beer !!! The beer was amazing and Tárlis was absolutely amazing, adorable and so welcoming to us ! Thank you so much for your kindness , you made our last day in Lisbon a perfection ! || Thanks a lot, Ninon! We loved having you here — so happy you enjoyed the beers and our spot in Lisbon. Hope to see you soon! 🍻  … || Super cozy bar with local craft beer. The staff was friendly and we really enjoyed our time there. || Thank you so much! 🍻 … || The bartender is super friendly and keeps a strict etiquette if you talk to him in english 😄 In front of the bar you'll have an amazing view down the street on the pastel coloured buildings which will blend in beautifully with the color of the sky when the sun is setting down and you'll start to think: I either get home now or I'll be drunk in the middle of somewhere in Lisbon. || Thanks for the review, Antonio! 😁🍻 … || Great beers and atmosphere || Lovely, friendly service and great beer! || Thank you so much, Rebecca!🍻 … || Tarlis is not just the owner and brewer, but a great company for a chat while enjoying some of his beers. Great music, food, prices, and service. Highly recommended and will definitely be back. || Thank you so much, Alan! 🍻 … || Excellent staff, perfect beer and delicious empanadas. If you appreciate a good craft beer this is the best place to enjoy in Lisbon. || Thank you, Marcela for the kind words and for taking the time to leave a positive review. We're delighted to hear that you had a great experience with us! || Brewpub with beers brewed on site - some decent beers. Owner was very welcoming - worth a stop on a Lisbon beer tour || Thanks a lot, Nik! 🍻 … || Very chilled place, loved it. Great range of beers, friendly staff..Highly recommended || Thanks so much, Liz! We’re glad you enjoyed the beers and the vibe. Hope to see you again soon! 🍻 … || Very nice place for some good local craft beers. The atmosphere and staff was awesome. || Thanks a lot! Glad you enjoyed it 🍻 … || Nice selection of 10 tap beers, 6 made by the taproom themselves. Friendly service. Cozy and relaxed atmosphere. Highly recommend for beer lovers! || Glad you enjoyed it! Thank you!🍻 … || Good selection of craft beers, welcoming atmosphere, and great service! || Thank you so much, Rodrigo! 🍻 … || Experimental beer, but not what we were looking for, namely hazy IPAs. Still I respect the craft and rate accordingly. || Thank you so much, Simon! 🍻 … || Lovely cosy place, with amazing people and marvelous craft beer! The owners, Luciana and Tárlis, are so nice! || Thank you, Fernanda! 🍻 … || Amazing beer, extremely nice owner and a wonderful atmosphere. I would say this place is a hidden gem in Lisbon. They have live music on Saturdays and sometimes special events like offering Pizza. Everyone is so nice here and the beer tastes so good. No matter in what mood you are, there is a beer flavor that matched your energy. || Thank you Lulu, for the kind words and for taking the time to leave a positive review. We're delighted to hear that you had a great experience with us! 🍻💛 … || Best place in Lisboa if you like craft beer and cozy atmosphere. Owner really nice guy || Thanks a lot! Glad you enjoyed it 🍻 … || LISPOA is a great place to taste amazing authentic craft beers and have an awesome time! With about 8 to 10 different on tap at any given day (with amazing home brewed options), the staff will definitely suggest the best one that fits your taste.  Cant recommend this place enough! Will be absolutely coming back. || Thank you so much, Renan! 🍻 …

A very lively and busy pub with live music. Serves a few irish drinks on tap and liquers at the bar. Prices are higher than other Portugese pubs because of the imported drinks. If you're British it is essential to visit. Seating is hard to find during peak hours. || We randomly passed this bar & being Scottish we had to go in (Scot’s love an Irish bar abroad). It was so busy but in a good way. Live music with amazing atmosphere. The choice of whiskey was amazing. The staff are brilliant. Would go back just for the staff. We had an cracking night here || Hi Robyn, thanks a lot for your lovely review. We're delighted you had such a great night and really appreciate your kind words about the team. Hope to see you again soon! || Very lively atmosphere at the pub.  The place was jam packed with only standing room.  The live music was great.  The food menu is limited as was expected in a pub.  We had a great time. || Hello Shailesh, thank you for your review. We’re glad you enjoyed the lively atmosphere and the live music. Next time, we hope you can try more of our pub food menu and have another great experience. || Brilliant bar, brilliant staff and brilliant food. We were there for the Ireland game and we found our second home. Special thanks to Mamina, she was a brilliant staff member and a sound girl. Thanks for making a bad result a brilliant weekend. 💚🤍💛 || Hi Eamonn, thanks so much for your fantastic review. We're delighted you enjoyed our pub and that Babina made your weekend even better. We hope to welcome you back soon! || We tried  the Fish and chips and it was very good just like the London one. || Hello Saleh, thank you for your review. We’re glad you enjoyed the Fish and Chips and hope your next visit will earn a full 5 stars. || Very cheerful irish pub, we were there on a Monday night and there was great live music. || Thank you so much, Lъчезар! We're delighted you had a great time with us and hope to see you again soon! || Irish pub that ran out of Guiness.... (this was in May). Had to settle for an alternate dark beer 🍺 recommended. Good place for a quick bite to eat. || Thank you for your visit. In May, there was a Guinness distribution issue across Portugal, which unfortunately affected us for a few days. We now have Guinness available as usual. We hope to welcome you again soon. || Our expectations were low as many Irish bars around the world are not at all Irish. But we were greeted at the door by Sofia, a lovely lady (from Cork, it turned out) and she had such a bubbly personality. We tried the Guinness and it was also pretty good, which is not easy to get away from home. The staff here seem to be one of the best assets, and of course the good porter is the icing on the cake. We promised to return for the Irish music the following night, so we’re looking forward to that already. || Hi Declan, thank you for your kind review! We’re glad you enjoyed the Guinness, the staff, and the Irish vibe. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for more Irish music at O’Gilins! || My fav pub in Lisbon with live music most nights and soccer is always on the TVs.  Great fish and chips and they know how to pour a proper pint.  Sofia runs the service like a pro in the evenings.  If u want a table get there before 2030 or u will probably be standing.  There are two tables outside mostly used for smoking but I like to sit outside and people watch in the cool breeze off the river.  Enjoy the friendly happy vibe here. || Hi Ladd, thanks for the great review! We’re glad you enjoy the music, football, and pints. Sofia will be happy to hear your kind words. || Excellent place to drink and eat. The hamburger and Prego was really good. || Thanks a lot for the 5 stars, Jonatas. We’re delighted you had a great experience and hope to see you back again soon

There aren’t many places open on Sundays, but Friends is one of them. Good music, reasonable prices, and friendly bartenders. If you get a beer, you pay €1 extra for the glass, which they give back when you return it. The music is pretty … || Very nice and affordable bar in Bairro Alto. Drinks are very affordable. Music is fun. We enjoyed our stay. || Ok, bars in Europe now throw as much ice into their drinks as those in the U.S. The difference is that when you reach the end of your drink over here, the melting ice still has something to dilute and tastes good. And I like this place anyway for its friendly vibe. || Absolute vibes in Lisbon. I went there three times during my 5 days in Lisbon and every night on weekdays at around 11-2am it was packed. … || Friends is exactly what the name promises — a super friendly, warm, and welcoming gay bar right in the heart of Bairro Alto! The vibes were amazing, the staff made us feel right at home, and the crowd was full of lovely, open-minded people. … || Lively bar with an amazing atmosphere and excellent music, located in a pedestrian area surrounded by nightlife and in a beautiful neighborhood. Drink prices are very reasonable, making it a perfect spot to start or end your night out. || It's a queer bar . Mostly gay men so if your looking for queer women it's hard . There aren't particular women queer bars in Lisbon is seems but made nice friends here . || There's no star rating for food as this venue does not provide food.  We went to FBA twice, and it was great both times. A slight uphill trek from the … || I was denied entry at the door for quite literally no reason. When asked about why, I was denied an answer repeatedly. I dont know how much worse it can get. Imagine yourself trying to walk into a bar and just being told no. || One of the best gay bars here in Lisbon. The bartender was very generous last night, we went to have some drink and he prepared the best capirinha ever. Small place, yet we were able to dance and enjoy a lot. Loved the playlists too!! || Very warm welcoming lgbtq+ club with great dj's very mixed crowed although mostly cis gay people I guess and the draft beer is good. Much better than I hoped for in Lisabon and for sure better than at most clubs in Barcelona. The staff is … || Just love the vibe! Grab your almost 1L cocktail, dance or just go outside on the street and mingle. Definitely will return || We had a really great time, the drinks were delicious || Hands down the BEST bar I have been to in a while. I wish I was able to get everyone's name to mention how great each staff member was. I wish I was staying more days just to go back. Thank you for making me feel at home. I will make sure we come back just to visit you all again!!!!! || Awesome drinks! Playlist is old good songs! Party starts from 9-10pm. If you fancy to have a nice quiet drinks come early || Hi Lora,  We're very glad to see that you had a 5 star experience at our bar. We hope to … More || Such a fun place to hang out. Staff and visitors are so fun to be around and the drinks are amazing. The music and atmosphere is so nice and enjoyable, literally have nothing bad to say about the place. Favorite evening/night activity! Amazing space for queer people and ally's! || Decent gay bar in Bairro Alto. Very agitated, and they really like to listen to brazilian remixed music 😆 … || I am from New York .. I love this place .. it’s small, it’s cute, the dance floor is small but packed, weekdays or weekends … the drinks are excellent… this is definitely one of my favorite gay bar/club in Lisbon… it’s a must visit while in Lisbon. || Definitely a gay bar! I had so much fun, it was completely packed on Saturday night at midnight, literally like sardines, but that’s part of the fun! The fact we’re all so close forced us to all talk to each other 😂 the DJ played amazing … || Probably the best bar in town. Amazing cocktails, incredible music, nice ambience, well decorated, 5 star service! || Great place for midweek drinks before midnight. Inside is small but was popping when I visited and the music was a good mix of global and local hits. Service was a little slow but we didn’t wait more than 10 minutes for a drink. Prices … || Fun local gay bar. Friendly service during the day. It's busy at night and takes longer to recieve a drink. || Cute servers, nice drinks. They have seats outside the bar to people watch. It was cute! || What a fun bar. A great mix of people; gender, age, skin colour! Bartenders are friendly and ready to get you a drink. The DJ was wonderful. A pro tip - make sure you return your recyclable cup and get your Euro refund. This place is fun. || Awesome bar 🍸 to hang out with friends. Small but they manage it well. Gives tropical feels. Drinks were good, price was reasonable. … || A small cosy gay bar in Barrio Alto. Great music and friendly staff that made us feel very welcome. The drinks are amazing and great value. The bar is clean and well sanitised. They also offer a wide range of 'tapas' which were delicious. Go check them out, I'm sure you'll have a great time. || Lively, loud, fun bar with a young crowd, friendly bar-staff, commercial music and reasonable prices. It’s small inside but fills the street with tables on warm afternoons/evenings (one of the few Bairro Alto bars to open early at 6pm). || Lovely and friendly gay bar, loved thier cocktails though shame they couldn’t make me a Bloody Mary. || They have reusable cups with a 1 euro deposit you get back when you return the cup. Sounds great for sustainability, until it's so packed that the blonde let you back inside the bar from the outside space to return the cup and you have to queue for 20 minutes at the end of the night just to be responsible when leaving. || Small bar with good music and cheap beer. Crowd is mostly gay, friendly and happy people. It is crowed but you could buy your beer and drink it outside. It is fun!

El Maria Loca is by far the best bar to hang out or chill in Lisbon.  Drinks are really good and not expensive, music is really good and a warm thank you to Mimo and Ronak that are the best waiters.  Wish you to stop by this bar that is in one the best places in Lisbon guys! || Great spot to sit outside and have drinks for happy hour. Very BIG drinks and great service from Prem!!! Amazing caipirinha || BIG drinks 5 euros at happy hour! Friendly staff! And it was nice to sip a drink at the street watching the funiculars going up and down. || This place is an absolute gem! The cocktails are delicious – carefully crafted, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. You can really tell the bartenders know what they’re doing and put heart into every drink.  The staff is amazing – super friendly, attentive, and always with a smile. They make you feel genuinely welcome and comfortable from the moment you walk in. The atmosphere is relaxed yet professional, which makes it even better.  We keep coming back with pleasure, and every visit is just as great as the last one. Definitely one of our favorite spots in the city. Highly recommend it to anyone who loves great drinks and a good vibe! || I must say this bar gave me arguably the best 3 nights of my life. The owners and staff looked after myself and my friends very well with many cocktails and gorgeous pizzas. We also were allowed request music so it made the place really feel like home! I am forever grateful to the happiness the brought to us all and my bank account 🤝 || Always happy hour cheap and quality cocktails also pizza in just 5 euro it's amazing experience... Great bar and staff is good || This place is awesome! Happy hour is fantastic. Drinks were really great and our bartender Prem was even better. It’s on a pretty street and you can sit outside and watch the funiculars go by. Awesome spot! || Great place to catch up with friends over a very generous sized tequila sunrise || Stopped by for a quick draft beer. $3 euro for a large. They also had cider beer on draft. Friendly waitress. Little out of the way but nice to get out of the sun for a quick cold one. || We came every night during our stay in Lisbon. 5€ for 1 liter of cocktail ???? And they are GOOOD ! Staff was very helpful and nice too. We are going to miss this bar :( || if you want a strong drink for cheap go here! $5 euro for a great drink during happy hour! We received exceptional service from Prem. Could not recommend this place and Prem more. || Stopped in here every night while we were in Lisbon. Great food, affordable drinks, and unreal owners. Highly recommend! || Best bar in Lisbon. Warm welcome and very friendly service! Would definitely recommend :) || Shout out to Ronak for providing great service. Randomly stumbled on Maria Loca Bar and he made us some great drinks. Bang for your buck. Also let us play some music. || We stopped in here every night we were in Lisbon. The drinks are affordable and well made and the staff are the nicest guys. Very chill, welcoming, laid back vibe. || We had the BEST first night here. Very cheap (and very large!) drinks, great atmosphere, lovely staff. || A great place to stop for a moment. Good drinks, friendly service, interesting surroundings. Beer, vodka, cider and more. I even turned on my favorite music 😂❤️ Thank you sooo much for a good evening! Highly recommended. || Staff are extremely friendly. Good vibe outside.  Didn't expect it once we arrived, but amazing prices and cocktails rastes delicious || Awesome little bar. 5€ cocktails Really friendly staff. And they do takeaway drinks. || Very good value bar. Would recommend for drinks at a great price. The cocktails are large

Atmosphere: 8.5/10 Monkey Mash has a playful, tropical-modern vibe with strong Monkey-themed decorations, leafy greenery, bright murals, and a lively bar counter area. Music (often hip hop) matches the energy. Seating is good — plenty of bar counter seats plus tables for groups.  Drinks: 7.5/10 Recommendation: StrawberryTomato Menu is creative and fun. Drink selection is solid. Flavor and balance are good. Coasters are unique. Glassware is above average. Presentation is more basic overall; garnish is minimal.  Service: 8/10 Water on arrival. The team is friendly, professional, and attentive, though most drinks are premixed. Reservations are not needed. Prices are average for Lisbon. || Super unique cocktails and great ambience!  The menu is extensive and the service was on point all night.  They place was killer music as well.  Definitely a must to visit when in Lisbon. || Very fun bar with unique drinks, an amazing playlist, and fantastic bartenders and servers. Personal favorite drink was the stone fruit, but there were lots of unique options like the shiokoji yuzu or if you’re adventurous there’s one with soy sauce and tobacco. The bartenders and servers had great recs and explained the whole menu! || Highly recommend Monkey Mash Lisbon — one of the best bars in the city. The vibe and atmosphere are amazing, and the bartenders truly know what they’re doing. The cocktails were excellent and super well-balanced. Big thanks to Hitesh and the rest of the team for taking care of me over the past three days — great service every time. My favourites were the Matcha cocktail with Roku Gin and their Piña Colada, which is honestly different (and better) compared to most bars. Every recommendation from the bartenders was spot on too. Will definitely come back again! || We ended up at Monkey Mash after an issue with reservations at their sister bar resulting in them cancelling our reso. This place is fun to look at.  I can't say it truly wowed me. The menu was a little lacking, especially as someone who is not a huge fan of rum or sweet drinks. The space is colourful and fun. The music was really loud and sort of annoying. The temperature was stifling hot, but it was a fairly casual and relaxed crowd. I can't recall what cocktail I tried. It wasn't particularly memorable, but it was good. Nicely balanced and I had no complaints about it.  The best part was our server who was a breath of fresh air and so super-friendly! She made the whole experience go from a 3-star to a 4. She even managed to get us in upstairs after we told her what happened to our reso.  There is only one reason I'd make the trek here again and that's the service! I mean, pretty decent drinks and awesome service, but the rest isn't really something I'd run to return to unless I'm already in the area. || When I visited Monkey Mash, the atmosphere immediately drew me in. The music, the drinks, the modern design, and the fantastic team make this bar one of the best I’ve visited in Lisbon. Especially Tiago, whose friendly and professional attitude created the best vibes. It’s clear he has a bright future ahead of him, i was really surprised how hardworking and professional he is. I definitely recommend this bar! || We came here for cocktails and thoroughly enjoyed them. Tiago was fantastic at recommending drinks tailored to our tastes and was a pleasure to chat with. || One of the most beautiful bars. Cocktails, food, service & atmosphere is so welcoming. Creative and innovative cocktail program and impressively executed. Food is so well cooked & seasoned. The best part of our experience was the staff, they made our night & made the night what it was. Luana is one of the kindest servers & we valued her very much. We love her! Xoxo || Cocktails out of this world. Luana provided the best service we had during our stay in Lisbon. She was fun to banter with & able to read the energy of our group to join in. Definitely try this spot! || What a great night! Ambitious, curious cocktails and everything was delicious! The team who helped us were sweet, helpful and fun. Highly recommend! We celebrated a friends wedding and my partner’s birthday and everything was absolutely perfect! Thank you!

Spent date night at Arco on a Saturday evening, and we couldn’t have found a better place 🥰  The vibe is perfect — the red light at the bar, the décor, the setup — all give the place a cool, polished look while still feeling warm and intimate, whether it’s for a date or a relaxed evening with friends.  The menu offers a great variety of drinks - and I loved the detail on the menu showing which type of glass each one comes in! We tried several options, one of which was  a Manhattan recommended by Ian, the owner, and honestly, it was incredible!  This place made us feel so welcomed, almost as if we were spending an evening at home — with an amazing soundtrack! We’ll definitely be back ✨ || I went to Arco tonight and it really surprised me. It’s the kind of spot you go to when you want a more private, chill night or something a little romantic. The atmosphere is perfect for that: stylish, cozy, and just easy to enjoy  I had the Manhattan and the Whiskey Sour, both were spot on and honestly some of the best I’ve had in Lisbon. The staff are genuinely great, super welcoming without being pushy, which makes a big difference. The furniture, lighting, and overall vibe give the place a really good energy  It’s definitely a place I’d recommend for dates or just a quiet, relaxing night out || Thanks Juan Ignacio! We agree, it's a good place for dates || The bar was really cozy – I loved what they did with the space. It’s a mix of rustic and modern, and keeping the original arch gave it such a unique charm.  The drinks were great! I’m not even sure about the names because the bartenders were super friendly and actually made two cocktails based on what we liked the most.  The staff was amazing – really cool and welcoming. They even gave us a little tour and explained the history of the building, which made the experience even more special.  Overall, such a great spot with character, great drinks, and an incredible team behind the bar. Definitely worth a visit! || Thank you so much for such an amazing review Beatriz! We loved your pictures and hosting you. Please come back soon! || Loved this place, proper Italian comfort food served as petiscos. The Talià meatballs with tomato sauce and Grana Padano taste like homemade Sunday lunch. Great option if you search for Italian tapas in Lisbon. They also have lactose free options and vegetarian options. || Arco Cocktail Bar is a chic yet cozy and warm haven amidst all the actions in Lisbon. Set inside a beautiful historic space with a stone arch, the bar has an incredible selection of liquor from the floor to ceiling where the bartenders have to climb a ladder to navigate. We were a group of 6 with a very different flavor preferences. Franc and Ian did an amazing job recommending cocktails. Their signature cocktails were delicious - many of classics with wonderfully executed modern twists, such as clarified piña colada that is light and balanced without syrupy sweet or heavy cream texture. My favorite was one that had so many characters - spicy ginger apricot mixed into such unique flavor profile! Some members of our group who ordered the classics were also impressed by how delicious they were. The music selection and the volume was just right - setting the chill vibe ambience where we could easily enjoy the music and carry on conversations with ease. We are glad they also had pizzas that we could order. We had a wonderful evening and Arco Cocktail Bar is truly one of the best spots in Lisbon. || Wow Regina thank you for such an amazing review, truly heartful. The pictures are also great! || Loved Arco, it’s a really nice spot to go with friends. Very nice bartenders and the space is very cozy and warm. Loved hearing the elétrico passing every 10min. Found it a tad expensive in comparison to competitors, but that’s my only issue and the only reason I give it 4 stars instead of 5. || Thank you Sara! Great pictures || Arco is such a hidden gem!! It’s a bit tucked away but the aesthetics are everything and it’s perfect for a cozy date night and delicious cocktails. Although it was a quiet night, the servers were so helpful and we had the best time, especially fun watching the tram go by the window!! Definitely recommend for your next cocktail night out. || Thank you Cassidy! Loved the pictures || Had such a lovely time at Arco Bar. Ian, one of the bar tenders was super friendly. Really wholesome ambience inside with the lighting come from behind the bar, and cosy as it's built under an arch (hence the name). They even had an area that is set up like a homely kitchen. Cocktails were nice, a bit on the pricey side for Lisbon but a lovely bar and good vibes! || Thank you Aimée! It was great to have you. Please come back any time || As a local Portuguese, I was genuinely impressed by Arco Bar. I had a Pisco Sour and it was honestly one of the best I’ve ever had – perfectly balanced and super refreshing.  The atmosphere is amazing – stylish yet relaxed, with a vibe that makes you feel instantly at home. And the staff truly make the experience: warm, attentive, and clearly passionate about what they do.  Whether you’re visiting Lisbon or you live here, I highly recommend stopping by. It’s one of those spots you’ll want to come back to!  I’ll definitely come back! || Wow Beatriz thank you! We truly appreciate this || What a cool spot in Lisbon! We told the bartender to surprise us with the cocktails- he made smth so awesome outside the menu and we loved it. The vibe was lovely and the interior design was on point. Definitely 💯 recommend || Thank you so much for such an amazing review! The pictures are amazing || This bar is perfect. Cozy, welcoming and warm. You can feel the care in everything they do. The drinks are a craft in themselves and they taste incredible and look beautiful. It is the kind of place where you instantly relax and want to stay awhile. A truly special find. || We went to Arco Bar on a Friday night and we felt immediatly captivated by the wholesome ambience there! The soft glow of low lights and vibrant neon set the perfect mood! We ordered 2 cocktails: the Daiquiri and the Manhattan, both amazing🍸✨ Highly recommend this place!🤩 || Thank you Beatriz! You ordered 2 of our favorite cocktails. Good choice! || It was really, really good! I fell in love with the place, such a beautiful spot, especially when the elétrico passes by. It was a pleasure meeting Frank; he treated us with such hospitality and makes the best drinks. What an amazing cocktail night! || Thank you so much for your warm review Sebas! It truly makes our day || This bar has such a great vibe! The atmosphere is relaxed with good music, cozy lighting, and beautiful decor. I went with friends and we tried several cocktails, each one was delicious. The waiter was super friendly and even gave us great recommendations for drinks. Definitely a spot I’d recommend, whether you’re out with friends or on a date :). || Thank you so much Gabriela! The pic looks amazing. Hope to see you soon || The moment you walk in, you’re greeted by an impressive semi-circular bar that instantly gives off a touch of old New York glamour. Set in a beautifully restored Lisbon cellar, the atmosphere is full of charm and character. Great music, truly amazing cocktails, and super friendly staff make it a place you just want to stay for hours. They also host lots of fun events — absolutely worth a visit! || Thank you Stefanie! So good to hear that you noticed the NYC touch. That's the idea ✨️ || A place I’ll definitely come back to! A cozy bar with super friendly staff, perfect for ending the night with friends. It’s really close to public transport and, as a Lisbon local, I can say it fits perfectly with the city’s vibe! Not to mention it’s pet friendly!!! Loved it 🫶 || Thank you so much for your review Mimi! We're glad you liked it and hope to see you soon || Our friend Nacho invited us and we had a wonderful evening. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, with nice music and friendly staff who made us feel at home. Highly recommended! || Thanks Eddy! Thanks for the great pictures. Come back any time || This place is just perfection!!! Amazing cocktails, great ambiance, perfect music! All the staff is so lovely and the place is beautiful! || Thank you Mafalda! We agree about the staff. Friendly and always ready to help! || I went and it was wonderful. The space is super cozy, the cocktails are incredible, and everyone was so nice!! I really need to return to eat something and drink another cocktails. Perfect for dates, any type. || Thank you Beatriz! It's indeed very nice for dates haha || We were wandering in beautiful Lisbon until we saw Nacho standing in the door. His energy brought us in! Best choice of our night. Cozy, private and romantic ambient with dim lighting and classic furniture. Amazing vibes, you won’t regret it! || Thanks Vidar! We hope you enjoyed and come back soon

A beautiful little bar in Lisbon. The decor is straight out of a movie. You walk in and forget where you are. It is an intimate space and I recommend booking in advance if possible. The prices are ok ok the cocktails and I thought they were generous on the amounts. Definitely work a stop! || Hi Donnie, Thank you very much for your visit and kind rating.  See you soon 🍾🍾 … || Fantastic little bar. Hidden amongst houses you need to ring the door bell and you're taken out of Lisbon and into a drinkers where time stands still. Decorated with traditional artworks and decor this place is a must for even just a night cap. Host was friendly and service was excellent || Hi Samantha, thank you so much for your visit and kind words. See you soon. Cheers 🍷🍹 … || Prices are higher here than most places but some of the drinks are quiet good. I recommend the top secret drink which is listed on the cocktail menu but without any clue as to what is in it. Most of the cocktails seem to be mixed a little on the strong side which is normally a good thing, they are not stingy with the alcohol. Nice atmosphere, it feels cool inside. Because it's aiming for the feel of a speakeasy, the door remains locked. We joked they are clearly catering to vampires as you have to be invited inside. And it has a vampire feel to the place. It's a fun place to stop in if you are in town and want a quiet bar where you can actually hear each other and have a relaxed conversation. || Hi John, thank you for your review and feedback! We're happy to hear you enjoyed the cocktails — especially the secret cocktail 😊 — and the atmosphere at Procópio. We hope to welcome you back soon! Cheers 🍸🍸🍸 … || Strange place, mostly English speaking people come with non-english staff. Drink menu consists of very old-fashioned cocktails, I guess keeping with the theme. It is a very photogenic space, small, quiet so when you talk everyone can hear. I guess it was fine for one visit. I would not come here for dinner, didn't look like they have a "real" kitchen. || Hello Jane, Hello! Procópio thanks you for your visit and informs you that we are a bar classified as a shop with history by the Lisbon City Council, having existed as such for 53 years and not as a restaurant. Our staff, in addition to English, communicate in French, Spanish, Catalan, German and of course Portuguese. Regarding our clientele, we are a bar frequented mostly by Portuguese people, with a small presence of native speakers of foreign languages. See you soon, Cheers 🍸🍸 || What a great intimate place!! Love the decoration ❤️ || Hello House, Procópio thanks you for your visit and kind review. See you soon! Cheers 🥂🥂 … || We loved this place, went on our first night is Lisbon and returned for more drinks on another night. Friendly service, good prices, fabulous cocktails in a fun atmosphere. Bravo 👏 || Hi Matthew, thank you so much for your kind and inspiring words. It's comforting to have feedback from our customers. See you soon, and we look forward to your next visit. Cheers 🍸🍾🍸🍾 … || Great spot for a cocktail! A bit hidden from the main street, after passing by the cute outside area the red door reveals this cozy 1920s inspired cocktail bar. The tables and seats are nice comfortable, the decoration is fun and campy, the menu offer a wide range of drinks that are made pretty fast, the price is fair. || Hi Nathan, thank you so much for your kind words and review. See you soon! Cheers 🥂 … || A fun little bar tucked away in Lisbon filled with interesting decor in a warm, wooden setting. Great drinks and kind service. The crowd is very local so if we respect that, you should be good. || Olá John, I'm glad you liked our space and had fun. We strive to make Procópio a magical place where the clients have the best service and great drinks. Until next time Chears ✨️🍾✨️ … || Good ambiance inside and outdoors. Located in a calm and quiet neighborhood of Lisbon. The lady owner is very friendly and knows how to receive guests/customers. Drinks are reasonably priced and so as the food. Minor cleaning of the area and sofa can be done for optimum cozy bar experience || Dear Mundo, Thank you for the evaluation and nice words. It was lovely to have you here. Hope too  see you soon!🥂 … || What a lovely place. Little door (akin to an house), to knock on in order to get in. Very friendly atmosphere, great service, not expensive. Try the local drinks you won't be disappointed. Absolutely tip top, with a lot of history about the place (think 1890s for planning purposes etc) It's a must visit. || Thank you so much for your kind words and beautiful photos. We are happy you had such a great time with us. Hope to see you soon! Cheer's 🥂 …

Great drinks. Awesome view of the city from the rooftop bar. Can’t go wrong. Affordable prices.  Let’s do it! || Main bar is down stairs however upstairs is a great rooftop terrace for 20ish people. Waiter managed the terrace perfectly. Great to watch the sun go down against the colourful buildings. Well priced and a great spot! || It was one of our favorite stops in Lisbon. Nice upper deck patio overseeing the town. Affordable prices. || We came to Lisboa Bar which is directly outside the Rossio train station in Lisbon, Portugal. We were greeted by the friendliest smile from the bartender Luca. He made my husband and I Sangria’s and they are the BEST we have ever had. Even better than some from Spain. Prices are cheap and service is amazing! I would definitely stop by this bar when in Lisbon😊 || Thanks Shantele 🙏🏾. … || Beautiful rooftop bar with a view of Rossio square. The two of us were alone on the rooftop and the staff switched a romantic play list for us and made our night. Great selection of drinks, highly recommended. || During our Lisbon trip last week, we went there three times cause it's rooftop has an amazing view and they have great cocktails. Also, the staff is super friendly and attentive. || Excellent service! All of the staff were very friendly and helpful. Andre helped walk my mother upstairs (she’s 77 and stairs can be tough) and helped us get situated. The sangria and views were wonderful too❣️ Highly recommended! || I was introduced to this bar during a stop while on a walking tour.  I didn't partake the first night because I was exhausted and didn't want to have a drink.  However,  my friend and I made it back here twice before leaving Portugal.   Both times, we visited this dive bar at night.   It wasn't as busy as it seemed to be during the day.   The only downside is that we never made it to the rooftop.  The first time, we ordered a Caprinha Black, and it became our drink of choice at this bar.  On the second visit,  the drink was better than the first time.   I'd definitely recommend stopping by and having a drink and possibly a bite to eat.  The vibes are great! || If you want the best pint of super bock, then this is the place. The pint was perfectly poured. Stayed cold all the way to the end. Really great taste. And only 4 euro. What!!!!!!!!!  If in Lisbon check this place out. Not far from the city centre. || Great bar with a roof terrace. Couldn't give 5 stars, as the barman accidentally started to pour the wrong beer, and instead of emptying the glass, filled up the rest of the glass with the correct beer which we thought was unusual. || Hi Mishka! Thank you for your feedback. Regarding the reuse of the cup, it's normal (since it was you who drank and not someone else 😉). But don't worry, we wouldn't use the same cup all night and of course it would be replaced with another if you drank more 😀. Thank you for your feedback and a Merry Christmas 🎄 and a prosperous 2026 🍾.

This little bar in Alfama is just perfect! 🍷 We had such a lovely time having wine and a great chat with the owner. He let us sample a few wines before we picked one. The cheese platter was also delightful. 🧀 Totally recommend! ✨ || We had fun at the tipsy turtle! I had a glass of delicious red wine, and my husband tried a few of the beers. Ronny was super helpful with selecting local wines, letting me taste a few to see which ones i liked. They are super knowledgeable and friendly! Will return. || We rounded out a great stay in Lisbon with an evening drink at the Tipsy Turtle. The drinks and cheese board were great, and the best part was the owner / manager / barman. He was really knowledgeable, lots of good advice about wine, port and the broad range of spirits and after dinner drinks.   My wife ordered Doces Traditionais, Keira Baixa, Licorice Pastel de Nata. It really was Libon's famous pastry in a bottle. A few other people in the bar also ordered the same after hearing the "ooh's and aah's". A fun, friendly spot. || We had the best time at the Tipsy Turtle! Ronny is an amazing bartender.  The charcuterie and cocktails were amazing.  Fantastic local atmosphere.  If you visit Lisbon, go here! || So lucky we found this wine bar- amazing service, wine and cheese. Met a new friend, Mary, who said the beer was great. Bartender Dillon’s recommendations were excellent- we tried so many wines we loved with tastes before we decided on a glass.  We tried so many- full bodied red, tawny port, and red and white sangria (freshly made to order).  The cheese plate was excellent- recommend the medium size for 2+ people. For atmosphere, service and quality, this is the place, highly recommend. || Perfect spot to take a drink. Highly recommended. Some of the best drinks we’ve had. Ronny and the crew were simply amazing. A must if you’re in Lisbon. || If you’re looking for a place with good music and great Portuguese wine don’t hesitate to check out this space! Our server let us try out the wines before purchasing and was very knowledgeable, he even gave us a couple free samples. A perfect place to grab a drink or two while discovering the Alfama neighbourhood. || What a hidden(?) gem! Stumbled upon this place looking for a quick glass of wine and little did we know that Ronny was our guy. Super friendly, attentive, and great wine. He let us try a wide variety of drinks and even hooked us up with some pastel de nata shots! Seriously—this place is awesome. Comfort, great wine, fantastic charcuterie board, and easy company are found here. 15/10, will be back. || Ronnie was a great host, a very knowledgeable bartender. Cocktails were amazing, Mojito & Pastel De Nata we would recommend. The music was fun & upbeat, great vibes! Give this bar a visit & you won’t be disappointed Ross, Lewis, Laura & Zak from Scotland :) || Beautiful bar with the best bar staff. Bar staff are so knowledgeable with fantastic wine recommendations and so knowledgeable. Had the best wine, cheese board, and shots. Literally couldn't ask for a better bar to stumble upon.

place_name: Pink Bar - The smallest bar in town
reviews_content: Sweet super tiny bar in Lisbon. Fortunately got here early and didn’t have to wait in any crazy lines like they had later on. Unsure if I ordered wrong both times but the drinks were quite rough || Great bar one of the best in town Best cocktails And the shots Great recommendation || They do not ask you what exchange rate you want to pay and force you to pay the 5% markup if you're using USD. || We recommend customer to pay in EUR,and its the customer who choose the currency . || Good drinks, owners, talkings. Pink cocktail was perfect. 5/5 || Exactly what it says it is. Good fun to have a beer from there. || Savory and tasteful takeaway cocktails for the right price. Not cheap because these cocktails are pretty loaded. There's a superman behind the counter || I love it here!!  Best drinks best vibes like… crazy from such a small place || Nice spot for a drink on the go! Great service and highly recommend || Best experience, great music and good vibes! Great prices too. || Nice place to drink cocktails. Funny and happy bartender.

We love trying cocktail rooms wherever we go, tried this one and it REALLY hit the spot. Best owners, very kind, great vibes - extremely relaxed. The drinks were solid - will hold their own against any cocktail room anywhere. We had the smoky margarita, negroni, a Caribbean inspired drink (forgot the name) and the Black Forest.  Shout out to the Black Forest, that was one VERY well made drink! Completely recommend. Host made us taste her favorite drink - I think it was called the Nikkei Milk Punch and I must say that one was extremely well balanced and beautiful as well.  Best part of the space for us were all the 🐶s visiting, completely made our evening! || Atmosphere: 8/10 Located in Lisbon’s Graça district. Very chill, home-style vibe—cozy, comfortable, music at a good level. Backbar is okay. Seating is limited: no bar counter, a few indoor tables, plus some patio seats.  Drinks: 8.5/10 Recommendation: Black Forrest, Pineapple Express Menu is simple. Selection is decent. Flavors are good. Coasters are nice; glassware is average; garnish is nice. Presentation is okay overall, with unique ice on select serves.  Service: 8.5/10 Water on arrival. Team is friendly, professional, and attentive. Prices are average for Lisbon. Reservations not needed. || Proper crafted cocktails in a small, cozy and we'll appointed space. Joanna and Peter create lovely drinks and provide personal service. I had a lovely milk punch which was perfectly balanced.  Its a good idea to make reservations. We will definitely go again. || Booked Onda to grab a quick pre-dinner drink and we ended up going a bit early and I’m so happy we did!  We got to try four different cocktails and they were so good and so creative! The space was also really cool - loved the decor and the owners were really sweet. || Had an amazing time here and really enjoyed getting to know the owners and hearing their stories and recommendations.  We loved it so much we closed out both of our nights in Lisbon here.  If you are looking for a great cocktail and a relaxing chill atmosphere this is the place to go! || This was hands-down our favorite cocktail bar in the city. It’s a laid back atmosphere where the husband/wife owners attend to the customers with passion and dedication. It’s clear that they love what they do. In my opinion, this establishment is better than Red Frog. The Nikkei Milk Punch was my favorite. You won’t find anything like it elsewhere; it’s one-of-a-kind. Don’t pass up the opportunity to visit, but do make a reservation. || What do you know about cocktails? 🍸✨ Forget everything you think you know! 😎 Because here, a whole new world will open up to you — a world of amazing flavors, aromas, adventures, and people who are truly in love with what they do! 💫🌍💃  Every sip is a little journey 🌴🍹 — through taste, through passion, through creativity! 💥 Whether you’re into something classic, bold, or totally unexpected, they’ll create the perfect cocktail just for you! 🍒🍍🍋  This place isn’t just about drinks — it’s about emotions, art, and pure joy! 💖✨ So dive in, explore, and let yourself be amazed by this ocean of cocktails! 🌊🍸🔥  Cheers to unforgettable moments! 🥂😄🍹 || Thank you so much for your visit and review. We hope you can come by this week for the tasting experience before you go home. 🍸🍸🍸 … || I’ve gone to Onda multiple times, and have always had a nice time.  I lived here as a student (American so do take that into account with my opinions on prices) for about a year and visited multiple times throughout my stay. A few times I went for drinks (sometimes alcoholic and sometimes not, they have amazing options for both) and once for a cocktail making class which was a super fun experience!  It’s a place to go if you want nice cocktails. They’re well made and super unique, so though they aren’t the cheapest, the prices  are by no means unreasonable and are on par with a lot of other places I’ve been to. I loved the smoky margarita, as well as the Thai infused alcohol (I don’t remember the name) which was one of the best cocktails I’ve had.  Would recommend and planning on going again soon as I’m visiting for the holidays! || I can't speak too much to the food but I can speak to the lovely couple who own the place and took us on a journey of many cocktails. Easily a true highlight of Lisbon and something I would recommend anyone who enjoys the finer spirits and what magic they might contain. Do yourself a favor take a friend or six to the cocktail flight, and if you enjoy whiskey talk to Peter the owner into giving you a master class in Whiskeys around the world. || Drinks are crafted with perfection. Flavor explosion balanced with eased shoulders. Cheers for the memorable experience. || We were super pleasantly surprised, they had a mini cocktail tasting flight! All five cocktails were unique and delicious. We’ll be back! Only suggestion would be to maybe serve some nuts or pretzels 🥨 || Not a 1st time but once again it was phenomenal! Joana and Peter took great care of us! We will definitely be back again when we come to Portugal! || What an amazing cocktail place!! The service is incredible, we didn't like one of the drinks and even before we finished the sentence it was taken from us and straight away offered a different (unlike other places in Portugal). The cocktails we had were unique, tasty and one of a kind. I definitely recommend this place for cocktails lovers! || Had the best experience. Went for an amazing cocktail flight, but then did a whiskey tasting and couldn't be happier. Come thirsty, leave happy! || We trekked here uphill in the pouring rain, and the experience was more than worth it! These were hands down some of the most creative and delicious cocktails I’ve ever had. The music and atmosphere were excellent as well, and it was a joy chatting with the owners. I would highly recommend anyone in Portugal take the time to check this spot out! || I’ve been to several cocktail bars in Lisbon, but my experience at Onda was truly on another level. Every cocktail we tried was exceptional — each one had such a unique and distinct personality that I honestly couldn’t pick a favorite. The service was also fantastic; everyone was super friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere was incredible too — perfect for a date, relaxed yet with a great vibe. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to everyone! || Despite celebrating its sixth anniversary in December, Onda Cocktail Room has been a bar that has somewhat flown under the radar of Lisbon’s bar scene, which is a shame because its quality is undeniable. . Led by Peter, owner and bartender. A former trainer and master of whisky at Diageo, he is assisted by his wife and fabulous host Joana, who takes care of the entire room. . A small space with an open door to the street, it is open every day from 5 pm to midnight except on Wednesdays, which is its day off. Located in the Graça neighbourhood, it has many regular customers, but with the growing number of foreigners who have invested in that area of Lisbon, its menu has been adapted to suit everyone’s tastes and budgets for unique experiences. . We were invited to try the tasting menu, which consists of drinking five small portions of cocktails from the menu, served as if it were a tasting menu at a Michelin-starred restaurant. From the aperitif to the dessert, all requirements are met, always with top-quality spirits and a fantastic balance in everything we drink. Best of all, it costs €38 per person. . For the more daring, we also recommend choosing a ‘Top Shelf Cocktail’, where spirits such as JW Blue Label, Don Julio 1942, Cambridge Truffle Gin, among others, are part of the menu. Don’t miss out. || Thank you very much, João. 🍸 … || This place is an absolute must if you love a high-quality cocktail! It's all they do, and they do it to perfection. We found this place while walking back to our apartment one night and then spent the next 3 nights going back to it because we could not get enough! They offer an amazing selection of carefully curated cocktails, each made to perfection. If you're lucky, you'll get to chat to either Joanna or Peter, and they are the kindest, most passionate people you'll meet. They love what they do, they're happy to share all the insights as to how they developed each cocktail, the thought and love they put into each one, and they'll be glad to make a recommendation if you're feeling like you can't decide. It is truly a gem in Lisbon. || Went here on our way up to the viewpoint. Very nice little bar. Had 2 drinks each, all were excellent well crafted and unique cocktails. My favourite was probably the Nikkei Milk Punch, ordered on the bartenders recommendation and was very happily surprised by this one. Best cocktails we had in Lisbon. Definitely worth a try! || This place is lovely, the interior is cozy and intimate great for a date. The cocktails were amazing! We tried the 5 mini cocktail tasting menu which I would 100% recommend. Each cocktail was so thoughtfully created and explained.

The best off beat experience you’ll ever find. Manuel is the best host you could ask for. He will bring you on a journey through your own preferences and then into the delicious dark boozy years of the 1920s. A true expert of the intricacies of the cocktail world. || The perfect intimate place to be in Lisbon, Emanuel got to greatest history knowledge I've seen in a long time, amazing service and awsome hospitality || Amazing experience if you truly appreciate a well made cocktail and are willing to pay for it. After asking a few quick questions, he riffs on a classic cocktail tailoring it to your flavour profile. The drinks are potent, but he can also offer weaker or 0 alcohol versions.  We enjoyed every drink he made for us, and they were all different in one way or another.  The venue fits only 4 or 5 people, so it's a private 2h experience and reservation only. It's also only open when the owner is in town. But hopefully he'll be expanding soon to a new concept.  Each drink was around 22€ || A lovely location with lovely ambiance. You can tell he is very knowledgeable about liquor and cocktails. Personally, this was a mediocre experience because it was not quite what I was hoping for. Writing this review to help others out -  1. It is by no means a cultural experience - NYC style bespoke cocktail bar. If you have been in North America you may have come across something similar  2. The conversation was fairly one sided and didn’t leave much of an aperture for intimate connection  3. The cocktails, while good, were not particularly memorable  If you’re looking for a good cocktail place in an absolutely wonderful area this is your best bet. If you’re looking for something else, I’d recommend any number of wine bars and restaurants in the area || An absolute must visit in Lisbon! The cocktails, service, and overall experience were wonderful. Be sure to book well in advance. You get a 2 hour experience and can order personalized cocktails or any number of classic cocktails. Manuel was a pleasure to chat with and made us incredible cocktails. Very reasonably priced considering the quality and amount of thought that goes into each drink. We wish we could have spent more time in Lisbon to come back another time and try more drinks. Such a unique experience and definitely a highlight of our trip! Highly recommend! || Absolutely out of this world experience.  Manuel will ask 4 questions and they will create a magical cocktail for you. Each sip is unique. Or you can choose a list classic cocktails from the billboard. Recommend to try both options.  You can choose cocktails with alcohol or zero prof (non alcoholic).  The place is small (4 to 5 guests at the time) and magical, with red light and over 500 bottles in display. You need to book in advance using Instagram to enjoy this experience for two hours.  Manual is phenomenal host and we learnt so much, while we enjoyed our cocktails. Thanks Manuel!  Super recommended! || Amazing and unforgettable experience in Ulysses! Manuel was an amazing and knowledgeable host, and the cocktails were absolutely beautiful. Highly recommend! || Chatted with Manuel outside the door as we walked by. He spotted my Oilers cap and started up a conversation about hockey. Funny to run into a fellow Canadian abroad randomly so I thought I'd post a comment for him. We didn't have a chance to visit Ulysses due to short notice and time constraints so this is a 5 star review for the brief engagement! Perhaps our meeting brought the Oilers some luck as they knocked off the Canucks in game 7 to be in the Final 4. Maybe the cup comes back to Canada this year! Saude, Manuel! - Scott (and Sarah) Sens fan (former Habs fan from the 80s/90s) and current Edm bandwagon fan 😀 || An intimate and relaxed place.  Congratulations on the hospitality and the top-notch cocktails.
