The bread and butter, I will never forget. The feature of the day was black pork. Exceptional. The almond cake with passionfruit curd was also wonderful… not overly sweet either. I highly recommend || It was our second home in Lisbon. The atmosphere was family-friendly, and after trying practically every dish on the menu, we can assure you that they were all delicious. Respect and gratitude from Italy! || We made reservations to take our son here during his Lisbon visit so he could experience a neighborhood Portuguese restaurant and it did not disappoint. The staff was friendly and help pick a wine and suggested dishes to try.  I had the Duck rice which was excellent and we also had seafood rice with great flavor. We liked the decor which has a picture wall of moms, which is a nice touch.  We will return. || Discovered this restaurant looking at Google Reviews and it was one of the best dinners we had in a long time. Forgot to make a reservation and they made sure we could have a table if we waited a little bit. Thanks for this amazing food. || It’s hard to put into words just how good this restaurant is. Without exaggeration, this place was the highlight of my family’s trip to Portugal. Every bite was a revelation and the service was warm, helpful, and made us feel like we were welcomed as family. Every aspect of the meal evidenced attention to detail and passion for providing delicious food.  The duck rice was richly creamy and warmly comforting with a hearty portion of duck. The octopus was innovative and perfectly tender (paired with candied pears that took this dish to a whole new level). The grilled codfish had a beautiful presentation and variety of textures that made it a complex delicacy. And the grouper in rice had a zing in flavor that made it the perfect cold weather comfort.  I am confident that you can’t go wrong with whatever you order here. And finally, another huge shout out to the staff. The manager, Joana, offered delightful recommendations and made us feel at home. And all of the waiters brought humor, professionalism, and care to the dinner.  This is not a place to be missed- and in fact is a reason in itself to come to Lisbon. I’m eager for the next visit already! || Could not recommend this place more! It is well worth the Uber/Train from down town. We’d come back if we weren’t leaving tomorrow! The steak was phenomenal but the Corvina w/ Shrimp Rice stole the show. Also recommend the goat cheese and sardines.  The service was exceptional and the wine was good too. Come to Mae!! || Everything was so delicious, tasty and accurate! Also the bread, the butter creamy and light like a cloud. The meat of croquettes the best i have ever ate. I have been in Lisbon many times but this has been the best dinner of ever. It worth the trip just for this restaurant. The staff is very kind. Highly recommend. Advised the reservation. || Amazing food! Everything we ordered was exquisitely delicious! I highly recommend to try as many dishes as possible. || ★★★★★ An Unforgettable Meal - A True Lisbon Gem! ​We had an absolutely fantastic dinner at Mãe Restaurante and can't recommend it enough. This place is the real deal! ​The stars of the show for us were the pork cheek and the octopus. The pork was unbelievably tender, literally melting in your mouth with incredible flavor. The octopus was cooked to perfection – so soft and delicious. The portions are very generous, and it's fantastic value for money given the quality and quantity of the food. ​We were so happily full from our main courses that we didn't have room for dessert, but we overheard other tables raving about them – just another reason to come back! ​A quick tip for anyone planning to go: definitely book in advance! It's a popular spot, and for good reason. This was one of our favorite meals in Lisbon. We will absolutely be back on our next visit! || We accidentally found this restaurant late evening and it was an amazing experience. The restaurant was busy and almost full but the friendly staff sat us on a table by the window and offered drinks while we waited to be seated. The manager was very knowledgeable and recommended us some very tasty dishes and wines. My personal favorite was the duck rice!! Good prices in this family owned restaurant. || I didn't expect to be everything great. The food was great, delicious, we even order more of what we didn't intend. The wine choice was great and the service was welcoming. My favorite dish 'duck drumstick'. You won't regret it 🙂  'Mae' means 'mum' , so you will see photos of random mothers on the wall😊 that gives warm touch and welcoming atmosphere || We were a family of 4 trying out a local favorite restaurant. Mãe certainly lived up to its reputation. My son said the Duck Rice was one of his most favorite meals in Lisbon. The grouper that my daughter and I had was also very good. My husband thoroughly enjoyed his Mixed Seafood with Rice. The staff was very attentive and the restaurant is very cozy. Reversations highly suggested. || We just experienced the greatest meal in Lisbon on our last night. Recommended by hotel staff the culinary journey left us speechless and gasping at how delicious every bite was. Joana guided us through the menu and painted a picture of what each item was, she was honest and knowledgeable and provided us with just the right information for us to make a decision.  The table bread, garlic butter and olives were a great start. The Seafood Pica Pau was literally        P E R F E C T I O N. It was a medley of tender shrimp, melt in your mouth octopus and grilled sea bream in a broth with pickled vegetables, the serving was generous, every bite brought excitement for the following bite. The bread served  as the perfect way to savour the broth. The Tuna Taco was heaping in portion and in flavour. It was a creamy ‘ceviche’ in a crispy shell offered a tasty balance of fresh tuna sprinkled with lime juice. The Steak was perfectly grilled to medium with just the right amount of salt and fat.  It delectably melted in your mouth. The mixed green salad with grilled strawberry was a surprising complement. The fries were pretty much a golden goddess of potato, seasoned with herbs.  The fries were crispy and steaming hot and full of rich flavour.  I was looking forward to dessert, since everything we tried were near perfection I knew that dessert had to be amazing.  The Chocolate Mousse as recommended by Joana was  H E A V E N L Y. It was silky and velvety and rich and a contrast to the peanut crunch and sponge topping. Thank you to the team at Mae for taking us through this culinary journey and as the best meal experience in Lisbon and a perfect last meal to our trip. || Food for your soul! Theme of this restaurant is about mother’s love and it justifies the theme so well that you can taste this in food and also see it on each table and the wall. Very friendly atmosphere and the best service where in they explain you what their menu offers.  In love with this place and would like to come back again! || Mae Restaurante is a laid-back restaurant in Lisbon that serves up great Portuguese food in the city. The menu is well-curated, with a focus on seasonal ingredients and traditional Portuguese dishes. The pork neck cooked for 48 hours is a must-try, and the cucumber sour is a refreshing and delicious accompaniment.  The service at Mae Restaurante is excellent. I found the staff friendly and knowledgeable. The atmosphere at the restaurant is warm and inviting, and it's the perfect place to enjoy a leisurely meal with friends or family.  The restaurant has a small outdoor terrace, which is a great option for dining al fresco.  Definitely recommended and definitely would go again || Our server was excellent with giving recommendations. Paired some nice wine with dinner and they were patient with us as our kids fell asleep waiting for the food. Our food was good and the overall price for dinner was pretty cheap considering what we ordered. The seafood was cooked well with an awesome cream sauce and the duck over rice was excellent. || Super great food! Everything we ordered was amazing!!!! I got the grilled octopus and it was the best I had in ages! I Totally recommend ! The staff are super polite and professional !

Having nice atmosphere. Lovely food with typical Nepali food. Well services  and best cuisine. Want to visit again || Every time I come to Lisbon, I eat here. The staff is very nice and friendly. Thank you 👍 || Glad to have Nepalese food. Real Nepali feelings with the food n services.. Recommended to taste the food here.. || Reasonable price with delicious Nepali cousine!!! || The staff were very welcoming. I would 100% recommend this place. The food was really good and seemed to be freshly cooked. Great overall service, thank you! || Best place for an authentic experience. The food was amazing and the price was more than decent! The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere extremely sincere! || Lovely food the staff were so lovely helped explain the whole menu and gave some recommendations. Good value for money. Would defo come again! || My second time in Nancy khaja ghar.Who could provide such delicious Nepali food in Such affordable price.The taste  was awaesome,i feel like taste of like my home .The atmosphere,service was awaesome.Recommend to everyone to try food.Thank you nancy khaja ghar || Very good food Specially kothe mom just wow thank you Nancy Khana ghar❤️ || Very good and topical Nepali food good service. Beautiful ambience. I 100% recommend this place. || Great taste of the food 🤤 and service is also good And the staff's behaviour is so polite 😊😊 || Ordered Momos, since we live in the apartment opposite… was absolutely awesome… my kids loved it… 👍🏻👍🏻 || Nice Nepali arganic food with Nepali teast and great service.. Fully recommended || Best hospitality and family envi || One of the best nepali reasturant in lisbon …. Everybody are so friendly || typical nepalese food  excellents  service and food || Delicious food and drinks bar in town || Operate by nice couple || The store was already closed at 4 am. || The chicken tasted very bad, probably because the meat was stale. || The dishes are nicely seasoned. For the price, it's a good value. The service was adequate. || I was there a year ago and we're going back today! All the food was delicious and reasonably priced! || Best restaurant in Lisbon 🔥♥️ I've never experienced service like this, not even in Germany 🔥 We'll definitely be back!  Thank you for everything ♥️ || I feel very bad! According to a Nepali, he took the food but those who ate the food took a hand and paid for the food with a lighter, which is the hospitality of the food vendor. They first started token system and felt very soft, thank you. Mero suggestion || Delicious, high-quality food, friendly owners, and fair prices! Located in a very convenient area of ​​Lisbon with public transportation. We'll be back! || I love this restaurant!! Best momos in town, especially the chili momo, be careful, it's spicy but tastes so good!! Plus, the staff are so friendly!! Very cozy place! I highly recommend it! || Thank you for everything, I recommend the traditional vegetarian dish! Such friendly service! I highly recommend it 🫶 || The food was excellent, the service welcoming, and the value for money outstanding!  Thank you for a wonderful meal!

One of my favorite meals in Lisbon so far, absolutely will return! || Another hidden gem that you wouldn't know about unless you stumble across it.  The amazing staff serve great food, we orderwd a variety of dishes to share and get a real tealste for what they serve, all of which was a delight.  The staff are all amazing and very friendly.  Not in the centre of town but well worth a visit. A big thank you to the owner of the restaurant around the corner who sent us there when we couldn't get into his place due to a family function! || The chocolate pistachio tahini mousse was the best dessert I've eaten in my whole life. Absolutely amazing quality food. So unique, so flavourful and well prepared. The space is also very cozy and relaxing. And the staff is really kind and competent! || Great place, amazing food and super nice  friendly staff. Everything was great. We ordered 5 sets (for 5 people) to try as much different dishes as possible. Recommend that very much. Just keep in mind that's a lot of food. One of the best culinary experiences I've had in Lisbon.  Definitely want to come back. || Great food and very friendly staff! A well deserved 5 stars! || The food was great. My absolute favorite was the fish in tahini sauce. Hummus, falafel,  salad, tamarind juice, lamb, all really good. Nice set menu options. Lots of vegetarian options too. || Such good food. We’re Armenian so a lot of culinary overlaps. My mom couldn’t stop praising the food as it came out : )  Service was very friendly. But the food is the reason to come. Excellent  Lamb Kharoof was fantastic. Beautifully spiced and very tender || Highly recommended!! We ordered catering for a Birthday party and every one was amazed with the food quality. Since day one, Mezze was very responsive and supportive. Absolutely amazing service and great food. Thank you for making my Birthday a memorable experience. || Dear Susana, thank you for chosing Mezze to make this special day even more special. We hope to see you again soon and to join you in other celebrations! || A great experience with excellent food and a good variety of what Syrian cuisine can offer. I was really amazed by the harmony of flavours in every plate, I enjoyed every bite in all its layered tastes. For a person who almost only ever ate western food, this place was an incredible discovery. Prices were fair too. Just perfect, cheers for the amazing crew running this restaurant. || Very delicious Syrian food and friendly staff. The social impact of this restaurant is also an highlight, so make review is 6 stars (5 for the restaurant and 1 additional for its mission)

Definitely my favourite restaurant place in Lisbon, food was delicious, best grilled salmon I have ever had, really good and wine the brilliant service! Very good experience! || We visited this typical Portuguese restaurant and were delighted. The food was very good, with authentic flavors that made us feel at home. The prices are very reasonable, offering excellent value for money.  We especially recommend the picanha, which was delicious, and the house red wine, perfect to accompany the meal. The atmosphere is cozy, and the staff is very friendly. Definitely a place to visit again. || Large portions, tasty food, very attentive and kind service. The prices are reasonable. I got the cod and chickpeas. The cod was huge and they gave a lot of chickpeas. It also came with potatoes and a separate plate of onions with a clove of garlic. I mixed it in with my chickpeas with some olive oil and vinegar and it was so good. My partner got steak and it was cooked very well and also delicious. That dish came with collard greens and roasted potatoes. We shared a jug of wine which came in a cute ceramic jug, dessert and a glass of porto all for less than 50 euros. I highly recommend this place. || We decided to eat here because of the good Google rating (4.4 with over 1,100 reviews), but it turned out to be a big disappointment.  The food was cold, clearly reheated or defrosted, and everything was swimming in oil — definitely not fresh.  This place feels like a tourist trap. Waiters bring starters that you never ordered. Some guests might think they’re free, but they actually appear on the bill later. We refused them twice, didn’t even touch the second one, and it stayed untouched on the edge of the table. Still, it was added to the bill. Only after we complained did the waiter remove the charge for bread — but if we hadn’t checked, we would have overpaid.  Very disappointing experience and not worth the hype. Be careful if you decide to go there! || This restaurant bears no airs beyond its honest aim—to offer good value, local charm, and savory delights for those seeking lunch or dinner.  The photograph, though a humble envoy, fails to capture the true merit of this 14.50 steak, egg, and fries—a dish both delectable and, by the world’s measure, kind to the purse. It struck the palate just so, leaving me sated in that rare, contented way one hopes for.  The service, as ever, glowed with friendliness; though English eluded them, we bridged the gap with understanding, shared smiles, and fulfilled intentions.  Should you find yourself near, ponder this place for a meal worth savoring. || Delicious traditional Portuguese food. Huge portions perfect to share. Friendly staff. The only drawback is how noisy it is. || I got the gravata a domingos as it was recommended by other reviewers. The dish was good, portion was huge, you better be very hungry, but I would rather order something else. The pork dish came with rice and fries, but I had to add salt and spicy oil, which added heat but not really spicy. The meat was well cooked and tender, but ok to my taste. They only start the A/C when more customers came, so it was really hot and uncomfortable. Bonus point for the service as the waiter ask customers if they want the bread or olives rather than leaving them on the table, though that is just in their culture. Card payment is accepted. || Food: Tasty traditional food, nevertheless the portion sizes are quite small for the price. Because, unfortunately, I found only 4 little pieces of codfish hidden, while there was lots of vegetables. Service: Staff delivered orders fast and was always ready to serve the customer. Atmosphere: Too noisy since que room is quite tiny, but everyone enjoying themselves. Price: A little bit higher than it should be for the "neighborhood" location. It was 26 euros per person with starters, main dish, wine jars, and several beers, and a few desserts. || Overall ⭐⭐⭐ The prices are a little above average, the bitoque unfortunately was close to raw. Atmosphere of a typical Portuguese restaurant but only average service.  Bitoque 🍖 ⭐⭐ The meat was almost raw, only a bit cooked on the surface. The taste was ok tho. The accompanying fries were good but a bit more cooked would have been better.  Staff 👥 ⭐⭐ Despite being a small Portuguese restaurant the service was not pleasant. Fast in the orders but seemed like we were unwelcomed.  Atmosphere 🛋️ ⭐⭐⭐⭐ Once you get inside you will be surrounded by a lovely place. Not many tables and maybe a bit crowded but 😍 || Went to Dominigos last minute while staying with friends. They accommodated for us despite not having a reservation. I think we were the only tourists in there but it was packed with locals who clearly frequent the restaurant. Service was friendly and fast and the food portions were ginormous. Great flavour and well-cooked. Super cheap and a wide variety of food options. Our friends will be going back again and again! || Very local. Excellent food and service. I've been there twice to try different plates. I can recommend them all. Also, don't forget to order the house wine and the ginja as digestive. || Bloody awful experience. I mean it. I have made the mistake of ordering the salchichon plate. In fact the salchichon, were some sort of canned beef kremwurst. Worse than the cheapest IKEA hotdogs. Nothing else. No taste, no nothing. And they have tried to convince me it was the real thing...by showing me the can. And this happens in Portugal, a country famous for its cured meat products. It could have happened in some other country, but in Portugal??? Never again am I going to set foot in that joint. || Good morning, the dish you ordered was sausages with eggs, which we served with canned sausages, fried eggs, french fries, and rice. Thank you. If you are unsure what the dish consists of, please ask before ordering. Thank you very much. || We got a recommendation by a local guide, so we decided to come here. The food is excellent and the portions large and varied. We tried the picanha and the veal, both were awesome. Chocolate mousse also very tasty!  The service is fantastic. Owner asked whether we would like to be reseated because of the cold near the door. At the end, the waiter offered a free Portguese wine.  We will try to come again during our stay. || The food was very authentic and super nice, the portions were large too. The owners of the place and other staff were super friendly and gave us very nice recommendations, which really made our evening special. So if they recommend something consider taking it :) The owner even helped me get the little red wine stain out of my shirt himself. The atmosphere of the place is really made by the great service and food and not the decorations. I usually don’t leave reviews but this place really made me feel like i should so here you go! || delicious and fresh food with generous portions! || A bit loud but food is incredible. Best Francesinha 👌🏻 || My wife and I enjoyed a very pleasant dinner at Adega do Domingos.  On a visit from Canada  with only knowledge of very basic Portugese, we were served by a friendly young man eager to practice his English with us.  The place had a friendly neighbourhood vibe as the various arriving patrons all seemed to be regulars and were greeted with hugs/kisses by whom we assumed were the owners.  We selected a bottle of excellent and reasonably priced red wine from the many options on offer and were brought warm buttered bread and olives (as in most places here, there is a charge for these starters, but it is a modest amount and well worth it).  We ordered the baked cod with potatoes and the special steak.  It was more than ample food for the two of us....probably was enough for a family of four.  We had no room for dessert, but we accepted the offer of ginja afterward.  Total bill came to 48 Euros which we feel was amazing value for the excellent food and friendly treatment we received. || Best tasca in Lisbon, there is no room for argument. Waiters are amazing and friendly, food portions are giant and tastes incredible. Also very affordable prices 10/10 || Classic Portuguese place. The grilled fish was excellent, but the mango mousse was way too sweet and nothing like a mousse? The white neon lights make you feel like you’re eating at a school cafeteria. Yes it is the traditional local stuff but it’s so ugly and hurts the eye, doesn’t hurt to change sometimes! :) || I would recommend this restaurant, but I find it really weird that they did not allow us to pay our consumption until the full table was closed, effectively forcing us to stay in the restaurant until everyone was finished, which was a pretty big problem because I was in a hurry.  Really weird. Do not recommend If you go with a group and are in a hurry. || Food was mid but portions are huge and staff are very friendly! Cheap too || I absolutely love this place. Been there 3 times and every time it’s a lovely experience. The staff is so nice - unlike most restaurants in Lisbon - the portions are big and the food is so delicious. And it’s also affordable, so it became very quickly my favorite Portuguese place in Lisbon. Can’t recommend enough! || Didn't like the Fracezinha at all, meat was rough and chewy || A typical Portuguese restaurant - tasty food, prices between 10 and 15€ per person, and big space with typical Portuguese decoration. There’s space for at least 50 people inside - perfect for group dinners.  I ate the “bife à casa”, a steak with a fried egg, French fries and rice, which was delicious (except the rice - I recommend order a portion of black beans to add to that). || Food was amazing. Staff was amazing. A must go to. || It's very busy and the staff is amazing in accommodating everyone. That being said, it is a very tight space and not very quick to serve. The various starters served are priced - the cheese is at 3.90 €, the salamis were at 7.70€, thr  plate of fried cod balls - 6-ish €, the bread at 2-ish €; The baked cod in tile was very salty and covered in olive oil - which is I guess how its made, but just to note, Franchesinas were also salty and sause was a little bit sour. Overall, the starters were the best part, tbh || Be careful with extra dishes, which are brought to your table w/o you ordering them! Maybe it is a part of the Portuguese culture. I don’t know. But we didn’t like that they bring extra dishes and you even don’t know how much they cost. We were charged like 6,8€ for the ham ( jamón), which was not even good :((( our fault that we touched it. But, hey, it is a bit tricky how they do it. In general the restaurant is nice. Dishes are okay. Quite big, too big maybe.  At the end we got a local drink and some sweets for free, like a compliment from the restaurant. That was nice ;) || Fantastic place, we went for dinner which was authentic, delicious and excellent service.  The portions were huge.  I got a Franchesinha for 9 euros, which was certainly avergae to low price wise.  The whole dinner was 30 euros for nibbles, starters, mains and wine.  The staff were friendly, very portuguese and spoke little English but we made it work.  Would reccomend! || Very good, traditional food. I had the bacalao which was delicious. || What in the Gordan Ramsey's kitchen nightmares is this restaurant. I walked into this restaurant hoping to walk out with a full tummy and an all-round awesome Portuguese gastronomic experience. Instead, it's almost as if I walked into an all you can eat in Montana.   I literally saw the employees handling the food with their bare hands before putting them on plates. Not only that, but the steak I ordered was harder to chew than my soles. Do yourself a favor and take your business somewhere else, do not come here.

We visited Han Table Barbecue Lissabon for the first time and absolutely loved it! Generous portions tasty meat and a lovely atmosphere!  A big thanks to Bina who welcomed us so warmly and explained everything with such patience because we did not know how it works! Her service was friendly and very attentive.  We can only recommend this place and we'll definitley be back! || We had a great time at this Korean restaurant. The food was delicious, and we especially enjoyed the bibimbap, which was served hot and full of flavor. I really liked how the rice turned crispy at the bottom of the bowl, adding an extra layer of texture. On top of that, the staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. || Had an amazing experience at this Korean restaurant. The barbecue was delicious and perfectly prepared, but what truly made the visit special was the service from Bina. She was incredibly attentive, kind, and thoughtful she really elevated the whole meal. Highly recommended! || The food is amazing, service great the waitress is really nice. Quality is great. You pay a bit more but for once per month is really worth. 😀 || It was my first time in a corean barbecue and the food and the presentation was pretty nice. The atmosphere is modern and pleasant, perfect for a relaxed dinner. The staff is friendly. || Awesome quality and a great experience. It tasted so good and the personal was really kind and supportive. Definitely something to recommend! Thanks to Vina! 😊 || The food was very delicious and fresh. We had a great time. Bina and Gaia were amazing waitresses, very friendly and helpful. I really recommend this place! || Amazing food! Fun experience to cook yourself. Platter was great with a range of meat / fish, excellent value for money. €12 for lovely bottle of red. Ruby provided top customer service. I would definitely recommend if visiting Lisbon! || I lived in Korea for two years so was looking forward to Korean BBQ. We had the pork set, some of the marinated meat was a bit odd, but I do realise they are catering for a varied clientele and not just Korean taste. The banchan wasn't as flavoured as Korean, but again, different clientele. The kimchi pancake was delicious. I enjoyed the experience, it reminded us of our time in Korea, cooking the meat in front of us, using the tongs and scissors to prepare the cooked meat, eating from the lettuce parcels. We enjoyed a couple of cold Cass beers too. The thing that nearly made us leave was that they don't accept foreign cards, and only tell you this after you've ordered your food. I had to check how much money I had and didn't have enough to get everything we wanted. They tell you to go to an ATM, but we don't use card, we use a phone app so that wasn't a possibility. They have to be more upfront about this, especially as they probably get a lot of foreigners. || I had an incredible dining experience at this Korean BBQ restaurant in Lisbon. The food was absolutely delicious — perfectly marinated meats & fresh sides.  What really made the evening special, though, was the outstanding service. Ruby and Bina were incredibly kind, attentive, and welcoming. Their warmth and friendliness truly elevated the whole experience.  Highly recommended for anyone craving Korean BBQ in Lisbon! || The seafood pancake is really good, recommend strongly. And the sauce is handmade also so good. A good experience || Had an amazing time. The meat was fresh and well-marinated, especially the bulgogi and pork belly. Loved how we could grill everything right at the table   it made the whole experience fun and interactive. The side dishes (banchan) were tasty and plentiful🤤🤤  Bina was super friendly and attentive.💖  It's definitely a great place to go with friends or family. Will be coming back for sure💗 || Best experience we had in Lisbon! Ruby and the staff were very friendly and the service was top notch!😁 The food was very good and the Korean alcohol went very well together with the meat || The service was excellent and very attentive. They were very welcoming, and the meat was especially delicious. Special praise to the staff member Pusu! || I had an amazing dinner! Had been to other restaurants of the franchise but this time decided to try the wagyu, super tender, melts in your mouth! We were served by Bina and she was super nice and attentive, even explained to us how the soju was made! Just an overall great experience. Would 10/10 recommend and come back for more :) || Craving Korean BBQ? This spot boasts a lovely atmosphere and serves up incredibly delicious meat ready for you to grill at your table 😋. Their nice Jinro selection and overall great food make it a winner. Fully recommend giving it a try! || Really great restaurant, s/o to Bina, she was amazing for the service Thank you and see you next Time :) || It was the first time I had tried out the Korean barbecue... It was a lot of fun, we picked out one the meat platters, the quality of the meat was really good. I appreciated that the place was setup for us and the barbecue with everything we needed. The staff were patient with us, friendly and helpful. We really enjoyed. One small side note, the seating and tables definitely need a bit of a refurbishment, they look really well used. || We had a wonderful experience at this Korean restaurant. The food was very tasty, full of flavors, and beautifully presented. The service was quick and efficient, making the dining experience smooth and enjoyable. A special mention to Beena, who provided excellent service with warmth and professionalism. Overall, highly recommended for anyone looking for delicious Korean food and great hospitality. || If you are looking for a great Korean BBQ, stop looking and just come here.  Food was excellent and so was the service by Devi and Ruby.  We will definitely be back if we are in the neighborhood

We’re thrilled you enjoyed our churrasqueira in Mercado de Arroios, especially the frango assado (grilled chicken). 🫶 Our team is happy you felt welcomed, and we can’t wait to serve you again when you’re back in Portugal! 🍗🔥 … || The food is good and service is good. Great place to sit under the shade of the many trees lining the Avenue. || Lovely spot at the Avenida with a small café nearby (good coffee and toast at affordable prices) || A beautiful 1.5 km promenade along Avenida da Libberdade. You can also rent a tuk-tuk from the middle of the promenade and tour the city. Both the west-north lake and the east-north lake display, respectively, a stone fountain statue, slightly larger than life-size, symbolizing, to the west, the Douro River and, to the east, the Tagus River, represented by a male figure resembling a god, attentive to the evolution of the banks. These allegorical sculptures, created by Alexandre Gomes for the Campo de Santana Fountain (never built), were later reused in the arrangement of the Passeio Público, and are currently located at the north end of each of these aforementioned lakes. It’s a peaceful spot, especially in the early morning or late afternoon, and the elevated position gives a great sense of Lisbon’s layout.  The area around the viewpoint is spacious and easy to access, though not as atmospheric as some of the older miradouros in the historic districts. Still, it’s a worthwhile stop if you’re already exploring the park or want a less crowded viewpoint with a clear, unobstructed city view. || Great location and view,  plenty of seating spaces too. Eduardo VII Park is one of the most beautiful and relaxing green spaces in Lisbon. The park offers stunning panoramic views over the city and the Tagus River, making it a perfect spot for photos, walks, or simply enjoying the scenery. The wide paths are ideal for walking or jogging, and the well-maintained gardens add a peaceful atmosphere away from the busy city streets. One of the highlights is the impressive geometric garden design and the viewpoint at the top of the park, which provides a breathtaking perspective of Lisbon. The park is also very spacious, so it never feels overcrowded, even during busy hours. There are benches throughout the area, perfect for resting and enjoying the surroundings. Eduardo VII Park is great for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. It’s close to the city center and easy to access, making it a must-visit for anyone exploring Lisbon. Whether you’re looking for a quiet place to relax, take a walk, or admire the city from above, this park is definitely worth a visit. || We were in Lisbon for several days while waiting to start a cruise with NCL.  We stopped at the north end of this magnificent park and walk all the way to the southern end.  Lots of great views and spots for wonderful pics.  Several monuments along the way. || Parque Eduardo VII is a beautiful park with stunning views of the city and the river. It's beautifully maintained, with plenty of greenery and spacious walkways. It's a great place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city, take beautiful photos, and simply enjoy the atmosphere. A must-see if you're in Lisbon. || It's quite an amazing space. Whether it's chilling, or events, or testing your photographic prowess, it fits the bill. There are usually tourists and residents generally around, and it's more lively during celebrations like Christmas. || It's a very beautiful and large park, perfect for a peaceful walk surrounded by nature. The view from the top of the park is spectacular. Depending on the time of year, there may be more or fewer tourists. On a sunny day with good weather, it's well worth a visit. || A great view of Lisbon from here, you can see the whole layout and scale looking down towards the river. Relaxed and friendly atmosphere as you view the scenery and monuments. You also get an excellent view of the planes coming into Lisbon. || A beautiful public park in Lisbon, Portugal with great views over the city. The top is great for photos. Good for a walk, sit and have lunch or a drink, or have your dog play around. || Wonderful Christmas Atmosphere! We visited Parque Eduardo VII during the Christmas season, and it was a fantastic experience. The Christmas market (Wonderland Lisboa) created such a pleasant and fun atmosphere. It’s a great spot, especially for young people and families, with plenty of amusement park rides, games, and festive food stalls. The park itself is beautiful, and the view from the top is breathtaking. Highly recommended if you are in Lisbon during the holidays! || Parque Eduardo VII is one of the best spots in Lisbon to enjoy a peaceful walk and take in a great view of the city. From the top of the park, you can see all the way down to the river and the Praça Marquês de Pombal. It’s a lovely place to relax, especially at sunset. The park is also very close to El Corte Inglés, so it’s easy to combine a visit with some shopping or a coffee break nearby. || What a great parque / jardim in central Lisbon. Plenty of spaces to walk and sit with many great restaurants, cafes , and quiosques nearby to enjoy the warm Lisbon sun

A beautiful park where you can spend a few hours. It has a path that goes around it and which I recommend to walk. Beautiful trees and ponds ideal for a pause after a busy day. There's a café which is usually busy and a table is hard to find. On Sundays there's a small marketplace and so you can encounter locals mixed up with tourists. Just across the street you'll find the admirable Basílica da Estrela which is worth the visit. || I met some friends at Jardim da Estrela and it was a very nice experience. The park has lots of trees and open space, so it felt calm and relaxing. We enjoyed walking and sitting by the small lake together. || This is a gorgeous park — perfect for people-watching or for families with kids who just want to escape the hustle and bustle of Lisbon. It’s a peaceful spot to unwind and enjoy a slower pace in the middle of the city, and it even has restrooms (although I wouldn't call them clean but they were free), which is always a plus when exploring! || This place is heaven! One of the most beautiful parks I've seen by far. It's full of nature and also some animals, mostly birds. The place is perfect for a weekend picnic, a chilly eventing, yoga, hangouts and more. Thank you Lisbon for this amazing green gem! || Stunning park in the heart of Lisbon. Absolutely stunning. Full of beautiful plants and flowers, ponds and statues. Benches everywhere and the wonderful Banana Cafe inside which sells burgers and sandwiches, drinks and other refreshments where you can dine alfresco || 🌿 A Peaceful Oasis in the Middle of Lisbon ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5) We stumbled upon Jardim da Estrela on a warm afternoon, and it turned out to be one of the most peaceful and refreshing places we visited in Lisbon. It’s more than just a public park — it feels like a little urban sanctuary. The garden is beautifully maintained, filled with exotic plants, huge trees offering generous shade, and winding paths that invite you to slow down. What really stood out for me was the birdsong — there were so many birds, and their constant, melodic chirping made the whole place feel like a live sound bath. It’s incredibly soothing. If you have the time, don’t just walk through. Find a quiet corner, sit down, breathe, and maybe even meditate. This place is perfect for that. It’s not just visually calming, it actually sounds calming too. There are also benches, fountains, a lovely gazebo, and a charming little café nearby if you want to sit and sip something while watching the world go by. Families, joggers, solo readers, and locals chatting on benches all seem to coexist naturally here. It has a very authentic Lisbon energy — not overly touristy, just real life unfolding in a gorgeous setting.  Quick Ratings: Atmosphere: 10/10 Birdsong & Nature Vibe: 10/10 Relaxation Potential: 11/10 Accessibility: 10/10 Instagram View: 8.5/10 Highly recommend making time for it — especially if you’re feeling overstimulated by the city. It’s the kind of place that quietly resets your mood.  If this helped, I’d love a 👍 — and don’t forget to breathe deeply when you visit. 🌿✨ || I recently spent a peaceful afternoon at Jardim da Estrela in Lisbon, and it quickly became one of my favorite spots in the city. Located directly across from the grand Basílica da Estrela, this romantic-style park was inaugurated in 1852 and offers a refreshing blend of history, nature, and community life. The park spans 4.6 hectares and features winding paths shaded by exotic trees like jacarandas and ginkgoes, as well as beautifully maintained flower beds and small lakes with ducks and turtles. One of the standout features is the wrought-iron bandstand, originally built in 1884 and relocated here in 1936, which adds a touch of old-world charm. Families and locals gather here, especially on weekends, to enjoy the playgrounds, picnic areas, and the café with outdoor seating that serves light meals and drinks. The park is free to enter and open daily from 7 am to midnight, making it an accessible and welcoming space for everyone. Whether you're looking to relax, take a leisurely stroll, or immerse yourself in a bit of Lisbon's history, Jardim da Estrela offers a serene and delightful escape from the city's hustle and bustle. || I have a 5 year old and a 2 year old. Come and enjoy! || Small peaceful park with chickens & ducks 🐔 … || Review of Campo dos Mártires da Pátria – 5 Stars  If you’re looking for a peaceful, green escape in the heart of Lisbon that also offers a quirky and heartwarming surprise, Campo dos Mártires da Pátria is an absolute gem. This urban park blends history, nature, and charm in a way that makes you want to stay for hours. It’s one of those rare places that feels alive—quiet yet full of character.  The park is beautifully maintained with wide paths, benches under tall trees, and a calm atmosphere perfect for walking, reading, or simply breathing in the serenity. It’s surrounded by elegant buildings and steeped in historical importance, making it more than just a green space—it’s a cultural landmark.  But what truly stole my heart and made me give this park a glowing 5-star rating were the chickens and roosters. Yes, you read that right. Real, free-roaming gallinas y gallos live here, wandering through the grass and greeting visitors with cheerful clucks and crowing. It’s such a unique and unexpected detail that adds life and magic to the place. They’re charming, friendly, and seem completely at home—bringing joy to kids and adults alike. I absolutely love them. They’re the soul of the park for me.  If you’re in Lisbon and want a quiet spot full of life, history, and the sweet company of feathered friends, don’t miss Campo dos Mártires da Pátria. It’s a small paradise with a big heart. || Great central park in Lisbon that is quite family friendly. With an outdoor beverage place and loads of friendly animals such ducks and chickens about to keep you and your kids eye's busy.  Campo dos Mártires da Pátria, commonly known by its former name Campo de Santana, is a street in the parish of Arroios in Lisbon.  It occupies the upper part of the trough that separates the two converging valleys in the city center, which correspond to Avenida da Liberdade and Avenida Almirante Reis. It is a space full of history, located in the central area of ​​Lisbon, which served as a slaughterhouse in the 16th century and which has known many uses over the last two centuries, such as a bullring, from 1831 to 1889, the realization of the Feira da  From 1835 to 1882 and still a vegetable market in the mid-19th century. || Cutest park with ducks, chickens, roosters, and a little water feature. Genuinely, the hidden gem of Lisbon. Worth the climb up from the coast and my word, what an attraction!  We had no queue and a very chill inside experience.  Explore (and I do mean explore) the exotic meandering paths through the foliage, it's great to spend an hour or so.  A really nice bio diversity to look at and enjoy. Particularly enjoyed the banana tree 🍌  Really fairly priced and a fantastic cultural excursion.  HUGE recommend✌️ || Estufa Fria is a true oasis of tranquility in the heart of Lisbon. A wonderful place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy the beauty of exotic plants, waterfalls, and cozy paths. The atmosphere is truly peaceful, with everything well-kept and thoughtfully designed down to the last detail. A wonderful place for a leisurely stroll, meditation, or a romantic date. A must-see for anyone who loves nature and wants to see a different, greener side of Lisbon. One of the most pleasant and inspiring places in the city! || Nature, garden, and park lovers will enjoy this spot. It offers about 30–45 minutes of peaceful walking surrounded by greenery and a small artificial lake.  Entrance costs less than €4 per person — a very reasonable price for the experience.  There’s also a café with a lovely terrace nearby, though it’s not directly accessible through the greenhouse area. || Verry beautiful, if you are traveling to Lisbon or just live here, I would recommend coming here. It’s very beautiful nature in the middle of the city come here and relax and enjoy your day. also, if you are a student or a younger person, you can get tickets for way cheaper. You just need to show your student card confirmation that you are a student and we paid our tickets for five euros the two of us so that’s amazing. || Really nice and super cheap. Cool plants and I saw baby ducks! there are so many rooms and pathways, despite it not being the biggest building in the world you really feel like you can get lost in there. Very thoughtfully and beautifully designed. || If you’re in Lisbon on a Sunday and want a peaceful escape from the city buzz, Estufa Fria is absolutely perfect. Hidden inside Parque Eduardo VII, this lush greenhouse feels like stepping into another world — calm, green, and full of life. 🌴  You’ll walk through tropical plants, waterfalls, and quiet pathways where time slows down. It’s beautifully maintained, not crowded, and filled with natural light filtering through the glass roof — ideal for a relaxed stroll or quiet reflection.  💚 Perfect for: •	A slow Sunday morning or afternoon •	Nature lovers, photographers, and couples •	Escaping the heat or city noise  Tip: Grab a coffee nearby afterward and enjoy the view over Avenida da Liberdade — it completes the perfect Sunday in Lisbon. || This is a great area to stroll through while enjoying beautiful flora and fauna. It is located at the far end of Eduardo VII Park. We spent 45 minutes there. || This botanical garden is my favourite hidden gem in Lisbon! Lots of great spots inside for photography and well maintained. Very affordable too! 🌿 || Most beautiful garden i have ever seen. So lush and green with the most monstera i have ever seen. So peaceful and relaxing. Toilets inside. Sat with goslings and ducklings and saw chickens and peacocks as well. Student tickets were €1.80! Highly recommend || This botanical garden is a true gem, offering a diverse collection of plants.  The layout is well-designed, creating a tranquil and relaxing atmosphere.  There are numerous benches and open spaces, perfect for enjoying a picnic lunch.  The affordable 3 euro entrance fee makes it an exceptional value.  A visit here is highly recommended for anyone seeking a peaceful escape.  The variety of flora provides something of interest for every visitor.  It's a wonderful place to spend a few hours immersed in nature. || One of the most beautiful botanical gardens I’ve ever visited, interesting and extensive collection and a landscape curated in every detail. || I loved this area! Completely covered with very high bamboo ceilings, feeling like a whole new dimension covered with beautiful foliage and secret passageways leading to different areas such as the cactus covered greenhouse. You could easily spend a few hours here just exploring! || mucho verde y mucha vida, one of the best botanical gardens but a lot of areas were closed :/ nevertheless its worth checking out 🌿🌱☘️🍀🪴🎋🍃 || Thanks for a wonderful evening at Estufa Fria during a gala dinner and the opportunity to catch some glimpses of the wonderful plants and garden setting in a former basalt quarry! || The place is beautiful, many different types of tree and plants but some area are under maintenance, good to visit and the price is inexpensive. || Fantastic place that just kept going on and on. Beautiful hidden caves, waterways with fish and amazing variety of plants. Well worth a visit || Incredible! Well worth a couple hours exploration, this place is huge and well organized to feel endless - lots of little paths through the plants. The cactus room was crazy! I've been twice and would gladly go again. || Hidden gem! Always calm and relaxing here. My absolutely favorite location in Lissabon 😍 Must visit for urban and garden architects. Unique origin of this project will bring you to the tropics right from city. You may wander around by the small paths into the huge monstrera bush or  chill on the bench observing the tiny habitants of the garden - birds and fish 😌 Truly zen space ✨🌱 || Beautiful park filled with surprises. Makes you feel like you’re roaming around the jungle with secret little passages, various birds and a nice pond. Special thanks to Maria da Graça who presented the different bird species to us 🥰 … || Really worth the money as it very big and a lot of things to explore. A lot of great spot to take picture. Student get 50% discount. However, you may need to use cash if you don't have credit card that issued in Portugal.

place_name: Jardim da Praça João do Rio
reviews_content: It is a beautiful park with musicians who play music. || Nice little park with two small playgrounds for kids. There are 2 baby swings. It is a better playground for toddlers than the one in Parque luminosa down the street. || This medium-sized city park has a large fountain and a drinking spout, ample lawns and a couple of playgrounds. These have a pair of swings for toddlers and older children, a small slide, a see-saw, a few rockers and little else. It's a bit close to a busy avenue but a definite advantage is that it's in the shade most of the day. || Small Park with two play grounds for children, which makes it specially very pleasant for them. || Very clean, beautiful and peaceful!! A dream place.

place_name: Garden of the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation
reviews_content: Such a lovely garden full of paths and little bridges and loads of seating in the shade and great fun to explore and some statues too and we saw a heron and lots of ducks.  The amphitheatre was a real surprise too || Beautiful garden with long bamboo passage ways, a pond with lots of cute ducks, a small area to eat ice cream or coffee and a large area great for dogs. This is a great place to go on a walk with friends or go on a study session. Everything is full of vegetation and butterflies. Like an actual 'secret garden'. If you like fantasy books this is your place to go because it looks like a place in a fairytale. I cannot recommend this garden enough, especially for outdoor lovers. My description doesn't give this place enough justice. || This place is part of a foundation started by Calouste Gulbenkian, an Armenian oil tycoon and art lover. You can really feel his belief that “art is for everyone, and beauty means more when it’s shared.”  Right in the middle of the city, there’s this peaceful garden with tall trees, calm ponds, and quiet paths. I could take my time and enjoy the art without any rush. The way nature and art come together here left such a strong impression. || A very lovely garden, located in the center of the city. It’s super convenient to visit either by metro or different bus networks. Here, it’s more like a combination of different gardens, so there are lots of options to enjoy the sun, green, and overall atmosphere. Totally recommended to visit, including the museum inside. || Gorgeous space for all to enjoy for free - lots of areas to picnic, hang with friends, for kids to run around or bike, easy for strollers to get around. There are also two cafes and an ice cream shop - you can spend a whole day enjoying this beautifully maintained space. There must be a mighty team of gardeners tending to all the plants! What a valuable space for residents and visitors alike in this otherwise very densely developed city. || Gulbenkian always had beautiful gardens, around the museums buildings. Landscaping as Portuguese know how ! Now that the renovation of the modern museum is achieved, there is a new setting of this side of the gardens to discover, mix of Japanese zen design, existing garden style and a monumental, yet perfectly integrated awning. Inspiring place where to wander, with cafe and sometimes outdoor activities at the amphitheatre. Just mind the rush hours and some week-end can be crowded, as this place is since long praized by Portuguese and tourists ! || My primary objective was to visit the museum; however, due to renovations, the collection had been relocated.  I was disappointed by the limited number of items, particularly paintings, compared to my expectations. Nonetheless, the collection was aesthetically pleasing and unique.  The garden, however, was unappealing.  Perhaps I mistakenly visited the incorrect park, as signage was inadequate, requiring extensive navigation to locate the proper entrance. || Big enough to wander around. The noise of the city suddenly stops and everything becomes cooler. Part of it is like a jungle. Lots of people either solo or couples and a lot of families with small children. It is a really special place || Designed in the 1960s by Gonçalo Ribeiro Telles and António Viana Barreto, the garden is a beautifully landscaped urban oasis in the heart of Lisbon. The space features a harmonious blend of lakes, streams, terraced lawns, and forested paths—creating a tranquil environment for relaxation and reflection. The garden connects seamlessly with the main Gulbenkian Foundation building and museum, allowing visitors to experience art, architecture, and nature in one integrated setting. || Quiet, cozy park perfect for rest, private conversation with a friend or relaxation!

My fav Lisbon park! Such a wonderful green space full of amazing trees and plants away from busy streets. The park used to be the garden of a wonderful Palace and is littered with beautiful old buildings and statues surrounded by nature and teaming with birds including chickens, geese peacocks and parakeets plus lots of stray cats. Set on a hill looking down to the river this parc is like stepping back in time. Never too busy and space to sit and just connect with nature. || Pretty neglected for the potential it has.  From dry vegetation that amounts, to destroyed/eroded pathways and all the buildings collapsing or ruined.  Among those a beautiful circular building with a greenhouse like glass roof, that by itself is worth the visit.  Just judge it too harshly by its state for it is in my opinion appealing as a rui ed site.  Can’t help to feel like patrimony is being lost without any concern or attempt to save it.  OVERALL IT IS FREE, so can’t really complain on the ticket price 😂  Therefore the relation price to quality of experience is actually juicy better than the Belém Botanical garden.  Also quite awesome if one is into urban ruin exploring! || I really liked this park, it is located a little away from the city center, therefore, there are very few people here and it is clean. There are several picnic tables, peacocks and ducks are walking, a beautiful view of the bridge, a lot of exotic plants and it's just nice to walk here. || A very wonderful and beautiful park.  - Diverse plants, interesting landscape, lots of greenery, and a fairly large area for walking. - There are buildings and fountains. They are partially abandoned but very atmospheric. - There is a lawn where people sunbathe in good weather. - Chickens, geese, peacocks, and cats roam freely around the area. - The park also has a restroom and an enclosed area for dog walking || A beautiful, tranquil space with magnificent cactuses. The chickens run wild, and it feels like a place from a different era. The views of the bay, framed by the plants are something you don't get in many other places either. || It’s a beautiful park with a rare tree that it’s worth spending some time with. Although it’s not for those with walking difficulties as it has elevations and unevenness. Love that there are chickens, peacocks and geese roaming freely. And there are benches for those who wants a place to chill and have their meals. || It has the potential to be the best park in the city if anyone would invest in it.  It has: In the central part is a big lawn, great for picnics and enjoying the peace and quiet (ducks, peacocks, gees and chickens excluded). To the west of the lawn there is a dog or children park, i was not sure, but it is fenced so they don't bother those that are allergic to them. On the other side to the east of the lawn there is a pond with ducks. Further east from the lawn there are staircases that lead to the closed section unfortunately, with a garden done in french style, with a symmetrical pattern of short hedges outlining the flowers planted there. And by looking at it on google maps it is apparent that on the other side of it there are staircases again leading to another similar area that is also closed off. To the north of the lawn there are buildings. First up right next to the lawn there is a glass dome that looks like a theater of some sort, although small and half the glass roof is shattered, then behind it there are buildings that look like maybe they were coops for the birds that are now running around. Coming right behind that is a plato with a big circular water feature that isn't working and half around it is a wall with a (closed) gate that leads into a (overgrown) corridor that leads to some sort of i guess important building. Next to the corridor starts a cactus garden that has been left unchecked for far too long. Even though cactuses are thriving, the paths through it are bit harder to navigate so caution is advised. || Absolutely got surprised by this little park in a quite busy city district. I was expecting an average garden park in the middle of a concrete jungle, but when I entered I got a real different feeling. Being used to Lisbon's buzziness, I am often missing the nature. This park has a very wild feeling to it. Even though it still offers the clean open grass area to lie down and enjoy a picnic with friends and family, you feel like in the middle of untouched nature just a few steps away from the central grass area. The cactus garden offers exactly what you expect and more. There are wild plants and of course 🌵🌵 but there are also free running chicken and even peacocks with beautiful feathers. Feels very untouched, and has even a great view to the bridge. The constant airplane crossing still remind you that you are almost in central Lisbon. Definitely worth a visit if you like wild nature and peace just around the corner. || Very calm space - the perfect get away from the busy touristy areas. Some visitors are sunbathing on the grass. The cactus garden impressed me with the size of the cactuses - some of them were twice my height. There are many happy birds but mostly roosters, crowing non-stop. It’s probably a way to prove their masculinity in front of the chicks… actually I don’t know - it’s not my business :) There are several neglected structures that are still quite beautiful. || What a beautiful, interesting little park! Off the beaten track, loads of ducks, geese, chickens, and pea-fowl. The cactus garden area was where the chickens were plotting to take over the world lol. So glad we happened upon it.

We came here to enjoy a good dinner of Portuguese food. The environment was excellent, full of locals having fun and enjoying the food, especially snails, one of the specialties. We were a bit disappointed when the waiter told us there was no cod (bacalhau) left, one of the dishes we were craving for. Still whatever we ordered was delicious, in good amounts and with fair prices. The service was friendly and even though this place is not in a touristic zone of Lisbon, if you are staying in this area I totally recommended. || A classic neighborhood restaurant, simple, yet free of tourists!  While the kitchen was a bit slow and iur food very simply prepared, it was good. We even had a large portion of rather large, oven baked snails, which are rare to find. || A great neighborhood restaurant, service was a little slow but VERY helpful. Food was terrific and very reasonably priced. I had grilled Corvina fish, creamy sheep cheese, chocolate cake and a small bottle of delicious white. || Came here with my family. There were 6 of us. Servers were very friendly. One of them spoke English who helped us with the menu. He made great suggestions. We loved the food and the price was very affordable. || Spectacular Portuguese cuisine for a very good price. Staff were extremely welcoming and responsive despite them knowing little English and us little Portuguese. Highly recommend if you are anywhere nearby!!! || 5 stars given it was really delicious food for more than reasonable prices. The waitress and chef brought us yummy treats - olives, bread, cheese, meat - to start. The grilled fish and the clams were so fresh and the sauce for the clams… nom nom nom soak it up! They even brought me rice as I’m gluten free. I felt like maybe they forgot to charge us for something because it was so so good and yet not breaking the bank by any means. Yum. || I shared picanha a brasileira with my friend. It was delicious but some parts of the meat were not well cooked. It is served with fried banana on top. Apart from this I can say that the quality/price ratio is high. I didnt try snails but they were good according to my friends || Very happy and friendly local restaurant! We loved the food and atmosphere 😍 😋 || This is the real Portugal. The food is great, the service was great and the locals were nice. || This place is amazing! Our server was super friendly and helpful. He recommended an excellent wine and helped us order lots of delicious plates. The food was out of this world and very affordable. This was the best way to start our trip in Lisbon! Don’t miss it!

A small, quaint, family-owned restaurant that truly captures the heart of Portuguese cuisine. I visited in December, and at first glance I thought it was just a small copy shop or grab-and-go spot but tucked around the back was a wonderful surprise. The menu changes daily, which only adds to the charm and ensures everything is fresh and thoughtfully prepared. Hands down, some of the best food I’ve had in Portugal. Don’t order à la carte trust the chef and take their suggestions. You'll get more for your money. The 3-course meal is an absolute steal at around 15 euros and delivers incredible value, flavor, and authenticity. A must-visit for a genuine, memorable dining experience. || This was hands down the best food we had in Lisbon. It’s a small quiet little family restaurant and everything we had was amazing. They were so friendly and patient considering we don’t speak Portuguese. They showed us pictures of the items on their menu and did their best to explain the dishes. I can’t recommend this place enough if you want good Portuguese food. It was definitely comfort food in a cozy little restaurant. My espresso was amazing too which surprised me since I’m not huge on espresso 😅  Thank you again for the great food and being so warm and welcoming. We have loved our trip to Portugal. Eating here just added to our wonderful experience. || The food portions are huge, and the seafood rice is really delicious. I had seafood rice, a drink, coffee, and a dessert — all for just €10! It’s so cheap and so tasty. The owners are very nice and even let us try a Portuguese dessert. Highly recommend! || Highly recommended!!! Authentic Portuguese cuisine!!! The food and desserts are so amazing. Set meal was just 10€ that included main dish, drink, dessert and coffee. I had seafood rice, there are total 3 options for main dish from meal of the day, there are also various options for the dessert and drinks (wine, bier, non-Alkohol drinks) || I've tried lots of restraunts but this was my Best experience %100. Very nice and helpful owners, traditional foods (menu is hanging every day!), very cheap prince (12 euros for one dish, desert, Coffee and a bottle of wine). I'm not a persona who comment on Google maps but this place deserves it really. || We visited a couple of times.  Thank you for Google reviews.  Resturant is not big but when we travel we like to visit local family resturant and try local traditional food. The price is unbeatable; one drink, one main course, one dessert and one coffee for $12. Services are excellent, they bring to you one item at a time and never rush you.  Food was also great, not oily even fried fish.  I don’t eat fried fish normally; but their fried fish is fresh and light. If you are in the neighbourhood, you should try to visit. || Had a nice typical meal. Really friendly staff, The owner was telling very proud that she took the restaurant over from her Father and Mother.  Cosy and with a real small kitchen.  They also have nice take a way(breakfast and lunch) and good coffee!  Just go there and be kind for these nice warm people || Great local place! The staff were very friendly with us especially given our little Portuguese. They were really helpful helping translate their menu and show us pictures of the food. The food itself was delicious. Felt like eating true homestyle cooking. And for 10€ a person we got a drink, meal of the day and a dessert. || What a lovely typical Portuguese ambience and excellently prepared menu - a must try for every visitor to Lisbon. We had the Patnniscas de Bacalhau and Iscas de Figado Frito. The hostess took exceptional pain to explain to us in English the various options available. The rate was very economically priced and included a drink, fresh salad, dessert and coffee. Left the place feeling contented with a full belly yet sad to leave behind the ambience which brought back memories of Portuguese influence on us Goans. The crockery, furniture and even the wall decor is similar to what we used to see in Goa, India, a former Portuguese colony, which i now miss back home, in Goa. Try it to believe. Obrigado. || We had an absolutely delicious meal with a main course, dessert, coffee, and a half carafe of wine for only €10. We had a pork rib and chickpea meal, and it was so good we would like to have licked the plate!

Good portion of pancakes and full of tasty ingredients. Clean toilet but very hot inside as there is a machine inside. Proper exhaust as the window is big enough. Cozy seats indoors and outdoors to hangout. Staffs are friendly and attentive. Music is a bit annoying and not relaxing as the cafe. So basically does not match the cafe environment. Otherwise great location in a neat environment || Very welcoming, good choice of food and drinks, great coffee, highly recommend || A very refreshing place to chill, friendly staff, speaking English as well. Variety of choices specially drinks.
Always very well served in terms of price and quality. || Friendly people, good food at a good price. || Well made, fast and inexpensive. || Homemade food at a good price.

One of our favourite meals in Portugal. Fantastic food with great service and surroundings - we’d definitely come back. || We had a gorgeous meal at this restaurant. The food was delicious, and octopus was cooked to perfection. All the flavours worked well together, and the presentation made the dishes very appealing.  Staff were lovely and welcoming, attentive but not overbearing. I'd definitely come back and recommend it to friends. I am absolutely delighted with this restaurant. || What an amazing place! The food and staff were impeccable. We already want to go back. || Look the food was great! Very well cooked and nicely prepared! We enjoyed our dinner here until we saw the bill! First when we arrived at the restaurant the chef came spontaneously with some bread and a plate of tiny portions of butter and olive oil, without us ordering it! So at the end they added Couvert two times, per person which is ridiculous, because the portions was super tiny for one person! So be aware of that! And try to get your 30% discount because otherwise it’s very pricey for what you get! || Honestly, Lisbon surprised me with how delicious the food is there. The food actually tasted as good as it looked. At Bistro 4, the space was elegant and so was its dining experience. The service was friendly yet still professional; they made us feel comfortable wearing casual attire in a formal atmosphere. On a side note, people in Lisbon were very friendly and welcoming, and they seemed to be happy all the time. I enjoyed the thin slices of meat in the salad as well as the thin crisps that complemented my main course perfectly. The cuisson of the fish was on point; topped with its sauce and the pleasant texture added by the crumble, the outcome was fulfilling. Last, but definitely not least, came the dessert. It was the perfect finish. I really loved how the chef played with the strawberries; presenting them as dehydrated as well as cooked becoming “jam-like”. One shouldn’t forget how the strawberries were placed, as if returning them to the garden they were once in, but improved and more desirable. || The sushi are tasty! But no for the baccalhau.....the fish is kind of dry...personal taste maybe...  Relaxing atmosphere! We were sitting outside in their courtyard. || A lovely outdoor setting with soft lighting and olive trees. The food selection is delicious and beautifully presented. A special evening made all the more pleasant by the attentive service. We've had dinner here on two occasions a couple years apart. We look forward to dining at Bistro 4 again on our next visit to Lisbon. || This place has its service levels perfected. Great service from a team of staff, there must have been at least 6 who just helped us on our table of three. The food was fantastically prepared and an imaginative take on portuguese styling. International in design, but not over the top. Still holding on to its simple roots and flavours of fresh red onion and tomato. The desert was the stand out. Don't order simply from the desert menu or you will get a simple dish. Try that something different and it will surprise you. An extensive wine list that might be just a tad over priced when you pay 48 euro for a wine that is 14 on the shelf in the supermarket. If these are to be the mark up, then I would be expecting wines that are not found in the local pingo doce, but rather locally produced small batch wines from producers that don't have the big distribution deals. || When we stumbled upon this restaurant the other night, we were blown away. The focaccia was truly the best I’ve ever had, and the ravioli was INCREDIBLE. When ordering a couple scoops of ice cream, I was shocked at the beauty of its presentation and addition of berries and granola. The chef and waitstaff went above and beyond in every way. I cannot wait to visit again!!! || Nice quiet and fancy restaurant but the service is painfully slow and the good is overpriced. 30 euros for risottos with scallops and there are 3 small scallops, that's a bit a a rip off.

If you're searching for the ultimate kebab experience in Lisbon, look no further than Lisboa Doner Kebab! … || Thank you for your visit. Please visit again & try our other dishes. We hope you will not be disappointed. || Best Doner Kabab of its kind. High Quality meat is used to create burgers and Kebab. A clean & Healthy Halal option at very convenient place. Very near to Metro Station. Must try their beef and chicken burger and Doner . They have Turkish sweet also || Thank you for your visit. please come again. || Great food and kind staff. I went eith crutches because i had an injury, the staff treated me really weel, i recommend for people with reduced mobility and for all the others too :) A place worth of your time and money. || The food was delicious, outstanding and the attitude of owner was amazing, you must try once. || They are super kind and good people. The food was tasty and it was open after 22h what helps a lot. || Dear Leo,  We wanted to thank you for taking the time to leave such a wonderful review on our Google profile! We're thrilled you enjoyed your dining experience at Lisboa … More || We were in the area while visiting Lisbon and were craving a kebab meal. Decided to go here as the reviews were great and it was right by our place. The reviews were right! We got the doner meals, shawarma wrap and just doner meat (carne). … || What can i say, i had fantastic falafel there, guys were so kind and amazing, we had great talk while waiting, simply lovely || Top quality food and very lovely, relaxed atmospehere. Very kind owners as well 👌 … || Absolutely fantastic experience! The team was professional, efficient, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. You can tell they genuinely care about their customers. Highly recommend to anyone looking for quality and reliability || Dear Ben,  We wanted to thank you for taking the time to leave such a wonderful review on our Google profile! We're thrilled you enjoyed your dining experience at Lisboa … More || Probably one of the best kebabs I’ve had in Lisbon. Nice guys as well || Lot of thanks ...come again for Quality food and service ...Thank you so much...

Best unit I visited in Portugal so far! Top notch service and really fast! Two ladies were working there really good and motivated. In Colombo unit people look always bored. || Hello Marcelo, your feedback is very important. Thank you for choosing Oakberry Areeiro. || The bowl is a bit dear but definitely worth it, I normally dislike Açai but this was very delicious. The worker was very helpful and nice. View is enjoyable || Hello Ella, thank you for your feedback. || The best açai ever. I am totally 🥰 in love || A lot of choice dor toppings. Menu well explained. Classic cup is 8.5€ || Thank you for choosing Oakberry. || Great açaí, delicious and flavorful. A wide variety of high-quality toppings! Excellent service! || The experience at Oakberry in Areeiro has always been very good, but today the employee who served us, Bia, was especially attentive, so I would like to extend a special thank you to her. || Hi Catarina, thank you so much! Your feedback is very important. Bia is a very dedicated employee. Thank you. || I had a wonderful visit to Oakberry Açaí! I want to praise Mayara's work; she served me with extreme kindness and dedication. She truly makes a difference in customer service! The açaí was excellent, with incredible flavors and super fresh. I will definitely return to enjoy it again! I recommend it to everyone! || I love the entire Oakberry chain and I'm a regular customer at the Areeiro store, undoubtedly the best Açaí in Lisbon. || Thank you for your feedback.

We ordered the ham toast and avocado toast, and both tasted amazing. They were nicely prepared and clearly made with care. The vibe of the place was great, and we really enjoyed our meal here. || Very trendy spot and most dishes are very IG worthy - portion is alright and taste fine … || I’m so sorry we’re not hungry enough for this place! I’d love to try their brunch sometime as it looked really delicious. We shared small tastes of Portugal and banana bread and both were delicious. This sour bread! Just amazing. Personnel and atmosphere were lovely too. || The best pancakes I ever had. I enjoyed my breakfast so much! From the eggs with de nata to the delicious orange juice and avocado. I can’t wait to come back. || Very good spot to have breakfast, though we had to climb up to get there but it is a usual thing in Lisbon) The food tasted very good, the waitresses were very friendly and nice. The food was served fast and I got a card with banana bread … || My husband and I were very pleased. Very tasty, large portions. The atmosphere is pleasant. The service is excellent. We really liked it, I recommend it. || One of the best breakfast we've had on our trip. The bacalhau toast(cod) was so delicious. The vitaminas mimosa is one of the best mimosas ive ever had and the pea hummus was on another level. The staff are friendly and just amazing. Great experience. || The high rating is well deserved.  The vegan toast was so yummy and looked so pretty and so were other dishes. Very friendly service in this very nice old cafe. || Nice place and the food is tasteful! Just there is not enough variety in my opinion. Also the prices are too high if I compare to other good brunch places in the city. 7/10 || Nice place to sit and good service! Banana bread and fruit bowl were nice. Got a recipe card afterwards of the banana bread because I mentioned I liked it. Good prices as well. || The best avocado toast!!! And the gin and tonic was BIG and yummy! They also have great coffee and smoothie options. It does get busy so there may be a wait depending on time of day but I highly recommend for brunch. The inside is super cute too and the staff were all very attentive and kind. Great experience overall. || food is delicious, i would love to know how to make this sauce on the ham toast… :) and if you’re struggling between choosing the avocado or ham toast - take the ham. staff is very nice, i really recommend this place for a brunch. || Thanks Zosia ! You can blend fresh tomatoes garlic olive oil salt and pepper :) || Probably one of the best places to have a rich brunch in Lisbon. The menu is very varied and healthy, prices are surprisingly good.
