It was so nice to have you and we all look forward to see you again soon. Thank you. Luka Team 🙏 … || In downtown Lisbon, this Asian fusion restaurant offers a short menu of Asian top sellers, in addition to a daily menu, all in generous servings at fair prices and with a friendly and efficient service in a light and open ambiance.  We were two for lunch that shared 3 starters (including the delicious duck croquetas), a main course and an excellent penna cotta (which all was too much for 2 grown men!!) with waters and coffee for €35/pax. || Thank you very much Jesper for your visit, review and such kind words! It was such a pleasure to welcome you and we all look forward to see you again soon. Thank YOU. Luka Team 🙏 … || Hands down the best massaman and thai green curries we've ever had. Wonderfully friendly staff, outstanding food and service. Would recommend without a doubt if in Lisbon || Thank you very much Jack for your visit, review and such kind words! It was such a pleasure to welcome you and we all look forward to see you again very soon. Luka Team 🙏 … || Great service. Dishes were so flavorful. We especially loved the cauliflower, duck croquettes and Khao Soi. Lovely atmosphere. We will be back! || Thank you very much Brigette for your visit, review and such kind words! It was such a pleasure to welcome you and we all look forward to see you again very soon. Luka Team 🙏 … || Excellent! Ambience was just right, warm welcome, friendly Service, active follow-up. Food portions medium sized which was perfect, presented very well and importantly, taste was rich with good flavours. Trendy, modern and minimalist style Restaurant design, away from the main tourist area.. so you’ll find a local crowd here and that’s a very good reason to try it! || Thank you very much Alan for your visit, review and such kind words! It was so nice to have you and we all look forward to see you again soon. Thank you. Luka Team 🙏 … || We stumbled upon Luka while looking for something different from traditional Portuguese food, and it was such a gem! The menu is a mix of Asian and Indian flavors, and everything we ordered was absolutely delicious and presented beautifully. The service was just as wonderful! Everyone was incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. If you’re in Lisbon and craving something flavorful and unique, Luka is definitely worth a visit! || Thank you very much Angela for your visit, review and such kind words! It was so nice to have you and we all look forward to see you again soon whenever looking for something different from traditional Portuguese food. 😊 Thank you. Luka Team 🙏 … || Fantastic dining experience. Food was 10/10, as was the service and cocktails. A must visit for anyone visiting the area. Allergens well marked, felt very safe as a GF person. || Thank you very much Sabina for your visit, review and such kind words! It was such a pleasure to welcome you and we all look forward to see you again soon. Thank YOU. Luka Team 🙏 … || Amazing Asian restaurant in Lisbon! The staff are attentive, portions are generous, and everything is fresh and well-prepared. Highly recommended! || Thank you very much Dan for your visit and review. It was so nice to have you and we all look forward to see you again soon. Thank you. Luka Team 🙏 …

great food and good meat! really recommend it! nice spot for group dinners and lunches. service is also very good || Very nice restaurant traditional vintage decor. Awesome grilled codfish with potatoes. Huge portions at plus 48€. A portion is enough for 3 persons. We strongly recommend and we’ll return. || Wonderful typical Portuguese restaurant. Simple menu with many classics. We did not feel rushed at all and enjoyed the meal. Couvert was good, with ham, cheese, olives and good bread. Deserts were a little bit generic. Great main dishes, some perfect for sharing. || Recently, I had the pleasure of dining at "Marítima de Xabregas" with some friends and, despite a somewhat confused service and slightly extended waiting times, the experience was very rewarding. The kitchen offers truly exquisite traditional Portuguese dishes and the portions are quite generous.  At the start of the meal, we were treated to an assortment of appetizers: a tomina cheese, flavorful olives, various sauces, and fresh bread, all of which were very much appreciated and tasty.  As for my choice, I opted for an omelette with fries, simple but well-executed, and concluded with a slice of chocolate cake that provided the perfect end to a satisfying dinner. The restaurant's decor has an old-timey atmosphere, adding to the charm of the place. The prices are absolutely reasonable.  A place where you can savor true Portuguese cuisine. || A cozy, traditional and authentic restaurant that will surprise you with the wonderful food and beverages. It is not your typical tourist restaurant but rather the place where locals eat. Excelente experiencia! Obrigado ! || Authentic, generous, and full of flavor! Marítima de Xabregas serves some of the best Portuguese food in Lisbon—perfectly grilled fish, tender meats, and generous portions. Friendly service, great wine selection, and a warm, traditional atmosphere make it a must-visit. || Very good Portuguese traditional food - can recommend the grilled sardines. The best dessert is Farofias! Not overly touristic at all || 1. Food: fantastic traditional codfish (bacalhau na brasa com batata à murro). 2. Service: traditional portuguese staff, very kind and delivering orders on-time and with quality. 3. Atmosphere: regular, not special but quite nice. || Absolutely delightful local restaurant I had the pleasure of some fantastic codfish sardines and some octopus salad on the a charming evening in this locality. || I booked 18 people for dinner and when we got there with UBER, he didn’t have enough seats for 18. Very disappointed. Dragged everyone out there and back to the hotel.

place_name: Kiosk Cafe | Specialty Coffee & Books | Brunch
reviews_content: Stopped by Kiosk Café for brunch and loved it! The place is small but really cozy, with a big shared table that has plenty of outlets - perfect if you want to get some work done while enjoying your coffee. The service was super friendly and the food quality was honestly top-notch. We had the avocado toast and the yogurt with granola - both were very generous in size and super tasty. Even the presentation was on point. And the coffee? Rich, flavorful, and just what we needed. Definitely recommend it if you’re looking for a great brunch spot in Lisbon! || Thank you, Magali! Always glad to welcome you in Kiosk 🙏 … || A small, cozy café run by Ukrainians in Lisbon. Very atmospheric! Delicious food, large portions, a wide selection of tasty traditional desserts. Lots of books that you can pick up and read. The music plays loudly, so you can talk, but not everything is easily heard. Overall, I really liked it! || This is a gem of place! The food is delicious, the service is great, the ambience is cozy and the drinks were wow!! We had V60 coffee from Colombia, so homey and full of flavor, with a sour dark chocolate taste. The iced matcha latte was perfect, with a smooth and soft taste. Fully recommend this place! || Thank you, Daniela 🙏 We appreciate you notice our incredible matcha!  … || Sure! Here’s a review in English:  ⸻  This is one of my favorite spots for desserts and coffee. I’ve been here several times, and every visit has been a treat. Their pastries are outstanding — especially the walnut cookies with condensed milk, carrot cake, cheesecake, Napoleon, and the cherry pie. Everything tastes homemade and full of flavor. The coffee is great too — whether you’re in the mood for a classic espresso, a smooth cold brew, or even their tea cold brew, you won’t be disappointed. Highly recommend this place! || Thank tou, Roman! Always glad to see you again 🫶 … || Such a nice and cozy café! It’s a small, comfortable place — perfect for working on your laptop, with good Wi-Fi and a calm atmosphere. The coffee is delicious, the sandwiches are great, and the syrniki are just amazing! 100% coming back again. || Thank you for kind words! We are super happy to see you again and again, with your laptop or on day off) || Kiosk Café is the kind of place you hope to stumble upon in Lisbon: tucked into a charming yellow corner building, blending the cozy atmosphere of a bookshop with the quality and care of a specialty coffee bar. There’s even a corgi you can pet!  We came here on a Sunday morning for brunch.  Tried their salmon & avocado toast (perfectly seasoned, fresh, with a crisp salad and just the right amount of feta), a granola & yogurt bowl (creamy, tangy yogurt topped with crunchy toasted almonds, golden granola, juicy kiwi, and blueberries), and a slice of cherry crumble pie (buttery crust, tart-sweet filling, and a nutty crumble topping that was impossible to leave unfinished).  Every bite felt intentional, the kind of quality you only get when the owners care deeply about their craft.  The drinks were equally memorable: my wife’s iced latte was smooth and balanced, while my matcha shot deserves a special mention - vibrant, rich, and perfectly whisked.  Easily the best I’ve had in Lisbon so far!  What sets Kiosk apart is the hospitality. The Ukrainian owners are warm, welcoming, and full of excellent recommendations, a true reflection of Ukrainian entrepreneurial spirit: self-sufficient, meticulous about quality, and genuinely invested in giving guests the best experience possible.  Whether you’re here for a coffee, a wholesome brunch, or just to browse books in a sunny corner, Kiosk Café delivers on every level. || Oh, how all our whole team smiles when reading this)   Thank you, Andri for kind words that truly warms our hearts! We are always glad to serve you 🫶 … || My favourite brunch spot at the moment, I feel almost embarrassed I didn’t leave a review earlier!  I’ve been here quite a few times already, and every single time the service has been incredible. The waiters are funny, polite, and always energetic; plus the food is great. Every time I went, I felt welcomed, which enhanced the already cosy atmosphere of the place.  Prices are not cheap but still on the cheaper side compared to other brunch places in Lisbon, which is one of the reasons I keep coming back.  I’ve brought along several people with me, and they all loved it as well. Highly recommend! || Thank you for your review, Filipe! It is soooo importante for us to read this 🫶 … || Kiosk was a random pick from maps while looking for a place to meet with a friend. I have to say it turned out to be far beyond our expectations, with incredible food (both sweet and savory), plenty of coffee options, and great service (everyone was kind, explaining anything in detail when requested). Add to this the fact that they also have books and great music playing in the background, and this is my kind of place. Looking forward to going back in future travels to Lisbon! || Thank you, Juan 🙏 Always glad to see you.  … || We stumbled upon this café in Lisbon completely by chance, just picking it randomly on the map — and it turned out to be a real gem! 🌿✨ We ordered syrnyky (cottage cheese pancakes) and bread with salmon — everything was absolutely delicious, with generous portions. The atmosphere is warm and homey, and the staff are so welcoming that you instantly feel like you’re visiting friends. A special highlight is the huge collection of books of all genres, which adds so much coziness and inspiration. 💛  I wholeheartedly recommend this place to anyone visiting Lisbon — it’s the kind of spot you’ll want to come back to again and again! || Thank you for your kind words 🫶 Nice to see you always!  … || Great place with amazing service and delicious coffee! I have tried the carrot cake and cappuccino - both were amazing! Will definitely come back. || Thank you, Andrii 🫶 Come again and give a chance to the rest of our deserts! Always glad to serve you.  …

I had brunch here several times. The place is chill and peaceful to work. Not too noisy and the service is great. The food is tasty but I’ll say a bit expensive compared to other options in Anjos area. || For sure recommend. We stopped here for brunch - great food portions, great coffee and delicious orange juice. Avo breakfast was delicious, I switched up the scrambled for fried.  The interior is beautiful, however not too practical, a lot of noise from the street and confusing layout. The staff was super nice and communicating.  We will probably return during our stay! || Great little place, relaxed atmosphere and attentive kind staff. We felt welcome from the moment we arrived. Prices are decent for the area, €3.50 for an iced late. We ordered two salmon and cream cheese croissants, along with a Kombucha and ice latte. All were delicious, would happily come back again. || This place is delicious for good breakfast / brunch food and is a really nice environment filled with plants. There are some people working but overall it’s a really nice atmosphere. It was so good I went back 2x and had the same thing. Solid. || We stopped by Curva Café in Lisbon for a quick coffee break and absolutely loved it! The ambiance is super cozy and beautifully designed such a lovely spot to relax or get some work done. Inside tables were full when we arrived, and it seemed like many people were using it as a coworking space, which totally makes sense given the vibe. The staff were incredibly kind, friendly, and fast. Definitely a place I’ll come back to next time I’m in Lisbon! 💛☕️ || This might be our favourite coffee shop in Lisbon! Spacious, friendly calm atmosphere. The coffee and food was delicious. || Very nice spot to work or connect with others! Food and drink fairly priced, great options, generous portions (I got the toast and it was plenty) and lovely service. Great vibe and recommend. || Solid breakfast with better coffee. Atmosphere is very modern and alternative, I enjoyed staying here. I liked their fresh version of Chai Tea. || Beautiful stylish place for eat. I ate toast with avocado and it was great. the place is great full of design. || Delicious food, great coffee and super friendly staff! One of the best breakfast places in the neighbourhood, I'll deffinitely come here again❤️ || An excellent brunch and coffee place with very affordable prices,  Curva is also a great place to work, since they accept remote work on some tables.  The service is nice and quick, you have often some exhibits and shops.  I totally recommend ! || Fantastic spot for breakfast or brunch! The dishes are fresh, well-prepared, and full of flavor. We had one of the best avocado toasts we’ve had in a long time. Highly recommended for both the food and the great atmosphere || Such a beautiful atmosphere, mixing a modern gallery with a high quality brunch venue, good music, very attentive service, and the food was unreal! The ‘side A’ brunch was so filling and so tasty, couldn’t recommend enough || Amaaaaaaaaaazing banana bread Like just the beat ever tried  Eggs were good too Coffee nice but 2 shots for small cup was a bit of a more than I use to || I can just recommend this place. We had breakfast here and it was delicious - decent price and amazing quality/ size. The flat white was superb and the service was so nice and funny. Would definitely come back. || Nice place with simple food and friendly staff. The small gallery inside worth visiting. The food was served fast. || great place for a breakfast/brunch. out ot the places we‘ve been here in Lisbon my favorite! i loved the granola and the coffee. || Loved this breakfast & brunch spot so much ! Everything we tried was delicious. The venue is very big, the distances between the tables are enough, it's not a packed shop which I live the most. Grilled cheese & jalepeno toast was delicious || Nice cafe with excellent service and a good choice of food and drinks, but I have to take off one star for the smell of dampness and mold, as a sensitive person it was pretty hard for me to breathe and I wanted to get out into the fresh air as soon as possible. Otherwise, everything was fine || Curva was a welcoming and convenient breakfast spot for me and my family. Their abundant seating, varied menu and ambient music made for an enjoyable dining experience.  The restriction on what tables can be used with laptops was excellent ensuring there is a place for working but also that tables are not clogged up for too long.

A lovely cafe with delicious food and nice service! We had the tuna salad and tried the passion fruit tart for dessert and both were delicious. It's a laptop friendly location and the wifi works good. The staff is friendly! Will come back here for sure. || Here you will find great coffee and sandwiches, and beyond any words service is so good that I can’t believe it’s just a local cafe across the road. I wish these guys to grow and thrive. It’s a hidden gem in Lisbon! || This banana dessert is straight-up divine — the combo of ingredients and flavors just melts in your mouth. Massive respect to whoever came up with this recipe, and big thanks to the café owners for keeping the bar so damn high. 🔥🍌 || Great food and very friendly staff. I'm coming here every two weeks for their amazing avocado toast 😊 nice coffee and cinnamon rolls as well!! || A café with quality cuisine and generous portions. Very pleasant and fast service. A modern, cozy, and pet-friendly place. My favorite spot for breakfast or lunch in Lisbon with a lovely outdoor terrace. || Generally I love to drink black coffee, and it’s nice to see that the options of beans and varieties are endless at A20. Easily one of the friendliest and well made coffee shops you’ll find in the area. || Had latte and a slice of lemon cake. Seems a convenient place to work with laptop as I saw many of them working there. Service and food were normal and nothing really special. Feel a bit pricy too. || We had an amazing experience at this café! The breakfast options were fantastic, and everything was fresh and delicious. We had the tuna salad, which was perfectly seasoned. My friend had the turkey sandwich, and it was absolutely mouthwatering—so flavorful and perfectly balanced. We also enjoyed two cappuccinos, and they were spot on, with rich, velvety foam and just the right amount of espresso. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, making it the perfect spot to start the day. We'll definitely be coming back! || Was super impressed with this quaint little coffee shop with a trendy vibe. Ordered an iced vanilla latte and enjoyed the earthy wood tones and greenery that gave the space a really calming ambience. Would definitely recommend! || ☕🦄 🐫🧜‍♀️Coffee with personality… and sometimes a tail! This café is pure foam magic! You order a cappuccino — and suddenly there’s a seahorse swimming in your cup or a camel casually strolling across the milk. One time I even got a unicorn🦄  The barista here doesn’t just make coffee — they lift your mood with every cup. Your spirits rise faster than your caffeine levels. If you want your morning to start with a smile — and maybe a mythical creature — this is the place! || Thank you sooo much for such a warm review!🤗🤗🤗 …

Lovely café with special and varied coffee choices — really impressive selection! You can tell they put a lot of heart into running the place (用心經營). The food is tasty too. Definitely coming back again — highly recommend! || An excellent flat white — honestly one of the best in Lisbon. Great Americano, good sandwiches, and such a lovely team. Easy location. Definitely recommend || Would give more stars if I could! The food was delicious with such high-quality products at amazing value. Brilliant coffees. Staff couldn’t do enough for customers, so attentive and helping everyone to get a seat. Food also came so quick! Also advertised as a work space. They also have veggie and vegan options.  Highly recommend!! || The best coffee place we have found in Lisbon 🎉 The quality of the coffee, the friendliness of the staff, great food and all priced really well. Can’t rate this place any higher 🙌🏼 || A very cozy and charming café! It has two floors and some outdoor seating as well. On the lower floor (-1) there’s a quiet area that’s perfect for working on your laptop. The staff is polite, friendly, and speaks English. Free Wi-Fi is available. Breakfast was delicious, and the coffee is great too — I had an iced mocha and really enjoyed it. || Amazing specialty coffee shop in the town. I had a v60 it was great. I really want to recommend to my friends to visit. || Perfect spot for brunch and coffee. The eggs Benedict with salmon were excellent. The staff was polite, and the place has a very cozy atmosphere. Definitely recommend! || Such an amazing spot! Came for brunch after a long travel day the night before to start our day. The staff were so nice and kind. They also walked us through a lot since it was our first time in Lisbon. The coffee was amazing and the food was so fresh. We left happy for the rest of the day! I am not sure if they are newer - but unless you use google it is very hard to find on Apple Maps or Yelp. They should make sure they are easily findable because they are amazing! || We were recommended to visit here by another coffee roaster, who raved about their creativity and high-tech attention to detail.  We went early and were warmly greeted by all the team who work there. The menu is very unique in the sense that you pick your coffee drink first and then the type of beans you’d like to use for that drink.  We went with a large group of 7, and they were incredibly attentive and took time to explain the menu and offerings.  Once our coffee was ordered, the male barista (Sam, I think?) showed us their espresso machine and how it all works. It’s a really cool piece of kit.  Their cold brew was delicious and came in a specific cup that allowed different flavour profiles to be accentuated depending on which side of the cup you drank out of - very cool!  I also ordered the triple lush - a creative coffee cocktail of sorts, made with lychee-infused cold brew and clarified berry milk. I’ve truly never had a coffee like it, and I doubt I will unless I visit again.  A great place to visit if you are a coffee geek and enjoy chatting about coffee.  The only downside is that none of their amazing coffee is available to purchase yet! 😭 || Thank you so much for your detailed and thoughtful review! We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed our creativity and equipment, and appreciate your kind words about our team’s warm and attentive service. We take pride in offering coffee geeks a unique experience, especially with the cold brew and the “Triple Lush” creative coffee cocktail you loved. Regarding the coffee beans not yet being available for purchase, we’re actively working on it and hope to offer them soon for everyone to enjoy at home. Looking forward to seeing you again for more coffee chats! || Food is amazing, staff very nice. What a nice brunch spot in Lisbon

place_name: Monkey Brain | Cookies, Coffee, Matcha, Boba & More

reviews_content: Vibe. The owner is BEYOND LOVLEY.  The coffee was good, they also serve ice coffees. The vibe is very homely, gluten free, nasty ingredients free - does that make sense? Some of yall will know what I’m talking about. and try the banana muffin thing. Interesting at first but second bite I was in love. She bakes all the pastries in the morning. It was delicious ! I will be coming back next time I’m in Lisbon || Amazing coffee shop!! Not only is everything homemade and delicious, but the atmosphere inside is really unique. Teresa (the owner) is very caring and makes you feel at home! It’s funny to see how she knows everyone’s name when they come in! A perfect place to have a chat with people from the neighborhood or simply read a book. || Incredible coffeeshop! So cozy, Tereza is the best. So cozy and an amazing vibe! Such a fun local spot- their carrot ginger juice is 10000/10 + their vegan cakes are heaven || really cool hidden gem of lisbon! vegetarian, vegan, gluten free friendly - i think it all might be vegan? plus loads of non-caffeine drinks too.  i got a blueberry iced matcha (i think with oat milk?) which was absolutely superb. i also got a pecan pie cake thing which was delicious too.  the owner is sooooo lovely and friendly and chatty and has curated the coolest, most relaxing and chill vibes in here.  the decor is super cool and interesting. great for catching up with friends or just having a solo coffee.  well worth a visit - im just sad i only found it on my last day!! || This place feels like your family hug after a long trip.  You can get inside and forget about the world for a moment, have some coffee, any of the amazing desserts, all with the cherry on top of a lovely and kind service.  It's a good place to come and recharge your battery. || Such a cute littel cafe, well decorated. The coffee is great and also tbe service. Gluten free&vegan. || Tereza is a very welcoming and positive person, it's always a fun time coming in here to grab my daily coffee, it's delicious and I often sit around having a chat with her. Would recommend anyone in the area to pop in and enjoy this lovely cafe! || One of the best coffee shops in Lisbon! Homemade stuff and good coffee. Cozy vibe! Must visit! || Cute little place with delicious coffee, matcha and some homemade pastries. Today I’m having the apple and pecans (no added sugar) and a flat white. || The cutest cafe in Lisbon! You can tell a lot of care has gone into this cafe and it has a very cozy feel to it. They make freshly-baked goods that change every day and they have "daffee" (caffeine-free coffee alternative made from date seeds). It was truly excellent.

Neighborhood café, sells bread to go and has an outdoor seating area. The owner is friendly and attentive. || Highly competent and friendly staff. Renovated facilities, very pleasant! || Fantastic service, super friendly staff. I highly recommend them. || Always that cozy corner and that friendly atmosphere. || Good atmosphere and friendly staff. || Just another quiet neighborhood café... || At the foot of the house and Bela Vista park || I recommend them; they are excellent professionals.

Super cute cafe and amazingly friendly staff. I had a coffee which was great, it had two shots in it so it was nice and strong which I prefer. I had a cinnamon roll which was yummy as well. They have one table available for laptop use however they don’t have wifi (which was fine for me as I had a hotspot). I hope to come back soon! || Thank you very much Edee! Hope to see you again soon✨ || Great coffee and lovely cheesecake. Staff was very friendly. Restroom was clean || Very nice coffee shop, with their own pastry options and specialty coffee. The service is very casual and friendly. The space is relaxed and attracts an international crowd.  I had a to-go filter coffee and a vegan chocolate roll. Both great!  It also sells a few coffee related utensils and some arts and crafts. The relaxed vibe, simple decoration, and the independent local art it promotes, combine well into a smooth, uncomplicated experience. || Thank you, João! 💙❤️💛 … || Cozy place, I liked that there are separate tables for laptops🙃 Delicious desserts - we took carrot cake, amazing. The coffee is good, but too strong for us) It was hard to  feel a taste of oat milk 😅 || Hi! Thank you very much for the feedback, we’ll try to be more clear about our drinks always being made with a double espresso 😅 … || A really nice café with good coffee. Unfortunately, there are only few places outside, but it’s okay to sit inside. Grab some issue of the New Yorker and enjoy your coffee. I recommend an Americano - Nice balance of the beans and not too acidy as some espresso beans can be || Thank you Sebastian! Unfortunately we didn’t get permission from the city for more outdoor seating. We’re glad you enjoyed our coffee! || A great vibe in here and a great price!!! The coffee was a bit too bitter for my liking but that’s fully personal preference.  The chocolate scroll was delicious and I loved that you could add your own icing since I find some scrolls have way too much icing 🥰  Overall such a cute cafe and great value for money || Thank you so much! Sorry you found the coffee bitter, we’re always happy to replace someone’s order if it’s not the way they like! ♥️ || This is the very essence of what coffee ought to be—a brew that sings to the senses.  By the measure of Portuguese standards, its price is not cheap, but the richness of its flavor and the atmosphere's subtle charm are worth, at least, a visit.  I find myself enamored of the convivial service, the sanctuary of a space unmarred by WiFi or the clatter of laptops, and the fine product.  All seekers of the sublime cup should venture there. || Thank you so much Justin! ❤️💙💛 … || I've traveled around the world twice. I had 100% Kona coffee from Hawaii, Jamaica Blue Mountain Coffee but this place is something else. Absolutely amazing! People are attentive, courteous and kind. The coffee was the best I've ever had. Will be back before returning home next week. Obrigado! || Well we are very flattered indeed, thank you Jaime!! || Best coffee in Lisbon hands down, with the friendliest people working there and the most relaxing atmosphere. A must go if you are living or visiting here.  I had an amazing doppio espresso with coffee beans from Colombia which I unfortunately did not take a picture of. || Thank you!! The fact you drank your espresso before even thinking of taking a picture is the best review we could ask for ❤️💛💙 … || Beautiful Café in a beautiful neighborhood of the city. As I am really picky with my flat white, I can say without a doubt. Worth every zip!  Visit late morning or early afternoon for best time to enjoy sun outside on the street. Oh, also tried the little chocolate cake / cinnamon roll. Nothing to complain! ;)) || Thank you Michael! So glad to hear you approve of our flat white 😁 …

Great brunch spot with exceptional service. The portions were large and the price was reasonable. The drinks had very cute latte art and the food was delicious. The service was great and they were very attentive. Loved the interior and the live plants which made it very comfortable and a fun place to grab a bite. || Delicious food, very soft well done scrambled. The portion was quite big. The avocado toast was having good amount of smashed avocado. Really good breakfast worth for money, the place was so boho, full of plants. I recommend the place and the food as well. || We have visited Mhendo Café several times with our family, including our 3-year-old, and we absolutely love it! The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, the staff are friendly and attentive, and there are options that both adults and little ones can enjoy. It’s a great place for families to relax, have a delicious meal or snack, and feel comfortable. We always have a wonderful experience and look forward to coming back!🫰 || The service and food was amazing! They got our order for a big group of 6 people with lots of drinks/modifications correct and even told us to ask if we needed any extra butter/nutella/other condiments. Would 100% recommend || Unassuming little spot that I wouldn’t have stopped at had it not been recommended! Staff were very attentive & kind. The falafel bowl I had was superb with everything tasting fresh, the coffee was great, and the outdoor seating just completed the experience!! || Service was excellent, the staff were friendly, attentive and very polite. Food was great and prices were great. While we were there a homeless man approached, the staff were very kind in how they handled the situation. I was impressed over all with my experience. || They serve lots of wraps, burgers, egg dishes, salads, açai bowl, smoothies, etc, so it is a great place to have lunch some the food was pretty good and the place was decorated nicely with some outside seating as well.  However, when I was there I was often surrounded by 4-5 flies revolving around me, so other than that, it was a very nice place. || Had a lovely brunch here! The staff were lovely and so helpful. They speak great English. The latte was nice, but I really loved the yogurt bowl. The variety of fruit was lovely, and the portion size good too. The place gets busy towards 11, so go early for a good seat! || Gluten free oats and bread available! The food is decent overall, the lattes are above average and the cocktails (mimosa and aperol Sprtiz) are great. The omelet was ideal firmness, the fusion bowl had a good amount of granola and greek yogurt, but a bit lacking in fruits imo. The chicken wrap was delicious, and quite large portions. || The service is amazing. The staff are so welcoming and very attentive. Great wine and food. Highly recommend the scallops and duck. || Loved it here. It was fully booked a day before, so we booked via this app. And it was a nice decision because food and service were sooo good! Anything from menu is good) || Antiga Wine Bar is one of our favorite places in Lisbon. We've had a fantastic dining experience all 3 times and look forward to visiting Lisbon to go back to this wine bar. We are not familiar with local wines, so Rodolfo helped us on our recent April visit select wines based on our wine profile. He also made wonderful food recommendations. Our favorite was the duck confit, but also loved the seabass ceviche, pork belly with guava & goat cheese rolls with honey.  Small place with great vibes and wonderful service in a charming area of town. Get reservations so you don't miss out. || What a delightful find Antiga Wine Bar turned out to be! We stumbled upon this charming restaurant and were fortunate enough to secure a reservation for that evening. Our experience was so wonderful that we returned just a few nights later, eager to relive the magic. The ambiance of Antiga is small yet incredibly warm and welcoming. It creates an intimate setting that makes every visit feel special. From the moment we walked in, we were enveloped in a cozy atmosphere that set the stage for a memorable dining experience. The waitstaff at Antiga are truly lovely. They are attentive and genuinely happy to make suggestions on both food and wine, all without being pushy. Their knowledge and enthusiasm for the menu added a personal touch that enhanced our experience. While the menu is small, it has been honed to perfection. Each dish we tried was memorable, showcasing well-portioned servings that were beautifully presented. The food was prepared to perfection, with thoughtful balance and pairing that made every bite a delight. If I lived in Lisbon, I would undoubtedly be a regular at Antiga Wine Bar. It’s the kind of place that invites you to relax and savor the moment, making it highly recommended for anyone seeking an intimate and enjoyable restaurant experience. Whether you're a local or just visiting, don’t miss the chance to dine here—you won’t be disappointed!

place_name: Locals & Nomads Natural Wine Bar & Shop
reviews_content: This is a fantastic family owned cosy wine store and bar. Service was top notch - extremely approachable and informative without being too over-bearing as some other natural wine bars can be. Wines themselves were delicious, fairly priced and served perfectly. Really can't fault this place! Bonus points for the lovely artwork! || Thank you for your appreciation, that truly means a lot ❤️❤️❤️ || Really great spot for natural wine and small plates. The service was wonderful and the wines recommended to us were perfect. I highly recommend! || It's been a pleasure having such wonderful guests! || Gluten free! Only a food menu, the waitress/wine expert asks you a few questions and gives you a selection of wines to try. You pick your favorite and get a glass (or bottle). Unique set up, and definitely better than a menu of 30+ wines. || These are the words that confirm that our approach works—tasting is always better than reading the long list of options:) Thank you for your lovely review! || The cheeses are wow. The service is amazing. If I had more days in Lisbon 100% would be back to sit here late evening. (Didnt drink wines, but heard another customers enjoying them a lot!) || We just love it when people come for the food—we're really proud of our selection ;) thank you for these kind words❤️ || We celebrated as newlyweds at the bar and it was an absolute blast. The food was delicious, champagne and Lambrusco flowed non-stop, and our Italian neighbors upstairs joined in and were the sweetest. Huge thanks to Nina for the best organization. Wish I had taken more photos, but I was too busy celebrating! || This was an absolute pleasure hosting you! See you on your anniversary? :) || Fantastic selection of delicious natural wines from Portugal and beyond. Staff are welcoming and make natural wines simple - just let them know what you fancy and they will bring out a couple of tasters before you commit to a glass or … || Best wine bar I've been to! Very tasty natural wine and very good recommendations by the owner. Also nice food that fits the theme of the bar and place. It's located in a busy little side street with other restaurants and people in typical, nice, lisbon evening atmosphere. We'll definitely go again! || Can't wait to see you again! Thank you so much ❤️ || Exceptional variety of natural wines, perfect matching snacks, and friendly atmosphere. What else to wish? || Beautiful photos ❤️ thank you oh-so-much for these kind words! || Had a fantastic time here. The wine selection is superb and well curated, with something for every palate. If you are a wine enthusiast looking for a good glass this place is a must! || This is a small out door only wine spot.  The food is limited. But wow, the wine selection is amazing.  And the staff are very knowledgeable about Portuguese wine.  The trolley passes by to the right and locals disappear to left through an arch. What a fun place to have a glass of wine and relax on an afternoon. || Beautiful wine curated by a truly passionate and knowledge owner - we chatted for hours about his love of wine and much more. There was a rain storm during my visit and they kindly gave me a blanket to wrap up in. Cosy beyond belief, stunning spot for people watching and the service is 10/10. Love this bar. || warms our hearts ^^ thank you so much! || A sudden Google find on the busy Travessa do Monte a Sunday lunchtime. A great choice of wines and some excellent snacks, but the service was the best. Friendly and clearly knowledgeable. If you are in the area, a go to spot for a very nice glass of something… || We're so happy you found us ❤️ || This is a GEM. You MUST come here. The owners are attentive and so knowledgeable! There is no menu, because the owner is the menu. It feels like going into Olivander’s and he knows the right wand for you - the same is true here. You say a … || that's it, I'm making a Harry Potter styled tshirt with myself as Olivander holding up several bottles :D … More || Lovely wine bar in Graça, Lisbon, located on a charming street. The owner is very friendly, and the wine selection, along with the snacks, are clearly prepared with love. A wonderful spot to enjoy a relaxed evening. || Love is why we're doing it all ❤️ thank you so much for the appreciation! || While more expensive than the average Lisbon bill, the wine selection was above adequate and the experience even more so. The owner is a savante in his own right, choosing a selection of wines for you to try each time ordering. The food was … || Thank you for such a detailed review, it's very much appreciated! Hope to see you again || If you’re in the mood for a truly delightful selection of wines… in the heart of the charming Graça neighborhood, served by energetic, involved, and knowledgeable nomads-turned-locals, then this is the bar for you. A gem in our gastro ecosystem to meet your next (favorite) wine. || Wow! Thank u so much for your review, so appreciate. Благодаря! || This is really just a door with outdoor seating and the natural wine was incredible. The current selection is mainly Portuguese and Spanish natural wines(which are delicious - we tried a Canarian white as well as an interesting Portuguese … || Thanks a lot for your review, will be waiting for your next visit to Lisbon 💙 … || It’s the perfect place to try an interesting wine paired with the right appetizer. You can also get professional advice and buy a bottle of wine to take home or as a gift. I highly recommend visiting || A lovely little wine bar that we discovered on our last night in Lisbon. The wine selection is well worth a visit, the small tapas plates offer more variety than most places, And the excellent host really took there time to discuss and … || Thank you so much! Hope, you will back to Lisbon soon and join us again 🫶🏻 … || Knowledgeable staff helped us both choose a glass from the offered natural wines. Lovely little menu of snacks and tapas on a side street with a view of the trams. … || Thank you so much, Benjamin, for your kind words, it’s really appreciated and motivated 💙 …

I received a winetasting experience as a gift, and it was amazing. Additional stars for being incredibly accomodating for Gluten Free folks. We chose the Madeira wines, highly recommend. Victor was very polite and explained the process of making these wines, their characteristics and what we were going to taste. Then we could taste and compare the wine, enjoy it at our own pace. It came with some cheese and cured meats. Because I mentioned I am GF, they were very accomodating even regarding cross contamination. They served the board with gluten free crackers and brought the bread separately for my friend. It sounds like a small gesture but if you are GF you know the smallest details make the difference. Overall, the atmosphere was great, the staff friendly and we had a great time. Surely coming back for a glass of wine! || Taste fine wines (traditional white and red, and all styles of port) from various regions of Portugal. Rui took us on a delicious flight from north to south, Albarinho to Cabernet Sauvignon, and six different amazing ports.  Charcuterie pairs with each wine, and you get a full pour of each wine with the flight. If you know your wines, this is the place to taste. My flight included the best Pinot Noir I've had in years from the Dão region. || This was the final stop on our food tour of Lisbon and it didn't disappoint. Here we tried an excellent red wine and sardines and chorizo. It was all delicious and served  in really authentic surroundings with great vibes. After the tour ended we ended up staying here until closing time enjoying further excellent red wines. Whilst chatting to others from the tour. || If you enjoy local wines, this is the place to visit. Tiago will guide you through an excellent selection of Portuguese wines and make great recommendations. It’s a great spot to start your evening. || Looking for a port wine tasting, we eventually ended up in this small, yet beautiful and cozy wine bar. The tasting itself included 5 port wines (2x white, 1x Ruby, 2x Tawny) for a proud price of 50€ p.p. Although, it seemed quite pricy to us, the wines were amazing and the host explained us really everything we needed to know about port wine, starting from scratch without getting lost in details a beginner wouldn’t be able to follow. What began as a wine tasting ended up as intense conversation with lots of room for questions, amazingly friendly and detailed answers and expanded to several further drinks. The hosts really know what they’re doing and within the few hours we stayed we rather felt like friends. Also the accompanying snacks matched perfectly and were of great quality. We loved it and would definitely visit again - highly recommended. Again, thanks a lot!! || Thank you LVD! We hope to see you again! || We liked the vibe and service in this place. Strongly recommend madeira wines, I haven’t tried anything like this before. Guys from the bar were very chill and told us a lot of details about wine and food there. We will definitely visit this place again, when we are back to Lisbon. || We stumbled upon this incredible wine bar in Lisbon! The staff was welcoming and friendly. There were amazing wines from all over Portugal with very knowledgeable staff to guide you. We started with a wine tasting and small bites, but ended up staying for hours and hanging out because we loved the vibe so much. We went back another day on our 3 day trip! And bonus…they ship wines to the U.S.!!! Definitely stop by this wine bar!!! || Thank you Nikki! We hope to see you again! Don´t forget to order wine to the Christmas! || If you are even remotely interested in wine, and you are in Lisbon - this is the place. And frankly, Tiago is the reason you should come here.  We were visiting Lisbon and stopped in for what we thought would be a casual glass of wine. Instead, we had one of the most exceptional wine experiences of our entire trip, and that is entirely because of Tiago. His depth of knowledge is extraordinary: not just regions and varietals, but producers, vintages, terroir, and the story behind every bottle. He asked thoughtful questions, listened carefully, and then curated recommendations with precision and confidence.  Tiago introduced us to remarkable wines from the Douro Valley that we never would have discovered on our own. Every pour felt intentional. Every explanation elevated the experience without ever feeling pretentious. By the end of the visit, we were so impressed that we ordered wine to be shipped back to the United States - something we do not do lightly.  What truly sets Tiago apart is that he combines world-class expertise with genuine hospitality. He has the rare ability to make guests feel both educated and cared for. He is not just a wine bar employee; he is an ambassador for Portuguese wine and an asset to any establishment lucky enough to have him.  Can’t wait to go back. Tiago and this place truly made Lisbon a place we would love to return. || Pros: The staff member who assisted us was very friendly and professional. He gave us a brief overview of the history of port wine and helped us throughout our visit in a knowledgeable and welcoming way.  Cons: Unfortunately, the owner left us with a very negative impression. While the staff was kind and attentive, the owner came across as unfriendly and dismissive, often ignoring us even when he clearly had time to assist. The prices were on the higher side, which I wouldn’t have minded if the overall experience had matched the cost—but the owner’s attitude completely ruined it. || Tiago was absolutely amazing and one of the best, kindest, and funniest sommeliers I’ve ever met! Not only did he select the most amazing wines to try, he helped us to secure vineyard tours for Duoro Valley. We ordered 12 bottles for shipment to the states and will definitely be calling him to order again and do a virtual wine tasting with him!!! Thanks Tiago!

place_name: Red Nose Natural Wine Bar and Shop
reviews_content: A hidden gem in the heart of Campo de Ourique.  On a hot summer’s day, we stepped into this cozy little wine shop and were warmly welcomed by the owner, who served us natural wines at a small table inside. The air conditioning was a big plus, making it the perfect escape from the heat.  We spent a wonderful afternoon learning about Portuguese wines and their origins, while enjoying delicious food that paired beautifully with each glass. We left feeling not only a bit more knowledgeable, but also a bit happier than when we arrived.  A true local treasure — highly recommended! || Red Nose Bar is the spot if you’re into wine and good times. They’ve got an awesome selection— sip whatever and everything they suggest, tastes good, you’ll find something special.  staff? super friendly, know their stuff, and will make you feel like a wine pro in no time.  Oh, and the vibe? Chill but classy, perfect for a date or just a night out with friends. || Very groovy wine bar. No wine menu, so you tell the host what wine you are after, they give you a few to try and you chose the one you want - loved it! The wine glasses are really nice too - which always makes the wine taste better 😅 || Very cosy wine bar, we had our first natural wine here thanks to the kind staff! || Great selection of European wines. I tried Portuguese wines and got excellent recommendations. Unfortunately, I didn’t get a chance to try the food. || Thank a lot! We are refreshing our tapas menu soon and hope you will back to try with cool wines! || Gorgeous natural wine bar in the charming Campo de Ourique area of Lisboa! I loved the choice of wines — including excellent non-alcoholic options — and the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere created by the team. The sommelier will help you choose the perfect wine according to your mood, taste, and preferences, making the experience even more personal. The place isn’t too big, but the tables outside add a lovely touch to the vibe. The food dishes vary according to the guest chef, who personally explains all the ingredients and inspiration behind each plate. Perfect for meeting friends, a date, or simply enjoying a glass of whatever suits your mood. || Very nice wine bar (natural wines mostly). Good choose of the different wines, which you could try and choose the better for you. Also good small plates of food, great pairing to your wine. || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're thrilled that you enjoyed our selection of natural wines and the food pairings. Wishing you all the best and hope to see you again soon! || It's always a good idea to pick one glass or bottle of natural wine here. Friendly staff, good vibe and any kind of taste could be satisfied || Top notch service, not only incredibly knowledgeable and professional, but also relax and extremely generous, with an impressive offer and fair and clear prices. Relax environment and very enjoyable experience. Highly recommended if you are looking to try good quality wines from all over the world! || Thank you for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our relaxed environment and global wine selection, and we can't wait to welcome you back! || The staff is very lovely and they have a great selection of good wines! I cannot recommend this place enough🙌🏻

This downtown cosy wine bar offers a fusion petisco menu with an extensive wine offer at fair prices with informal service in a minimalistic ambiance.  We were 3 for dinner who chose the couvert, fresh goat cheese, escabeche de coelho, a delicious lascas de bacalhau, the ox tail with salad, all with waters, a few glasses of wine and a coffee for €40/pax.  IT is a favourite ✨💫 || Truly the best wine bar in Lisbon ♥️ We had the loveliest time — the staff and the owner were so welcoming, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. They were incredibly helpful in helping us choose a wine, and the Dois Carvalhos Reserva was absolutely excellent. A bottle of that, paired with goat cheese and sourdough, made our evening truly wonderful. Highly recommend! || The best way to spend a last afternoon with friends Seriously. It’s a wine bar, and they’ve got great munchies. And, even more importantly, they’ll happily spend all the time in the world with you figuring out what you want to drink - anything from pairings to “just a glass of wine” Seriously, just an awesome place! || We had an amazing night at Nova. After a long day walking the hills of Lisbon their concept "you choose the food and we choose the wine" is a perfect way to relax. Every bite, paired with a perfect wine ... and a beautiful reflection of Portuguese grapes. The bread and olive oil was so good I could drink a glass of the olive oil. The oysters, fresh and paired perfectly with a white wine. Fish cakes were tasty. Above all, the friendly and fun service the staff provided was outstanding.  Do go see this quaint lil wine bar in Lisbon! || I never give full 5 stars, but I had to make an exception. The experience starts from your first step inside, the place is built perfectly. The staff is more skilled in wine then most sommelier I've met even in michlen restaurants. The food is not only great but with precision. Everything about the place is precise and any little detail in the place was given sophisticated thought. If you like wine, and are in Lisbon, you must pass through. || Yonara is great! She helped us so much!! I loved the food, the atmosphere, the wine! It was a superb experience. Save some room and taste the drunk pear for a dessert || Wow, Pedro thank you! We stumbled across this gem and I’m so glad we did! The food and wine were incredible - even my picky eater parents agreed. I’ve been a little scared to try sardines but tried it here and it was SO delightful. Each of the food/wine pairing went so well with each other and Pedro gave us explanations to put it all into context. Highly highly recommend!! || Wow, this wine bar and restaurant is just absolutely incredible. Our first night in Lisbon, we went here after dinner and were blown away by how intimate and personally curated the experience was. João helped us pick a couple dishes and suggested wines to pair each with. He explained why each wine would pair well, along with an explanation of where in Portugal each wine came from.  Our experience was so good that we came back for our last night in Lisbon for a full dinner, along with wine pairing. Our second visit was even better than the first, with both the hostess and João remembering us and taking incredible care of us.  Some Google ratings in Lisbon seem artificially inflated, but Nova Wine Bar has absolutely earned its 4.9 stars as of September 2025. || I came to Lisbon in search of a true culinary experience, and this was easily one of the best meals of the entire trip. The owner, Pedro, personally welcomed me as soon as I sat down, which immediately set the tone for the evening. I told him I was open to anything, and he curated a six-tapas tasting, each thoughtfully paired with a different wine.  Every pairing was beautifully balanced and clearly intentional, elevating each dish without overpowering it. The progression felt effortless, refined, and deeply satisfying from start to finish. If you are looking for an exceptional, memorable culinary experience in Lisbon, go to Nova. You will not be disappointed. || Loved this spot! We tried two cheeses and the ham — all perfectly curated — and Pedro gave us great wine pairing tips. Every choice was spot on for the four of us. Cozy, elegant and delicious!

really cool spot! great for people watching. very relaxed vibes with a tonne of wine and other drinks (including non alcoholic drinks) available. … || Very great wine selections. If you are preparing WSET, it is a good spot to do the practice! It is very tranquil. The music is great. The staffs are very friendly. I like it. A great wine bar. || Highly recommend- the staff are very kind and happy to take the time to talk to you about their wine and Portugal in general. The vibes are nice, air conditioned inside which is bonus in the summer heat. Wine is also very affordable for the quality that they serve. || Price point will depend on how much you consume. Many varieties available by the glass, as well as dozens of bottles. Great wine bar! || I love the wines there and the staff is so friendly. Always the best recommendations for my wine taste. Get the cheese board, olives and bread with olive oil. So good. I wish they would have a bit more on the menu, but anyway I love this place. || Hi Alina, thank you so much for your kind words ! Since your visit we have added few new suggestions to our food list, including delicious tartines, so don't hesitate to come back to try them ! || Cute and atmospheric wine bar with a great selection of Portuguese wines. I really loved the interior and you can sit outside on a terrace. … || This is a great place for cheese and wine!  They really make you feel welcome even though I knew nothing about wine. They … || Really lovely spot to grab and drink and/or take away a bottle. The staff are incredibly knowledgeable about Portuguese wines; I really appreciated how patient they were when examining the different regions and varieties. Would definitely recommend popping by! || Thank you so much Caylin ! We are happy to read that you enjoyed our recommendations :) || happy hour 17-19u: 4,5 for two roses. || Cute little wine bar, great staff and good small plates of food. Beautiful Portuguese wines on the list. || Great nook for a great selection of wine and cheeses. We stopped here before dinner for a little happy hour and the service was fantastic. E are on our honeymoon and we can’t begin to recommended the cheese with the Calabrian chili pickled … || I was looking a place with Portuguese wine and I found this gem close to the hostel I stayed. Nice environment, great prices, good customer treatment. || Thanks so much for your feedback Ingrid ! || Really nice neighborhood wine bar! Great selection of wines, ambiance and friendly service! Highly recommended! || Thank you Marco for your nice words ! Cheers ! || Wonderful ambience! Lots of options for wine and the team behind the bar always has incredible suggestions. Outdoor seating at night is so much fun. || Such a cozy and loving vibe with truly heartwarming service! The food was fresh and delicious, the wine was excellent🥂and we had a wonderful evening here🍷 Would definitely come back again! … || A fun space and a fun selection of wine - all from Portugal which is great. The service was nice but maybe a little cold. And it was weirdly empty when we went, I’m sure some more people would’ve added to the atmosphere || Hi Lucas, thanks for your review ! You're welcome back any time ! || My favorite wine bar in Lisbon. Always nice and helpful in the bar, guiding you towards the wine you like. It’s not a problem to try a few different until you find the right one. You feel very welcome and the wines they have are really good and “different”. Also it’s not expensive - like 4-7€/glass || Very cozy, a wine bar that is more "trendy" than classic and I think it is nice that Anjos have such diversity. Good wine, OK prices, beautiful inside! || Lovely wine bar with a great selection of wines. They also serve some tapas to go along with drinks. The service was very nice and knowledgeable about wine. || I think they only sell portuguese wines and oh my aren't they fabulous :)) The staff is super friendly and funny!

So far it’s the best wine bar i have been in Lisbon. We just saw it from outside and wanted to try. you shouldn’t go as a big group if you wanna sit because they only fav few bar chairs inside. We asked for white wine but they made us taste bunch of wines and explained all the stories behind those wines. It was such an experience. They also told us they are changing their wine collection every week. So we loved the place!!! || Laid back and intimate, this is a fantastic natural wine bar in a great location! Jamie was incredibly knowledgeable and welcoming, happy to share his insights and have a chat.  My partner and I only had time for one glass each, but he generously let us taste a few extras, all of which were excellent! If I’m ever back in Lisbon, I’ll definitely return, and I’ll be recommending it to friends visiting the city as well! || Some places are just pure serendipitous joy. I love finding places like Salty. Jamie and all the patrons I met were kind and equally happy to be in that moment. I think anyone that finds themselves enjoying the delicious wine on offer should savor not only the unique and fantastic wine they are tasting, but also a very wonderful slice of kind and warm hospitality in central Lisbon. Love love love. || Absolutely love this little wine bar in Lisbon. The staff (Jamie, Nicole, Zane) are so friendly, welcoming, knowledgable about the natural wine they serve and just wonderful to talk to. The place is small and very cozy. Good tunes are usually playing and the atmosphere is very social. You feel like you are at an old friend’s house catching up over a glass or two of fabulous natural wine. This will be a regular spot for me on all future trips to Lisbon. It is truly a special place, mainly due to the outstanding staff! || Called into this cool little wine bar prior to a dinner reservation and wasn’t disappointed. Jamie looked after us, it was good to run into another Australian in Lisbon. Tried some nice wine and place was a great vibe. Would highly recommend. || What a Gem. Amazing options and such a broad spectrum of different wines. Jamie was amazing and made our night. We originally wanted to stay for one drink and ended staying until closing! || Randomly walked in and it was a great way to end the day out! Jamie knows exactly how to engage with his customers and make them feel at ease. Wonderful customer service, friendly, and a beautiful, quaint spot. The atmosphere was so relaxed, yet brilliantly engaging. We shall definitely be going back, and I would recommend this place to anyone who wants an intimate yet fun experience trying out natural wines. Mind you, I don't drink alcohol, but my partner was served a wonderful selection and I was offered many delicious non-alcoholic alternatives. || A very cozy place with great wines. Nicole was lovely and extremely attentive. She made us feel at home! Great music and energy, we'll be back :)) || Wandered into Salty on a solo date day—and what unfolded felt like one of those rare, serendipitous moments you don’t plan for but never forget. The space was warm, intimate, and effortlessly inviting. I didn’t catch his name, but to the bartender: thank you for an experience that felt both grounding and quietly transcendent. The wine was incredible, yes—but it was the conversation, honest and unforced, that stayed with me long after. A true hidden gem, found by chance, felt like fate  With love, A grateful Toronto, Canada traveller || Such a cozy wine bar in a vibrant neighborhood in Lisbon. We had delicious wine, thanks to David’s guidance, and great conversation. Felt right at home!!

Such a wonderful and magical wine bar with and thoughtfully curated wine selection. The owner truly cares about both the business and the customer experience. He’s welcoming and very knowledgeable about wine. The range of wines is impressive, with options from accessible to more premium. The food is classic, traditional Portuguese, and pairs beautifully with the wines. Highly recommended || Great spot for trying out local wines. The owner had great suggestions and was very welcoming. || Adega Etelvina is a wonderful little wine bar with tons of charm, and it feels like a true hidden gem away from the tourist crowds. It’s a small, cozy space with a very local, welcoming vibe, the kind of place you stumble into and end up staying longer than planned. The Portuguese wine selection is fantastic, with something for every taste, and the owner is happy to help you choose. || A place full of love, washed down with fine wines and incredible Portuguese snacks, which formally brings us together with the informality of the good old days. Thank you for being there! || Lovely wine bar, great host, great wine. Sláinte || By far the coziest and most intimate wine bar I’ve been to. The owner is obviously extremely passionate and knows his craft. A definite must visit for every wine lover. || An absolute gem in Lisbon. From the moment we walked in, we were made to feel genuinely welcome by the owner, who took the time to chat with us, share recommendations, and clearly takes great pride in both the wine and the experience. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, the wine selection was thoughtfully curated, and every glass felt like it came with a story. It’s the kind of place where you lose track of time in the best way. We left already talking about when we’d come back — and we absolutely will. Highly recommend to anyone looking for an authentic, memorable wine bar experience in Lisbon. 🍷 || A wonderful spot to hang out with friends, have a glass of wine, and enjoy authentic Portuguese delicacies. The atmosphere is incredibly welcoming, and Tiago, the host, makes the experience even more special with his warmth. ★★★★★ || A good wine list, honest and traditionally flavorful snacks and appetizers, a refined musical selection, and the excellent hospitality of the hosts - Tiago and Foxy. In short: it has all the necessary ingredients to be "THE" meeting point of choice for a relaxed end-of-day drink, a chat, and a good snack. || Thank you for your visit, the cat fell in love with you ♥️

In love with this place! I’m so happy we came across this wonderful place: great coffee in the morning and amazing wine and food in the evening. Went there with my friends and had the best time. The staff is so nice, and the food is really tasty, which is not that common in great wine places. We even had the burrata twice!! Totally recommend! || Oh my..  the food was simply perfect. A beautiful balance of simplicity and flavour that made every bite irresistible (I could hardly keep from licking my fingers). The quality of the fish was so good, the cheeses were just as perfect, and the wines carefully selected. The atmosphere was warm and inviting as if you are sitting in a living room, and to top it all off, the owner was incredibly sweet and welcoming. Such a special experience. I can’t wait to return. || Oh, thank you so so much for such a kind compliment! We wish to have you here soon again! || Beautiful summer evening with Cesar and Katya (owner)! Incredible bright and light red wines, great stories, and lovely ambience. Hidden gem! || This cozy wine bar in Lisbon is a great spot for natural wine lovers. They have a well-chosen selection and serve tasty small plates to go with it. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the staff is friendly and happy to help with recommendations. A perfect place to unwind and try something new! || Thank you so much! Hope to see you again soon) || Priviettttt!!! Honestly, this is the best place ever. A beautiful wine selection, all curated by my dear boss and friend, Ekaterina. A very chill yet classy terrace with an amazing view of the Red Bridge. Come by for some great wines and lovely snacks! || Wonderful little spot off the main path, with a cozy quiet atmosphere. Everything I had here was fantastic quality and it's apparent everything is lovingly made. Great ingredients and combinations, and great wine choices. The couple running it are also very pleasant. Will definitely be back! || Thank you very much ♥️ See you soon again;) || A very cozy place with incredibly delicious food and equally great wines.Katya was a wonderful host, friendly and attentive, which made the experience even more special. Definitely a wine bar I’d happily return to. 🤤😍 || The staff of Afterhours really made the difference for me. I reached out to them to plan a birthday dinner and they were very friendly and adapted themselves to all my requests. The gym management has forgotten that not everyone works from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and therefore they don't care about people who arrive later and leave later... they only care about people who don't work, or who are on vacation or students, forgetting about the people who work and also pay their monthly fees, because the classes they offer between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM are only available to those who don't work, are on leave, or are on vacation. They are not organized in their scheduling. For example, the RPM classes start at 10:00 AM... and who can attend those classes if we work? Then there's one at 7 PM, and those who leave at 6 PM, if they work far away and come by car, may or may not be able to attend. I leave at 7 PM, even though I work nearby, I can't get there on time. They could have 3 RPM classes so everyone has an equal opportunity to attend. Those in charge don't have the reasoning skills to see this. If they had this RPM schedule, for example, Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday, there would be more people happy in the classes. Classes like TRX are the same, there's only one when there is one, etc. Right now there are no more members because whoever is managing it doesn't know what they're doing, and it's a shame because if they did, I would go every day if the classes that push us, like RPM and TRX for example, started at 7:30 am.
