Our goal is to always offer a tranquil and welcoming environment, ideal for relaxing and taking care of yourself. We hope to welcome you back soon. || Perfect session with Cattaleya. Discreet, polite professional with excellent technique. || 5 stars. The service, the massage, and the space. || Thank you. And it will always be like this... || Very good, I will recommend it. More than an incredible experience with the massage therapist Yris at this SPA, welcoming and attentive, I will return many more times. || Thank you so much for your recommendation and for your kind words 🤍 We are immensely happy to know that your experience with Yris was more than incredible. She will be very pleased with your feedback.  It will always be a pleasure to welcome you back. See you soon ✨ || Thank you for your review.

Had an amazing experience! Me and my boyfriend decided to give it a try and they provided such a good service. They’re in the central area very easy access. The environment is clean and comfortable, they offer different types of massages for couples and singles and the girls are gorgeous. Thanks to Fae and Sofia. Our vacation got even more exciting after this experience next time we’re in Lisbon we’re definitely coming back || Such a fantastic place! I've already heard about tantric massage experience, but I've got the most discovery experience ever so far. Naomi made me feel out of this world with such touch and helped me to discover myself, thank you for this amazing experience. Also, I'd like to greet Isabela for the attention and booking || Pathetic tourist trap. Most girls could stand to lose 30-50 pounds. Had Vivi - she was particularly skilled at giving remarkably boring massages. Almost walked out in the first 15 minutes but since I already paid the overpriced fee I decided to stay to the end. Should’ve walked out. || Mark, We need to make it very clear that offensive comments about the appearance of our therapists are disrespectful, inappropriate, and do not reflect the values of Venus Spa. We work exclusively with tantric, sensual, and therapeutic massages, always within an environment of respect, professionalism, and elegance. We do not offer sexual services at any time. The massage you selected corresponds to one of the simplest options on our menu, with a well-defined concept that is clearly explained to the client beforehand. Our therapists are qualified professionals, admired daily by our clients for their beauty, technique, sensitivity, and posture. The public that seeks us truly values exactly this: sensuality with class. We respect that our concept is not for everyone, but we do not accept personal attacks or demeaning comments about our professionals. || Had an amazing time with Sarah who was very amazing at small talk and was skilled even against difficult odds. If I'm ever in Lisbon again, I would love to come back here! || RECOMMEND, WILL COME BACK. From all the spas I tried in lisbon this one so far has been the best. Prices are fair, they got AC and overall everything was great. || A memorable experience! From Isabela's smile and initial service to Serena's massage, I was treated very well. They are very professional, they love what they do and they know how to treat people. The massage has technique, it's revitalizing... I'm amazed! I highly recommend it! And I'll be back soon! Thank you Isabela, thank you Serena. Much more success to you! || Whenever I come through Lisbon for work, I make a point of visiting at Venus.  Regardless of who the therapist is, the level of service has consistently been excellent. Had the best experience with Sofia, and had four hands massage with other girl that I forgot the name but was one of the best experiences that I had so far in Spas.  Unlike some other places that I have visited, where at best you get a back rub (not a real massage) from someone mechanically going through the motions, the therapists at Venus consistently provide a real sensual massage that is sublime. I highly recommend the four hands massage. Yes, it is more expensive, however, the level of sensuality and added intimacy makes it well worth the additional cost.  You will forever remember it. If you are thinking of visiting Venus, you will find a professionally run Spa where you can go with confidence. 10/10. || We are extremely grateful for your detailed feedback and for consistently choosing us whenever you visit Lisbon. It is a great pleasure to know that the quality of our service has been consistently excellent for you.  We especially appreciate the recognition given to Sofia and our four-hands massage. Our mission is to provide a professional and memorable experience, and your 10/10 comment confirms that we are on the right track.  We look forward to welcoming you back soon! || Sofia is the best girl in the town, she eas very professional and very good at what she does || I was in heaven for an hour of Nuru with Sarah and Joana. Nice and kind girls, who are even prettier in real life. The nice was classy in a historic building. A perfect experience, and a place I will definitly revisit in the future… || This was by far the worst experience I’ve had at a massage center. I paid for a specific service, but ended up receiving something completely different, and for a shorter duration.  It’s clear they’re targeting tourists, but the quality of service was disappointing and unprofessional. I do not recommend this place at all.

I came to the spa today with minimal expectations, but from the moment I arrived, I was pleasantly surprised. The reception was warm and welcoming, the spa area was lovely, and the ambiance was very tranquil. To top it all off, my masseuse, Jone, was absolutely amazing. She has such soft and delicate hands, and her skill made my experience truly enjoyable. Thank you again, Jone—I’ll definitely be back! || This is a lovely place to relax, especially on a rainy day. The hydro circuit has everything needed for a very pleasant experience, the space is clean, and the staff is warm and polite. I also truly enjoyed my facial treatment — it was deeply relaxing, and my therapist was very skilled.  I do have a couple of gentle suggestions that I believe could make the experience even better:  • During my visit, the hydro circuit was quite lively, which made it a bit harder to fully unwind. An encouragement of silence or whispering could really help preserve the calm atmosphere the space is clearly designed to offer.  • After such a soothing treatment, transitioning into a brightly lit space with product recommendations felt a little abrupt. Offering guests the option to opt in or out of product advice on the intake form might make this moment feel more aligned with the overall sense of relaxation, while still supporting the team’s expertise.  Overall, this is a beautiful space with thoughtful services, and with a few small refinements, it could feel even more exceptional. || We picked this place because it was recommended as the best Spa place in Portugal. I would say we already saw better places in Lisbon, but still it's a good place to relax. Maybe still a bit overpriced for the hydro water treatment. || The staff is very welcoming and friendly. We felt well taken care of  during our visit to the water therapy circut. We were the only people there late afternoon so we had the infrared sauna, cold plunge and bubble pools all to ourselves. || A decent spa. All of the hydrotherapy rooms are off of one larger room, but it’s a lovely environment to chill in for a few hours. The massage and facial were also great. Lovely facilities.  However… one star removed due to the staff chasing me out of the elevator after I was leaving, for accusing me of not having paid (even though they had already made me pre-pay via an online link the day before). Between the three staff on reception accusing me of not having paid, even though I kept insisting I had, after having paid around EUR280 for a treatment - this felt quite sub-standard service. The manager checked the system as soon as she got to the till and confirmed I had paid - but my goodness, just check first before chasing me around the hotel next time.  The beautician also kept trying to up-sell me lots of skincare products even though I said I had carryon luggage only and no space. She clearly did not want to hear it.  All in all a rubbish end to an otherwise lovely spa trip. || Recently visited the spa, it’s amazing! Sanu my masseuse was incredible, would fully recommend - the best massage I’ve ever had 10/10  I will be revisiting vey soon! || Amazing spa and fantastic professional massage 💆‍♀️ Highly recommend it … || Awesome experience 😍 I reserved 1 hour for Water Therapy Circuit and it was incredible!! Relaxing area, great hidroterapia, high service. Thank you! … || I had an exceptional experience at The SPA, where I chose the signature treatment called "Portuguese Journey." It was absolutely marvelous. The experience began with a beautiful tour of the SPA area, followed by an invigorating scrub treatment, and concluded with a wonderfully relaxing massage.  As the largest SPA in Portugal, it boasts numerous awards for its outstanding services. Be sure to visit their gym as well—it's fully equipped with state-of-the-art TechnoGym Artis equipment.  Amazing! || I’ve been to this spa a few times and most of those visits have been very positive - slick service, great treatments and facilities - but the last time was really bad.  This could be the spa having a bad day or could be their service quality slipping. I booked a facial and massage and instead of being shown to the changing rooms, I was brought to the treatment room to change.  After the treatments I was left in the treatment room covered in oils and expected to put my clothes back on, with no option for a shower. I had to use one of the small towels in the room, wet it in the sink and wash off as much of the oil as I could, before dressing. When I exited the treatment room, the member of staff had gone, rather than escort me back to reception. The facial treatment I had booked also included an extraction, which I needed, but was told could not be done that day - no partial refund offered. Really not the quality of service I have experienced before at this spa and has put me off from visiting again. || Beautiful & clean hotel. My wife and I are looking forward to visit Lisbon again, we enjoyed our trip very much. || An incredible experience for my birthday, everything was perfect, the crew was very nice. The spa space is with the jacuzzis, the showers ect. is just wonderful.a special thank to the director for the amazing present. || I recently had the most incredible experience at The Spa by Corinthia Lisbon. From start to finish, everything was absolutely perfect. Melissa, my therapist, delivered the best massage I have ever had. Her technique was impeccable, leaving me feeling deeply relaxed and rejuvenated even the next day.  At the reception, Katia suggested upgrading my massage with a Red Light pad, and it was a game-changer. The addition of the Red Light pad took the experience to another level, and I can't recommend it enough.  The spa itself is nothing short of luxurious. It's beautifully designed, and impeccably clean, creating an atmosphere of pure tranquility and elegance. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to enhance the overall experience.  One of the highlights that should not be missed is the water therapy circuit. It’s an extraordinary feature that adds to the comprehensive relaxation and wellness experience offered by the spa.  I will definitely be returning to The Spa by Corinthia Lisbon. If you're looking for an unparalleled spa experience, this is the place to go. Highly recommend! || Good spa, some jets did not work, water was pn the cooler side. || Immense gratitude to everyone at the Spa - Corinthia Hotel for making our Lisbon experience extra special. From the amazing Head of the spa, the technical director- Pedro Tomás to every team member, Beatriz Sa & especially Catia Macieira. It’s well deserved that the they are consistently awarded the best. Truly fabulous on every front- from the facilities, to how they run it 💛⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ || So happy I have found this place. I have had the combination massage which was perfect relief to my muscle ache and back pain. The Spa setting is clean and relaxing atmosphere. My therapist was super kind & professional. VERY SATISFIED!!. Will come back for sure 🙏 … || I did the corinthia signature massage and I highly recommend it. 5 star service from start to finish. Such a relaxing experience! || I had a great water circuit experience with my friends! I loved all the facilities! || Gorgeous facilities and interesting customer experience. || Excellent experience! Beautiful environment and great professionals. Highly recommended! || Myself and my partner visited for the 2 hour Hydrotherapy session over Christmas. From the moment we arrived, the staff were polite and friendly. The spa had a luxurious and relaxing atmosphere, it was spotless and smelt lovely. The hydrotherapy experience was amazing with lots of different features to try, and thanks to the small numbers per session it felt very exclusive. It was just what we needed after a busy stressful day in the city! I would 100% recommend this spa. || We were there yesterday, my boyfriend and I, At first we were in the spa facilities and it was excellent. we each had an 80-minute massage, our therapists were Margarita and Beatrice, we really enjoyed it, the entire staff was also nice and helpful, we really recommend it || I visited the Corinthians Spa and was completely delighted with the quality of service and the welcoming atmosphere. From the moment I entered, I felt welcomed and relaxed. The team is extremely professional, friendly, and attentive to detail, which makes all the difference.  The treatments are performed with great care and dedication – I tried a therapeutic massage and it was simply wonderful. I left feeling renewed, with a light body and a tranquil mind.  The space is clean, elegant, and beautifully decorated, conveying a sense of peace and well-being. Without a doubt, one of the best spas I have ever visited in Lisbon. I highly recommend it and intend to return soon! || My experience at this spa was simply extraordinary, a true urban oasis. From the moment I arrived, it was clear that the focus is on the holistic care of body and mind.  The atmosphere is elegant and relaxing, with sophisticated décor that blends contemporary luxury and serenity.  I experienced an aromatherapy massage and a facial treatment; the feeling of lightness and balance after the sessions was remarkable. It's the kind of place where time slows down and self-care takes priority.  Without a doubt, The Spa by Corinthia Lisbon is one of the best spas in the city, a perfect refuge for those who need to reconnect with themselves. || I stayed at the Corinthia Spa during a short trip to Lisbon and was delighted. Besides being a beautiful space, very well thought out in terms of decoration (which immediately creates a relaxing atmosphere), the water circuit is also perfect. The icing on the cake was a massage I had with Aline – in addition to having incredible technique, she was always very friendly. I think that even though the place is amazing, it's nothing without the people who work there, so congratulations to the team! || The Hotel Corinthia Spa is truly a haven of tranquility and well-being. From the moment you enter, you are enveloped in a relaxing atmosphere that promises to rejuvenate you. The gym is a spectacle in itself, equipped with modern equipment and an inspiring environment that makes each workout a pleasurable experience.  And the breakfast at the spa is simply unmissable! With a delicious variety of healthy and flavorful options, it's the perfect complement to a day of self-care. Each meal is a celebration of flavors that nourish the body and soul.  I'm in love with this incredible space and can't wait to return and enjoy it all again! It's a place that truly transforms the relaxation and fitness experience into something magical. || The best spa! Friendly staff and fantastic therapists, I recommend it to anyone who wants to spend a relaxing afternoon, do the hydrotherapy circuit and a massage! || The spa at the Hotel Corinthia is truly wonderful! From the moment you enter, you are enveloped in an atmosphere of tranquility and well-being. The massage experience inside the capsule is simply incredible; the sensation is unique and relaxing, providing total immersion in a world of serenity. Every detail is carefully thought out to ensure maximum comfort and pleasure.  After the massage, the tea tasting is the icing on the cake. The flavor is delicious and perfectly complements the relaxing experience you have just had. It's a true invitation to relaxation and renewal of energy. Truly, the Hotel Corinthia spa is a place that wins over anyone seeking a haven of peace and well-being! || It's a shame to only have 5 stars to rate this incredible spa! From the reception to the hydrotherapy circuit and the treatment, everything was unforgettable. I loved it! || I had a wonderful experience at The Spa at the Corinthia Hotel, starting with a 2-hour water circuit followed by a body exfoliation accompanied by a deep tissue massage to relieve muscle tension and fatigue. I highly recommend it.

place_name: Float in Spa Lisboa - RATO - Spa Massagens e Flutuação
reviews_content: I just finished the "Float in Zen" spa package, which included 50 minutes of floating and a 70 minute massage. The facilities are clean and modern, with a nice zen vibe. The main reason for my visit was to try out the floatation tanks, which was a good experience in itself. Afterwards, I got ready for the massage, when something unexpected happened. I had received massages in the past so I thought I knew what to expect. But this treatment by Rosa surpassed all of my expctations, by a lot. It was clear that she knows exactly what she is doing. She truly is an expert. Every single touch was full of healing, conscious awareness. In the process she pointed out to me that I have inflammation deep in my back muscles. I was not aware of that, but when she told me, I immediately knew that she was right, as I had felt it subconsciously for years. She did her best to help me and gave me recommendations for treatment.  This massage transported me into another dimension. Definitely one of the best experiences of my life, and the most relaxed I might have ever felt. Thank you Rosa!  Highly recommended. || I tried to book a spot via WhatsApp starting on December 7, but the team was unable to complete the booking. This was not due to a lack of availability or any other reasonable cause. They simply replied about once a week, repeatedly telling me that I would receive an email to pay the deposit. I never received any email and informed them of this on December 13. They replied again on December 19, and I once more explained that I still had not received any payment email. After that, they stopped responding entirely. On December 23, they contacted me again asking, “Do you still need a spot?” By that time, of course, I did not — on December 7 I was trying to book a spot for December 24. I found a better service instead. I did not visit this place, but I believe this review is necessary, and I hope they improve how they work with potential clients. This is the worst customer service I have experienced in the spa or massage industry. Think twice before considering this company if accuracy and respect for your plans are important to you.  UPD. This is an amazing place to check out if you are into the ruins and history of the sacred sites. Such a cool place. Plus you can buy a ticket that is good for 4 museums in the group. If you are checking out the free ruins across street ensure you pay the fee to check out the museum as it is worth it. || Museu de Lisboa - Teatro Romano: Where Romans Once Roared and Bluegrass Now Echoes  There’s something magical about watching live music in a Roman theatre, especially when it’s tucked into the winding streets of São Mamede and surrounded by the bones of Felicitas Iulia Olisipo, Lisbon’s ancient Roman self.  We arrived on a Thursday evening, just in time for the monthly performance held every last Thursday at 18H00 and were lucky enough to catch Stonebones and Bad Spaghetti, Portugal’s only bluegrass band. Yes, bluegrass. In a Roman ruin. And it worked.  The excavation site itself is awe-inspiring. You sit among the stones, imagining togas and sandals, while banjos and fiddles fill the air. The crowd was a mix of locals and curious wanderers, all drawn in by the music and the magic of the setting. After the show, we joined the happy throng for a glass of wine overlooking the river, because of course there’s wine. It’s Lisbon.  Then we wandered into the museum, where we met the charming Carlota, a bubbly art historian with a passion for living history and history in the making. She walked us through the scale of the original theatre, which could seat 4,000 patrons in the 1st century AD a fact made even more impressive when you see how modest the current excavation is.  The pottery displays are beautifully curated, and the guides know how to spin a story, turning shards and stones into tales of empire, entertainment, and everyday life.  Verdict: The Museu de Lisboa - Teatro Romano is a hidden gem where ancient history meets modern creativity, and where you can sip wine, hear bluegrass, and learn about Roman engineering all in one evening. Highly recommended for history buffs, music lovers, and anyone who enjoys a good story told in stone. || Outstanding indoor and outdoor spaces showing archeological remains, restoration, artifacts and renderings of what the Roman theater looked like. Excellent place to stop, scenic views and learn history || An absolute must see in Lisboa especially more if you happen to be lucky enough to attend a concert there. || We recently visited the Roman Theatre remains in Lisbon and were pleasantly surprised by how well done the site is. Although it’s quite small, it’s incredibly informative and thoughtfully presented, giving a real sense of the history and significance of the area.  One particularly lovely touch is that they host free concerts on Thursdays a beautiful way to keep the spirit of the theatre alive and open it up to the public in a meaningful way. It’s great to see such cultural heritage being celebrated like this.  We do hope there’s still more to be discovered and that future excavations might reveal even more of the site’s past. For now, though, it’s well worth a visit if you’re in Lisbon and interested in its layered history. || I love Ancient Rome. And this was a great little spot to visit. I walked away from the site wondering how much more history lies buried beneath the city. || This small but incredibly insightful museum reveals a hidden layer of Lisbon's deep past: the ruins of the Roman Theatre of ancient Olisipo. Originally built during the prosperous era under Emperor Augustus in the 1st century AD, the theatre was a major public building in Roman Lisbon. For centuries it lay buried and forgotten. ​Remarkably, its existence came to light following the devastation of the great earthquake of 1755, which unearthed parts of the structure. Excavations continued sporadically, revealing more over time. The museum itself does an excellent job presenting the archaeological finds (columns, pottery, everyday objects) and explaining the theatre's structure, history, and rediscovery through engaging displays. A must-visit for anyone interested in Roman history and the origins of Lisbon! || The main site of the theater ruins are viewable, free of charge, via the walkway constructed around the protected site. I left the theatre feeling both informed and inspired.  Unfortunately, my visit ended on a rather different note at the front desk. The receptionist, ever so curious, decided to round off my cultural experience by asking whether China is “a liberal place to live.” A bold choice of topic for someone who’d known me for all of thirty seconds. How refreshing — to travel thousands of miles only to be quizzed about one’s government by a man whose idea of diplomacy seems to be drawn from pub banter.  It was a fascinating encounter — equal parts microaggression and amateur anthropology. I suppose I should be flattered he thought I could provide the definitive account of 1.4 billion people’s lived experiences, all while handing back my ticket stub. But alas, it felt less like cultural curiosity and more like an attempt to have his preconceptions neatly confirmed by a passing Chinese face.  What struck me most was the selective nature of this curiosity — I didn’t notice any Korean or Japanese visitors being pulled aside for a quick pop quiz on their countries’ politics. It seems “Chinese” remains the go-to lightning rod for casual stereotypes and misplaced debates dressed up as conversation. place_name: Escape Rooms Game Over - Santa Clara
reviews_content: It was incredibly interesting, very interactive, and extremely well designed. The special effects, the storyline, and the overall atmosphere were impressive and truly immersive. Everything was well explained and easy to follow, even though the challenges themselves are quite complex — in the best possible way.  The staff was fantastic: friendly, professional, and very attentive. A special thank you to our guide Luca, who helped us a lot and made the whole experience even more enjoyable.  I highly recommend this escape room to everyone — just make sure to choose the difficulty level wisely, as it can be quite challenging but incredibly fun. We will definitely come back and are already excited to try the other rooms.  Book in advance — it’s absolutely worth it! || Great place with a good variety of escape rooms. We had a lot of fun, the puzzles were engaging and the time flew by. Big thanks to Sara - she was welcoming and made the experience even better. We’ll definitely be back to try the other rooms. || We tried the Agrabah room this time and it was a lot of fun. The puzzles were more physical and we enjoyed the different kinds of challenges. Alexis  was our game master and she once again was very helpful. Her hints are just enough to lead you in the right direction. || We've tried multiple rooms and I only have good things to say. About the game masters, I had Luca and Rodrigo. The first one is the best and the latter I found a bit neutral and didn't help the experience itself. place_name: Enigmas Land by Vítor de Almeida
reviews_content: It was an awesome day, very friendly people, funny and interesting escape rooms. || Very glad that you enjoyed your birthday with us :D We will always have that special chocolate cake prepared for more birthday celebrations and amazing escape rooms and games to explore with full magic :D || I loved the experience!! Even compared to escape rooms played abroad, this one undoubtedly had the most diverse and challenging puzzles! We loved all the decoding, and a super positive factor for its success was that, given that we have team members who don't understand Portuguese, Enigmas Land provided both English and Portuguese versions of all the escape room puzzles, allowing everyone to easily understand and focus on solving each one. In addition, Victor was with us in a super fun character who always helped with translations and communication with my friends, as well as putting everyone's reasoning together. He never gives direct clues like in other escape rooms, but rather makes us think through our own reasoning, which makes everything much better and gives us a real feeling of being the ones solving everything, even when we seemed stuck. It was perfect!! I recommend it so much that we've already bought two more escape rooms and even got a free speed game! Thank you so much for everything!! || Thank you very much, and we'll be here to honor those 5 stars in the next games you'll venture into! || As regular customers of this type of game, we were quite disappointed. Anyone who has ever been to an escape room will find this completely different. It's even worse. The game consists only of a table with props on it. The clues are very complex, long, and don't make much sense. And we also have the constant company of a man who is always directing and explaining everything. Which is not expected in an escape game where the group must decipher the clues on their own. || We realized that you didn't read what you were getting into; the game you purchased was an escape game, not an escape room, something that is even in the Odisseias title and present in 3 different places on the voucher.  And as with everything in life, we couldn't all like the same thing, and fortunately, the game you played is our most played and liked game. As you mentioned, the clues are indeed complex, and when you constantly try to read more than one at a time, it becomes more difficult, and this fact was mentioned several times before and during the game by the game master. In Portugal, and especially abroad, this figure (and you can research it) serves exactly as part of the game and to help guide you during the experience. We understand those who prefer to touch a button and immediately get the answer through the intercom; in our case, we prefer to guide the thinking and only assist in how to get the answer to the customers themselves. For your part, you decided to play as 6 in a game meant for 4 people, and despite mentioning that you weren't in the best frame of mind for riddles due to the few hours of sleep you'd had, thankfully at least 2 members still enjoyed it. Our games are all designed for thinking, not just wandering around looking for keys or objects in rooms like in others, but for reading, interpreting, and solving riddles. That's why we're called ENIGMAS LAND. Have a fantastic rest of your birthday and a great week! || The best Escape Game I've ever played! The biggest surprise is that the game is led by an actor...yes, an actor, Vitor de Almeida... Inspector Carlos Alves.  Get ready because you'll be chatting for a looooong time after the game. When you meet someone from soap operas who's also nice, that's what happens. || When you love what you do, you have time and you have the best clients in the world! Everything has more magic and charm :D Thank you and you are always very welcome! || I bought the Code! Neon game and loved it! It arrived super fast and is made of excellent quality materials. A very well-built game, perfect for playing with the family.  I recommend the Enigmas Land escape room to everyone looking for a place with diverse games that provide moments of fun. || Thank you! For this Christmas we're having another Home Game, Stop The Killer. Will the most fun team from Ovar and the surrounding area be ready for this adventure? || I loved the experience! Vitor is amazing and the game is set up in a fantastic way! My boyfriend and I both loved it! And we'll definitely do it again. || Thank you from the bottom of my heart, and we hope to see you again soon! :D || Incredible experience with extraordinary staff. Provides a very fun and enriching family moment. I highly recommend it for couples, friends, or families. It strengthens the bond between participants through activities that stimulate intelligence and resourcefulness! || A huge thank you to the creator and interpreter of the best photographs ever of our Enigmas Land! :D Big hug and a magical Christmas, just like your whole family!! <3 || Great experience! The games are interesting and diverse. It's worth trying and playing again! || And you are living proof of that with all the times you've visited us, the many Escape Rooms you've already played, and we'll be waiting for you again at the end of December :D See you then!! || Thank you very much! Always here for lots of riddles and fun! || Thank you very much, and may you continue to have lots of fun with our games because it's a great pleasure to see you spreading genius!

We played today "A Jogada de Lisboa". Our game master Diogo Rosa has made an awesome job! Very professional and authentic. We can recommend this room for all players, also for experienced escapers. Here you can find challenging and unique puzzles, technical know how and a lot of love to the details. 100% fun is promised! || I played the new Macau outbreak game. I didn't like it. I consider it practically impossible to complete without help. Context changes between rooms don't make much sense. The game is too confusing and long, with symbols everywhere and challenges that seem like filler. The game's flow didn't seem interesting or well-executed to me. What I liked most: the beginning and the first room is very fun in terms of scenery. Otherwise, it was a constant decline in my expectations. I've never played a game that made me want to leave halfway through. It's certainly not worth 80 euros, nor is it on par with other Scapers games, which are fantastic. Want a good experience? Choose another game, not this one :) || So far the best escape game I've done.

A couple of things to improve. Close the kitchen before visitors arrive, it's not supposed to be a students dorm. Fix the closets, some have no keys. Clean the place, before the next visitors arrive, nobody likes to see a kinderbueno paper in the floor. Fix the electronics on the first room of the SW experience, it does not "touch" very well. Close the hole of the air vent on the bottom left. Fix the UV lantern (change the batteries), it nearly had no light. Fix the laser gun (tape is not a good option). When the experience is over, someone should meet the team at the room and take the photos there. The radios to communicate is not the best option, since we could listen the other rooms, if channels were changed inadvertently (suggestion is to install intercomms). This is an idea with a lot of potential, that could be explored at full. Rgds || Nice puzzles. We had a good time, but it was bad for the price. what a wonderful experience! we play a long game with amazing riddles paying a very honest price, 16 euros! amazing night spent with friends || This was my first Escape Room and I confess it created a huge desire to do more. Our sincere congratulations! We were 6 adults accompanied by two 9-year-old children and it went beautifully... well... We weren't expecting the scares 🤣👏 The challenges are very well created as well as the environments in the various rooms and I felt like Robert Langdon deciphering some of them 🤠 If you don't know who I am... here's my first challenge for you 😆👍  We opted for the 1h30 and so we did both floors and we couldn't be happier! A huge thank you to the whole spa team, especially Marta, Beatrice and Andre! 🙏😊 || ✨ Title: Perfect stay in the heart of Lisbon  Review: Our stay at EPIC SANA Lisboa was exceptional from start to finish. The rooms are spacious, modern, and spotlessly clean, with extremely comfortable beds. The staff is incredibly friendly and professional – always ready to help with a smile and great tips about the city.  Breakfast is absolutely fantastic, offering a huge variety of fresh and high-quality options – one of the best we’ve ever had in a hotel. The rooftop infinity pool with views over Lisbon is a true highlight and the perfect place to relax after a day of exploring.  The spa and indoor pool are also beautifully designed, adding to the sense of luxury and tranquility. The hotel’s location is excellent – quiet, yet close to major attractions and shopping areas.  Overall, this hotel combines true luxury with warm hospitality. We will definitely return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for an unforgettable stay in Lisbon. 🤍 || I absolutely loved this experience. Staff are friendly and nice though. || The relaxing massage was good. The overall service and facilities were some of the worst of luxury hotels in Lisbon. The two "masseuses" talked the whole time, there was no music/ambient sound, you could only hear their voices, the room smelled of mildew, my masseuse had the heaviest hand ever and I was in pain the whole time (I asked more than 5 times for her to use less force and NOTHING!). From what you describe, it seems that the treatment performed was a technique called Gua Sha (刮痧) — a traditional practice of Chinese medicine, different from a conventional relaxation massage.  What is Gua Sha and why "saiu sha"?  Gua Sha consists of using a specific instrument to gently scrape the skin, with the aim of stimulating blood circulation, releasing toxins and relieving accumulated tension. When the body has areas of tension, stagnation or inflammation, it is common for marks to appear on the skin (known as "sha"), which may look like superficial bruises.  These marks are not wounds or injuries, and they disappear naturally after a few days. For many people, Gua Sha brings a feeling of relief and well-being in the following days — but we fully understand that, without proper prior clarification, the experience may have been uncomfortable.  We apologize for not having communicated and explained better before the treatment. Then came a stuffed crab shell, rich and savory, layered with cheese and crispy bits that gave it a perfect crunch. The grilled romaine with parmesan and crispy pork was a bold, elevated take on a Caesar salad. For mains, the white fish fillet in a foamy reddish-brown sauce was delicate and flavorful, paired with golden fries that were crisp and herby. And dessert? We would have happily stayed longer. But who knows, perhaps we will return. From my point of view, Santa is absolutely worth a visit.

The yogurt granola was easily one of the best I’ve had—topped with fresh fruit and these beautiful maraschino cherries that added just the right pop of flavor. The pancakes were fluffy and came with a stunning blueberry compote that felt more like something out of a bakery than a brunch spot. Can’t say a single bad thing about this experience. The food was DELICIOUS. Service was OUTSTANDING. Atmosphere? A VIBE. Can’t wait to come back.  I got the bitoque (best I’ve had in Lisbon) and the tiramisu (soft, rich, and explosive in flavor). The pictures I’ve attached don’t do it justice.  My favorite aspect was the service. So kind and fun and genuinely joyful. Special shoutout to Mohammed for making our experience so welcoming and knowing exactly what to recommend. || ​If you are looking for authentic Mediterranean soul food in Lisbon, this spot is a must-visit. The atmosphere is warm and inviting with its rustic red tiled tables, but the real stars here are the food and the people. ​We ordered a spread that perfectly highlights fresh ingredients. The grilled octopus was fantastic—tender tentacles served with crisp broccolini and a flavorful sauce. We also tried a velvety yellow vegetable soup topped with fresh greens that was comforting and delicious. The main event, however, was the seafood pot. It was a hearty casserole packed with pasta, clams, and massive, juicy prawns in a rich, savory broth. ​The drinks were spot on as well. The Gin & Tonic was crisp, refreshing, and served with plenty of ice and lime—the perfect balance to the rich seafood. ​The Service: What truly elevated our experience was the hospitality. A massive thank you to Mohammed and Arefin! They were absolutely wonderful—incredibly friendly, attentive, and efficient. They made us feel genuinely welcome and ensured we had everything we needed throughout the meal. ​Verdict: Great portions, incredible seafood, and outstanding service from the team. Highly recommended! || Great restaurant! Fairly priced, but the portions of the pasta are small, and the ragu barely had any meat. The pizzas are huge portions! The wine list is great, having wines in all price ranges. The tiramisu is delicious! The environment of the restaurant is upscale, secluded and has a bar as well incase the table is not ready. || Thank you so much for your kind words! This and Santa Joana are two of the best hotel restaurants I've ever tried (and I travel a lot). I really recommend the bitoque and the apple crumble! The service was on point and the food was delicious!  Warm atmosphere with a very inviting alfresco space.  We reccomend the grilled prawns, the strawberry sundae, the veal ragu and the Toscana pizza. Although we had much more and everything was superb. || Thank you so much for your kind words! It’s almost impossible to leave just disappointed. Literally everything on the menu will leave you happy. We ordered the spicy pizza and it was the best pizza I’ve had outside of Italy. If I ever go back to Lisbon, I’ll make reservations here again.  One of the best meals of the whole trip || Great food, lovely atmosphere and amazing people!!! Have been multiple times already during our stay at Locke de Santa hotel and would highly recommend. Mohammed, Danilo and all the others are so friendly and welcoming. You feel very well taken care of. ❤️ Would definitely go for a pizza😍😋 || We chose Santa Marta Mediterranean Restaurant for a celebratory dinner on Oct 6, drawn in by the promise of authentic Portuguese and Mediterranean flavours. The experience lived up to the hype in every way—the food was sublime, the ambiance was warm and inviting, and the wine list was thoughtfully curated. Unfortunately we left two new paintings on the coach after the dinner and reached out to the restaurant after 10 -15 minutes. The staff who answered the call handled unprofessionally. The next day we decided to go back and check with restaurant again. Amy, the restaurant manager and Romolo, the restaurant supervisor not only found our paintings and kept them safe in the reception but also apologized for the unpleasant experience. They were understanding, patient, helpful and professional. They have turned a potentially upsetting situation into a powerful testament to their customer care. We felt relieved and grateful. It is the integrity and professionalism of the management staff that truly sets Santa Marta apart. We believe the true measure of a restaurant isn't just how it handles your order, but how it handles a crisis. || This place was a great find. Only one year old and at the top of their game. Don’t be fooled by Google Maps. It’s tucked into a ‘courtyard’ off a plain street. The ambiance was great on the terrace. I had the Veal Ragu with Pappardelle. Great flavors and the pasta was perfectly cooked. My wife had a Neapolitan style pizza and the crust was a quality that you would find ‘in country’ - great flavor development of the dough and a perfectly crisp, thin bottom and a tender edge crust. A very adequate wine list. Service was top notch, to a person. The Manager has a good staff in the front of the house and in the kitchen. Give them a try!! || This place is inside this courtyard. I believe a hotel surrounds it. It’s a really nice place. Great elegant ambiance. The food was good.  The service was great at first & unfortunately, it went downhill from there. Near the end of our meal. One of our friends decided she wanted a side of chicken. We had 2 servers who would come by. There must’ve been some confusion because it took like an hour for her side of chicken to come.  Other than that, it was a nice restaurant and the food was good || What a great surprise! We were staying in the neighborhood for a couple days and came across this charming location for dinner. The outdoor area is very enjoyable and nicely decorated, the menu is simple and yet very well thought and original. We had pizza Emilia and Salsiccia&ricotta,and for dessert the Banana sundae and Strawberry sundae. Best strawberry sorbet I've ever had, it is made directly at the restaurant. Everything tasted fantastic. Service was amazing, the whole tram was taking care of us. We had an amazing last evening in Lisbon. || We truly appreciate your feedback — it means a lot to our team! We're glad you had such a great experience. || Lovely food and super amazing staff. We felt welcome from the beginning! And Santos made sure the night was perfect. Thank you so much! Highly recommend! || Dinner at San Ta Marta Restaurant (Lisbon, Portugal)  Tonight’s dinner at San Ta Marta, the cozy restaurant tucked inside my hotel, was a lovely surprise that felt part celebration, part comfort, and entirely delicious.  The atmosphere had that soft, golden glow that invites you to settle in and exhale. The gentle clinking of glasses, the low hum of conversation, and the faint scent of bread baking somewhere nearby all wrapped together like an embrace.  Mariana, my hostess, was pure sunshine in motion. Her dreads framed a face that couldn’t stop smiling, and her enthusiasm was contagious — the kind of energy that makes you feel instantly welcomed. I couldn’t resist taking her picture; she had that sparkle that belongs on postcards.  Then there was Mohammed, my waiter — calm, kind, and quietly intuitive. Every time I thought I might need something, there he was, appearing like a friendly magician. You can tell he genuinely loves what he does, and it shows in every thoughtful gesture.  This week, the restaurant was participating in Restaurant Insider of Portugal’s Restaurant Week, which meant a special three-course menu was being offered. Naturally, I chose that — though I made one small adjustment: a different wine for each course. (How else can a girl properly explore Portuguese wine?)  It started with a glass of sparkling white Alvarinho, my first experience with this local grape. The bubbles kissed the edges of the glass, bright and playful. The flavor was crisp and floral, like a friendly handshake from Portugal itself saying, “Welcome — you’re going to like it here.” The starter arrived looking like something painted by summer itself: charred tomatoes, fresh arugula, a soft puddle of basil purée, and a creamy burrata resting in the center like treasure. The scent alone — the basil mingling with olive oil and warm tomato — could make anyone swoon. The burrata melted at the touch of my fork, creamy and cool against the warmth of the tomatoes. Each bite was a lovely balance of smoky, tangy, and green — that peppery arugula giving it just enough spark.  A plate of focaccia sat beside it, and oh, that bread! Light as air on the inside with a deep, golden crust that crunched delicately between my fingers. When I dipped it into the olive oil, the flavor burst with a salty richness that made me consider asking for a second basket!  For the main course, I chose the Pizza Funghi, paired with a glass of Alento 2022 Red.  The Alento — from Portugal’s Alentejo region — poured into the glass a deep, garnet red. It had the comforting richness of ripe red fruits, a touch of spice, and this velvety fullness that wrapped around each sip like a soft blanket. It felt both elegant and inviting, never fussy. Then came the pizza, rustic and full of promise. The air above it carried the scent of mushrooms sautéed in olive oil — earthy, rich, and completely irresistible. The crust had just the right crispness before giving way to that perfect chew that makes a pizza memorable.  A trio of shiitake, portobello, and white button mushrooms mingled under a sprinkle of Fior di Latte, that delicate fresh cow’s milk cheese made within a day of milking. It was creamy, mild, and just wonderful allowing the olive oil and mushrooms to truly shine. Each bite was a cozy mix of flavor and texture — the kind of simple perfection that can only come from really good ingredients treated with care. By the second slice, I knew why this restaurant had earned its spot in Lisbon’s Restaurant Week lineup.  Dessert was where curiosity met delight: olive oil gelato. I hesitated at first, expecting it to be… well, odd. But one spoonful in, and all doubt disappeared. Smooth, silky, and impossibly light, it melted without a trace of heaviness — just a whisper of sweetness and a gentle hint of salt. It was unexpectedly luxurious. Sadly my review is too long for Google reviews, to read it's entirety please go to substack.com put my name in search. || What a great meal we had at Santa Marta! The service was spectacular, the food was delicious, and the prices were extremely reasonable. We started with the the focaccia, crusted with rosemary and sea salt, and drizzled with a little olive oil. I had the chicken thighs in piri piri sauce, and a side of Parmesan french fries. The chicken was fork tender and the sauce had just enough zip without being overwhelming. My date had the tagliatelle with veal ragout. The pasta was perfectly cooked, slightly al dente, and the veal was succulent. We're honestly thinking about going back for a second night in a row. || Wonderful restaurant for a delicious dinner. We opted for reservations and good thing we did as the place fills fast.  Our server had us seated and took our wine order.  For dinner we went with the sea bream fish plate, the rib eye steak along with the green salad and bowl of piri fries. The food was delicious.  Service is friendly and attentive. Decor simple but clean and tasteful. There is lots of outside seating as well. || Very friendly staff bur also taking care, the first thing they asked was “if we have any allergy to specific ingredients “ , nice environment and good quality food. The pasta with veel was really good, pizza was also fine. || Awesome restaurant with exceptional service. Fantastic vegetarian options. We got a couple of margarita pizzas, the spaghetti al limone, some apps. Others in our party got the Seafood taglioni and piri piri chicken. All outstanding.  Finished the meal with a shared slice of tiramisu and the 20 year port. Our server gave us a glass of the 10 year on the house said it was his personal fave. I agreed.  Couldn’t recommend more! || Amazing meal and even better service! Our daughter thoroughly enjoyed the attention from Lua, making our dining experience that much more memorable! Highly recommend going here if you’re ever in Lisbon. || Not far from our hotel, located in a nice private place and beautiful surroundings. They welcomed us with a lot of smiles and did their best to make our dinner perfect. 🤩The staff is very kind, I would especially like to highlight Felipe who is wonderful. 🥰Top quality food, also freshly prepared. 🍲I owe special thanks to the birthday cake they prepared for my birthday. 🎂Prices are well balanced.All recommendations !!🤗 || Amazing food and insanely good prices, friendly staff Mohammed was an amazing waiter. Atmosphere was great  They gave a scratch off ticket for a 20% off our next visit (never expires!)

place_name: Mila - Santos - Specialty Coffee, Brunch & Salad Bar

reviews_content: Stopped in for a late afternoon pick-me-up. Enjoyed a lovely white port and a delicious soft cheese. Added bonus, the wine list explains the various wine regions and wines of Portugal. Lovely people too. A delightfully spent 40mins. || Thanks for your feedback. || My husband and I visited Portugal last month, and, on our last night in Lisbon, we happened upon Lisbon by the Glass.  The place was inviting, especially the second floor, with amazing views of the city.  We were assisted by Princika, and she was awesome!  She explained each port and laid out the glass and bottles for us so we can take a picture.  This place was an absolute find!!  We recommend it highly if you are in Lisbon.  It certainly capped off our Portugal vacation perfectly.  If we ever find ourselves back in Lisbon, this place will be a repeat! || Great wine selection and truly welcoming service  This place has a really exciting and diverse wine list. We had already eaten, so we just came by for a couple of glasses and to explore something new – and we were not disappointed.  The staff have great knowledge of the wines they serve, and made the experience feel personal and authentic.  On top of that, the service was outstanding – warm, friendly, and attentive. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates good wine and genuine hospitality. || Thanks dear Christina for your feedback. || After feeling lost of an evening when it came to food, we came across this place and decided to change it up. Unknown to those walking on the street below, this tiny frontage from the street includes a gorgeous upstairs seating area giving lovely views of the city's East hills. However the view is not what you came for, we chose a 3 wine tasting menu with the charcuterie, cheese and pate board serving as more then enough for 3 adults. Wines were all Portuguese with background's explained and personal preferences included. Service was immaculate throughout and really has opened our eyes to the world of Portuguese wines. || Thank you Sam for your feedback . || We stumbled upon this place after dinner one evening.  Off the praca up some stairs is this little gem. Take a seat up stairs and enjoy Lisbon through their magnificent picture window.  enjoyed selecting wines to suit our tastes and definitely knew her stuff because we had some delicious Portuguese red wine and a platter of local cheese.  If you like wine,  like Lisbon, like tapas then you must find this place, sit back and enjoy. || Absolutely amazing service the staff here really know what they are talking about when it comes to the wines they are presenting to you.and top floor is breathtaking. Highly recommend 👌 || Thanks for your feedback . || Amazing experience, the staff were so knowledgeable in recommending wines and cheese. Also the best, most scenic place to enjoy an aperitif 🍷 || Thanks for your feedback . || This is a nice little spot with beautiful views on the second floor. The staff was extremely helpful, kind and educated us on the fortified wines we were tasting. We did not have any food so cannot really comment on that. || My wife and I went here for wine and cheese tasting, and we had a superb experience! The staff was so nice and even had us taste the wines being served to us before filling our glasses. She also explained in detail the background of each wine bottle she served us.  The cheese was amazing. We ordered the 5 types of cheese, and the cow cheese was unforgettable. We even ordered a second time, this time with just the 2 types of cheese we preferred!  The view of Lisbon from where we sat was breathtaking, even at night. The space was cozy and had good aesthetic.  We loved our experience overall! Definitely going back here whenever we're back in Lisbon! || Thanks for your feedback. || Cute place with a nice selection of wine. There's an upstairs seating area with a decent view of the city. They have some lite bites you can order as well. || Definitely one of the highlights of our time in Lisbon was spending a few evenings with the owner and crew of this quaint wine bar. They know their stuff. I highly recommend a port tasting. We bought one bottle for home. Excellent service, professional and most important, FUN! from Kingston Ontario CANADA || We got the big tapas plate for 41€ and 2 x wine tastings. We weren't sure if the big plate would be enough for 3 people, but it fit perfectly. The staff were friendly and professional, the tapas plate was amazing, the wine was good and the view was absolutely fantastic. The wine tastings were with 3 different wines and were served by the staff very professionally and told very well. They test-tasted two wines each round before deciding on which they wanted. The new wines came with no rush , so there was time to actually enjoy the wine, the food, and the conversations. We recommend the restaurant for so many reasons. We can't find anything negative about the restaurant, the food or the staff. They even went out of their way when I thought I had lost my phone and helped look for it and even gave me a phone to try and call it. We will definitely go there again if we visit Lisbon again. || Hello Dear Tine ,  Thank you for the incredible 5-star rating. Your feedback motivates us to keep raising the bar and sets the standard for excellence in everything we do. We’ll continue working hard to make every interaction . Once again thanks. || We found this place on our last night in Lisbon and regret not finding it sooner. The wine selection was great and the service really good. Lots of information about the wine and really friendly. If you happen to stumble across this place whilst walking up, or down, the steps- stop and go in. It’s great. || Thanks dear Emma for your feedback . || Fantastic place with a large selection of wines. Great option of tasting different wines. Nice service with professional knowledge. Very pleasant place. Definitely worth a visit!! || Great tasting experience of local Lisbon wines and other regional Portuguese wines. They carry brands/wineries of wines and fortified wines that you can't buy elsewhere -- so enjoy here knowing that it is a special tasting and the staff is knowledgeable about their many dozens of wines. We had the charcuterie platter with meats and cheeses -- good variety, but not the most flavorful we've had while in Iberia.  Recommended to sit upstairs to enjoy the views day or night, especially of St. George's Castle. || Hello Dear Mark   thanks for all your insight. Appreciated || I popped in one hot afternoon. I enjoyed excellent wine by the glass in very good condition. The cheese platter and meat selection was delicious. Beautiful views over the city and a cool breeze. Great service and friendly staff. I highly recommend. Obligato Lisbon by the glass 🍷 || our bar server was very friendly and knowledgeable about the wines. we enjoyed our wine tasting there! || Thanks Dear Aubrey for your positive experience in Lisbon by the glass.appreciate for sharing your feedback || Fantastic views and wine selection! Make sure to go upstairs for the view.  4 stars because the cheese plate was NOT good. It looked pretty but the cheese had zero flavor and the bread was grainy. Meat was ok. || Really cool place with vast selection of Portuguese wine. || We came here from a recommendation on a walking tour and had a nice experience. We were lucky to have a seat upstairs near the window which had an incredible view of Lisbon. We ordered some boar pâté which was not my favorite due to the texture, cheese platter, and the wine tasting.  The white was was very refreshing with some acidity and floral notes. The red wine was very full bodied and paired well with the heavier cheese. The staff were extremely helpful and kind. Would definitely recommend, especially if you can get the view upstairs!

reviews_content: This is a fantastic family owned cosy wine store and bar. Service was top notch - extremely approachable and informative without being too over-bearing as some other natural wine bars can be. Wines themselves were delicious, fairly priced and served perfectly. Really can't fault this place! Bonus points for the lovely artwork! || Thank you for your appreciation, that truly means a lot ❤️❤️❤️ || Really great spot for natural wine and small plates. The service was wonderful and the wines recommended to us were perfect. I highly recommend! || It's been a pleasure having such wonderful guests! || Gluten free! Only a food menu, the waitress/wine expert asks you a few questions and gives you a selection of wines to try. You pick your favorite and get a glass (or bottle). Unique set up, and definitely better than a menu of 30+ wines. || These are the words that confirm that our approach works—tasting is always better than reading the long list of options:) Thank you for your lovely review! || The cheeses are wow. The service is amazing. If I had more days in Lisbon 100% would be back to sit here late evening. (Didnt drink wines, but heard another customers enjoying them a lot!) || We just love it when people come for the food—we're really proud of our selection ;) thank you for these kind words❤️ || We celebrated as newlyweds at the bar and it was an absolute blast. The food was delicious, champagne and Lambrusco flowed non-stop, and our Italian neighbors upstairs joined in and were the sweetest. Huge thanks to Nina for the best organization. Wish I had taken more photos, but I was too busy celebrating! || This was an absolute pleasure hosting you! See you on your anniversary? :) || Fantastic selection of delicious natural wines from Portugal and beyond. Staff are welcoming and make natural wines simple - just let them know what you fancy and they will bring out a couple of tasters before you commit to a glass or bottle. The prices are shown on the bottles so there’s no guessing or awkward questions! Their small plates are delicious too. Drinks: 8.5/10 Recommendation: Black Forrest, Pineapple Express Menu is simple. Selection is decent. Flavors are good. Coasters are nice; glassware is average; garnish is nice. Presentation is okay overall, with unique ice on select serves.  Service: 8.5/10 Water on arrival. Team is friendly, professional, and attentive. Prices are average for Lisbon. Reservations not needed. || Proper crafted cocktails in a small, cozy and we'll appointed space. Joanna and Peter create lovely drinks and provide personal service. I had a lovely milk punch which was perfectly balanced.  Its a good idea to make reservations. We will definitely go again. || Booked Onda to grab a quick pre-dinner drink and we ended up going a bit early and I’m so happy we did!  We got to try four different cocktails and they were so good and so creative! The space was also really cool - loved the decor and the owners were really sweet. || Had an amazing time here and really enjoyed getting to know the owners and hearing their stories and recommendations.  We loved it so much we closed out both of our nights in Lisbon here.  If you are looking for a great cocktail and a relaxing chill atmosphere this is the place to go! || This was hands-down our favorite cocktail bar in the city. It’s a laid back atmosphere where the husband/wife owners attend to the customers with passion and dedication. It’s clear that they love what they do. In my opinion, this establishment is better than Red Frog. The Nikkei Milk Punch was my favorite. You won’t find anything like it elsewhere; it’s one-of-a-kind. Don’t pass up the opportunity to visit, but do make a reservation. || What do you know about cocktails? 🍸✨ Forget everything you think you know! 😎 Because here, a whole new world will open up to you — a world of amazing flavors, aromas, adventures, and people who are truly in love with what they do! 💫🌍💃  Every sip is a little journey 🌴🍹 — through taste, through passion, through creativity! 💥 Whether you’re into something classic, bold, or totally unexpected, they’ll create the perfect cocktail just for you! 🍒🍍🍋  This place isn’t just about drinks — it’s about emotions, art, and pure joy! 💖✨ So dive in, explore, and let yourself be amazed by this ocean of cocktails! 🌊🍸🔥  Cheers to unforgettable moments! 🥂😄🍹 || Thank you so much for your visit and review. We hope you can come by this week for the tasting experience before you go home. 🍸🍸🍸 … || I’ve gone to Onda multiple times, and have always had a nice time.  I lived here as a student (American so do take that into account with my opinions on prices) for about a year and visited multiple times throughout my stay. A few times I went for drinks (sometimes alcoholic and sometimes not, they have amazing options for both) and once for a cocktail making class which was a super fun experience!  It’s a place to go if you want nice cocktails. They’re well made and super unique, so though they aren’t the cheapest, the prices  are by no means unreasonable and are on par with a lot of other places I’ve been to. I loved the smoky margarita, as well as the Thai infused alcohol (I don’t remember the name) which was one of the best cocktails I’ve had.  Would recommend and planning on going again soon as I’m visiting for the holidays! || I can't speak too much to the food but I can speak to the lovely couple who own the place and took us on a journey of many cocktails. Easily a true highlight of Lisbon and something I would recommend anyone who enjoys the finer spirits and what magic they might contain. Do yourself a favor take a friend or six to the cocktail flight, and if you enjoy whiskey talk to Peter the owner into giving you a master class in Whiskeys around the world. || Drinks are crafted with perfection. Flavor explosion balanced with eased shoulders. Cheers for the memorable experience.

Atmosphere: 9/10 Located in Lisbon’s Chiado district, Toca da Raposa leans into intimacy. The space is deliberately dark, with stone walls, velvet seating, and pink limestone counters setting a moody stage. No traditional backbar in sight—drinks come straight from the prep area, which keeps the focus on the cocktails themselves. Music fits the scene without overpowering it. Seating is well arranged: a good bar-height table for singles or pairs and plenty of couches for groups.  Drinks: 9/10 Recommendation: Gorilla 7.0 The menu is one of Lisbon’s most creative—animal-themed, stylishly presented, and wide in selection. Flavors hit the mark, balanced and layered. Coasters are cool, ice work is unique, and garnishes feel thoughtful. Glassware is more standard, but that doesn’t distract from the overall presentation. The bar is known for seasonally shifting menus, and every drink feels intentional and concept-driven.  Service: 8.5/10 Water is served on arrival. The team is friendly, professional, and attentive, though the bar does fill up fast—reservations are recommended. Prices run above average for Lisbon, and there’s a mandatory 13.5% service charge added to the bill. Overall, service is smooth and consistent with the venue’s elevated positioning. || beautiful atmosphere and so aesthetic. fun and creative drinks that you’d never have anywhere else. had one of the best cocktails of my life and i’ve been in a lot of speakeasy bars around the world. cannot wait to go back and try more cocktails on my next visit to lisbon || One of the top bars in the city and not just that, but female owned!!! Such unique flavors and the main bar top is so gorgeous. Made out of a single block of limestone. I found this gem in 2019 and met the owner, who is a delight and a talented young woman. I loved it so much I had to return this trip as well. A do not miss bar if you know what’s good for you. 😉 || A Lisbon must. Not a single spirit bottle in sight. Gorgeous limestone bar as a centerpiece. And probably the most unique cocktail experience in Lisbon. Don't leave without trying the Badger or Anaconda. Altho they change the menu every 2-3 mos. || A unique and fascinating cocktail program let down entirely by terrible bartenders and bad service, and a bar that feels like a tomb.  Look, I like a solid minimalist/modern cocktail bar. I get it. I like the new techniques and creative types of menus and use of ingredients. I do think this whole pretentious hipster vibe can be a good time... when a spot has the drinks and atmosphere to back it up.  This place felt wrong from the moment we entered. It was super dark, but that's trendy now. Not a lot of seating, which again, trendy. And it was all tiny, low stools around small tables. Very uncomfortable to be squatting in the dark for any extended period of time. It's a one and done feeling.  I had wanted to come here for so long! I followed them on Instagram, loved their marketing, admired their program and I thought the cocktails seemed fantastic. Just my kind of thing. So, I didn't want the first impression and bad seating to spoil it for me. But the experience only got worse. We were purposely ignored for at least 20 minutes, and when I finally did call out politely for service, I got glared at like I was a troublesome child. He reluctantly tossed coasters and menus down and walked away.  I get at that moment he was the only one working, and all the seats at the bar were full. But he was far more interested in chit-chatting constantly with those patrons (specifically one man) than serving the rest of the bar. Finally his coworker came but his attitude was even worse. Completely unhelpful, impatient, and rude. He tried to ignore us as much as possible, even when we tried to pay.  What a disappointment. By that point, even if the cocktail had been amazing, I couldn't tell (I enjoyed mine, although a friend said hers was the worst tequila drink she's ever had). I was so bummed out by the overall vibes and awful guys working there who seemed to look down on us for no reason. We all couldn't wait to leave. We felt like they hated us. I'm really sad about this because there had been many cocktails on their menu I really wanted to try, but never will now. || Super easy to miss if you’re walking by but this little bar was amazing. super cozy ambiance and all the drinks were phenomenal. they all tasted super smooth and very creative. we tried the unicorn, lion and gorilla || It's not just a bar, it's an experience. Toca da Raposa has that rare energy of a place that is made with a lot of love and care in every detail.  I'd like to start by praising the cocktails, which are simply divine! Each drink is a surprise, balanced, creative and made with impeccable technique. You can see that it's not just a drink, it's a little work of art served in a glass.  But what really makes this place special are the people. It's beautiful to see the team, Bianca, Vinícius and Pedro, each one flying solo in their role, but creating such a perfect harmony that everything flows with contagious joy. The service is attentive, full of personality and makes you feel at home from the very first moment.  Toca da Raposa has the soul of its owners and staff. I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone who wants a special evening with incredible drinks and a heart-warming welcome. I'll be back again and again! After all...  Who returns, remains a friend! With love, R9 || Loved the atmosphere of this speakeasy style bar! The pink limestone and dim lighting gave the place the true essence of a speakeasy.  There 14 unmarked bottles on the back wall which add to the ambience. The drinks are well done as well and the drinks on the menu have names of animals or mystical creatures: ray, blue whale, unicorn, stock etc. I would definitely recommend this place along with making reservations on advance as it's a small establishment || This bar is prohibitively dark to the point where it ruins your entire experience. The menu was on one sheet of metallic paper with small font that cannot be read unless you hold up your phone’s flashlight. I hated the idea of using my phone, so I resisted and tried to use the reflected light from the mini mart next door to see…no success. When the waiter bright us our bill, he had to use his phone light to show us the total. It’s ridiculous to the point that it’s almost comical. I understand wanting to keep the space dark and moody but then the menu should be accessible with QR codes on your phone if you have to use your phone anyway to access it.  I really wanted to like this bar. It’s woman owned and features ingredients the owner often forages herself. The cocktails are creative and unique. I got the milk punch and my friend got a tea based cocktail, both were great. It appears the cocktails are pre-batched, so if you’re one to enjoy sitting at the bar to watch the cocktails get made, this is not the place to do so (also it’s so dark you wouldn’t be able to see anything anyway). I wanted to try more of their menu, but I couldn’t bear the darkness for long enough to have another drink.  Also tip for anyone who does end up going to this bar despite this review, the bathroom with the pink neon lighting is the women’s room. Blue is men’s. || Moody cool cocktail bar (no food or snacks- drinks only but it did have a few non-alcoholic options available). Cocktails have just enough variety but not too many to have to think to hard to choose. Cozy plush seating and cute menu branding. || A very hip and trendy bar with a creative edge. The cocktails are well crafted, I had a cedarwood-infused Negroni, one of their signature classics, and it was fantastic.  The staff are friendly, relaxed, and genuinely helpful. You can tell they’re having fun at work, which adds to the overall atmosphere.  Worth a stop if you’re looking for a great cocktail in Lisbon! || I stumbled upon this hidden bar tucked away in the city and was immediately struck by its unique drinks menu. Each cocktail was represented by cartoon animals, with a list of spirits underneath. The drinks were fantastic, and I loved the moody ambiance—it’s perfect for a date. The interior is very minimalist, which adds to its charm. || Pretty siick cocktail bar. Very nice vibe and good bartenders. Could’ve been a speakeasy if they wanted. Super interesting menu and got some nice cocktails going. Music was nice and will visit again.  The old fashioned was top. || The drinks are great. The bartenders could be nicer and tone down the attitude - especially when talking in a room full of people! Making people feel unwelcome is the last thing you want to do in a cocktail bar. Also see similar experience of rude staff that others have had here. || Cocktails are delicious. My favorite was the ‘Andaconda’ 8/10. Not a spot for someone looking for dive bars/pubs.  As someone who has visited probably 25+ of the 50 Best Bars, toca da raposa definitely deserves its spot in the 50 Best honorable mentions list. Drinks are priced accordingly. Bar seats were uncomfortable but the bar tenders are so chill, it was worth it. Place is extremely dim. Hip hop music, perfect volume. || A unique place with awesome cocktails. Arrived in the middle of the week at 19:00 and was seated immediately. The Pigglet with rum pineapple and blood sausage was the highlight but their old fashioned was a close second! Cocktails are all inventive with a beautiful menu. Sasha made the experience even better with her kindness and I will definitely visit again if I can! || Amazing cocktails and chill vibe! Had 2 rounds and wished we found this bar earlier so we could try everything else on the menu as well! || Amazing aesthetics, delicious cocktails, and super friendly staff! The badger with the tomato-soy-ginger combo was out of this world creative. We discovered this place by recommendation from a waiter from lumi rooftop, which closes at midnight. This was definitely an incredible stop for a small group. I'd bring a date here or just show off how cool this place is. No labels for drinks. Just excellently made Cocktails and good times.

The best off beat experience you’ll ever find. Manuel is the best host you could ask for. He will bring you on a journey through your own preferences and then into the delicious dark boozy years of the 1920s. A true expert of the intricacies of the cocktail world. || The perfect intimate place to be in Lisbon, Emanuel got to greatest history knowledge I've seen in a long time, amazing service and awsome hospitality || Amazing experience if you truly appreciate a well made cocktail and are willing to pay for it. We enjoyed every drink he made for us, and they were all different in one way or another.  The venue fits only 4 or 5 people, so it's a private 2h experience and reservation only. It's also only open when the owner is in town. But hopefully he'll be expanding soon to a new concept.  Each drink was around 22€ || A lovely location with lovely ambiance. You can tell he is very knowledgeable about liquor and cocktails. Personally, this was a mediocre experience because it was not quite what I was hoping for. Writing this review to help others out -  1. It is by no means a cultural experience - NYC style bespoke cocktail bar. If you have been in North America you may have come across something similar  2. The conversation was fairly one sided and didn’t leave much of an aperture for intimate connection  3. The cocktails, while good, were not particularly memorable  If you’re looking for a good cocktail place in an absolutely wonderful area this is your best bet. The cocktails, service, and overall experience were wonderful. Be sure to book well in advance. You get a 2 hour experience and can order personalized cocktails or any number of classic cocktails. Manuel was a pleasure to chat with and made us incredible cocktails. Very reasonably priced considering the quality and amount of thought that goes into each drink. We wish we could have spent more time in Lisbon to come back another time and try more drinks. Such a unique experience and definitely a highlight of our trip! Highly recommend! || Absolutely out of this world experience.  Manuel will ask 4 questions and they will create a magical cocktail for you. Each sip is unique. Or you can choose a list classic cocktails from the billboard. Recommend to try both options.  You can choose cocktails with alcohol or zero prof (non alcoholic).  The place is small (4 to 5 guests at the time) and magical, with red light and over 500 bottles in display. You need to book in advance using Instagram to enjoy this experience for two hours.  Manual is phenomenal host and we learnt so much, while we enjoyed our cocktails. Thanks Manuel!  Super recommended! || Amazing and unforgettable experience in Ulysses! Manuel was an amazing and knowledgeable host, and the cocktails were absolutely beautiful. Highly recommend! || Chatted with Manuel outside the door as we walked by. He spotted my Oilers cap and started up a conversation about hockey. Funny to run into a fellow Canadian abroad randomly so I thought I'd post a comment for him. We didn't have a chance to visit Ulysses due to short notice and time constraints so this is a 5 star review for the brief engagement! Perhaps our meeting brought the Oilers some luck as they knocked off the Canucks in game 7 to be in the Final 4. Maybe the cup comes back to Canada this year! Saude, Manuel! - Scott (and Sarah) Sens fan (former Habs fan from the 80s/90s) and current Edm bandwagon fan 😀 || An intimate and relaxed place.  Congratulations on the hospitality and the top-notch cocktails.

The churros are amazing. Recommed also club sandwich. The staff are very kind. Beautiful experience and beautiful view || Thank you for your feedback Tanz, we are glad you enjoyed it. Hope to have you around again soo :) || After the Time Out Market Paulicarus found this small roof top venue. Only holds about 40. Madge bought me a cairphreni (?) Pleasant enough cocktail. A nice breeze and a lovely waitress. Toilets on way in on ground floor. || Super great ambiance! The music was so good and perfect for a beer on a sunny rooftop 🌞 As a tourist, I loved the chill ambiance and the good beer. The bartender was super great, service was quick and personalized. This place is a co-opt with the church to fun community initiatives. We will be bringing our friends next time! || Amazing bar. Carla treated us so well, the playlist was perfect and the drinks were immaculate! || Thank you for your feedback Chris! Music ranging from Latino to bebop and house and nice exposure in the evening! I hear their brunch is nice. || Surprised to see you can enjoy the famous churros from the San Gines Chocolatería.
