A great hidden gem in Lisbon! The location is ideal, very central. Great environment, delicious drinks. Cabal is that type of bar that will suit everybody: a great vibe inside, and a big open terrace outside.  We tried some classic cocktails and Cabal signatures: Panther Martini, o.f Martini and Rooibos Spritz. All three were delicious and unique.  A definite must-try in Lisbon! || Thank you so much! Which one of the three was your favorite? 👀 … || I'd been looking for a nice cocktail bar in Lisbon and this one is tucked away behind a really busy part of Lisbon! Tried a few different cocktails, favourite being the Osaka Basil - so refreshing!! And the other two cocktails had quirky twists. A martini with tequila infused gummy bears and a purple martini served with purple pickles! Overall the vibe is really nice with a DJ inside and a nice outdoor esplanade || Wow Aimée thank you for such an amazing review! The pics are great, they really capture the vibe. We tried their Negroni with coffee and wow… it’s one of the best twists on a classic I’ve ever had even though I’m not a fan of negroni ) 🫣😋  Honestly, every drink I’ve tried here has been spot on. The team is awesome too – really welcoming and fun to hang out with. Definitely one of the best drink spot I’ll keep coming back to❤️🙏 || Nastya thank you so much! Great pictures. It was amazing to host you. We agree on the Negroni part || Met some friends at cabal on a Tuesday and we couldn’t have had a better experience. We were looking forward to try the cocktails and treated ourselves with six different options to try.  All of them were honestly great , but if you’d like some ideas, here’s my review of the ones suggested by the barman: - o.f.martini - my favourite; sweat and sour at the same time, perfect taste, served with gummies, 10/10 - old fashioned Portuguese - stronger taste but not overwhelming, definetly try if you’re into “bolder” flavors, - rooibos spritz - if you’re not a fan of aperol spritz like me then this is the perfect alternative, fruity , fresh, not too intense, really liked it  To make it better, the DJ had the perfect set for the occasion, chilled but you could move a little to it if you’d like, and the ambience just feels welcoming overall.  We’ll definitely come back!!  🥰 || Loved the pictures! Thank you so much || I absolutely love this bar! I have been in the city for a while now and this is one of the coolest bars in town. Great environment, spacious, beautiful drinks, easy access and good music. The cocktails are tasty, creative and fun! || Thank you Rafaela! It's an honor || Cabal Cocktail Bar is one of those places that quietly exceeds every expectation. From the moment you walk in, you can tell this isn’t your average cocktail spot — it’s got that perfect blend of sophistication and comfort. The lighting is warm and atmospheric, the music hits that sweet spot where you can still hold a conversation, and the staff immediately make you feel welcome without being intrusive.  The cocktail menu is outstanding — creative without being pretentious. Every drink feels carefully balanced and thoughtfully crafted. I had the whiskey sour. My friend tried the Hugo, and it was easily one of the best floral cocktails I’ve ever tasted (and I’ve tried a lot!). You can tell the bartenders here are true mixologists who take pride in what they do.  What really stood out, though, was the service. Our bartender took time to ask about our flavor preferences and then offered a few off-menu recommendations that were spot on. It felt personal and genuine, not rehearsed. Even when the bar got busy later in the evening, the team stayed attentive and upbeat — you could feel that they actually enjoy what they do.  The ambiance also deserves a mention: stylish decor, a bit of a speakeasy vibe, and a nice mix of people — perfect for date nights, small groups, or anyone who appreciates a good drink in a relaxed setting.  Prices are fair for the quality you get, and honestly, I’d come back just for the experience. If you’re into crafted cocktails, great energy, and a place that treats its guests like regulars from the first visit — Cabal is absolutely worth it. || Wow Dorian, you basically wrote a book here. Thank you so much for such level of detail, and for the amazing review. Come back soon! || We visited Cabal yesterday and really enjoyed this experience. The place has stylish vibe with great attention to detail in the interior and lighting. The cocktails were beautifully made and tasted amazing.  The Coffee Negroni was a real surprise for me – I had never tried anything like this before, and it quickly became my favorite of the night. You should try!! Service was friendly and professional, and the whole experience felt relaxed but special. It’s your sing to visit Cabal if you looking for unique cocktail spot🥰 || Thank you Diana for such an amazing review! place_name: Enigmas Land by Vítor de Almeida
reviews_content: It was an awesome day, very friendly people, funny and interesting escape rooms. || Very glad that you enjoyed your birthday with us :D We will always have that special chocolate cake prepared for more birthday celebrations and amazing escape rooms and games to explore with full magic :D || I loved the experience!! Even compared to escape rooms played abroad, this one undoubtedly had the most diverse and challenging puzzles! We loved all the decoding, and a super positive factor for its success was that, given that we have team members who don't understand Portuguese, Enigmas Land provided both English and Portuguese versions of all the escape room puzzles, allowing everyone to easily understand and focus on solving each one. In addition, Victor was with us in a super fun character who always helped with translations and communication with my friends, as well as putting everyone's reasoning together. He never gives direct clues like in other escape rooms, but rather makes us think through our own reasoning, which makes everything much better and gives us a real feeling of being the ones solving everything, even when we seemed stuck. It was perfect!! I recommend it so much that we've already bought two more escape rooms and even got a free speed game! Thank you so much for everything!! || Thank you very much, and we'll be here to honor those 5 stars in the next games you'll venture into! || As regular customers of this type of game, we were quite disappointed. Anyone who has ever been to an escape room will find this completely different. It's even worse. The game consists only of a table with props on it. The clues are very complex, long, and don't make much sense. And we also have the constant company of a man who is always directing and explaining everything. Which is not expected in an escape game where the group must decipher the clues on their own. || We realized that you didn't read what you were getting into; the game you purchased was an escape game, not an escape room, something that is even in the Odisseias title and present in 3 different places on the voucher.  And as with everything in life, we couldn't all like the same thing, and fortunately, the game you played is our most played and liked game. As you mentioned, the clues are indeed complex, and when you constantly try to read more than one at a time, it becomes more difficult, and this fact was mentioned several times before and during the game by the game master. In Portugal, and especially abroad, this figure (and you can research it) serves exactly as part of the game and to help guide you during the experience. We understand those who prefer to touch a button and immediately get the answer through the intercom; in our case, we prefer to guide the thinking and only assist in how to get the answer to the customers themselves. For your part, you decided to play as 6 in a game meant for 4 people, and despite mentioning that you weren't in the best frame of mind for riddles due to the few hours of sleep you'd had, thankfully at least 2 members still enjoyed it. Our games are all designed for thinking, not just wandering around looking for keys or objects in rooms like in others, but for reading, interpreting, and solving riddles. That's why we're called ENIGMAS LAND. Have a fantastic rest of your birthday and a great week! || The best Escape Game I've ever played! The biggest surprise is that the game is led by an actor...yes, an actor, Vitor de Almeida... Inspector Carlos Alves.  Get ready because you'll be chatting for a looooong time after the game. When you meet someone from soap operas who's also nice, that's what happens. || When you love what you do, you have time and you have the best clients in the world! Everything has more magic and charm :D Thank you and you are always very welcome! || I bought the Code! Neon game and loved it! It arrived super fast and is made of excellent quality materials. A very well-built game, perfect for playing with the family.  I recommend the Enigmas Land escape room to everyone looking for a place with diverse games that provide moments of fun. || Thank you! For this Christmas we're having another Home Game, Stop The Killer. Will the most fun team from Ovar and the surrounding area be ready for this adventure? || I loved the experience! Vitor is amazing and the game is set up in a fantastic way! My boyfriend and I both loved it! And we'll definitely do it again. || Thank you from the bottom of my heart, and we hope to see you again soon! :D || Incredible experience with extraordinary staff. It's wonderful to know that our efforts to create a welcoming community made a positive impact on your experience. We look forward to welcoming you back if you visit Lisbon again! Safe travels! || My fave cowork in Lisboa so far, and I’ve been to at least 5! Chilled, friendly, unpretentious place with longer term coworkers that build a great sense of community. Mariana, Felipe and Renata are great and make it feel like home every day 😍 Nice mix of some socialising / events and quiet time to get on with your own thing. For me it’s the perfect balance. Keep up the good work guys! Xx || Hi Will, it's wonderful to have with us! So good to know that you find the perfect balance between productivity and community here. Thank you for contributing and helping us make this place a home to many. || Spent two months with a dedicated desk at Resves over the summer of 2022.  The staff was exceptionally welcoming, and the community was fun and diverse (digital nomads, expats, and locals).  I was able to rent a monitor, and the office had everything I needed (phone booth space, bright light, air conditioning, comfy chairs, printer, even snacks sometimes!).  It was just the right blend of heads down focus with office banter and community events (like happy hours, wellness sessions, and more).  I would recommend to anyone looking to meet people and build community in Lisbon. || Kelly, thank you for sharing your kind words! It was a pleasure having you with us this Summer. Come back anytime! || I really enjoyed my time at Resves. The community was built with purpose and really helped us in our transition to life in Lisbon (building a community). People are friendly the atmosphere is very welcoming. The team at Resves are willing to support you in any way possible, which we really appreciated. The location is also great as it is in a nice but quite area, so not to much distractions/noise but yet close enough to all the restaurants and coffee shops for lunch or routine breaks and walks. || Yonnas, we really enjoyed your time here with us! The talks, the lessons, the drinks at happy hour... thank you! See you soon :) || My remote company needed a coworking space for a meet up and we contacted a few places throughout Lisbon. Mariana at Resvés was definitely the kindest and most attentive person we talked to. My group of 4 had a great experience coworking here. There was plenty of water, coffee, and a kitchen. Very best Wi-Fi and clean. I would definitely recommend it || Thank you for your kind words and presence, Victoria! Would love to have you and your team back anytime. :) - Mariana & The Resvés Team || Great space, plenty of light, good atmosphere. They all have lunch together on Wednesdays, which I loved! And the area is very nice to go for a walk and even the park of Estrela, which is gorgeous. They also had a big party the week I was there that was so much fun! || We're happy that you enjoy our space, Alicia! || Wonderful place to work! Resvés made working remotely so much better. The wifi is great, the desks are comfortable, the decor is nice, the kitchen has tea, there are plenty of phone booths, and the staff are very friendly and accommodating. || Thank you Tally! It's great to have you with us. || Working at Résvés was one of the best experiences for me this last year, I'm an architect so the quality of space is very important to me. The space is beautiful, full of light, and clean all the time. Mariana and António are wonderful, very pleasant and sociable, and very attentive to our needs. The ambience provided between all members is very nice, Mariana and Antonio organise several events and that makes a very good energy and dynamic between all. There is also a terrace outside that is very nice to eat or have a coffee. The location is very good, very central, and at the same time is a very calm street. Highly recommended! || Thank you Ju! It was a pleasure having you and your sparkling energy (and boots) with us. || I spent just under one month working at Resvés and could have happily stayed much longer! The energy in this coworking space is very welcoming, due largely to Mariana the lovely community manager. She showed me around and made me feel at home right away. The desks are spacious, the common areas are clean and quiet and there are private phone booths and meeting rooms available for video calling. The weekly events including happy hour and community lunch made it easy to connect with other members. I would highly reccomend this coworking space to anyone community-driven freelancers who finds themselves in Lisbon! || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're thrilled to hear that you had such a positive experience at Resvés. It's great to know that our team and our welcoming energy made you feel at home right away. We're glad you enjoyed our spacious desks, clean common areas, and private spaces for calls and meetings. It's fantastic that our weekly events helped you connect with other members. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we hope to see you back in Lisbon soon! || Joining RESVÉS last year was by far one of my best decisions since I am living in Lisbon, because I did not only find a place where I feel like I belong but also where I could be productive, for real. Most importantly, I was always surrounded by attentive, humble and inspiring people, who make this place very special. The owner Antonio and the community manager Mariana have understood what we remote workers are really caring about, hence this place is a must-visit when in Lisbon and looking for a space to work.  My professional path is leading me another way now, but I will be back - my heart belongs to you, RESVÉS 💛  Thank you Antonio and Mariana for creating such an amazing place and welcoming me to the family! || Thank you Jamaine! You were a wonderful addition to the family. || I love this place! This coworking is my second home in Lisbon! Here you can find not only your place to work, personal offices, fast internet, cool activities, but also a great community, support when you need it, and even massage;) || Hi Nataliia, it's so wonderful to have you as part of our space and community! You contribute so much with your smiles, gifts, collaboration and overall beautiful presence. Thank you :) || Reves is the perfect place for those seeking meaningful work and friendships in Lisbon. You will leave each day with a smile on your face. Their community is very welcoming, caring and genuine. || Thank you Andrea! It's been amazing having you with us.

An incredible coworking space!  The team are so friendly & make a huge effort to make everyone feel welcome  I've attended many of their community events to connect with other members - which have all been excellent  (Picture from the football tournament attached)  I have met both friends & business partners here - and I love coming to work at Palacio every day  Highly recommend IDEA spaces to all :) || Thank you so much for your amazing review Omar 😊 We're thrilled to hear that you love working at Palácio and that our community events have been a great way for you to connect with others. It’s fantastic to know that IDEA has helped you build both friendships and business partnerships, that’s exactly what we strive for!   We truly appreciate your kind words about our team, and we’re so happy to have you as part of our community. Looking forward to many more events, connections, and great moments together! || The ambiance is much more formal than other coworking spaces because very different professionals shared the building: freelancers, digital nomads, small teams, bigger companies... Very interesting and nice ambiance with different areas to work. The space is quite big and it's also pet-friendly. The only thing I didn't like is that there is no coffee machine but a coffee vending machine that you have to pay for whereas in other coworking spaces coffee is offered :) || Thank you for your review Raquel! When are we seeing you again? :) || Lovely place to work! The space is large and open, with plenty of free call rooms available. The staff is very polite and welcoming. Prices are also quite reasonable. || Hi Stanislav! Thank you for your review, we love having you here with us :) || Great space with a nice atmosphere. Visited on a day pass and it was very busy. I would recommend going early so you can find somewhere comfortable to sit. We were at standing desks that were waaaay too tall for me. A really nice space to work! || Great coworking place. Clean, stylish, fast wifi. Clean kitchen. Also they allow dogs to come which is great! Minus one star for working only until 6pm. I usually work in coworking places until 8-9pm. || Hi Alina. Thank you for your great review! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the space, the amenities, and that you're a fan of our dog-friendly policy. 🐾 Just to clarify, the 6 pm closing time applies to our HD plan. However, our other plans offer 24/7 access, so you're welcome to work at any time that suits you. We hope this gives you more flexibility next time you visit us! Looking forward to having you back soon! || Really nice staff. However, the office looks a bit old, a big open space with no natural light! Which is a bit sad, we’re in Lisbon after all. :( || Thank you for your feedback and for your kind words about our team! We’re sorry to hear that the space didn’t fully match your expectations. Just to clarify, our cowork does have a large skylight in the center that brings in plenty of natural light. That said, we truly value your perspective and will keep working to make the environment feel even brighter and more welcoming. We’d love to see you back soon and give you a better experience :) || IdeaSpaces Palácio is, without a doubt, one of the best coworking spaces I’ve ever worked from. The environment is beautifully designed, calm yet energising, ideal for staying focused and productive. What truly sets it apart is the team: incredibly professional, friendly, and always eager to help, they make you feel genuinely welcome. || Hi Andre, thank you so much for your wonderful words! We’re thrilled to hear that IDEA Spaces Palácio has been such a great place for your work. Creating a welcoming and inspiring environment is exactly what we strive for, and your kind feedback truly motivates our team 😊 … || Amazing coworker in Lisbon. Nice networking. Different opinions for coffee. Every Thursday is mingling event with free beer:) || Hi Dimitri, thank you for the kind words! We’re so happy to hear that you enjoyed your time with us. 😊 It’s great to know you’ve had a chance to experience our community and the weekly events we offer, especially our Community Hours on Thursdays! 🍻 Looking forward to having you back soon for more great networking and fun events! || The place is clean and well maintained. I’m posting this review as a hot desk user as opposed to permanent members (for whom I believe the experience is quite different). I spent a full day at the venue to work and take meetings. Like many other co-working spaces in Lisbon, people don’t bother leaving their desks when in video conference, hence the result is a noisy, chatty and unfit place to focus, unless you put on your headset with power volume (yes, because you’d hear other people talk anyways). There are 4 phone booths and I could use none (people ignore the courtesy of leaving after 30min or even the hour, using it as a “private”, quiet spot to work and not just for calls). No one polices these behaviours. It’s a pity as the building is nice, well positioned and could be much more. || Great underground space and structure. The staff is kind and helpful. Good place to work! || Thank you for your kind review, Ilana! Our team will be so happy to ear about it! 🙏💙 #letsbuildtogether …

The Impact Hall at Impact Hub is a wonderful space for event hire. The team there were welcoming and accomodating, to ensure the setup of our event fit the values and ethos of our organisation. Thank you Impact Hall! I would highly recommend for those looking for a chic event space in Lisbon :) || Very nice place for co-working with so many different areas; terrace, upper areas, wide open space and conference rooms. Also, a lot of natural light and extremely helpful staff/hosts! || I have been a participant of Creative Mornings Lisbon several times which takes place in the hall of Impact Hub. I have had a tour and the generous opportunity to facilitate a debrief with my Europass Teacher Academy group. I appreciate the energy of the co-working space - calm, spacious and kind. The natural light, beautiful natural plants combined with the comfortable interior are a nurturing environment that sparks ease, focus and creativity.  I enjoy the co-working space. || Very inspiring workplace in Lisbon! Great meeting rooms! || Amazing co-working space, full of natural light, outdoor space and rooftop with stunning views. Comfortable chairs, delicious coffee, but above all, a very welcoming team. Totally recommend it! || Really enjoyed our meeting at Impact Hub, a lot of natural light and comfort for our team 🐝🐝🐝 … || We had a great meeting at Impact Hub! Positive and inspiring energy! ✨Thank you! || So, I was privileged to be the 1st person to cowork here at the NEW Penha location of Impact Hub Lisbon. 🎉😎🙌🏽✨  It was the perfect space to continue building and working on my startup. Open and spacious, there’s lots of natural light, strong Wi-Fi, and everything from hot desk, meeting rooms, outside terraces to telephone booths.  The team were very warm and inviting. I had a very pleasant workday.  I’ll definitely be back, the space is beautiful. 🤩 || Giel, it was such a pleasure to have you as our first coworker! Come back to check out how space and the community have grown since. You'll love it! - The Impact Hub Team || The co-working space is truly a place I can wholeheartedly recommend to anyone.  In my case, everything that could go wrong did—and I ended up walking in unannounced, simply hoping to get some work done. Even in that situation, I was welcomed with a warm smile and a “Of course, go ahead and get started—we’ll take care of the rest later.”  The staff here are consistently helpful, courteous, and genuinely accommodating. What stood out to me most, however, was the clear focus on building and nurturing a sense of community within the co-working space.  The workstations themselves are excellently equipped, allowing for both productive focus time and seamless participation in calls or meetings. It’s an environment that truly supports concentrated, effective work. || Great community, infrastructure in an open, wide and friendly space. And vegan shared milk for your capuccino.  Perfect if you are looking for focus time/space or not (good people hanging out)

It is ok. Very clean. Good view from the window. Great central location. More like for small companies that for individual people. Few people inside. But coffee is extra. And you need to pay for it 50cents. And guess what the machine accepts only coins. Guys coffee is our fuel for work. How come it can be so hard to get? || Very welcoming, understanding and helpful staff. Marianna did an awesome job. Thank you! || Cozy space, tables though were ver unstable and the Wi-Fi not reliable enough for zoom calls || The best cowork in lisbon !!! || Congratulations on the creativity in the entire design of this space, everything thought out in detail. The capital needed a space like this. Excellent prices with a modern, welcoming and refined atmosphere where we feel at home. The location is fantastic, central area of ​​the city with excellent access. Lisbon needed a space like this!! || There is an immigration company here, the service is very good

Loved working at Second Home during my time in Lisbon. Super unique and cool work space full of great people. If you're a digital nomad, great place to meet friends and find things to do. And can't speak highly enough about the staff, everyone is absolutely wonderful. They take great care of you, more than worth the price to be a member. || Hey Carson. Thank you so much for taking the time to write this wonderful review! I am very happy you enjoyed your time at Second Home. We loved having you here and hope to see you again next year :) Filipa || Such a beautiful place for working. I was invited by friends so i did not actually work there. But the spaces were very nice. Fridays they have music and happy hour for members. || Great place to get traditional Portuguese food.  Prices are good,  12 to 16 €.  Fast service.  Had a great meal for 12.50 €. || Great place, full of people. Excellent staff. The chairs and desks are a bit old, but overall it’s a good environment for work. || Thank you so much Damien! Hope to see you again at Second Home soon. || After visiting many coworking spaces in Lisbon and around this world, Second Home fits me perfectly. I was looking for a work space that isn’t a bunch of digital nomads temporarily staying in Lisbon. I find value in expanding my professional network and the community here has members that are serious about their work. At other spaces, you get the cliche “I’m a freelance copy writer” but in reality they are just in Lisbon to surf and party. At Second Home, you will form genuine connections. The staff at Second Home is amazing as forming connections with members to help their business thrive. A coworking place should be much more than a table and chair for your laptop. The value is the community and culture.  The cafe at Second Home is second to none with healthy food options that is affordable and delicious. Each person of the Second Home team comes into the office every morning asking “how can I help everyone thrive?”  Of course, the office design itself is inspirational with a focus on nature. Not your typical coworking space. If you’re a serious entrepreneur needing a space that helps you learn, be productive, and find inspiration, I highly recommend Second Home. || Loved the space - really organic, lots of greenery, good vibes, friendly staff. It pains me to vote it so low as it's such a njce space, however the air-conditioning is just not good enough to cope with the summer and the place is too stuffy and warm. || Hello Ivan,  Thank you for taking to time to leave us this honest review. While I am sad you found the space too hot, I am pleased you liked the vibe, setting and the Team. Hopefully we'll see you again once these heatwaves passes! || The place is beautiful and pleasant. Very quiet and very comfortable, and on Fridays there are cocktails. That’s great.  But here comes the "but." I was asked by the staff to leave 45 minutes before closing, and when I said I still had time since I often work late, I was met with dirty looks, and something was said about me in Portuguese. This isn’t the first time.  Additionally, there are lots of small things that, over time, become really annoying. The staff chat away at the reception while I wait and wait, even though they see me, and they just laugh amongst themselves.  One time, I had an impromptu phone call, and all the booths where it was quiet were occupied. I quickly stepped into the conference room for one minute to finish my call. It was already 9 p.m., so very late. I was interrupted and asked to leave because the room was reserved.  What’s the deal? I was on the phone, it was almost closing time, and I said I needed two minutes, but they just left the door open. Meanwhile, people were shouting and laughing everywhere, and I couldn’t finish my call. Sorry, but I’ve never experienced anything like this in any other coworking space. || Hey Mathe, Thanks for taking the time to review your experience at Second Home and sorry we didn't meet your expectations. Apologies you were asked to leave 45min before closing and that, on other occasions, the staff kept you waiting -  it may be they were finishing a previous task. This should not happen and I will look into it to ensure it doesn't happen again.  The meeting room was indeed booked for the entire month, so even if it's empty and unlikely someone will show up that late, we still had to honour the booking. I can understand it is frustrating to be interruped during the call, especially when you were about to end it, but kindly note our Team was only following procedures.  Thanks. Second Home Team || A great place to cowork :) bring your own laptop stand if you’re a roaming member || Hey Georgie! Thank you for your kind review, we're really glad to know you are happy with the space! || Complete lack of professionalism and respect!  I booked a tour through the website to visit the coworking space with the intention of renting an office for my company. I arrived on time (2PM) and was greeted by a staff member at reception who had a dirty, empty food plate right next to her – absolutely disgusting and completely unprofessional.  She told me to wait for another employee who would take me on the tour. I waited 15 minutes, and despite there being three employees at reception, no one bothered to assist me or even acknowledge my presence. Completely unacceptable!  After wasting my time waiting, I simply left feeling utterly disrespected. If this is their service before even becoming a customer, I can only imagine the chaos afterwards. Terrible experience, zero commitment to clients. DO NOT RECOMMEND! || Good morning Bia,   We sincerely apologize for the experience you had with us. Our reception team remembers your arrival and did ask you to wait. Unfortunately, due to an unforeseen situation that required their attention, they forgot to inform our membership team that you were already here.   We deeply regret what happened, and although mistakes can occur, we understand that this situation was completely unacceptable. This does not reflect the service we aim to provide, and we genuinely value your feedback. We would love the opportunity to make it right and would be honored to welcome you back for another tour at your earliest convenience. As a gesture of goodwill, we would like to offer you a complimentary day to experience our space again.  Thank you for your understanding, and we truly hope to have the opportunity to make it up to you.  Sincerely, Margarida || It is nice, but the rules are.....they are brainless. If you have a daily pass, your client can not visit you, even for 5 min or something. They force you to pay the higher Option to get this basic privileges. And you see a empty meeting room for like a week and you ask if you can just stay inside and make you call for 5 minutes. It is not possible, because someone booked it for a YEAR. And I am like, no one is there, just 5 minutes. No it is not possible. Sorry but I this is brainless and stupid. || Good afternoon Romik. Thank you for your feedback, we appreciate your opinion. Our clients have some benefits that come with being Second Home Members. Naturally, we need to make sure that those perks apply only to members, as those are perks of being our member. Regarding the meeting room, that room in question is booked as a private office for a whole year, so no one else but the clients that rented it are allowed to use it. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact us. || Great co-working space, no walls though, with amazing bar. || I got a day pass here and loved the setting. The desks, chairs, lighting are all mid-century. The location is excellent. Wi-fi very fast. Only problem is the high price for day pass. || Hello Leo! We are very glad to know that you enjoyed our space! We really appreciate your feedback, and will take it into consideration. Hope to see you again (: || Very disappointing for the price. I'm surprised it's so popular. Zero privacy, quite noisy, hot, no decent coffee, no complimentary fruits or anything, horrible restrooms... meeting rooms to be booked separately at extra cost. Plants are nice, but does it need to look like a forest? || A wonderful space, set in one of the best locations throughout Lisbon. Stayed here for a month in summer 2021, using a residents membership. The staff here are fantastic, and it was great getting to know other members. The events they hold are brilliant, and it was great to go surfing with the team (first time). Always quiet enough to get work done, but enough of an atmosphere to enjoy the social side of things. The team also went the extra mile to help me out with a few admin requests, which is greatly appreciated. Recommend this to anyone looking to join a co-working space in Lisbon, or even to break up the repetitiveness of working from home. || The coworking is nice but there's a construction right on front of it so the noise is horrible. I could not concentrate even with headphones. || Hi Jordana, Thank you for taking the time to write this review. I am sorry the construction noise disturbed you. We'd love to welcome you again once the construction is over so you can truly experience Second Home! Have a great day. Filipa || Very cool vibe and plants everywhere! They also seem to do a lot of community things which is great for digital nomads. Great location and really wonderful staff who are super obliging and happy to help :) || Lovely location and interiors, but they totally lost their soul and we now have moved into our own space. Three things that really bugged me were - we could not organise a company party, no dogs allowed and over time the team has became less and less friendly. || Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that you and your team no longer felt satisfied in the workspace and that Second Home was no longer able to accommodate your needs. We wish you all the best in your own new space. || Having worked out off here for years, never having a problem, I guess they’ve changed how the treat people with day passes. Very standoffish reception staff who made for a less than enjoyable day. Don’t come here if you need to get a days work done, the vibes have changed. || Hey Michael,  I am sorry you didn't enjoy your experience at Second Home on Wednesday. As you might know, we are a Members only space and from what I gathered, our Community Team was simply ensuring you had a Day Pass, giving you access to the space - being in the Market, oftentimes tourists wander up to explore the space.  Our goal is to make everyone feel welcome and at home here, so I'd love for you to give Second Home another try.  Hopefully see you again, Filipa Matos || Maybe the best experience of a modern co-work and office space. A new concept of working and collaborating together. || Very turned off by standoffish and unwelcoming sales staff. Came in with nothing but excitement to see and engage with this lovely looking coworking space in a nice and central area but the team made me feel as if I was intrusive.  I will never recommend this place to anyone in my ecosystem. Pretentious vibe, hard pass.

Great coworking space. When we visited on Friday, it was quiet. Coffee, water and fruits available. Nice and clean. The receptionist was attentive and informative. We paid 14€pp for half day. || Heden offers a great working environment! It is bright, has a great interior design and is in a top location that is well connected to public transportation. The office itself offers numerous seating and working options. Everything runs smoothly. You'll find everything you need to work productively here. The team is super friendly, helpful and very committed. In addition, there are always various events such as AfterWorks, joint breakfasts... +++ there are cute office dogs:) I would come here again and again and recommend it to anyone looking for a co-working space in Lisbon. || Great coworking with lots of seats, spacious zones. It’s right near Rossio station and in the downtown, so it’s to get there even from the outskirts of Lisbon, then wind down in local bars after work, then hop on a train or metro. Lots of secluded individual seats with power sockets. || Beautiful, clean and really comfortable space, great for group events (I attended some Inner Development Forum events), including areas for both group talks and small group discussions. || For me the best coworking in town. Spacious Very friendly staff Appliances are very comfortable Bathrooms very clean and tidy Stable internet Booth for calls (enough for everyone) Just don’t be afraid to tell some people to not take calls in the common work space (booths are everywhere) without the need to book for them in advance. || Thank you Diana! We appreciate your thoughts and hope to see you again soon. || Great coworking space! I was remote working from Lisbon and had to check out the hotel at 11am. I found this place online and went there directly. They have great internet, coffee, clean toilets with shower. It was great to spend the day working. Nice vibes as well. || Thank you Vitoria. Come visit us next time you are in town. || Great facilities, a positive vibe throughout the space, loads of natural light, and balance between getting work done and connecting with interesting people and attending events.  Many restaurants, supermarkets and transport at the doorstep is also convenient. I would recommend it. || ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️  I've been coming to Heden regularly, and it's easily one of my favourite coworking spaces in Lisbon. The atmosphere is calm and inspiring, the design is thoughtful, and the community is friendly and professional. The team is always helpful and welcoming, and the environment really helps me focus and get things done. Highly recommended, I hope Heden continues to thrive and grow! || Thank you Alex. Hope to keep seeing you around! || Very nice coworking space, well located, with sufficient seats. The only drawback is that the Internet does not work well in some areas, such as the phone booth in the upper floor near the bathrooms. Hope they fix it soon. || Hello Manuel, first of all, thanks for your feedback. As the space is big, we have different access points spread around the coworking area. Unfortunately they don't share the same network ID. Our staff usually warn our clients to connect to both networks if your intention is to move around the space and work from different areas, but in this case we probably missed it. We hope to see you again soon and make sure you are fully connected to both networks next time. || Amazing coworking jn downtown Lisbon. Great design (inside the beautiful Rossio Train Station building) high ceilings, spacious and not too loud. Acoustic booths and meeting rooms available. I particularly love the location, 5 minutes walk from Chiado where I can sort out basically everything. Good food options around.

My absolute favourite place to work in Lisbon! Giraldo Works is spacious, quiet and has so much light! The staff is amazing and the office is super well located. If I could give them more stars I would. || Your insightful and motivating comments are a true gift to us. They inspire us to evolve and hold immense importance in our journey. || The office is located in an excellent area in the heart of Lisbon: near Príncipe Real, Liberdade, Jardim Botânico, and several other points of interest in the city.  Luis, Rodrigo, and the team were super professional, responsive, helpful, and friendly in all of our interactions, from my initial questions about their services, to payment, and beyond.  Very highly recommended! || I highly recommended this space 💥 I was in Lisbon during the web summit and was looking for a coworking space for a couple of days. Giraldo Works is so well organized, the staff is very friendly and the location is great. The overall experience was fantastic 👏 … || Your encouraging words provide us with the motivation to strive for greatness. We hold your comments dear and are grateful for your consistent support. || Amazing place to work right in the middle of prime CBD Lisbon. Very professional and friendly team, highly recommended for small companies/startups or individuals who seek a good working environment on a prime location! || Your kind words inspire us to reach new heights. We cherish your comments deeply and value their impact on our journey. || Great team who are always lovely. They’ve handled my virtual office & post for nearly 3 months with no issues. Couldn’t recommend them enough :) || Thanks for the kind review Jessica! || Great location, amenities, and environment. The staff is kind and accommodating - any issue is immediately addressed. Plus: a great view over the city center. || Your thoughtful comments are invaluable to our growth. We are sincerely grateful for your support and the impact it has on our endeavours. || Amazing place to work. Very good environment, spacious and provides all the amenities needed. 100% recommend and definitely will be back || Your feedback is like a guiding light, illuminating our path to success. Your comments are treasured and contribute significantly to our development. || Great place, they help you with everything and every step of the way. The people are extremely friendly and patient, would definitely recommend to others. || Your opinion is very important to us, as it guides us towards excellence. Thank you very much for your commitment. || The space was great! It was very clean and well-organized, and the staff was friendly and helpful. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a place to work. || The staff is incredible! Very spacious and comfortable place to work. I strongly recommend it for anyone looking for a nice place to work. || We are genuinely grateful for your thoughtful comments. They fuel our growth and carry immense importance to us.

Amazing location and space! A great space to work, meet likeminded entrepeneurs and network 👌🏼 … || I really enjoyed my day working in sitio Rossio! The space is very beautiful and welcoming, located right in Rossio square, so very pratical. It has several phone booths and all the amenities needed. Staff was super helpful too! Definetely recommend! || Crazy good location and space! Been to a lot of coworking spaces in Lisbon and this is definitely among my favorite, definitely recommend it || Really nice co-working and very well located. 5 min form many metro stations || Very pleasant place to work and great location. || New co-working space right at the city center, calm, new instalations, has phone boots and nice coffee. :) Perfect location for me. || The place is amazing. || Very comfortable coworking space, with an excellent location and good access. I recommend it :)

place_name: Tribe Social Club - Cowork, Bar, Events
reviews_content: Just went to a People of Lisbon event. What a place. Great ambient, good decoration and also furniture. First time ever in my life that I did speed networking.  I hope it becomes a thing!  Perfect place to celebrate your birthday or to host any type of event.  Def recommend!  It also has an amazing view, and it's in the epicenter of nightlife. || When I first landed on October 12, I was running around trying to find a place to work from. My friend Jennifer told me to check out Tribe, so one day while I was out exploring, I decided to stop by. That’s when I met Vickey he showed me around with such a calm, kind energy that I instantly felt comfortable. I signed up for a membership that same night and started the next day. reviews_content: One of the first fixed desk member and no regret ! After testing different co works in Lisbon, I fell in love with A Dama Rosa. The high ceilings, the location on the Principe Real square,  the decoration as if you worked from your private palace, the view, the sun on the terrace for every break and most especially the warmth greetings of Camille, the manager. Thank you Camille for creating this space and fulfilling my work dynamism for me and my team ! || My team and I occupied the lovely 'Loft' space for our work retreat. Lovely airy space with great furnishings, perfect for both group presentations and for the team to splinter off into small groups. The views of Lisbon from the windows were amazing too —  and the workspace looks over a gorgeous park we spent every lunch in. Camille provided a great service for us, and even sorted some delicious catering for the team. Thank you Camille and team A Dama Rosa! || Amazing spot, really! I was in Lisbon for a day and had to work from somewhere and this place was awesome! The atmosphere is very nice, there are permanent members and others just for a day. The location is stunning (literally a palace with a terrasse with the view of Lisbon and the bridge). Camille, who runs the place is super nice, super helpful. || Friendly coworking space in a large beautiful grand old Portuguese home, with a real community feel. Central location so easy access and startup friendly pricing! || We spent a couple of weeks working from here on a working holiday and it was a great spot. Very calm atmosphere, in an interesting building and in a nice area of town. || Perfect space to work, very nice atmosphere and the general manager is so welcoming. The terrasse is amazing, beautiful view! || I absolutely adore this space. Very nice and relaxed atmosphere. Top location as well. 5/5 || Lovely space with a very nice athmosphere, a lot of social life, and an amazing terrasse! || First hot-desk member @ A DAMA ROSA ! A Shiny and peaceful coworking space in the center of Lisbon ☀️ || Awesome location, great environment and good people. Excellent to make connections while enjoying the unique neighborhood.

Great location in the heart of Lisbon! The space is modern, clean, and well-equipped. The staff are friendly and helpful. Convenient access to public transport and local amenities. Highly recommended! || A perfectly authentic place to work in along with desires to fulfill the requirements of the co-workers. A simple yet mesmerizing environment where anyone would enjoy working to their greatest potential👍 … || thank you for your review || This co-working area exceeded my expectations in every aspect. As such, I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a professional and comfortable workspace. || Professionalism in a people friendly environment where attention to detail and comfort is paramount. Highly recommended as a venue that ticks all the boxes. || thank you for your awesome review. || Beautiful office space and great staff support! Very accessible and good amenities including fast internet. || Friendly atmosphere..very accommodating...spacious... And wow lovely recreation area ...will highly recommend || A great and pleasent atmosphere. Liked everything about it. || Just ring and enjoy ;-) || Prestige location and good vibe || Even in the most central area of ​​Lisbon, next to Marquês de Pombal. Several rooms are available for us to hold meetings with our clients, or for coworking, a young, modern and well-equipped environment. We are greeted by a friendly and very helpful team. Close to public transport, which I recommend, given the parking constraints in the center of Lisbon. I highly recommend it! || Thank you for your informative review. || A highly professional team, always available and attentive, the ideal space, well located, well decorated, always complying with hygiene standards, I recommend it. || We've been there with our team on several occasions and the service has always been exceptional. Good location, very friendly and well-presented staff, the office is always clean, the equipment is very good, and the booking process is very easy to complete. 100% recommended. || Thank you for your generous review we aim to please and prioritize customer service. || Excellent location, fast and efficient service. I recommend it.

Hyggelig isn't just another co-working space in Lisbon; it's the one I'd pick any day for its awesome vibe and top-notch facilities. It's got this cool, homey feel that makes working remotely a breeze, and let's not forget about those comfy chairs and super handy electric standing desks.  What's really neat about Hyggelig is how it's all about giving remote workers a spot that feels both professional and snug, like your favorite coffee shop but with way better desks. Speaking of which, those standing desks are a game-changer – they're perfect when you need to stretch your legs after hours of sitting.  The crowd here is mostly long-term folks, which is great if you're into getting into a solid work groove. Everyone's super friendly and interesting, so you're bound to bump into someone who's up for a chat or a brainstorm session.  The heart and soul of the place is Nikolaj, the owner. He's a genuinely great guy who made sure I felt right at home from day one. He's all about making sure everyone gets to know each other, which really helps in striking up conversations and feeling part of the gang.  Bottom line: If you're after a place in Lisbon that's more than just a desk and Wi-Fi, where you can settle in and find your work rhythm, Hyggelig's the spot. Trust me, it's a cut above the rest. || Hi Zaid. Thank you very much for your kind words, hope to see you again when you come back to Lisbon! || Hyggelig  is great!  Everyone gets an electric height adjustable standing desk. They are by far the best working spaces of all the co-works I've tried in Lisbon. The seats are also good and comfortable.  The co-work has a kitchen and showers onsite as well which is great. I love the location as it's really close to Intendente, Graca and Alfama which are my favourite areas in the city.  Nik and the other coworkers have created a really fun,  professional vibe. Everyone is up for an ice cream or a drink after work. || Thank you for your great review. We always enjoy when you are back for a visit in Lisbon. || I have only good words to define this cowork.  The owner Nik created this space with a philosophy and vision that is much more focused on quality and healthy space rather than just a Wi-Fi (that is super fast by the way).  The environment is quiet but friendly.  The quality is the absolute best in Lisbon - motorized desks - very comfortable chairs - stoves and super-equipped kitchen with much more included.  You just have to schedule a visit. || Thank you very much for your kind feedback. We really enjoy having you here. || Cozy and welcoming coworking office, luminous and well equipped, with very friendly members and owner. Perfect even as a longer-term choice for freelancers with flexible calendars but with the need of something more stable.    Highly recommended || One of the best coworking spaces I have visited in Portugal. The environment is very friendly and you know everyone. I found it very good that you were integrated right away. I also found the idea of having a Slack group very funny, where you exchanged information (for instance if you would join for lunch etc). The motorized tables that you could move up and down were also a highlight. All in all, I can highly recommend it. Nick thank you for your host :) || Thank you for your kind words. Hope to see you back one day! || What a solid space. 5 years remote and this is a top 3 space. Really calm, friendly community. They do a day trial and if you like it a monthly pass - quality stand/sit desks, chairs and lighting as well. Highly reccomend! || Thank you for the kind words. Loved to have you here and hope to see you again soon. || Hyggelig is a very nice place to work ! Located close to the metro station, it is a small, quiet and peaceful work area. There are several rooms where you can find adjustable desks and comfortable chairs. The kitchen is well equiped. The team there is very welcoming and organizes regularly lunches and after-works. I highly recommend ! || Thank you very much for the kind words. Hope to see you here again some time! || Hyggelig is a great coworking space for the following reasons: -height adjustable standing desks by Flexispot -rooms for quiet work and seperate rooms from which you can work from if you get many calls or have lots of meetings -room/space to have a meeting on your own as well  Also there is a nicely and fully equipped kitchen and social room(s). Speaking of social, you can always find someone to go out for lunch with. The rooms are very bright, even when I worked here in November. If you open a window on a sunny day, it is not very loud in the street next to it even though it is very close to the tram line up the hill.  I can only recommend this place - it really is as hygge as the name suggests! || Thank you very much for your kind words. || I’ve been going to Hyggelig for a few weeks now and it’s great – from the other workers, facilities, equipment, and the management. It’s a great community vibe which is invaluable if you’re passing through Lisbon or building something long term. Very happy for such a welcoming experience by very lovely people – easily recommend. || Thank you very much, it is a pleasure to have you here! || Great coworking space: easy going people, good chairs and tables, good wi-fi, beers on Friday evening. Great community! || Thanks for joining our workspace, even though it was just for a short period. || The only thing I didn't like was the noise from the traffic when the windows are open. Apart from that, this is way better than any other coowork I've tried in the surroundings. || Nice place to work compared to a lot of places in Lisbon that I trialed. I get a lot of things done here and everyone is nice. || Nice new co-work really close by the Intendente square. Motorized desks as standard and free biscuits, who could want more! || Thanks for your nice feedback. We are always ready with cookies for our resident cookiemonster! || Cozy coworking space living up to its name. Flexible plans. || Thank you for your nice review. || Nice co-working space in central Lisbon! || Thank you very much Nicklas. Always pleasant to have you in! || That's not my cup of tea. || Hello Paula. I don't think we have seen you here at our office. But your are welcome to come by for a free trial day.

The most delicious coffee in Lisbon - with a cozy atmosphere, beautiful lighting, and my favorite music. Laptops are welcome, and there’s plenty of space inside. It’s our favorite spot to enjoy a coffee, hang out, meet friends, or even host a photography workshop. Thank you for being here🧡 || My favorite spot in Lisbon to sit down with a great coffee, enjoy a pastry, and get some work done. It tends to attract an international, digital-nomad crowd, which gives the space a creative feel.  The staff is always kind, the space feels cozy, and the music is consistently great. If you plan to stay for a while, it’s nice to keep supporting the café by ordering throughout the day :) || Nice interior and the avocado toast was good, but ridiculously expensive and was served after 30 min of waiting although the cafe was pretty empty.  Most of all, the staff was unfortunately very rude. With a very passive attitude they made me feel like I was bothering them.  With the amount of good coffee places in Lisbon, I for sure do recommend going to another one than this. || Love this place!!! The environment is fantastic—comfortable, quiet, and perfect for productivity. || Cozy, friendly coffe place with an excelent coffee and coworking space in the back. The coworking part has tons of natural light, with a very fast internet and while working there I noticed there's a community of people who know each other and come working there on regular basis.

Shared a 2 twin room with a friend. Overall, for the price (one of the cheapest private rooms in Lisbon), it was a good experience - exceeding my expectations. Room was clean and reasonably spacious with a balcony and a fan. We kept the door open anytime we were in the room to cool and help with air circulation (30c+ every day). 3 bathrooms for 5 rooms on the floor was not a bad ratio. Showers were a bit small but on par with other Portuguese accommodations. Bathrooms were reasonably clean, there was free laundry, a nice view from our balcony. I had a few chats with some floormates but didn't find the vibe in the co-living exceptionally social. Location was excellent - we loved the Cais do Sodre area - so much to see. || Thanks so much for taking the time to leave a review, Catherine! We're so happy to hear your stay exceeded your expectations. We'd be happy to welcome you back again soon. || My stay at Outsite Lisbon was average. I really liked the area. Cais do Sodré is a neighborhood full of cafés and well connected to the rest of the city, so location is great in my opinion. The ambiance in the coliving itself, however, felt … || It was the worst room I’ve stayed in over the last 5 years. The entire 4th floor smelled strongly of mold. We were all complaining and asking for help, but nobody did anything for us. The community manager was like a ghost — I didn’t see him once during my 13 days in Lisbon. Please consider replacing Sebastian, as he was completely absent || Stayed here with my daughter as she was working. This place is fabulous, esp the community they create for single people. Cafe down stairs was perfect for me to work in as well. Awesome concept || Thanks so much for leaving us a review! So happy to hear that you enjoyed your stay and the Outsite concept! We'd be happy to welcome you back again soon. || Not great, I checked out early and went to stay somewhere else - the only time I've ever done that. Noisy, hot, bathroom a bit grim, extremely hands-off community management. It's an old building in the wrong sort of location for coliving. I expect their other site is better! The co-working is nice though. || Hi Joe,   Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We're sorry to hear that your stay with us didn't meet your expectations.  We understand that arriving during Lisbon’s lively June festivities and staying in a street-facing room impacted your experience, especially with the noise. Unfortunately, as we were fully booked, we couldn’t offer a quieter room until later in your stay, but we respect your decision to check out early.  We appreciated your calm and courteous communication throughout and were happy to refund the extra guest charge as a gesture of goodwill. While we wish we had the chance to show you a more comfortable experience, we’re glad you enjoyed the coworking space and hope you might consider visiting one of our other locations in the future, which may better suit your preferences.  Wishing you all the best on your travels, Outsite || I was just passing by this cute coffee shop in Cais do Sodre. I got in to buy a cup of macchiato with oat milk to go.  Luckily I was attended by Esperanza. To my surprise she was also Chilean as me which made our encounter funnier and nostalgic.  I left the place with a smile upon my face. However, I wasn’t prepared for the quality of the beverage she made; a macchiato with perfect proportions of coffee and oat milk, strong and tasty.  My walk experience through the streets of Lisbon with my coffee in hand was utterly fabulous and comforting.  Thank you Outsite Lisbon and Esperanza for the incredible coffee and service. || Thanks so much for stopping by! We're so glad to hear you had a great experience at the Outsite Cowork Cafe in Lisbon. || Really good place and coworking. The appliances in shared area are really worn out (laundry is literally falling apart in front of you). There are some loud clubs or cafes nearby, so, it can get loud at night. But overall, I loved the place. || Thanks for leaving us your review and feedback. We're looking to do some upgrade and the laundry would be great to update. I'll share that with the operations team. Our very central location is a a great base to explore the city from, but we apologize if it was a bit noisy. We'd be happy to welcome you back again soon. || Had an amazing stay at Outsite! As a digital entrepreneur running a marketing agency it’s super important to me to find places to stay that give me the space to work. This one also came with an amazing community, cafe to work in and I was able to network and meet a ton of people! || Thanks so much for leaving a review, Danielle. It was my first coliving experience and first time living abroad so naturally there were a few adjustments. However, once I settled in it became my … || I really enjoyed my stay overall here - the location is really in the center of the action. The accommodation itself has areas for improvement. Each floor has a separate living area that’s not really used so there isn’t much mingling happening in the building. The rooms themselves … if you book anything other than a room with a balcony, good luck. The private queen with private washroom on the fourth floor doesn’t have a fan installed, only a portable floor fan (that’s super noisy if on max) - there’s also no ventilation because there are no windows so it has a strange odour. It’s fine if you’re there for a few short days but less than a week for sure. The community manager, Inês, is a gem. She’s super welcoming, friendly, and really does a great job bringing us together by organizing dinners as well as sharing suggestions for things to do throughout the week. || Hey Jessica, thanks so much for leaving us a review. I wanted to thank you for your feedback and let you know actually stopped renting that room and it's closed until we can find a better solution for it. Appreciate the review and feedback. We hope to see you back again soon.

Eduardo VII Park is one of the most beautiful and relaxing green spaces in Lisbon. The park offers stunning panoramic views over the city and the Tagus River, making it a perfect spot for photos, walks, or simply enjoying the scenery. The wide paths are ideal for walking or jogging, and the well-maintained gardens add a peaceful atmosphere away from the busy city streets. One of the highlights is the impressive geometric garden design and the viewpoint at the top of the park, which provides a breathtaking perspective of Lisbon. The park is also very spacious, so it never feels overcrowded, even during busy hours. There are benches throughout the area, perfect for resting and enjoying the surroundings. Eduardo VII Park is great for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. It’s close to the city center and easy to access, making it a must-visit for anyone exploring Lisbon. Whether you’re looking for a quiet place to relax, take a walk, or admire the city from above, this park is definitely worth a visit. || We were in Lisbon for several days while waiting to start a cruise with NCL.  We stopped at the north end of this magnificent park and walk all the way to the southern end.  Lots of great views and spots for wonderful pics.  Several monuments along the way. || Parque Eduardo VII is a beautiful park with stunning views of the city and the river. It's beautifully maintained, with plenty of greenery and spacious walkways. It's a great place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city, take beautiful photos, and simply enjoy the atmosphere. A must-see if you're in Lisbon. || It's quite an amazing space. Whether it's chilling, or events, or testing your photographic prowess, it fits the bill. There are usually tourists and residents generally around, and it's more lively during celebrations like Christmas. || It's a very beautiful and large park, perfect for a peaceful walk surrounded by nature. The view from the top of the park is spectacular. Depending on the time of year, there may be more or fewer tourists. On a sunny day with good weather, it's well worth a visit. || A great view of Lisbon from here, you can see the whole layout and scale looking down towards the river. Relaxed and friendly atmosphere as you view the scenery and monuments. You also get an excellent view of the planes coming into Lisbon. || A beautiful public park in Lisbon, Portugal with great views over the city. The top is great for photos. Good for a walk, sit and have lunch or a drink, or have your dog play around. || Wonderful Christmas Atmosphere! We visited Parque Eduardo VII during the Christmas season, and it was a fantastic experience. The Christmas market (Wonderland Lisboa) created such a pleasant and fun atmosphere. It’s a great spot, especially for young people and families, with plenty of amusement park rides, games, and festive food stalls. The park itself is beautiful, and the view from the top is breathtaking. Highly recommended if you are in Lisbon during the holidays! || Parque Eduardo VII is one of the best spots in Lisbon to enjoy a peaceful walk and take in a great view of the city. From the top of the park, you can see all the way down to the river and the Praça Marquês de Pombal. It’s a lovely place to relax, especially at sunset. The park is also very close to El Corte Inglés, so it’s easy to combine a visit with some shopping or a coffee break nearby. || What a great parque / jardim in central Lisbon. place_name: Garden of the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation
reviews_content: Such a lovely garden full of paths and little bridges and loads of seating in the shade and great fun to explore and some statues too and we saw a heron and lots of ducks.  The amphitheatre was a real surprise too || Beautiful garden with long bamboo passage ways, a pond with lots of cute ducks, a small area to eat ice cream or coffee and a large area great for dogs. This is a great place to go on a walk with friends or go on a study session. Everything is full of vegetation and butterflies. Like an actual 'secret garden'. If you like fantasy books this is your place to go because it looks like a place in a fairytale. I cannot recommend this garden enough, especially for outdoor lovers. My description doesn't give this place enough justice. || This place is part of a foundation started by Calouste Gulbenkian, an Armenian oil tycoon and art lover. You can really feel his belief that “art is for everyone, and beauty means more when it’s shared.”  Right in the middle of the city, there’s this peaceful garden with tall trees, calm ponds, and quiet paths. I could take my time and enjoy the art without any rush. The way nature and art come together here left such a strong impression. || A very lovely garden, located in the center of the city. It’s super convenient to visit either by metro or different bus networks. Here, it’s more like a combination of different gardens, so there are lots of options to enjoy the sun, green, and overall atmosphere. Totally recommended to visit, including the museum inside. || Gorgeous space for all to enjoy for free - lots of areas to picnic, hang with friends, for kids to run around or bike, easy for strollers to get around. There are also two cafes and an ice cream shop - you can spend a whole day enjoying this beautifully maintained space. There must be a mighty team of gardeners tending to all the plants! What a valuable space for residents and visitors alike in this otherwise very densely developed city. || Gulbenkian always had beautiful gardens, around the museums buildings. Landscaping as Portuguese know how ! Now that the renovation of the modern museum is achieved, there is a new setting of this side of the gardens to discover, mix of Japanese zen design, existing garden style and a monumental, yet perfectly integrated awning. Inspiring place where to wander, with cafe and sometimes outdoor activities at the amphitheatre. Just mind the rush hours and some week-end can be crowded, as this place is since long praized by Portuguese and tourists ! || My primary objective was to visit the museum; however, due to renovations, the collection had been relocated.  I was disappointed by the limited number of items, particularly paintings, compared to my expectations. Nonetheless, the collection was aesthetically pleasing and unique.  The garden, however, was unappealing.  Perhaps I mistakenly visited the incorrect park, as signage was inadequate, requiring extensive navigation to locate the proper entrance. || Big enough to wander around. The noise of the city suddenly stops and everything becomes cooler. Part of it is like a jungle. Lots of people either solo or couples and a lot of families with small children. It is a really special place || Designed in the 1960s by Gonçalo Ribeiro Telles and António Viana Barreto, the garden is a beautifully landscaped urban oasis in the heart of Lisbon. The space features a harmonious blend of lakes, streams, terraced lawns, and forested paths—creating a tranquil environment for relaxation and reflection. The garden connects seamlessly with the main Gulbenkian Foundation building and museum, allowing visitors to experience art, architecture, and nature in one integrated setting. || Quiet, cozy park perfect for rest, private conversation with a friend or relaxation! || Best place to hide when it is very hot. There are lots of nice shaded banks to sit and rest under the trees. || Lovely place to escape the bustle of Lisbon for some hours, still in the middle of the city. Grab a picnic towel, a book and sunscreen and lay down for the afternoon. The grass field in the garden is lovely to get some sun light. Even in winter. || A really nice place to wander around, there's lots of corners tucked away if you want to sit by yourself or have a conversation. And they have ducks! || Well-known park in Lisbon where people go to just hang-out, relax, create, work and have a love/get out of here relationship with all the ducks! The museum offers a lot of commodities as well and many times have free entry events :) || So relaxing to walk the grounds of the garden. There are shady as well as sunny areas depending on what you prefer and a cafe for your meals. The ducks and the water areas make it even more attractive. Unfortunately a large part of the grounds are under renovation, so we couldn’t walk there. Still, the air is crisp and the garden is well maintained for visitors. || One of the most gorgeous public gardens I've been to with stunning art, landscaping, plants and wildlife. They are doing extensive renovation in a section of it so it's blocked off (and will be incredible once done) but there's still plenty of areas to wander on paths, sit on benches, grab something at cafe and sit outside and enjoy the birds. I brought my camera and had so much fun capturing images of the Spring babies. Truly a remarkable place for all to enjoy. || A perl in the city of Lisbon. Strongly suggested if you have any minimal appreciation for plants and greenery. They have three great greenhouses with a wide variety of plants from all-over the planet. Hábito Café is an absolute gem in the heart of Beato! ✨ The moment you walk in, you’re greeted by a cozy and stylish atmosphere — the kind of place that instantly makes you want to slow down and enjoy the moment. The coffee is excellent — smooth, rich, and clearly made with care. You can tell the baristas really know their craft and take pride in what they do.  The staff are super friendly and welcoming, always ready with a smile or a recommendation. It’s the perfect spot whether you’re meeting friends, working on your laptop, or just enjoying some quiet time with a good book.  Their pastries and snacks are delicious too — fresh, tasty, and beautifully presented. Combined with the calm vibe of Beato, Hábito Café is one of those cafés you end up coming back to again and again.  Highly recommend to anyone who loves good coffee, good people, and a good atmosphere. ☕💛 || My favorite cafe in the neighborhood. Very friendly and super nice owners. Great food- aspecialy the Momos and Portuguese burger. This Library is usually empty, but with few seats, only eight. Comfortable chairs and tables, free wifi, natural and artificial illumination. Recommended for Master and PhD students. Why not Five Stars? Because of the number of seats. || It is small and cozy and it has a children's corner || In addition to the excellent titles available, the library offers an excellent cultural program.

Had a lovely experience here! The woman at the desk outside of the reading room whom helped me get my card was so lovely and kind. I wish I would have thanked her properly before leaving Portugal! As a foreigner with little verbal Portuguese researching the English fragments of Pessoa’s Archived manuscripts, I was nervous about getting access to the library - but she was so welcoming! The security at the front desk also were kind and described how everything worked with the lockers well! The space is very nice. || Oops, thought biblioteca meant bookstore but it means library. Apparently it is not somehow allowed inside the library. || The Receiptionist/Security was kind with great customer service. Nice library, with different rooms on different styles. It appears small from outside but it was very nice and big inside. || A great place to study overall, but the security guards are some of the rudest people I ever met. It is furnished with new desks, chairs, lights and a lot of … || This is a treasure! You can enter for free, have a look and enjoy the first and second floors of the library in the historical building and interiors. Very nice space for kids and friendly staff. A must visit if you love books and history. || Beautiful library with a good number of desks for studying, but the wifi makes internet use frustratingly difficult (the DNS connection drops for 5-10 seconds every minute) and therefore not great for working on a laptop. If they fixed the unreliable wifi, this place would be an easy 5/5 stars. || Mixed reviews. I have been twice now as I like going to the library to get books. The first time the staff was so nice and helpful to get me a library card and help me figure out things. The next time, there was a school in the room with … || Beautiful library with a large variety of books and an impressive selection of places to sit and work or read. Desks and seating are exactly how a library in the 21 century should be. Staff are all calm and welcoming. Toilets are kept spotless and clean. There's heating in the winter and air con in summer. A wonderful … || This is by far the best place to work in Lisbon. It's clean, quiet and beautiful... I would only like that it would open at 9.00... These wonderful places should be available for people as much as they can... || There are so many tables and chairs you can sit in, complete with power points. Went in today and the security guy rushed us out saying that the place closes at 18:45 when the website says 19:00. No air conditioning so it was hot, and the books are poorly organized downstairs. I prefer the blx location in marvila and probably won't be coming back here again. || Stunning library in a former palace. Plenty of study space. || Extremely friendly and helpful staff that spoke excellent English to help me. It's a large room, so users have to respect each other, and thankfully that's what happens every time I go. Congratulations and thank you! || The former Cinema Europa, now a library, was inaugurated in 1958, featuring a high-relief sculpture on its facade by the sculptor Euclides Vaz. … || I visited the Cinema Europa Library/Cultural Space in Campo de Ourique during a book presentation. A welcoming place, well-organized, with great facilities! I highly recommend it! 📚 📖 🖊 … || Presentation of the poetry book 'On the Other Side of the Street' by Sara Pereira. Available for purchase at the Ler bookstore in Campo de Ourique. || I've never seen a library like this. Among friends, we call it "the crazy people's library" because it's full of people every day who make noise, take up seats, sleep, snore, bother others, smell bad, etc. Whenever I tell acquaintances … || A calm, quiet space that's ideal for reading and studying. It was a magnificent idea that … || Excellent space for borrowing books, studying, and even drafting work. Good facilities and very efficient and helpful staff. Campo de Ourique has needed a space like this for quite some time. … || I found it very inspiring for anyone who enjoys reading or interacting. Very organized and with a very pleasant atmosphere. All the best to the library team, Teresa Alves || A very pleasant place where you can read (books and daily newspapers), connect your computer, or use the computers available there.
