It has an area for studying, browsing books or using computers in silence, and a children's area where kids and teenagers can play, read books on beanbag chairs, play PlayStation, watch movies, and use computers or iPads! A visit to this place is highly recommended! || Well-lit space with adequate technical support and very efficient service. Networked with the LX Libraries and always full.

It is a nice and quiet place to work. It has bathrooms and a living room. In addition, one can go out for fresh air and return without problem. || Small but very comfortable library. Good place to do some work. Air conditioned and very clean place. || A very pleasant experience. I went there looking for some books and the librarian, Conceição, was extremely attentive and professional. I recommend her! || The Penha de França Library is a very pleasant place because its staff are very competent people who make the activities very interesting. They are very proactive, communicative, and have a great disposition that makes us feel very comfortable. In this place, I feel at home. || Great library, quiet space and very friendly staff! It's possible to use the computers and access the Wi-Fi without paying anything and without registering. || An excellent library, with plenty of light, lots of space, and very friendly staff. A great place to research and study. Wi-Fi is available, and it's possible to borrow books to read at home (except for some reserved items). It's also possible to request books from other municipal libraries. || The entire library is recently renovated, from its infrastructure to its technological equipment. It has a room with access to laptops and internet. || Great selection of books and a very airy and organized environment!!! || Attention: INCORRECT HOURS. Closed on Mondays and Saturdays. || Great location, friendly staff.

The Museum of Illusions in Lisbon is a nice place to visit, especially if you’re looking for something fun and a bit different. Some of the illusions are really clever and make you stop for a moment to figure out how they work. The whole museum is not very big, so you can go through it quite fast, but it’s still enjoyable.  It’s a good spot for kids because they can interact with a lot of things and take fun photos. Adults will also find a few rooms and tricks quite interesting. Overall, it’s a quick and enjoyable visit, and worth passing by if you’re nearby or looking for something entertaining to do. || Hi Kinan,  Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review! 😊 We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the clever illusions, the interactive elements, and the fun photo opportunities — and thank you as well for sharing your photos, they look great! While the museum can be explored relatively quickly depending on the pace, we’re glad you still found it entertaining and worthwhile.  Thanks again for visiting and for capturing such nice moments with us! || Omg what a gem this place is. It's sooo quirky and interesting absolutely worth a visit. I'm soo glad we went and ignored the negative reviews. The staff are soo engaging,  soo polite soo helpful. We had a wonderful visit thank you. If your contemplating going don't think any longer just get going! Pink street is a 10 min walk away for after you've seen this amazing place! || Hi Sasha,  Wow! Thank you so much for your amazing review! 😊 We’re absolutely delighted that you enjoyed your visit and appreciated the quirky illusions and our friendly team. Your kind words mean a lot to us, and it’s wonderful to know you decided to come despite the mixed reviews — we’re so glad it was worth it!  Enjoy the Pink Street and the rest of your time in Lisbon! || Loved it! Was a really fun (although short) time. The museum is not big, so it took us 50 minutes to do the full tour and re-do some of the activities || This place is amazing. Lots of staff around to answer any questions and take photos if you are a solo traveler. Definitely worth the entrance fee and definitely worth visiting. || Hi Luke,  Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed the museum and that our team could help make your visit enjoyable, even as a solo traveler. Your kind words about the experience and value mean a lot to us! || The Museum is a chain around the world. They are all similar in layout as there are only so many optical illusions out there. The cost for a family of four was 47€, which considering you can only spend about 20 minutes looking over the exhibits, is a fairly high price. However, if you have young children, they will be amazed at some of the illusions they’ll see. There is even a gift shop at the end where you can bring home brain-twister toys or souvenirs to remember your visit. Recommend if you’re looking to get out of the heat for 30 minutes, just don’t expect an entire afternoon here! || Hi Mo, Thank you very much for your visit, your review. We're glad your family had a good time 😊 … || Very fun and informative place, the museum is interactive and is suited for taking pictures, whilst still being a great place to go just to see the illusions. There are many activities and illusions and great photo ops. || Hi Inf,  Thank you so much for your fantastic review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you found the museum both fun and informative, and that you enjoyed the interactive illusions and photo opportunities. It’s wonderful to know you appreciated the experience from every angle! || I'm sorry. There was no one at the entrance. There were 55 minutes left before closing. Little girl was crying. They didn't let us in. Ridiculous!! change your way. staff to be trained.  in other European cities, different treatment. || Hi Mone,  Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re truly sorry for the frustration you experienced, especially with a child involved. We understand how disappointing that must have felt.  However, we’d like to clarify that we cannot allow new entries after a certain cutoff time before closing. This is to ensure every visitor has enough time to enjoy the full experience safely and comfortably. Our ticketing system automatically blocks sales and entry after this time, precisely to avoid situations where guests would not be able to complete the visit properly.  We’re sorry for the inconvenience this caused and appreciate your understanding. If you’re still interested in visiting, we’d love to welcome you back during opening hours so you can fully enjoy the museum experience. || Great experience with the family, fun photo opportunities, great to get out of the heat and explore. || Hi Panit, Thank you so much for your kind review! 😊 We’re delighted you and your family had a great time, enjoyed the photo opportunities, and found the museum a nice escape from the heat. … || Very funny, mindblowing for the brains of young and old. Emplyees friendly and willing to explain || Hi Annegreet,  Thank you so much for your lovely review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you found the experience funny and mind-blowing for both young and old. Our team will be very happy to know their friendliness and explanations helped make your visit even better! || I found this so fun and enjoyed this interactive and interesting experience, the Illusions are great, get fab photos while learning and have a good laugh. The staff were super friendly and helped take photos of us. When we went, the morning slot was full, so we had to wait around half hour till next slot, which was fine as the museum is in such a main area you can easily wonder round, have a coffee or snack near by, for example. || Hi Jennifer,  Thank you so much for your fantastic and detailed review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear that you found the experience fun, interactive, and interesting — and that you enjoyed the illusions, the laughs, and the photo opportunities. It’s also wonderful to know our team helped make your visit even better with their friendliness and support with photos.  Thank you as well for your understanding regarding the short wait between slots — we really appreciate your patience, and you’re right, the central location does make it easier to enjoy the surroundings in the meantime.  We’re really happy you had such a great time with us!

Wonderful experience, art and nature collide.  Wonderful to walk through the garden, have a coffee at the cafe and appreciate the museum and its beauty. What a combination || One of the most pleasant places in Lisbon to read and do research. Some negative comments came to me as a surprise. Not being an art student was never an issue to me for not having access or for not doing research or just reading any of their books. It’s a private Art Library, not a coffee shop or a study room or a University Library. It serves quite well its purpose and hope it stays like that. || I don’t understand the bad reviews, maybe people forget it’s not a public library so they have their own rules. I think it’s an amazing place, the staff is helpful, and put at your disposal an extensive catalogue of material. Plus, a very handy cafeteria with delicious food is just next door to get you through the breaks. Very quiet, something quite unusual in Lisbon libraries according to my experience. Thanks for your service! || Apparently arts students are too good to have other students use their space; I find it unbelievable that all other libraries don’t restrict student access given their field of study, but Gulbenkian library does. || It is a "very" small art library which is quiet and with a fine view to the garden. I think considering how small the space is  it is fair that only people connected to arts could use it. Very close by there is a large and beautiful public library that can accomodate much more people. It is called  Biblioteca Palácio Galveias located in Campo Pequeno. Check it out! || To access the library you need to slay a dragon, find the Philosophers’s stone and save Middle Earth from the forces of Sauron. Ugly dark library. Extremely exclusive for art researchers, even difficult to get in as an art student. Conclusion: elitist policy strengthening Portugal's extremely unequal society. NO ACCESS FOR THE MANY. Farewell, never again || So many amazing pieces of art. Wonderful experience. Recomemd leaving plenty of time as you will be lost in wonders of the great masters. Well worth a visit. || Basically is a great place with sun and large garden , the issue is students out of ART Spesialty are not allowed to study in the bibliothec, which is not fair at all regarding a student life , overall the woman that works there claimed that is the case since 2016/ 17 , hopefully it will change soon !? || U have to study ART to have access to this library!  such a thing... reviews_content: A free library in a fantastic place. Librarians are very kind. They also do art exhibitions and readings. There’s wifi || This was my first time learning about Mario Dionisio. reviews_content: Opened in 1955, this traditional bookstore has a peaceful place with its furniture and atmosphere while wandering among the books. In addition to various books in different languages, there are also different things such as puzzles and notebooks. There are also areas where you can sit to read a book inside and in the backyards.  It's caught our attention with a great puzzle about James Joyce, which we saw in the window as we passed by. The variety of books inside was so high quality that we spent a lot of time. The gentleman working was very kind and caring. We bought puzzle and some small notebooks. || Thank you for rating and recommending us. Your opinion helps motivate us to continue offering a service that meets our customers' expectations. Happy reading! || One of the most beautiful bookstores I've ever visited. If you love books and spaces with history this is a mandatory visit || Your praise reinforces our commitment to offering quality and excellence at all times. Thank you for sharing your experience. || Pleasant  bookstore with varieties of book and comfortable automosphere. You can even find several chairs inside for reading and they also have a beautiful garden in  back, a Japanese style to me ,esp that small red bridge.  One of the books I want is not available but they said I can order then fetch the book in 4-5days but luckily I got another one--Tao Te King. || Thank you for giving our bookstore a positive review. We are delighted to hear that you had a positive experience with us. Your feedback is very important to us. || A good selection of books, a pleasant place || Your praise is an incentive for us to continue building lasting relationships with our customers. We greatly value the trust you have placed in our service. || Gorgeous bookshop. Staff were friendly and helpful when asked for recommendations. I hope that the sculpture you bought in my gallery gives you a lot of happiness.  Best regards, Greta Balín, curator. || I bought a beautiful acrylic on canvas by artist Monica Silva from Art Gallery The One in Lisbon. It was delivered to me via DHL on Feb. 29, 2024.  Greta the curator was delightful to deal with on the purchase, and the Gallery is very nicely done.  After that, however, things went bad and the gallery refused to make them right.  In mid-August I noticed that the artwork had started to bulge, from the lower left corner all the way up to the top right corner.  I notified the gallery of the situation and sent photos on August 15.  Greta responded that the canvas might have loosened over time, causing the bulge, and  recommended taking the artwork to a professional framing store where they can restretch the canvas to its original state.  I brought it in two weeks ago, and upon examination the framer found that the stretcher bars (or spreader bars) were cut wrong and therefore could not create tension and a good stretch.  Specifically the lip was on the inner edge instead of where it was supposed to be.  The framer said he does not normally see artwork brought in like this.  In summary, the canvas was attached to the bars wrong and it was a problem just waiting to happen.  Since it wasn’t just the canvas that had to be restretched but the bars rebuilt, this turned out to be a costly repair project.  I forwarded the receipt to Greta, along with videos from the framer detailing the problem and showing the wrongly made stretcher bars and where the lip was.  Greta’s response was that the reimbursement is not approved and that while she understands my experience and appreciates the details provided, including the framer’s observations, each piece is thoroughly inspected prior to delivery to ensure its quality.  Responsibility for subsequent adjustments to framing of presentation typically falls outside of her purview.  I understand the gallery position if I had owned the artwork for a long time but this expensive artwork began unstretching in under 6 months.  If the bars had been made with the lip in the correct location it would not have occurred.  Without the lip being in the correct position there was nothing to provide tension to the canvas.  This also would not have been seen during their quality inspection because it would have required taking the canvas off the bars.  My additional communications with the gallery after their refusal to make the matter right were met with total radio silence.  Any buyer of this piece would have experienced this problem, not just me.  I love this gallery, and was interested in additional pieces by the artist, but I should not have been responsible for incorrect framing and have to warn others that this gallery does not stand behind their work.  If you do buy a canvas here please request that they unframe it for you to show you that the lip is in the proper location so that you don’t end up with the same negative experience as me. || Thank you for taking the time to share your experience, and we’re truly sorry to hear that the situation with your artwork developed in such a disappointing way. While all artworks are carefully inspected before shipping, we recognize that certain structural problems — such as internal faults with stretcher bars — may not be visible without removing the canvas, which we do not do out of respect for the artist’s original presentation.  That said, we took your report seriously and consulted with our logistics and artist support teams before responding. As mentioned, our general policy does not cover alterations or reinforcements required after delivery, especially several months post-purchase. It’s a beautiful church but do not plan a whole afternoon for the visit, it’s not a very big church.  There’s an option to burn a candle for € 0,50. place_name: Basilica of Our Lady of the Martyrs
reviews_content: Beautiful and warm, cosy feel. It's just a stunning basilica (which you can tell by the "umbrella" up at the right in the pulpit). I even ended up attending a portion of a Sunday mass, which was pretty interesting (not that I understand Portuguese).  I don't know what made this basilica feel different than many other churches I've visited, but it just had a very cosy, welcoming feel, and gorgeous ceiling art.  It's deceptive from the outside because you think it'll be kind of "plain", but it isn't. It's really stunning. || Marvellous architecture. Very very pretty. Highly recommend taking a look even if it’s just for a little while. There are also skeletons inside. || A beautiful church in the heart of Lisbon. I was surprised that it was open at 3:00pm in the afternoon and the Blessed Sacrament exposed for a duration. Beautiful! || Beautiful with amazing ceiling paintings. (The floor made my shoes make very loud sqeaky noises though) || Very beautiful church that you can easily visit in the city center. The ceiling is truly wonderful. || A really nice piece of architecture and a stunning site to explore and visit when walking around this area. || Basílica de Nossa Senhora dos Mártires (Basilica of Our Lady of the Martyrs) is located along Rua Serpa Pinto in the Chiado neighbourhood. It is one of several interesting historic church buildings you can visit in the area and according to their website is open from 9am to 6.30pm (Mon to Fri) and 10am to 6.30pm (Sat & Sun). There is a mass schedule on the Basilica website as well if needed.  The Basilica history dates back to the reconquest of Lisbon in 1147, when a chapel was built here to house the image of the Virgin carried by English crusaders. The chapel was given the name Our Lady of the Martyrs in memory of all European soldiers who died in retaking the city and defending the Christian faith.  The present church you can see today dates back to 1784. It was constructed by Portuguese architect Reinaldo Manuel dos Santos to replace the previous building destroyed during the 1755 Earthquake. You'll find subtle Baroque exterior along with a nicely decorated interior. The nave is lined side alters and fronted by an impressive main alter. There is also a delightful ceiling fresco, the work of Pedro Alexandrino de Carvalho, whose work can also be found in Sé (Lisbon Cathedral) and other important historic buildings around the city from that time. || We attended the vigil mass on Saturday evening. The Cantor also played the organ and had a beautiful singing voice. The people were friendly and the interior what's lovely. I wish that I spoke Portuguese. I couldn't understand the homily. || Simply a beautiful Church built-in 1147, check out all the details on their walls. I was shocked by how it was so well preserved and so nice at the same time.  It is amazing how people used to work years ago.  As soon as I walked in I felt so at peace and I loved it. || This is a beautiful house of worship with an ornate interior. Stop by for a few minutes to rest,  relax and admire this church.

place_name: Church of St. Vincent de Fora
reviews_content: A beautiful and tranquil church. Few visitors on a weekday in December. Time and space to appreciate wonderful monastic chanting playing in the background. The multi-lingual signs direct you towards the amazing collection of blue and white tiles (azulejo) which decorate the cloisters, walls, and stairs. These are simply stunning. Many depict rural scenes and the pursuits of the gentry, while others capture funny parables and fables. The latter are very well presented for visitors, with written summaries of each one in Portuguese and English. In total there are over 200 tiled panels so some you might want to study carefully and others you might spend less time on, depending on your schedule. Another highlight for us is the 360 degree panoramic view from the roof, well worth the climb. A fascinating good-value  visit. Seems to be overlooked by many tourists. || Thank you so much for this wonderful and thoughtful review! We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the calm atmosphere of the church and had the time and space to fully appreciate the monastic chanting and the remarkable azulejo collection.  It’s especially rewarding to know that the multilingual interpretation and the presentation of the tile panels helped bring the stories to life for you. With more than 200 panels, it’s lovely to hear you took the time to explore them at your own pace.  We’re also very glad you enjoyed the panoramic rooftop view, it really is a special perspective over Lisbon and a highlight for many of our visitors.  Thank you for highlighting the tranquility and value of the visit, and for helping bring attention to a place that often remains a hidden gem. We hope to welcome you back again in the future! || A beautiful and peaceful church with impressive architecture and stunning tile work. reviews_content: The Church of Saint Anthony of Lisbon is a beautiful and historic site dedicated to Saint Anthony, who was born here in 1195. According to tradition, the church was built on the very spot of his birthplace. The architecture is charming, and the altar is especially stunning, showcasing exquisite detail and craftsmanship. It’s a peaceful and inspiring place to visit. I highly recommend it to anyone exploring Lisbon. || Beautiful, historic church right by Lisbon Cathedral! Lovely Baroque-Rococo architecture with elegant details and a peaceful atmosphere. Built on the traditional birthplace of Saint Anthony and after the 1755 earthquake was rebuilt in 1767, it blends history and artistry perfectly. A must-see stop in the Alfama area || Beautiful and peaceful church of Saint Anthony, located in the heart of the downtown Full of history, with a warm and spiritual atmosphere. Downstairs, there’s a small chapel and the place where Saint Anthony was born. Visitors can also write prayer intentions. An ideal place to pause, pray, and fill your heart with peace. Inside the church, there’s a small shop where you can buy souvenirs, prayers, and rosaries. Highly recommended it is a must see, do and visit || The Church of Saint Anthony is a must-visit in Lisbon! It is highly recommended for devotion to Saint Anthony and for a moment of peace and reflection. || A beautiful church dedicated to Saint Anthony of Lisbon, known throughout the Cristian world as Saint Anthony of Padua. This 18th-century baroque church is believed to mark the birthplace of St. Anthony, one of Portugal’s most beloved saints, and offers beautiful architecture, onsite services, and an atmosphere steeped in history just steps away from Lisbon Cathedral. || Beyond being the patron saint of lost items, I was told Saint Anthony was also known as the match maker; regardless, you should definitely visit this beautiful little church if you have the time. || The Church of Saint Anthony of Lisbon (Portuguese: Igreja de Santo António de Lisboa) is a church located in Lisbon, Portugal. A must-visit sanctuary for those seeking solace, inspiration, or simply a moment of connection.🤩🌟🌟 || Church of Our Lady the Rosary of Fatima in Lisbon was consecrated in 1938. Afterward, I was given tea and snacks in a very pleasant relaxation room as I enjoyed the post-treatment high.  The facilities were clean and the staff was warm and welcoming. I came to the spa today with minimal expectations, but from the moment I arrived, I was pleasantly surprised. The reception was warm and welcoming, the spa area was lovely, and the ambiance was very tranquil. To top it all off, my masseuse, Jone, was absolutely amazing. She has such soft and delicate hands, and her skill made my experience truly enjoyable. Thank you again, Jone—I’ll definitely be back! || This is a lovely place to relax, especially on a rainy day. The hydro circuit has everything needed for a very pleasant experience, the space is clean, and the staff is warm and polite. I also truly enjoyed my facial treatment — it was deeply relaxing, and my therapist was very skilled.  I do have a couple of gentle suggestions that I believe could make the experience even better:  • During my visit, the hydro circuit was quite lively, which made it a bit harder to fully unwind. An encouragement of silence or whispering could really help preserve the calm atmosphere the space is clearly designed to offer.  • After such a soothing treatment, transitioning into a brightly lit space with product recommendations felt a little abrupt. Offering guests the option to opt in or out of product advice on the intake form might make this moment feel more aligned with the overall sense of relaxation, while still supporting the team’s expertise.  Overall, this is a beautiful space with thoughtful services, and with a few small refinements, it could feel even more exceptional. || We picked this place because it was recommended as the best Spa place in Portugal. I would say we already saw better places in Lisbon, but still it's a good place to relax. Maybe still a bit overpriced for the hydro water treatment. || The staff is very welcoming and friendly. We felt well taken care of  during our visit to the water therapy circut. We were the only people there late afternoon so we had the infrared sauna, cold plunge and bubble pools all to ourselves. || A decent spa. All of the hydrotherapy rooms are off of one larger room, but it’s a lovely environment to chill in for a few hours. The massage and facial were also great. Lovely facilities.  However… one star removed due to the staff chasing me out of the elevator after I was leaving, for accusing me of not having paid (even though they had already made me pre-pay via an online link the day before). Between the three staff on reception accusing me of not having paid, even though I kept insisting I had, after having paid around EUR280 for a treatment - this felt quite sub-standard service. The manager checked the system as soon as she got to the till and confirmed I had paid - but my goodness, just check first before chasing me around the hotel next time.  The beautician also kept trying to up-sell me lots of skincare products even though I said I had carryon luggage only and no space. She clearly did not want to hear it.  All in all a rubbish end to an otherwise lovely spa trip. || Recently visited the spa, it’s amazing! Sanu my masseuse was incredible, would fully recommend - the best massage I’ve ever had 10/10  I will be revisiting vey soon! || Amazing spa and fantastic professional massage 💆‍♀️ Highly recommend it … || Awesome experience 😍 I reserved 1 hour for Water Therapy Circuit and it was incredible!! Relaxing area, great hidroterapia, high service. Thank you! … || I had an exceptional experience at The SPA, where I chose the signature treatment called "Portuguese Journey." It was absolutely marvelous. The experience began with a beautiful tour of the SPA area, followed by an invigorating scrub treatment, and concluded with a wonderfully relaxing massage.  As the largest SPA in Portugal, it boasts numerous awards for its outstanding services. Be sure to visit their gym as well—it's fully equipped with state-of-the-art TechnoGym Artis equipment.  Amazing! || I’ve been to this spa a few times and most of those visits have been very positive - slick service, great treatments and facilities - but the last time was really bad.  This could be the spa having a bad day or could be their service quality slipping. I booked a facial and massage and instead of being shown to the changing rooms, I was brought to the treatment room to change.  After the treatments I was left in the treatment room covered in oils and expected to put my clothes back on, with no option for a shower. I had to use one of the small towels in the room, wet it in the sink and wash off as much of the oil as I could, before dressing. When I exited the treatment room, the member of staff had gone, rather than escort me back to reception. The facial treatment I had booked also included an extraction, which I needed, but was told could not be done that day - no partial refund offered. Really not the quality of service I have experienced before at this spa and has put me off from visiting again.

Had an amazing experience! Me and my boyfriend decided to give it a try and they provided such a good service. They’re in the central area very easy access. The environment is clean and comfortable, they offer different types of massages for couples and singles and the girls are gorgeous. Thanks to Fae and Sofia. Our vacation got even more exciting after this experience next time we’re in Lisbon we’re definitely coming back || Such a fantastic place! I've already heard about tantric massage experience, but I've got the most discovery experience ever so far. Naomi made me feel out of this world with such touch and helped me to discover myself, thank you for this amazing experience. Also, I'd like to greet Isabela for the attention and booking || Pathetic tourist trap. Most girls could stand to lose 30-50 pounds. Had Vivi - she was particularly skilled at giving remarkably boring massages. Almost walked out in the first 15 minutes but since I already paid the overpriced fee I decided to stay to the end. Should’ve walked out. || Mark, We need to make it very clear that offensive comments about the appearance of our therapists are disrespectful, inappropriate, and do not reflect the values of Venus Spa. We work exclusively with tantric, sensual, and therapeutic massages, always within an environment of respect, professionalism, and elegance. We do not offer sexual services at any time. The massage you selected corresponds to one of the simplest options on our menu, with a well-defined concept that is clearly explained to the client beforehand. Our therapists are qualified professionals, admired daily by our clients for their beauty, technique, sensitivity, and posture. The public that seeks us truly values exactly this: sensuality with class. We respect that our concept is not for everyone, but we do not accept personal attacks or demeaning comments about our professionals. || Had an amazing time with Sarah who was very amazing at small talk and was skilled even against difficult odds. If I'm ever in Lisbon again, I would love to come back here! || RECOMMEND, WILL COME BACK. From all the spas I tried in lisbon this one so far has been the best. Prices are fair, they got AC and overall everything was great. || A memorable experience! From Isabela's smile and initial service to Serena's massage, I was treated very well. They are very professional, they love what they do and they know how to treat people. The massage has technique, it's revitalizing... I'm amazed! I highly recommend it! And I'll be back soon! Thank you Isabela, thank you Serena. Much more success to you! || Whenever I come through Lisbon for work, I make a point of visiting at Venus.  Regardless of who the therapist is, the level of service has consistently been excellent. Had the best experience with Sofia, and had four hands massage with other girl that I forgot the name but was one of the best experiences that I had so far in Spas.  Unlike some other places that I have visited, where at best you get a back rub (not a real massage) from someone mechanically going through the motions, the therapists at Venus consistently provide a real sensual massage that is sublime. I highly recommend the four hands massage. Yes, it is more expensive, however, the level of sensuality and added intimacy makes it well worth the additional cost.  You will forever remember it. If you are thinking of visiting Venus, you will find a professionally run Spa where you can go with confidence. 10/10. || We are extremely grateful for your detailed feedback and for consistently choosing us whenever you visit Lisbon. It is a great pleasure to know that the quality of our service has been consistently excellent for you.  We especially appreciate the recognition given to Sofia and our four-hands massage. Our mission is to provide a professional and memorable experience, and your 10/10 comment confirms that we are on the right track.  We look forward to welcoming you back soon! || Sofia is the best girl in the town, she eas very professional and very good at what she does || I was in heaven for an hour of Nuru with Sarah and Joana. Nice and kind girls, who are even prettier in real life. The nice was classy in a historic building. A perfect experience, and a place I will definitly revisit in the future… || This was by far the worst experience I’ve had at a massage center. I paid for a specific service, but ended up receiving something completely different, and for a shorter duration.  It’s clear they’re targeting tourists, but the quality of service was disappointing and unprofessional. I do not recommend this place at all.

place_name: SAYANNA Wellness & Spa - EPIC SANA Lisboa
reviews_content: For me personally a 10 out of 5 star spa and gym! The gym equipment is top notch and everything about the spa area is just amazing! So glad I had the opportunity to become member. The Turkish steam room is one of the best, if not the best, I know. The body treatment (30 minute massage) surpassed my expectations! The body products, the pool and showers, not to mention, the Finish sauna are great too. A huge thank you to the whole spa team, especially Marta, Beatrice and Andre! 🙏😊 || ✨ Title: Perfect stay in the heart of Lisbon  Review: Our stay at EPIC SANA Lisboa was exceptional from start to finish. The rooms are spacious, modern, and spotlessly clean, with extremely comfortable beds. The staff is incredibly friendly and professional – always ready to help with a smile and great tips about the city.  Breakfast is absolutely fantastic, offering a huge variety of fresh and high-quality options – one of the best we’ve ever had in a hotel. The rooftop infinity pool with views over Lisbon is a true highlight and the perfect place to relax after a day of exploring.  The spa and indoor pool are also beautifully designed, adding to the sense of luxury and tranquility. The hotel’s location is excellent – quiet, yet close to major attractions and shopping areas.  Overall, this hotel combines true luxury with warm hospitality. We will definitely return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for an unforgettable stay in Lisbon. 🤍 || I absolutely loved this experience. Perfect place to go when I arrived early with my cousin and had several hours before check in at my Airbnb. Andre (I think that was his name) at the front was so helpful and kind enough to let us leave our bags to grab food before coming back and enjoying the sauna and poolside. We got incredible massages by Martha and Mikayla - they did an awesome job! Afterward, they served us champagne, tea, and fresh fruit. We ended up staying a few more hours by the pool to soak in the whole experience.  Loved it and would do again. The whole staff was excellent. I only wish I took more pictures. || I had a wonderful facial cleansing experience at SAYANNA Wellness & Spa - EPIC SANA Lisboa with Marta. From the moment I arrived, the ambiance was calming and luxurious. Marta was incredibly professional, tailoring the treatment to my skin's needs. The products used left my skin feeling fresh, smooth, and deeply cleansed. I left the spa feeling relaxed and rejuvenated. Highly recommend this experience for anyone looking to treat their skin to something special! || The spa area is nice. Big pool and a good sauna. It has been empty the few times I have been. The gym however lacks sufficient equipment. There is not enough variety of machines and the free weights only go to 14kg. I was considering signing up monthly but the equipment is far too limiting. Staff are friendly and nice though. || The relaxing massage was good. The overall service and facilities were some of the worst of luxury hotels in Lisbon. Too crouded, couldn't find a place to sit and the relaxing area after the massage was open to people coming in and out of the place. Overall disappointing since the rest of the hotel facilities are very nice. || For €110 I got overall clean a spacious spa with nice and welcoming staff. With showers by the pool that have terrible smell from drainage, water wasn't running away while I showered ( changing room showers - same thing), steam room has pretty funny smell as well. There is no cold water anywhere, even in showers ( I like to cool off after heat), but it wasn't a problem, since sauna and steam room was barely warm. Ok, I accepted that not everyone understands benefits of contrast and use of facilities included. But I  was hoping to have at least good massage. I payed for deep tissue massage and specifically told masseuse that I like it strong. She smiled and give me greasy oily rub instead. And I had relaxing massages before, this massage was barely ok, can't even call it good. What a waste of precious vacation time. This is not a 5 star experience, not even close. || After my favorite gym and spa at Papa had to temporarily close, they were kind enough to recommend this one. What a treat! Very spacious, relaxing ambiente, super friendly staff, fantastic massagists and trainers. All of this for a great choice of flexible and attractive membership rates, making the relatively pricey extra services affordable overall. || Amazing! Super friendly staff and the signature massage  was so relaxing! Great massagist! Can only recommend it 😊 The place overall is very nice and let’s you escape from everyday life || Unprofessional staff. Unfortunate air of disrespect toward tourists || Tried to schedule an appointment and received an automated message that they would reach out. They never did. || Rude, disrespectful and unprofessional! || A hotel that deserves its stars. Friendly, welcoming, and always smiling staff. A fabulous buffet breakfast of incredible freshness, you will find something for everyone. If you like cocktails, do not hesitate to visit the bar and let yourself be tempted. As for the "Allora" restaurant, go there with your eyes closed. The staff is just as welcoming and friendly, and I won't even mention the menu, it is worth discovering. The spa is very relaxing and spotlessly clean, as is the gym. Treatments are offered there... Zenith is there for you. || The perfect place to relax even if you're not staying at the hotel. There is a fee to use the pool, sauna, Turkish bath, and jacuzzi. VIP cleanliness and service. || Excellent space for wellness, relaxation and self-care, but above all, a space that provides a very welcoming environment from the moment the client enters until they leave. Boutique gym with necessary equipment and towels always available, the Acqua Spa is spacious, clean and has dormer windows. One point to improve is the changing rooms; when showering, water comes out everywhere, which is for safety reasons and doesn't give a good first impression. || Magnificent pool. Spacious sauna, very well decorated and at a perfect temperature. The relaxation area is very pleasant with different tea options. Finally, the massage rooms are very peaceful and spacious. A very good time, included for hotel guests. || Excellent hotel, with fantastic service and a very competent staff, a frequent guest of this hotel chain... very good. || What a pleasure to see a service of this level; breakfast, food at the bar and in the dining room, decoration of the establishment, kindness of the staff (thank you to Jefferson at the bar) well done and thank you for this moment. || Possibly the best hotel spa I've ever been to. Beautiful pool, sauna, Turkish bath, gym. Fantastic. || It's been around for a few years and continues to maintain its quality. It's a shame they don't offer some promotions to increase the frequency of visits to the spa (for non-guests). || Spa area used: €50 for 1 hour, 1 sauna, 1 steam room and 1 mini-pool?! Unbelievable. || Everything was 5 stars, the water was nice and warm, the Turkish bath was one of the best, and the sauna was excellent. || Perfect for relaxing and forgetting your problems. || Professionalism, calmness, efficiency. A delightful person. || Clean and a relaxing experience.

Arguably the best sauna I have ever been. Every time I go, I have a great time The space is large, well designed and is kept spotlessly clean. There's usually good number and variety of patrons. The staff is always friendly and helpful. There's a decent bar and the drinks are pretty strong. There's a fair number of large cabins for more privacy, a sling and a large shower area. The best part for me, however, is the sizable dark area with many twists and turns, where cruising is quite exciting, and it includes a few more cabins, albeit smaller and a large porn room for those who prefer to be seen. If you're looking for "trouble", there's no better place in Lisbon. || Trombeta is clean, modern, and well-equipped, with a decent range of facilities like a bar, filtered water, and plenty of lockers. The staff are attentive and keep the place in good condition, but there are a few things that could be improved.  Pros: * Plenty of lockers, each with a built-in light, which makes it easy to check your belongings. * Staff are on top of cleanliness. Once, I noticed a strong urine smell in the darkroom, and within 10 minutes, they shut the session down to clean it for 15 minutes—kudos to them! (Though honestly, anyone who thinks it’s okay to pee there should be ashamed.) * Slippers are provided. * There’s a bar and filtered water available for drinks. * The cubicles have mirror-like panels, which look great and give a spacious feel.  Cons: * No lube in the darkroom, which is a basic necessity. * The video room is too bright and could use softer lighting. * Lockers have no hangers and no separate space for shoes. * The mirror panels in the cubicles have sharp edges—I accidentally cut my toe on one and bleed quite badly. * Entry is a bit pricey at €21. * On one Saturday afternoon visit, some younger guys seemed high inside the cubicles and darkrooms, which was uncomfortable to us. || Hello Mike, Thank you for your thorough review. At Trombeta Bath we always welcome constructive criticism, and we will take your points into consideration. Especially the point about providing lube in the darkroom + reducing the brightness of the darkroom cinema , this is already done. Trombeta Bath is constantly looking for ways to improve the experience of our current regular and new clientele. We also look forward to welcoming you again at our sauna. || The sauna was really nice and tight, the atmosphere is incredible and the staff make sure you feel welcome and that the space is clean. The amazing experience starts when you check in, and John made sure to make me feel welcome and explained and everything how the club works and he is extreme friendly! Thank you John, hope when I come back i see you again  The bar is amazing and the drinks are very cheap and the men are incredible hot, not to mention to that if you are under 37 you get a discount  Definitely one of the best I've been || A pleasant surprise. I went there on a Wednesday around 9 p.m., and there were already about 30 people. The place was calm and well organized, clean and modern. Lockers are small, so don’t bring too much. Water bottles aren’t allowed inside, but they give you towels and slippers.  The space is really big and very clean — staff are constantly checking and sanitizing. There are condoms and gel everywhere, plus more than 10 private rooms. The dark room is huge, and I always felt safe since employees go around regularly.  The sauna is a bit small, but the Turkish bath is very spacious. The bar area is nice, drinks are affordable, and you can even buy poppers from vending machines like cigarettes.  I paid €21 to get in and stayed for about 3 hours. By midnight, there were already more than 50 people. || I visited Trombeta Bath while in Lisbon on three occasions and had a really positive experience each time. It’s one of the most welcoming and well-maintained male-only spas I’ve been to. The space feels safe, relaxed, and thoughtfully designed.  I also booked a 60-minute massage with Wesley — he was professional and respectful throughout. You can tell the staff and ownership take real pride in keeping the environment clean, stylish, and comfortable for everyone.  Definitely recommend, and I’ll be back on my next trip to Lisbon. || Clean and truly a quality facility. Easy for inter. Travelers, staff speaks PR/ES/EN really well. The dark room is pretty dang dark, but hangout in there for 2 min, your eyes adjust and it’s just awesome. Will return 10/10. Was there 11pm to 5am on a Thursday, and plenty of fellas were there. 😍  -Clean out stall -great jacuzzi temp -staff was awesome, good prices for drinks -friend got the message and stands by it || A very good space; despite the number of people, it’s constantly being cleaned. Of course, there are some areas that aren’t 100% spotless, but that’s completely understandable. The only thing I really want to point out is the shower water temperature — it stays at the maximum heat, not cold, but also not comfortably warm, so please pay attention to the water temperature. Everything else is top-notch. || Like the other reviewers said, the staff work so hard to keep the sauna clean and tidy at all times. The crowd is very mixed with local and international, different ages and body shapes. A special shout out to the new masseur Jonathan, whose massage technics are professional, wonderful and attention to details. I had a bit of lower back pain plus sore legs from too much walking, after the massage I felt so much better, next time I will book one hour! || I cannot fault my experience at Tombeta Baths, from the moment I was welcomed to the moment I left too many hours later.  The hygiene was impeccable, every member of staff was welcoming and has a smile that offer.  While I understand the management cannot be responsible for the friendliness and general sexiness of the clientele BUT 10/10!! 4pm on a Wednesday afternoon and it was already busy!  I spent a very satisfying 4hrs at Trombeta today so thank you!!! || Very clean sauna, they do constantly clean. Has jacuzzi, small steam bath and sauna. There is a large section with cabins and (very) dark room. The cabins have lube dispensers which is very convenient. || I arrived in Portugal in Algarve on the 2nd of October. Took a flight to Porto on the 8th. I have had the most wonderful time, but when I arrived in Lisbon, someone suggested I go to Trombeta. I've heard all these stories abouts how the gay Portuguese are so friendly. NOT True. I left feeling sad, lonely and unexpected. || I'm very happy to recommend this welcoming venue. It's exceptionally clean, has a lovely and relaxed atmosphere, and attracts a diverse and friendly crowd. Plus, it's excellent value for money – a real gem! || One of the best gay saunas in Europe! Super clean, with very friendly and helpful staff. Lots of space and a great atmosphere – the perfect place to relax and meet new people. || This is the cleanest sauna I’ve ever been to. reviews_content: One of the highlights of Estrela. One of the main Lisbon churches due to its size and beauty. You can visit for free but you'll need to pay to go to the rooftop. Beautiful paintings that contribute to the espiritual experience. Parking available just next to the church but it's usually quite full. You can also visit the park just across the street. A metro station is being built which will make it more accessible. || You can pay 5 € to walk up to the roof top. 20% off with Lisboa card and a million steps. The view is amazing. You also get to see inside of the basilica from the top- close to the dome. Also- Jesus dine with the 12 around a round table. || It is an absolute must see! One of the prettiest Basilicas we've visited. And we were able to access the roof and walk around the inside of the church from above and look down into the sanctuary. Absolutely gorgeous! || The interior is splendid. The ceiling, dome and floor are colorful. Paintings are fabulous. The ambience is serene. || The inside of the cathedral is free and breathtaking. there is a core beam of light that shines on you like a spot light for judgement of course.  For the bathroom. You need exact 0.50€ to use it and the post cards are exactly 0.50€ if you need change. I did the €5 climb which was not worth so buy the postcard instead and enjoy a clean private wc. The light goes off automatically but I just used my phone flashlight.  Update: I walked across the street to the Jardin and there is a free bathroom in the “casa de jardin estrella”. Do that. || Very ancient Basilica. It was indeed an Awesome Place, a must visit Place in Lisbon. It is a silent place to be with God. || After years of passing by outside, finally went in and was pleasantly surprised. It is not a giant cathedral, but it has enough of an imposing presence to allow one to appreciate the multiple altars and cruciform architecture. Also a pleasant surprise came in the form of the possibility of climbing to the rooftop from where you can have a look around the area at a very budget friendly price. Just be sure to be away from the belltowers when the full set goes off at, for example, 11:50 on a Sunday morning. || Known for its beautiful dome and interior, the Basílica da Estrela is one of Lisbon's most impressive monuments. The Basílica da Estrela in Lisbon was the first church in the world dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, built by Queen Maria I, and houses her tomb. It is also known for its large dome that dominates the Lisbon skyline, a remarkable baroque nativity scene, and its impressive neoclassical architecture. || I like to recommend everyone to visit this place it’s very peaceful n nice food with handmade dumpling thank u || Very beautiful and peaceful interior to the church. The floor of the church is particularly stunning in its design. We paid the 5 euros each to go to the rooftop. It was pleasant but for us, not worth the price.  Much prefer the pantheon rooftop.  The climb via a narrow spiral staircase is quite steep with just enough room to pass people - it is fun to go up. The view from the rooftop is nice and the dome is beautiful (you can see it close up from access from the rooftop terrace - mind your head going in 🤕) || Beautiful building and great to go up to the top to explore the roof and dome. || One of fav places in Lisbon. Very intricate details of the dome and arches. A must-visit spot for the  moment of peace and awe. Highly recommend spending time here to soak in serenity. || Sit down inside and settle your soul or admire the interior. || The beautiful colors of the church all come of different colors of marble. Blue, green, pink, yellow and grey marbles carefully carved for a harmonious result. The polished marbles shine like jewels. The interior is breathtaking. (Today's prices for blue marble is 2000e/m2), The rooftop  was nice, with the bells banging at five  a'clock and sun setting in the Atlantic ocean. || A basilica and a national heritage of Portugal. Built around 1780 this is the first church dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus. It is very good and the dome above the altar is wonderful. || It is a beautiful building inside and out, seen from below and above. Gorgeous decorations, works of art painted and carved in stone. The combination of natural light from the dome and the artificial lighting covers the interior in a special mix of colours. The roof offers great views of Lisbon in all directions. || Impressive creamy white late baroque church with a truly spectacular “terrace” on the roof of the nave, which is like something out of a movie set. Price to climb the spiral stairs is just 3€, and a small door in the dome also gives you a scary view straight down into the church itself—be mindful of the loooooow balustrade and also the electric wires running around the edge of the roof to keep the birds away ⚡️🐥⚡️ || The church, which was built in the Estrela neighborhood as a dedication by Queen Maria I of Portugal, whose wish for an heir was fulfilled, takes its name from this district. Since it is dedicated to the heart of Jesus, it is also known as the Convent of the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus.  The church, which we can call the Baroque style, has a remarkable splendor and a beautiful architecture. The entrance is free, but I can say that the Bema section is viewed from a bit of a distance. There was a fee to access the terrace of the church. Since our visit was in the evening, we could not go to the roof, but I think the view is very beautiful with the Estrela park opposite.  I should also point out that the huge dome of the church, located in the hilly part of the neighborhood in the west of Lisbon, can be seen from many points in the surrounding area. If you take a nice route to the church, I think you can enjoy watching this dome until you get close. || Beautiful old church. When we visited the church, on a Monday around 11.30 in the morning, there was a service ongoing which ended around 12.30.  It’s a beautiful church but do not plan a whole afternoon for the visit, it’s not a very big church.  There’s an option to burn a candle for € 0,50.  Make sure to also visit the park behind the church, absolutely worth the visit. || It was a lot of fun to the climb 114 stairs to the roof. Some sections had no barriers 😫

Eduardo VII Park is one of the most beautiful and relaxing green spaces in Lisbon. The park offers stunning panoramic views over the city and the Tagus River, making it a perfect spot for photos, walks, or simply enjoying the scenery. The wide paths are ideal for walking or jogging, and the well-maintained gardens add a peaceful atmosphere away from the busy city streets. One of the highlights is the impressive geometric garden design and the viewpoint at the top of the park, which provides a breathtaking perspective of Lisbon. The park is also very spacious, so it never feels overcrowded, even during busy hours. There are benches throughout the area, perfect for resting and enjoying the surroundings. Eduardo VII Park is great for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. It’s close to the city center and easy to access, making it a must-visit for anyone exploring Lisbon. Whether you’re looking for a quiet place to relax, take a walk, or admire the city from above, this park is definitely worth a visit. || We were in Lisbon for several days while waiting to start a cruise with NCL. From dry vegetation that amounts, to destroyed/eroded pathways and all the buildings collapsing or ruined.  Among those a beautiful circular building with a greenhouse like glass roof, that by itself is worth the visit.  Just judge it too harshly by its state for it is in my opinion appealing as a rui ed site.  Can’t help to feel like patrimony is being lost without any concern or attempt to save it.  OVERALL IT IS FREE, so can’t really complain on the ticket price 😂  Therefore the relation price to quality of experience is actually juicy better than the Belém Botanical garden. To the west of the lawn there is a dog or children park, i was not sure, but it is fenced so they don't bother those that are allergic to them. On the other side to the east of the lawn there is a pond with ducks. Further east from the lawn there are staircases that lead to the closed section unfortunately, with a garden done in french style, with a symmetrical pattern of short hedges outlining the flowers planted there. And by looking at it on google maps it is apparent that on the other side of it there are staircases again leading to another similar area that is also closed off. To the north of the lawn there are buildings. First up right next to the lawn there is a glass dome that looks like a theater of some sort, although small and half the glass roof is shattered, then behind it there are buildings that look like maybe they were coops for the birds that are now running around. Coming right behind that is a plato with a big circular water feature that isn't working and half around it is a wall with a (closed) gate that leads into a (overgrown) corridor that leads to some sort of i guess important building. Next to the corridor starts a cactus garden that has been left unchecked for far too long. Even though cactuses are thriving, the paths through it are bit harder to navigate so caution is advised. || Absolutely got surprised by this little park in a quite busy city district. Poor neighbors! || It was a lot of fun during early June. || Nice fair on Portugal day || Interesting. It has the potential to be the amusement park that Lisbon lacks. What's missing is the infrastructure. There's no shortage of space. And the children (and adults too) would appreciate it. If only there were the will. It remains for the City Council and the Port of Lisbon to come to an agreement. Everyone would win. ADDITIONAL NOTE: Days after what I wrote before, the space closed. The carousels, the Ferris wheel, etc., disappeared. And the entertainment at the site ended. It was a shame. Since 2003, the year the Feira Popular in Entrecampos closed, there hasn't been any amusement space in the city, despite the successive promises of the many mayors who have passed through the municipality. The Santos embankment was a good experiment, which in my view deserved to have been continued and cherished. The city's population would have benefited, the children would have benefited from having a place where they could have a good time, the merchants and amusement entrepreneurs would have benefited, and even the tourists could have benefited. The atmosphere became unsuitable for families, which led many parents with children to leave the venue. Some young women were behaving completely inappropriately, which further contributed to the feeling of discomfort.  The sound was very bad, muffled, without any quality, and without the proper regulation that a Quim Barreiros show requires. To make matters worse, the event started 45 minutes late. Time is time, and it should be respected.  As for Quim Barreiros' show, it was up to par, as always, but impossible to stay until the end. reviews_content: The República Pilates studio stands out for its friendly, polite, and highly trained staff, dedicated and professional instructors, and excellent facilities. It offers a welcoming, safe, and high-quality environment, making it a top choice for Pilates practice.

Such an amazing studio! The space is modern and stylish - everything from the decor to the lighting creates a calm, inviting atmosphere. The studio features a welcoming reception area and a lovely little boutique corner with gorgeous training clothes. Forgot your grip socks? No problem! :) You can easily pick up a pair there. All the reformer machines and equipment are brand new and top quality, which really enhances comfort and performance during workout. The staff is highly professional, friendly, and always ready to help. The first class I attended was called First Prescription - it’s a fantastic introduction for beginners. I highly recommend this studio if you're looking for a premium Reformer Pilates experience! || Thank you so much for this incredible message, Agnes! ✨ We’re thrilled to hear how much you enjoyed the space, from the atmosphere and design to the boutique and reception experience. Creating a calm, inviting environment is something we care deeply about, so it’s wonderful to know it resonated with you. We’re also delighted that you connected with the quality of the equipment, the professionalism of our team, and your First Prescription class; it’s a great way to begin the Reformer journey, and we love making sure every mover feels supported from day one. Thank you for the wonderful recommendation. We can’t wait to welcome you back soon for more sessions at Prescription! 💛 || I LOVE Prescription classes! Professional studio, professional staff and lot of positive vibes. If it´s your first time you definitely need to start with the First Prescription class! It´s where you understand the basis and feel the real flow - and you end up with an amazing feeling of connection between your body and soul after the class. Classes are engaging and with clear instructions, always with options for different levels so it can be challenging if you feel like :) The venue is new, clean and beautiful, has AC, showers, and free water, towels, lockers and hygienic products to use such a shampoo, conditioners, body lotion or deodorant, amazing! It´s definitely my favourite place for reformer pilates. Thank you Prescription! <3 || Thank you so much for this incredible message! ✨ We’re thrilled to hear how much you love your Prescription classes and that the combination of professional guidance, positive energy and a welcoming studio environment has been such a meaningful part of your practice. We can’t wait to welcome you back soon for your next session! 💛 || Prescription is much more than a studio: it is a true community, guided by highly skilled and thoroughly trained teachers, in beautiful spaces where you instantly feel at ease. A truly unique experience in Lisbon. ✨🤌🏼 || Thank you so much for this beautiful message, Solene! ✨  It means a great deal to us to hear how deeply the Prescription community has resonated with you, from the atmosphere of our spaces to the guidance and dedication of our trainers. We understand that you experienced some neck tension. In your next class, and in case of any injuries or safety considerations, we can explore alternative options, such as using the footbar, to help reduce strain and keep you comfortable.   Our trainers are always here to support and adapt exercises to suit your body’s needs, so never hesitate to let us know how you’re feeling.
