Great bread and food, perfect carcaças And a great service, very kind people. || Such a lovely local bakery where all the sweet grannies and people from neighbourhood get their bread and pastry. People working there are friendly and efficient. And the pasty is very good! So tempting to go there ☺️ || This is such a lovely local bakery. Everything I got there was delicious. I don't speak any Portuguese and they were so incredibly kind and helpful. Makes me wish I lived here. || Delicious food and friendly people. The meat pastries, almond and chocolate pastry and pasteis de nata are amazing. Highly recommended to make a stop here! || Fish was particularly good. Service was excellent.  Great value for money.  Good explanation and assistance in English. || Bread is pretty good, service is pretty bad. I'm disappointed, as I had this place as being, probably, the best bakery (bread-wise) in Lisbon. || Moito Bo! Greatest breakfast! || Some of the best bread ever! Their pão de água is near perfect. || I was treated with pure contempt by a woman here as I was buying something for about 20 euros. Be friendly with your customers. || Very expensive or a tourist scam! We paid ridiculous prices after the woman wo worked there talked to the cashier while we were paying.. || Super friendly people, great pastries and strong late! || Good and fresh local bread. Sweets are waist of calories...so stay focused. || When you need sugar in the most tasty form and the smell of baked bread.

place_name: Delícia do Pão - Forno a Lenha
reviews_content: In all of Lisbon, the lady here was the friendliest person we met. We tried so much at this store over the course of a week and everything was tasty. Her younger colleague was also super sweet and offered to still make coffee in the evening for us, even though she had already cleaned the machine.  Nice people with even nicer pastries. || We stumbled upon this place while walking around the backstreet. Very friendly and patient lady who was so happy to explain to us about the different pastries eventhough there were other people behind us. The pastries and bread were all very delicious at very reasonable price. Highly recommended!! || Beautiful pastries in a beautiful place served by a very nice lady. Excellent quality at a price that genuinely surprised us. || All the locals went here vs the one just next door that’s (I think) higher rated in google.  Tells you something about quality of what you’re getting. Not to mention the one next door has some rude people working there.  Anyways, the lady here is very sweet and main reason I kept going back.  Pastries are excellent.  Nothing fancy.  Just fresh delicious local sweets || The nicest lady in the whole of Lissabon! Bread and pastries are tasty and affordable. Me and my partner went to get breakfast every day of our holiday here. || The worst croissant and pastries I’ve ever eaten. Very bad quality, they taste old, like they were made yesterday, not fresh today. || I've been here twice in the last few days, and I agree with all the positive reviews. The desserts were amazing and the service was as friendly as you can imagine. || Pastel de Nata delicious. But you have to work on good coffee. 2,75 for take away burned and washed out coffee taste is very disappointing! || The employer ignored the client to talk to a friend. Then picked the wort pastel de nata. Never had one that got mold!!! Just in a few hours... Don't go there... || Good coffee and cakes, but the lady and the atmosphere are perfect — truly authentic. || Nice bread and pastries with friendly staff! What more can you want? Great if you're taking away for a cozy breakfast at home-- that's what we did. A great start to a bom dia :) || A small local bakery with really good bread rolls and sweets, very decent prices, and lovely staff. || Great place to start your day in Alfama! || Good bakery in the centre of Lisbon. Very good orange juice. The pastry are good. || Just another average bakery. Great location. If you want warm bread do not come here. || Delicious authentic pastry, lovely service. Came back for more! || Local place to grab a good pastries and bread. || Excellent selection of coffee and pastries || The Delícia do Pão café in Lisbon is a unique place that captivates with its atmosphere and the high quality of its products. From the moment you walk in, you can smell the aroma of freshly baked bread and sweets, immediately inviting you to try them. The interior is cozy, with pleasant décor that creates an atmosphere conducive to relaxation and conversation with loved ones. The menu is extensive – from traditional Portuguese pastéis de nata, through a variety of breads and rolls, to delicious sandwiches and cakes. Everything is prepared with great attention to detail and high-quality ingredients. The service is polite and helpful, further enhancing the experience. Prices are commensurate with the quality and portion sizes, and the place is frequented by both locals and tourists, which attests to its popularity. Delícia do Pão is the perfect place for morning coffee, lunch, or an afternoon snack. If you're looking for authentic Portuguese flavor in a friendly atmosphere, this café is definitely worth a visit during your stay in Lisbon. || 🇬🇧 A very atmospheric little café, tucked away next to another (larger) one. Very good coffee, reasonably priced. Delicious cakes and sweets. Friendly service. Worth a visit and a try. Downside: no banner/advertising whatsoever and poorly visible prices. Best regards. 🇬🇧 || I was sitting at the bar next door reading a book, and my chair was touching the one at this bar called "Delícia do Pão." The lady who owns it is rude and said, "Move, I need to sit down." After I moved, I pointed out that she could have asked politely, and she said no, but boy, she said it in a way that was too rude, as if I had actually done something wrong. Then she continued laughing and joking with her friend. If I had been a customer at her bar, I guess she wouldn't have been so rude. She must be really jealous of the bar next door where there was a line. But that doesn't justify treating people like that in general. I don't recommend going. || A wide selection for a light and very sweet breakfast, excellent service. Recommended! || Finally, an honest place in Lisbon, with normal prices, where locals shop. The pastries are truly excellent. || What a fantastic and authentic shop! The custard tarts are absolutely superb – amazing pastries, incredible chocolate croissants, excellent coffee, and first-class service. Plus, the value for money is superb. Perhaps the best bakery you can find in all of Lisbon! || Delicious sweets at fair prices || The coffee was very good, as were the pastries. The lady who served us was very friendly. || Thank you for enjoying the experience. You are always welcome. || Very nice bakery with delicious food and very friendly service in the heart of Alfama! || Very good value for money. Great pastries and great prices. I highly recommend it. || The lady was really nice and kind + the price was low! 🌟 || I was mistreated by the attendant for being Brazilian, I wouldn't recommend them to anyone.

In a city known for its high-quality brunch spots and cafés, this establishment no longer holds its place. Despite its history dating back to the 1930s, it’s unclear how it has survived. The pastel de nata, priced at €1.50—above average—reflects the overall quality of the café. Served cold with an overcooked exterior, it was disappointing. The barista, an older gentleman who may be the owner, was friendly, but the café itself feels like a fading relic, slowly dying and suffering . The interior is outdated and lacks cleanliness, creating a sense of neglect. Overall, it’s not worth a visit—more of a forgotten space than a thriving café. || Amazing and traditional spot to have breakfast with a view of the tram. The owner and employees are very friendly and always try to make an effort to understand what you are saying, despite only speaking Portuguese. If you come a couple days in a row the people in the neighborhood will welcome you with kindness. Ideal spot to get a pastel de nata! || Truly a gem and a favorite among locals. This is a cozy small cafe and bakery run by a lovely old couple. I came here on a morning walk and got myself treated to sweet and fresh aromas of pastries and coffee beans. Thank you for making my day. || Hidden gem down a little backstreet. Way cheaper than the tourist traps, everything is so delicious and fresh. Great spot for a coffee sat on the tables outside. Recommend the palmier and all of the pastries.. || Cute neighborhood bakery where the locals go for coffee.  Great for early risers since it opens at 7am while the other coffee shops/bakeries in the area open at 8:30.  Very friendly service, English speaking.  Their plain brioche roll as well as the rustic roll were both fresh.  And the croissant filled with cream was soooo good!!  More like brioche, not flaky, and the filling reminds me of Korean cream custard with a hint of orange flavor?  And coffee was excellent and strong, great value for 75 cents!  And you can get it to go. || Lovely little bakery, and place to have an authentic Portuguese experience. Prices are extremely reasonable and great value. The place is clean and inviting. Delicious treats and coffee. Loved the Pastel de Nata. || Lovely quaint bakery. The owners are a lovely pair who only speak Portuguese. They were patient with me fast and efficient went two days  in a row. This is an ideal palce for early risers. || What a gem of a place. Clean, friendly, and affordable. Gorgeous selection of pastries and delicious coffee. Way better than the over-priced newer establishments further up the road. We will be back! || Excellent service. The man at the counter was very friendly and even though my Portuguese isn’t great he still made the effort to understand and was very polite and well-mannered. The pastries are good and reasonably priced. I recommend the freshly-squeezed orange juice. 5* || Lovely little bakery run by a very nice couple. Excellent food with pastries, cookies, sandwiches and more. The coffee is top notch with expert espresso pulls by the owners. Paninis are fresh and cooked to order. Limited English but didn’t affect order or experience. Highly recommended. || Our group of three ordered 4 pastries, two coffees, and a juice for less than 15 Euros. So affordable!! The food was amazing, really big portions especially if you're used to North American pastries. The mille feuilles was easily at least 4 north american servings, for less than the price of one! They don't speak great english, but it's easy to point and sort out what you want. Highly recommend coming here! || Hipster places are fine but the baking here will knock your socks off and while language might be a barrier, you can get by with a nice (and appreciated by the owners) bom dia to start your visit and pointing from there. || Honest, tasty, and authentic — a refreshing change in a neighborhood full of ‘too-cool-for-school’ breakfast clubs. || Great place! Really kind people, although I don't speak Portuguese and they don't speak a lot of English. We could somehow understand each other and had some great time in there. Pastry was really good. Came multiple times during my stay. || Delicious pastries, good tea and a very friendly lady working behind the counter || A trip for your taste buds with amazing Portuguese snacks. Our favorite was the chicken pie pastry and chocolate cone. The coffee was also great. || OH MY GOD. They have these round cookies with red filling that are insanely good. Pastels de nata were also as good as it gets. The lady at the counter is very sweet. It’s honestly one of the best places in the world to get a little treat after a long walk. || The pineapple pasty was absolutely delicious! Quaint little local spot. Felt like everyone in this place knew each other. I appreciated that the person behind the counter was kind even though I was clearly the odd man out and couldn’t speak Portuguese. || Fantastic local spot for pastries and coffee. Huge portions for little cost and very high quality. || “Not too sweet” ❤️ Local and real. || Very nice local place, quiet and without overburdening crowd of tourists. Fresh and tasty pasteles de natas, and ok coffee (if you like a strong one) || Traditional bakery and coffee place frequented by locals. Authentic and good value. || Stumbled upon this place. Absolute gem of a local spot. No frills but great food and a very sweet man at the counter. || Fantastic Portuguese plain croissants! Don’t go the new French or hipster bakeries around. This is as good and Portuguese as it gets! Much better trust me haha. || Great pastel de nata. Definitely worth it || Perfect place to taste local pastries. Everything was delicious. We had breakfast here most of our days in Lisbon || Pastry doesn’t look good. I was searching for traditional brioche croissants and found only something very dry covered with sugar powder. || A small cafe with excellent pasteis de nata, toast & coffee. Visited mostly by locals, lovely staff. || Lovely local coffee shop run by a lovely lady. Delicious pastel de nata! || Great coffee and snacks, out of the main tourist melee || Solid spot, and the workers were very helpful when I was trying to decide what to get (even when I could only speak English 😬) … || Super authentic small bakery. Lovely owner and amazing pastries. || Great pastries and well-tuned coffee machine. You don't find the latter often in Lisbon. || Lovely pastel da nata's. Feels proper Portugal || Great place, very kind staff. || An island in a sea of hipster places with astronomical prices. || Lady at the till would not even serve us || Friendly, great value and quality!! || Really friendly staff

The coffee was smooth and nicely presented as a simple cappuccino, but €7 feels a bit steep for what you get. The café has a cozy atmosphere and an impressive pastry selection ,the flat croissants (especially the pistachio and chocolate ones) look amazing and are definitely worth trying. Overall, it’s a nice spot to relax, though more for the experience than the value. || Thank you very much for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We’re delighted that you enjoyed our coffee, pastries and the cozy atmosphere. We appreciate your comment regarding the pricing and will certainly take it into consideration as we continue to improve the overall experience we offer. We hope to welcome you again soon!  Kind regards, The Bread & Friends Team || Very nice sandwich/bread/pasteis/croissants place! They have nice lunch deals (varied and good value for money). Their croissant collection is pretty wild! And the bakery is right next door with a glass wall, which gives a nice touch. Looks visually appealing inside and in the terras outdoors. Very clean too! || Thank you so much for such a lovely and detailed review! 🥐✨ We’re thrilled you enjoyed our sandwiches, pastries, and croissants, and we’re so glad you noticed our little bakery next door! We put a lot of love into creating both good food and a welcoming atmosphere. Hope to see you again soon for another delicious visit at Bread and Friends  The Bread and Friends Team || Best New york rolls I had without a doubt!!! Croissant is flakey, its filled with quality filling and there is a lot of it. Staff was really friendly, and if your looking for new york rolls this is the best place for sure!! || Thank you so much for your amazing review!  We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our croissants! It’s wonderful to know that the quality of our food and the friendly service made such a positive impression. We truly appreciate your recommendation and can’t wait to welcome you back for more delicious treats.  Kind regards, The Bread & Friends Team || Pastries look better than they taste. I went at 8am hoping for fresh warm croissants but was left a little disappointed by the red velvet croissant. Was dry and too sweet. The pastel de nata (Portugese egg tart) was super sweet as well. Might come back to try the flat croissant - strange concept but intrigued all the same. Cafe bakery has nice aesthetics to sit and relax. || Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are sorry to hear that some of our pastries did not fully meet your expectations, your comments are important to us. We are glad you enjoyed the atmosphere of our café and we hope you will give us another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a better experience. || Amazing place! Gorgeous interior and delicious food. Shared the Brunch for Two and enjoyed it thoroughly. Great choice of pastries. Would 100% recommend! || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed our Brunch for Two, the pastries and the atmosphere. Your recommendation means a lot to us, and we can’t wait to welcome you back soon!  Kind regards, The Bread & Friends Team || The space itself is very nice and comfy, perfect to work for a bit but the cappuccino was terrible, I couldn't drink it. The pastry I picked was also very dry. Maybe I just went there on a bad day or the staff needs more training? || Thank you for sharing your feedback.  We’re glad to hear that you enjoyed the space and found it comfortable. Your comments are important to us, and we will certainly look into improving the quality of our offerings and ensuring better consistency.  We hope you’ll give us another opportunity to provide a better experience in the future.  Kind regards, The Bread & Friends Team || Nice and cozy. Several breakfast and brunch options. I saw several people coworking, too. The shop has indoor and outside seating.  My breakfast was superb. I visited 2 days in a row. || Thank you very much for your review! We are delighted to know that you had such a great experience with us. It’s wonderful to hear that you enjoyed the service, food, and atmosphere. We look forward to welcoming you again soon for more enjoyable moments.  Kind regards, The Bread & Friends Team || Really basic cheesecake nothing special about it. The other stuff we tried tasted so good but it wasn't fresh unfortunately. Nice service. Clean place. And Really Good cappuccino 😋 … || Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We are pleased that you enjoyed the service, the cleanliness of our space and especially the cappuccino. We are sorry to hear that not everything met your expectations and we appreciate your feedback regarding the cheesecake and freshness of some items. We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back soon. || Brunch was fantastic! The decor is stylish and inviting, the staff were warm and welcoming, and the food was absolutely delicious. The bread was incredibly fresh, and the eggs were cooked to perfection. Highly recommend! || Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback. We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the brunch, the atmosphere, and the service from our team. It is a pleasure to receive such recommendations and we look forward to welcoming you back soon at Bread & Friends. || The tomato mozzarella toasts are very good . The fries are not fresh at all , cold and not crunchy , ruined my dish. The pastel de nata was a 6 out of 10 not the best I had. The orange jus is not fresh. || Thank you for sharing your feedback.  We’re glad to hear that you enjoyed the tomato mozzarella toasts. Your comments are important to us, and we will certainly look into improving these aspects.  We appreciate your input and hope to have the opportunity to provide a better experience in the future.  Kind regards, The Bread & Friends Team

I came through here on my round trip through Lisboa by foot and found the little tables outside in the street next to the tramway very welcoming. So I sat down and finally achieved to try the famous Pastel de Nata and Pastel de Bacalhau in here. Just amazing, with a little espresso on top I felt very blessed by these little food gems and this beautiful city in general. The working staff were also highly kind people, thanks for these marvellous impressions. || Excellent service and Portuguese food, great product quality and freshness of ingredients. Fair prices. Our highlight was that the staff perfectly guided us through the tons of allergies my wife has. Memorable and highly recommended. || Special Bifana and beer! Awesome sandwich and the bread it’s on was out of this world! Fresh, crusty, soft so good! Great French fries, nice and crispy! Definitely need to stop for a bite and cold one! || Thank you, come back anytime. || Came across this cute place by chance and had the best breakfast! A wonderful brioche croissant with egg, ham and cheese along with a flat white coffee and the juice of the day (this day - orange and red berry) was amazing! This place is definitely a must stop if you're walking your way from the National Pantheon to the city center. One of the trams passes by and if you snag a seat outside, it makes for a fun view. || Thank you very much, please come back again soon. || Came across this place and a great breakfast! We had a brioche croissant with egg and cheese along with a flat white coffee and a juice of the day. As well as chocolate pancakes. Everything was tasty and the service was very friendly. || Wow what a great surprise. Found this place on the go with the cute little terrace next to the tramline. Great food for a great price. We tried two of the day menus and both were amazing and included a glass of wine! Service was very good as well. Friendly staff and good recommendations. 10/10 would recommend! || A place with a great atmosphere, delicious food, and excellent service. The waiter was very attentive and truly outstanding. The sangria was my favorite. Would definitely come back || We visited this place for brunch and totally enjoyed it! They have a vast menu to choose from. The owner was a pleasure to talk to and provided great service. He made sure to accommodate our requests. Totally recommend. Bonus- you can sit outside and enjoy looking at the trams passing by :) || Had such a lovely meal we picked up to take home after a hot afternoon. Enjoyed a terrific mint lemonade with such great balance of flavor. Pastel de nata was amazing. I had a pork dish with olives and potatoes, in a flavorful light sauce. One of the best meals in my two monts of travel. Simple, delicious! || This place is a gem, 100% would recommend  🫶🏼 the team is sooo sweet, the food is great & home made, the place is chill, you’ll feel right at home. Obrigada 🫰🏼 || Thank you so much 💝 …

A hidden gem in Lisbon! 🥐☕ If you are looking for an authentic experience, Pastelaria Camões is the place to be. It’s a wonderful local café with a great atmosphere where you’ll meet more locals than tourists. The highlight is definitely their pistachio croissants – honestly the best I’ve ever had! They are fresh, generously filled, and absolutely delicious. On top of that, the staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy the city’s vibe. Highly recommended for anyone who wants a true taste of Lisbon! || Good coffee, good service and yummlishes pastries. Many locals frequent the cafe so a good place to feel the local vibes. We visited again before we left Lisbon for home. || Lovely coffee, fresh pastries from the oven, great prices and friendly staff. When we asked for a pau con chorizo which they didn’t have out yet, they very kindly grabbed one straight from the oven for us which was incredible - you have to try this! This was our morning ritual while we stayed close by. || love the coconut taste! very nice coffee too! a cute local bakery that worths stopping by and just pick something to try. you won’t be disappointed! || Very nice, busy, pastry shop, where you'll only find locals (so that's a good sign). Perfect place to start your day trying traditional desserts, and have a decent coffee. For a rissóis, a pão de deus and an espresso only 4.30€..who can beat that.. || Delicious desserts at an affordable price, friendly and polite service. A wonderful cappuccino. || We visited this place while searching for breakfast in the area and were pleasantly surprised to find this cozy dining spot.  The atmosphere felt very welcoming, and it appeared to be a popular spot among locals.  The lady staff was exceptionally friendly and took the time to explain the menu to us, ensuring we understood the dishes and got exactly what we wanted.  We ordered a few dishes that seemed traditional. I had a rice dish with a hint of fish and shredded potato, which was incredibly flavorful with a great texture.  We also tried their pastel de nata, topped with cinnamon powder, which was fresh, light, and tasted homemade.  The diner was clean, the food was delicious with plenty of options, the portions were just right, and the prices were reasonable.  Overall, it was a great experience, and I would highly recommend visiting this spot for a delicious and authentic meal. || Must go place when in Lisbon. Very lovely staff. Lidl price but ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ quality || We were accommodated near Camões and every morning we had a breakfast there, because the pastries and coffee are delicious. Special thanks to the local waiter. It is probably the best waiter we have ever come across. So kind and attentive, even when it’s always full there. Thank you, we will definitely come back! || We loveeed this place. There are lots of options to eat and cheap prices with good quality. The staff is also great and fun. || I discovered this traditional bakery when I was in a hurry to buy breakfast in the city centre. It looked so popular within the neighbourhood that I decided to have breakfast here 3 days in a row. All the food and drink I tried was fresh and delicious, especially the pastel de nata! The pastry was crispy, and the filling was sweet, rich and creamy. Cheap price, very friendly staff and amazing service. Missing the happy atmosphere there! || Pastries was so nice that attract us to taste all differents kind. Good recomendation from the waitress and the charming boss. They deserve super thumbs up both food and services. || This place is very authentic.  I saw mostly locals.  The service was excellent.  I got the coffee with milk with really good.  I got the bread with butter and some local savory stuff.  Again top notch.  Came here 2x || during our 3 days in lisbon we visited this place 3 times. i think i became addicted to their pastel the nata with pistachio cream… we also tried their savory pastries, coffee, rice pudding and cakes and everything was literally perfect! staff is also amazing || Best cafe latte I’ve had in Lisbon so far. Smooth! Staff speak excellent English, are friendly & efficient. Very busy breakfast rush, but still tables available. Chairs have cute “coffee bean” backs. Lots of savoury and sweet pastries including chocolate-filled or brioche varieties of croissant. I had a delicious savoury filo pastry (1/4 circle shaped) with a smooth filling. (I don’t know what it actually was, but I would have it again!) So many sweet treats 🤤 I got the house special (broa de mel) to take away for later. Free Wifi! (Password on wall) I lovely walk, but if you’re driving there’s nderground paid parking (Telpark, see App) nearby. || Amazing, Great service and everything is delicious. I went 5 times || Delicious pastries and coffee. The pastel de nata was great so they do sell out, therefore you must visit early in the day to try them. The man behind the counter was very kind and polite. || This small Portuguese bakery is perfect!  The pastries are delicious and freshly made, with great variety and flavor.  Prices are very reasonable, and the owner is incredibly attentive and welcoming.  A perfect spot for a tasty treat! || There are two reasons why a place is always packed with locals. Either cheap or / and good.  This pastry shop has both!! Delicious cakes. Good coffee. Friendly service. A good vibe place. || Very good quality, quick service, nice staff, value for money and cosy atmosphere.  Try the pistacchio croissant 😋 … || A gem in the neighbourhood, local feel. The coffee was great and pastries are amazing. It was crowded but the staff was still nice. Came back there several times! || Amazing pastries and coffee. Their cheese bread is out of this world. Place is full of  locals so it's a sign they have the best goods tried many other places in lisbon and this one is the best by far! || Delicious bakery. You must try the pistachio pastel de nata. || Very nice breakfast spot and it had great quality and was very cheap. Personnel also friendly and helpful. Can recommend the croissants and pastel de nata. || A must stop when in Lisbon. My wife and I spent 7 days exploring Lisbon. You can keep to all the tourist areas and it is all the same. We were exploring off the beaten path and just stumbled upon this place. The window filled with all handmade drew us in. So welcoming even though we only spoke English it was fun connecting and pointing out what we were wanting to try.  We made it a must stop daily as we explored.  We are coming back next year with some friends and we will be bringing them here.  Just a heads up it’s not open on Saturday. With how hard everyone was working there I would take a day of rest also. || An amazing local place for breakfast & snacks! Super friendly all staff (Miguel is superstar), clean canteen, toilets, wifi and local vibe! Place has pastries, different drinks and main courses!  Always coming back here! Strongly recommend! || The best pastelaria in Lisboa! Friendly staff who can speak english! Great coffee and pastries 😋  You have to try the Pastel de Chaves here 😉🥰 || What a great place to stop for a coffee and pastry. Quick service, amazing value (see pic of bill for proof!!) and pastries that will require a few kms of running to work off !! || Pastelaria Camoes was an amazing discover in the center of Lisbon. We found this place casually: we were walking in one the most turistic areas of the city and we were attracted by the "local" look of this pastelaria.  Unlike many other places, Pastelaria Camoes is popular among portoguese people. And there is a reason why! The food is incredibly good and the staff is extremely friendly with everybody, tourists and locals.  We loved every single "pastel" we had (they were very good) and we really appreciated the helpfulnes of Miguel, one of the staff members. If our experience in Lisbon was great its also because of them!  We really recomend it! (Mattia and Antonella) || Very local and affordable prices, mostly the people there is Portuguese, the service was excellent, they were super kind with me, I spent few hours and I felt them very smooth, amazing place to go alone or with your beloved ones, they have plenty of sweets and also traditional meals (Plato del dia) very recommended 🫶🏻 they have WiFi and nice restrooms :)

Very nice sandwich and an exceptionally delicious caramel macchiato. Great quality, fresh flavors, and a pleasant atmosphere. Definitely enjoyed the experience and would happily return. || From start to finish, my visit to Paul on Rua Augusta was a top-notch experience. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with cozy seating and soft lighting that’s perfect for a relaxed lunch or evening treat. The staff was friendly, attentive, and genuinely seemed to care that you enjoy every bite.  The menu offers a beautiful mix of French and Portuguese flair. I loved their flaky pastries, fresh salads, and the way they balance flavors with finesse. The bread baskets were irresistible (of course!), and their signature desserts were just the right sweet note to end on. Portion sizes were generous without feeling excessive.  In such a busy tourist area, Paul stands out for consistency and quality. If you’re strolling down Rua Augusta and fancy a break with good food, excellent service, and a comfortable atmosphere, this is a 5-star pick. || Just beautiful.   They make their bread and pastries fresh every day.  This family run bakery serves the most delicious food right on the heart of Lisbon.  Their food and service was exceptional.   With outside and inside dining. || Amazing place! Me and my family stayed several nights nearby and this was our go to place for food, both to takeout and dine in. I really loved their bread loafs for making sandwiches and breakfast toasts. And the times we dined there were also great, no complaints about anything. Quick tip: heat their sandwiches if you can || This place has super friendly staff, great sandwiches, amazing patisseries and bread. They have reasonable prices for being in such a touristy spot. Would recommend 100% || Good breakfast, their pastries 🍰 are very delicious. || The staff are rude. 5 minutes after I sat down, the waiter came and took away my plate of food. 5 minutes later, another waiter came to take away half my coffee. I paid 15 euros for an empty tuna sandwich. I would not recommend it at all. || Dear  Rami, We apologize for what happened and thank you for sharing your feedback with us. The experience you describe does not correspond to the quality that we want and are proud to offer to those who visit us. We will report what happened internally so that situations of this type do not occur again. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us, it is very important to us and helps us to improve. || Delicious food - dishonest attitude. Origins: The building itself dates to a period shortly after 1899, and the bakery was officially inaugurated in 1914, featuring its unique interior design. Art Nouveau Style: The interior is a beautifully preserved example of Portuguese Arte Nova, which flourished in Portugal between roughly 1905 and 1920. This style was a reaction against rigid academic forms, embracing organic lines and natural motifs, particularly popular in port cities like Lisbon and Porto. Key Features: Tiles (Azulejos): The interior is adorned with bright, Art Nouveau tiles that have a recurring motif of wheat, a fitting symbol for a bakery. Architecture: It features massive pink marble columns and counters, antique mirrors, and a gracefully curved or vaulted ceiling. We can't wait to see you again soon for another great experience! || Talking about Lisbon bars, what comes to mind? The typical, cheap drinks, and so on. But this bar is something entirely different. An incredible reflection of a medieval atmosphere at the crossroads of the modern century. It's amazing that there are people who skillfully combine old things with new, understanding the value of each item. Do you know what really surprised me? A chessboard in the middle of the bar. People who come not only to drink alcohol but also to socialize and find common interests. That's what's really valuable today. I would especially like to highlight the alcohol in the bar. On the shelves, you won't find the cheap, typical Portuguese rum or tequila. Instead, you'll get the highest quality alcohol that can be found in Lisbon. The extensive cocktail menu has no limits. You can order cocktails that aren't on the menu, and they will definitely make it for you. Personally, I liked that the bar has a wide selection of non-alcoholic drinks: wines, champagne, beer. The bar is suitable for both lively groups and romantic dates. You can even visit the bar alone, but trust me, you won't remain alone. The bartenders won't let you get bored, and the bar owner, who is always present and oversees everything, ensures that everything runs smoothly. This is what true passion for your craft looks like. || Thank you for your great review! We're happy you enjoyed our medieval-style atmosphere and the blend of old and new vibes. It's awesome that you liked our chessboard for socializing and our selection of top-notch drinks, including custom cocktails. Our team works hard to make everyone feel welcome, whether you're with friends or on a date. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

Tucked away in one of Lisbon’s charming streets, 1869 Cocktail Boutique is a hidden gem for anyone who loves creative, well-crafted drinks served in a classy, intimate setting.  We tried the Espresso Martini, which was perfectly balanced — smooth, velvety, with just the right kick of coffee and sweetness. It’s one of those cocktails that shows real craftsmanship: chilled just right, topped with a silky foam, and beautifully presented. The Rooibos-based cocktail with a touch of whisky was a pleasant surprise — aromatic, slightly smoky, and incredibly refined. It had that perfect balance between tea-like softness and whisky depth, making it one of the most unique drinks we’ve had in Lisbon.  The atmosphere is elegant yet cozy, with soft lighting, good music, and bartenders who truly know their art. It’s the kind of place where every detail feels intentional — from glassware to garnishes.  Whether you’re starting the night or ending it on a smooth note, 1869 Cocktail Boutique is the perfect choice for sophisticated, beautifully made drinks in the heart of Lisbon. || Such an amazing place! Very spacious and beautiful, with a great atmosphere and really nice music that sets the vibe perfectly.  The cocktails are outstanding and beautifully made, and the service is just WOW - warm, attentive, and on another level. Prices were similar to many other bars we visited in Lisbon, but the atmosphere and service here were definitely better than most.  Monkey Mash and Red Frog (one of the Top 50 speakeasies in the world) are their sister bars, so you can expect the same quality, but this place feels very independent and unique. Don’t skip it if you’re in Lisbon, this cocktail bar delivers on every level. || What an amazing and surprising experience at 1868 Cocktail Boutique. This really feels like a hidden bar with so much character. The atmosphere is stylish and intimate, with elegant décor and warm lighting that makes you want to stay all night. The staff were incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, and the service was very professional and helpful. You can tell they love what they do. They explained the stories behind their cocktails and made the whole experience even more memorable.  The food came in small portions, but each dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. We tried the batatas, cachorrinho, bolinhas de bacalhau, and crudo de robalo, and every bite stood out. From the wine list, they only had the Altitude Douro by the glass, and it paired perfectly with the food. It is clear that here the kitchen is not just supporting the bar with snacks, but creating thoughtful dishes that elevate the whole experience.  Prices are a little higher than a casual bar, but for what you get it is absolutely worth it. Plan around 30 to 40 euros per person for food and drinks. Located at Largo Barão Quintela 14 in Lisbon’s Bairro Alto/Chiado area, it is easy to miss from the outside, but once you step in, it feels like a secret you are lucky to have found.  I only wish I had discovered this place earlier. Between the creative cocktails, the professional and attentive service, and the amazing food, this has to be one of the best cocktail bars in Lisbon. || What a great place!  They don’t have much signature cocktails, but can make you a lot of classics and the bartender who served us was a real professional. The food was amazing as well- we loved the table side beef tartar preparation.  Highly recommended! || Outstanding bar.  Excellent cocktails and nibbles.  The chocolate cake was delicious.  I had the Negroni flight. All were tasty.  Bruno, the bar tender, is personable and knowledgeable.  Lara, also bartender is experienced and charismatic.  And the bar is quite pretty.  The first night, we arrived early evening and had great service.  As we left it started jumping.  The second night, we arrived later.  Super elegant vibe and fun experience.  Go there! || I was walking in beautiful Chiado, without a destination.  So I Googled "best bar near me".  I wasn't dissapointed!! Google delivered, as always. It got me to this BEAUTIFUL bar. Like so beautiful. The ceiling and tapestries on the wall reslly give it a vibe. I hope you can see that from my terrible camera.  The place is just a vibe, really. It seems very classic, which I suppose it's the idea given their name. The tapestries are flowers in a forest in blackish, greenish and goldenish tones, that go really well with the rest of the space. The furniture is all wooden or black marble. The couches are top notch, and they have real plants that complement all of this.  You have multiple light bulbs that hang from the ceiling, like magical balls. Everything is dim here, giving it a perfect frequency for intimacy, privacy and romance. Perfect for dates and for celebrating special ocassions.  The service is amazing. I got a "hi" from Lara the momment I walked in, which made me feel very welcomed (I came alone by the way). I sat right in front of the "kitchen" and spoke to her, something that really adds a value to a bar. Especially when they are classic.  I didn't get to try the food, but it looked really good. Quite gourmet and decent sizes. Will def come back.  All in all, a hidden gem for sure. Crazy how after 4 years in this beautiful city, I only met this bar tonight.  And by accident.  Oh and the playlist. I left this at last because I'm ashamed. I shazamed 7 songs ok byeeeeeee hahaah || A very interesting concept bar. I don't usually like these sorts of places that have a tiny selection of spirits, with everything prebatched, and so regimented with the menu because there's very little room for creativity or personalization.  However! This place does 'concept bar' better than so many others I've been to. It specializes in two spirits, and all their options are based upon these. What stands out is that the variations of the martinis are actually unique and each has a distinct profile. Same goes for the negroni flight. Some of the best Negroni riffs I've ever had. Beeswax for the win!  They have other menu cocktails, but the true stars are the martini and negroni variations.  The staff is also excellent. Truly welcoming and helpful and seem to love what they do. A place like this lives or dies on its staff, and every single person working here made it a memorable visit. So much so, that we came back again!  Definitely a classy little joint that I would love to return to. || We had a great experience at the 18.68 cocktail bar! The staff was super engaged and the drinks were prepared with love and care. They tasted great and we really loved the chic ambience of the bar!  Prices are totally fair for the experience and excellent quality you get. We highly recommend this cocktail bar! || The service here was completely unmatched for our whole trip, so much so we went back for more another night! Bruno was the one who waited on us and he was a fantastic mixologist. He really understands how to make an excellent, well balanced drink. He even made a few things off the menu for us which were just as good, if not better. He and all his colleagues were warm, welcoming and we were sad to leave. When we return, we will definitely be stopping at 1868 again! || Fantastic place. Highly recommend. Bruno - our bartender - was referred to us by one of the servers at Alma the night before. He was an absolute gem. My wife loves Negronis and did the tasting flight - each one was spectacular and Bruno took the time to explain all the intricate details of each one and how they’re made in house. Great conversation. Great drinks. Gorgeous space. Couldn’t ask for more.

place_name: Pink Bar - The smallest bar in town
reviews_content: Sweet super tiny bar in Lisbon. Fortunately got here early and didn’t have to wait in any crazy lines like they had later on. Unsure if I ordered wrong both times but the drinks were quite rough || Great bar one of the best in town Best cocktails And the shots Great recommendation || They do not ask you what exchange rate you want to pay and force you to pay the 5% markup if you're using USD. || We recommend customer to pay in EUR,and its the customer who choose the currency . || Good drinks, owners, talkings. Pink cocktail was perfect. 5/5 || Exactly what it says it is. Good fun to have a beer from there. || Savory and tasteful takeaway cocktails for the right price. Not cheap because these cocktails are pretty loaded. There's a superman behind the counter || I love it here!!  Best drinks best vibes like… crazy from such a small place || Nice spot for a drink on the go! Great service and highly recommend || Best experience, great music and good vibes! Great prices too. || Nice place to drink cocktails. Funny and happy bartender.

Finally, a place skipping the standard cocktails and offering crazy experiences instead. We went through, for example, whisky with bone marrow. We really enjoyed their approach. This is extreme training for taste buds. Highly recommend. || I came here with my boyfriend, I felt so comfortable, humorous, and the choice to come here was the best thing I have made in Lisbon. Unforgettable experience! As homosexual we feel that is a friendly place and the service is fantastic. A beautiful experience with wonderful cocktails! The italian boy was super kind to us and the bartender too! We recomend it! 🍻 || Truly incredible cocktails. George and Julio mixed wonderful renditions on some classics. Come for the familiar drinks but stay for the refined execution and friendly service. || Thanks for your words. See you soon || The bar has a very chill vibe. Our server George was very nice and extremely knowledgeable about cocktails. He made some great recommendations. We will be back! || TLDR: unique cocktails and amazing customer service.  This spot is a nice hidden gem! We've been to Lisbon a few times and had never explored this area. This bar was a pleasant surprise. The drink menu is detailed and a tad atypical. The specialty drinks are tailored towards Lisbon the culture and food in one way or another.  The music was pleasant and modern hip hop and r&b (not sure if that's everyday of bartender choice).  Selma helped us throughout the evening. She was kind, energetic and explained the cocktails thoroughly when we ordered in the event we were unsure of the flavor profile.  We also had the duck and octopus highly recommend trying these snacks! || Definitely more a cocktail bar ++ with some wine also offered. Awesome place with very unique and interesting ingredients. They built their menu from the flavours of their favourite places around Lisbon and give you a menu that mentions the place the cocktails flavours are inspired by and the local foods that are available around there. They don't shy away from pushing the borders of "cocktail ingredients" and have come up with really interesting and tasty ingredients that add layers of flavor to their cocktails.  After tasting it I could tell they are very passionate about the flavors they create and after speaking to them I know for sure. They are super passionate about polushinng the boundaries of cocktails and bringing people rhe experience of their favourite areas of Lisbon in new and unexpected ways.  Really really cool concept, will be returning!  P.S. if you're looking at the photos of the menu, the numbers on the right of the list are not prices but page numbers. The average price for a cocktail is around 13 eur as far as i've seen so far. || Klandestino is a fantastic cocktail bar! It's got a chill vibe, serves up original and delicious drinks, and the staff is super knowledgeable. A must-visit for great cocktails and a relaxed atmosphere! || You're not going to find more curated cocktails anywhere! Every drink on the menu has been carefully crafted with a lot of thought and passion. I had the El Nativo and it was nothing like I'd ever tasted before. It was a trip in all the best ways.  Also the owners/bartenders make zines about their drinks!! 🤩  Also they are so hospitable and will make you feel at home in Lisbon.  Also the atmosphere is very cool but also fun. || Absolutely incredible cocktail bar just off the main drag.  Jorge was super knowledgeable and passionate about the drinks and the quality homemade ingredients.  We came for one after dinner drink and ended up in a great conversation with the bartender team and stayed for hours.  I can't wait to return! || Amazingly creative cocktails, Jorge and Thais were super hospitable and guided us in finding our new favorite cocktails in Lisbon. || George and Thais are extremely friendly. The environment is cozy and I indeed will go back there. This place deserves more more than 5 stars. || We were walking around and sort of stumbled on this place. We had some really lovely cocktails which were well-explained by the server and we got a few tapas free with the drinks because of a happy hour special. We got the twist on a basil smash and an espresso martini. These were both amazing. The basil smash even had matcha powder around the glass. Highly recommend for some casual cocktails. Great environment, drinks, and snacks. || Had a wonderful time, the drinks, the food, and the music were exceptional. Thanks to Jorge for his excellent service and friendly/welcoming vibes. This cocktail bar is a gem in Lisboa that you'll never forget! Highly recommended :) || Our first weekend in Lisbon, we returned twice to Cafe Klandestino. Good music, good vibes and Ricardo and Selma were very friendly, given us lots of places to check out in Lisbon. The cocktails were unique and delicious! Thank you guys for the great time! (Our favourites were the Beez, Urbano and the OG) || Arguably the best cocktail bar myself and my partner have ever visited. Selma and Flavia were on the bar, were exceptionally welcoming, and took the time to talk to us, take us through the menu, and the processes and ingredients involved in making the cocktails. We had 6 cocktails between us, the quality of all of them were exceptional. All very different, all well executed, and all very individual. The music was excellent. The food was good too. Literally couldn't find fault with anything.  I would seriously recommend anyone visiting Lisbon to try this bar. You won't be disappointed. One of the nicest... if not the nicest experience of our whole trip.  The total bill was around 80 Euros for 6 drinks, and a couple of plates of food. It was worth every penny. We were there for 3 hours or so, and were made to feel at home.  They were also kind enough to offer us ideas for the rest of our trip.  A truly exceptional place. || Decided to walk here after a day of shopping on the main strip Liberdade.  The atmosphere is very chill and an easy place to relax and enjoy a great handcrafted cocktail.  We ordered the Sneaky (pornstar martini twist), Indya (London mule twist), Ex-Press (espresso martini twist), & Mucky (Paloma twist). You can the bartender takes his time and focuses on the ingredients. Very much handcrafted and delicious. 😋 To finish the cocktails off we tried a Campari infused with coffee. Talk about a burst of flavors. Definitely an acquired taste. 😂  The service was good which I don’t often see in a bar. She thoroughly explained each drink and the flavors in it. It’s off the beaten path but a great place to hang out and relax for a well made cocktail.  *only gave 3 stars for food because we didn’t order food* || Four cocktail bars during my visit, and this took second place when only considering the drink uniqueness, variety, and price. The service was great, and I felt very welcomed, which always boosts the experience. The drink themes and quality for the price were excellent, and the atmosphere definitely has the dive bar feel, but with great cocktails. Overall, it is a great place to try unique cocktails made by great staff. || Simply Outstanding Cocktails. Very inventive and delicious. Funky lounge vibe with friendly and personalised service from a talented staff. I've hear they've won awards and it shows. Prices also good value. Highly Recommend!!! || This is NOT a Jazz Bar.  They do NOT have live music. With that said, it's a cool vibe spot that does play music selections. || Hands down the most unique cocktail bar I have ever been too!! Such a great concept of creating cocktails inspired by key parts of Lisbon. The employees were all very attentive and eager to talk about the drinks Highly recommend stopping by!

We did a cocktail workshop with the bartender Stefano, and it was an incredible experience we absolutely loved it! We were a group of nine and had a total of five cocktails: one welcome drink and four that we made ourselves. The workshop was very well organized; Stefano explained everything clearly, and we had so much fun. Definitely worth it and something we’d love to repeat! || Hi Sandra, thanks for the kind review! it was a pleasure hosting your group at Rumours, looking forward to welcoming you back soon! || We booked the B.Y.O.B. experience and had a fantastic evening. Stefano isnvery knowledgable and mixed super tasty cocktails with the whiskey we brought. The venue, inside the Opium bar, was lovely. There was nice music and other guests we chatted with, so overall a great experience. || Hi Kristin, it was a pleasure to have you at Rumours, thanks for the kind review! || We went here after dinner for a nightcap. It turned out to be a great idea. The cocktails were excellent. It was nice to see some creativity in the cocktails rather than the same 5-7 drinks that are on every menu. We wound up having 2 drinks each and they were all wonderful with unique ingredients. I’m just sorry we didn’t find this place until our last night in Lisbon. || Hi Eric, we are happy to hear you had a great time with us and thanks for the review! || This past week Rumours hosted our Welcome Drinks for our destination wedding. From the beginning, Stefano was very professional, quick to respond, and provided great insight.  The drinks were beautiful, creative, and delicious.  The atmosphere was perfect and Stefano coordinated a piano player for us which added to the experience.  Nothing but smiles at this event.  We can’t thank Stefano and his staff enough. || Thank you Olivia, it was a pleasure hosting this important event, we wish you all the best! || If you are in Lisbon, and a fan of craft cocktails, or even just interested in learning more about them, Rumor’s BYOB cocktail experience is a MUST! Stephano may tell you he’s shy, but in reality he is both a performer and a craftsman (and maybe a wizard). Amazing drinks with unique ingredients, and lovely conversation. Cannot recommend highly enough. || Thank you for the fun night and nice review, great pictures too!! || Last week, I had an amazing night at Stefano's bar during a BYOB experience. From the moment we arrived, Stefano was super nice and welcoming. Since we were the only ones there, we got his full attention, which made the night feel really special.  Stefano's passion for cocktails is evident in every aspect of his service. We spent the evening chatting with Stefano about cocktails, life, and everything in between. Even though I'm not usually a cocktail person, I absolutely loved every single one of his creations - balanced, creative, and delicious. The flavors were surprising and delicious, and you could tell Stefano really knows his stuff.  If you're looking for a relaxed, personalized night out with great drinks, I highly recommend checking out Stefano's bar. || Thank you very much Ana, it was a pleasure having you || This is my favorite cocktail spot in the city. Stefano makes cocktails that are complex and incredible. Do not miss this spot. The space is comfortable with good relaxing music. || Hi Kelly, thank you very much for the kind review! || Was part of a group who did the cocktail making class and we had a blast! Stefano was super attentive to us all and everyone made some delicious cocktails they loved. Thank you so much! ❤️ || Hi Triona, thank you very much for the kind review, it was a pleasure to host your group! || I was so excited because my friend was visiting Lisbon for the first time, and I really wanted to make our evening together special. I had heard about this place, so I decided to give this experience a shot. We were a group of 5, and we made sure to book in advance. When we arrived, we had no idea what to expect.  But let me tell you... Stefano, the owner and the most amazing bartender, completely surpassed our expectations. He introduced himself to us and  talked about different cocktail ideas. We told him what flavors we liked, and he created the most incredible and delicious recipes. Each cocktail was even better than the last. It was such a fun experience, filled with laughter and anticipation to see what Stefano would come up with next. I can't recommend this bar enough. You won't be disappointed! WE WILL DEFINITELY BE BACK! || Thank you very much Joyce, looking forward to welcome you back soon! || We enjoyed our evening at Rumors with Stefano.  Our drinks were delicious and created perfectly to our preferences!  Stefano was super informative about other spirits and provided excellent recommendations.  In addition, we ordered the Smoked Turkey, Brie and Dry Apricot sandwich and it was also delicious || Thank you for the kind review and amazing pictures! || Stephano the owner is an amazing host and an excellent bartender. We tasted 5 different cocktails with the BYOB Experience.All the cocktails were very unique and delicious. We can that the passion and the experience of stephano creation in every cocktail. Perfect for all taste. Would recommend to everyone in lisbon and will go back for sure. || Thank you very much for the kind review || One of my favorites to try out new cocktails in Lisbon. The owner who is also the barman pays attention to every detail when it comes to combining different tastes that I could never think of! The place is cozy but not too crowded either. Can definitely recommend the BYOB experience. || Thank you very much for the positive feedback!! || We had the B.Y.O.B. experience and it was AMAZING! At that particular day we were the only reservation so we had a lot of talking with Stefano at the bar who entertained us the whole night. The food actually was very good too and so I recommend this experience with no doubt, he really understood the flavors we wanted in the 5 cocktails and he nailed it. Thank you Stefano! hoping to come back soon with new ideas :) || Thank you very much Andrea for the kind review and the great pictures! || MUST DO IN LISBON Highlight of our Portuguese trip. Stefano blew our mind with his extensive cocktail knowledge. We had 5 fabulous cocktails with a massive range of spices,oils, pickled fruits. Stefanos passion really shone through we could of sat at rumours all night talking and drinking his incredible concoctions all whilst in a really personal intimate experience. not to be missed. We will be back whenever we are in Lisbon. || Hi George, it was really fun to host you, thanks for your review! || Stefano was amazing, friendly and chatty, great life stories and cocktail knowledge!  Mixes are some of the best I’ve had, you can definitely taste all the experience and passion Stefano puts into the art!  Def will come back || Thank you for the amazing review, looking forward to be welcoming you back soon at Rumours! || This place was highly recommended and it did not miss. We were only able to stay for an hour and Stefano was gracious enough to let us do 3 drinks instead of 5. All drinks had their own unique twist and expertly curated, with Stefano providing an explanation of why they go well together. A highly underrated part of this is getting to interact with Stefano, who was highly conversational and made the drinking experience even better. A must go if you’re in Lisbon, even if you only have an hour! || Thank you very much Rufus and great pictures! || We did a Team building workshop and it was incredibly fun! Absolutely recommend this for groups! Our bartender teacher Stefano really took the experience from great to unforgettable! || Thank you very much for the great feedback Cesar, it was a pleasure hosting your company's event and meeting your team! || Heard about this place from a friend and booked for Friday night! It was an amazing experience. You bring your own liquor and the bar tender creates unique cocktails with fresh and home made ingredients. So Fun!!  I’m not normally a cocktail person but these were made based on my individual taste and preferred ingredients and I love every single cocktail (you get 5 in 2 hours). I definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Lisbon :) || Thank you very much for your kind review Ava! || This was a really cool experience in Lisbon! My friend and I booked for Saturday night and had a great time. Our flight was late getting in and we were worried about finding the alcohol to bring but we found a little shop as we were walking to Rumours (the shop wasnt on Google maps) but there were quite a few of them around!  The cocktails were all delicious and very interesting - we even had one with arugula! They were customized to our tastes and what we were feeling which was nice! This was a very cool experience and I would recommend it to anyone looking for something fun to do in Lisbon! || Hi Zoe, thank you very much for your kind review! || OMG! It was one of the best experiences ever !!! After looking at the reviews of this place, I had high expectations and still was blown out of the water by how great this was. Words can not describe how great this experience was. From the intimate setting, Stefanos' knowledge and passion, and of course the drinks themselves, my girlfriend and I had just a FANTASTIC time. We gave him fairly vague ideas of what kinds of flavours we wanted with each cocktail, and every time Stefano knocked it out of the park. He gave us such a delightful course of drinks from sweet to spicy to a Nutella dessert drink to finish off the night. We also had a Procheta sandwich that was once again beyond our expectations. Perfect for a date and I believe Stefano could cater to any friend group. As my girlfriend and I were talking about the experience on the way home, we both agreed that we would recommend doing this to anyone coming to lisbon. We came early around 5pm and the main dining area doesn’t open until after 7pm, thus we’re were near the bar in a very comfy and cozy area. Your wonderful compliments will be passed out to all the 146Bar team, in particular to those who took such good care of you.   We hope to welcome you back again very soon.  Best regards,   Nuno Ribeiro ,  Guest Service || Francisco and Mauro were both excellent and deserve all the praise for their service and attention. The cocktails were amazing and the food was excellent as well. || Dear Jorge Hernandez Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! We are absolutely thrilled to hear that Francisco and Mauro provided such excellent service and attention—they truly are outstanding, and we will be sure to share your kind words with them! We’re also delighted that you loved our amazing cocktails and excellent food. Your praise means the world to us!  We can't wait to welcome you back for another fantastic experience!  Best regards, Nuno Ribeiro  Business Intelligence  GreatCreation Collection Hotels || This is place is definitely our favourite bar in the whole town! Fabulous drinks, full of creativity and deliciousness, professional staff and amazing service. We stayed in Lisbon 5 nights and ended up here almost every single night! The place itself is also a wonderfully cozy and friendly, the music is not so loud so you can actually relax, have conversation and enjoy a well made drink. the service was exceptional, and everything I got was based on their recommendations. the avo toast was a 10/10, and since they don’t have regular lemonade, they offered me this “lemonaid” which I really liked, it comes in different flavors. the place is beautiful, cozy, and super comfortable to work from || Wonderful the most delicious coffee I tasted , very friendly stuff , it has small terrace and nice quiet place to work or come for a brunch ! Lovely staff and great food and coffee. We came back a few times. || ## How About Coffee? Caffeinating Your Lisbon Experience with Delicious Delights  In the heart of Lisbon, where the aroma of freshly roasted coffee beans mingles with the city's vibrant energy, lies How About Coffee? - a café that lives up to its name and beyond. More than just a caffeine pit stop, this charming spot offers a delightful culinary experience that tantalizes the taste buds and warms the soul.  **A Feast for the Senses:**  * **Salmon Sensation:** My personal highlight was the **exquisite salmon** bathed in a **luscious hollandaise sauce**. This dish is a must-try for avocado enthusiasts seeking a hearty and flavorful breakfast.  **Beyond the Plate:**  * **Charming Ambiance:** Stepping into How About Coffee? is like stepping into a warm hug. The cozy atmosphere, with its exposed brick walls and inviting décor, creates a space that feels both modern and comforting. * **Coffee Connoisseur's Paradise:** True to its name, the café boasts a **diverse selection of coffee**, expertly brewed to satisfy every palate. Whether you're a latte lover or an espresso aficionado, you're sure to find your perfect cup. * **Friendly Service:** The staff at How About Coffee? are the icing on the cake. They are attentive, welcoming, and knowledgeable, making you feel right at home from the moment you step in.  **In Conclusion:**  How About Coffee? is more than just a café; it's an experience. From the delectable dishes to the inviting atmosphere and friendly service, this hidden gem offers a taste of Lisbon that will linger in your memory long after you leave. So, when you're exploring the city and need a caffeine fix or a delicious bite, do yourself a favor and ask, "How About Coffee?" I couldn't fathom what would happen next. Coffee stopped tasting the same in other places. But OK, this is a small adjustment, I can live with it.  Then you try the filter coffee and you're gone. No other V60 will feel quite the same and you're stuck coming in every day.  You're thinking "this is not too bad...", but it is.  The barista is too friendly, and a lot of people come here just because of the dude.  Fernando, the musician who makes terrariums. Linde, and Frankie the coolest red toy poodle. Carlos, the music teacher who builds bicycles. Ana, the lawyer with a big heart. Fábio, who has the secret identity of DJ Quesadilla.  And this isn't even half ! Barry and Niall both agree Lisbon is better than London just because of this place. Roman came all the way from the US and got hooked faster than you can say "One cold brew please, nitro." And let's not forget Tom, who comes in with the chillest and coolest vibe, and leaves with a smile and a takeaway cup.  Don't even get me started on the staff. Marie, barista, opera singer, awesome. Juan, chef, coffee connoisseur, and amazing. Manuel, barista and hobby hoarder, unafraid of breaking the comfort zone. I could also go on about Tiago and Maira, the owners, and little Sofia who will be serving espressos in no time. But you got the idea by now: those 3 give this place a heart and soul.  Everyone else?  I've seen people come in and the weirdest thing happens. They have an espresso, and before finishing it, ask for the wifi password. Not a minute goes by and they're cancelling flights and looking for a place to rent in the neighbourhood.  They then find out about Malabarista and Milkees and end up having to take turns going around!  So, for your sake, stay away. There's a Starbucks down the road in Rossio, go there. Or to any roadside pastry shop, ask for a bica, talk with your friends how it's a burnt, bitter espresso. Then you'll go back home tell your friends "yeah Lisbon was great but the coffee here is better".  You'll be happy living in the ignorant bliss of not having tried the best café in Lisbon. reviews_content: Great little addition to the Alfama café row!  The gentleman that runs the place actually worked for Illy in Italy! Hands down really the best coffee Ive tried in Lisbon! Crafted to perfection! || Illy Espresso White Lady Coffee Alfama is a refined and indulgent coffee experience, offering a perfect balance of smoothness and flavor. The Alfama, a unique twist in this offering, adds a slight hint of aromatic spices, reminiscent of Lisbon’s iconic Alfama district. The warm, inviting flavors are both comforting and sophisticated, with the richness of espresso playing off the gentle sweetness of the milk. This drink is ideal for those seeking a luxurious, but approachable coffee experience, perfect for a leisurely morning or an afternoon pick-me-up.  It’s a great choice for anyone who enjoys the smoothness of a well-crafted espresso combined with a touch of milk-based sweetness. If you’re looking for something more refined than your average espresso, the White Lady Coffee Alfama delivers in both taste and presentation. || Great quality coffee for a cute location in Alfama. I recommend it. || Review of the Play "From Mary to Mary" The play "From Mary to Mary," by Paloma Pedrero, directed by Maria do Céu Guerra and performed by Rita Lello, is an intense and deeply emotional dive into the life and legacy of Mary Wollstonecraft, one of the pioneers of modern feminism and mother of Mary Shelley, the author of Frankenstein. This monologue, structured as an intimate dialogue between life and memory, presence and absence, is a spectacle that transcends time and places us face to face with the struggles and pains of a woman ahead of her time.  Text and Dramatic Construction Paloma Pedrero creates a text that is not limited to a conventional biography. Instead, the playwright presents Mary Wollstonecraft in all her complexity—revolutionary and fragile, determined and tormented. The monologue unfolds as a stream of consciousness, in which the protagonist reflects on her life, her ideas, her loves, and her disappointments, always with the shadow of patriarchy looming over her trajectory. Her relationship with her daughter, Mary Shelley, is one of the guiding threads of the performance, but there is also a strong focus on her fight for rights and her constant battle against the social norms of her time.  The performance skillfully balances the political and personal dimensions of the character. Wollstonecraft is not just a theoretical icon of feminism; she is a woman of flesh and blood who loved, suffered, wrote urgently, and died prematurely. The text emphasizes the protagonist's solitude, not only the solitude of premature death, but also the solitude of one who dares to challenge power structures.  Directed by Maria do Céu Guerra  Maria do Céu Guerra's staging respects the intensity of the text and creates an atmosphere that allows for the fusion of word and emotion. The simplicity of the stage design—a wise choice—gives total prominence to the actress's body and voice. The lighting effectively enhances moments of introspection and emotional explosion, creating scenes of great visual beauty. There is a clear emphasis on closeness with the audience, making the experience immersive and almost confessional.  Maria do Céu Guerra opts for a minimalist direction, but full of subtleties. Small gestures, charged silences, and calculated pauses are part of the staging's grammar, allowing the story to unfold without haste, but always with increasing intensity.  Rita Lello's Performance Rita Lello, who takes on the challenge of being the only presence on stage, delivers a masterful performance. Her Mary Wollstonecraft is fierce and vulnerable, full of strength, but marked by invisible scars. Her precise diction and the way she modulates her voice create a captivating spectacle from beginning to end.  The actress has an impressive command of both word and silence. There are moments when a simple look or a pause carries more meaning than a long speech. It's an interpretation that doesn't take refuge in didacticism, but delves into the depth of the character, allowing the audience to feel her anguish, her dreams, and her revolt.  Theme and Relevance "From Mary to Mary" is not just a portrait of the past; it is also a mirror of the present. Mary Wollstonecraft's struggle remains surprisingly relevant in a world where feminism still faces resistance and where women continue to fight for basic rights. The play questions the price of being a pioneer, of challenging norms, and of claiming a voice in a society that insists on silencing.  The show also invites reflection on the role of motherhood and intellectual legacy. What do we leave for those who come after us? How do our ideals survive the test of time? These are questions that resonate in the dramaturgy and make the play profoundly universal.  Conclusion "From Mary to Mary" is a show that confronts us with the urgency of memory and struggle. With an engaging script, understated staging, and a powerful performance by Rita Lello, the play rescues Mary Wollstonecraft from the past and places her at the center of the present.  An intense, moving, and necessary theatrical experience. || Good place to watch plays. || I returned to Barraca to see the play The Pessimist and enjoyed it, as is usual when I go to Barraca. Atmosphere: 7/10 Monarch sits in one of Lisbon’s popular nightlife areas. The vibe is casual yet accented with cool design elements that give it character. Music volume is good. The backbar looks nice, though seating at the counter is awkwardly split by a column. There are many tables available for groups.  Drinks: 7.5/10 Recommendation: Rub-A-Dub-Anana The menu is simple in design with a decent selection. Flavors are good and generally well balanced. Glassware is average, garnishes basic, and presentation minimal with little focus on ice or details. No coasters provided.  Service: 8/10 Water is served on arrival. The team is friendly and attentive, though professionalism could be sharper. Reservations aren’t needed. Prices run slightly above average for Lisbon. || Thank you so much for your review, Anton!
