We came off season on a Saturday night. Right away the staff was super nice and recommended us cocktails to our liking. 11/10 recommend. I felt very welcome and the place looked cozy and nice :) || Thank you so much for your review, Kadi! We're so happy to hear that you felt welcome, enjoyed the cocktails, the cozy atmosphere, and the service. We appreciate the recommendation and hope to welcome you back soon. || Short story: this is probably the best cocktail bar in the city. You must go. Long story: I stumbled upon this place after a surprise cancelation of a dinner reservation down the street (another story) and what an amazing turn of events! Tamara made me one of the best cocktails I’ve ever had and they recommended another restaurant to me and called to make sure I could get a seat and the food was incredible! Great drinks and but even better people here. Tamara, they took great care of me at Gunpowder thank you for turning my night around :) || Thank you for your feedback, Amber! We are so glad you enjoyed the experience and that the service made a difference to your evening. Tamara greatly appreciates your recognition and kind words. We hope to see you again soon. || My favorite bar in Lisbon hands down.  Friendly place and welcoming to English speakers.  The place is a clean, upscale, trendy establishment with comfortable seating.  The service was professional and friendly and the establishment really cared about the customer experience.  The drinks were artful and unique combinations, involving some different ingredients like rhubarb.  There was skilled mixology, care, pride, and passion that went into the cocktails.  The owner even helped us with researching and finding a restaurant.  I would frequent this place if I was a local. || Thank you so much for your review, Jason! We're glad you enjoyed the atmosphere, the cocktails, and the service from our team. It will always be a pleasure to welcome you back whenever you return to Lisbon! || Delicious cocktails with refined flavors. The bartender was incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the atmosphere was just perfect. Highly recommended! || Thank you so much for your review, Josephine! We're so glad you enjoyed the cocktails, the friendly service, and the atmosphere. Your recommendation is very important to us. || Monarch Bar in Lisbon was such a fun surprise. I came in expecting to order a Last Word, but Tamara suggested something off-menu—the Back Door Bandit—and it ended up being exactly what I didn’t know I wanted. It had the perfect balance of kick and spice, with just enough sour. The chipotle and habanero flavors were bold but smooth, and yes, the mix is homemade. WOW to the expert mixologist!!  Even their water was thoughtful—infused with macaron tea, light and floral without being sweet. The whole experience felt considered but totally unpretentious. The vibe was cool without trying too hard, and the service was warm and welcoming from the start. I’ll definitely be back to see what else Tamara has up her sleeve. || Maryam, thank you for the feedback! We work every day to create special moments, and knowing that it worked makes us happy.  Best regards, The Monarch Cocktail Bar || Monarch is a must-visit for anyone who truly appreciates top-quality cocktails. Every drink is beautifully balanced, made with great ingredients and real attention to detail — you can tell there’s serious craft behind each glass. The atmosphere is cozy and relaxed, and the service is amazing. Definitely a place worth coming back to! || Thank you so much for your review, Luis! We're delighted to know you appreciated the quality of the cocktails, the attention to detail, and the atmosphere of the place. We appreciate your kind words and hope to see you again soon. || We stepped inside and the bartender invited us in. You can sit at a cozy private table. We chose to sit at the bar and have fun conversation with other patrons and the owner. Was not crowded early on a weeknight during off peak season. We each enjoyed 2 cocktails that were priced as expected between 11-13 euros each for high quality crafted drinks. Our favorite drink was Backdoor Bandit. Would happily return and explore the menu more. || Thank you for your review, Emily! We are delighted to hear that you enjoyed the cocktails, the atmosphere, and the interaction with the staff and other customers. We appreciate your feedback and hope to welcome you back soon to explore more of our menu. || TL;DR: This is hands-down the best cocktail bar in Lisbon. Bigger review: Oddly enough I don't want you to know about this bar. I want to keep it all for myself... but since I'm not in Lisbon all the time, I don't mind sharing it that much. Excellent cocktails, amazing people and lovely atmosphere. If you're ever in the neighbourhood, dive in, and your tastebuds will thank you for it. Enjoy! || Thank you for your review, Bas! It's great to know that you consider our place one of the best cocktail bars in Lisbon and that you enjoyed both the drinks and the atmosphere. We really appreciate your kind words and hope to see you again whenever you're in the area. || A classy little cocktail bar that is tucked away just a short walk from the hustle and bustle of the Time Out Market and all the bars and restaurants in Cais do Sodre.  We came here on a recommendation from another Lisbon bartender, and it was a pleasant experience. Despite being a sophisticated looking place, it has a casual, relaxed feeling that invites you in. There's no pretentiousness here.  The day we tried, they were out of some of the menu due to a really busy night before, and I understand that happens at these small, independent bars that make their own infusions and batches. It was okay, because they have a decent backbar and were able to get all the classics we asked for. The cocktails we tried from the menu were good and solid, but didn't exactly wow. But they're definitely better than a lot of cocktail bars I've been to in Europe. Simple and classy, but with a flavour complexity that is still interesting. You'll find creations here that are very unique.  All were made well, and service was good. Definitely a strong choice for a place to come for a nice drink and chat with friends. If you want to avoid the packed, loud, stuffy bars in town and have a creative drink or classic cocktail made exactly how you like it, I'd recommend this spot. || Thank you for your positive review, Vee. We look forward to your next visit!  Best regards, The Monarch Cocktail Bar || These are some of the best cocktails we’ve ever had—absolutely spectacular! My number one from now on is “Blast from the Past”, but honestly, every drink we tried was incredible. On top of that, the place itself is beautiful, with a cozy, intimate vibe and great music. The owner, Ze, is such an awesome person and really makes the whole experience even better. We’re not from Lisbon, and we already know we’re really going to miss this spot. || Hi Silvija! Thank you very much for your words. It was a pleasure to meet you and Nerius. You guys are amazing! The kind we wont forget.  I hope to see you guys soon! A wine bar literally the size of my bedroom! The guys behind the bar are very knowledgeable and helpful, so a good glass or two or wine is guaranteed.  This is the first stop on my trip to Lisbon and I'm very happy indeed. || As travelers in Lisbon and natural wine lovers, we found this wine bar exceptional. We like the concept of no wine menu, just talk with the very kind, welcoming, calm, and knowledgeable sommeliers about your wine preferences, and they will let you try different wines until you find what you are searching for. I described the sommelier as “calm” because I mistakenly knocked the bottles of wine, which spilled about a glass on the floor, but he was genuinely calm and friendly. Their wine choices are great, and we were super blessed with what we tried. There are few food choices, but it's great for an after-dinner visit. || I loved this wine bar so much! It is vibrant, full of good wine choices, there is a park next to it where you can sit and enjoy your drink. Price per glass ranges from €6 to €20. The staff is cool, they let you sample wines before ordering and they also give you good recommendations. You can take tour glass to the park, but you need to leave a deposit. || Black Sheep Lisboa is a gem — an intimate, stylish wine bar with an outstanding selection and truly knowledgeable sommelier (also very handsome) bartenders. The staff pair wines with just the right notes and stories, making each pour feel curated. Cozy atmosphere, great small plates that complement the wines, and excellent recommendations whether you prefer natural, classic or adventurous bottles. A must-visit for anyone who loves wine and thoughtful service. Highly recommended. || Lots of wonderful memories at my favorite wine bar in Lisboa over the years. Yes the wine is always amazing, but the people even more so. Warm hearts always welcome you at Black Sheep—what makes it special. Obrigada || Amazing place I just discovered with a friend. We went to the side of the bar and were welcomed warmly. The bartender has a real knowledge about wine, switched between English and Portuguese with the two of us without any issue and has even told us more about the history of the bar and the owner.  Can’t remember the name of the bartender, but can’t wait to come back for moments like this || Black sheep is a gem. I loved that when I asked if "we could get weirder" with wine recommendations, we were brought a series of incredibly fun and funky wines. Black sheep delivers on everything -  local art, great wine recommendations, and unbeatable vibes. || What a shame. I moved to Lisbon the year this place opened, and I’ve watched it lose the soul it once had.  Tonight we went to Black Sheep for a friend’s celebration - 3 glasses, a few bottles, nothing complicated. When my friend left early, she returned her glass to the bar and even texted me to say so. Later, the staff insisted one glass was “missing” and refused to listen or consider anything we explained. We were charged for a glass we had already returned.  And here’s the thing: I understand the deposit system and why they use it. But when the system fails, the customer pays - even when the bar will inevitably find the glass later. That’s not just rigid, it’s getting money for something that wasn’t actually lost.  It wasn’t about the amount. It was the attitude: zero trust, zero curiosity, zero willingness to engage. Just a robotic “no.” It feels like customer care has been replaced by profit-first thinking.  If you want natural wine in the neighborhood, go to Magnolia or bring your own bottle to Praça das Flores. Black Sheep used to feel alive. Now it feels indifferent - guided more by turnover than by hospitality. || I cant give less than five stars. I went for the first time and got impressed by the service. They really know what they are talking about! They have a large variety of wines. Black sheep is usually crowded and almost impossible to have a seat on weekends. The tip here is to get there earlier so you can be able to have a full tasting experience while listen to the amazing stories of each bottle of wine you try! || Wonderful tiny wine bar serving “whatever we have open at the minute!” They let you taste a ton of wines to find one you love, and staff are super nice & knowledgeable. It can get packed so visit on a week day or just be patient. Totally worth it— the wine and vibes are amazing.

Jardim da Parada in Campo de Ourique is one of those rare places in Lisbon that feels genuinely local—quiet, shaded, and full of character. The garden is beautifully maintained, surrounded by big, old trees like sequoias and plane trees, with a small pond in the center where ducks and turtles paddle around peacefully. There’s a traditional bandstand, a nice playground for kids, and a charming little kiosk café that serves good coffee, light meals, and has plenty of outdoor seating under the trees. The vibe is calm and neighborly. People of all ages hang out here—seniors playing cards or reading, parents with strollers, kids running around, people walking their dogs, and others just sitting quietly enjoying the shade. One lovely touch is the old red phone booth that’s been turned into a tiny free library. It’s things like this that make the park feel alive and loved. The space isn’t huge, but it’s got everything it needs. Flower beds are always fresh, paths are clean, and there are benches everywhere. There are also two important statues tucked inside the garden—Maria da Fonte and Professor Ferreira de Macedo—which give it a bit of historical personality. But what really stood out this time was the buzz around the new underground development being planned. The city has announced a project to build a large underground parking garage beneath the garden. While I understand the need to ease traffic and create more parking in Campo de Ourique, I can’t help but feel concerned about the long-term impact this might have on such a delicate green space. There’s a real fear among locals that the construction will disturb the ecosystem of the garden—the roots of these beautiful old trees, the peace and quiet, and possibly the safety of the pond and wildlife. Right now, the garden feels timeless and balanced, and people are naturally worried that digging beneath it could change that. It’s a bit of a crossroads moment for Jardim da Parada. As it stands today, it’s one of the most welcoming and peaceful little parks in the city—loved by the neighborhood and full of everyday life. I hope that whatever happens with the development plans, the soul of the garden is preserved. If you're in Lisbon and want to experience a bit of calm, community, and natural charm, this place is well worth a visit. And if you’re a local—keep an eye on what’s planned beneath your feet. || Jardim da Parada is a compact, well-kept square that does the fundamentals right: plenty of shade, ample benches, smooth paths, a small playground, and a kiosk for quick coffee. Lots of people during the sunny weekends of the autumn. Sometimes also market with handicrafts. Good for a walk with the family. || Nice place to take a break when doing the shopping in Campo area. A little oasis in the city with local artisans offering handmade items (maybe that is just on the weekends). || One of my favourite Parks in Lisboa. Perfect for young children and dog walks. There's also a kiosk next to the play park that serves drinks and snacks || great place to take young children for a playful time and nice hangout for a coffee or tea || I love it here! The trees are gorgeous and provide shadows and beauty to the square. Always lively with kids, doggies, and elderly playing chess. Loads of restaurants and shops  in the adjacent streets, including Arcádia (chocolate), A Padaria Portuguesa, and a good Italian restaurant called Memoria. One cannot go wrong! 🙂 || Beautiful park to walk through. Lots of kids playing and laughing. Pond with ducks and turtles. Beautiful trees || Community Park with lots of little shops all around and some cute ducks in a small pond || Not the best park, small, busy roads on all sides, packed in the evenings. But the pond is nice, especially when it’s clean. || Dreamy Green space with magnificent trees and plants . Wonderful tropical oasis to escape the busy city of Lisbon. Super sun sets. || Amazing local park with vegan burgers and pool of turtles || Great garden with cafe... But too busy sometimes. If you are looking for some quiet place won't work during the summer... || Romantic and charming park. Nice for an afternoon stroll while you enjoy the duck pond, gorgeous trees, and tiny library. || Fantastic little park in the middle of a French neighbourhood. Has the occasional weekend market with Portuguese style home made items || My beautiful, local square with a café that serves drinks and burgers, a small playground for the kids, benches and framed with trees and bushes inside and around the park. || Great park for all ages. A real taste of how the locals spend their afternoons || Unique neighbourhood garden with cafe, playground and several spectacular hundred years old trees. This much beloved garden is the gathering place of locals young and old, and their dogs. It provides a much needed leafy oasis in an otherwise almost treeless neighbourhood. Surrounding it are shops, restaurants, and the like. || This beautiful little park in Campo De Orique sees a lot of visitors. There's a cute small fountain that has some live fish and turtles in it as well as some ducks. Keeping the kids busy. And there is a hamburger place also located in the park where you're able to get either food from their menu or of course coffee and beer. The trees are magnificent, old and stately. It's worth a stop when visiting there. || It’s a wonderful spot to relax, there’s a park where children can have fun, and an artificial lake with cute ducks! There are seating spots, and a Quiosque should you wish to grab a coffee or a juice as well. Overall a wonderful place where you can hang out with friends. || Beautiful and relaxing green space. || Nice place to rest and have a drink. || Very relaxed local park in a nice neighbourhood with a nice little food stall, seats and toilets available - everything you need to spend a lazy morning or afternoon. Also plenty of shops and markets within walking distance. || Nice garden with walkways and water area with ducks || This is very beautiful and green park. Here are many tall  trees and comfortable benches. The park is quiet and cool even on the hottest  days. This place is near the subway . I recommend it! || Very pleasant place to have a stroll. Has some movement full of children and locals, not for a quiet walk. Has a children's park and a burger place in the middle of the garden. Is surrounded by local shops, pharmacy and coffee shops. || Community oriented, with benches and tables for the elderly, a playground for kids, a variety of bakeries, cafes, restaurants around. Close to the market too. Plenty of trees to give it constant shade all year round, a lake with ducks and turtles, and a public library made out of a phone booth. If you can't find a good book in it, there's a good bookstore right next to it. || Again pls amend, according to Google there was a fair there last Sunday, went for nothing. What's happening to you guys?

Skip time out, just come here.  Really quaint market with good selection of local specialities.  The chicken place that only serves take away was amazing.  Bitoque at Petiscaria was good.  Highlight and star of the market has to be Meroir the Oysteria! || Love this place. A good option to chill, relax get a drink and a bite to eat. Much smaller but also much less busier than Time Out Market. || A very nice market with dome food and drinks. There is a common area in the middle and you can buy food and drinks from different stalls and enjoy it there. The stalls already provide clear menus with pictures to make ordering easy for tourists like us. Reasonably priced and not very busy during lunch hours when we visit there on a weekday in July. || This place has a nice collection of shops and food stalls. Stalls selling all kinds of local fare lice cheese, sardines, fruits, veg, flowers. They also have 2 bars in it. Can order food from the stalls and have it at the bar or the centre sitting area. I had the secretos was really good and the Gin Corner is where I had the beers. Highly recommend this place. || Such a nice market, very authentic & local. Worth a visit! || Forget Time Out market - go here! It is a little off the beaten track but the food is great, no queues when we went and half the price of Time Out. No problem getting a seat either. We really loved it. Helpful staff and a lovely range of dishes to try. Great bar and lovely gifts too. A short walk from Rato metro. || Mercado de Campo de Ourique is a hidden gem in the heart of Lisbon, offering an exceptional blend of traditional market charm and modern culinary experiences. Stepping inside, you're immediately greeted by a vibrant atmosphere and the tantalizing aromas of freshly prepared food.  The market boasts a diverse array of stalls, each offering high-quality, locally sourced products. From fresh produce and artisanal cheeses to an impressive selection of wines and gourmet delicacies, there’s something to delight every palate.  What sets this market apart is its delightful food court, where you can savor a wide range of international cuisines and local specialties. Whether you're in the mood for succulent seafood, savory tapas, or indulgent desserts, the variety and quality here are second to none. The friendly vendors and lively ambiance make it a perfect spot for both casual meals and special gatherings. || Local market. We probably went too early so most shops were not open. Located just next to the church, there is also a park nearby for the dogs to roam || Definitely a spot to stop at, it is smaller than other 'Markets' however it does offer more of a local vibe. The food offerings were really good from all four places we tried out. Staff were helpful and pleasant, even with assistance of takeaways and the bar service. Service in English and Portuguese || We have been there to have a cheese&ham&wine, it was very nice atmospahe. Local people adress.. Nice to eat there .

place_name: Antiga Doca Seca da Ribeira das Naus

reviews_content: Found this cozy café on my first day in Lisbon and loved it. Great food, fair prices, friendly English-speaking staff. Perfect spot for a morning coffee before exploring the city ☕️✨ || Olá Vladyslav Maidanskyi (Pharmazeus), Thank you so much for your lovely review! ☕✨ We are really happy you found us on your first day in Lisbon and enjoyed the food, prices, and friendly team. It means a lot to be part of the start of your time in the city,  we hope you have an amazing stay.  Much Love, Team Espressolab || Lovely little café with a relaxed vibe and the girl and who worked there was super nice! || Olá Ulf, Thank you so much for your lovely words✨ We are really happy to hear you enjoyed the relaxed vibe of our café, and we will make sure to pass your kind comment along to our team😊  Hope to welcome you back soon! Much love, Team Espressolab || Best Cappuccino and extremely nice pastel de nata. Don't skip this place || Olá Robert, Thank you so much for your wonderful recommendation! ☕🥐 We are thrilled to hear you enjoyed our cappuccino and pastel de nata. Your support means a lot to us, and we cannot wait to welcome you back for another delicious visit! Much Love, Team Espressolab || I studied here with a friend and it was perfect — good Wi-Fi and plenty of plugs if you want to get work done. I had an iced coffee and a matcha with coconut milk, both were delicious (10/10!). The staff were also really sweet and welcoming, in particular Muco. Definitely recommend! || Olá Camille, Thank you so much for your lovely review!  We are so glad you and your friend enjoyed studying here and found the space comfortable and convenient. It is great to hear you loved the iced coffee and matcha and we will be sure to share your kind words with Muja and the team. Hope to see you again soon for another great session☕✨ Much Love, Team Espressolab || What a fantastic place to have a brunch! Avocado toast 🥑, salmon bagel 🥯, focaccia 🧀, banana bread 🍌, chia pudding 🫙and much more to try out. The food is fabulous and the drinks are super fresh. The staff are very welcoming as well. We recommend 🙌🏼 || Hello Maria, Thank you so much for the wonderful review you left us. It brightened our day.  With Love, The Espressolab Team || This was our very first stop after landing in Lisbon, and we were wow’d by the warm hospitality of the staff here at Espressolab Estrela. Not to mention the coffee and treats was amazing, and they even offer V60 pour over (which we don’t see too often in cafes around the world as it’s time consuming to make well), and that tells us that they really love coffee 😆. The interiors are cozy and airy. Perfect for a catching up with friends or hiding away with a book. || Hello Jialynne, What great pictures...Thank you! Our team really enjoyes having you over. Much Love, Espressolab Team || I love this coffeelab! The people who work there are amazing, kind hospitality!  I was in Lisbon in April, went back home to the US, came back in July…first place I went to after landing…I was instantly greeted with a huge “welcome back!” They have delicious coffees,even their decaf is good. A great place to work from or grab a coffee and go walk in Estrella Park. A true gem and what makes its magic is the people who work there. || Hello Katia, Wow, thank you so much for your beautiful words! It truly means the world to us that Espressolab was your first stop after returning to Lisbon. We are so happy you felt the warmth and welcome we love to share with our guests💛 Much love, Team Espressolab || Amazing place for coffee and food! The service is great and food taste very good! For 13€ you get a brunch menu including a hot drink, juice, yoghurt, cake and an avocado toast. Highly recommend and will come back for sure! || Hello Chiara, Wow! 🤩 Thank you for such a great review and picture. Much Love, Espressolab Team || Great coffee and the staff are wonderful || Hello Negin,  We arethrilled to hear you enjoyed the coffee and had a great experience with our team 🤗🩵 Much Love, Team Espressolab || I was there on holidays, I saw it from TikTok cause I was looking for a matcha and Pastei de nata. Very friendly people and I ordered a matcha with oat milk (they have different milk varieties) Everything was great, also the pastei de nata (but I found a better one) || Olá Lisa, Thank you so much for stopping by during your holiday! We are so glad you found us on TikTok and enjoyed the matcha and our friendly team. Happy to hear you liked the pastel de nata too, even if you found another favorite, we love that you explored Lisbon’s sweet side! Hope to welcome you back next time you are in town. ✨ Much Love, Team espressolab || The people who work here are incredibly nice. The cappuccino is the best I've had here so far and the pain au chocolat... wow!!! We are coming back ♥️ || Hello N.P Thank you for the amazing review 🩵 Looking forward to seeing you again! Much Love, Espressolab Team || Good coffee and food. They have an amazing breakfast/brunch deal if you're hungry. Very nice staff too. || Hello Michel, Thank you for the awesome review, we really appreciate you 🩵 Much love, Espressolab Team … || Helpful staff, nice lattes (I got the marshmellow/cinnamon latte) convenient location, good ambience to work/study. || Olá Zahara, Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback✨ We are really happy to hear you enjoyed our lattes and that our staff were helpful.  Hope to welcome you back again soon😊 Much Love, Team Espressolab || They are so nice and the coffee and sweets are very good, i would also recommend their Matcha! || Olá Montgomery, Thank you so much for your kind words! We are thrilled you enjoyed the coffee, sweets, and especially the matcha! Your recommendation means a lot to us.☕✨ Much Love, Team Espressolab || Tiny but cozy café. You'll have a tiny dedicated space to work if you need, some sofas and chairs outside. The coffee is super good and high quality. Love it! Outside is super pretty and inside are very elegant and vintage. || Hi João, Thank you so much for your kind words, the team really appreciates them 🤩 With love, The Espressolab Team … || Great place for a quick snack! Amazing, big and cheap lunch menu! || Hello Teresa, Firstly, thank you for the rave review that the team really appreciates🤩 Secondly, thank you fro the great pictures🩵📷 Much Love, Espressolab Team || Delicious coffee and prompt, friendly service. An excellent café experience here in Lisbon. || Hello Shaun, We are so grateful for your great review 🤩 Much love, Espressolab Team … || Great place for espressos or lattes || Hello Yves, Thank you for the great pictures and awesome review 🩵 Wishing you a great start to 2025 Much Love, Espressolab Team || Up there with Copenhagen Coffee Lab 🇩🇰  MUCH better service though, cleaner and comfortable. You won yourself a new regular  Unfortunately 'digital nomads' are allowed to hang around all day, pretending it's their office and taking space up for paying clients. No coffee shop can survive hosting Nomads for hours on a €3.70 cup of coffee  🧑‍💻🚫 || Hello Henrik, Wow! Thank you for the rave review 🤩 Looking forward to seeing you many times. Much Love, Espressolab Team || coffee is great so far! stuff is very welcoming and nice, leaves a very good impression and desire to come back. interior design is not cozy though and the choice of music is pretty weird and way too loud and upbeat for weekday noons. || Hello Alina, Thank you fof your seincere review. We have ajusted the music to more moderate decibels 😉 Please be back for a heart warming coffee. Much Love, Espressolab Team

Remarkable experience for coffee lovers! If you love coffee, this place is a must visit! Had the Metacafeina coffee with my husband and loved its unique taste. Also, the owner Adroaldo makes sure you feel relaxed and take your time at their tables. If you wish, you can also learn about their coffee producers and sources. Will definitely be back! || Great food, great atmosphere even for someone who’s not a coffee expert. I’m just a regular coffee drinker but what I tried from their specials was really something unique. This place is also highly recommended for value for money and very nice and accommodating crew. || The price of this place is affordable but the food it doesn’t taste very good. I was very disappointed from the branch menu. I was expecting to look good and taste good but it was really vague for me. Maybe it look good but it doesn’t taste very well, so if you will ask me if I will go back again to this place, my answer will be no. || I loved this place! So cozy and welcoming, the decor is on point. It’s a great place if you value coffee quality, you can see they are truly passionate about it. Also the food it GREAT for the price?!! When I ordered the toasts I wasn’t expecting a huge plate at all. The service was beautiful. Will come back again soon ❤️ || A nice cozy coffeehouse with absolutely fantastic speciality coffee. Tasty food, but the shoutout has to go to the coffee itself. Rich, clean, fragrant and flavourful. The ones I tried had lower acidity compared to a few other coffee roasters I’ve visited, which is more my cup of tea (including the cup of coffee that somehow tasted like tea). If you’re uncertain whether you will like it, I suggest trying the batch brew (3€). Price of the beans may be a bit higher, but it’s worth it as a special treat. They are also pet friendly! || Absolutely the best spot in Lisbon for lunch, brunch, or just a coffee! The atmosphere is cozy, the food is delicious, and the coffee is top-notch. My husband and I can’t get enough of it — we’re truly addicted. Simply the best in town! || If I could give 6 stars I would. The food was extremely delicious and the staff was so friendly and nice. When we ordered the unique coffee the staff played a fun taste perception game with us.  I got the pão de queijo with duck confit and orange and it was extremely flavorful and rich but not too heavy. My friend got to the tapioca rendada with egg and ham and it was also tasty with good crispy texture on the outside and flavorful in the inside. || Very cool spot. I'm not a big coffee drinker and normally add cream and sugar if I do, but I drank this as is and it was extremely smooth and tasty. || Excellent coffee. Brunch was also delicious, good variety of dishes. Full of energy and ready to start exploring the city of Lisbon after this. || Finally a place in Lisbon that is serious about coffee, not just something to sip with your brunch. From classic origins like Kenya and Ethiopia to more recent stuff like Pink Bourbon and the latest experiments like fermentation, thermal shock process and fruit co-ferments, they offer quality, exciting beans and they know how to brew them, too. I’m a filter person, but they have a Slayer espresso machine so I would guess they are as serious about espresso, too. Variety of different brewing equipment lining the shelves is amazing. As a coffee enthusiast I can hardly wish for a better coffee shop. || Staffs here are so nice and welcoming. I also love the decoration and atmosphere.  What I really want to point out the most is cold brew here is absolutely the best I have ever tried. I went here almost three weeks ago and the taste of cold brew I had that morning is still in my mind. It has a really fruity flavour and tasted like grapes. It gave you a strange feeling almost as if you are tasting a glass of really good red wine.  If this cafe owner or staffs see this review- could you please kindly let me know which coffee beans you used that day (if you can have a guess that would be perfect😭😭). I bought so many coffee beans from other local shops after I went back to my country and it never tasted the same. || The chicken salad was delicious. It had sweet potato chips, like homemade. The Americano was also very tasty || When ordering a V60 pour over Adroaldo suggested it’d be best to sit down with the coffee instead of taking it to go. It turned into an automatic kinship. What was supposed to be a hot second turned into a ninety minute escapade into flavor and comradery. And ps. the orange color DOES taste the best. ✨ || Our experience at SOLO was simply AMAZING! From the moment we stepped in, we were welcomed by the awesome owner & host, Adroaldo - he and the staff are so friendly with smiles and great vibes! The food was top notch delicious and the coffee is just perfect! What was initially our only available choice on Christmas day has quickly transformed into our top choice every day of our trip! The tables have a QR code with a walking tour of Lisbon in consideration of the many tourists visiting the area 😊 such a unique and friendly touch. || Amazing expertise in this man! He taught me about the difference in coffee. I ordered the drip coffee and got to “experience” the different flavors the human mind experiences based on the surroundings. My coffee was delicious with no bitterness. Normally I would add sugar and milk, but it was unnecessary. || We went to this cafe twice in our short time here in Lisbon! This was the only place we visited twice because we loved it so much! The people are very friendly and welcoming. Prices are reasonable and food is phenomenal. A special treat is the designs on the mocha… the mocha was also amazing! In addition they provide quick service and are great at answering any questions. Also they speak excellent English. I have to add, amazing desserts as well as brunch items. No wait time and nice and cool downstairs on a hot day. Highly recommend this place! Thank you for a great experience! 😊 || Life´s easy when you have great people around! I hope that you and your family visit us soon so we can chat more! || BY FAR the best specialty coffeeshop in Lisbon. In a city where coffee culture is quite underdeveloped compared to some other European capitals, SoLo really stands out. You can tell that the owner and staff are really passionate about what they do and this is reflected in the high quality of coffee drinks. I tried their espresso and their nitro cold brew. Both were outstanding. Unlike many other 'specialty' spots, SoLo has great beans *AND* they know how to prepare them. Staff members are very kind and knowledgable, happy to answer questions. I will definitely be coming back. || It’s great to see change whenever I go back to Lisbon and try new brunch places. This place was just fantastic. The food had some twists to typical brunch classics. I had waffles with ham and pesto (+açai) but I tried also “ovos do céu” and the ham&pesto toast which were delicious. || Coffee is great, a lot of options and all of them nice. Food is decent; some Dishes good - very good, the tapaiocos (not sure if correctly soelled) were very dry, rest was nice. || Play with your coffee! Amazing coffee, great food. Well worth a stop. Grab some bags for the road!

The most delicious coffee in Lisbon - with a cozy atmosphere, beautiful lighting, and my favorite music. Laptops are welcome, and there’s plenty of space inside. It’s our favorite spot to enjoy a coffee, hang out, meet friends, or even host a photography workshop. Thank you for being here🧡 || My favorite spot in Lisbon to sit down with a great coffee, enjoy a pastry, and get some work done. It tends to attract an international, digital-nomad crowd, which gives the space a creative feel.  The staff is always kind, the space feels cozy, and the music is consistently great. If you plan to stay for a while, it’s nice to keep supporting the café by ordering throughout the day :) || Nice interior and the avocado toast was good, but ridiculously expensive and was served after 30 min of waiting although the cafe was pretty empty.  Most of all, the staff was unfortunately very rude. With a very passive attitude they made me feel like I was bothering them.  With the amount of good coffee places in Lisbon, I for sure do recommend going to another one than this. || Love this place!!! This is what we need, spacious, friendly, every table is laptop friendly and welcome. Everyone is friendly and the vibe is so young or at least feels young! Music is perfect, not too loud but calm. “You must come back” as the barista told me, of course I will! I just want to secretly keep this hidden gem to myself.  : ) || This is the best place in the city for a place to eat, drink and get some work done! Such a great vibe here and space to work and charge laptops etc.. The food was also very tasty and so affordable! || Great coffee and food. Not a big selection but that’s great. It means what is available is delicious. A great place to sit and work. Very reasonable prices for this quality environment. || Very good flat white on oat milk and nice design || The VENUE is still new and probably because of that unfortunately currently only open three days a week, but I can highly recommend a visit. Starting with the quality of the products, I must say that the coffee was very tasty. The food was also very good and there are several sweet and also savory options, some of which are vegan. The two baristas were super friendly and also took the time to chat with us. The ambience is as seen in the pictures and video very cozy and invites you to linger. You can work here in a quiet atmosphere productively or just come by to drink coffee. We will definitely come by again. || One of the best places to work and enjoy a great cup of coffee. The environment is fantastic—comfortable, quiet, and perfect for productivity. || Cozy, friendly coffe place with an excelent coffee and coworking space in the back. The coworking part has tons of natural light, with a very fast internet and while working there I noticed there's a community of people who know each other and come working there on regular basis.

Great coffee shop with fantastic cakes (highly recommend the gluten free banana bread and pain au chocolate)!  We came here to work for a few hours and the WiFi is extremely reliable and they have sockets everywhere.  Highly recommended! || I love this place! They have the best coffee in the area and the service is very friendly. It us my place to go when walk my dog as they are pet friendly and pet lovers || Super  good coffee (oat milk cappuccino) and nice vibe in the cafe. We also had toasts which were simple but yummy. Would definitely return || Very good coffee and delicious pastries. Great staff and a nice ambience to sit or work (Free WiFi and plug ins near the tables) :) || Great flat white - always a test of a specialty coffee shop - plus tasty light snacks such as traditional pao de queso in a few flavours. Tried the chorizo, delicate flavour and bouncy.. yum.  Also offering pastries and breakfast style bowls. Friendly staff, quiet atmosphere with light background popular music.  A nice spot to drop by or work a while. || Relaxing spot with a chill vibe for coffee or breakfast.  The service is superb and (I hear the coffee is delicious) they have a delightful black tea for me!   We love the yogurt y bowl with granola and fruit and the ham and cheese croissant.  Love coming here for the whole experience. || Wandered across this whilst adventuring across Lisboa. The staff are friendly and accommodating, even with my limited Portuguese!  A quiet and comfy spot with a good selection of coffees beans and accessories.  Would definitely recommend taking the extra bit of time to visit, getting away from the crowds and finding this hidden gem. || One of my favorite places in Lisbon! Great food and even better coffee in an excellent atmosphere. || We had a small breakfast at this cafe. The portion size of the joghurt bowl was big and the joghurt with the fruits was delicous.  The cappuccino there was so so good! The coffee flavor was slightly fruity, sour and nutty at the same time. On that day they used their new limited coffee blend of Ethiopia and Brazil. The latte art of the cappuccinos was so cute! We also got to try one shot of cold brew made with Ethiopian coffee, which was so refreshing and flavorful.  The atmosphere was very cozy and relaxing. Additionally, the staff was very friendly and attentive there.  If you love coffee, you need to visit this cafe. || I love this cafe. Great barista, the coffee is very good and he draws exquisite patterns on the coffee. Even a professional designer like me is amazed. The food is very fresh, clean and delicious. The service is also very friendly. A beautiful place worth visiting every day. In the morning you get a cup of delicious coffee made with such care, and the whole day is full of joy.

New coffee place whenever you’re in Estrela! It has all types of flavorful coffees, hot, cold, with ice cream. Delicious home made pastries with caramel, nutella, pistachio. Lovely and COMFY seating. Wifi, run by a charming family your heart will want to support. Here having a ice cream pistachio coffee! || We stayed in Lisbon for 10 days and Luli’s Bakery Café quickly became one of our favorite spots. We had the pleasure of enjoying breakfast here twice the humous toast and the salmon toast with cream cheese were both absolutely delicious. … || It makes us truly happy to a share a bit of our history and family recipes with such warm people like you 🧡 Thank you for this wonderful review! … More || I wish more people would discover this family-run cafe! I had the homemade lasagna and watched her make the pasta before making the lasagna! Super delish. Also had the homemade mango juice. || A small family business. One of the coziest places in Lisbon, if you’re not family they’ll treat you like it anyway. The soup was amazing, and even the coffee was presented in a way that made me feel cared for! Thank you so much to the owners. || Such a good place! I hope they stay for a long time, just what the neighbourhhod needed! || Hopped in on a rainy morning for a flat white and the often-mentioned avocado and beetroot toast. The duo running the shop were as kind as can be, and both the food and coffee hit the spot perfectly. Really happy with my choice to come here, and I’ll definitely be back! || Great pastry and coffee!! They speak english and the staff is really nice! || Amazing food, delicious pastries, great service. I highly recommend the pao do queijo and the the avocado hummus toast. || Thank you so much for your review 🙏 We’ll always have a fresh Pão de Queijo waiting for you! Hope to see you again for some artisan pastries or a specialty coffee.  … || The avocado toast with hummus was delicious 😋 … || Great little bakery and cafe, you must stop here for breakfast. They have a great set menu toast option with juice or coffee that is very affordable. They also have Portuguese, Brazilian and Hungarian baked options. I tried the Portuguese chorizo bread and it was great. The Frango tart also looked great. Service was most friendly. || Thank you so much for such a thoughtful review! It makes us so happy to know you and your family enjoed our breakfast set and baked goods here in Jardim da Estrela. 🙏 at Luli’s we use many of our own family recipes, like the Portuguese … More

Good coffee shop with friendly staff.  Staff member explained different coffee beans and let us smell them.  2 drawbacks: espresso was too weak and my cappuccino was served lukewarm, not hot at all. || Thanks Samuel :) Hope next time we will have 5* || Baobá Café is the kind of place that reminds you why you love specialty coffee. The vibe is relaxed but stylish, with real care behind everything they serve. We ordered two flat whites—one with a light roast and one with a medium—and both were flawless. I was, of course, in the mood for the light roast (as always 😊), and it hit all the right notes: smooth, bright, and clean.  What really made the experience extra special was Julio, who came out to chat and shared the story behind their coffee. He told me about their other café where they do their own roasting—so cool to see that level of connection to the craft. The milk texture here is perfect, and I love that they serve the drinks in clear cups so you can actually see the foam layer.  Next time I’m coming back for the power balls and some of their pastries, which looked genuinely tempting. Baobá is absolutely worth a visit. || My first coffee in Lisbon was at Baobá café 3 years ago and I had no idea I’d end up living here…but guess what - it’s still my favourite spot! I try to pass by every week on my way to work. and I always leave with a smile (and the best coffee!). I’ve even made a few friends around the long table! This tiny café has so much soul - it just makes you feel so welcomed <3 One of my favourite memories: I brought the team some fresh figs once and the chef surprised me back with the most amazing warm toast - melting cheese, peanut butter, red berry jam and fresh fig slices on top. That toast completely changed my day - it’s little moments like this that make Baoba Café so special 🤍 || A really great coffee spot in Lisbon. We ended up going there at least once a day during our stay, and it never disappointed. The coffee was consistently excellent—especially the freshly brewed filter coffee and the flat white, both easy recommendations. The baristas clearly know what they’re doing and are also genuinely welcoming, which made every visit enjoyable. We liked the place so much we even brought home a couple of t-shirts. I only wish this café were in my neighborhood so I could enjoy their coffee every morning, noon, afternoon, and evening. || Thanks Tamer Basman :) || That was really good and tasty coffee ☕ You can choose from different beans. If you buy a pack, you receive a free cup. Workers are very friendly and ready to explain and answer to your questions. I'll be glad to come again 👍 || Beautiful food, fantastic coffee. Next to this there is also Lidl so this is great spot to do shopping. || Great traditional Mercado. Almost tourist free || A one-stop shopping experience for all things fresh and fabulous. It caters for the fancy dinner soirée, or the relaxed beach BBQ. 🐟🐟🐟🐟🐟 … || The prices of fish are totally out of reality, what's happening to Lisbon? This market is the perfect example of what's happening in Portugal, the rising prices of apartments in the center of the city. It's a totally new Lisbon where very few people can afford to live a normal life. A sad sign of the times. || Probably one of the most traditional and oldest open food markets in Lisbon that is mainly used by locals. Much smaller than in the past with only a handful of stalls still operating. Good for fish and vegetables/fruit mainly. Hard to find a free parking spot and the paid parking gets filled quickly so you might have to wait outside || Local produce and fresh food. Some small restaurants in the market prepare traditional Portuguese food. The place was seen in some international culinary shows. It is not particularly a beautiful building but keeps the tradition of the farmer's market like many districts of Lisbon. It has a public (paid) parking lot and is next to Av. Igreja. The neighboring area preserves the local shopping district without the overwhelming flow of tourists. || A traditional Portuguese market that was recently restored and also houses a coffeeshop, a playground for children and sometimes some local neighborhood exhibitions. On Saturdays at least, it houses a large variety of fruits and vegetables, fresh fish and meat, vegan burgers and even specific Indian ingredients. || This market stands as one of the remaining active food markets in Lisbon, offering a delightful and engaging visit.

Such a perfect place to stay after flying into Lisbon. We arrived late, so we booked a shuttle through the hotel, and the driver Bruno was so warm and professional. The hotel is lovely, exceptionally clean, and has a leafy courtyard to enjoy. Breakfast and coffee were delicious! || I’ve been a loyal Booking.com customer for years and have always had great experiences—until this stay. While trying to make a last-minute reservation for November 2025 on my mobile device, the booking accidentally processed for November … || This hotel was the perfect choice for my needs. Its proximity to the airport made it  convenient for walking, both on arrival and departure with my backpack. Check-in was efficient and hassle-free. I was particularly impressed with the overall cleanliness, both in my spacious room and throughout the hotel. The room itself was well-appointed, featuring a comfortable bed and a modern, clean bathroom. The breakfast was also a pleasant surprise – a solid and satisfying start to the day.  There is also a nice small garden. It was too chilly in January to use it though. The location is ideal for those needing easy airport access, and the short, affordable Uber ride (only €4) to downtown makes it a possible base for exploring the city as well. Combined with the reasonable price, this hotel offers excellent value for an overnight stay near the airport. || A great place to stay close to the airport. It was quiet and clean, they are clearly used to people coming in late/leaving really early and have check-in & out made easy outside of normal business hours. The staff was also very nice. It’s a residential neighborhood but there is a cafe at the end of the street. You can get an Uber or Bolt easily & cheaply to the tourist areas.  Airport tip: this place is so close to the airport it can take a while to get a Bolt or Uber driver to pick you up (they don’t make enough). When I got a driver assigned I sent them a note right away that I would tip at least €5, so they wouldn’t cancel the pick up. I was told some people also walk, but I had too much luggage for that! || We needed a place to stay close to the airport since we were flying in late from Madeira and leaving in the morning. This place was economical, clean and quiet.||Alvalade Palace is on what was clearly a magnificent boulevard of grand homes … || This property did not meet any acceptable standard—neither that of a hotel nor even a basic bed and breakfast. Our stay was stressful and disappointing! || Stayed one night before catching our flight home.  The entire hotel was clean and quiet. A good place to stay the night before heading to the airport. The bathroom is tight but is fine for one night. || 20 minute walk from the airport. 20 minute walk to the Areeiro metro for an easy ride into Lisbon. Very clean and quiet hotel with friendly staff. It's a small cosy place, i think they did their best with the small space that they have. I also enjoyed walking around the area, it's beautiful and there are many restaurants and old buildings in a 15min radius. || We chose Alvalade Palace primarily for its location near the airport, but also because it is not just another sterile hotel. reviews_content: We love trying cocktail rooms wherever we go, tried this one and it REALLY hit the spot. Best owners, very kind, great vibes - extremely relaxed. The drinks were solid - will hold their own against any cocktail room anywhere. We had the smoky margarita, negroni, a Caribbean inspired drink (forgot the name) and the Black Forest.  Shout out to the Black Forest, that was one VERY well made drink! Completely recommend. Host made us taste her favorite drink - I think it was called the Nikkei Milk Punch and I must say that one was extremely well balanced and beautiful as well.  Best part of the space for us were all the 🐶s visiting, completely made our evening! || Atmosphere: 8/10 Located in Lisbon’s Graça district. Very chill, home-style vibe—cozy, comfortable, music at a good level. Backbar is okay. Seating is limited: no bar counter, a few indoor tables, plus some patio seats.  Drinks: 8.5/10 Recommendation: Black Forrest, Pineapple Express Menu is simple. Selection is decent. Flavors are good. Coasters are nice; glassware is average; garnish is nice. Presentation is okay overall, with unique ice on select serves.  Service: 8.5/10 Water on arrival. Team is friendly, professional, and attentive. Prices are average for Lisbon. Reservations not needed. || Proper crafted cocktails in a small, cozy and we'll appointed space. Joanna and Peter create lovely drinks and provide personal service. I had a lovely milk punch which was perfectly balanced.  Its a good idea to make reservations. We will definitely go again. || Booked Onda to grab a quick pre-dinner drink and we ended up going a bit early and I’m so happy we did!  We got to try four different cocktails and they were so good and so creative! The space was also really cool - loved the decor and the owners were really sweet. || Had an amazing time here and really enjoyed getting to know the owners and hearing their stories and recommendations.  We loved it so much we closed out both of our nights in Lisbon here.  If you are looking for a great cocktail and a relaxing chill atmosphere this is the place to go! || This was hands-down our favorite cocktail bar in the city. It’s a laid back atmosphere where the husband/wife owners attend to the customers with passion and dedication. It’s clear that they love what they do. In my opinion, this establishment is better than Red Frog. The Nikkei Milk Punch was my favorite. You won’t find anything like it elsewhere; it’s one-of-a-kind. Don’t pass up the opportunity to visit, but do make a reservation. || What do you know about cocktails? 🍸✨ Forget everything you think you know! 😎 Because here, a whole new world will open up to you — a world of amazing flavors, aromas, adventures, and people who are truly in love with what they do! 💫🌍💃  Every sip is a little journey 🌴🍹 — through taste, through passion, through creativity! 💥 Whether you’re into something classic, bold, or totally unexpected, they’ll create the perfect cocktail just for you! 🍒🍍🍋  This place isn’t just about drinks — it’s about emotions, art, and pure joy! 💖✨ So dive in, explore, and let yourself be amazed by this ocean of cocktails! 🌊🍸🔥  Cheers to unforgettable moments! 🥂😄🍹 || Thank you so much for your visit and review. We hope you can come by this week for the tasting experience before you go home. 🍸🍸🍸 … || I’ve gone to Onda multiple times, and have always had a nice time.  I lived here as a student (American so do take that into account with my opinions on prices) for about a year and visited multiple times throughout my stay. A few times I went for drinks (sometimes alcoholic and sometimes not, they have amazing options for both) and once for a cocktail making class which was a super fun experience!  It’s a place to go if you want nice cocktails. They’re well made and super unique, so though they aren’t the cheapest, the prices  are by no means unreasonable and are on par with a lot of other places I’ve been to. I loved the smoky margarita, as well as the Thai infused alcohol (I don’t remember the name) which was one of the best cocktails I’ve had.  Would recommend and planning on going again soon as I’m visiting for the holidays! || I can't speak too much to the food but I can speak to the lovely couple who own the place and took us on a journey of many cocktails. Easily a true highlight of Lisbon and something I would recommend anyone who enjoys the finer spirits and what magic they might contain. Do yourself a favor take a friend or six to the cocktail flight, and if you enjoy whiskey talk to Peter the owner into giving you a master class in Whiskeys around the world. || Drinks are crafted with perfection. Flavor explosion balanced with eased shoulders. Cheers for the memorable experience. || We were super pleasantly surprised, they had a mini cocktail tasting flight! All five cocktails were unique and delicious. We’ll be back! Only suggestion would be to maybe serve some nuts or pretzels 🥨 || Not a 1st time but once again it was phenomenal! Joana and Peter took great care of us! We will definitely be back again when we come to Portugal! || What an amazing cocktail place!! The service is incredible, we didn't like one of the drinks and even before we finished the sentence it was taken from us and straight away offered a different (unlike other places in Portugal). The cocktails we had were unique, tasty and one of a kind. I definitely recommend this place for cocktails lovers! || Had the best experience. Went for an amazing cocktail flight, but then did a whiskey tasting and couldn't be happier. Come thirsty, leave happy! || We trekked here uphill in the pouring rain, and the experience was more than worth it! These were hands down some of the most creative and delicious cocktails I’ve ever had. The music and atmosphere were excellent as well, and it was a joy chatting with the owners. I would highly recommend anyone in Portugal take the time to check this spot out! || I’ve been to several cocktail bars in Lisbon, but my experience at Onda was truly on another level. Every cocktail we tried was exceptional — each one had such a unique and distinct personality that I honestly couldn’t pick a favorite. The service was also fantastic; everyone was super friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere was incredible too — perfect for a date, relaxed yet with a great vibe. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to everyone! || Despite celebrating its sixth anniversary in December, Onda Cocktail Room has been a bar that has somewhat flown under the radar of Lisbon’s bar scene, which is a shame because its quality is undeniable. . Led by Peter, owner and bartender. A former trainer and master of whisky at Diageo, he is assisted by his wife and fabulous host Joana, who takes care of the entire room. . A small space with an open door to the street, it is open every day from 5 pm to midnight except on Wednesdays, which is its day off. Located in the Graça neighbourhood, it has many regular customers, but with the growing number of foreigners who have invested in that area of Lisbon, its menu has been adapted to suit everyone’s tastes and budgets for unique experiences. . We were invited to try the tasting menu, which consists of drinking five small portions of cocktails from the menu, served as if it were a tasting menu at a Michelin-starred restaurant. From the aperitif to the dessert, all requirements are met, always with top-quality spirits and a fantastic balance in everything we drink. Best of all, it costs €38 per person. . For the more daring, we also recommend choosing a ‘Top Shelf Cocktail’, where spirits such as JW Blue Label, Don Julio 1942, Cambridge Truffle Gin, among others, are part of the menu. Don’t miss out. || Thank you very much, João. 🍸 … || This place is an absolute must if you love a high-quality cocktail! It's all they do, and they do it to perfection. We found this place while walking back to our apartment one night and then spent the next 3 nights going back to it because we could not get enough! They offer an amazing selection of carefully curated cocktails, each made to perfection. If you're lucky, you'll get to chat to either Joanna or Peter, and they are the kindest, most passionate people you'll meet. They love what they do, they're happy to share all the insights as to how they developed each cocktail, the thought and love they put into each one, and they'll be glad to make a recommendation if you're feeling like you can't decide. It is truly a gem in Lisbon. || Went here on our way up to the viewpoint. Very nice little bar. Had 2 drinks each, all were excellent well crafted and unique cocktails. My favourite was probably the Nikkei Milk Punch, ordered on the bartenders recommendation and was very happily surprised by this one. Best cocktails we had in Lisbon. Definitely worth a try! || This place is lovely, the interior is cozy and intimate great for a date. The cocktails were amazing! We tried the 5 mini cocktail tasting menu which I would 100% recommend. Each cocktail was so thoughtfully created and explained.

To snack, we ordered the anchovy bites and the panino com la mortazza (with mortadella)—both were flavorful, high-quality, and complemented the drinks beautifully. If you’re in Lisbon and love unique, expertly crafted cocktails in a stylish yet cozy setting, Liquid Love is a must-visit. Already planning to come back to try more from their inventive menu. || Possibly the best cocktail bar in Lisbon.  The cocktails are unique, creative, and incredibly well crafted with impressive flavors and balance.  The owners also bake fresh focaccia bread every day, which they use to hand make all the delicious appetizers and sandwiches on the menu.  You can really sense the passion in what they do.  Every single cocktail I had was unique and delicious.  The bartenders/owners are really friendly too, I always had a great time chatting with them. || Unique cocktails and drinks in a very relaxed atmosphere. Some great nibbles available as well. We were 4 for aperitivos that chose a Cocktail each and a platter to share foe €15/pax which is a very fair price. We cannot wait to show this to our kids when they are back. || This was our favourite cocktail bar when we visited Portugal. The snacks were also unreal and super fresh. We thoroughly enjoyed our experience. The owners are also very kind. It is a must when visiting Lisbon. || A hidden gem just a bit off-center with some of the best drinks I had in Lisbon, especially the zola e pepe! The bartender Semi made the experience even better with his hospitality and recommendations! They frequently change the menu based on what ingredients are best. The menu is mostly inspired by Italy and north Africa and they often host events so keep an eye out for that. When I visited they still had a record player from a recent event and played records which really added to the atmosphere. I will absolutely be back again if I have the chance! || What a beautiful bar! The founders are Italian and Portuguese and the food & drinks are inspired by them which gives an unique taste to everything. A local recommended this bar and it was even better than expected: the bartender was super friendly  and made conversation sometimes which was cool, the drinks were really special, there was not one drink that I’ve ever seen in another bar or restaurant ever before! Really original! The Sakura 🌸🍸 was my favourite. We also ordered food and he left out the meat and fish for us as requested and the focaccia was delicious! The interior is very clean and tasteful, I loved the table pattern (as shown on the photos), the restrooms were very clean, too.Thank you very much, we really enjoyed it & we will definitely come back! 🩵 || Phenomenal staff. Very professional, super hospitable and kind. Some of the best drinks we had in Portugal and they even gave me a tour of where they batch cocktails. Would 100% recommend this to anyone looking for high quality cocktails and friendly service. || Probably one of the best bites I had my whole trip. That focaccia is unbelievable! I would go back just for that. The drinks were incredible as well. Every drink we had was delicious but that curry drink is the one me and my wife talk about most because it's so interesting. David was a great bartender and host. we look forward to coming back when we are in Portugal!! || This place is a proper Lisbon Gem. The couple running it are not only skilled at creating tasty cocktails but they are also very kind and welcoming.  Liquid Love has a really chill vibe, great music selection, and even better selection of original cocktails. They also make great classic cocktails though you won’t find them on the menu.  Coming here is always a win and you’re guaranteed a great time whenever you visit.  Standout classic of theirs if your interested is the Sakura for those who really like dry martini styled drinks. This is just perfect 👌🏿 || Went here for a corporate outing and it was amazing. If you're in Lisbon and have a taste for exceptional cocktails, Liquid Love is an absolute must-visit. The staff at Liquid Love deserve special mention for their exceptional service. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with genuine warmth and hospitality. These events showcase local talent and create a lively and dynamic atmosphere that keeps you coming back for more.  In conclusion, Liquid Love is a cocktail bar that truly lives up to its name. It’s a place where you can savor expertly crafted drinks in a welcoming and stylish setting. Whether you’re a cocktail aficionado or just looking for a great night out in Lisbon, Liquid Love is the perfect destination. Five stars all the way! || Amazing cocktails, innovative and creative combination of flavours resulting in some of the best cocktails I have tried. Thanks for Michael’s great work and we had a wonderful time. Love the cocktails as well. 🍹🥰 …

What a wonderful experience.  I had been following this bar on social media for ages, and never seemed to find the right time to visit whenever I was in Lisbon before. Finally I made it here! Wow, I'm so happy I did.  Not only were the drinks fantastic, but it was so welcoming and felt like a truly cozy neighbourhood bar. You'd never guess that it was mostly tourists. Everyone was so warm and friendly, and the barman treated every customer like an old friend. Absolutely no pretentiousness which is amazing considering the high-class and rare quality of the cocktails.  I sat at the bar and had a lovely time just absorbing the atmosphere and exceptional cocktail made with vintage spirits. (Not everyone would spend as much as I am willing on a single drink but they were actually reasonable prices for rare vintage spirits.) And the Basque cheesecake cocktail is even better than I expected. I generally don't like dessert cocktails but, this one is the exception to the rule! || Wow! Glad to read that you enjoyed the time with us! Hope to see you back again 🫶🫶🫶 … || Atmosphere: 8.5/10 Located in Lisbon’s lively Mouraria district, Quattro Teste is casual and warm in vibe. Drinks: 8.5/10 Recommendation: Banana Joe, Basque Burnt Cheesecake Menu is simple but cleverly structured with color indicators for drink strength. Prices are below average for Lisbon, making it a strong value for the quality delivered. || We randomly came here to end the night, and the place didn't dissapoint! We tried the cheesecake cocktail. Red and green, with some woody textures and tones to make it more earthy. Nice cocktail bar. Small and cozy. Friendly owner. Interesting cocktail menu with a nice variety of options. Owner/bartender can make whatever you like. Overall a nice way to end a evening. || Nice cocktail bar / lounge with great atmosphere. We had some beautifully crafted cocktails and met some nice people. Owner Stefano was great to talk to and his cocktails were delicious! || Thank you for the kind review! || Fantastic bar with a great atmosphere and relaxed vibe.
