Definitely one to add to your Lisbon visit list. || Thank you Gareth, great having you at Opus, looking forward to your next visit! || Got the chance to try out the new menu items and boy did they not disappoint! Both drinks were crafted to perfection and the owner was lovely to talk to. Highly recommend || Thank you very much for the kind review! || Friendly and warm, cool and sexy, this bar is a great place to go and enjoy with a small group. The drinks are thoughtfully authored, graciously served, and enhanced by the warmth and humanity of the staff. Will come again. || Thank you Daniell, it was a pleasure having you at Opus || An amazing option for cocktail enthusiasts, right in the heart of Lisbon! Decor is modern, sophisticated and the vibe is intimate. The lowlights and lounge-like atmosphere is perfect for couples and small groups. The menu is very creative with interesting mixed flavours. I tasted a few items and my favourites were Beets & Jams and Smokey Forest. Barrel Aged Negroni and Whiskey Thyme are also great choices for whiskey aficionados. We also recommend it for great conversations with the bartender himself :) || Thank you very much for the nice review and great pictures! Looking forward to welcoming you back soon || What a amazing place! I went to this place for 3 days straight just for the vibes and the owner! His own cocktails are amazing and he’s such a lovely guy!  For the owner: you made our schooltrip so much better so thank you so much!  Wish you the best in the future!  When in Lisbon go to this place!!!! || Hi Thijs, it was an absolute pleasure meeting you and your group and having you at Opus, looking forward to see you back in your next visit to Lisbon! || Cozy spot. Nice owner/bartender. Decent cocktails, made bespoke (1 by 1).  Not as pretentious as some other places nearby.  Would visit again. || Thanks for your feedback Ben, looking forward to welcoming you back at Opus soon! || One of the best cocktail bar of Lisbon!  We had been to their other bar before for the cocktail workshop (Rumours) and we wanted to try their new bar.  Stefano is very knowledgeable and welcoming, it was a pleasure to sit at the bar and talk with him while enjoying these incredible drinks. || Thank you very much for the kind review! Great Picture! || Cute little bar, off the Main Street but still easy to access. Very friendly people and knowledgeable barman. I was not in the mood for conversation so had my one beer and left but could enjoy a night and chat with new people another time. || Thank you for the kind feedback Andrew! || This bar provides a unique cocktail experience. Most of the available options will not be found anywhere else in Lisbon.  Definitely a must try!! Great environment to come with friends or a couple. || Thank you for the kind review! || Highlights recommended! Perfekct Drinks Very creative. Normal pries. Out of the beaten tracks. || Thanks for the kind review Michael! || Incredible mixology. A must visit! || Thank you for the kind review! || I loved Rumours and it was so fun to visit their newest concept! I loved the smoky mezcal drink and my friend had the 0 Guilt, which was a perfect Dry January option!! || Thank you for the kind review and great pictures!! Looking forward to welcoming you back soon || Amazing new coktails place! We tried few ones and they were delicious and beautiful. We'll be back soon to experiment more! And the owner is super friendly and knowledgeable! So happy about this new place in the neighborhood || Very Nice meeting you Maxime, nice picture! Looking forward to your next visit to Opus! || We had a great night there. The drinks were fantastic and the owner was so knowledgeable. The best negroni I've had. Highly recommend. || Thank you for the kind review, it was great to have you at Opus! || A great find, the barman was super friendly and welcoming. We tried the negroni which was great and very similar to the ones we've had in Milan. We also had a bramble upon special request, he managed to make it happen. Well worth a visit. || Hi Daniel, thanks for the kind review! || Cocktails with interesting combinations of flavors prepared with high quality. The owner is super friendly and you can see he enjoys preparing the cocktails and making the customers feel welcome. The place is cozy and cute, but not very suitable for big groups. || Thanks for your kind review! || We love Stefano and Sofia! The cocktails were great and the conversation even better! A true mixologist is crafting your evening, take advantage and try a few of his creations! || Thank you very much Eden, it was a pleasure to have you at Opus!! || Lovely bar with amazing cocktails - owner is super nice and curated everything himself, definitely recommend!! || Thank you for the great feedback!

When you think of a family run business you automatically know there is some personality to the place. In Bar Olf Vic you will find a father and a son holding up old school bar traditions! Are they a bit overworked.... yes... does it take longer to get a drink than in a McDonalds, yes! Never the less you go there to have an atmosphere you can only achieve by generational dedication to giving your costumer a great bar experience. Coming here is a must if you look for a safe and friendly place to have a couple of drinks. || Terrible experience at Old Vic!  I went there with friends expecting to have a good time, but the service was absolutely disappointing. I waited for over 30 minutes just to place an order. The waiter was rude and disrespectful from the start. When he finally came to the table, he brought popcorn and acted annoyed because I was impatient — after such a long wait, who wouldn’t be?  When I tried to order something, he said they were only serving ham and cheese toasties, without giving any proper explanation or apology. On top of that, the prices were insanely high for both food and drinks. The drinks especially are ridiculously overpriced considering the poor service and limited options.  Definitely not worth it. Terrible cost-benefit. There are plenty of better places in Lisbon with way better service and fairer prices. || I know this is a vintage place & some things come with the territory. With that being said, in terms of visiting, this is more of a living historical relic to visit than a bar to enjoy. If you’re okay with rude service & paying more than normal, then go ahead and check it out. The older man who owns the place is a feature, but he is very rude & particularly rude to foreigners unfortunately. He also tries not to give you a menu so he can charge you more at the end. My friends paid 3.50€ for an imperial (small beer) and 3€ for a Pedras (sparkling water) because they couldn’t speak Portuguese to question him on it, and when I did, he complained about foreigners & paying more for a drink at new places in the city center. I wanted to, but just can’t recommend it I’m sorry. || Great experience! The bar is operated by a father and son who deliver an excellent experience. We really appreciated the care they shared during our visit. I couldn’t recommend it more to those who want to enjoy a drink in a place that’s lost in time, while also preserving the best of interactions we all enjoy. || A place where you can talk with friends without yelling. Loved the entire vibe of the place. Just make sure to bring cash though. When we went there, unfortunately they didn’t accept cards or MBway at least. Would still recommend the place. Loved the drinks! The drinks were really good with reasonable price, and it wasn’t full of ice, like what other bars do. Would definitely come back. || Great snacks. Good cocktails that sneak up on you. Really cool environment with red velvet seats and antiques. Feels like an English pub. A little pricey. || Hidden bar in Lisbon. Older man working behind the bar, and we were one of the first customers to arrive. It's definitely a vibe, and I would recommend it to come earlier.  Be aware that it is a smoking bar, but that's part of the "bodega" experience. || We went to Old Vic for cocktails. This place is nothing less but perfect. You feel like treated on hands and the cocktails are unreal, so delicious. Marcel is one of the greatest bartenders we have met and he has got a pure heart. Totally recommended! || We were just looking for a pub that was closing later than most, when we found this hidden gem. It has a nice, warm and cosy atmosphere with cool decorations, good music and the most lovely bartender I've met in a long time. Old Vic is not only a pub, it is a place with a kind soul that you feel right after entering. I am very grateful for this experience it was the highlight of my trip to Lisbon. Thank you for having us! || What a great find! A hidden little gem in the heart of Lisbon! My partner and I popped in for a late night drink on arrival to the city where we were greeted with popcorn, snacks and a selection of the most amazing cocktails (The Pina Colada was incredible and their cocktail decorations so cute and delicious, my parther said it was the best Old Fashioned he's ever had!), the service of the father & son team was impeccable, they really made us feel at home... Will be will going back!

Great place to drink gin and eat some tapas. It is usually full so make a reservation. The waiter Camila is the best! || Thank you for your kind visit. || Great place for drinks and amazing food. Small neighborhood bar that has 90% of its seating outside. The kitchen is amazing - try the Octopus, first class. || The best bar in town, concerning the variety of drinks and food. Good quality food. The manager, owner, tries to select the customers maintaining all the tables reserved. Just ignore it and ask for a table to have drinks and tapas. The tapas are very good and good price. || Excellent bar with tons of gin options. The food is also great. Totally recommended! || I'm going to be super honest: I haven't still eaten but I'm doing this so I'm the thousandth comment. Love the place so far. Waitress very polite and was laughing as I told her about this  Edit: 20 minutes in and still nothing lol. Not so much as a "oops" or "in a second" Lowering to 4 starts for now... Place is evidently understaffed.  Edit: it took 40-50 mins to get my order. The oysters were decent. Service sucked || We caught a busy moment but luckily the owners assisted, food is definitely original, some dishes stand out, for Sure: i just wouldn't serve the warm Camembert in cardboard.... || Great bar to taste the best gins and cocktails and nice food || They have really good tapas!! And cheap cocktails<3 || Impeccable! An astonishing selection of gins, good food (tapas), warm and friendly service and clean installations. Fully recommended! The only downside is the amount of people smoking. || When i wanted to pay they charged me for more dishes then i ordered.  I dont know why but i already had the feeling they would do that

place_name: Metro e Meio restaurante cocktail bar
reviews_content: This is my favorite place to watch football if I am hungry.  The food and drink is awesome and the service is great.   The staff speaks good English and was very helpful with recommendations of both food and drinks. I love the garlic shrimp and the pic a pau lombo, both are amazing.  I have never had a bad meal here, highly recommended! They have both indoor and outdoor seating. || Thank you for your review, Ladd! We're delighted to hear you enjoy our football viewing space, as well as the food, drinks, and service. It's great to know that the garlic prawns and picapau continue to impress. We appreciate the recommendation and look forward to your next visit. || This was a well known watering hole in Avenidas Novas in Lisbon. have been there a few times in the past but for snacks and drinks, so decided to try out the food this time.~ It was okay, the menu looks interesting but is a bit confusing in terms of the flavours. Seems more of a mix of cuisines. The name continues to be the most interesting, considering that the doorway is a meter and a half in height! || Thank you so much for your review, Darryl! We're glad you returned to our restaurant and shared your experience. Your opinion about the menu is very important to us and helps us to continuously improve. || The food was amazing! It was made w fresh ingredients, extremely tasty, and the overall flavor was superb! Sangria was flavorful and the ambience was classy! Highly recommend and was family friendly. || Thank you, Dawn! We are so happy to hear that you enjoyed the fresh, flavorful food, the sangria, and the elegant atmosphere. We appreciate the recommendation and hope to welcome your family again soon! || The bar is great, very chill and not noisy. Drinks are great and the people are really welcoming and friendly. The prices are decent and there is a lot of options. Would definitely recommend.  PS: The classical cocktails are also made here. || Hi Yevgen, thank you so much for your positive review! We're happy to hear you enjoyed our atmosphere, drinks, and service. We look forward to your next visit! || Amazing cocktail bar! I had the Sir Rabbit, an amazing blend of Scotch Whisky, Amoretti and other things garnished with a charred rosemary sprig. Smokey, slightly sweet and refreshing. Highly recommend this place! || Thank you for your feedback, Shahriar! We're glad you enjoyed our Sir Rabbit. We hope to see you again soon! || Great bar with excellent cocktails and a very decent whisky selection including a wide range of single malt scotch! Good vibe and love coming here. || Thank you so much, Seb! It's great to know you enjoyed the cocktails and our selection of whiskies. It's always a pleasure to have you with us. See you soon! || I only had drinks here. It's a really neat neighborhoodly feeling place to meet friends. || Thank you so much for your review, Julie! We're delighted to hear you enjoyed the drinks and the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere, perfect for hanging out with friends. We hope to welcome you back soon. || Awesome find!  Post concert meal in a super cool speak easy near Campo Pequeño!  We had a hamburg pattie with fries and drinks.  We sat at the bar and watched the artistry of the bartender while he made several unique drinks. So fun!!! || Thank you, Hannibal! We're so glad to hear you had an amazing experience at our restaurant. We hope to see you again soon! || We ordered a food plate for 17 euros and we got very little food, the was only one rose and it was not good. we also ordered fries but there was not sauce nothing it tasted really frozen and had almodt no taste || Hello Noa, thank you for sharing your experience. We regret that your meal at our restaurant did not meet your expectations. We apologize for the situation and would like to invite you to contact us so that we can better understand what happened and offer a suitable solution. || Tasty snacks, creative and delicious cocktails, fun staff || Thank you, Geoff! We're thrilled you enjoyed the snacks, cocktails, and our fun team. Hope to see you again soon! || Everything is perfect with this bar. Vibe is cozy, not crowded, food is great, cocktails are out of this world and people who work there are the friendliest in the city. I’ll come back. || Thank you, E! We're happy to hear that your experience at our bar was perfect. We hope to see you again soon! || Ordered anchovy and tomato on toast, broken egg with mushroom and the hamburger with mushroom and Roquefort, and all were delicious! The servers were friendly as well. For drinks, ordered the espresso martini and the little rabbit - both were also really good albeit a bit pricy. We got a glass of wine each and the pours were generous. Ambiance was good but when we sat at a cute area, there were a bunch of flies that flew out so we moved. || Hello Isabel, thank you so much for your review and for sharing your experience with us. We are happy to know that you enjoyed the dishes and drinks! We apologize for the inconvenience with the flies; we hope to welcome you back soon for a new experience. Thank you! || Nice atmosphere and nice drinks, very enjoyable but bathroom was a bit dirty || Hello Cee,  Thank you so much for your feedback! We're glad you enjoyed the atmosphere and our drinks. We apologize for the condition of the bathroom. We are already working to improve that aspect. We hope to welcome you back soon!  Regards, Metro e Meio restaurant cocktail bar || Absolutely great, staff was great - Service was great. Food was absolutely delicious. The drink Choice was fabulous would highly recommend atmosphere & music was superb || Thank you so much Nikita for your review! Your opinion is very important to us and motivates us to continue providing special moments. We hope to welcome you back soon. || A very nice and cozy bar near the hotel I stayed. Great cocktails! Nice food! || Thank you for your feedback, Dren! We're glad you enjoyed our cocktails and food. || Great cocktail bar with great drinks and delicious food. The staff were friendly and helpful. Well worth a visit. || Hi Tom, thank you so much for your review! We're glad to know you enjoyed our drinks, food, and service. Come back anytime! || Couldn’t fault this place at all! Staff were so lovely and welcoming, we ordered a variety of dishes to share, which were so delicious and cocktails which were fab! The vibe here was sooo good! Had the best time & will defs recommend for friends coming to visit Lisbon in the future! Thank you so much again to all the guys working here! || Hello Alice, thank you so much for your review and for sharing your positive experience with us! We are happy to hear that you had a great visit, enjoyed the food and cocktails. It will be a pleasure to welcome your friends to our restaurant! Thank you very much! || only stayed for one drink which was nice but a bit sweet, would have been nice to see some classics on the menu. Not the most social place, I felt very uncomfortable as a guest by herself. I was asked 3 times if I was there alone by the waitresses before being asked to move to a smaller table at the back even though the place was almost empty at the time. I actually wanted to sit outside but was told there were no tables even though there were two tables free, just happened to be adjoining tables to others. Very anti social vibes. This might be a nice place to visit as a group but solo travelers might as well stay at home! || Hello Kat, thank you for sharing your experience with us. We sincerely regret that your visit to our establishment was not entirely satisfactory. We apologize for the lack of more traditional drink options on our menu and for the embarrassing situation you experienced as an individual customer.  We would like to better understand what happened and help improve your experience on a future visit. Please contact us so we can discuss more details about the problem you encountered regarding the service you received. Your feedback is very important to us, and we want to ensure that all appropriate measures are taken to prevent similar situations from happening again in the future.  We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back to our establishment and provide a more positive experience. We are available for any further clarification. || A bit expensive hence the 4 stars but otherwise 5 stars. || Thank you so much for your feedback, Thelma! We're glad to hear that, despite the price, your experience was very positive. We hope to welcome you back soon! || We visited this bar early and enjoyed a couple of cocktails. The staff member that served us was very helpful. We loved the pink spicy cocktail! 🌶️ 🌸 || Thank you for your review, Annie! We're glad you enjoyed our cocktails and service. We hope to welcome you back soon! 🍹🌸 …

great wines (we had one from Dão and one from Trás-os-Montes). great food (the oysters were TOP and the vegan cheese selection whatttt?? so good). great service too. it’s located in a not so touristic area of Lisbon so the atmosphere is very relaxed. can I also mention the menu with great music hits as the dish names? and the fact that we made a doggy friend? oh god my experience here was exceptional. I’ll come back. thank you :) || We were recommended here from our air bnb host. We have been here 2 out of our 4 nights in Lisbon, which speaks for itself. The food and wine are amazing, and very very cheap for the quality. All the staff have very welcoming and lovely. || This is an exceptional, cozy place to meet your neighbors, gather around a table, connect over life, and discuss the rich beauty of wines. I learned so much of the diverse range of wines in Portugal, I truly appreciated the music displayed on the walls featuring Pharoah Sanders and and Miles Davis, I felt quite at home with the kind service. If you are looking for that essential traveling experience to meet travelers and discuss the shared life we overlap, this is the place to be. || Thank you so much Smitha💜. See you soon. … || Cannot recommend enough this place. It was a very pleasant surprise. Staff is just precious, warm smile and great recommendations of food pairing with such an amazing and huge variety of natural wines. The food is very good, it is a bit pricey but it's definitely worth it. They have different dishes that combine surprising flavours and textures. Loved it. They also have a nice terrace. || This place is unique in Lisbon. The food is perfectly assembled to give you an array of emotions. The wines are special. The awesome owner and Paulinho make you feel very welcome. I simply love this place. || Thank you, Catarina. ♥️ || What a great spot! 🍷 Loved the wine selection—so many tasty options. The food was fantastic too! I highly recommend the stracciatella with peach and cucumber, the aubergine, and the amazing mackerel nigiri.  Everything was so fresh and delicious, and the prices were very fair. A must-visit! ✨ Small suggestion for the place : the cheese board was a bit humble, could benefit a 3rd cheese on the platter for the price. || 10/10 wine 10/10 vibes 10/10 food  If you want a cost intimate spot with an excellent selection of nibbles, wines and tunes then look no further than here.  I'll definitely be back the next time I'm in Lisbon x || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re delighted you enjoyed the wine, food, and atmosphere — that’s exactly what we love to hear. We can’t wait to welcome you back the next time you’re in Lisbon! 🍷✨ … || Food was surprisingly good. Good selection of wines and the waiters give a recommendation. If you go there will be more positive things that negative its just a crammed spaces with people smoking near you and too close to the street and the cars. Not my kind of atmosphere || Love this place for a wine after work. Menu recently changed and unfortunately it seems to have gotten a bit more expensive. But wine selection is good and the sitting area outside has a great vibe. || I can only reaffirm all the other reviews. Absolutely loved this spot.  The best part was the friendly guys working at the joint. They were very accomodating to ensure we had a pleasant visit.  We enjoyed their local portuguese craft beer and two pizzas.  I highly recommend the pizza Era um redondo vocábulo. The pest was delicious and mild, the amount of pecans were generous and the burrata was fresh and creamy.  If you're looking for a cozy spot with nice music and delicious food, visit this place. Will definitely return. || Thank's a lot🥰🥰🥰 Kian❤. …

To have a drink at night. With darts and pool table. In my opinion prices are very high. Can smoke inside.  Probably I'll never come back again. || Really loved the atmosphere and it was super easy to talk! Cocktails were really nice on top of that || Great place for a late night drink, with darts and pool table, just ring the bell at the door. Can smoke inside. || Licors and drinks from the best you can find, a nice card of cocktails, very cosy, and everyone was super friendly. Had an amazing time and will definitely come back ! || Great place with highly professional bartenders. Some drinks are overpriced || Nice and cozy place... very good selection of whiskey || It's not "great", but it's an ok place to go, that's open after 2am. || Very expensive for a very low quality service. The space is okay || To have a drink in Lisbon for sure one of the best places || Good place to enjoy the Italian Night.

Thursday night visit on my own. Excellent. Got there at 9pm, and the band started at 9 15. And played till 11.  40% of seats taken by the time I got there; there are only about 30 seats, and limited standing area. Cover charge of €10 and drinks are reasonably priced. Musicians were superb - played modern improvised jazz. Little bit difficult figuring out where its entrance was when I got there; actually up a set of stairs, on the first floor verandah if the building it’s in. Staff really friendly and helpful. || Thank you very much, Ian! See you soon! || Small and cozy place. The band was fantastic, playing beautifully and creating such a relaxing, authentic jazz atmosphere. We didn’t make a reservation, we just showed up at 9pm sharp to find the best seating place, the band started at 10pm. A special shoutout to Edwardo & Rita their hospitality and kindness made the evening even more enjoyable. They made us feel truly welcome from the moment we arrived. || Thank you very much! See you soon! || Exquisite, small and intimate jazz club. Live music every night every day. Amazing service and atmosphere. But please be aware and respect the house rules - silence when musicians play. If you want to gossip with your friends with some background music this is not your place. If you enjoy music in it's deepest form, this is definitely your place! Card payments accepted and english spoken by staff so very easy for visitors in town to come and enjoy. Will definitely be back. || Thank you very much, Tuomas! See you soon! || Amazing cozy place for Jazz! Wonderful atmosphere. They serve some snacks, like pizza (which looked really nice) but the main thing is drinks and music of course. Highly recommend. Even if youre not a Jazz fan per se, you will love it. Staff is friendly! Go early cause seats are limmited. || Thank you very much, Isabel! See you soon! || Wonderful venue and even better music. We stopped here shortly before getting an early flight out. It’s small so if coming for a gig I recommend getting there close to doors opening. || Thank you so much, Wana! See you soon! || The place is beautiful and elegant. It was hidden in a quiet neighbourhood, in the beginning I was a bit hesitant but once they opened the door, Its like another world, a bit like speakeasy bar  The staff were very friendly. The minima expense for jazz gig is €10, which means if you order drinks more than €10 then the gig is free  The gig I had that night was very good, but was so late, 11pm-2am, I had to leave at 12 otherwise I almost fell asleep, can’t really enjoy the music , really wish they could start earlier || What a fabulous place! A gem! The owner is super friendly - answered my questions in advance and chatted to us when we were there to explain the background to the music (the night we went was a kind of Portuguese folk jazz fusion - which was beautiful and high quality). The place is small, packed full of locals with a really warm atmosphere. We had cocktails (great) and stayed for both sets. If you like intimate venues away from the tourist drags you’ll love it. || Thanks, David! See you soon! || All good very beautiful and they respect the moment for the musicians! The entry is 12,5€ plus what you want to drink. There are no tables just sits. The only thing is that the space is a little bit small and were full and more people was coming inside 🫣 you don’t need to do reservations 🙂 || Távola is easily the best place for live jazz in Lisbon! Excellent music, service and drinks. || Thank you so much, Liz! See you soon! || I'm not new to jazz, but new to the jazz scene here in Lisbon. Finally made it to Távola. The space is tight and the gig I saw was a trio...the musicians were fantastic and did not disappoint. There's an intimate setting where you are as close as possible to the musicians, so the audio quality is live and not being blasted through big speakers. €10 music cover €3 small beers, food: more bar style, simple (my next visit I will for sure eat before I go to hear jazz) || Thanks, Aaron! See you soon!

We landed late in Lisbon one night and were dying for any kind of food at 1 AM, even fast food. What we did not expect from this bar was one of the absolute tastiest black angus burgers and fries cooked to perfection. On top of that we got a plate of various Iberian meats and finished everything with a delightfully paired chocolate crepe and gelato combination. At 1-2 AM mind you. If you’re in the area and wondering what to eat, absolutely make sure to visit this bar. They cook to such a high standard even at night. || Cocktails are very good, food options better than expected and the service fantastic The place is cozy not too loud || It's the greatest pub that I have ever been. Julie is such a nice person to meet... Thank you so much, you are so nice.. we will be back again... :)))))) || One of my favourite places. Try the dip!  I love this bar and come here at least once a week. They are open till around 3 and have food till 1:30 (highly recommend the steak sandwich).  The staff are super friendly and the place is always very calm and we'll organized. Definetly one of my favourite places in Lisbon. || It is such a cool local bar. Great service. Great music. Fantastic cocktails and so chill || Loved the vibes and the environment, good selection of drinks and spirits. The service was really on a high level. I'll be back soon for sure || Lovely basement bar. Cheap beer, great service, lovely atmosphere. || One of the best chill bar ever, friendly staff, best fries and burger i ever had, dip is from haven || Has a really cozy atmosphere along with great drinks and great service. || Nice cocktail place. Have the kitchen open until late

Amazing aperitivo italiano, everything it's super cool here, music, atmosphere, food and Marco he gives an excellent service, cocktail fantastics. For €6 you can have an amazing italian aperitivo with cocktail. || Great Gonzalo! I love you! Thanks so much for the fantastic review! || If you’re looking for the most unforgettable, authentic, and vibrant bar experience in Lisbon, look no further – this is hands-down the best spot in the entire city! Tucked away in the heart of a truly charming neighborhood, this place offers a magical mix of atmosphere, character, and energy that is simply unmatched anywhere else in Lisbon.  From the moment you step through the door, you’re greeted with the warmest, most welcoming vibe imaginable. The staff are incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do – they make you feel like a local from the very first visit. It’s the kind of place where strangers become friends, and every visit feels like a celebration.  The atmosphere is absolutely electric – buzzing with laughter, conversation, and the unmistakable soul of Lisbon. It’s packed with locals, which speaks volumes. You won’t find a more genuine or authentic crowd anywhere else. There’s no touristy pretense here – just pure, unfiltered Lisboeta life at its finest.  And now, let’s talk about the drinks – because WOW. The Caipirinhas served here are nothing short of legendary. Easily the best I’ve ever had – perfectly balanced, incredibly fresh, and dangerously delicious. Each sip is a burst of citrusy, refreshing perfection. It’s clear that they use only the highest quality ingredients and pour a ton of care and craftsmanship into every cocktail.  The location? Absolutely unbeatable. It’s nestled in a prime spot that’s both lively and laid-back, making it the perfect place to kick off your evening or wind down after a long day of exploring the city. Whether you’re sitting inside soaking up the cozy ambiance or enjoying the lively street-side buzz, it’s the ideal setting for unforgettable nights.  In short, this bar is nothing less than a hidden treasure – an absolute must-visit for anyone wanting the very best Lisbon has to offer. I can’t recommend it highly enough. Do yourself a favor and go – you’ll thank me later! || Oh my god Jan! Really thank you from the bottom of my heart for the wonderful review! A Morte do Corvo is fantastic show. If you have done "immersive" theater before, there is a lot to discover here - if you haven't they do an excellent job of giving you enough information to piece together what is going on and what to do. The venue/space is worth the price of admission alone, but so many of the scenes are fantastically thought out.  Neither Portuguese nor English fluency is required to enjoy! The instructions and rules at the beginning of the show are provided in those two languages, but the vast majority of thw show is presented without language. || Heard about immersive theatre before, but this was my first time actually trying it out. Happy, we have it in Lisbon 🫶🏼 || This was the most incredible performance we’ve ever seen. Every actor’s story was spot-on — full of emotion and precision. It’s true that some smaller rooms were crowded and we couldn’t catch every moment, but honestly, that didn’t take away from the experience. The ambience was beyond words — we truly felt like we were part of the show. Thank you!!! || One of the most interesting and unique experiences. Not great if you have troubles walking (there are stairs and sometimes to follow a character you need to rush). Some of the guests could be a bit more  mindful of actors and guests and allow space. Waste of time || I can only recommend A Morte do Corvo to whoever is in Lisbon or visiting! My boyfriend and I arrived today and decided to visit - we were left speechless! The atmosphere, the actors and the sheer performance was extraordinary. We will most certainly recommend this to all of our friends who will visit Lisbon in the upcoming months!  To the entire acting team & staff: thank you from the bottom of my heart - you made our first day in Lisbon truly magical! || What an experience! We had no clue what we really booked when we heard what it was about, nevertheless we wanted to try something new (1st day in Lisbon and my gf and I don't speak Portuguese).  These actors were able to convey more with their bodies than we thought possible, it had action, drama, intensity - just everything one could want.  Do yourself a favor and read the play as it will greatly help you understand the nuances.  To the actors, the staff, the people who built the props - THANK YOU for making our first day in Lisbon unforgettable!!!  For people considering to go, my and my gf have booked it again before we leave as this is how absolutely stunning it was. || I recently attended this venue for a show and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. Due to the complete lack of available parking spaces nearby, we spent over 30 minutes searching for a spot. As a result, we arrived 7 minutes late and found the doors locked, with no way to enter. There was no prior warning in the ticket or email that arriving even slightly late would result in being denied entry. Additionally, there was no information about the serious parking challenges near the venue, which would have been crucial for planning our arrival.  What made the situation worse was the complete lack of support or communication from the company. The only person we could find was a security guard who had no ability to assist us. This experience was deeply frustrating, and I would caution others planning to attend. Be aware that even a small delay could mean losing access entirely. The company needs to take accountability for better informing their customers about these strict policies and challenges, as well as offering proper support in such situations. Great "batch" of young people. || It was a funny parody, in a very old place, but preserved without luxury. || We look forward to seeing you at the new revue “And Nobody Goes to Jail?!”, seated in our new and comfortable auditorium. ❤️ 🎭 … || I loved watching the great revue theatre show in Lisbon. Something that should last forever!  It has parking. || Want to go to the theater? You're in the perfect place. || Good show, but it really needs some renovations in the auditorium and new seats. || We look forward to seeing you at the new revue “And Nobody Goes to Jail?!”, seated in our new and comfortable auditorium. ❤️ 🎭 … || Excellent theatre. Great performance by the Revue Theatre, Nobody Goes to Prison, an excellent satire of Portuguese society.

Watching the opera Fatima in this enchanting venue was a truly magnificent experience. I highly recommend that tourists like me who are planning a long stay in Lisbon see at least one performance in this magnificent setting. || Awesome place to watch musicals !! Follow here and the IG link in profile for more travel and food and drink tips, ideas and reviews! || Lovely theatre, very cosy, the seats are comfortable and has homely feeling about it. We saw the musical called Severa and thoroughly enjoyed the production and didn't find the language a barrier. || "LAURA" Fantastic, spectacular musical. Hugely professional, wonderful theatre, dance and singing. Great orchestra..  Sissi incredible lead, actress, dance and singing. La Feria does it again and again and again! 😊 … || I do recommend this show that is currently on exhibition in Politeama theatre. The two actors are incredibly talented and they work very well on this piece. Go and you won't regret. || I have gone to a show 4 times and it has never disappointed me. There is a show every winter and it has amazing acting. The props and costumes are amazing and believable. The last one I went to was Beauty and the Beast, it was great and I definitely don’t regret going. All the singing is live and even though the shows are mostly for kids, adults also enjoy them. All the songs and dialogue is in Portuguese, but there are subtitles in English that tell you what is happening in the scene. I recommend. || Beautiful building both outside and inside. The façade is worth a special attention. || The only theatre with musical productions in Portugal. Really good productions with really good voices and actors. Update, new show same quality! Great cast! || They have a loud speaker at the street playing songs from their shows constantly. We are trying to eat at the restaurant next to the theater but the music is so loud that we cannot even speak to our company. They seem to have no respect for the public or their neighbors || Amazing performing talent! Would give the final star if there was air conditioning. || A magical theater! Know for its Portuguese musicals (a genre called Revista). Filipe La Feria is the most known musical director in Portugal and is responsible for most of its plays.  This photos are from the play ‘Laura’. The biographic narrative of Laura Alves, the most important comic in Portuguese Theatre. || Very nice and comfortable, in the city centre. Easily accessible, the theatre is not too large. Well decorated, with good acoustics. || We recently had the pleasure of watching Cinderella. Although the play may have been primarily geared towards a younger audience, we found it delightful and thoroughly entertaining as an adult couple. The experience was truly joyful, filled with fantastic singing and dancing that had us thoroughly engrossed.  Unfortunately, we made an error with our dates and arrived a day later than our tickets were scheduled for. Despite this, the staff were incredibly understanding and accommodating. They went out of their way to offer us equally good seats. We're tremendously grateful for their kindness and flexibility. This unexpected act of kindness added even more to our wonderful theatre experience. || July 6, 2024, last performance of Sleeping Beauty, which they will record for television. I go with my daughter, we don't speak Portuguese but it is a story more than known to everyone. Before giving way to the performance, a man appears (to call him something), a kind of presenter who gives instructions on how to applaud, how to laugh, how to say NO during the performance, since the TV records and apparently it has to be everything more intense. After this , he begins to make changes in the seats in the first rows of the stalls (I am in the balcony, above) he changes some adults for some kids (adults who had paid for their tickets in the first rows, not the last). Suddenly, without us understanding anything, he makes a kid who was in the front rows with his friends stand up (he couldn't have been even 10 years old?) and changes him for a girl who is in the back row. I don't know if it's a joke that's part of the show and I haven't understood it, but when the child, visibly affected, sits in the last row, I ask my neighbor in the seat and, sure enough, to my astonishment, she has changed the child. because he says he does not comply with the standards of weight, height and beauty required by a show that is going to appear on TV. I can not believe it. I'm shocked, and hasn't the entire audience risen in a fit of anger at such humiliation of a child? I am sad, indignant and angry with myself for not having understood anything and for having stood up in his defense. This child will never forget a humiliation of this caliber. But this man, when do they kick him out? Who gave him the power to do what he did to a CHILD in front of a packed theater? I can't be sadder. Nothing has changed either in the theater or on TV, or in the world? || We went to Cinderella show, and it was purely magical. The musical was a great remake, respecting the storyline. The cast, costumes, and decor were a dream. If you have a kid, it's a great opportunity to see a beautiful classic Disney story. If you are an adult, it is always nice to see a childhood memory. 😍 … || There is an unbelievably loud and annoying ad playing in front of this theatre 9am-10pm everyday. This place seems to have no respect for the people living, staying or eating (at the many restaurant terraces) on the street. || The theatre on a whole is nice. Just an issue with the seating which offers very little leg room. || The hall offer good acoustics. Seat are confortable and clean. || Filipe Laferia always surprisrs us in a positive way, with a great team and amazing wardrobe! Difficult to park very near but Restauradores public parking serves the purpose. Difficult accessibility for wheelchairs but not impossible with a little help from muscular Portuguese men.

Cinema São Jorge is a beautiful, historic cinema that every film lover should have on their radar. Housed in an old building, it constantly hosts screenings and is regularly featured in film festivals and cultural events. … || THE main stage of most lx film fest. The place is central and kind of iconic. || Went to a comedy show and left amazed by the venue. It preserves a lot of the original elements of the cinema including the restrooms (I did not expect to ever say this, but tres cool urinals!). Beautiful vintage  spacious cinema with multiple halls, comfortable seats. Fine bar with tap beer. I am very glad that places like this still exist. Worth visiting || I went to the cinema to see a Ukrainian film about the first days a begining the war with russia. I was very impressed by this movie. The cinema was clean and cozy. There are friendly staff and comfortable chairs. || I visited the Cinema São Jorge during the Lisbon Film Festival 2024 and I enjoyed the experience. The structure of the cinema is a little old, such as the seats, the distribution between the rows and the inclination of the screen in … || Spent a lot of of time there during the Doclisboa festival. Have so much good memory from this nice cinema and it's beautiful people. || In the heart of town and full of action around it. It is a spacious place with different rooms for entertainment. Somewhat difficult to navigate by the lack of correct signaling but clean and well kept. || Went to see Jim Jeffries, like always never desapointed! It's a great place with a lot of history. The new neaby parking is awesome. Totally recommended! || We had a wonderful time at Cinema São Jorge during the Festival Play, a kids' film festival. The cinema's beautiful building on Avenida Liberdade is a great setting for any event. Our nearly 3-year-old daughter thoroughly enjoyed her first … || Classy cinema, old school style. An aperitif by the balcony before of after the film adds to the experience. || My first time on the cinema was to participate on Cinema Medo. It’s a immersive terror experience where you follow the characters stories in order to discover the main mystery. The participants are divided in teams and participate in … || Stunning old-school movie theatre. Greatly keeps architectural details. Very nice staff. || I'm not referring to the restaurant, but to the cafeteria at the entrance to the cinema. … || Amazing vintage cinema equiped with the latest technology. Diversified program during the year with different cinema genres. My favourite is the Lisbon Motorcycle Film Fest. || Loved it! Had the opportunity to visit without anyone there. It was amazing, I had a blast. It's full of history and it's in the middle of the Avenue, just magical!! || Great old cinema. Host of various interesting festivals || Cinema São Jorge isn't just a cinema; it's a Lisbon landmark and a cultural powerhouse. From hosting prestigious French film festivals to showcasing chilling horror flicks, its walls have pulsated with cinematic energy for decades. … || Very nice Movie Theater! || Always is good to go there with friends to experience indie films. Is a great place to enjoy that kind of films, great sound in the cinema room and the atmosphere outside to drink a coffee or be in the balcony. Great place :)

As students of film heritage, we had access to  not just the cinemas and the museum but the documentation centre as well.  Cinemateca Portuguesa is the state institution responsible of preserving and protecting film heritage of Portugal and beyond.  It also boasts of a rooftop restaurant and a curated book and antique media shop.  It’s worth visiting! || Thank you so much, Emmanuel! || The Cinemateca Portuguesa offers not only cinema and cinematic history but also a cinematography museum, a wonderful rooftop restaurant, and an exquisitely curated book and antique media shop. || Thank you so much, Alvaro. || Went to the restaurant here, good food and friendly service. Something went wrong with our booking for 11 but they accommodated us well regardless. Really interesting building, and loads of cool film projection memorabilia everywhere. || This place is a gem! Highly recommend a visit to their cafe bar (with terrace). The staff are super helpful and the food is great. A lovely place to hang out. Apparently,  they show films outside in the Summer.  One of the most beautiful art cinemas I've been to. They've got a book shop and a quiet library.  Lots of English language films. Using proper film rather than digital.  I'll be back. || Hidden gem for film lovers. Founded in 1948 and set in a magnificently restored 19th-century building, it’s a space where moorish arches, tiled walls, and a grand staircase meet vintage projectors, rare posters, and screenings of timeless films. It feels less like stepping inside cinema’s living memory. Beyond the films, the bookshop is great with cinephile’s gems, and the café terrace “39 Degraus” is perfect for a coffee break. || Great ambience, didn’t know what to expect of it. But the food was great! And the movie was so nostalgic (high quality). || This place is heaven! There are old European and American movies playing everyday and you can get a list of them at the front desk. The museum isn’t very large, you might want to check it out while waiting for the movies. Make sure you pay a visit the bookstore! Plenty of vintage magazines in Portuguese. So precious. || That was an amazing cultural place. The building also is very beautiful. Fantastic people. Great snack bar too! || Unbelievable place! It's an old cinema in the city centre where you can feel being 60 years back and watch the old movies. Incredible experience!  They show some world classics in original language, not only Portuguese, but also French, Italian, Spanish, and of course American.  Really stunning decoration with old video cameras, old cinema chairs, and posters on the wall. Even if you don't want to see a movie, just drop by for a coffee or a cocktail in the rofttop restaurant || Thank you, Alexandra. || Nice building, the museum exhibit is small but interesting. There's a very nice terrace with great lunch deals, the food was really nice. || Went for the "cinema museum", and was quite disappointed. The museum is actually just the first floor of the cinema with a few old cameras, projectors and cinema-chairs. I thought that it would be an actual museum telling the Portuguese film history. And, if your not speaking Portuguese, all you can do is look at the items but not knowing anything about them. As I'm not from Portugal I didn't went to the cinema as I guess I would not be able to understand the movies themselves. || We've just had a lovely dining experience in the restaurant/bar upstairs.  A hidden jem. Amazing friendly staff. A couple of the young gentlemen spoke very good English and made us feel welcome. We were looking for a menu that could accommodate gluten-free and found it here. The steak meals where just what we were after. One of us had the pork cheeks that just melted in your mouth. || My favourite cinema in Lisboa. The building is gorgeous and every little detail makes for a wonderful cinematic experience. I love the entrance and the neon sign. I love how affordable the cinema is (3.20 a ticket!) I love how the ticket seller always kindly checks to see if you are eligible for any discounts 😀 I love the star effect ceiling before you enter the cinema room. I love to hang out in the cafe and get a drink before the film and hearing the somewhere over the rainbow music to signal the start of the film. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Was really excited to go there with my girlfriend since we both really enjoy movies, but couldn´t help to leave the place a little bit disappointed since there were no exhibitions happening and the place was quite small. However, if you are around avenida da liberdade and fancy a cocktail or a coffee, they have a great rooftop bar and a really cute bookstore. If you can, check the website beforehand and see the schedules of the movie screenings! || Super interesting history, cool restaurant with even and outdoor space! Really good food and price. They have Meetup there or just conference where they talk about the history of the place. The meetings are weekly and you can go in just for for free if you want to meet new people from everywhere! || Wonderful programming of classics (usually with English and Portuguese subtitles), friendly staff (especially in the fantastic bookstore), and great food and ambiance in the cafe. The museum and architecture is also a treat. || Cinema screenings are varied and in numerous languages, tickets are €3 There's a small (free) museum, bookshop and restaurant/bar with a large terrace called 39degraus, upstairs. || Thank you for your comments. You're always welcome. || Beautiful museum, location, and cinema with a restaurant and bar upstairs || Thank you very much, Pedro. || Watching movies at their esplanada is a must-do during the summer. Staff is always super friendly and food is very tasty with good pricing. || The museum part of the cinematheque was a lot smaller than we had expected. Entrance is free, but it was still a bit disappointing. There is a nice courtyard which i assume is used for viewing movies. The best part of it all was the small shop with interesting books about cinematography. We didn’t get to see any movies as the Cinema was closed.

We bought tickets for hangmassive that says 19:30-23. Dropped other stuff to come here at 19:30 sharp only to a close gate and a line. Been standing here for 30 mins now. Just wow. Experience ruined at the start! || A good venue for concerts, people were all friendly. I'd just suggest to leave the bar open a little bit longer after the end of the show, for people to return their cups or to have another drink. || Newer more modern theater in Lisbon. It's in the "theater district" and is close to a metro stop. The sound quality was very good.  Although the seats were cushioned, they were uncomfortable. || Great concert. Good space! || We went to the sleeping beauty in lights ballet that we purchased through “FEVER”. This is my review of the show, not the building itself. Unfortunately, the show was very sad. It wasn’t what I expected at all. And even though I appreciated their interpretation of it, I feel that they needed more practice so they’d be more synchronized. Their movements, we’re not in sync with each other, or the music. They also seemed clunky, and not very graceful at times. The lack of costume changes, stage design, and lighting on their costumes made it feel like a missed opportunity. Several families stood up and left the show 10-15 minutes into it. We didn’t do it, because we honestly felt bad for them, but thank god it was only one hour. || Great place for gigs. Great sounds and way access from the metro. Lots of bars within 5 or  10 minutes walk. || Comfortable seating and decent sound. Very close to the Avenida Metro. If you're taking a car ride there, it's best to have the driver drop you off a block of so away as the small street leading to the theatre gets VERY backed up. The only negative is the single small entrance and exit door. || A very nice place for concerts and other live events. Quite central too. || Extremely poor experience. The parking was closed without any prior information and we were delayed trying to find alternative parking. the staff at the theatre refused to accomodate late entry due to their own mismanagement ...

place_name: CAL - Centro de Artes de Lisboa
reviews_content: A very pleasant place. From the outside, you can't imagine what you'll find inside. A spacious performance hall. You'll want to spend a whole day there reading and watching shows. The theatre group based there, "Os Primeiros Sintomas" (The First Symptoms), is constantly progressing. From show to show, they are always growing significantly. It's really worth visiting CAL and getting to know "Os Primeiros Sintomas". || Probably the best alternative theatre in Lisbon :) || Amazing space for shows || Long live the theatre!!

Good Teatre, good seats and facilities. Staff also very polite and welcoming || It was amazing. We saw A Mentira and all was fabulous. The actors were simply great. Cast is fantastic. When the act finished they did a Q&A session with all the spectators. It was a wonderful moment. Great job, well done! You will make me come again to see A Verdade. || Very accommodating staff. My mother has mobility issues and everything was done to make sure she had a great experience at the theater || Very nice theater and, by the way, very nice restaurant in the theater || A well-equipped contemporary theatre house. || One of the best theaters in Lisbon || One of the great Portuguese theatre companies. Throughout its existence, it has presented a number of great playwrights. A must-see for theatre lovers. It has good public transport links to reach the venue.

Popcorn-Lovers take care, the big bucket is unusual big, I didn’t even manage half of it as an experienced popcorn-eater. Great experience, cinema was very clean and super friendly staff! || Staff were friendly. We were in Sala 6, very well organised and clean but sound system could have been better. It was lower than expected and we could clearly hear the person talking beside and behind us, which created a problem for us to focus on the movie. || This was always my favourite mainstream cinema in Lisbon, no scratch that, anywhere!  There was nothing to fault it. Comfortable - nonsense to state there is no a/c. No sound inteference from areas outside. Faultless peojections. Good programming. Great prices. But was prompted to comment by the quick and gracious way they dealt with us not wanting to watch what we mistakenly thought was an English language film. Full marks to them! || Good cinema and convenient seats. They apparently don’t accept foreign credit card but you can buy the ticket online at cheaper price. ( 6.3€ online vs 6.6€ at box office ). There are few movies that are displayed in the original language so better check before buying. || I think this is the best place to watch a movie in Lisbon. The cinema is very comfortable, the prices are really affordable and the quality of the projection is good. Besides that, the audience behaves very well, so this is a very good extra point. || Just returned from a Sunday afternoon trip to the movies. The theater was clean, popcorn freshly prepared. Unfortunately the studio 11 where our film was showing got really warm a quarter of the way through the film even though it was nearly empty. By the end of the film I was almost in a full sweat. I did not find anyone after the movie to let them know of this condition. Also the screen had a few water marks at the top Centre which was a bit annoying. || Large selection of movies through the entire year. Food and drinks are big and expensive. || I had an inconvenience in my first attempt to watch a movie and it was so well solved. I had really a good experience. I got Yorn discount for the ticket and also for the popcorn menu. So I spent just 8€. || Some movies are not in English even though the theatre is in El Corte Ingles. “VP” is shown next to the Portuguese movies but who would know what VP is supposed to mean? Website does say “double session in Portuguese” in the description for VP but it’s not a good translation. What does double session mean? All they had to do was say “Language: __” next to the movie. The fact that all movies have the word ingles next to them is very confusing. There are very simple ways to make it clear which language the movie is shown in and they fail to do so by using random acronyms. (Edit: Changed star rating since they did refund me) || The lack of air conditioning killed the mood. Great movies, comfortable seats,  however unbearably hot during a summer night

Great VIP experience. Comfortable room, good image and sound. The menu is tasty and a nice alternative to popcorns although those are also included. || We did the VIP experience just to try it out. For the price (just over €20 each) the food was very disappointing, very cheap pizza, nuggets, nachos etc but you get unlimited popcorn and drinks (including alcohol) although given how cheap booze is in Portugal you aren't really gaining anything plus you can't go back out during the movie so only so much you can carry out to seat. Anyway, aside from that, it was still a nice experience and the seats were very comfortable (electric recliners). Staff very friendly too.. || I enjoyed my visit to this cinema. The movie show was great, everything was convenient and comfortable in the cinema hall🎥🍿 … || BEAUTIFUL!! So far, this was the nicest looking cinema I have ever visited.Beautiful architecture overall with awesome statues and movie props around the cinema. 2 tickets + Large popcorn with 2 large drinks cost us around 23 €  which was a bit less than what we pay in our country with lower standard than Portugal so..Definitely recommended!!🎟 🎥 🎫 || Stunning architecture, I wish indoors interior was as beautiful as outdoors. Concert hall seems more like a tiny stadium/circus rather than a classical concert hall. Chairs are plastic and uncomfortable, also every seat is situated too close to each other. They sell popcorn during a classical music concert. Seriously? It was quite disappointing overall. || Beautiful building, amazing architecture, great presence. I can only imagine the energy once this place is full of people. Good for a quick visit. || Room 4 smells like mold and urine. Why would it smell like urine!??? Please deep clean the carpets or take them out. || Very good cinema, lots of interesting movies, near subway, has delicious popcorn and other indispensable things. Highly recommended || Went to see Gladiator II, the cinema was confusing to find your way around as one of the entrances was closed. The staff were all very nice and made the process quick and easy. Comfortable and clean seats in a quiet cinema led to great experience || Good local cinema in the underground mall here. Go down using the elevator or the ramp. The most obvious entrance is on the west side.  They have 4 screens and lots of seats which are almost empty (not sure how they make money!) So you can usually sit in the centre. The Hollywood films are in English with subtitles - as in most Portuguese cinemas. Tickets are about 6 euros. They have fun seats outside with a retro car theme.

Small intimate theater. Has a restaurant in the second floor if you want to grab a snack or a drink before the show. || Only tried the bar, so can't say much for now. Will conclude the review once full visit is done. || Great theatre hall as well as concert venue. Good acoustics, quite comfortable, I have great memories from the shows I’ve seen there. || Very lovely ambience and comfortable seating. Me and a few friends watched the Live Musical Dear Evan Hansen there (em português, Querido Evan Hansen) and we loved every second! || A nice teatre small but cosy, the entrance may be simple, you may wait to enter before the show begins,  but next to the space you have a nice chinese restaurante, where you can have dinner before the show, no café inside the theatre, so do have it outside, but after 8 pm the cafe outside are all closed. Only the horrible fast foods next to the railway station are opened, the resturants and some licor bars. || Comfortable and the art play was hilarious || Staff really nice, seating comfortable and spacious, very good acoustics || I'm writting not about the theater but about its bar, on the first floor. It is open every afternoon until 2 A.M. Serves light snacks, wines, gins, etc. It's one of the few bars open late night in the neigbourhood. Calm ambiance, nice balcony fr the hot days. Good for chating with small group around a small table. || Theatre venue with a casual and quiet coffee lounge, with a very laid back atmosphere. Events are typically innovative and eager to the young crowds. || Great visibility of the stage, cozy and intimate room which is good on my opinion, chairs could be more comfortable || Comfortable sits. Nice coffee shop on the first floor for some pre show drinks || Great spot for a drink or a quick meal. Good music most of the time. :) || Nice Theater. Very good facilities. Top, Top, Top || Good service,  close to Porto city || Cozy place, relatively confortable chairs, good acoustics. || Excellent protocol for COViD. And excellent play Avenida Q || one of the few places in lisbon for experimental electronic music shows || Nice place quiet good condition || Absolutely amazing concert Lina_RaulRefree || Sharing old school theater. || Great music, great bar, great place || Good concerts, alternative music || Great cocktails and choice of whiskey || Great selection of drinks in bar || The reference in Lisbon for quality and alternative music concerts.

Such a special place for kids, my son absolutely loved it! Maria is a wonderful teacher—warm, engaging, and so talented with the kids. I couldn’t recommend it more! || Space to Be is a one-of-a-kind place where children are able to use their imaginations, express themselves freely and creatively, and have fun! In a world where children are less and less connected to themselves and the people around them, Space to Be gives them the chance to do just that. To challenge them to think for themselves and pursue their dreams. I can't recommend it enough! || Space to Be is an incredible place for children to explore their creativity in Lisbon. The performance was honest and sweet and had a very clear, honourable message. A fantastic experience I hope my daughter gets to repeat || Ms Rio and Space to Be are amazing! A caring  and passionate place for kids to learn and explore their creativity and build confidence. Highly recommend and will definitely be back! || Miss Rio is great!  Super creative and inspiring. She is a pleasure to work with and her activities engage her students and help them build confidence.  I wish there were more then 5 stars I could give her. || Our and especially our Kids favorite camp because of the love and passion that is behind every project. Such wonderful ideas, such caring staff, and perfect group dynamics. || Ms. Rio is one of the most empathetic individuals I have ever met.  Her sincerity and compassion are unequaled.  This is who I would turn to for any of my kids. || Miss Rio creates a space that encourages curiosity, self expression and a wonderful exploration of the imagination. My son comes out of her classes beaming with confidence, an enthusiasm for learning and joy. He is always asking when is his next drama class ! || My daughter just loved the time at space to be .Great fun and she loved Ms Rio! Looking forward to more- Adding to my post from before I must say the program never disappoints. Great fun for the children ❤️ || Amazing space, curriculum, and environment. You couldn’t put your children in better hands. || My children had the most wonderful experience and I would highly recommend Space to be , we shall be back ! || Amazing activity for children! Confidence building creative and fun! I would 100% recommend it!! || The best place for children in Portugal! Maria Rio is an incredible person who conducts all activities with great love and professionalism. A space for children to get to know themselves better, their relationship with others and with the world. A wonderful job!

Great location and amenities. Needs a little freshening up of wood finishes in the room. Photos show views from the rooftop where there is a nice bar. || Amazing location and the best view of the city can be had while swimming in the rooftop pool. I highly recommend staying here when visiting this beautiful city. || It is a super clean super friendly great place to stay. It's in the center of town. || Rooms are a bit dated but clean. Good central area to stay. || Beautiful buildings in the daylight. It is located on the main road of Lisbon city center. The entrance is accessible for wheelchairs. It might be difficult to find parking nearby. || Seems okay. If you are extreme fan of hygine and luxury, this won't suit you but if are a traveller and need a decent place at the epicenter of hustle and bustle of Lisbon, go for it. || Great location, nice rooms, breakfast selection good. || Looks awesome at night, great achitecture! || Art deco icon building of Lisbon.  Designed by Cassiano Branco and Carlo Florencio Dias and built in 1931. Unfortunately only the facade was left and hides these days a hotel. || There are many things to see and do.  If you have time, this is a great experience.

I got turned around because I was 10 min late for the show  The ticket didn’t say that I won’t be able to enter after the show starts. Information on the ticket that is in English doesn’t state that I won’t be able to enter.  The rest of the information is in Portuguese in tiny letters I came to the wrong theatre first because there are two theaters with a similar name, stayed in traffic that’s why I was late (This is not the problem of the theatre obviously).  Yet I wasn’t accommodated, I wasn’t offered any solution. Just was kicked out at the door . || Hello, Alina. We are sorry you had a bad experience. Our tickets, both digital and printed, say that latecomers can only enter the room when it is permitted. In this particular case, that was not possible.
