Frankie's is a very cheap place. I had 2 drinks, a hotdog with side dish and dessert for €11! The portions were perfect for me.  All combined, it makes for a popular place which gets very busy after 7PM. They don't do reservations, so be there early or you'll be in a long line.  UPDATE: we came back today at noon, and tried some other hot dogs. Service was again very friendly. It's really mist visit! || Good quality and tasty food, great presentation and environment, great price! Everything’s good about this place! Fast service even in rush hours. || Nice hot-dog restaurant around the University Campus. || The first place we visited on our trip to Lisboa. The food was AMAZINGLY TASTY. Huge hot dogs with a lot of ingredients, everything home-made.  It's a shame we do not have this kind of "restaurant" in Madrid. I would totally repeat.  10/10 Best hot dog I've ever eaten.

A great playground right next to a quiosk. Perfect for a weekend or afternoon meet up with friends while the kids play. || This is a playground in the park, with slides, swings, climbing nets, and other play facilities. || Nice place to relax and get a drink or snacks with kids playground || Nice atmosphere. Clean. Right next to the kiosk that has a bathroom. Several different areas. The spider web area is my son's favorite. There's also a small slide and swings. Lots of local children and tourists too. || Nice park. Several areas, with some shady spots and even one next to a kiosk. || Plenty of opportunities for play and always open. It tends to be crowded on weekends and late afternoons, but children can easily move around on the swings, etc. || Various devices for children to enjoy. Equipment without significant degradation. || Safe, with different toys, a safe and well-frequented environment. It has a water fountain and sand for the children; my daughter loves it. || It could have a few more attractions. But even so, the children enjoy it. || There's nothing better for a child than playing outdoors. The park is great. || Very fun and well-equipped park. It's a shame that the older children destroy the equipment meant for the younger ones. || Sometimes quite crowded, but very good for taking children. || Good park for children, unfortunately very close to the road. || Great for children, it's a shame it needs more cleaning. || Not very suitable for children. || There's a small playground for children, and a kiosk nearby where parents can have coffee and a snack while their child plays. || A good children's playground in Campo Grande, next to Avenida da Igreja. || Good space, but needs more frequent cleaning. || Wonderful space, perfect for relaxing!

It's a rather boring playground. It is somewhat worn and only suitable for very young children 4-6 years. However, there is a park in the area with free-range chickens and ducks. I give this place 2 thumbs up. 👍👍 … || Decent park. The ducks and chickens are quite the sight to see. It is centrally located in the central area which means there a restaurants and stores to access, however, you are caught in the middle of all the day to day hustle. || I love the wild birds here . Beautiful spot . || Chickens, ducks, roasters, cats and dogs living together. Strange place ;) || Shady, tree-filled respite from the Lisbon sun. Places to sit whether on park benches or stone halfwalls. There's also an enclosed basketball/futsal court at the south end if your child fancies a pickup match. || Smoking bench at gate entrance to playground. Smoking shouldn't be allowed in the vicinity of the playground. Playground equipment like the metal slippery slide and metal chain to hold onto on the swing was at burning temperature on a 33 degree celsius day because there's no shade from the sun || It's a nice parc ! BUT some weird guy wearing a white sweat-shirt, was pulling trash from his bag and putting it in the little bassin where the birds are... he did it at less three times. Leaving and comming back. Poor birds. || The slides here are great and relatively large. There are many parents and children around. || It's a play park, the buildings around mean it does not get intense sun || Cute play park, seriously in need of some TLC though which is a shame || A nice playground in the park, suitable for both toddlers and older children. It's fully fenced. || There is some equipment for children. A field for various sports. It needs to be more careful regarding the litter scattered around the area. || A children's park, small for the number of people it attracts on weekends. However, the funny thing is that this influx of many children accompanied by their parents manages to create a family-friendly and healthy environment for play. … || Spacious area, safe and well-located.  Obvious planning error (enclosure on the inside of the park) and the usual … || Abominable individuals are having a wonderful time right in front of the playground: smoking and drinking alcohol. There are practically no children. I absolutely do not recommend it with children. || Nice park, but I have a suggestion. They could add one or two more ping-pong tables because the one that's there is always occupied due to its popularity. || Good morning, will it be necessary to hire a gardener to prune what is needed around the football field? || Beautiful large park. Also suitable for children, as there is a playground there. || Excellent park with a good variety of attractions for children to play on, and surrounded by a beautiful garden.

Well equipped, clean and entertaining playground. Plenty of slides, swings and play structures for smaller kids plus more challenging play structures for bigger kids. Note gravel surface was fine for 1 kid with no shoes but bothered the other one who kept her sandals on. Toilets strictly for kids only - attendant monitors adherence to the signs! Nice bar nearby - in common with plenty of playgrounds in Lisbon. || We were in Lisbon for vacation. I was riding the tram 28 with my toddler son and we decided to jump off the tram to go to the nearest playground.  It turned out it was a fun playground with little stones on the floor. Kids can play with the stones for a long time.  The playground is situated in a nice green park.  The slides are giraffe and lion shape. There are few swings. There isn’t much shades so it could be hot and sunny during summer days. || The best playground! The animal shaped structures are so cute! This is my first time seeing little pebbles as the playground floor, and my daughter loved it. There are decent swing sets for babies and older kids, and also a climbing structure in another area. The surrounding park is beautiful and busy, and parents can have a drink at the nearby quiosque. || Very good park perfect do go with children because it has a lot to do for kids in a Jung age || Excellent playground for children to play but be cautious going during work hours as the lady who works there will yell at any adult that attempts to climb or sit on a swing and threatens to call the cops on you. I advise visiting after 17:00 when she’s no longer there (plus it’s cooler with the sun going down) || The playground itself is very nice. But the lady who takes care of the toilets next to it is very bossy and kinda mean. The playground was almost completely empty and I just wanted to swing a little bit on the swings. I was not bothering anyone. The lady came out and said I was not allowed in there and needed to leave. Apparently it is forbidden to enjoy a swing set in peace when you're not a little kid anymore. For the rest the playground is nice with cool slides and climbing stuff || Not sure why this playground gets such high marks (aside from the lovely surroundings). The equipment is not actually very kid friendly. Younger children absolutely need assistance climbing, and the rocks are difficult to walk on. || Nice playground. Restrooms are just for kids. There are benches and water fountain closeby. || This is our favorite playground and park in Lisbon. There are two play areas…  The first is quite large with super small, smooth rocks for the surface and enclosed by a wooden fence. There you can find swings, slides, teeter totter, benches for parents, and all sorts of other fun. My kids love the rocks and spend half the time scooping and burying themselves. Bring sand toys and trucks for the ultimate rock experience.  The second play area is a giant rope pyramid! It’s awesome. I’ve even climbed up as far as my old body would allow. This is a kid favorite too.  Next to the play areas is a kiosk/cafe serving up everything you want - tostas, pastries, snacks, ice cream, wine, beer, cocktails. The kiosk has one small bathroom.  There’s a children’s only bathroom that is attended by a park worker to ensure the kid’s space remains safe and clean. There are water fountains around too.  The park has many shaded areas perfect for a picnic or birthday party. There’s another cafe on the other side of the park that is more calm and typically has fewer kids.  There are also peacocks that live there and they wander about and are a fun surprise for the kids. || Great for having coffee seating in nearby coffee place and watching your kids playing on the playground. Just warning.. don't put best clothes on them. They will end up a bit dirty from the flooring which are small stones. But what a fun for them... || My kids liked it. It’s unpleasant for 3 reasons. First, there is an attendant who forbids adults from using equipment. An adult cannot swing or even sit on a swing, even when no child is present. Second, the ground is covered with pebbles that are covered in dust and grime. Finally, the pest count is high: flies, pigeons, and rodents abound. || The best play park outside of the centre of Lisbon. Never too busy, and just really well designed and thought through. Side note: there is a black board (double sided) so always a good idea to take some chalk if you have any. || It's one of the most famous parks of the city. Great for picnics, walks or just laying on the grass. Kids love it and if you're lucky there's a live concert going on || Nice little playground with slides, swings and other things. The park seems to be haunted by obnoxious flies though :/ No accessible toilets in the vicinity. || Cool little playground in a beautiful park setting. Lots of kids and lots of fun. || Great for kids of all ages. The bathrooms are kid friendly with small toilets and very clean. Benches on the shadows for parents. || Great place for the kids to unwind. Great surrounding park and plenty of places to get drinks and food nearby. || Lovely spot for children, wear closed toe shoes if you can if your kids are picky about pebbles. || Really nice playground for wide age range. Clean. || Quiet a big playground with deep gravel so wear full shoes || Has everything for kids and even some food and peacocks walking around || Good local park with nice playground. || Nice for kids up to 7-8 years old || Best in town. Toillet for children nearby || A superbly shady playground. We included the park/playground as a detour during our city tour. It's easy to combine with a ride on the 25E historic tram, which stops right in front. There are separate children's restrooms and adult restrooms available. || A wonderful park with lots of green space, a playground, a running track, and two kiosks selling snacks, coffee, and ice cream. It's a park for all ages. It even has a bathroom just for children, which I think is a great idea. || Very nice children's park in a great location. It is a very large park with lots of games. Swings, slides, car games....

place_name: Parque Infantil da Praça das Flores
reviews_content: Cute 🌸 one of my favorite pracas of Lisbon … || Feels like a movie set in the best way. || I go to this cafe to play chess; this outdoor space in the middle of the city is spectacular. I'm looking forward to SUMMER so my spirit can enjoy combining my two passions! || In 2022 it was voted the best square in Lisbon and it really does have a good location, restaurants, bars and kiosks. However, at night it's a place where people gather, drink and talk loudly, throw trash and urinate in the streets. The next day, the place, which has a playground for children and benches to relax and read, becomes an unpleasant place. The cleanliness leaves much to be desired, as does the lack of manners of the people. || There is no more romantic and beautiful square in Lisbon than this one. || Very small park, but enclosed. If you are at the restaurants next door you can keep an eye on the children. || Small playground, in a small park. Nice!

place_name: Parque Infantil do Bairro das Estacas
reviews_content: The park is almost entirely occupied by a wooden structure with a couple of slides, a rope climbing incline and a stump bridge. There's also a couple of rockers, a hopscotch and a drinking fountain. || Nice renovated playground, great place for little ones with trees and good shade. … || This small playground is quiet and well located. It is located in the Estacas neighborhood in an area surrounded by lawns and leafy trees. It doesn't have a great variety of swings. It does have a wooden structure from … || Nice park, pleasant and quiet space, but like all parks in Lisbon, it's very geared towards younger children up to 7 years old. It should definitely have more options for older children up to 12 years old... even if it were just some trampolines. || The gravel in the park is quite uncomfortable. Children wearing shoes fill their shoes with the stones, but barefoot children hurt their feet because the stones are very small and some are sharp. || My family is always at this park because my daughter loves being there, but there should be more options for older boys 😊 … || Pleasant park for children in the heart of the Estacas neighborhood. Safe and quiet place. || A good place for children to play, but too small for the number of children there. || A quiet place with plenty of shade, not very large but with perfect space to play. || A pleasant playground in a small green area. Its only drawback is the lack of swings.

place_name: Parque Infantil do Logradouro da Avenida de Madrid
Parque Infantil do Logradouro da Avenida de Madrid
reviews_content: Very small park for children but it has an amazing view, if you seek some quiet places to sit and enjoy the views get to this park and admire the view. Not crowded and easy to take pictures and relax here. The park itself is great for children with some small rides. Free entrance! || A beautiful place to escape the tourist trap castle and enjoy the vista of the Lisbon coast. There are benches and tables to eat a quick meal and a drinking fountain if you get thirsty. I highly recommend visiting this park if you don’t want to pay money for a view in an old castle. || Nice park, good shade. Fitness and kids play structures. Has nice viewpoint of the City as well. Orange trees can be found in the park. || Super cute and brand new, with beautiful fruit trees as shade spots, nice breeze, a view point right beside it, and even a reading cabin with books for kids and adults to read and return them. There is a water fountain to drink from, seating places and tables. A perfect stop for a family sightseeing Lisbon. || Wonderful quiet spot just a block away from crowds. Perfect to have a picnic with a beautiful view || Nice place with a view, some slides and such, and fruit trees. || Amazing park!! Beautiful view and a cute playground for littles. || A perfect playground for children aged 2-5, with the delightful addition of oranges in October and a picturesque view. || Fantastic views from this playground but quite the uphill hike to get there.  No swings and very little shade (the steel slides and equipment get extremely hot under direct sun).  Nice place for a rest with little ones but not necessarily worth going out of your way to get here. || Great little playground for kids aged 2-6 if you don't mind the climb. I do not recommend bringing a stroller up the narrow cobblestone roads though.  Several trees offer shade and there are benches to relax. We had a small snack while enjoying the view. || Great little playground and amazing view. You can get in a little bit if exercise while watching the kids. || If you have one year old you will love this hidden park. It is small, there are benches, trees for shade and a playground for little children. It offers great view on Lisbon. Also, opposite from it is Ludo’s bar where you can have a brunch/coffee/deserts. We || Arrived up the steep hill to bring our excited 5 yr old but found it was closed when we arrived. A full hour before it was due to close! || Nice and cozy playground with trees for shade and an amazing view || Beautiful space. Strangely closed for lunch and in the evenings. No WC for kids. || Small clean playground. Nice view. || Great views and.......  SILENS !!!  For me the best connection 👍 || Closed for maintenance. I couldn’t tell if it said when it would be open again. || Lovely place to sit and read. || Nice little playground || Very beautiful park near the "Castello." Here you can enjoy the view of Lisbon for free. A beautiful view, and at your feet, you can also admire a few ruins. A little insider tip from me. Only a few visitors to Lisbon find their way here; mostly locals. You'll also find a wonderful playground for children and exercise equipment here; if the climb wasn't enough for you, you can also work out other parts of your body here. There are also two picnic tables, a few benches, and a hammock for chilling. It's very quiet and pleasantly windy here; the only drawback is that the benches are unfortunately mostly in the sun. The drinking fountain is also very good. || Very well-maintained playground. With a breathtaking view. Some exercise equipment as well. The exercise area has anti-fall safety features. There is no slide. There is a drinking fountain. Please note that there are opening and closing hours. The best in the area without a doubt. || A cute little children's park with slides, ideal for relaxing after visiting the castle. Magnificent viewpoint right next door! || A small park with a playground and sports equipment is located near the castle. There is seating in both the sun and shade. Great view towards the sea! || One of the few playgrounds in Lisbon.  Orange trees are everywhere, and rotten fruit is falling from them, which isn't being cleaned up. There are no swings, and the playground closes at 6 p.m. || Beautiful playground with a great view (free) || A lovely little park with a beautiful view

place_name: Parque Infantil da Avenida Duque d'Ávila
reviews_content: The children's amusement facilities are great. We were the only ones there to play in the morning. || The main photos of the park shown here are outdated. Abandoned, neglected, constantly invaded by pigeons and their droppings scattered everywhere. It also seems to be a nighttime leisure space because on some mornings you can find trash inside the park. Bottle caps, cigarette butts, packaging, etc. For a year (maybe more?) one side has been empty, stripped of anything for the kids to play with; not even the only swing (which was ridiculous enough) remains. The park gate is literally held together with a string. The playhouse is filthy. || The saddest playground I've ever seen. Dirty and with all the fixtures and equipment broken. It urgently needs restoration. || Playground suitable for various ages. || Time to pause and read a good book. || Very good for children || Cool little playground 😌 …

place_name: Parque Infantil do Parque da Bela Vista
reviews_content: A rather disappointing parque. On a public holiday it was completely empty. It is hard to reach and seems almost disused. || Small hidden park with games in very good condition and respectful users. || Quiet place, good for *children *picnics *outdoor walks || Playground with a very large spider web, two slides of different sizes. || It has little shade and little variety. || A peaceful space, surrounded by nature. || Don't waste time, go... It's really great... || Good for children to play with.

This place really is more than a gym. It is a community space – truly wonderful! Very helpful staff, immaculate atmosphere, great machines, super clean. A blessing of a place. Really thankful I found it. Thank you. || Best gym one can ask for! Such a family feeling there. Personal training services also top notch - I am training with Tomas N. and I would highly recommend his services. Group trainings are also very nice, not too full and there is this personal touch to it. || More than a gym, it's a family-friendly space and environment. Exemplary professionalism from all the personal trainers and team members, along with a close-knit atmosphere that makes you feel like you belong. Those who try it, stay! That was my experience 😁 … || I've been looking for a gym that would get me out of bed early and motivated for a long time. It has a very welcoming atmosphere, lovely people, and very nice people!  I take personal training classes with my dear Ana. Everything is more fun with her.  Congratulations to everyone! || Exceptional atmosphere, a more family-oriented gym concept. Not to mention the team of professionals who far exceed expectations; in addition to their friendliness, effectiveness in achieving results, and the care they take with all members, they make us feel part of the family. I recommend it 1000%. || Excellent professionals. Superior quality equipment and facilities. Very good price-quality ratio. Family atmosphere and good cheer, combined with the rigor of physical activity. Promotes diversity and collaboration between ages and people with varying levels of experience in physical exercise. Nobody feels alone or lost, but those who want privacy also have it. Very flexible in accommodating everyone's personal and professional schedules. Once you're there, you don't want to leave. || An excellent place to train, with a great atmosphere and highly professional and dedicated instructors who provide excellent support to users. || Spectacular gym, family atmosphere, great staff and teachers, keep it up and you'll have great success. || Fantastic team, motivating and attentive to our needs. Tomás and Nuno are the reason I'm almost a regular visitor. 🤩 … || All the staff are very professional and helpful, always ready to assist. The space is always very clean and the atmosphere is very pleasant. Wishing you continued success! || Gym with competent professionals and a great atmosphere. I highly recommend it. || The atmosphere is great. Everyone is professional and very friendly. || Gym with excellent facilities, a "family" atmosphere, and top-notch professionals! || A second home ❤️ Amazing staff || Excellent space and the best service! || I like it very much. Good professionals, lots of good equipment. || I highly recommend them. Excellent professionals.

“I recently visited ZIM and had a great experience. I really loved the spacious changing room — it was comfortable and easy to use. The place was quite busy with lots of people, but the service and environment were still good. Overall, a nice spot to shop and try things out!” || In general its a good, clean, gym. However what happens in the swimming pool/sauna area is pure insanity. Never seen anything like this anywhere in the world. I got kicked out of the Sauna 5 times within a few weeks. Here is what happened: 1. Forgot my flip flops (fair enough) 2. I just wanted to go to the sauna. I put a towel around my hips and went in. During relaxation Pool guy knocks and says to come out and proof that I am wearing shorts because thats the rule (what the???)- I told him I am not wearing shorts obviously as its super unhygenic to wear swimming shorts in the sauna. Weirdly enough ppl there come in with there swimming shorts without a towel and sweat everywhere because they are not obliged to put a towel on the wood. Disgusting. Anyway I told him I am not wearing any and he kicks me out. How did he know that I am not wearing any? He couldnt see. Its basically harasment. You want to check every guest if he/she is naked? What if I wear shorts underneath the towel? You want a security check? Well 3. Time I have shorts but no swimming shorts. Kicked out again. 4. Time I have swimming shorts but with pockets- kicked out again.  5 I buy in decathlon swimming shorts without pockets= the same the pool guy is wearing. Funnily he showed me the other day that his shorts would be okay. AGAIN kicked out because it has to be a certain material (Lycra- super toxic to go in the sauna with that material, but they are not really smart- i explained to them but i got zombie stare) I asked for the supervisor. Supervisor says "its the rules". He can wear because its his work clothes- no logic at all but okay. They always repeat like robots "Thats the rules"? Literally everyone in the digital nomad community I tell the story thinks I am messing with them and everyone is shocked and says i should cancel and they also now start to cancel. Its funny how much they love the rules and dont understand that there is also something called "breaking the rules or "tato/tact". Who cares I put a towel on in a sauna/ do you check every person with a towel before the person goes in? Pure discrimniation and use of power/authority. They just love it. Probably remains from the dark times to execute rules without thinking at all. Ironically everyone crosses the red light while waiting on the traffic light as a pedestrian (what you should do when no car is coming)- but when it comes to stupid rules that make no sense they love to follow the rules. So its a pure joy of executing auothority Too bad because it has a cool pool a nice sauna. The funny thing is I already know the reply to this - "Well thats the rule, nothing we can do". Why can I go to a 5 star hotel sauna with a towel but i cant here? Answer: They care about the customer feeling good. You dont. Yes you can be proud but you lost money- not only mine but from other friends/nomads. So what did you win in the end? || Wonderful gym. Very spacious, clean, with brand new equipment and super attentive staff. The spa is also amazing, with a pool, sauna, infrared light treatments… Top marks! I’ll definitely keep coming back. || One stop shop for a gym rat! Amazing gym, best in Lisbon! Staff is very polite. All new equipments and also a amazing spa with saunas and complete hot tub park. Definitely a must go when in Lisbon! || 0 star Extremely disappointed and hurt by the discriminatory behavior we experienced at Campo Grande branch. My friend and I purchased a day pass for €8 to use their pool facilities. While my friend wore a standard swimsuit, I was wearing a proper burkini made entirely of nylon — a material suitable and commonly accepted in swimming pools.  Despite this, a staff member approached us and told us I wasn’t allowed to be in the pool because of my hijab. This was not a matter of safety, fabric, or dress code — my outfit was a full swimming suit made for water, yet I was singled out and asked to leave the pool. No clear explanation was given other than “this kind of swimwear is not allowed,” while my friend’s more revealing attire was deemed acceptable.  We were offered no refund, no apology, and there was no one available to address our concerns or even have a respectful conversation. We were simply removed — blankly and unfairly.  This experience was humiliating and discriminatory. Facilities that claim to be inclusive should not tolerate such bias. I sincerely hope the management addresses this serious issue, trains their staff properly, and reconsiders their policies — or at the very least enforces them fairly for all guests. || First of all the location is perfect. In the middle of the park! It has some pools for swimming, a big training session floor and also many equipment. You can see all your habits and workouts with your own chip, which is really helpful. The only thing is that the gym is too full in the evenings… || Awesome gym. All the professors I had contact with were very gentle. The adaptive bike classes that I usually take is very energetic and you can’t even see the time passing. I really recommend for a person who is searching for a gym which has different kind of classes, pool and an affordable price. || I had a very disappointing experience at the GoFit swimming pool in Campo Grande. The staff were consistently rude and unprofessional. On top of that, I was given incorrect information, which resulted in being overcharged — almost double the expected amount. When I raised the issue, their attitude was dismissive rather than helpful.  This kind of treatment is unacceptable, especially in a service-based environment. Clear communication and respectful customer service are basic expectations. I would not recommend this place unless the management seriously trains their team in customer relations and ensures accurate information is provided upfront. || Very nice club! Especially Aqua zone! I visit more than 1 year || The best gym in Alvalade. Friendly staff, fair membership fees, and a swimming pool and sauna. It gets very crowded at peak times, but it's right next to the park where you can also work out.

Don't sign up for this gym!! They're very friendly when you're signing up, but they're not when you want to leave! First, they make you pay two more months' membership just because, then they say that we, the customers, have to send a letter by mail saying we want to leave. Neither I nor another person ever received a response to that letter, so we were forced to "block" the gym at our bank to prevent them from stealing our money. However, two years later, they stole money from our account. They are thieves, and the owners never show their faces! Run away from this gym if you don't want to be robbed! || Terrible experience! I went to the gym for 3 years, and when I wanted to quit, they told me I had to give them 2 months' notice and that I would still have to pay for those months. After that, I informed them with a letter that I wanted to quit (yes, because a letter has to be sent), however, after 2 months they are still taking money from my monthly fee, so I blocked the account with my bank. Today, 2 years later, they stole money from my account (more than one monthly fee). I wonder how this happens in a gym like this, they change their name and think they can steal from people like this?! DO NOT SIGN UP. || A spacious venue with excellent staff and a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere; super accessible, with 100% customer-focused service. || Superb club! Very clean, beautiful facilities, plenty of space on several levels. I recommend it 🔥 … || Very welcoming environment, and excellent professionals, both the instructors and the reception staff (very polite and always concerned about our well-being). At this particular time, the hygienic conditions are perfect: disinfectant gel everywhere, equipment disinfected after classes, gym disinfected every 20 minutes between classes! I feel very good in this gym! || Thank you, Alexandra :) || Terrible, I was a client of this establishment for a year, I paid the monthly fees every month even though I only went to the gym 3 times a year! And after 3 years they deducted €30 from my account! This is ridiculous, nobody is obliged to be stuck with any membership forever, one year of paying and not attending was enough! || They do everything to get the customer to sign the contract, but then they don't keep their promises and shirk responsibility, including the gym manager. Avoid this gym at all costs. || I really like this gym. Enough equipment for what I need, great professionals, and a good atmosphere! || Thank you very much, Francisco! || Terrible service, they promise things at the beginning of the contract that they don't deliver, there's no manager who shows their face at the gym, they shirk all responsibilities, there's no concern for the customer. Everything is bad. If you're looking for a gym in Lisbon, please don't sign up at this one. || Excellent teachers and a great environment. The staff are very friendly and efficient! A good gym! || Hi Rita! We're so glad to hear you're feeling comfortable here. Thank you so much :) || One of the best gyms I've ever been to. The instructors are 5 stars! Kevin and Anderson || Good atmosphere, good facilities, good staff, good location and affordable price. Only those who rarely go there complain. || A very pleasant space and the staff are super friendly! I highly recommend it. || Professionals, always available to help, family atmosphere, many options, great price, simply 5 stars!!!! || Wonderful atmosphere!!! Excellent. Very professional and friendly PTs. || That's what happens when we have the best associates in the world. Thank you very much for your kindness as well! || Dishonest and of terrible quality. More concerned with themselves than with the customers... Avoid signing this unfair and one-sided contract at all costs. || Very welcoming space Very family-friendly atmosphere Very affordable price I recommend it 🔝 Very friendly staff || It may be considered a low-cost gym, but it has good facilities and is well-equipped with exercise machines. || Very welcoming space, very friendly and approachable staff, I recommend it five stars. || Quiet, very spacious, and equipped with all the necessary appliances. Plus, an excellent team. || Spacious, very well-equipped, and with very friendly and attentive staff! || Gym in Alvalade, good atmosphere and where you can train without crowds. || Great work environment, with mutual support between technicians and clients. Wide variety of machines. || Excellent environment and conditions. Quiet gym, good value for money. || Excellent service and affordable price. Friendly and attentive staff. 5 stars. || Good space, very nice gym, I highly recommend it!! || Good gym, but very bureaucratic when it comes to canceling. || A good gym, but its small size means a limited number of machines;

Decent, not very crowded, basic equipment normally working well and the staff is friendly.  The climatization is pretty bad, which makes many parts of the gym too hot, humid and reeking of sweat. There are many air conditioning machines permanently turned off and the staff can't do much about it.  Fresh water is paid extra, which makes the heat experience even tougher.  Some basic apparatus, like the resistance bands and squat pads are kept stored by the local staff, which isn't always available when you need them.  The music is often too loud. || Dear Antonio, thank you for your feedback. We're glad you appreciate our staff and equipment. We're sorry to hear about the climate control and availability of some items. Your concerns are important to us, and we will address them to improve our gym experience. We appreciate your input and hope to provide a better visit next time! || This is one of the worst gyms I have ever seen and been to. I had to go there this month because I work near there, but I will never come back here. The people there are disrespectful, and each one takes a place and stays there for an hour. They do not respect the rest of the people, and there is a bad smell in the place. I will never go back to this place again. There was a trivial person today who treated me in a bad way. He wanted to work alone on the machine and did not want anyone to share with him. He stayed in the same place for an hour. Damn such disrespectful people. || Dear Souheil, we're truly sorry to hear about your experience at Ginásio VivaGym Roma-Areeiro. We take feedback seriously and will address the issues you've raised regarding gym etiquette and cleanliness. Our goal is to create a respectful environment for all members.  Best regards. || Guys please can you get proper racks for the small weights that they actually fit in? || Hi John, Thank you for your feedback.  We appreciate your comment and we will take it into account.  Remember that you can to write us an email at contacto.pt@vivagym.com where we will personally attend your request. Best regards. || I am a digital nomad who stayed in Lisbon for 1 month & this gym just so happened to be walking distance from my place. It is perfect! It has a lot of machines, a good open-space workout area, the facilities are always clean, and the staff is so friendly. I recommend anyone staying in the area to come use this gym, the membership price is very reasonable & absolutely worth it! || It’s okay for a day pass, but it’s the first gym I’ve been with no free water fountain! There’s a paid one and they have machines selling plastic water bottles as well. Besides the clear environmental impact it’s insane they choose to put and maintain fancy selling machines instead of a simple water filter. || As far as FitnessHuts in Lisbon go, I prefer this one. Less crowded, machines working, low-key. I don’t attend classes usually nor do I like to talk to people while training so this suits me.  I’ve only come here once though. I’d go more often to this location if I lived closer to it. || Great gym! Lots of open space for stretching or walking lunges. Sufficient equipment to get your workouts done. The people at the reception were very friendly and helped me get started. Went back twice to workout here again. There's a supermarket right below to get hydrated or buy protein yogurt after your workout too. || One of the very few good Fitness Hut branches, i was (finally) able to do a full workout without having to wait crazy amount of time just to do my set on a machine.  Lacking few equipment but i was able to do an alternative workout, showers are your standard Fitness Hut showers (filthy) || Thank you very much for your feedback!  What you said about the showers caught our attention, as it does not correspond to FITNESS HUT's policy, so we will investigate what happened. Remember that if you have any other questions, you can also contact us through the contact section of the website at www.fitnesshut.pt  Regards. || Gym is good quality and good price. However when they are having  group class the music is horrible and loud. Please lower the noise if you can't improve your taste in music. || Hello; Thank you very much for giving us your feedback! It is very important for us to know the opinion of our members. Regarding what you said, we inform you that our colleagues work to maintain a good environment in which you can enjoy your workouts, so they take into account that the music does not exceed the recommended decibels. Remember that if you have any other questions, you can contact us through the contact area of ​​the website at www.fitnesshut.pt Regards. || It's one of the better fitness huts. Mainly because the courses are more respectful in that they are not as loud and obnoxious as in some of the other locations of this franchise. Still all of the other issues of this chain applies: crowded during peak hours, no cables machine, only one type of leg press. Only two cable towers. It's kind of bare bones. Also the application and the IT of this place lacks leaves a lot to be desired. You can pay your monthly fee in only one way which is only possible with Portuguese bank accounts, which is also annoying. Overall, it's not exactly great, but it does the job at least and at an affordable price.

Had a class with Silvia she was so amazing, I’ve never had an instructor put so much care and effort into each student. I am left handed and have done a lot of boxing classes at other gyms and never have any instructors asking me for what hand is the strongest. Silvia asked me right away and positioned me accordingly with different gloves to best suit me. She was so nice and a great instructor. Highly recommend. I sweat a lot in her class :) || Hi Noa! 🥊 Thank you so much for your amazing feedback! We’re thrilled to hear you had such a great experience with Silvia — she truly puts her heart into every class and every fighter. 💪 We love that you felt seen and supported — that’s exactly what BHOUT is all about: personalized, high-energy, and empowering training for everyone. Can’t wait to have you back for another sweaty and powerful session! 🔥  The BHOUT Team || Unfortunately after the first session I have been having consistent pain in the joints of my small finger. It started right after the training and has been going on for 4 months. They hurt even without doing anything.  It was my first time boxing so I appeared early and stayed next to the trainer to be checked but.  My friend who used to do boxing said that the fingers should have been tied together tightly because if they spread apart injuries can happen. I didn’t know about this and wasn’t informed.  I am quite worried that this resulted in such a long-term issue and since it isn’t going away at all will have to seek treatment. I‘m 28 so it’s unlikely that is just an „aging“ thing.  Prior to that I left a 5 star review because the team and vibe are great but yeah joints are kinda important :/ || Hi Marina, we’re really sorry to hear about your experience and that you’ve been dealing with ongoing pain after your first session. This isn’t what we want for any of our bhouters, and we fully understand your concern.  Safety and proper guidance — especially for first-time boxers — are very important to us, and we’ll make sure this feedback is shared with our coaching team to review how we can improve our instruction and wrapping support.  We’d really like to follow up with you directly to understand more and support you in the best way we can. Please reach out to us through our support page at bhout.com/pt/club/support  so our team can connect with you personally.  Thank you for sharing this — it helps us keep improving every day.  The BHOUT Team 🥊 || Enjoyed the trainers, music, and atmosphere. Love that you could bring a plus one and were able to have workouts with friends. The only reason I gave up my membership was because of parking. This location is not an option if you are driving. || Simone, it's great to know you loved the training, the music, the atmosphere, and even the experience of coming with friends! 💙🥊 We're really happy with that feedback. We're sorry that parking was a challenge—we understand that it can be a factor in your decision. We hope you can play with us again someday at another BHOUT club where that's not a problem. 🚀🔥 || I am visiting Lisbon and I went for a class this morning. The instructor was Ines and she was really great - full of energy and very good at showing the exercises and helping people. The music was also good. I borrowed wraps and gloves from at the studio. The place is super clean and has showers too. The best part of it are the screens in which you can see your performance so you can keep track of your workout and push harder over time. I would definitely recommend it to anyone (it is good for all levels of fitness) || If I could give more stars I would! Been trying out so many classes in lisbon and this is the first time I just have to write a review! The place is very stylish, clean and feels good! Free lockers with code (no lock needed haha), your own changing room/shower. But most of all the nicest instructor who took so much time to explain everything to me and guide me through the whole workout, which itself was really good and well thought out too! Also the class was in portuguese but he went above and beyond to always explain everything for me in english too. Thank you! || Hi Ham, wowwww HUGE feedback!  Thanks || Love the intense workout and music! Highly recommend this club if you wanna boost your energy and fitness! || Hey Camellia. Thank you for your kind words. See you in the next round! || Amazing!! Such a cool workout and great energy. The class is much fun, the environment is cozy and clean, the coaches super thoughtful and everyone in the class had this crazy energy. I enjoyed so much and super recommend || Thank you for your amazing feedback, Monica! 🤩 It's great to know you loved the energy, the atmosphere, and the coaches!  That's exactly our goal: unique, fun sessions where time flies by! Come back! ... if you bring friends, we guarantee the fun will be even greater! See you in the next round, brother! 🥊 || It's a really nice space in terms of design and facilities. It's fast paced so it could be easy to feel lost during the class, but the instructors were welcoming and took time to demonstrate the moves to me 1-1. I really enjoyed the pace and energy created with the music and lights. Will definitely try this class again. || Hi JW, thanks so much for taking the time for such thoughtful feedback! 🤩  We are getting ever better to welcoming more international people. We have international classes at 10am on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Hopefully it helps you feeling even better supported!   See you in the next round! 🥊 || I've been coming here for at least a year and a half. I really love the concept. You come in, workout for 45min hiit training, and go about your day. It can be as hard or as easy as you want. The trainer gives suggestions, you're free to follow them or adapt to your own needs.  The trainers are wonderful and João is probably the best trainer I ever had. In general people are awesome. On top of that, you can't avoid learning new things no matter how hard you try.  Unfortunately I have to stop for a couple of reasons:  - Air circulation: 15 people in a small (for 15ppl) closed room working out with not enough ventilation. It gets too hot and those fans do nothing. It will get much hotter soon as outdoors temperature rises, I don't want to be there when that happens, it's already hard to breathe as it is.  - Some of the bags are leaking water: I'm tall, the top of the bag where I hit is partially empty. Basically the bags should be depreciated. Honestly they are really bad.  - Dumbbells go only up till 10kg: that's not enough. Can't have a progression if I'm stuck at 10kg. Each exercise is max 1 min so no matter how fast I lift, 10kg is still not enough.  - The "point system" aka the selling point that is advertised isn't working for at least a year and a half. || Hi Kyryll, Thank you for being with us all this time, you were a true Bhouter ⭐️ We really appreciate your feedback and we are sorry that our current experience doesn't match your expectations. We are aware of some improvements that need to be implemented in our club as well as the need for replacing our equipment, and we are working hard to be able to do it really soon. Stay tuned for news and updates regarding our upgraded experience with the new BHOUT Bags, equipment and gamification. Hope to see you again in the future, you'll always be welcome in any of our clubs! 🥊 || Amazing experience with such good quality! As someone with knee issues, I was finally able, through this amazing team, to try different types of Martial Arts. Every single month is a new crazy and hard working experience that can be felt not only through the exercises they select but how they manage to select the best soundtrack to keep you motivated. 45 min session that flies due to how much fun you are having. || Hey Claudia. Thank you so much for such an amazing feedback. Time really flies when we are having fun 🥊 … || Very Nice workout. I had a lot of fun and the teachers are very good. The english of the teacher wad not perfect but...we are in Portugal! Time to get adapted! I really enjoy the calculating of points during your workout || Grazie Giuseppe! 🤩  … and thanks for the input on the language. With time, we will start delivering some classes in English, but we hope it was still easy to follow the professor.  See you in the next round! 🥊 || This is not my first time in fitboxing, but my first experience in Portugal: i'm extremely satisfied and want to become a regular customer. Special thanks to Carol ❤️(you are amazing|)! The only problem is that I don't see any classes available on the weekend, which makes me sad. it would be great to have a couple of classes on Saturday as other clubs do || Hello Yulia Thank you very much for the feedback and stars 🤩🥊  Regarding the training sessions at the weekend, only this 18.03/19.03 is that we are not open (maintenance).  Saturday we have 4 times and Sunday 3.  Good workouts and once again welcome 🤙🥊 || What an amazing experience it is to train in BHOUT!  The installations are great!  The training consists in 45 mins of rounds of cardio/boxing alternated with rounds of strength with music and lights. The punching bag records the strength and number of punches and you can see your current score. This way you can see your evolution and compare yourself to others.  The payment/scheduling of sessions is very easy and supported by sites and apps.  I highly recommend it! || Frederico, thanks for the 5 stars rating and for the both exciting and thoughtful review! 🥊 … || Fun workout! I’ve had classes with Joao and with Ines and they’re both helpful and positive forces. I love the gamified boxing, although being petite I struggle to get high points! I’m trying to focus on the fact that my scores are improving, instead of comparing them to everyone else in the room! The changing room is practical and clean, the showers and bathrooms too. They have hairdryers and lockers that can be activated with a simple code, which means you don’t need a padlock. || That’s it Raquel! Step by step you’ll see your progress. We have seen amazing progress stories! Let us know how it’s going 🥊🥊  Thank you for the helpful review from your perspective, and the great stars! 🤩  See you in the next round! || So much fun! 45 min fly by, it’s incredible. High quality facilities, great trainers and a very engaging workout. Big fan! || Sabrina, thanks so much for the 5 stars! 🤩  We are such fans of yours for sharing your personal angle - that might resonate with others to come for a BHOUT session too! See you in the next round! 🥊 … || What an amazing place, music awesome, good Coaches. The workout is powerful and fun. Good place where we can workout, drink a beer at the end and make friends. Love this 💥🥊 … || You are the best, Bearded and Tattooed Professor! 🤩 … || Joao is a great instructor and super motivating! The workout was very fun and challenging, also the studio is such a special place. I'll definitely come back! || 5 stars for you Ariane 🥊🚀 … || I really liked the space: private changing rooms, mirror area with dryers, electronic lockers (no padlock needed) and the exercise area is very well equipped.  Compared to Brooklyn Fitboxing Areeiro, the space is better equipped, but also the workouts are better and not as confusing. I got frustrated with Brooklyn because at the end we have to do all the 45mins exercises - I go there not to think, and not to memorise exercises. So Bhout in that is better because we do both boxing or other arts and weights exercises interspersed.  Also in the end of the session there's no one wanting to sell you plans. In Brooklyn every class I went to try there was someone bothering me. || Silvia, thanks so much for the 5 stars 🤩, and the detailed feedback! We hope to see you soon in the next round! 🥊🥊 … || An amazing experience! You go at your own pace while being guided by an amazing coach! || Inês, thank you for your 5-star feedback! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 We look forward to seeing you many more times at Club Av. Roma. See you in the next round! 🥊 … || Amazing vibe, great coaches and the best boxing classes in Lisbon!! A must try for sure 🥊 … || Thank you so much for your 5⭐️ feedback! Your amazing vibe is always welcome in our clubs 🥊 …

VivaGym Campo Pequeno may not look very large at first glance, but the layout is well thought out, with clearly separated areas for cardio, weight training, racks, and high-intensity workouts. The equipment is quite complete, so you can still get a solid workout in.  The shower facilities feel old and could use an update, and the atmosphere isn’t particularly warm or friendly. I even noticed some poor gym etiquette — for example, one person was hogging five steps just to get the right height for her workout, which was a bit frustrating.  The crowd tends to build up in the morning, but overall it’s manageable. Despite the quirks, this gym is still a good option for training if you’re in the area. || Hi Willie, Thank you for your feedback. We're glad to hear you appreciate our gym layout and equipment. We take your comments about the shower facilities and atmosphere seriously and will work on improvements. We also encourage all members to practice good gym etiquette for a better experience. We hope to see you again soon! Best regards. || All i wanted to come by on a (overpriced! 11,90€) day pass but their online sign up form - where you need to put in basically all your personal data including your expiration date of your identity document - doesn’t work correctly: when I entered my german adress, it doesn’t recognize my ZIP code and makes it impossible to submit the form.  No idea how this chain of gyms survive - i’m not the only one, check the other reviews around the city… || Dear Manuel, we apologize for the inconvenience you experienced with our online sign-up form. Your feedback is important to us, and we are actively working to resolve these technical issues. We appreciate your patience and hope to provide a better experience in the future. Please feel free to reach out to our customer service for assistance. Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Best regards. || Very good gym.  Can get crowded after 1700 or 1800.  The staff is super friendly and helpful and so are the vast majority of the people that go to this gym. || Thank you, Marcus, for your review! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoy our gym and appreciate our friendly staff. We strive to create a welcoming environment for everyone. We understand that it can get crowded during peak hours, and we appreciate your understanding. Looking forward to seeing you at VivaGym Campo Pequeno! || Very good gym. Plenty of space, lots of machines, and the gym workers are all very nice and ready to help. On the downside, there's a few things that could be improved upon. The gym is a bit overcrowded, especially around the late afternoon. Besides that, there's some issues with the air conditioning. They turn it on very late in the season and adjust the settings incorrectly, leaving the gym very warm in the summer (because they turn it on too late) and kinda cold in the winter (because they also turn it off too late as well). Also, the biggest issue is that the cleaning crew doesn't clean it as often as it should for a gym of this size and with this many people. There's usually a lot of dust on the floor and in the machines, or even bits of trash from the street that gets stuck to people's shoes. Finally, the machines aren't very good (although these are being replaced and more machines are being added, which is a plus). Adding to all of this, the locker rooms are in need of some renovations. That being said, these are all semi-minor issues, and this continues to be the best gym I tried in Lisbon. If I could I would have given it 4.5 stars. || Hi Tomás, Thank you for your feedback. We're glad to hear you enjoy the space and our staff's support. We appreciate your suggestions, your insights help us improve, and we’re actively working on enhancing the gym experience for everyone. Best regards. || A good gym, is very big, maybe there aren’t so much machine but they are good, I really feel them, i think they do regular maintenance service and is always clean therefore a good place where do a good  workout. Also the staff is kind || Hi Giacomo, Thank you for your feedback. We're thrilled to hear you enjoy our gym and appreciate our maintenance and cleanliness. Our staff works hard to create a welcoming environment. We look forward to seeing you again for your next workout! Best regards. || Awesome gym, great atmosphere, the music is always good. Kind people! Tiago at the desk is super helpful! Also great personal trainers and zumba rocks! || Hi Halina, Thank you for your feedback!  We're thrilled to hear you love the VivaGym Campo Pequeno. Your support means a lot to us! Best regards. || The gym is fully equipped. Whether you just want to do cardio, lift weights, CrossFit circuits or different classes. The changing rooms are very large, spacious and clean.  Competent and friendly staff, not all of them speak English so I recommend learning the basic words to communicate. If you prefer a personal trainer there are several and almost all of them speak English. Recommended! || We appreciate your rating and feedback! Best regards. || Big space, but try to avoid rush hours. Nice big and clean changing rooms. High quality equipment but a strange selection: only one flat bench press but two incline bench presses (why??), only one lying leg press, no pec fly machine (please, this one is crucial), no assisted pull up/dip machine. All these exercises can be replaced by similar ones, but in such a big space with so many machines I would expect a better selection. || Hi Frank,  Thank you for your feedback. We're glad you enjoyed the space and cleanliness of our facilities. We appreciate your input on the equipment selection as it helps us improve. We'll definitely take your suggestions into consideration as we look to enhance our gym offerings. If you have any more feedback or ideas, feel free to share! Best regards. || Very good experience. I always come to that gym. However, to improve my experience I'd like to have machines, such as lying leg curl, benches and another squat rack. || Hi Bendetta, Thank you for your review. We're thrilled to hear you enjoy your experience at Ginásio VivaGym Campo Pequeno. We appreciate your feedback, your input helps us improve. Best regards. || Good gym, plenty of equipment, but it is comically hot even on a mild day. || Hi Ilya, Thank you for your feedback. We're glad you enjoy the equipment at Ginásio VivaGym Campo Pequeno. We understand that temperature can be an issue and are actively working on improving the climate control in the gym. Your comfort is important to us, and we appreciate your input as we strive to enhance your experience. We hope to see you back soon! Best regards.

I had a great experience at this gym. The staff at the front desk was super polite, friendly and really understanding, which made a great first impression. The gym itself is well equipped, clean and has everything you need for a solid workout. I had a good session and will definitely be coming back. || Thank you so much for your kind words! We’re delighted to know that you had a great experience at Supera Areeiro and that our team made a positive impression. It’s wonderful to hear that you enjoyed our facilities and had a good workout. We look forward to welcoming you back soon! || Never Going Back Me and My Futsal Group !🚨‼️  I recently visited this swimming pool and was disappointed with how the staff handled my experience. I paid for swimming and did not realize that the sauna and hot bath required an additional fee. Instead of politely explaining this, the staff were rude and unhelpful.  As a first-time visitor, I expected clearer communication and a more welcoming attitude. Facilities may be fine, but the way staff treat guests makes a big difference — and unfortunately, this left a very negative impression. || We appreciate your comment and regret that the experience did not meet your expectations.   Please note that the free swimming pass includes access to the pool only, while the spa and sauna areas are available only to active members or upon payment of the corresponding daily fee, as indicated at reception.  We value your feedback and will take it into account to improve communication with our visitors. || Is it really that hard to fix this? You claim regular cleaning — but just look at the photos.  The cleanliness in the women’s changing area — not just the showers — is consistently poor. Soap residue stays on the walls and floors, and hair is not just in the drains, but all over. Even after mopping, there’s hair and dirt all over the floor. I wiped it with a tissue right after and it turned brown.  Please consider reviewing the cleaning tools being used. It might help to provide mops and equipment that are better at collecting hair and dirt, rather than spreading it around.  Photos and videos attached — this isn’t a one-time issue. I really like this gym otherwise, and I hope this can be improved. || We're sorry about your experience with us, Sveta. Don't hesitate to rewrite your review if you feel we've change something. Best regards. || Nice pool and spa, not too crowded. However, it’d much better to ask people to take off their shoes before entering the locker room, it’s really unhygienic. Also people walking in flip flops in the pool is quite gross too, not sure where they walked with those. || Hello Eric, We understand your concern about hygiene in the changing rooms. At our center, users can enter the changing rooms wearing the shoes they wear outside. However, hygiene and safety rules apply strictly beyond this area: the use of flip flops is mandatory in the pool and spa, as this is a fundamental hygiene and safety requirement. For group classes and the gym, training shoes other than outdoor shoes are required. We appreciate your cooperation and will continue to ensure the hygiene of the space. || Not allowed to take off shoes on yoga matts and be in socks, but everyone walks in their workout shoes from their home to the gym, so people's "gym shoes" are full of street dirt. My socks are certainly cleaner than people's shoes 😂  This has been pretty much my experience. All communication and contact I've had with Supera was negative. I recommend staying away from this gym and pool facilities. They are just too complicated, have too many contradicting and illogical rules, and when it truly counts in terms of safety they are arrogant, rude, and negligent. No wonder they have a lot of negative reviews. || We appreciate your feedback. We regret your frustration with the rules regarding footwear and socks. The rules are in place to maintain hygiene and safety in training areas and group classes, and are an integral part of the regular operation of the facilities. || I am writing because I feel very insecure about using direct debit with Supera due to a very bad experience I have had. When my son wanted to join Supera, my wife and I took him to the facility. We spoke with a staff member at customer service about enrolling him. The staff member explained that the monthly fee for one person was €48.60. She also told us that if the father and mother joined together with their son, the total monthly fee would be €57.43. Based on this information, we agreed to the €57.43 plan, and we provided one bank account for this payment. However, when I later checked my bank account, I was shocked to find that Supera had been charging €48.60 from one account and €57.43 from another account since last August. We went back to customer service to discuss the issue. The staff member told us that she had registered me to pay €48.60 and my wife and son to pay €57.43. I told her that this was not what we agreed to, and I asked why she separated my payment when we signed up for the €57.43 family plan. What is even more concerning is that Supera took money from an old bank account that my son used when he first joined, even though that account was already closed and we never gave permission to use it again. Supera used that account without our authorization. We are extremely disappointed, especially because my wife and I joined together with our son, but we did not even attend the gym, and yet Supera charged both accounts. We request that this situation be investigated and corrected, and that the incorrect charges be refunded. || We are sorry for what happened and thank you for sharing the situation with us. This does not meet our service standards. Please go to reception to check what happened with the charges and use of your old account, correct any errors, and settle the amounts due. We apologize for the inconvenience and are available to resolve everything as quickly as possible. || I went to renew my membership in order to use the swimming pool - paid 80EUR - only to be told when I went to the swimming pool that they were not open to the public for another week. The receptionist failed to mention this. This public sports centre fails to understand that during the summer, when schools are closed and the weather is hot, and some people are still working or cannot afford to go away, citizens of Lisbon need access to this public service. Very disappointing indeed. || The closure of the pool for routine maintenance at this time of year may be inconvenient for those who only use municipal facilities offering this service.  This is not the case for us.  All other services besides the pool that we have available are operating normally, which may not make it clear that someone would only need one of them.  We apologize in advance for any communication error on our part; we are working to improve. || The pool itself is clean and suitable for swimming, but the staff’s behavior was disappointing. Several staff members were rude and spoke in an unprofessional manner, showing a poor attitude. One staff member repeatedly checked our time more than three times, which felt unnecessary and annoying. Improving the staff’s professionalism and customer service would greatly enhance the overall experience. || We regret that the experience was less positive, but we work to ensure that procedures are followed as accurately as possible. Due to the high demand and number of people using our pool, without more strict controls in place, we would have to deny access to more people who might want to use the space.  We are working to provide a better response to these types of situations and improve the overall experience. || Very bad attention to the clients, staff is not to blame, but the organization of the gym. You guys need TWO pools. One is NOT enough. And then the staff have to be denying people to enter. Lisbon is super crowded now, grow your business too and people would politely pay the fee to swim. 3 times been denied to enter, one I waited until I could go in but the lady receptionist was really unaware of customer service and made me wait even more. Get better, or lose clients. || Unfortunately, the number of people using our pool is something we cannot control. Given the limited capacity of the area, we manage the flow and have to deny some entry to ensure activities can continue. This control is not done by reception but by the lifeguard team. We regret that the experience was less positive, but we are working to provide a better response to these types of situations. || ‼️ Incredible how a MUNICIPAL swimming pool behaves as if it were 100% private, disregarding those who live in and contribute to the municipality ‼️  The pool’s management is clearly run in favor of the interests of the company SUPERA, neglecting an entire community that should have access to these public facilities.  WARNING FOR ALL OCCASIONAL USERS:  Management blocks access to the pool for indefinite periods, claiming it is “full,” when in reality there are completely empty lanes for “free swimming".  Essentially, management consistently claims that the pools (even when empty) are closed to occasional users because they are full — which they are not — thereby reserving the right of use exclusively for SUPERA’s own clients.  This already happened to me 3 times... ON A SATURDAY MORNING........  There is clearly an abusive and manipulative management of the space, showing total disrespect for those who wish — and are entitled — to make occasional use of a municipal facility. Not to talk about the staff's rudeness addressing this topic.  There should be regulations to prevent this kind of abuse, but there is a lack of oversight from the responsible authorities. A typical case of “Portugal — good name, bad practice.” || We deeply apologise for your frustration and feeling that access to the facilities is not equitable. We understand the importance of these municipal facilities to the community. However, access to the pool is managed according to the capacity of the space and user priority, always ensuring safety and comfort for all.  One-off (occasional) admissions may be closed whenever capacity justifies it, even if there are lanes reserved for priority users (classes or free swimming). This is our policy, as part of our internal management procedures. We regret any perception of rudeness on the part of our staff and will reinforce training on communicating these rules. We appreciate your feedback on the need for greater clarity.

place_name: Ginásio Solinca Classic - Defensores de Chaves
reviews_content: Nice Gym, all new equipment, spacious, plenty of machines for cardio and lifting. Lots of benches for free weights too. || Thank you for your feedback, Matthijs! We are pleased to know that our facilities are meeting your expectations. We work daily to offer the best in every workout. || I went to ask for information, but the staff member seemed completely uninterested in helping. As an alternative, we opted to visit the museum instead and we were pleasantly surprised by the quality of the exhibits and the … || A cool place to plan a weekend day. They also give free tickets to the garden and the museum on Sundays, if you visit before 13:00 || Small but wonderful science and natural history museum. Quality exhibits that are interesting and not overwhelming. The building is beautiful and a wonderfully cool respite on a hot day. Lots of space for little ones to explore. Quiet and …

An incredible museum, with many ancient coins and gold, banknotes, a 12 kg gold bar that you can actually touch it and that today, 26 December 2025, it is worth almost €1,500,000, ancient artefacts, several interactive exhibitions etc...  And all of this is free, because entry to the museum is complimentary.  I’m not giving it five stars only because, to start the visit it was a bit confusing and I didn’t really know where to start, I had to go to a separate area to pick up a map and a ticket that lets you interact with some of the exhibits, and only then could I start the visit.  If there were signs or a clear route to follow, everything would be much easier and smoother. || This is a wonderful Museum of Money situated inside the Bank of Portugal.   The architecture is amazing as it was a cathedral turned into a bank.   The museum showcases many tech related displays and many interactive presentations related to money/coins.   A very interesting way to see how money developed and changed over man's history.   Definitely worth a visit, especially it is free. || Visiting the Currency Museum in Lisbon was a truly unique experience. One of the highlights for me was the opportunity to hold a 12-kilogram gold bar in my own hands — I was genuinely surprised by how heavy it felt compared to its size. The museum beautifully traces the entire evolution of money, from the barter system to modern paper currency. I found it fascinating to learn about the various techniques and machinery used to mint coins and print banknotes, and to see how money evolved from simple trade objects to coins and, eventually, to the notes we use today. It’s both educational and engaging — a must-visit for anyone curious about history and economics. || It was so interesting, a nice museum. We were pleasantly surprised, it's only one place in Lisbon with free enterence. I recommend to visit it 100%. || Very interesting, small(ish) museum. Excellent, well organized and well curated collection of money from around the world, ancient and modern, with extensive Portuguese coins, paper money, bearer notes, and letters of credit. Lydian and Chinese items are very special. || Cool information, I love money museums. The order of things was weird. If you wanted to read everything, you had to walk in a full oval and then make half of another lap to go to the next place. I didn't get to hold the gold bar, unfortunately, it wasn't available while I was there. || Arrived an hour before close time and didn’t get the ticket, which is for free, so couldn’t enjoy some of the interactive exhibitions, such as taking a picture of your head and you can download a copy of the paper money with your head on it. The ground floor has a vault where you can touch the gold and the rest of the exhibition is a bit boring. However, the first and second floors are great. You can see the history of the money evolution and money from different countries. Interactive exhibitions are also interesting, with some sections suitable for kids. || The Money Museum was a pleasant surprise for us, given that it was free we weren't expecting much but it was really well done with excellent exhibits and areas that were laid out very well and very informative. The interactive exhibits were a lot of fun as well for both kids and adult, we certainly learned a lot.  The staff there were also very friendly and kind as well. You couldn't ask for a better experience that was also free. Absolutely worth a visit if you're in Lisbon. || Visiting the Museu do Dinheiro in Lisbon was a surprisingly fascinating experience that I would recommend to anyone curious about history and culture. Situated inside the historic Church of São Julião, the museum offers a unique glimpse into the world of money, banking, and the evolution of commerce throughout the centuries. The building itself, beautifully restored, adds a rich atmosphere to the exhibits with its old stone walls and elegant design. Inside, I enjoyed interactive displays where I could even mint my own virtual coin and learn about the origins of currency in Portugal and beyond. One of the most impressive features is the access to a part of the old city wall beneath the museum, connecting visitors even further to Lisbon’s past. The entrance is free, which makes it even more attractive for travelers looking for valuable experiences without spending much. Although the museum is not very large, it is well-organized, educational, and very family-friendly. It is definitely a place worth visiting for a couple of hours if you want to discover another side of Lisbon beyond its typical tourist attractions. || A truly hidden gem! Run there on a rainy day It’s incredible and it’s free Fully interactive and nicely made Saw the first bank notes made etc The building itself is beautiful And don’t forget to go to the underground to see the remaining of Lisbon walls prior to the earthquake || Very cool and interactive museum. It is not very often that you get the chance to hold a 12 kilo pure gold bar. || I visited already second time, a strict security check upon entry, it's understandable, because there are really rare coins and objects on display. The museum is free. || We were surprised by this eclectic museum in the former Church of S. Julião. The basement contained archaeological artefacts from the excavation of the medieval wall of King Dinis. The main floor housed a temporary special exhibition. Then, the main exhibits upstairs illustrated the processes of printing, minting and distributing currency, with displays showing everything from gold bars to ancient coins to modern Euro notes. It was interesting (and free) way to spend an hour or two in Lisbon. || This place is amazing. Highly recommended! Free admission! Clean restroom! They even have water fountain to fill your water bottle 😄 … || A very interesting both technical and pedagogical museum in Lisboa. Sponsored by Bank of Portugal it offers free access in an interactive space loaded with history: that of the XVIIIth century building that was built as São Julião church before being bought by the Bank and in 2016 reopened as museum after renovation and parasismic reinforcement, that of the exposition in the basement of King Dinis wall (XIIIth century) and the history of the urbanization of Lisbon through a short animated métrage. Really worth the visit which is offered for free. || Super interesting about the history of international currency.  There is a segment of an ancient city wall buried beneath the museum.  A guide may be helpful if you are not fluent in Portuguese. || Such an interesting museum all about money! It is free to enter but has plenty to see and explore.  I was pleasantly surprised to find exhibits featuring Asian currencies from the time when Portugal was expanding its influence around the world. || Great experience for free. You need at least 3 hours to get the full experience. || free entrance. great collections of coins and bills. Great interactive display and activities so the kids will not get bored. don't miss the basement level which includes parts of the ancient city wall. || Ironically, the money museum seems to be the only free museum in Lisbon! Overall it was a fun and interactive experience. Enjoyable for all ages. Don't miss King Dinis' wall  which is down a set of stairs which can be easily missed.
