We hope to see you back one of these days. || Thiago is the best I want to adopt him. His knowledge of the Portuguese wine region is beyond words I'm already ready organizing a family trip to come back and feast on Thiago's knowledge of wines. Please if you find yourself in Lisbon come to this wine tasting with Thiago. Thiago is the best I consider him as though he is my son! 😂 || Thank you, Daniel, for your amazing review. It is just beautiful to see that we end the tastings with new friends. We had the best time!! We hope to see you back soon. || Tiago was excellent!, it was an amazing  experience totally recommend it, we learned a couple of things and we have been to wineries everywhere in the USA, Canada, Mexico, New Zealand, Spain. Thank you Tiago for your time and knowledge. || Thank you, Deborah, for your kind review. It was an absolute pleasure to welcome you at the Lisbon Winery and to share our passion for the Portuguese wines with you. We hope to see you again one of these days. || What a lovely place! It’s stylish but relaxed, and the staff is super friendly and speak great English. They explain everything clearly and can choose wines for you based on your preferences — and the recommendations were spot on for me.  Do yourself a favour and get the cheese/meat platter. It’s huge — listed for 2 people, but perfect for 3, and you could even share it with 4 if you’re on a budget. The wines were reasonably priced and the recommended ones didn’t break the bank.  I’ll definitely return the next time I’m in Lisbon. Thank you, and all the best to your business — it’s clear you take pride in what you do. || Thank you, Samu, for taking the time to review us. We had a great time too. We hope to see you back one of these days. || Tiago was our host for the evening.  Starting with bread and olive oil.  Then the wines and cheese and meat board.  Finishing with a 35YO port.  Greedy,  we asked for something to knock oursocks off. A 43YO port.  Echoing back to that first night,  "I don't want the evening to end..." Amazing... || Thank you, John, for your kind review. It was a great pleasure to welcome you at the Lisbon Winery and we are really happy to know you enjoyed the wine tasting and the special Ports served. || The wine tasting is truly excellent. We were brought some nice wines that represented different areas of Portugal that were not mass produced and good quality. The cheese and charcuterie platter was also very tasty. Our sommelier was Thiago who used to take part in the World Cup of wine tasting. He was very friendly and informative. Highly recommended. || Thank you for your generous review. We are really happy to know you enjoyed our wine tasting and your time with Tiago. It was a fun afternoon. || My husband and I were part of a small group wine tasting on Nov. 26th and had an amazing experience! The Sommier was incredibly passionate about the wines and we learned so much, including our liking of “Green Wine” and  Tawny Port. The only criticism we have is that there wasn’t an opportunity (that we noticed) to note ahead of time that we’re vegetarian so the Charcuterie was in the same board as the cheese. We ate most of the cheese that was not in direct contact with the meat, but felt bad about the food waste! || Hi, Lindsay. Thank you for your kind review. We are really happy to know you had a nice experience with us. Regarding your point about food restrictions, actually that is one of the questions we ask in our booking form. We ask for name, contact and also: “Do you have any food restrictions or allergies?” We have a lot of people doing our tastings with food restrictions and allergies and that is where we ask for that information so we can be ready for all situations. We were surprised to see all the meat untouched and it actually something we commented, but without that information we just did our normal premium board, cheese and charcuterie included. || Thank you so much to Tiago for a wonderful and very educational tasting! Great wine and even better conversation. Lisbon Winery is a  wonderful ambassador for Portuguese wine. We had a great time and I highly recommend a visit! || Thank you, Amie, for your review. We are so happy to read that you had a fun experience and are really excited to meet people as passionate as we are for great wine. || A group of 4 of us reserved a wine tasting and we were fortunate that Diago was our sommelier! We had a wonderful time and enjoyed the finest wines of different parts of the Portugal region. Went above and above and beyond, Very attentive and answered all of our questions. || Thank you for your kind words, Elizabeth. It was great meeting you and your group. What a fun afternoon! We hope to see you again soon.

This downtown cosy wine bar offers a fusion petisco menu with an extensive wine offer at fair prices with informal service in a minimalistic ambiance.  We were 3 for dinner who chose the couvert, fresh goat cheese, escabeche de coelho, a delicious lascas de bacalhau, the ox tail with salad, all with waters, a few glasses of wine and a coffee for €40/pax.  IT is a favourite ✨💫 || Truly the best wine bar in Lisbon ♥️ We had the loveliest time — the staff and the owner were so welcoming, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. They were incredibly helpful in helping us choose a wine, and the Dois Carvalhos Reserva was absolutely excellent. A bottle of that, paired with goat cheese and sourdough, made our evening truly wonderful. Highly recommend! || The best way to spend a last afternoon with friends Seriously. It’s a wine bar, and they’ve got great munchies. And, even more importantly, they’ll happily spend all the time in the world with you figuring out what you want to drink - anything from pairings to “just a glass of wine” Seriously, just an awesome place! || We had an amazing night at Nova. After a long day walking the hills of Lisbon their concept "you choose the food and we choose the wine" is a perfect way to relax. Every bite, paired with a perfect wine ... and a beautiful reflection of Portuguese grapes. The bread and olive oil was so good I could drink a glass of the olive oil. The oysters, fresh and paired perfectly with a white wine. Fish cakes were tasty. Above all, the friendly and fun service the staff provided was outstanding.  Do go see this quaint lil wine bar in Lisbon! || I never give full 5 stars, but I had to make an exception. The experience starts from your first step inside, the place is built perfectly. The staff is more skilled in wine then most sommelier I've met even in michlen restaurants. The food is not only great but with precision. Everything about the place is precise and any little detail in the place was given sophisticated thought. If you like wine, and are in Lisbon, you must pass through. || Yonara is great! She helped us so much!! I loved the food, the atmosphere, the wine! It was a superb experience. Save some room and taste the drunk pear for a dessert || Wow, Pedro thank you! We stumbled across this gem and I’m so glad we did! The food and wine were incredible - even my picky eater parents agreed. I’ve been a little scared to try sardines but tried it here and it was SO delightful. Each of the food/wine pairing went so well with each other and Pedro gave us explanations to put it all into context. Highly highly recommend!! || Wow, this wine bar and restaurant is just absolutely incredible. Our first night in Lisbon, we went here after dinner and were blown away by how intimate and personally curated the experience was. João helped us pick a couple dishes and suggested wines to pair each with. He explained why each wine would pair well, along with an explanation of where in Portugal each wine came from.  Our experience was so good that we came back for our last night in Lisbon for a full dinner, along with wine pairing. Our second visit was even better than the first, with both the hostess and João remembering us and taking incredible care of us.  Some Google ratings in Lisbon seem artificially inflated, but Nova Wine Bar has absolutely earned its 4.9 stars as of September 2025. || I came to Lisbon in search of a true culinary experience, and this was easily one of the best meals of the entire trip. The owner, Pedro, personally welcomed me as soon as I sat down, which immediately set the tone for the evening. I told him I was open to anything, and he curated a six-tapas tasting, each thoughtfully paired with a different wine.  Every pairing was beautifully balanced and clearly intentional, elevating each dish without overpowering it. The progression felt effortless, refined, and deeply satisfying from start to finish. If you are looking for an exceptional, memorable culinary experience in Lisbon, go to Nova. You will not be disappointed. || Loved this spot! We tried two cheeses and the ham — all perfectly curated — and Pedro gave us great wine pairing tips. Every choice was spot on for the four of us. Cozy, elegant and delicious! || Wow. What a great finding in Lisboa ! We stepped in for a little break to have a glass of wine. Being a wine enthusiast, we started discussing with Pedro, the owner, who’s a passionate wine lover. He took the time to explain to us the different portugese “terroirs”. He suggested we come back the next day for a wine & tapas pairing, and we did !!! We discovered wines from different regions, and Pedro stayed with us to chat about the tapas (all of which are his own unique creations) and his excellent wine pairings that were perfectly matched. Note: this was his day off but he came and stayed with us because he had suggested we come back the next day ! In summary: he enhanced our lisbon experience. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE Thank you Pedro ❤️ || What a gem!  So glad we came in. Pedro made our visit along with his lovely staff. Our first time in Portugal, we love wine but don’t know much about it so we let Pedro lead the way.  We had such a blast joking with him and learning from him.  The food was fantastic as was the wine. Also our first time trying Port and we fell in love. I wish we would’ve have more time to come back but if we ever make it back to Lisbon, this will be our first stop!! || This place is really SO special. If you're in Lisbon, this is an excellent choice for dinner - especially if you want to try lots of different foods! We ordered 7 dishes to share, and each was paired with a glass of wine. Every single dish was beautifully plated and tasted phenomenal, we were awed. The wine pairings were always spot-on. It's such an intimate setting,  you feel at home and the servers make you feel like family. Food we loved: sourdough, octopus, blood sausage, sardines, fried cod, stewed rabbit salad, drunk pears for dessert || This establishment deserves 10 stars and Pedro deserves 11. Kind of a place where you walk in, without speaking any Portuguese, but if you speak wine language, you immediately feel at home. Kind of a place you leave knowing you will return tomorrow. And we will (return tomorrow) to try the food and some more amazing wine. Just don’t ask for the bottle in the picture. That one (and all that’s left of it) is mine. || What a find!!! This fabulous wine bar was just down the road from our hotel. We had to resist the temptation to go every evening to sample delicious Portuguese wines. The tapas of sardines and the sheep cheese were so tasty. It was a warm and inviting place to spend a couple of hours or even more. || What a gem! My wife and I absolutely loved this place. The food is great. The wine is great. The staff and Pedro are even better. They make you feel like family. We had the creamy sheep cheese, black pig belly (amazing), Iberico ham and the drunk pear (so good!) each with a wine recommended by our awesome wait staff. Highly recommend this amazing wine bar in Lisbon!!! || All round excellent experience. Delicious food and host paired half glasses of Portuguese wine to each course! Highly recommend || The vine was kind of like a speakeasy, even though it isn't one. The wine was good and my server was very knowledgeable. || We went here after recommended by a friend. We had a fabulous time. We enjoyed an ash covered goat cheese, sausage and an AMAZING chocolate desert! Pedro made excellent wine suggestions to go along the food and we will come back next time we are in town. Highly suggest everyone stop in for food and wine you won’t regret it. || One of the best things we did in Lisbon. We wanted to try some Portuguese wines and Pedro gave guided my wife and I through whites, reds and port. Fantastic experience!

place_name: Red Nose Natural Wine Bar and Shop
reviews_content: A hidden gem in the heart of Campo de Ourique.  On a hot summer’s day, we stepped into this cozy little wine shop and were warmly welcomed by the owner, who served us natural wines at a small table inside. The air conditioning was a big plus, making it the perfect escape from the heat.  We spent a wonderful afternoon learning about Portuguese wines and their origins, while enjoying delicious food that paired beautifully with each glass. We left feeling not only a bit more knowledgeable, but also a bit happier than when we arrived.  A true local treasure — highly recommended! || Red Nose Bar is the spot if you’re into wine and good times. They’ve got an awesome selection— sip whatever and everything they suggest, tastes good, you’ll find something special.  staff? super friendly, know their stuff, and will make you feel like a wine pro in no time.  Oh, and the vibe? Chill but classy, perfect for a date or just a night out with friends. || Very groovy wine bar. No wine menu, so you tell the host what wine you are after, they give you a few to try and you chose the one you want - loved it! The wine glasses are really nice too - which always makes the wine taste better 😅 || Very cosy wine bar, we had our first natural wine here thanks to the kind staff! || Great selection of European wines. I tried Portuguese wines and got excellent recommendations. Unfortunately, I didn’t get a chance to try the food. || Thank a lot! We are refreshing our tapas menu soon and hope you will back to try with cool wines! || Gorgeous natural wine bar in the charming Campo de Ourique area of Lisboa! I loved the choice of wines — including excellent non-alcoholic options — and the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere created by the team. The sommelier will help you choose the perfect wine according to your mood, taste, and preferences, making the experience even more personal. The place isn’t too big, but the tables outside add a lovely touch to the vibe. The food dishes vary according to the guest chef, who personally explains all the ingredients and inspiration behind each plate. Perfect for meeting friends, a date, or simply enjoying a glass of whatever suits your mood. || Very nice wine bar (natural wines mostly). Good choose of the different wines, which you could try and choose the better for you. Also good small plates of food, great pairing to your wine. || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're thrilled that you enjoyed our selection of natural wines and the food pairings. Wishing you all the best and hope to see you again soon! || It's always a good idea to pick one glass or bottle of natural wine here. Friendly staff, good vibe and any kind of taste could be satisfied || Top notch service, not only incredibly knowledgeable and professional, but also relax and extremely generous, with an impressive offer and fair and clear prices. Relax environment and very enjoyable experience. Highly recommended if you are looking to try good quality wines from all over the world! || Thank you for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our relaxed environment and global wine selection, and we can't wait to welcome you back! || The staff is very lovely and they have a great selection of good wines! I cannot recommend this place enough🙌🏻

Wine tasting at best. Highly recommended  for wine tasting with flexibility to choose your bottles and taste them. Friendly and well deserved || Everything was lovely!!  Porto wines are highly recommended!!  Centrally located - thank you for the amazing night || Lovely little spot - quiet, calm, such wonderful and well informed staff (I assume he was the owner!). Price was good, vibes immaculate, wine excellent. Will be returning! || The wine is very good and the cheese was amazing too. The prices were very good and the owner a very nice man. Bairro Alto was an interesting place with many young people there and lots of cheesy trashy touristy places - when some teenagers walked in and left saying everyone looks old I knew I found the right place :) || Love this place, what a hidden gem! We visited around 3.30pm in the afternoon and after two others left, were the only people in the joint. Great wine recommendation from the owner, delicious food and liqueurs. Relaxed, friendly, local & well priced. We paid around 45€ for two wines, three glasses of liqueur, sardines, bread and delicious cheeses, plus a tin of sardines and small bottle of liqueur to take home. Will definitely be back and highly recommend. || It’s an amazing experience. Antonio is a lovely man. He takes the time to describe and tell something about the wine he is serving. Also the atmosphere alone is worth visiting. Glasses of wine are 4-5€, and you definitely get a well filled glasses. || Lovely wine shop with a very friendly owner and a great selection of local wines. Highly recommended! || A great spot to have a drink in a relaxing and magic atmosphere. Great prices, delicious appetisers and large wine selection. If you are in Bairro Alto, a must visit. || I was walking in Bairrio Alto when I saw this wine shop. Stopped for a glass of white wine from Alentejo, but they did not have one on the standard menu. The owner went to his cooler and pulled out a bottle and poured a generous glass for me. Atmosphere was nice and I came back for a port tasting after dinner the same day. || This place rocks. The selection is excellent, the environment is warm and inviting, and the owner was extremely nice to us.

I absolutely loved the place. From the very start, entrance until I got to the bar the ambient was elegant, classy and boutique. Great interior design and the smell was super pleasing.  The staff is polite, friendly and really care about your experience. The view is great, even though there is a wall of buildings in front. But it made you feel inside a hidden, exclusive place that nobody knows about.  For some reason I really see this place as a great option for white wine with oysters. It would fit their concept perfectly, I believe.  Glad that I found this place after 4 years in this amazing city. I will def come back soon with more friends.  Keep in mind that I ordered a beer and a coffee, that's why I selected 5-10 euros per person. However the place is more pricy than this.  Cocktails 13 euros on average, and dishes for 20+ || O Jardim wine bar was a pleasant surprise! The atmosphere felt like a fancy palace, and the service was both polite and knowledgeable. Considering the top-notch food and the beauty of the place, the prices were surprisingly reasonable. Overall, a great experience that won't break the bank || Great drinks and delicious food but quite on the expensive side. You do get to sit in a lovely garden || A hidden Gem in Lisbon. Big and beautiful outdoor terrace with relaxing music on the roof of “The One Hotel”. As the name says, it’s more a Wine / Cocktail Bar with some smaller plates to share. The waiter “Eduardo” was very attentive and friendly, for that a big thank you. || Great location. Nice and quiet to go for a glass of wine. There are also small tapas which are pretty good. Great service especially Eduardo. || Very nice open terrace. Good service. Friendly to all customers. Salad ingredients were good. (Polvo/octopus, tomatoes, greens). But pity they don't know how to make a world class modern salad. Common problem here in Portugal... || A little pricey on the foods but drinks were great! || Stopped by for a glass of wine and to chill.  Met by very nice members of staff, had two lovely glasses of wine and the price was extremely reasonable. || Oxtails is amazing. Not the biggest wine selection for the name, but nice atmosphere. Medium price. || Lovely experience at the O Jardim Wine Bar! The bartender, Jackson, was awesome and made the tastiest drink. Definitely try the “Dear Lisbon” drink if you stop by. In addition to nice service the decor and aesthetic is very nice! Would highly recommend to others. || Very nice staff, great place. You should try the brunch! || Nice place to enjoy drink in small garden || Very nice, relaxing atmosphe. Expensive. Sadly no music in the background. || Nice quiet courtyard sun trap. Lovely spot. || We are celebrating my sister’s 40th in Lisbon and we were pumped to visit this place for drinks. We were sitting for for a long time today and nobody came to greet or help. We just decided to leave. It was a disappointing experience. || A rather elegant rooftop in the centre of Lisbon, only a street away from the bustle so ideal for a calm drink || Very nice ambiance and service! || Great place for an afternoon drink and tapas. Lovely inner esplanade || Delicious tacos, chickpea burger, cheese board! || Stylish, peaceful bar and terrace. Good service.

place_name: Bico Cultura do Vinho | Wine Bar Lisbon
reviews_content: The place has an amazing atmosphere. The owner is extremely nice and knowledgeable. He gave us the best and most accurate recommendations for our taste. We were not planing of having so much wine as they selection is quiere well curated, which of course means glasses have a higher cost, but it was just inevitable, great wine, great service, great atmosphere, we just couldn’t leave. The snacks served with the wines where also very good, a delicious bread and berry tart. I highly recommend this place. || Thank you so much, Maria! We’re so happy you enjoyed the wines, the atmosphere, and our snacks — especially the tart, which is homemade by our owner ❤️ Hope to see you again soon for another glass! 🍷 … || As a local, it's a pleasure to visit Bico again and again. They keep searching for new wines that surprise you and challenge you so you keep discovering new flavours. If you haven't tried their paté, it's a must! If you're not a fan of paté, go for the bruschetta. Tell Jude what you like and he'll definitely find something for you. Enjoy, you're in safe hands ✨ || Thank you, Aurélien! We’re happy to be a place you enjoy coming back to. See you again soon 🍷✨ … || Wow, was really lucky to stumble upon this place on our stroll to look for a place to unwind at after a long walk around the city. The interior is very warm and inviting. An extensive list of wines paired with a very knowledgeable and experienced host is what sets this place apart. Would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to experience high quality Portuguese wine. || Thank you so much, Wesam!  We’re really happy you found us on your walk — and even happier you enjoyed the wines and the vibe.Hope to see you again at Bico soon! 🍷✨ … || The biggest compliments to the chef and owner. I do not normally give such enthusiastic reviews however this establishment deserves them all.  The selection of Portuguese wines is elevated and unique, tailored to one's tastes as well as pushed to experiment. One of the best creations in Lisbon...  Now the food... Balanced regional flavours that compliment the wine perfectly. Every detail to the selection of the cheese boards (which you can and we did purchase) artfully selected.  The hospitality, food and wine sum up to a perfect evening that one must experience on any trip to Lisbon. || Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Karolis! ❤️ We're truly happy to hear you enjoyed the wines, the food, and the overall experience. Your kind words mean a lot to our whole team!  We look forward to welcoming you back on your next visit to Lisbon! 🍷 || We were looking for a quiet, non-touristy place to do a tasting of Portuguese wines — and Bico did not disappoint. Jude greeted us at the door and made our time there so welcoming and memorable. The wines are specially curated and we got to enjoy rare tastings of some really excellent wine from all around Portugal. Jude took time to explain the features of the regions and the wines, highlighting the range of wines and listening well to our questions and preferences. The meat and cheese pairings were also phenomenal — each item came with a little story and seemed hand-selected for quality and uniqueness. It far exceeded our expectations and we’d highly recommend it! || Thank you so much, Julianne! We’re really happy you found the calm, non-touristy experience you were looking for. It was a pleasure welcoming you, and we hope to see you again at Bico 🍷 … || 10/10 experience. We each did a wine flight and Jude took us on an adventure with each wine sharing with us his deep knowledge of Portuguese wines. His knowledge of every wine that he carries is amazing and really stands out. The cheese plate was also phenomenal! || Thank you, Carolyn! We’re thrilled you loved the wine flight with Jude — he truly brings each glass to life 🍷❤️ … || This place is just so cool and well put together! I felt great when the guy in charge offered me a seat at the bar since all the tables were taken—such a nice gesture. I ordered the best Aperol Spritz I’ve ever had—perfectly made—and it came with a full bottle of San Pellegrino, which was a great touch. I also got some snacks to go with my drink.  The music was spot-on, and the atmosphere was so good I didn’t want to leave. The staff were super friendly and always smiling, which made the whole experience even better.  Honestly, I was expecting to pay nearly double what they actually charged me, so the price was a very pleasant surprise. Can’t wait to come back soon! || The space is modern yet warm and intimate. The cheese and cold cuts were amazing. The wine selection was excellent! The owner was super friendly and made us feel very welcome. He was a great host and clearly passionate about what he does. He let us try different wines before choosing. He really made the experience special. A highly recommended wine bar. || This wine bar in Lisbon is absolutely fantastic! I highly recommend it. The food is delicious, the wine selection is outstanding, and the customer service made me feel truly welcome. It’s both cozy and elegant—a perfect spot to unwind. || We absolutely loved this wine bar! The staff were SO friendly, knowledgeable and welcoming. The mortadella, stracciatella and pesto dish will be something I remember for years to come. Every glass we tried was interesting, easy drinking, mostly natural and all had a story. It’s these kind of experiences that make an impact. We loved it so much we returned on our last night. Obrigada, thanks for your hospitality! || Thank you so much! We’re truly happy you loved your time at Bico — and that the wines and our mortadella dish made such an impression. Sharing these experiences is what we love most. Obrigada for coming back — hope to see you again soon 🍷❤️ …

place_name: Retro Wine Lounge - Wine Bar & Tasting Room
reviews_content: This is the best bar you could ever find in Portugal. What makes it truly special is that it offers the most unique Portuguese wines you won’t find in stores and would probably never even hear about otherwise. Daniel explained each wine to … || Such an offbeat bar you won’t find anywhere else in Lisbon. Today, it stands as one of the most authentic spots for Portuguese wine. At the heart of it is Daniel, a man with deep knowledge of Portugal’s wine culture. If you’re looking for … || A hidden gem in the city! Daniel, the owner, is one of the most welcoming and knowledgeable hosts I’ve ever met. … || I found Retro Wine Lounge on a whim as I was seeking local wine bars to spend an hour or two in while visiting Lisboa. I am SO happy that Retro Wine Lounge is the one I discovered on Google Maps and ventured to. This neighborhood gem is … || Thank you so much for your kind words and review, Natalie. It's nice that you mentioned the music also as it's the soul of our place, together with the wines. We'll be truly happy to see you at our lounge again next time you'll be in town. || Beautiful, cozy atmosphere, welcomed by a great host and flavorful wine. This place is a must if you’re looking for an experience like no other. || I came with the idea of getting to understand Portuguese wines, and what a better place to land than Retro Wine Lounge. Wide variety of high quality native wines, all explained with passion and … || I recently visited this charming wine bar with a friend, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. The selection of wines was exceptional, offering a variety of unique and intriguing options that delighted our palates. We paired the … || Thank you so much for your review and such kind words. So glad that we didn't disappoint you. We'll always do our best to provide the most authentic wine experience and we truly hope to see you again when you visit Lisbon someday. You'll always be welcome here. || The best place for the most special experience ever. Authentic, traditional and very original products. Best host ever, lots of knowledge and passion. || This place is amazing. A true gem off the beaten path with a very knowledge wine owner. He only opens occasionally to the public and we happen to come during that time. He was welcoming and the wine was fãulous! || We had a very nice wine tasting. You can expect special wines, unique and rare. Daniel explained a lot and knows his business. We enjoyed it a lot and hope to come back! || One of my best wine experiences. Great wines, but what I liked the most was Daniel explaining details about the wine we drunk and a lot more about the history of wine in Portugal and in the world . || Just had an exceptional experience at the place. The host is amazing, courteous and has deep knowledge about wines. The experience starts with an introduction to many different types of wines. After that the guests can taste a few selected … || Thank you so much for your detailed review and very kind words, Tulika. I'm very glad that I could attend your expectations. Hope to see you again at our place. || The wine wasting experience is good, you can describe what flavors and brands you prefer, then the boss will give you recommendations. This wine  in the picture is super refreshing , fragrant and easy drinking, especially when paring with chocolate. || Glad that you enjoyed our fresh red vinho verde ("green" wine), which is so specific, specially with dark chocolate. Thanks for your detailed review and kind words, Carey. We hope to see you again at our wine spot. || Amazing wines! Daniel is an expert but makes it so approachable. His English is fantastic! Perfect tourism spot in Lisbon for tasting Portuguese wines! || Had a nice experience here with some friends last Saturday, the owner Daniel was very knowledgeable and gave insights into Claret wine which was a first for us. Nice cheese and meat snacks and tasty wine. Highly recommended! || Thanks for your review, Arthur. Glad that you enjoyed that claret wine. It's different and at the same time one of the most traditional Portuguese wine styles. Hope to see you again at our place. You guys are always welcome here. || A very interesting selection of amphora wines, a beautiful and cozy place. The host will tell you a lot of interesting things about wine. || I came here for the talha wine, I stayed for the experience. Daniel is incredibly knowledgeable and generous with his time and expertise. The wine was gorgeous and interesting to learn about. I'll definitely be back. || Thank you so much for your review, Conor. That's why we believe we're, step-by-step, achieving the goal of providing one of the best selection and experiences in the field of the Talha and Amphora Wine in general, here in Lisbon. And you're always welcome at our place as a big appreciator of it. || You can really tell that the owner absolutely loves what he does and he takes such a good care of the guests and their preferences. A lovely place for a quiet and romantic evening. || Thanks for your review and nice words, Julia. Those are our goals.  You'll be always welcome in our place. || You are visiting from another country and you want to try Portuguese wines by someone experienced and enthusiastic. This is the place. Definitely worth the trip. The owner is very knowledgeable and very nice. Would visit again. || Thank you so much for your review, honest and kind words, Nazli. We hope to see you again when you'll be in Lisbon. || Daniel was an amazing host!! He served us a plethora of delicious and authentic local wines as well as a plate of nuts and gourmet cheese. 10/10 place. || Thanks for your review, Hazel. It's always a pleasure to host you at our place. Hope to see you again.

Had my first (and last) drink and small plates here, they have a brilliant selection of natural wines, with plenty available by the glass. The staff were incredibly friendly and helped me choose the perfect wine. The small dishes were absolutely delicious! When I come back to Lisbon, I’ll definitely visit again. Good luck, guys! 💜 … || A cozy place to reunite all of your friends to celebrate your birthday. It was an amazing experience for a Sunday rainy afternoon, super chill and comfortable. Great wines to taste and also great options for people who don’t drink alcohol. The host is incredibly kind, welcoming and genuinely attentive. Highly recommend ! || We had a great time at Nata Wine Bar. They had an excellent choice of different wines and the service was great. … || Hi there — thank you so much for visiting Nata Wine Bar and for the lovely words about our wine selection and service. We’re really happy you had a great time! We’re sorry for the confusion around the bill and receipt. Our focaccia is €5, … More || Phenomenal! There are no words to describe my happiness that I found Nata and they exist here in Anjos during my lifetime . Nata converted me to natural win having tried quite a few places in Lisbon and just never convinced. That’s before … || We highly recommend the Nata Wine Bar! We often spontaneously go there for a glass of wine in the evening, and last week we also did a wine tasting, which was very well organized and we all enjoyed it very much! We will definitely be back often 😊 … || I had the most wonderful experience hosting a brunch for my pilates community at Nata. The space was perfect for our group, Abbie thought of everything- and the food, drinks and special touches made it such a perfect morning! Everyone left … || Thank you so much Imo! We definitely had the best time with you and the pilates girlies and we’re looking forward to next weekend! 💚 … || Nata Wine Bar offers a lovely, intimate space in Anjos with about 120 natural and organic labels, many from small Portuguese producers. The interior is modern and welcoming, the staff are knowledgeable and helpful, and the tasting flights are a great way to discover new producers. Good spot for a relaxed glass or a low‑key meet‑up || I have hosted two events at Nata, and would love to host more in the future since it is the most PERFECT venue for my creative workshops; such a beautifully considered, warm, cosy space - but still enough space to seat large groups with … || Lovely bar with an interesting selection of wines by the glass and a great shelf full of bottled options. The menu is small but delicious. The girls behind the bar are fantastically welcoming and passionately describe the wines to help you choose. || So far my fav wine bar in lisbon. Such a vibe. Only thing is there is really limited spot in the outside area so you might need to sit inside. But wines are crazy good.

All the dishes were amazing and I couldn’t get enough of the chorizo butter. Quick friendly service and superb wine. Not one to miss || WOW! Discovered this place almost by accident just up the street from where we were staying.  It's an amazing space. We sat upstairs outside and had the absolute best service all night long.  The wine recommendations were spot on. We wanted to eat everything on the menu. Everything we decided on was top notch and so delicious.  We started with the tempura green beans and the roasted carrots. Delicious! Then we moved on to the octopus stew and the braised pork cheek. Could not have been better! || Absolutely loved this place and will be recommending to everybody. I stumbled across it as I had struggled to make a last minute booking whilst waiting for a friend to arrive into Lisbon. From the start we were made to feel incredibly welcome, and Antonio was our waiter. In fact, he also was cooking all the dishes and owned the place, so the fact that service was beyond exceptional was mind-blowing. I had the pork belly on fried rice, and my friend had the octopus stew, both of which tasted incredible. Portion sizes were medium and filling, it’s the perfect spot prior to continuing your night elsewhere. We definitely didn’t leave feeling hungry! Above all of this, it was very reasonably priced, including drinks. I’ll be coming again when I return to Lisbon next. || Such a wonderful place, offering high-quality local wines and delicious food. I especially loved the Kimchi & Goat Cheese and the lemon cake - both were outstanding! I’ll definitely be coming back :) || We always find the best spots away from the main bar/dining areas and Caruma is by far one of the best so far,  service food wine ALL excellent, we will definitely return before we leave. There’s a hidden terrace out the back with a beautiful atmosphere we were greeted so warmly we felt right at home. There’s natural wine is amazing but be warned the hangover from to much is quite unique! || Great wine and even better food! Table of 5 had wine, small plates and dessert for a very reasonable price! All 5of us said they make the best chicken cutlet sandwich we’ve ever had (try not to overlook it!). Great mix of flavors in every bite of every dish. We were only in Lisbon for 9 days and we planned to go back for dinner again before we headed home. We couldn't try everything! When you go, make sure to pay sufficient attention to Gigi. || Delicious food and great service ❤️ also a good selection of wines. An absolute must in Lisbon! || Off the beaten track place with really good food and wine. Knowledgeable and friendly service. Kind of wish they had some music and more art on the walls (though there is a great historic poster from the Carnation Revolution). I would definitely go back || The food is fantastic. I highly recommend the octopus stew and the pica pau || We loved our dinner there. Delish small plates. The owner is vey passionate about the food and wine he chooses , and everything was great. Only 3 for atmosphere because it was very quiet but maybe it was because it was rainy. Would definitely recommend fora low key, delicious dinner.  Thank you || Beautiful restaurant with kind staff and excellent food and wine. I highly reccomend It. || I was fooled by all the random 5 star reviews. All the food is laced with paprika, EVERY SINGLE DISH. if you order 5 dishes from the menu, it all tastes the same... We couldn't finish even one dish, that never happened to me before. I was actually in shock. Left to find something edible nearby. Any lists that have Caruma on their must go to is VERY suspicious to me, virtually impossible to eat the food. || We stumbled across this place and were blown away by the dishes! We were a table of three and had 7 plates and every single one was 10/10. Already planning our return to try the remaining things off the menu. Service was great and the ambience on the terrace was lovely. Thank you for having us 😊 || We love coming here.  The food is excellent and well prepared.  We love the natural wines.  Very delicious.  Highly recommend. || This is a lovely local place with high quality food yet to be discovered by the big crowd. Enjoyed every bite, amazing wine and great service. It’s that hidden local spot you want to find in the creative Graça area ❤️ || AMAZING EXPERIENCE ! I have no words. The food was amazingly cooked, innovative and so tasty. I never put Google comments but this restaurant DESERVES one. || We stumbled upon this hidden treasure accidentally, and I'm delighted we did. The wine was excellent, the food even more so, and the hosting was delightful. I would definitely return on my next visit to Lisbon. || Lovely spot. Great waiter. Amazing food. Some of the best food I’ve ever had type of good. || Wandered in late night for dinner and they happily sat a group of 6. The food and wine were both delicious. The pork cheek with sweet potato and blueberry was the highlight. || Fascinating small selection of natural wines with original food. Charming service.

Quaint little wine stop up the hill. Food was excellent. I had the Muxama, oysters (which were fresh), and the cured ham. Glass of white then glass of red wine. They helped me pair everything really well. || Thank you for your kind review Matt. See you next time! 🥂 … || Local wine shop that offers light bites like oysters, cheeses and meats. They offer local wines and have a rotating monthly wine special. It’s a small space but people but they make it work with tables both inside and outside. Friendly service and helpful with the wine selections. We had a glass with some cork in it and the server immediately replaced it with a fresh glass which was highly appreciated. || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time! || A very nice and eclectic place where patrons will be able to discover the best Portugal has to offer in wines. Very discrete wine tasting house in the street coming up to Miradouro de Graça , but a stop there (mind you, only when you go downhill ! ) is more than justified. Will definitely come back . || Thank you for your review. See you next time! 🥂 … || This place is awesome. I’ve come here two nights in a row. Their wine selection is fantastic. I asked for recommendations and got something better than I had hoped for. Service is super friendly and knowledgeable, the wine is fantastic and the cheese I had was perfect. I’d come here every night if I lived in Lisbon! || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time! || Located pretty uphill we walked 40min- Nice n cozy little wine bar. White sangria was refreshing and sweet Porto wine flight was sweet but stronger than we thought.. Oysters were good with my white wine. || Thank you for your thoughtful review. See you next time! || For wine lovers in Lisbon, this bar is a must-visit. The great wine choices are a real highlight, and the delicious food and snack options perfectly accompany them. The ambiance is lovely, especially with the addition of a small outdoor terrace. What truly sets this place apart is the owner and staff, who are exceptionally attentive, lovely, and pleasant. Highly recommended! || Thank you so much for your kind review, see you next time! || This is an amazing place, we ended each night of our stay here. The owner is wonderful and is happy to make recommendations on which wines we ordered. The food is very good and the atmosphere is cozy and relaxed. There a many wines to choose from and try and he is very knowledgeable about each one. We loved coming here and hope to go back! || Thank you for your thoughtful review. See you next time! || The definition of an amazing place: very good wine selection, delicious small plates to share, and great service. The interior styling is also amazing. It's an old drug and grocery store very well preserved. Definitely recommend it! It's the perfect place to enjoy a good wine with friends or lovers. || Such a lovely place to have a wine and some oysters in Lisboa. The guys were really nice and helpful! Totally recommend it! || Thank you for your kind review. See you next time! || Very cozy wine bar. Super kind owner who can recommend wines for your taste || Thank you very much for your kind review. See you next time!

Cool restaurant on a super cute side street packed with outdoor seating, an awesome wine bar, other restaurant options, and amazing vibes. This place was so busy the first time we went that by the time we got a seat they were sold out of pizza! We ended up getting some pasta dishes which were great but super happy we got to make it back because the pizza was awesome! || Really enjoyable quality place where to sip a good wine while tasting it. Very close to Largo da Graça and 2 remarkable miradouros where to enjoy the sunset view 🪟 from (you will though have to choose what you do ... The sunset watching or the wine sipping !). All kinds of local and international wines available there, in a very popular street where you will be able to eat good pizzas or other food. Recommended (we also visited their other venue in Venice Italy). || I had the dish of the day (briosh with shrimp and maracuja dip) and the white wine from portugal - both was delicious! I had to sit inside at the bar as it was very crowded but it was still a very nice atmosphere. The service was a bit slow but friendly. Would come back! || Lovely wine bar on a super cute bustling alleyway of Graca. Hard to find Sunday night hangouts sometimes and this spot was bustling! Loved it here and will Come back.  Only gripe is pours of wine are small and on the more expensive side. || Perfect small plates and natural wines tucked away in Graca. We ate outdoors and the street was full but not crowded around 7:30pm. Friendly staff that recommended and provided tasting of wine before the glass was poured. French and Italian natural wines with some from Portugal as well. The food was delicious and very reasonably priced. The foccacia with mortadella, pork belly entree, and swirdfish carpaccio was delicious. Must try! || Hands down the best wine bar in town!  Not only do they have the most extensive domestic as well as import wines, the space is very well suited to enjoy a bottle with your friends, in the most picturesque alley way of Graça neighborhood.  And the cherry on top of the cake: the owners are outspoken in their belief in humanity! || To be honest this review is a little bit difficult to write because I like this place but there are just to many things here that simply ruin the experience.  Let’s start with the good. There is a large wine selection with interesting labels from all over Europe. The staff is helpful and nice. Shout out to Chicha who made our experience. We had a really nice lentils dish that I recommended to anyone visiting.  The main problem here is that there are so many tables and so little staff that it took us 45 minutes to get a beer from the tap and another 30 minutes to get our wine. And trying to get a servers attention to order anything else is seemingly impossible if you want to be polite. When we arrived (with reservation)we still had to wait 25 minutes to be seated.  4 out of 5 of the dishes we ordered were poor for many reasons that are unnecessary to detail here.  The bottom line is that yes this place is a great vibe and has so many things going for it but it still lacks basic service to make the experience a good one.  If you find yourself here enjoy and find an extra measure of patience. || Loved this wine bar! It was just the vibe we were looking for - perfect for sipping wine outside with some food.  The wines we had and food were all amazing, highly recommend if you’re after a cute little wine bar! || Found this in passing. Amazing services and truly wonderful wines. I am 100% going to be going back, if you like French wine and champagne then this is the place for you. I enjoyed Portuguese wines all holiday but it was nice to find some beautiful French wines served here. The staff were super brilliant also. I’d love to try some food here next time. || The only Pizza places we recommend to our guests who want takeaway. They are by far Lisbon's best. Their pizzas are made from the best flour you can get in around Lisbon (we know because they buy from the mill we get our bread flour from) - and the various toppings are all made from the best ingredients. Get the Classics or try Antoinne & Mateo's take on this Italian classic 👌 😋 ✨️ - executed by Mario in the kitchen.  Highly recommended! || The atmosphere is really nice, with some tables outside, perfect for summer nights. Very friendly and helpful staff. In my opinion, they should have a bigger offer of Portuguese wines by the glass. Most of the people visiting this bar are tourists and they would prefer to try portuguese wines. || Probably the most visited natural wine bar in Lisbon! Open all week round it offers a mesmerising selection of natural wine gems. Natty universe!  A diverse audience combines both locals and expats, young and elderly. Cozy simple interior or even better sit outside in the street if the weather allows.  Friendly barmen will guide you to the world of natural wines, so don't worry at all when you see hundreds of playful labels.  Food is good and moderately priced. The menu is short and goes well with wines, so can't miss with it.  Expect a 10 percent discount on wines you want to take away.  Gets packed after 8pm.  Ciao and see you soon!  P.S. also check out their sister bar in Venice and soon to be opened another one in Lisbon! || We sat at the bar which ended up being a great spot. Note that we came without reservation. There is an insane selection of wine. The staff is very friendly and helps with the choice of wine. Food is also great. Mostly small plates and some boards to share. I would definitely come back. || Very nice, hip and chill place to go for propper wine and a bite. They have a wide range of wines and taste delicious. Furthermore, they offer small complimentary snack that go really well with the wine. The food is absolutely amazing and perfect to share for 2 people. As stated before a lot of young, hip people come here and drink wine together. There is not much of a view and compared to other places in Lisbon it is a bit expensive, but definitely worth it for a nice wine experience. || Nice place, but there are better ones like this. Above all, it caught my attention that they do not have wines from Argentina or Chile, which are in the top 5 of countries producing the best wines in the world. Furthermore, if you order a glass of wine they serve you very little, less than 8cm, and they charge you a high price. A lot of things to improve, no doubt. || looooooved it. devine wine and good charcuterie board next to it, what else you can ask || Pretty cool bar in Graça, where you can find some great wine and appetisers. Price is fair as well so you won't spend a lot to get satisfied, although it's not cheap either. I had two glasses of wine plus two appetisers and paid around 25-30 euros. If you're looking for a place to have a few drinks and have fun with friends it's worth the time. || Thank you very much for the lovely words !    Come back !  ♥️ || My favorite wine bar in Lisbon. Besides the great selection of wines also a small very good menu of dishes (also vegan options). Great selection of wines, always tasting. Great atmosphere. It is always worth the trip there. || Really cool wine bar with great vibes and nice staff. We also had the ‘vegan dish’ which is whatever delicious stuff they have that day and it was super good. I always take my friends here! Get down early or reserve if you want a seat || Amazing spot. Found us a table even though they were pretty full. Everything we ate was great but it’s the natural wine selection which is the stand out. That and the super helpful and friendly staff.

Café super cute, the pancake were special, the Greek yogurt was very good and the orange juice and the tea were perfect.  Yesterday we tried avocado toast and croissant with ham and cheese and also they were perfect! Very good also the filter coffee.  In 3 days in Lisbon we come 3 times here to have breakfast because everything is very good and the staff is adorable.  Very recommended :) || Perfect location a street off main thoroughfare tucked away in a side street. Beautiful ambience with attentive staff. Our bread; olive oil and glasses were refilled with barely an ask. Our waitress was so attentive we never had to even raise our hand. The best type of wine bar post tour and pre dinner is one with good vibes, soft music and comfort. To add to that we had a beautiful cheese plate, excellent assortment of wines and enjoyable company. Thank you for this NoN tourist trap, wonderful quaint place || Blend & Bottle is one the best location in lisbon to have perfect food and Wine , I had one of my favorite Iranian food-Gheymeh- with saffron rice. Good place to hang out in evening and enjoy the vibe with your wine beside. Highly recommended || Fabulous find hidden off the busy Lisbon streets. Wonderful selection of local wines and paired with cheeses and meats. Attentive service and really intimate. Well worth a visit! || I had such a lovely time at this café. Everything about it felt easy and enjoyable the kind of place where you can actually relax. The wine was honestly amazing, and the little extras they served with it made it even better: fresh olives, a nice variety of cheeses, and this incredible bite-sized pizza that totally hit the spot. Nothing fancy or overdone, just really good food and a great vibe. I’ll definitely be going back. || If you are looking for a quiet and relaxing atmosphere, good food and drinks with great service then you’ll want to skip the crowds and try Pouya & Farzane’s Blend & Bottle Cafe in the heart of Lisbon’s iconic downtown. Where you can enjoy good wine, great cappuccino and blazingly fast Internet! And the music is always nice. And don’t forget the Pizza. || Thank you very much Benjamin || Best vibe, delicious food, and the most amazing wine and atmosphere you can find in a bar. The service is excellent, and the people who serve you are so kind. Definitely my first choice to enjoy good wine! || Beautiful ambience, great music and well priced wine. Authentic wine bar that my wife really wanted to experience - fully recommended. || Very cute little bar with friendly waitress and good wine. Very chill, off the main touristy area. We don’t try the food because it was late. || The service was great all the people were super kind and they gave us homemade chocolate bread because my son wanted chocolate milk but they only had plain. We ordered the port wine and it was very good. || Great experience! Cozy environment, lovely service, delicious wine and pepperoni pinsa 🍷👏🏻 || What a lovely place to relax with a cup of coffee or wine. Very peaceful, great to have conversations. Underestimated gem of the area. || It’s a cozy-comfortable place to chill and relax. Loved the vibe & calm music. Kind personnel.  In my favorite list 😎 || Beautiful cafe, open for coffee and pastries in the morning then wine and savoury bites in the evening. Service is brilliant, would definitely come again. || Very comfy and eye-catching place, enjoyed a lot to have a talk. Owners are incredibly friendly. Prices are a bit expensive and since doors are all open to the street, it gets cold in the winter inside but still a very cool place that I recommend nonetheless. || Loved this place! Great coffee in the morning, lovely wines at night, and a super cozy vibe. Friendly staff, beautiful design — easily one of my favorite spots in Lisbon! || new in town,   must go! we enjoyed our drinks,  very cosy place,  perfect service, || I recently visited Blend&Bottle, and I can’t recommend it enough. From the moment you step in, the atmosphere wraps you in warmth, cozy and inviting. The wine selection is thoughtfully curated, featuring both local gems and international treasures. Whether you’re a wine enthusiast or just someone who loves a relaxing glass in good company, there’s something for everyone with amazing prices. The service is also excellent. Hope you enjoy as much as I enjoyed. || Great cosy place with aromatic coffee, good wines & very friendly staff. Perfect if you want to relax for a while and take a break from the city center or do some work (there is good Wi-Fi and power outlets available). || Very nice Location and perfect Coffee! Friendly and helpful Service😎👍

Almost 5 years in Lisbon and I didn't know this place. What a shame!  I liked the vibe, it's like going to TimeOut Market but more private, and more elegant.  We went for the Matheus Dry, the bottle went for 16 euros, which in my opinion is a great price. We really liked it ans we sat right at the bar.  They have a lot of choices to pick from, and great presunto and cheese to complement the wine. We didn't try that, unfortunately.  Instead we went for a prego with fries and mustard that was pretty nice. However, overpriced in my opinion. It goes for 15 euros, but in my opinion it should be 9 - 12.  All in all is a great place. I will come here for my next date! || Had a lovely evening trying all different kinds of wine with some great recommendations from our waitress. All the wines we had were great and very fun to try a selection! The food was also great, the croquettes and the veal cheeks especially. The interior was also super cool and very different which adds to the experience. Would recommend but probably do have to book in advance! || This restaurant is very pretty & interesting inside and it’s fun to try wines by the glass. I was however disappointed by the food. The tuna & plantain appetizer was much too sweet and over dressed. The octopus w green pea entree was unique and tasty but over salted. Yet the chocolate cake was perfect. Our waitress aimed to please and match wines to our personal preferences. The customers next to us ordered a charcuterie board w mix of meats and cheese which looked much better than our app. || We’d originally planned to do a wine tasting here but didn’t get round to booking this in advance. We turned up, explained and asked if a tasting was possible to which they agreed to let us sample three wines and then share a glass of our favourite from these three. We did this twice, once with white wine and once with rose.  The barman was very knowledgeable and friendly and guided us through our selections with ease.  The striking interior design of this place is centred around backlit wine bottles which cover the arched ceiling. We sat at the bar for about an hour and observed how busy it got. A reservation for dinner would be advised….. || Stumbled across it by chance one night and saw a line outside - returned the following night to properly investigate. Stunning food and excellent and reasonably priced by the glass range. Waiters worked as a seamless team and explained the menu with excellent detail. Highly recommend tuna on plantains, tempura green beans and ribs with polenta. || Sensational interior, hard working team, and compelling offering. Slick. The tuna tartar with toasted plantain was outstanding. So too the carpaccio of octopus. The peixinhos da horta were on point, but the fried calamari were over cooked and consequently tough. Ordered a bottle of verdelho from Açores having tasted a delicious sample of the same by the glass. The bottle ordered was badly corked and bore no resemblance to the thimbleful of a minute before. Sadly, a young man carving ham, who was asked by our clearly distressed waitress what to do, decided to explain to me that it wasn’t corked, but simply not the right temperature and recently opened (he then surreptitiously re-corked the bottle and secreted it under the bar). I’ve been collecting, trading and enthusiastically drinking wine for over forty years and have managed to develop a ‘nose’. These guys should know better than to try and pretend a wine is fine when it clearly isn’t. We ordered a different local bottle, an Encruzado from Dão that was delicious. Similar price range circa €55 - so both quite decent choices. Sadly the only bad taste left was the charlatan behaviour of an employee trying to shaft the clientele. I only pray it isn’t emblematic of a more cynical business and employee bullying culture - we genuinely felt worried for our waitress having merely explained the product was off. True lovers of wine know when a wine is corked - these guys either don’t (which is not a great sign) or worse, the business model says, bully the customer until they give in if the wine is expensive. Caveat emptor if you darken this door. I’d still return believing the lack of grace, good manners and the rude treatment by one particular employee shouldn’t be enough to ruin what is definitely a commendable operation. || Got the chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream, paired with a port wine. The chocolate cake was delicious, albeit probably 100 000 calories. Paired with a really good vanilla ice cream, with some dalt and crumbs, it did not dissapoint! The port was a really good choice by the waiter. All in all good experience! || Excellent wine bar that we accidentally stumbled in. And it was totally a pleasant surprise. The Green wine is delicious. They do have some snack, but not a huge selection. But you are here for the wine, not the food. || Stumbled upon this place, headed to our dinner reservations and decided to stop in for a glass of wine.  Beautiful place with super helpful servers.  We grabbed a couple seats at the bar for a glass of wine.  Great spot to watch the gentleman slicing ham and making gorgeous charcuterie boards.  So the next night, we went for dinner after seeing all the amazing plates the night before.   Food was lovely.  Wine was fantastic.  Service was great with amazing suggestions. || We came here for our last dinner in Portugal and loved it! The food was good but the highlight was the wine and the service. Our waitress was so knowledgeable and let us try different wines while explaining the different regions in Portugal. I would recommend for wine lovers looking for a fun vibe

place_name: From The Vine: Port & Wine Tasting Bar - Port & Wine Tasting In Lisbon
reviews_content: I visited From The Vine for my birthday, and it turned out to be one of the highlights of my trip. The entire experience was fun, informative, and genuinely educational exactly what a great wine tasting should be. Our instructor was absolutely wonderful: knowledgeable, engaging, and full of joy. Their passion for Portuguese wine made the session not only insightful but also incredibly enjoyable. I learned so much while laughing and sipping my way through some amazing pours. I loved the wines so much that I ended up purchasing a couple of bottles to take home which says everything! If you’re looking for a memorable, welcoming, and authentically Portuguese wine experience, From The Vine is a must-visit. I can’t recommend it enough. || Thank you so much for your feedback || overall a 5 star experience! the customer service was incredible, the entire group were talking and having a great time, we met some lovely people. The wine tasted great, as we've never been wine tasting before we learnt some new things and were able to enjoy the wine however we liked. Lovely birthday experience, I was going to post the wines we tasted but I wont ruin the experience! I had a lovely birthday experience here and we all got on so well, it could've been the wine haha please do visit here if you're in Lisbon, everyone was so friendly and we all had such a lovely time! || We appreciate the flexibility and we are glad that you had a good time || Cio was amazing! Great host! Incredibly passionate and knowledgeable about the wine. We had an amazing experience! Will definitely return!  Lots of laughs and met a lot of new friends! || Thank you for your kind review || Thank you for a wonderful experience! I live in Lisboa and wanted to learn more about the wines of Portugal, The Vine wine tasting was absolutely amazing, educational, and so much fun! I would highly recommend The Vine wine experience to anyone interested in a culinary and wine tasting adventure in Lisboa. The wines and the presentation were both delicious and perfectly done. Thank you so much! || This was fine. The host was not very welcoming at first but he did warm up as time went by. We tasted 6 ports - which were delicious and learnt a small amount about each. The snacks comprised one very small bowl of walnuts. It was finished in 30 minutes. || I am sorry the experience did not meet your expectations we try our very best to accommodate all allergies || Really recommend this place for wine tasting! We were hosted by Kaio who went through the wine regions in Portugal and we got to taste 6 different wines that were all really good. Thank you and keep up the good work! || Thanks for the recommendation || We had high expectations for this port tasting because of the positive reviews. Upon arrival, we we're welcomed by the host, but unfortunately, the other booking didn't show up. We found the host a bit impersonal. He gave a good explanation of the Port, but wasn't a good host otherwise. He didn't interact or enjoy a pleasant chat, which made the atmosphere feel uncomfortable. At the end of the tasting, this was made very clear to us, and we were also reminded of the tip glass, which I found very rude. We gave a tip but the amount was not to his satisfaction. All in all, the Port and the explanation were fine, but the host did his job, and that was that. We wouldn't go back. || We are really sorry about that and will take your feedback as a lesson || We had a fantastic time here! I booked as a present for my partner for his 30th, we booked the tasting of three wines through get your guide, and we ended up getting a private tasting as no one else had booked! Our host Caio was so knowledgeable and kind and the wines were really lovely! Dan was even given a little present at the end for his birthday! Thanks so much for one of my favourite memories from Lisbon! || Visited today as a "must do" whilst in Portugal for the first time, all the wines were incredible, food was great and Caio was a true professional whilst also keeping the atmosphere casual and fresh.  Would recommend to anyone visiting Lisboa.  Thanks again for an amazing afternoon folks! || Thank you Mark. I had a great time with you guys || We went twice on our trip to Lisbon! Once for the Wine & Cheese and once for the Port Tasting! Caio was fantastic and made the classes both fun and educational! :) || It was great having you back!

Lero Lero is one of those spots that you insist your friends go to, it’s the entire package.  The walls are lined up with some of the best biodynamic producers (the type of bottles that make you dance once you taste them); don’t know what you might be into, don’t worry, ask the staff and they will point you in the exact direction.  The pizza, the pizza was so good, we ordered 5 and every one HIT. Our group was arguing about who got the last slice of pie from each.  Above all; the vibe. Lero Lero is gorgeously set up. Whether you want a corner to gossip and drink or be in the middle of the action. We came on a DJ night and ended dancing the night away by the booth. The staff is so warm, gave us so many recommendations as to where to go next. Lero Lero is full of life and one of the highlights of my recent trip to Lisboa.  You’ll see me on this street corner again one day and someone better save me a slice and a glass of wine. || Lero Lero is the epitome of a good bar/ restaurant. The staff is warm, the music had my friends and I shazaming every five minutes, the selection of wine was impeccable! And the pizza? Unreal. The team is so knowledgeable and eager to speak about the product. Love going to places where the passion and love is evident, I’m coming back to Lisbon just to come here again :-) || Incredible place ! It's a must if you are into wine ! The waitress was so nice and giving us nice advices for good wine ! The pizzas were also amazing, was worth every single penny ! Shoutout to the nice jazzy decoration too ! || One of my favourite places in Lisbon! Delicious pizza (fav one: Santa Marina). Excellent hospitality and service by lovely staff, especially Felipe who not only is a highly qualified professional when it comes to wine but also a caring host, a sweet person who welcomes everyone warmly. The place is beautiful, cosy and thoughtfully decorated. The music is always on point, curated with care and never too loud. Recommended to every lover of good (natural) wine, pizza, music and beautiful things. || Best Pizza in the city, bar none. Place is beautiful, bohemian chic. Lovely warm, low lighting, such a nice vibe. The only thing curated better than the playlist is the wine list. Lots of super intersting references.
