Whether you’re after a peaceful retreat, a picturesque spot for photos, or simply want to enjoy sweeping views of Lisbon, this hidden gem is definitely worth a visit. || Somehow hidden from turistic path, a small part of the parc is dedicated to famous singer. || Designed by Gonçalo Ribeiro Telles and opened in 1996, the garden was named in 2000 in tribute to Amália Rodrigues, Portugal’s legendary fado singer. The garden features a variety of trees and plants, with quiet walking paths and benches that make it ideal for rest, reflection, or a peaceful stroll. || Lovely setting, but the garden is boring and very disappointing. Fans of Amalia Rodrigues must be very disappointed. Like the rest of the area, very poorly maintained and pedestrian access is dreadful. A missed opportunity, big time. || Great views and perfect location to see sunset over Lisbon with some live music in the background || Park with a great view of central Lisbon 💚 The shade of the trees makes for a great place to sit down and relax a bit. The sun beats down quite mercilessly at around midday. The many benches are a welcome addition for weary travelers. || What a beautiful park. With a nice a cosy bar to hang out and have a drink while enjoying the fresh atmosphere. || This little garden looked like part of the Parque Eduardo VII. The statue at the entrance was interesting. || Good place to relax and meditation... Also your dog will be more than happy to play into the little lake... A coffee on the side also will be great || Amazing views, beautiful gardens, and a perfect place to read a book. || Not to much illumination by night but it’s a cute place || Everywhere I go in the world I always look for a sculptor from the maestro Botero 🫀🫶.  So glad I saw that they have a piece of his in Lisboa.  🇨🇴🇨🇴🫶🫶 … || I love it. You can find fresh corners to cool off in summer while enjoying a green calm environment. A nice pond with fish, turtles and beautiful lilies. Visit it if you are in the area. || Beautiful green space and a lovely photo opportunity || Chilled park that catches the sun perfectly and usually there is a bit of a breeze and if that's not the case you may find some shade from the nearby trees. Close proximity to cafe for some drinks or a nearby lidl that also sells cold drinks. Sunset can be pretty incredible from this place as well if you're lucky || This was very pretty. Worth seeing if you're in the area. My family, though, was under the mistaken impression that this was a fountain that young children could frolic in. To be clear, once we realized it wasn't, we made another plan. People seemed to be letting their dogs run in. So there's that.  Nearby ice cream stand only takes cash. || A great place to stop for a drink, a bite or both. The round, shallow pool is perfect for dogs to play in. || Beautiful clean park. Really loved it. People were jogging, exercising, walking. Very beautiful.

The esplanade at Linha de Água in Jardim Amália Rodrigues has a fantastic location. However, the advantages end there. Unfortunately, the furniture is some of the most uncomfortable and least ergonomic imaginable, from chairs made with iron bars to metal grid backrests placed at a height that hurts anyone trying to lean against them. To make matters worse, some of the furniture is fixed to the floor with screws, not allowing any adjustment according to the height or needs of the users. I won't even comment on the aesthetics of the thing. There is another unpleasant surprise. Orders must be placed by cell phone, but the app created for this works very poorly. When customers try to order at the counter, employees use a tablet and also have difficulty registering orders correctly, which causes confusion, errors and a constant accumulation of people who cannot order what they want. The waiting times (over half an hour for a cake and two coffees) are unbelievable. In addition to all this, the service is the worst. The service is entirely provided by persons whose lack of knowledge of product terminology and designations is evident, making the service slow, confusing, and ineffective. They handle the food with their bare hands, without gloves or tongs; and although there are 8 or 9 people behind the counter, the inefficiency and lack of professionalism of the service is shocking. Furthermore, they respond arrogantly and rudely to customers who try to find out what is happening with their orders that are not arriving or that arrive incorrectly. In addition, the area has many tourists, but the employees don't speak a word of English. Who runs this business in this way? And in such a prime area of ​​the city… || Went there yesterday.  The coffee was good although the chocolate cake was exceptional. My friend wanted me to taste their apple pie, therefore got one.  It was fine. After the chocolate cake, nothing could beat its taste. || This is my second visit to this café, and the quality of its desserts remains consistent, whether in the middle of summer before dinner or in the early morning of autumn. It's a very pleasant place to sit and enjoy something different each time, thanks to its extensive menu. The view of the park is an excellent option for relaxing in the middle of the city. Pets can sit at the outdoor tables, and there are lounge chairs for added comfort. || I really wanted to like this place, but unfortunately, it just didn’t deliver. From the start, the setup was confusing—it’s self-service, which I wasn’t expecting, and honestly, it didn’t feel like it added any value to the experience. If anything, it made things more chaotic. The staff seemed overwhelmed and disorganized. We were rushed through the line, given barely any time to make decisions, and somehow ended up being charged for items we didn’t even order.  The food itself was underwhelming at best. For the price we paid, I was expecting something at least decent, but everything felt bland and thrown together. Nothing stood out, and it definitely wasn’t worth what they were charging.  The only semi-redeeming quality was the atmosphere—it was clean and had a nice vibe, but nothing beyond average. It wasn’t enough to make up for the overall experience. Between the confusion, the mediocre food, and the feeling of being overcharged, I can confidently say I wouldn’t return or recommend it. || Update: i came another time. The service was also very bad. Staff were rude & not friendly at all.  Old review: Very nice spot. The mood is super nice but the food was ok. Highly recommended to chill and enjoy your time. || Charming café by the pond — peaceful and welcoming  We visited Linha d’Água while exploring the park and really enjoyed our time here. It’s located right next to a large circular pond with fountains, offering a tranquil and scenic spot to relax.  The space is open and airy, with a clean, minimalist vibe—not many trees, but still a great atmosphere for sitting outdoors. The food was tasty, and the staff were genuinely kind and attentive. || I happen to stumble upon this ‘very laid-back’ restaurant that's shaped like a waxing crescent with a waterfront terrace that’s just gorgeous. The paperless menu option is 👌🏾. It’s QR code based, very straightforward and requires a touch of patience. I'm sure, peak spring and summer it's just gorgeous. Go have a coffee, read a book, update your itinerary or just unwind. Plus it's pet-friendly. || Terrific lighter fare, very chill atmosphere on a small pond like structure.  Inexpensive || We were walking in the park here and just saw this lovely place. It looked really nice and wasn't busy that we decided to try. I had mushroom quiche with fresh salad and roasted vegetables + fresh fruit pot. And of course a glass of sangria to enjoy. Everything was lovely. The atmosphere is 5*. Loved the little pond and the outside seating area. If you walk around you can see turtles, frogs as well, not to mention the pretty water lilies. || Its a great place with great atmosphere its a great place to relax drink coffee and converse.  Its especially nice for on sunny days with the nice artificial pond infront.  Staff was okay not rude but not too friendly either, i havent tried the food but the coffee is good.  What really disappointed me is the no study/work rule because it looks like a great place to focus on working, and apparently this only applies if you are using a laptop for some reason notebooks, tablets, books are okay. I don’t really understand why this rule exists I know they don’t want people occupying tables for long but still I hope they reconsider this.

Eduardo VII Park is one of the most beautiful and relaxing green spaces in Lisbon. The park offers stunning panoramic views over the city and the Tagus River, making it a perfect spot for photos, walks, or simply enjoying the scenery. The wide paths are ideal for walking or jogging, and the well-maintained gardens add a peaceful atmosphere away from the busy city streets. One of the highlights is the impressive geometric garden design and the viewpoint at the top of the park, which provides a breathtaking perspective of Lisbon. The park is also very spacious, so it never feels overcrowded, even during busy hours. There are benches throughout the area, perfect for resting and enjoying the surroundings. Eduardo VII Park is great for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. It’s close to the city center and easy to access, making it a must-visit for anyone exploring Lisbon. Whether you’re looking for a quiet place to relax, take a walk, or admire the city from above, this park is definitely worth a visit. || We were in Lisbon for several days while waiting to start a cruise with NCL.  We stopped at the north end of this magnificent park and walk all the way to the southern end.  Lots of great views and spots for wonderful pics.  Several monuments along the way. || Parque Eduardo VII is a beautiful park with stunning views of the city and the river. It's beautifully maintained, with plenty of greenery and spacious walkways. It's a great place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city, take beautiful photos, and simply enjoy the atmosphere. A must-see if you're in Lisbon. || It's quite an amazing space. Whether it's chilling, or events, or testing your photographic prowess, it fits the bill. There are usually tourists and residents generally around, and it's more lively during celebrations like Christmas. || It's a very beautiful and large park, perfect for a peaceful walk surrounded by nature. The view from the top of the park is spectacular. Depending on the time of year, there may be more or fewer tourists. On a sunny day with good weather, it's well worth a visit. || A great view of Lisbon from here, you can see the whole layout and scale looking down towards the river. Relaxed and friendly atmosphere as you view the scenery and monuments. You also get an excellent view of the planes coming into Lisbon. || A beautiful public park in Lisbon, Portugal with great views over the city. The top is great for photos. Good for a walk, sit and have lunch or a drink, or have your dog play around. || Wonderful Christmas Atmosphere! We visited Parque Eduardo VII during the Christmas season, and it was a fantastic experience. The Christmas market (Wonderland Lisboa) created such a pleasant and fun atmosphere. It’s a great spot, especially for young people and families, with plenty of amusement park rides, games, and festive food stalls. The park itself is beautiful, and the view from the top is breathtaking. Highly recommended if you are in Lisbon during the holidays! || Parque Eduardo VII is one of the best spots in Lisbon to enjoy a peaceful walk and take in a great view of the city. From the top of the park, you can see all the way down to the river and the Praça Marquês de Pombal. It’s a lovely place to relax, especially at sunset. The park is also very close to El Corte Inglés, so it’s easy to combine a visit with some shopping or a coffee break nearby. || What a great parque / jardim in central Lisbon. Plenty of spaces to walk and sit with many great restaurants, cafes , and quiosques nearby to enjoy the warm Lisbon sun

place_name: Retro Wine Lounge - Wine Bar & Tasting Room

reviews_content: really cool spot! great for people watching. very relaxed vibes with a tonne of wine and other drinks (including non alcoholic drinks) available.  staff were all super lovely and friendly, service was great.  i only got some olives and hummus to eat, both of which were lovely. got some aperol spritz to drink which were also great. || Very great wine selections. If you are preparing WSET, it is a good spot to do the practice! It is very tranquil. The music is great. The staffs are very friendly. I like it. A great wine bar. || Highly recommend- the staff are very kind and happy to take the time to talk to you about their wine and Portugal in general. The vibes are nice, air conditioned inside which is bonus in the summer heat. Wine is also very affordable for the quality that they serve. || Price point will depend on how much you consume. Many varieties available by the glass, as well as dozens of bottles. Great wine bar! || I love the wines there and the staff is so friendly. Always the best recommendations for my wine taste. Get the cheese board, olives and bread with olive oil. So good. I wish they would have a bit more on the menu, but anyway I love this place. || Hi Alina, thank you so much for your kind words ! Since your visit we have added few new suggestions to our food list, including delicious tartines, so don't hesitate to come back to try them ! || Cute and atmospheric wine bar with a great selection of Portuguese wines. I really loved the interior and you can sit outside on a terrace.  I would recommend trying a glass of orange.  Friendly staff and great service, totally recommend ✨ || This is a great place for cheese and wine!  They really make you feel welcome even though I knew nothing about wine. They explained the wine types and patiently gave me suggestions based on my preferences.  The waiter was awesome, and the wine and cheese was just as awesome. The goat cheese was AMAZING!  GREAT PLACE! || Really lovely spot to grab and drink and/or take away a bottle. The staff are incredibly knowledgeable about Portuguese wines; I really appreciated how patient they were when examining the different regions and varieties. Would definitely recommend popping by! || Thank you so much Caylin ! We are happy to read that you enjoyed our recommendations :) || happy hour 17-19u: 4,5 for two roses. || Cute little wine bar, great staff and good small plates of food. Beautiful Portuguese wines on the list. || Great nook for a great selection of wine and cheeses. We stopped here before dinner for a little happy hour and the service was fantastic. E are on our honeymoon and we can’t begin to recommended the cheese with the Calabrian chili pickled peppers - WOW! Delightful and very welcoming environment. It’s at a corner and you can view the Lisbon life happening from the window while enjoying wine. Thank you for having us and hope we can make it back! || I was looking a place with Portuguese wine and I found this gem close to the hostel I stayed. Nice environment, great prices, good customer treatment. || Thanks so much for your feedback Ingrid ! || Really nice neighborhood wine bar! Great selection of wines, ambiance and friendly service! Highly recommended! || Thank you Marco for your nice words ! Cheers ! || Wonderful ambience! Lots of options for wine and the team behind the bar always has incredible suggestions. Outdoor seating at night is so much fun. || Such a cozy and loving vibe with truly heartwarming service! The food was fresh and delicious, the wine was excellent🥂and we had a wonderful evening here🍷 Would definitely come back again! || A fun space and a fun selection of wine - all from Portugal which is great. The service was nice but maybe a little cold. And it was weirdly empty when we went, I’m sure some more people would’ve added to the atmosphere || Hi Lucas, thanks for your review ! You're welcome back any time ! || My favorite wine bar in Lisbon. Always nice and helpful in the bar, guiding you towards the wine you like. It’s not a problem to try a few different until you find the right one. You feel very welcome and the wines they have are really good and “different”. Also it’s not expensive - like 4-7€/glass || Very cozy, a wine bar that is more "trendy" than classic and I think it is nice that Anjos have such diversity. Good wine, OK prices, beautiful inside! || Lovely wine bar with a great selection of wines. They also serve some tapas to go along with drinks. The service was very nice and knowledgeable about wine. || I think they only sell portuguese wines and oh my aren't they fabulous :)) The staff is super friendly and funny!

This downtown cosy wine bar offers a fusion petisco menu with an extensive wine offer at fair prices with informal service in a minimalistic ambiance.  We were 3 for dinner who chose the couvert, fresh goat cheese, escabeche de coelho, a delicious lascas de bacalhau, the ox tail with salad, all with waters, a few glasses of wine and a coffee for €40/pax.  IT is a favourite ✨💫 || Truly the best wine bar in Lisbon ♥️ We had the loveliest time — the staff and the owner were so welcoming, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. They were incredibly helpful in helping us choose a wine, and the Dois Carvalhos Reserva was absolutely excellent. A bottle of that, paired with goat cheese and sourdough, made our evening truly wonderful. Highly recommend! || The best way to spend a last afternoon with friends Seriously. It’s a wine bar, and they’ve got great munchies. And, even more importantly, they’ll happily spend all the time in the world with you figuring out what you want to drink - anything from pairings to “just a glass of wine” Seriously, just an awesome place! || We had an amazing night at Nova. After a long day walking the hills of Lisbon their concept "you choose the food and we choose the wine" is a perfect way to relax. Every bite, paired with a perfect wine ... and a beautiful reflection of Portuguese grapes. The bread and olive oil was so good I could drink a glass of the olive oil. The oysters, fresh and paired perfectly with a white wine. Fish cakes were tasty. Above all, the friendly and fun service the staff provided was outstanding.  Do go see this quaint lil wine bar in Lisbon! || I never give full 5 stars, but I had to make an exception. The experience starts from your first step inside, the place is built perfectly. The staff is more skilled in wine then most sommelier I've met even in michlen restaurants. The food is not only great but with precision. Everything about the place is precise and any little detail in the place was given sophisticated thought. If you like wine, and are in Lisbon, you must pass through. || Yonara is great! She helped us so much!! I loved the food, the atmosphere, the wine! It was a superb experience. Save some room and taste the drunk pear for a dessert || Wow, Pedro thank you! We stumbled across this gem and I’m so glad we did! The food and wine were incredible - even my picky eater parents agreed. I’ve been a little scared to try sardines but tried it here and it was SO delightful. Each of the food/wine pairing went so well with each other and Pedro gave us explanations to put it all into context. Highly highly recommend!! || Wow, this wine bar and restaurant is just absolutely incredible. Our first night in Lisbon, we went here after dinner and were blown away by how intimate and personally curated the experience was. João helped us pick a couple dishes and suggested wines to pair each with. He explained why each wine would pair well, along with an explanation of where in Portugal each wine came from.  Our experience was so good that we came back for our last night in Lisbon for a full dinner, along with wine pairing. Our second visit was even better than the first, with both the hostess and João remembering us and taking incredible care of us.  Some Google ratings in Lisbon seem artificially inflated, but Nova Wine Bar has absolutely earned its 4.9 stars as of September 2025. || I came to Lisbon in search of a true culinary experience, and this was easily one of the best meals of the entire trip. The owner, Pedro, personally welcomed me as soon as I sat down, which immediately set the tone for the evening. I told him I was open to anything, and he curated a six-tapas tasting, each thoughtfully paired with a different wine.  Every pairing was beautifully balanced and clearly intentional, elevating each dish without overpowering it. The progression felt effortless, refined, and deeply satisfying from start to finish. If you are looking for an exceptional, memorable culinary experience in Lisbon, go to Nova. You will not be disappointed. || Loved this spot! We tried two cheeses and the ham — all perfectly curated — and Pedro gave us great wine pairing tips. Every choice was spot on for the four of us. Cozy, elegant and delicious! || Wow. What a great finding in Lisboa ! We stepped in for a little break to have a glass of wine. Being a wine enthusiast, we started discussing with Pedro, the owner, who’s a passionate wine lover. He took the time to explain to us the different portugese “terroirs”. He suggested we come back the next day for a wine & tapas pairing, and we did !!! We discovered wines from different regions, and Pedro stayed with us to chat about the tapas (all of which are his own unique creations) and his excellent wine pairings that were perfectly matched. Note: this was his day off but he came and stayed with us because he had suggested we come back the next day ! In summary: he enhanced our lisbon experience. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PLACE Thank you Pedro ❤️ || What a gem!  So glad we came in. Pedro made our visit along with his lovely staff. Our first time in Portugal, we love wine but don’t know much about it so we let Pedro lead the way.  We had such a blast joking with him and learning from him.  The food was fantastic as was the wine. Also our first time trying Port and we fell in love. I wish we would’ve have more time to come back but if we ever make it back to Lisbon, this will be our first stop!! || This place is really SO special. If you're in Lisbon, this is an excellent choice for dinner - especially if you want to try lots of different foods! We ordered 7 dishes to share, and each was paired with a glass of wine. Every single dish was beautifully plated and tasted phenomenal, we were awed. The wine pairings were always spot-on. It's such an intimate setting,  you feel at home and the servers make you feel like family. Food we loved: sourdough, octopus, blood sausage, sardines, fried cod, stewed rabbit salad, drunk pears for dessert || This establishment deserves 10 stars and Pedro deserves 11. Kind of a place where you walk in, without speaking any Portuguese, but if you speak wine language, you immediately feel at home. Kind of a place you leave knowing you will return tomorrow. And we will (return tomorrow) to try the food and some more amazing wine. Just don’t ask for the bottle in the picture. That one (and all that’s left of it) is mine. || What a find!!! This fabulous wine bar was just down the road from our hotel. We had to resist the temptation to go every evening to sample delicious Portuguese wines. The tapas of sardines and the sheep cheese were so tasty. It was a warm and inviting place to spend a couple of hours or even more. || What a gem! My wife and I absolutely loved this place. The food is great. The wine is great. The staff and Pedro are even better. They make you feel like family. We had the creamy sheep cheese, black pig belly (amazing), Iberico ham and the drunk pear (so good!) each with a wine recommended by our awesome wait staff. Highly recommend this amazing wine bar in Lisbon!!! || All round excellent experience. Delicious food and host paired half glasses of Portuguese wine to each course! Highly recommend || The vine was kind of like a speakeasy, even though it isn't one. The wine was good and my server was very knowledgeable. || We went here after recommended by a friend. We had a fabulous time. We enjoyed an ash covered goat cheese, sausage and an AMAZING chocolate desert! Pedro made excellent wine suggestions to go along the food and we will come back next time we are in town. Highly suggest everyone stop in for food and wine you won’t regret it. || One of the best things we did in Lisbon. We wanted to try some Portuguese wines and Pedro gave guided my wife and I through whites, reds and port. Fantastic experience!

Uva Livre is a very nice and friendly wine bar and cellar in the heart of Lisbon, based on my visit on November 1st, 2025. The staff are genuinely helpful and will guide you in choosing the best Portuguese wine to match your taste. If you’re lucky enough to get a seat by the window, the experience becomes even better; watching people pass by and admiring the buildings across the street under the evening lights is simply beautiful. Highly recommended to all. || On reading the hundreds of 5* reviews we thought we had to try this wine bar and I’m very glad we did. The staff were friendly, attentive, relaxed and knowledgeable. We felt at ease and took time to pick out some great wines for us, allowing us to try two or three before deciding. It was an unpretentious and welcoming atmosphere. The charcuterie board was great to have on the side, and they had lots of choices including some bigger dishes by the looks of it, and everything was very reasonably priced. I think we had 7 glasses of wine plus the food for €90. A big thank you to the team for helping us try new wines and broaden our knowledge, would very much recommend even if you’re not quite sure about what you like or how to describe wines, they will find something for you! || Dear Amber, Your review couldn't make us happier! Our first 5-star ratings were an encouragement. Now they compel us even more, as we fear not meeting expectations. We realize that we must offer you more than a good selection of wines at reasonable prices. It's also the quality of our service, what we reveal about ourselves, that ensures our customers' satisfaction. Our team is certainly what we can be most proud of. There are 5 nationalities and as many different personalities, but all driven by the desire to please you. Thank you again, and we hope to see you again. Best regards, The team. || 5-stars all around. This place was incredible. We had been looking for a wine bar that does tastings that allowed flexibility in what we were trying (specifically local Portuguese wines) but also wasn't 85euro a person off the bat. This place was perfect -- the staff were engaging and helpful; they took us through half-glasses (though you could get a full pour of anything) of sparkling, white, chilled red etc. And nothing was pre-set, so it was based off exactly what we were feeling in the moment.  The food was also an incredible accompaniment to the wines, especially as we really stayed in local wines (what grows together, goes together). Have the chouriço, it's outrageous.  If you're not sure which wine bar to check out, this is a slamdunk. || Friends and I came here to pass the time and it was one of the highlights for our trip to Lisbon. We were immediately greeted and seated. We sat in the back with the couches and we actually had the area to ourselves during the time we were there. We were asked our preference for wine and were given samples so we could make informed choices. The atmosphere was calm and relaxed. The music playlist was perfect - not noisy and good melodies for the mood. I plan to come here whenever I’m in Lisbon. Strongly recommend this place to anyone interested in sipping and learning about wine and socializing. || Five stars are not enough. I had the best time at Uva Livre - I had great wine, great food, and made new friends. Julian has “rescued” a number of interesting bottles from an abandoned cellar here in town, and offers them at a very attractive price. There is something indescribably fun about ordering an ancient and unknown bottle. You may get a gem, or a dud. Julian is an absolute gentleman, and poor the bad ones down the drain at no cost to you. Or so I’m told, because I’ve never come across a bad bottle here. I had a lovely 1992 DAO, and I made new friends as I shared a taste with other patrons. I just can’t recommend this highly enough. I’ve made a dozen or so trips to Lisbon, and this is one of my favorite places. It works especially well as a warm up for your trip to Cafe Sao Bento right around the corner. || A wonderful wine bar. Great wines, knowledgeable and friendly staff. Delicious charcuterie and oysters. Highly recommended. || What a wonderful end to our Lisbon visit! Excellent service, high quality wines and delicious food. Wish we had more time here to explore the rest of the menu and offering. Thanks Justin! || It’s a nice place, we had a very nice bottle of wine accompanied with some cheese and meats. Unfortunately it was very hot inside, would be much better with an AC instead of a fan. We got a nice service from one person, the others were mostly confused. Would be nice with some more information about the bottle we bought, but the place is absolutely worth a visit! || Such a wonderful wine bar. Justin and the team are extremely knowledgeable  and do such a fabulous job of helping you find a great glass of wine to drink. They also do a really good job of educating you on the wines you are drinking or considering. This is a medium sized, airy and very comfortable wine bar. It is great place to come solo, or in small or fairly large groups. It is also located in a great part of Lisbon with lots of good restaurants nearby. So you can come in here before or after dinner. If you like wine, check Uva Livre out, you won’t be disappointed. || We had a wonderful experience at Uva Livre. Justin spent 10 minutes finding the perfect wine for us, letting us sample several bottles and explaining the regions the wine was from and the different unique features of each. He is incredibly friendly and he has curated a very warm atmosphere. The charcuterie board was delicious as well. 10/10 recommend. || I was a little sceptical when making a reservation for UVA Libra because it’s very rare to find a restaurant with this many reviews all giving 5 stars. Having now visited I can confirm that this restaurant does exactly what you expect, great wine and sharing boards. The sharing board options have great vegetarian and meat versions. As mentioned the wine selection is great with, as you would expect, focus on Portuguese wine. Well worth a visit || Dear Richard, Your review couldn't have pleased us more. We were so proud at our opening to have earned the respect of our customers. Now, more than 250 reviews later, we still worry about disappointing our guests and not meeting their expectations. That's why your review means so much to us, especially coming from a seasoned Local Guide. It is with immense gratitude that we thank you for your visit.  We hope to see you again. || A convivial wine bar to sit, relax and enjoy a wide range of wines. They also make one of the best Bloody Mary’s on Sundays! The Sommelier (Justin) knows his stuff and talks you through a range of wines to suit your palette and your wallet. The food choices are chosen to match for nibbling on while sipping your wine. A great place to visit in Lisbon to while away a few hours. Great friendly knowledgeable staff, great wines and delicious nibbles. We went back twice it was so much fun. || Dear Paul, You perfectly summed up our ambition: to entertain you with sincerity and passion. We love our work so much that we sometimes forget it is work. We choose all our wines and products with exacting standards. Taste is our only guide.  Thank you for your visit. || All the staff are super kind! Amanda, Foyez and Euclides were amazing ✨ The wine options were SO GOOD and the food… You must try this restaurant 💖 || ABSOLUTELY the best wine bar we’ve been to! The owner was so hospitable and it felt like we were invited to his home. Everything we tried was delicious and we highly recommend going here! We will be back for sure! || Justin, the sommelier/gm was absolutely amazing! He recommended wines based on each of our personal tastes and had a selection of traditional and natural wines to choose from. We were there from 22:00 until close, and the service was still top notch! || Thank you so much for your review. Our Justin is tireless, driven by his passion for wine!  We hope to see you again soon.  See you soon. || I was excited to try this wine bar after reading so many great reviews and it did not disappoint. Justin was so knowledgeable about the wines - we didn’t even use the menu. We shared what we liked and he had amazing recommendations and great information to go along with it to understand more about the wine you’re drinking.  The cheese and snacks we ordered were also delicious. This is a must visit for anyone - those who are avid wine lovers or those who just enjoy the occasional glass. || Dear Jackie, If you only knew how delighted we are by your review. Our fear is that we won't live up to the expectations created by this unanimity! We put so much energy and heart into our daily work at Uva Livre that our disappointment would be greater than yours. We are relieved and proud that Uva Livre has met your expectations. Our selection of wines and products is uncompromising. We source directly from producers to guarantee the best quality/price ratio for our customers. The photo features two Portuguese cheese producers: Monte da Vinha for sheep's milk and Ortodoxo for goat's and cow's milk cheeses. We work so closely with the latter that we are helping them finance the acquisition of Jersey cows, one of which will bear the (sweet) name "Uva Livre"! We have a wonderful job, don't we? :) We hope to see you again. See you soon || Fantastic experience! Staff is so welcoming and helps guide you to wines you prefer and I was I able to try things I would not have otherwise chosen for myself. Cheese board and snacks were enough for us to make a hearty meal from. Amazing atmosphere and overall wonderful spot to spend the evening! || Dear Catherine, The entire team thanks you for your appreciation. It encourages us to continue our efforts to satisfy you. See you soon! || Had a fantastic experience here, thanks to Justin and his team. Justin offers plenty of suggestions (and stories) as you figure out which wine you're feeling. A lot of options for cheese and charcuterie boards too to enjoy with the wine. || Dear Whitney, Thank you so much for your feedback. We have over 200 wines to choose from, and the Uva Livre team and sommelier are here to help you find the perfect wine to suit your taste and leave you with a wonderful memory of our winery! See you soon! || Stopped in for a quick drink and snack and ended up staying for an amazing tapas style meal and another bottle of wine. Clement and Justin(corrigible 😎) made the experience memorable with wine and App suggestions!  Couldn’t recommend a better place to stop. Also atmosphere was excellent and extremely clean and organized. || Thank you very much for your appreciation. It was a great pleasure serving you. Your compliments go out to the entire team, because where would we be without them? We hope to see you again when you return to Lisbon. See you soon. || Great wine selections, stupidly great. Our sommelier listened to what we were looking to taste and accommodated us perfectly. Coupled with matched side dishes, we didn’t want to leave, but we had early flights. If you love your wine and great service in a relaxed atmosphere - go here! || Dear Michael, It's important for Local Guides to share their opinions of Uva Livre; it lends credibility to everything we believe in: sharing, a taste for good things, and the smiles we get from the experience! Thank you.

place_name: Club des Châteaux - WINE BAR - SALDANHA

reviews_content: A wine bar literally the size of my bedroom! The guys behind the bar are very knowledgeable and helpful, so a good glass or two or wine is guaranteed.  This is the first stop on my trip to Lisbon and I'm very happy indeed. || As travelers in Lisbon and natural wine lovers, we found this wine bar exceptional. We like the concept of no wine menu, just talk with the very kind, welcoming, calm, and knowledgeable sommeliers about your wine preferences, and they will let you try different wines until you find what you are searching for. I described the sommelier as “calm” because I mistakenly knocked the bottles of wine, which spilled about a glass on the floor, but he was genuinely calm and friendly. Their wine choices are great, and we were super blessed with what we tried. There are few food choices, but it's great for an after-dinner visit. || I loved this wine bar so much! It is vibrant, full of good wine choices, there is a park next to it where you can sit and enjoy your drink. Price per glass ranges from €6 to €20. The staff is cool, they let you sample wines before ordering and they also give you good recommendations. You can take tour glass to the park, but you need to leave a deposit. || Black Sheep Lisboa is a gem — an intimate, stylish wine bar with an outstanding selection and truly knowledgeable sommelier (also very handsome) bartenders. The staff pair wines with just the right notes and stories, making each pour feel curated. Cozy atmosphere, great small plates that complement the wines, and excellent recommendations whether you prefer natural, classic or adventurous bottles. A must-visit for anyone who loves wine and thoughtful service. Highly recommended. || Lots of wonderful memories at my favorite wine bar in Lisboa over the years. Yes the wine is always amazing, but the people even more so. Warm hearts always welcome you at Black Sheep—what makes it special. Obrigada || Amazing place I just discovered with a friend. We went to the side of the bar and were welcomed warmly. The bartender has a real knowledge about wine, switched between English and Portuguese with the two of us without any issue and has even told us more about the history of the bar and the owner.  Can’t remember the name of the bartender, but can’t wait to come back for moments like this || Black sheep is a gem. I loved that when I asked if "we could get weirder" with wine recommendations, we were brought a series of incredibly fun and funky wines. Black sheep delivers on everything -  local art, great wine recommendations, and unbeatable vibes. || What a shame. I moved to Lisbon the year this place opened, and I’ve watched it lose the soul it once had.  Tonight we went to Black Sheep for a friend’s celebration - 3 glasses, a few bottles, nothing complicated. When my friend left early, she returned her glass to the bar and even texted me to say so. Later, the staff insisted one glass was “missing” and refused to listen or consider anything we explained. We were charged for a glass we had already returned.  And here’s the thing: I understand the deposit system and why they use it. But when the system fails, the customer pays - even when the bar will inevitably find the glass later. That’s not just rigid, it’s getting money for something that wasn’t actually lost.  It wasn’t about the amount. It was the attitude: zero trust, zero curiosity, zero willingness to engage. Just a robotic “no.” It feels like customer care has been replaced by profit-first thinking.  If you want natural wine in the neighborhood, go to Magnolia or bring your own bottle to Praça das Flores. Black Sheep used to feel alive. Now it feels indifferent - guided more by turnover than by hospitality. || I cant give less than five stars. I went for the first time and got impressed by the service. They really know what they are talking about! They have a large variety of wines. Black sheep is usually crowded and almost impossible to have a seat on weekends. The tip here is to get there earlier so you can be able to have a full tasting experience while listen to the amazing stories of each bottle of wine you try! || Wonderful tiny wine bar serving “whatever we have open at the minute!” They let you taste a ton of wines to find one you love, and staff are super nice & knowledgeable. It can get packed so visit on a week day or just be patient. Totally worth it— the wine and vibes are amazing. || This is one of those charming spots in a city that will instantaneously make you feel like a local. The owner are so kind and knowledgeable about wines. The place is great to sit and have a glass of wine and even talk to people around you. The environment is super social and you never know who you’re gonna meet. Love this place. Seriously a hidden gem of Lisbon. Whether it’s there wide range of great low intervention wines or just their friendly charm you will surely find you’re welcome here. || Tiny natural wine bar with the best staff! Get a wine to have inside on a stool at the bar, or get a reusable takeaway cup from them to sit in the square across the lane! || Great wine bar. Pick up a glass , walk into the garden 🪴 play with a few dogs 🐕. What more can you want! Oh they charge a deposit for the wine glasses which I think was odd considering it’s plastic glasses. || Amazing experience! Staff is super friendly, professional and knowledgeable about wines (and they can carry 6 bottles in their hands at once!). Cozy ambiance and reasonable prices. No menu as they change assortment all the time and recommend you personally which wines you could like. || One o Lisbon's best Wine Bars... fantastic hosts and lots of wine and champagne... great new place, modern and just right next door to the old classic Black Sheep... Great wines, great champagne, great crew and great multicultural atmosphere... Must not miss! Cheers 🥂🍷🍾🥳 || This review is long overdue! One of my favorite places in Lisbon, a wine bar that feels like home. The staff is amazing, knowledgeable and the nicest people. You can even go by yourself and I’m sure you’ll make a new friend! Don’t go expecting a wine list, stay open to their suggestions, let them know your likes and dislikes and I’m sure you’ll be happy! || Don’t come in looking for a menu! Come in looking for a wine journey and experience! We had such a great time here with the knowledgeable staff who asked preferences and then blew our minds with some excellent wine choices and service!  Love those cheeky washrooms as well. Lol. || Adorable little wine bar. The owners are incredibly knowledgeable in local Portuguese wines, which you will most likely miss if you don't visit this amazing wine bar. Would highly recommend making a stop before or after your dinner at least once, as we went twice! We also purchased a bottle of our favourite sparkling wine we've ever had.  Drink by the glass, enjoy a tasting curated by the Sommelier or take home a bottle of your favourite. Which ever choose you won't be disappointed! || Thank you for your lovely review! We're glad you had a good time in Lisbon. See you next time! || I can’t say enough good things about this wine bar. They serve mostly natural wine and will find you something you like, every time.  I didn’t think I liked natural wines, but I was proven wrong on my first visit. Let’s just say, since then, I’ve been back almost every night.  The people who work here are some of the best people I’ve met. They’ve all become very close friends with me, just like they do with most. They know so much about wine and really care to make sure you drink wine that you like.  If you’re in Lisbon, stop by. It’s worth it and I promise you won’t be disappointed. || Wonderful place . You know is packed for a good reason . This is the place to go to have awesome wines . Everyone working here is amazing and they have done an amazing job making this place so beautiful. I had a great time tried delicious wines and just overall the best wine bar I have seen .

Almost 5 years in Lisbon and I didn't know this place. What a shame!  I liked the vibe, it's like going to TimeOut Market but more private, and more … || Had a lovely evening trying all different kinds of wine with some great recommendations from our waitress. All the wines we had were great and very fun to try a selection! The food was also great, the croquettes and the veal cheeks … || This restaurant is very pretty & interesting inside and it’s fun to try wines by the glass. I was however disappointed by the food. The tuna & plantain appetizer was much too sweet and over dressed. The octopus w green pea entree was unique … || We’d originally planned to do a wine tasting here but didn’t get round to booking this in advance. The tuna tartar with toasted plantain was outstanding. So too the carpaccio of octopus. … || Got the chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream, paired with a port wine. The chocolate cake was delicious, albeit probably 100 000 calories. Paired with a really good vanilla ice cream, with some dalt and crumbs, it did not dissapoint! The port was a really good choice by the waiter. All in all good experience! || Excellent wine bar that we accidentally stumbled in. And it was totally a pleasant surprise. The Green wine is delicious. They do have some snack, but not a huge selection. But you are here for the wine, not the food. || Stumbled upon this place, headed to our dinner reservations and decided to stop in for a glass of wine.  Beautiful place with super helpful servers.  We grabbed a couple seats at the bar for a glass of wine.  Great spot to watch the … || We came here for our last dinner in Portugal and loved it! The food was good but the highlight was the wine and the service. Our waitress was so knowledgeable and let us try different wines while explaining the different regions in Portugal. I would recommend for wine lovers looking for a fun vibe || Good value for money with delicious tapas in Lisbon.  We stumbled upon this place on google search and booked ahead online … || Decent large wine bar. Food is ok, but not fine.  Wine selection is distributor driven, not curated.  No sommelier, or at least no obvious one. Beer hall vibe.  Great for after work or a quick drink. || By the Wine quickly became my favorite wine bar in Lisbon — and not just because of the iconic wine bottle ceiling. The food is great, the wine list by the glass is solid, but what truly sets this … || Absolutely lovely place to taste very good portuguesw wine!! Also the staff was so friendly and the different tapas where a fusion between spanish, portuguese and latin american dishes! The portuguese cheese absolut must at the end together with the lime cake || Great food and great experience. The octopus was incredible. The wine was delicious. It’s a great place to go to for a great dinner! || We went on a walk till I found the perfect place to eat! We were lucky enough to get 4 bar seats as we had no reservation and it was extremely busy!! Atmosphere popping and so much fun. The decor was beautiful and the food and the … || We discovered this restaurant in the afternoon and asked to book a table. Unfortunately, it was already fully booked but were given the option to sit in the bar if we came back in the evening which we did and were welcomed immediately the … || We were in Lisboa for 2 nights, and I feel downright lucky to have found this bar. The owner has crafted an experience, from the ambiance of the bar and decor of the gorgeous dining area, to the wine selection. He has found a wine to fit … || We stopped by By The Wine without a reservation and were pleasantly surprised to be seated right away at the bar. The bartender was super friendly and gave us great wine recommendations, each glass hit the spot. We paired them with a cheese … || Great vibes for dinner. They have big table for big groups in the back hall. Food was good, some dishes like the octopus was excellent.

Amazing food, very good prices, good services. I had a Francisinha, a traditional Portuguese dish that I had been looking in Lisbon for a while, since it's originally from Porto, so I found this amazing location where I ate the perfect one. The place is quiet, it has an amazing view and fair prices. || In terms of food - the worst restaurant I’ve been in Portugal. 1. First of all, they had only one red wine by glass and it was extremely low quality. They know it themselves, so they poor it in a bowl instead of glass and also very cooled like white wine, so that you have no chance to feel repugnant aromas and tannins. And they call themselves a wine bar! 2. The lamb was really bad. Super salty, bitter and dry. They obviously put too much vinegar and salt. And this is despite Portuguese usually put less salt in their dishes. 3. They ran out of octopus so they replaced it with cod fish, which was just average. But the garnish was same potatoes as in the previous dish. 4. Their cheese selection was very poor, like from a supermarket. 5. Desert was presented as a traditional Christmas pumpkin pastry. I didn’t feel any pumpkin in it, and I googled - Portuguese don’t put pumpkin in Christmas deserts.  I should admit, service was good. 3 people were asking me regularly if I’m doing ok. || I had a burger and fries which were really good. Nice Sangria. However, the restaurant area to the rear was quiet. A few of the waiters were wearing gilets which was weird. An okay view of the city but not the best. || I honestly don’t get how other people can rate this place badly. It was the best restaurant I’ve been to in Portugal. Truly golden. The clams are an absolute gem. || I went there with a TheFork discount, that made the dinner to be very cheap. Nonetheless, the prices are fair also without. We took a mixed board entry and 3 main meat-based main dishes. They were good but not super flavourful. I loved the atmosphere. || Very good food and cute place. Our waiter Sunny was very nice and helpful in helping us decide what to eat. The owner was also very kind and welcoming too and we felt very comfortable here. Our first taste of Green Wine and it we all liked it very much. The whole experience was one of the best here. || What an amazing culinary experience! The chef is brilliant. The staff is so helpful in making sure your dining experience is outstanding! This is a hidden gem! Make the time and effort to have a wonderful dining experience! Climb the hill below the Castle in Alfama and enjoy the view, the food and the wine - Seis is inside the Solar do Mouros Hotel. || The food was gorgeous and the prices were reasonable. The restaurant is quiet small but has a nice atmosphere, and all staff were friendly and welcoming. Great experience overall. || On our way to visit the Castle of São Jorge, we were lucky to find one of the best places to eat in the area. We had a great experience discovering Seis. The staff was very friendly and helpful. If you don't know what to choose, you can select one of the predefined menus for 2 persons. || Very nice restaurant with great wine and food selection. Everything we ordered was so nice, the tapas were so tasty. Vast wine selection both local and foreign. Very professional staff. Unfortunately we came after sunset, because the view during the day should be amazing.

This is one of the best places I’ve visited. The staff is amazing and accommodating. I booked for two but asked to change for three at the door and they were so friendly and helpful. The place is tiny so I highly recommend booking in advance. The wine selection is spectacular and the staff is very knowledgeable. The food was perfect. I’m not usually a fan of seafood but all the dishes were brilliant! I will definitely make this a must visit on my times in Lisbon! || The Curated list of Portuguese wine was really great. It was a friendly place and suitable for solo visitor. The guys were amazing and accommodative and made great recommendations. Unfortunately I wasn’t able to try the food but am sure are amazing also! Will defo come back again!! || fantastic food! the bread is so fresh and warm. highly recommend the prawns, labneh, and fish cakes! great atmosphere to sit and enjoy a bottle of wine with friends || I came across Antiga Wine Bar one night near Castelo de São Jorge and what a great find! The wine selection was exceptional and the food was delicious. The service was great and very accommodating. Would recommend making reservations as it gets very busy, and for good reason! || Everything we had here was delicious. The goat cheese rolls, ceviche, pork belly, seafood board, clams, scallops, duck confit...and on and on...we almost tried everything and we couldn't decide what was best. Our server gave us the best recommendation on wine and we just had a wonderful experience. We got a reservation because we had 5 people but its reasonable to walk in because their service is so efficient. || Our initial server was amazing and did a fabulous job pairing our first 2 food orders with wine. But then he left, and when we asked the next server about a pairing for our pork belly he said “we don’t have a lot of options” and we said that’s okay what’s the recommendation for the pork belly (since this is a wine bar after all?) he came back and described the bottle as “this is 5 euros a glass” lol  Scallops were absolutely delicious! Chicken was a little bit dry but had a good sauce. Pork belly was cooked well but needed a little bit more flavour or sauce. Overall, a good experience. But latter half felt meh and we didn’t feel encouraged to stay for dessert.  Would’ve given a 5 star if we had the same server til the end of our meal! || Stopped by a glass of wine and ended up returning a few hours later for dinner (the delicious food smells won us over). Great wine and food. Highly recommend the scallops and duck. || Loved it here. It was fully booked a day before, so we booked via this app. And it was a nice decision because food and service were sooo good! Anything from menu is good) || Antiga Wine Bar is one of our favorite places in Lisbon. We've had a fantastic dining experience all 3 times and look forward to visiting Lisbon to go back to this wine bar. We are not familiar with local wines, so Rodolfo helped us on our recent April visit select wines based on our wine profile. He also made wonderful food recommendations. Our favorite was the duck confit, but also loved the seabass ceviche, pork belly with guava & goat cheese rolls with honey.  Small place with great vibes and wonderful service in a charming area of town. Get reservations so you don't miss out. || What a delightful find Antiga Wine Bar turned out to be! We stumbled upon this charming restaurant and were fortunate enough to secure a reservation for that evening. Our experience was so wonderful that we returned just a few nights later, eager to relive the magic. The ambiance of Antiga is small yet incredibly warm and welcoming. It creates an intimate setting that makes every visit feel special. From the moment we walked in, we were enveloped in a cozy atmosphere that set the stage for a memorable dining experience. The waitstaff at Antiga are truly lovely. They are attentive and genuinely happy to make suggestions on both food and wine, all without being pushy. Their knowledge and enthusiasm for the menu added a personal touch that enhanced our experience. While the menu is small, it has been honed to perfection. Each dish we tried was memorable, showcasing well-portioned servings that were beautifully presented. The food was prepared to perfection, with thoughtful balance and pairing that made every bite a delight. If I lived in Lisbon, I would undoubtedly be a regular at Antiga Wine Bar. It’s the kind of place that invites you to relax and savor the moment, making it highly recommended for anyone seeking an intimate and enjoyable restaurant experience. Whether you're a local or just visiting, don’t miss the chance to dine here—you won’t be disappointed! || Everything was perfect. A good selection of wines with reasonable prices, and the menu was an adaptation of the local ingredients with their style. We took the eggplant paste and prawns, both were very tasty. || We stumbled upon Antiga Wine Bar by chance and were pleasantly surprised by both the quality of the appetizers and the wines. We ordered the bolinhos de alheira and goat cheese rolls, along with two glasses of Vinho Verde, expertly recommended by Natália, who provided outstanding service.  The restaurant filled up within minutes, yet she managed to serve everyone efficiently without compromising quality for a second. I highly recommend this place for anyone looking to enjoy great wine and delicious appetizers in Lisbon! || Food is top notch delicious, the wine list is extended, waiters were very friendly and the atmosphere is quiet Good option for a romantic dinner Needs reservation || We came here for wine when we first arrived because we thought it was just a wine bar. We came back on our last day in Lisbon for lunch before our flight. We were glad we did. The food was actually really good. The tomato risotto with octopus was a standout. Goat cheese egg roll was great. We also liked the seafood special. Overall a great wine and food spot. || The food is good and the place is nice. It is quite small but cosy. We got the pork belly, the duck, and the cod. All really nice. The place is crowded, so it is better have a reservation. || Very friendly staff and excellent service. Wine selection was good and the food was tasty! I would recommend this place to anyone. This was our dinner for our first night in Lisbon and it was a great way to start things off. || Fantastic place for a couple glasses of wine and eating. We tried the portuguese fish and chips, the codfish cake and alheira cake and all of them were spactacular, specially the sardines (portugues f&c). Besides the local wine reccomendations were really good. || Very beautiful place, excellent wines and delicious kitchen. Try the food (the clams delicious and the cheesecake also). Highly recommend!!! || The crispy pork belly is delicious. The skin is nice and crispy and the meat park is so tender. || A very cute place near the cathedral. The Ceviche was really great and they have a good selection of local wines, especially if you want to drink by the glass, the selection is really big. Very friendly and helpful staff.

Great place to drink gin and eat some tapas. It is usually full so make a reservation. The waiter Camila is the best! || Thank you for your kind visit. || Great place for drinks and amazing food. Small neighborhood bar that has 90% of its seating outside. The kitchen is amazing - try the Octopus, first class. || The best bar in town, concerning the variety of drinks and food. Good quality food. The manager, owner, tries to select the customers maintaining all the tables reserved. Just ignore it and ask for a table to have drinks and tapas. The tapas are very good and good price. || Excellent bar with tons of gin options. The food is also great. Totally recommended! || I'm going to be super honest: I haven't still eaten but I'm doing this so I'm the thousandth comment. Love the place so far. Place is evidently understaffed.  Edit: it took 40-50 mins to get my order. The oysters were decent. And cheap cocktails<3 || Impeccable! An astonishing selection of gins, good food (tapas), warm and friendly service and clean installations. Fully recommended! The only downside is the amount of people smoking. || When i wanted to pay they charged me for more dishes then i ordered.  I dont know why but i already had the feeling they would do that || Oh Yeah! One lovely Gin-Bar with the finest placing solutions for tiny rooms and a huge amount of not only Gin. In Germany we say 'gemütlich' (cozy). I'll be back! || Drink bar with unique atmosphere. Grilled octopus as a tapas was incredible! Ovos rotos could be better but everything else was amazing || Amazing!!!! One of the best tapas in all of Lisboa. The staff is very friendly and attentive and I can’t stress enough how kind was the woman who worked on the terrace. She even remembered my preferred drink when I came back. Will come back for sure.. || After a late arrival in to Lisbon we desperately needed a drink to wind down. Found this place on Google maps and headed over. Absolutely delicious and would definitely return if we had more time. || Great vibe, efficient service,  a vast selection of gins all served  in a G&T format with tailored garnishes. Interior seems cool too. || Great little gin bar in Lisbon 🍸 Lots of gins to choose from as well as a lovely tapas menu. It's so full of interesting things and quirky things to look at, whilst playing some jazz In  the background. A great little find for an atmospheric evening. || The best place to have a drink in the neighbourhood.  Great selection of gins (it is really hard to choose). The service is very friendly and they are always happy to suggest something to eat. If you want to have dinner, it is better to a reservation. || Very busy bar. One of the spots to enjoy a nice Gin in Lisbon. Difficult to get a table over there, and maybe because it's so busy, the service is not very efficient or personal. My advice is: slow down and care about people. Maybe by increasing the staff. Nevertheless, for a good Gin in Lisbon area, don't miss it || The most unusual and unique place I've been. I've never experienced a place like this. All the dishes were awesome. A tapas style restaurant, my friends and I shared many different items from the many choices. We are heading back k tonight to try more! Just can't get enough. || This place changed my opinion about gin. From hating it to loving. || Very pleasant bar with a huge range of gins and tonics. The staff were great - very knowledgeable about gin and with good english (helped us a lot). Nice cheese and ham on the side. || Very small bar, very popular with locals that meet. Clientele is mainly above 30. They serve tasty treats and have a very decent gin and cocktail list. You can reserve a table, as it can be dificult to one, it is tiny, thus the name. || Always a great place, lovey outdoor smoking spot, really tasty food and the gins...worth the visit! Definately a super cozy place and super great location if you live around Avenida de aroma. Sadly not a great parking spot, and always full of people most Fridays and weekends. || Really had a good time, cocktails are really good and staff is nice. A perfect place to with a friend and have a good time || I dont even know when did I have such a great coctail last time, also please make yourself a favor and order a tuna sandwich with fried onions. It was absolutely delicious and I felt like in heave . || Went for a cheeky post concert drink. Opens til late and possible to order tapas.  Extensive list of gins. Very helpful staff || What a treat to discover a true neighborhood watering hole here in Lisbon after living here four months! Thanks to new friends who live near the Cockpit, we got to experience the pleasure of a friendly community vibe and a vast array of gins and accompaniments, along with outstanding, tasty tapiscos, including smoky padron peppers plus, our favorite, a combination of polvo and chorizo that delighted us. Owner Pedro made sure all was perfect and we can’t wait to return. || Thank you very much for your kind visit. || Super nice food, amazing staff. Although its a bar, you can go there to get some of the most delicious side dishes you can eat in Lisbon || Every dish I've eaten is delicious the drinks are delicious and the service is top notch. I feel at home. Love it best place ever || Huuuge amount of different gins. Very friendly personal, but you should reserve table before visiting.

Great place to visit if you're looking for help/ recommendations. Very friendly and approachable, very knowledgeable, and clearly enjoys talking about wines. || Thank you so much for your review. We hope can see you again. || Prime location in a zone not yet crowded by tourism. Not as many references as other larger wine stores in Lisbon but the selection is amazing. The prices are fair so I usually buy more than planned!! The owners are of the utmost sympathy … || Thank you so much for your feedback. Straightforward advice and a discerning selection made for a rewarding visit to this clearly cherished shop in a peaceful neighbourhood… || Thank you so much for your feedback. I'm happy to know you enjoyed our store. Hope to ser you again. || Nice wine shop with a great selection of new and old wines. but the attitude of the owner almost comes across as "you are not good enough to drink the wines I sell" || Thanks you for hour feedback.We regret that you are left with this impression. we hope you can visit us again and we can change your opinion. See you soon || Good choice of wines, including ports. Very reasonable prices, friendly service. || Thank you so much for your feedback. See you soon || Good wine selection and with good prices... ask for their recommendations. || Love it! And so helpful, with great prices and selection. || Thank you for your feedback. Happy new year! || A very decent vine shop. || Thank you for your feedback. Happy new year! || lots of brands and those attending are connaisseurs ! || Thank you very much for your feedback. We hope you will visit us again soon! || The owner was very friendly and helpful. I don't speak much Portuguese and he didn't speak much English, so we communicated in French and had a very pleasant conversation. I always learn something new when I go there. || Thank you so much for the feedback ☺️ || A very good variety of wines, good service. They have wines from the wine regions and some gems. Friendly, good service || Thank you very much for the feedback. Happy New Year! || Located in a central area, next to Saldanha, the owners are very friendly and the wine selection is excellent for those who enjoy good wines. They also hold various events that add new experiences for those who visit and follow them. || Thank you so much for your feedback 😉 … || Excellent service and friendliness. We bought a bottle of wine for my father-in-law following the store's recommendation, and it was a big hit! I recommend the store. || Thank you so much for the feedback, and I'm glad you liked the suggestion. See you soon! || A benchmark in Lisbon's wine shops and certainly in the country. A safe choice for wines from all regions and an extremely safe choice for wines from Dão, Bairrada, Minho, Madeira and Port... … || Thank you so much for the feedback 🙂 … || Good service, with quality. || Excellent value for money. Very friendly and attentive owners. Great variety of wines. || Thank you very much for the feedback and see you soon. || Pleasant place, good service from both Mr. João and his employee, who in this case is Mr. João's daughter. place_name: Escape Rooms Game Over - Santa Clara
reviews_content: It was incredibly interesting, very interactive, and extremely well designed. The special effects, the storyline, and the overall atmosphere were impressive and truly immersive. Everything was well explained and easy to follow, even though the challenges themselves are quite complex — in the best possible way.  The staff was fantastic: friendly, professional, and very attentive. A special thank you to our guide Luca, who helped us a lot and made the whole experience even more enjoyable.  I highly recommend this escape room to everyone — just make sure to choose the difficulty level wisely, as it can be quite challenging but incredibly fun. We will definitely come back and are already excited to try the other rooms.  Book in advance — it’s absolutely worth it! || Great place with a good variety of escape rooms. We had a lot of fun, the puzzles were engaging and the time flew by. Big thanks to Sara - she was welcoming and made the experience even better. We’ll definitely be back to try the other rooms. || We tried the Agrabah room this time and it was a lot of fun. The puzzles were more physical and we enjoyed the different kinds of challenges. Alexis  was our game master and she once again was very helpful. Her hints are just enough to lead you in the right direction. || We've tried multiple rooms and I only have good things to say. About the game masters, I had Luca and Rodrigo. The first one is the best and the latter I found a bit neutral and didn't help the experience itself. I would give 5 stars if all the game masters were at the same level. Apart from this I totally recommend if you like to challenge yourself. || My family and I were very impressed with this location and the number of rooms they offer. The design of the Atlantis room was really cool and the puzzles were decently hard! Alexis was very helpful throughout our adventure, offering small nudges when we looked lost or when we were going too far the wrong way. We're definitely coming back soon! Thank you! || We did the haunted hotel and it was very fun and interesting. The rooms are big and more to explore. Alexia was very nice and helped us along the way. It makes a great day out. || Great experience, really amazing and great fun. Our gane master Vaz was very helpfull and accommodating.  Reccomend and if ever in Lisbon will come back. || We played Illuminati. The rooms are nicely done. The riddles are definitely challenging. The loudness of the sound was for us too much. The two of us didn’t solve it within one hour. Propably it’s better to ask more frequently for help if you get stuck. || Amazing experience! Very fun and challenging room for our first time. The host Rodrigo was very pleasant and explained and guided us very well. Will definitely come back to try another room || What an amazing experience! I've played the scream of Agrabah with Bruna as Host and was amazing, she was a great host, helped only when is necessary! We are going to return very soon. || Wonderful experience with our gamemaster! The room “Iluminati” was awesome! We’ll come back to do their other rooms. || We had such a fun evening at the escape rooms. Our guide Sena was great, he was polite, explained evening really well and set a great scene for the escape room we chose. He was also great with the kids. Thanks for a great evening. We will definitely return! || Amazing experience - very well prepared, challenging but not too complicated. We went with 3 kids (9 years old) and we all enjoyed it so much! And Lucca, our game master, was fantastic - he gave us hints when needed, but not too many, he really challenged us and let us solve things on our own. We played the SCHOOL OF MAGIC room - highly recommended! || We enjoyed our game experience so much! Soares was an amazing game master. From the beginning he was really into character and  we felt like we were inside the Orient Express. The puzzles made sense and even though some were difficult, we were able to solve the murder mystery with success 💪 … || Great place. We did the professor mission. It is very thematic and a lot of fun. Difficulty 4/5. The game master Sena was of special mention as he made the game even more fun :D great job. Would recommend. || Played the Lost City of Atlantis with LUCA. Very cool , lost of automation making the game more reliable and rewarding. The theme was nice too and décor added to the experience. || We went to the Lost City of Atlantis room. The decor and atmosphere was nice and pretty to look at. However, the puzzles were weak. It's was more of a - find this folded piece of paper somewhere hidden on the wall several times and proceed to the next room. The game master also kept interruting our game and giving us hints unprompted. We didn't ask for help at all, but bascially got guided through the room. || It was an incredible experience. The decor is amazing. Just know that if you feel confident before the game, you will for sure feel dumb at the end 🤣 But we were so lucky to have Ruben to help us with so much kindness 😊 Thank youuu we recommend. … || We had a great time doing the Haunted Mansion with Lucca as our game master - just the right amount of clues while leaving you some time to figure the puzzles out yourself. Cool decor as well and great fun with the scares. We were two players and it was perfect. See you soon! || Amazing rooms, great themes, very friendly game master. Game Master, Atlas, was super friendly and helped us have a good time. || We went to the quest illuminati and we didn’t escape it but it was still very interesting and fun 🤩 … || We loved the Orient Express!  It’s tough- we didn’t finish I time with two people!  But it’s super fun.  Leo was a great host || Really cool experience. Our game master Alexis was amazing. It really felt like we were in Hogwarts. I’ll definitely be coming back for other rooms. || Me and my sister played the illuminati escape room and it was a very fun an intellectually challenging experience. I would recommend joining ‘game over ‘ and their escape rooms again for an intellectually challenging experience . || Pedro was very nice. He did it verry good for his first day. We had a fun time. || The room was really fun and Luca is such an awsome person qnd he deserves employee of the month, his attitude is truly inspiring😇 … || We experienced the Orient Express escape room, and it was absolutely spectacular! Playing this escape room was a highlight of our trip and will definitely bring us back to Lisbon! || OMG, you guys HAVE to check out this escape room in Lisbon – it was seriously the best! The theme was all about the Illuminati and the Holy Grail, which is already super cool, right? The puzzles were incredibly clever, and we had to work together to solve them, it was challenging and so much fun. Seriously, if you're looking for an awesome activity in Lisbon, this escape room is a must-do, you won't regret it! || This escape room was so fun, so interactive, very terrifying, and very cool. I loved this experience so much || We had a great experience! La misión del professor was one of the best escape rooms i ever did and Rodrigo made the experience even better! || Amazing! reviews_content: It was an awesome day, very friendly people, funny and interesting escape rooms. || Very glad that you enjoyed your birthday with us :D We will always have that special chocolate cake prepared for more birthday celebrations and amazing escape rooms and games to explore with full magic :D || I loved the experience!! Even compared to escape rooms played abroad, this one undoubtedly had the most diverse and challenging puzzles! We loved all the decoding, and a super positive factor for its success was that, given that we have team members who don't understand Portuguese, Enigmas Land provided both English and Portuguese versions of all the escape room puzzles, allowing everyone to easily understand and focus on solving each one. In addition, Victor was with us in a super fun character who always helped with translations and communication with my friends, as well as putting everyone's reasoning together. He never gives direct clues like in other escape rooms, but rather makes us think through our own reasoning, which makes everything much better and gives us a real feeling of being the ones solving everything, even when we seemed stuck. It was perfect!! I recommend it so much that we've already bought two more escape rooms and even got a free speed game! Thank you so much for everything!! || Thank you very much, and we'll be here to honor those 5 stars in the next games you'll venture into! || As regular customers of this type of game, we were quite disappointed. Anyone who has ever been to an escape room will find this completely different. It's even worse. The game consists only of a table with props on it. The clues are very complex, long, and don't make much sense. And we also have the constant company of a man who is always directing and explaining everything. Which is not expected in an escape game where the group must decipher the clues on their own. || We realized that you didn't read what you were getting into; the game you purchased was an escape game, not an escape room, something that is even in the Odisseias title and present in 3 different places on the voucher.  And as with everything in life, we couldn't all like the same thing, and fortunately, the game you played is our most played and liked game. As you mentioned, the clues are indeed complex, and when you constantly try to read more than one at a time, it becomes more difficult, and this fact was mentioned several times before and during the game by the game master. In Portugal, and especially abroad, this figure (and you can research it) serves exactly as part of the game and to help guide you during the experience. We understand those who prefer to touch a button and immediately get the answer through the intercom; in our case, we prefer to guide the thinking and only assist in how to get the answer to the customers themselves. For your part, you decided to play as 6 in a game meant for 4 people, and despite mentioning that you weren't in the best frame of mind for riddles due to the few hours of sleep you'd had, thankfully at least 2 members still enjoyed it. Our games are all designed for thinking, not just wandering around looking for keys or objects in rooms like in others, but for reading, interpreting, and solving riddles. That's why we're called ENIGMAS LAND. Have a fantastic rest of your birthday and a great week! || The best Escape Game I've ever played!
