Glad you enjoyed :) || We had a truly wonderful dining experience here, and all of the Michelin and Eater buzz are well deserved.  The pork sandwiches, fries, and dumplings were the highlights, but everything we tried was good.  The only thing I would not re-order were the cracklings. Overall, an excellent meal with great service!

place_name: Fábrica Rodizio de Picanha - Campo de Ourique
reviews_content: Amazing experience! The quality of the meat was outstanding—perfectly cooked, full of flavor, and incredibly tender. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere made the whole evening even better. Highly recommended for anyone who loves great steak and top‑notch dining. Carne eccellente, cottura perfetta e servizio impeccabile. Un posto davvero consigliato per gli amanti della buona carne. Seb || Fabrica was an amazing experience from start to finish. The service was top tier—attentive, welcoming, and professional without being overbearing. The food was absolutely delicious. The staff truly stood out and made the entire experience even better with their warmth and attention to detail. Everything exceeded my expectations, and I’ll definitely be back! || The food is amazing, the meat is juicy and tender. We had the passion fruit sangria and it was incredible! Everything was very tasty. We have to point out Leticia the waiter was so nice smiling all the time! We even saw some tender team moments. If you have that carnivorous desire this is a must go! || Amazing food! The meat is amazing and you can have as much as you want!!!! Also the pistachio dessert is sooo good! Definetly coming back also the staff was very helpful ! || FOOD WAS 10/10 AMAZING!!! Literally creamed my jeans and server was awesome. Lorraine was the best one in the building hardest worker fr. || The service was outstanding. It’s rare to find a place in Portugal where all the staff genuinely care about their customers. The restaurant operates fully digitally, allowing you to place your order via a QR code. The food arrives quickly, and it’s simply amazing. || The restaurant fools you for a Brazilian steak house. The service was the only good thing here. The music is definitely Brazilian, but not one I expected to hear while having a meal. Sertanejo songs all along. If you like it, you’ll like it. If you don’t, you’ll be as annoyed as I got. Regarding the food, that was my biggest disappointment. The cut is so thin you cannot savory the meat. It comes very dry and it’s almost impossible to get a good medium rare meat. It looks and tastes like a dry carpaccio. The picanha has no flavor, and so hasn’t the maminha. We order a plate, that came with loads of sides. The french fries were tasting like those dirty clothes from the sink, not at all like it was supposed to taste. The “Rodízio” is exactly the same. The meat comes as this carpaccio, not like the real Brazilian Rodízio. I felt completely deceived because they don't tell you these "details" before you place your order. It was like throwing money in the trash and still getting angry (and hungry). || One of the best place in town if you looking for an aesthetic restaurant and good grilled meat, we'll be back for sure ( press the red button into the toilet) || Lorraine is the best waitress, so kind and attentive. Food was great and the caipirinhas even better! || a little bit overpriced, the meat doesn’t worth 24€ for 1 person, the staff is amazing but the overpriced food doesn’t make sense. I suggest everybody that is looking for meat to take other restaurants in Lisbon that you can have “all you can eat” by the same price and have better food. || Loraine was awesome. The food was amazing definetely coming back || Great experience at this restaurant! The all-you-can-eat buffet is high quality and really delicious. The staff is very polite, welcoming, and attentive. Thank you to the whole team for this lovely moment. || Very nice restaurant where you get all you can eat and taste very nice picanha. The staff is lovely. Come try it. || One of my favorite restaurants ever! First time ever going there and I must say it’s so good! The food was enjoyable, the workers were so friendly, the drinks were really good too and the atmosphere was amazing. All in all I loved it a lot! Also nice surprise in the toilet😂✌🏼 || Lorraine was very sweet, attentive, & amazing amazing! Delicious food ! || The place is nice and the service is alright, but the food is not good at all. The picanha has no flavor, the fries are soggy and very oily and the sausage tasted like carbon from the grill. Very overpriced too.. 50€ per couple with no drinks.. || Amazing place. Great food. Great staff. || Very good, great service and spectacular desserts. I definitely recommend it, I will be back for a birthday party. Thank you very much || A gem of a find. Delicious food and wine, and an absolutely fantastic dining experience. Our server Lorraine was brilliant, very attentive and a lovely person. Would highly recommend for any meat lovers visiting Lisbon || Good food and good music, easy choice ! || This place is just great. Lorraine is the best 👌 || For what you pay, you can get better. The  place has a really cool vibe, but the "all you can eat" concept is disrupted from getting way too small amount of meat served every time.. im not there to eat myself full on the side dishes. I come to a place, which name includes "picanha" expecting to eat lots of meat. Here to order the beef, receive 3 small pieces and when you turn around to order more,  everyone is so busy it takes a while to get someone to take your next order of beef, and then 5min, sometimes even later you receive your next small serving. This is very frustrating for someone who came here to expect eating yourself full on beef. When you have to wait sometimes 10minutes before you get served more. Other than the disruptive frequency between the servings, the beef was decent, not what you would expect from the price at least. || Average quality picanhas. The reason it made the 2 star mark was the super friendly and hospitable staff. Besides that, don’t expect anything special from the picanha rodízio (all you can eat). I also think it’s definitely overpriced. You can get better quality meat from all the other known buffets in Lisbon. || Fair deal and great food || Cozy place with very polite staff and excellent value for money picanha meat. The cocktails and sangrias are also very good. || Great food.Great staff || Best picanha in Lisbon 🥰 || Good company, good food, great service, but not a typical rodizio. Picanha way too thin. || The service was great second to none, and the food was delicious.  Strongly recommend it!!! || Very nice restaurant, good price, good food and very good service! || Too much ice in the drinks. Good service || Great food, great staff || Lorraine’s the soul of this restaurant.

The best Portuguese restaurant I know in Lisbon, amazing food, with the chef speciality steak in butter, fresh fish and classic Portuguese dishes, the staff always gives you feel like home, parking nearby.  Our default place to bring guests from abroad but also for family dinners or casual lunches  Recommended!!! || In a central bairro of Lisbon, this small classic restaurant has it all: an extensive menu with an innovative and selective wine card, a fast and friendly service by João Paulo in an ambiance with great acoustics and without any disturbing background music.  We were two for dinner that shared a tasty peixinho de horta, a pica pau de lombo, an outstanding lombo de pregado with a great white Dão, a pavlova with coffees and water for €50/pax.  This is a long standing favourite that just never fails. || Good Portuguese cruise. Lots of food  choices. Our waiter spoke excellent English and very knowledgeable. Will definitely dine there again || Perfect fish and meat. Top notch and attentive service . A not over priced but the quality is unequal . We took the prego, amêijoas , seared tuna, and other petiscos and all were perfect . || Amazing experience. Booked this place for a special birthday. Even went with a high expectation, it completely surprised us in a nice way and we had a great time - the vibe is relaxing and private, with great food,  fabulous wine and excellent service. Thank you and will come again next in Lisbon. This whole area is less touristy and more local. We love it. || The food was absolutely excellent. Of the month we spent in Europe the group agreed the fish was top two. More than anything though our waiter John Paulo made it the most memorable dining experience we had all trip. He was funny, no that’s a injustice, he was hilarious. Have great tips and suggestions. Generally everytime he came around the group was excited because something funny would come out of his mouth. Great energy and it made it absolutely a joy to eat here || We had our last lunch here and everything from the food, the ambiance and especially our waiter John Pau was excellent. I don’t usually give reviews, but I had to make an exception for this place. All dishes were excellent, but I absolutely recommend the cod and clam dish and the gambas. And again, look for John Pau as a waiter. The man is an amazing waiter and made our experience so much more enjoyable. || I did a lunch here during my visit in Portugal.  Every food item had a very good taste. Cooperative staff and clean environment.  Love the food.  Recommended for every one || What a great restaurant. Went for lunch and it wasn’t too busy. The chef’s special steak for two, which was recommended by the friendly and helpful server, was one of the best things we’ve ever eaten. Just thin sliced steak with loads of butter and garlic! The starters were also very good. There were many other delicious-looking menu items that we’d have loved to try if only we had bigger stomachs. Overall this establishment is worthy of all five stars! || If you are looking for the most authentic delicious Portuguese Cooking, this is it. Please ask for Jennifer. She is the best

Tasquinha do Celso is a solid neighbourhood spot for a relaxed meal. The menu focuses on traditional Portuguese dishes, prepared in a straightforward and honest way, ideal for a midday meal. The atmosphere is informal and local, with a steady flow of regulars, which is always a good sign. Service is simple and efficient, without fuss, and the pace suits a lunch break rather than a long, leisurely meal. It’s not a place that aims to impress or reinvent, but a reliable option for good, comforting food in Campo de Ourique. || Another hidden gem! Home-made Portuguese food elevated, sitting here amongst all locals, they sit with their friends and family enjoying a quiet Thursday lunch. I felt being taken care of by this little family run restaurant. Ordered sea bream from the dish of the day and it’s so well executed and delicious, the next level of home cooked but price is very reasonable and worth every single euros. (Seems like a formerly famous beloved local place just reopened) Would definitely come back!! || This has quickly become my favorite spot in the neighborhood if not Lisbon. I’ve been 3 times in as many weeks so far and each time has been great. I’ve had the robalo grelhado, iscais, and arroz de gambás and they have all been excellent. And very generous servings at a very reasonable price. And best of all, everyone who has helped me has been so friendly and welcoming, putting up with my pathetic attempts at Portuguese but smoothly moving to English when I reach my limits! A truly wonderful spot, I highly recommend. || What truly stood out was the food quality and taste; it was fantastic—delicious and plentiful, especially for what we paid. We were lucky to get a table without a reservation, but I'd definitely recommend making one. It's clear this is a place where locals gather for dinner. That authentic, welcoming atmosphere is what makes me want to come back. || One of my favorite places in the neighborhood. Always good variety of dishes (meat, fish, seafood), very nice staff and unbeatable vibe of local place with traditional food. || Love this place! I've been here several times already and in my opinion his newly reopened tasca is one of the best in Lisbon considering the quality of the food, service, and prices. Definitely a must-visit place when you're in Campo de Ourique! || Delicious food, attentive service, and a friendly atmosphere. This is a perfect neighborhood restaurant! || Great, cozy restaurant with delicious Portuguese food and incredible kind staff. I highly recommend visiting :) || This place is amazing cuisine!! I love the atmosphere as well as the very well seasoned food!! The service is remarkable!! I could go here everyday!! || Been there twice in a week. Family owned restaurant that makes you feel home, but don’t forget to book as the locals are coming there every night! || Absolutely love this place. I would go everyday if I could! Every dish is spectacular! || Super nice owner & delicious homemade Portuguese specialty. Great place, great food! || Amazing place with the most friendly young owner and great cooks in the kitchen :) || Amazing place, definitely will come back. Shrimp rice is a 10/10 || Says it's open on the website and on Google, but it's not. || Delicious food, lovely atmosphere and friendly staff! || Only one word - exceptional! From the starters to the desert. Great food and environment. Try it!!! || Excellent food and service || Another restaurant in the Campo de Ourique neighborhood, a small tavern with indoor seating and an outdoor terrace, it meets the minimum requirements. It was my first time at this place; they have a good wine list and relaxed, yet assertive service. I only noticed one negative point, which is the coffee, too watery. Regarding the cost of the meals, I found it a bit excessive, but try it, it's worth it. || We highly recommend it, the value for money is unbeatable. Homemade, local food. Exquisite. We had octopus salad and dobradha, both delicious. The staff was lovely, and the atmosphere was quite local. When we return to Lisbon, this will be a must-visit. || Excellent, authentic Portuguese restaurant. Generous and delicious dishes. Very good value for money. || We were looking for an authentic restaurant with traditional Portuguese dishes. This restaurant exceeded our expectations. It's very family-run; everyone knows each other, creating a friendly atmosphere. From the attentive and friendly service to the food and the prices, everything was simply top-notch. If I could, I'd give it six stars. || The best clams à Bulhão Pato in the world. The steaks and prawn curry were absolutely delicious. The service was very friendly. We will definitely be back. || A recently opened and welcoming space, delicious food from Dona Rosa, an icon of Campo de Ourique, and the friendliness of Celso and his team. The samosas are delicious, and the monkfish rice is the best in the world. I highly recommend it! || An experience to repeat. Very good food, very helpful staff, and an excellent atmosphere! || I went with my partner and friends on Saturday night and we thoroughly enjoyed the meal at this restaurant. First of all, we want to thank Susana for her kindness in welcoming us, as well as Sandra and Dona Anabela, who made our dinner an experience filled with warmth, great energy, and delicious food. This isn't our first time at this restaurant, and it certainly won't be the last! || You really have to go there and try it! What a great idea from Ruben! It's so good to have Dona Rosa back in our neighborhood, come visit us 🌺 || Love at first sight. Heartfelt food with plenty of soul. The staff were super warmly welcomed, and it was a wonderful lunch! || The food was delicious and Susana was very attentive.

Great food and nice portions. Staff is super nice from the man that serves to the really sweet woman working at the bar. And the food is so good. I had a robalo with potatoes and a really good mixed vegetables situation. Two thumbs up. || The Cantinho is relaxed and feels local. The food is great and Rodrigo offers all attention to deliver a local foody portguese experience. || An unassuming neighbourhood restaurant that really delivers on both food and service. Every dish was perfect, quality ingredients cooked with skill. Warm, friendly and professional easy going service made for a memorable family meal || fantastic place, the steak and bacalhau are superb, but my favorite is still the Polvo || Tried dining in (family and guest entertainment), take out and delivery countless times. Dog friendly owner with English speaking staff. Steady home made gourmet delight with authentic Portuguese ingredients. Been entertaining guest here so many times with only amazing feedbacks. It might not be the most mind-blowing Portuguese dining experience ever, but it is that good old classical steady, reliable home made charm that not just my tongue - but  my stomach also -  can trust. The magic that keeps me , my family and friends coming back. || Delicious food. We don't speak Portugese, but the staff was very helpful to us and offered to translate the menu. || Super recommend! Great cozy spot to have a drink and a bite. Very nice service too! || My worst meal in Portugal!  We ordered food from this place via Uber Eats and we couldn't eat it. Shame that they serve such a poor quality to their customers. || This place is a hidden gem in campo de Ourique! Every dish is delicious but the best is the picanha with pineapple! Although some price increase compared to earlier this year (inflation, of course), the octopus simply was  very good, just a little over burnt today.

Such great food and atmosphere! A little gem to discover when visiting Lisbon. I started with vitello tonnato, gnocchi with cod, and finished with the amazing tiramisu. Barbara, the owner, is super kind and gives excellent menu recommendations. || A small Italian restaurant with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The space is small, so reservations are necessary. This was, without a doubt, the best experience. Barbara was an amazing hostess, Gio cooked the best food. I cannot recommend them enough. We found this place at random, proof that fate is sometimes kind. || I've eaten many times, but forgot qhethwr Ive reviewed it already. I go as often as I can, and it continues to be hands down without discussion, the best, most authentic and comforting italian restaurant in Lisbon, throughout the seasons! - Ive tried them all. The owners are incredibly nice, and the food is a little weekend in Tuscany with a touch of Sardinia. Absolutely phenomenal. If you are reading this, don't hesitate, GO, and GO HUNGRY! || Ma grazie Franceso!!!!!!! What I liked the most, of your beautiful review, is the suggestion to come here HUNGRY........ Thank you so much for your really nice words and for appreciating ours efforts, in and out the kitchen!!!!! Looking forward to seeing you soon, Barbara and Gio || The food is amazing here. Don't miss out on the hot seafood appetizer. But more than just amazing food, the owners obviously care about their guests and ensure everyone enjoys themselves. We got a very thorough walkthrough of the menu as well as great recommendations.  Will definitely be back to try other dishes.  Reservations recommended for Fridays and weekends. || My dearest, thank you soooo much for your nice words!!! We  are looking forward to hist you again, to try more options!!! Big hugs, Barbara e Giovanni || The food was really delicious. More than the food, we really liked the hospitality of the staff there. (It is a shame that we didn’t ask her name) She was lovely and very engaging and friendly with the guests. She was kind enough to translate the menu in English for us. We would love to visit again. || Very good plate of the day. We had swordfish and beef it was more than perfect and very balanced. The ambiance is good the service is very good and we could even go inside with our dog, because it was cold outside... this restaurant is a must to visit and let the chef surprise you💯✅️ we will be back for shure. Compliments to the chef and the staff ❤️ abraço || Best italian food you can get in Lisbon! Very nice and cozy space, homemade food from Giovanni, great and fun  service from Barbara! Reservations recommended || No dispute, the best Italian restaurant I have never been. Don’t expect to see pizza on the menu but authentic Italian cuisine. Top quality food and extraordinary service. Restaurant well run by Barbara and her crew. || This place blew my mind, to be honest 😁 We had a dinner for 6 people, I tried every single dish at the table, each one was just perfect and high-end delicious. Highly recommend! || Lasagna da Dio!! Amazing and genuine italian restaurant. Felt like in Italy. Restaurant to bring family and friends. Totally recommended. Good food, wine and service. The owner is 5* person. Homemade food. Thanks a lot for the kindness. See you soon || Grazie André!!!!!! So happy to hear that you loved it!!!! Giovanni and I are looking forward to hosting you again, in the future!!! Big hugs, Barbara || By far the best Italian food in Lisbon (and I’ve tried many). The food is delicious, and the hosts are lovely. Can’t recommend enough! || My dearest Ilana, thank you so much for your nice words!!! It has been a pleasure to have you at La Bottega di Gio, and we sincerely hope to see you again for trying new dishes!!! Hugs, Barbara e Giovanni || Went last night to this restaurant in Campo de Ourique which was really great. We haven't been to Tuscany in ages, but this was a slice of that. Give it a go, I recommend La Bottega di Gio highly. || Mark, thank you so much!!! So happy to know that you felt in Tuscany, for a few moments and that you enjoyed your evening with us!!! Barbara e Giovanni || An incredible restaurant to have authentic Italian, with the most lovely staff and owners. I had an authentic Sardinian entree and some of the best octopus I’ve ever had for an appetizer!  Barbara is so warm with all her guests and really makes you feel like family! || Thank you soooooo much Ishrat!!!!! So happy you liked it!!! We hope to come to NY to see you again!!!! || Excellent family-owned Italian restaurant in Campo de Ourique area. My husband's plate of the day was excellent. They made me a wonderful salad as I was not so hungry. Everything was delicious! || Thank you so much, Lilo. Hope you had a safe trip back home, and hope to see you again, one day. Barbara e Giovanni!!! || from a UK group of 4 with high food standards. We were very happy to have incredible family Italian food, friendly atmosphere, worthy of a 5 star restaurant in central Lisbon. At the end of the 25/28 tram in Campo De Ourique. And great wine! A hidden gem. || Today we ordered the octopus salad and the Bresaola plate. So so good! Perfect food when you are on a diet and LOVE Italian food. Thank you for your enthusiasm and for your food. And not a least thanks to the staff always friendly and helpful and with a smile on their faces. Cosy atmosphère in the restaurant too. Very nice! || Great lunch! Authentic Italian food, nice “patron” of the restaurant, good wine and a lot of locals || We had an absolutely amazing meal, with the kindest and most attentive service we have ever experienced. Cannot recommend this little restaurant with the homemade food enough! || Lovely experience, a family run delicious Italian restaurant. || My favourite Italian restaurant in Lisbon. Bárbara is very friendly and welcoming. I never meet Gio, but I assume he is as well. The food is incredible and it makes me feel like I'm dining in Florence. Grazie Mille || A small piece of Italy in Lisbon with the lovely Barbara always taking good care about the costumers and the chef Giovanni bringing me back to Italy and my grandmother’s food! For sure the best Italian food in Lisbon! || Thank you so much, Bruna!!! We look forward to seeing you whenever you want!!! Thank you so much for the kind words! Waiting for you, soon!!! || I genuinely think this is the best Italian restaurant I have ever been to. The most amazing pasta dishes. I had the truffle ravioli and I could honestly eat it for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Barbara was so lovely and welcoming and took time to explain the full menu in English. Anyone who comes to Lisbon I would highly recommend. || The funnest and friendliest owner but the food is just insane - authentic flavors and excellent preparation! Will be back again, and again || Best Italian restaurant in lisbon for sure. Food is delicious and the service is amazing. Highly recommend. || Fantastic!!! High quality food, very well cooked. You can tell that every ingredient is chosen with attention, from the bread to the dessert! … || Dear Valeria, simply THANK YOU!!!!! See you soon, Barbara and Giovanni || La Bottega di Gio in Lisbon is a hidden gem, earning accolades for its authentic Italian cuisine. Nestled in a small, intimate setting with about six tables, the restaurant offers a less touristy, more local ambiance. Owned and run by an … || During our short stay in Lisbon, this was definitely a big highlight. We came here very hungry and left very happy. The food was great and tasty, they have a great variety of meals and the owner was so lovely and kind that you almost wish … || Last three days on our Portugal trip was spent in Lisbon. Had some fantastic traditional Portuguese meals. None came close to the food and service we had here. The moment we walked in, Barbara greeted us with a smile and and treated us like … || This is not your usual restaurant. This is the home of a chef, with dishes vetted by his own wife, who serves you as if you were part of their family. Expect unique homemade dishes, and the warmest of services.

Loved this place! The food was fantastic. I especially recommend the tuna tacos; they are my new favourite!  The atmosphere was great, and the service was superb. A special thank you to Laís, a staff member who was truly kind and attentive. She did a wonderful job! || Lovely place in great local neighborhood with great interior and atmosphere. Quite interesting taste and fantastic coffee. Staff were moderately friendly but smile and good vibes did the job. Highly recommend if you are around. || Super nice experience at this spot! Vegan pancakes were absolutely delicious and I loved the pinkish setting and tshirts of the staff! Really cute place I’d recommend || It was such a joy to eat breakfast at Amelia's. The whole place got such a comfy, relaxed vibe; we were served rather fast even tho there was quite a lot of people. The food was incredibly tasty, portions big and the design of dishes just marvelous. Everything was so colorful. It felt like we were in the super fancy restaurant while we paid just like in regular one. Would really recommend. || Amazing! We visited twice with 3 kids. Fresh; delicious, incredible quality, creative flavors, reasonable prices. Wonderful back patio. Fresh fruit, sangria, bowls, the best grilled chicken sandwich ever, creative pancakes and tartines. Vegetarian & vegan-friendly, but also great burger. Wonderful neighborhood spot! Kids are begging to come back a third time. || The atmosphere is very cute and aesthetic, right down to the washroom. Prices are reasonable, and both the French toast and pancakes were delicious. I would definitely come back again. || Delicious breakfast spread! The poached eggs were perfectly cooked, the muffins were fresh and flavorful, and the coffee was rich and satisfying. However, the pancakes were a bit of a letdown - they had great potential, but could use a bit more fluff and flavor to take them to the next level. That being said, our waiter Diogo was absolutely fantastic - attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed. Would definitely come back and try the pancakes again (or maybe just order something else 😉). 4/5 stars! || Everything was lovely! The staff were super friendly and patient with our lack of Portuguese. The food not only was beautiful, it was incredibly delicious! This was our first time coming but won’t be our last. See you next time! || I couldn’t ask for a better experience! Sometimes it’s not just about the food or the place, but about the team—the waiters who are so friendly, warm, and at the same time truly professional. That’s what makes the visit unforgettable. A big thank-you to Vinicius and Georgia. The business is lucky to have such talented and dedicated people like you! || Lovely setting but I sat waiting for my coffee included in the brunch for 25 as my bowl sat empty on the table. Staff just stand there taking to each other without giving you care and attention. Go check on your guests!! Also the ‘hollandaise sauce’ is not. || What a beautiful spot to stop for breakfast. We had the Tosta Alberta which is grilled brie cheese toast with prosciutto, tomato, arugula, and oregano. With a balsamic glaze. Absolutely wonderful. Our server Diogo greeted us with a smile and was very friendly and attentive the whole time. He even gave us recommendations of where to sightsee after breakfast.  So happy we found this spot. Would definitely recommend. || Amelia was a gem I found during my trip. Great food and even better service. We had Vinicius helping us and he was amazing, super kind and attentive! Definitely made the experience 1000x better || Wish the burgers were less saucy . It was a mess and the tasts was okay. Shrimp tacos were so good || Fantastic place with delicious food! Best curry in Lisbon, very friendly service, good coffee and other home made drinks, amazing atmosphere. Def recommend and will come here again and again 🩵 || Beautiful space and delicious food! So many options on their menu! Highly recommend || Loved Amelia! It’s a lovely little place to have breakfast or lunch. The service was good and I got my food really quickly. Diogo was a good waiter, and my food was great too :) || Amazing place to eat and wonderful staff super ambiance during weekday or weekend highly recommend alone, date, meeting or with kids perfect place for everyone || Hands down best eggs Benedict I’ve tried in a LONG while. First, I thought the portion was tiny, but I was proven to be very wrong😂 Absolutely gorgeous place. || Great charming Green brunch coffee Even cocktail place. I definitely recommend it for a nice pleasant moment with your lover or friends! || Food was good, fresh and tasty. And the service very friendly. But I felt the basic toast a bit poor in variety on the dish itself. I have been to many brunch places around Europe, and in the Lisbon, my home town, I expected a bit more, due portuguese food being very tasty and rich in ingredients. I asked for a gluten free toast with eggs. And that was what I got. I expected a bit more in the presentation and maybe a bit of a spread on the dish, since only bread and eggs was too dry in my opinion. So had to ask for avocado on the side. They took their time to bring it. I do understand when a house is full things take time. Maybe next my experience will be better.

Truly amazed! We were just hungry and our expectation was a bit low. How can one get 5/5 pasta in a small market? We were wrong! The ravioli and pasta came out one of the best pasta we ever ate! Just saying as a person who had very good pastas in Italy! Would go here again! || Maybe my issue with this place were the expectations that I had.  I read many fantastic coments saying they were life-changing Raviolis, spectacular flavor and things like those.  And, don't get me wrong, they are definitely good Raviolis. Maybe not just so life-changing, to be honest. Especially if you're not around, I'm not sure it's that worth actually moving around the city just to try them.  But they were good, I want to emphasize that. || AMAZING 🤩 their raviolis were so good and rich, good portion to fill you up! Really flavourful and goes well with their special lemonade! Definitely worth trying ! || Thank you so much dear Yuqing! || Best food - get the pesto linguine - it’s insane it tastes like it came straight from Italy - the environment is so cute and lovely as it’s in a market and the servers and cooks are so kind !! Support , support , support!! || The truffle ravioli is one of the best things I've ever tasted.  So rich in flavor.  The sauce was incredible.  Perfect sauce to ravioli ratio too.  As someone who likes meat, I usually go with some kind of protein but I didn't miss it with this dish.  Can't wait to go back.  Really nice people running it too. || Thanks so much Jonathan for your review and positive feedback! We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed, and can’t wait to have you back! Give our fresh pasta dishes a try next time 😉  … || Wow first time I’ve seen 5 star across the board. To be honest it’s justified. From the staff who is super friendly to the relative decor which is pleasant then to the food which is amazing. I could eat 3 portions but then I would destroy my gym efforts. Anything you get will be amazing. Even the lemonade. 6 stars || We rode the 28 tram to the end of the line, arriving about 12:30 pm, and made the shirt walk to the Mercado. Delighted to find this Italian food. Despite the informal atmosphere, the host was full of friendly, interesting conversation... told us the ingredients for the pasta come from Italy, and are then made in a commercial kitchen in Lisbon.  My husband had the Ravioli Bolognese and I had the Pozzuoli flatbread sandwich - both delicious! Highly recommend for the friendly service and the food. || Thank you so much fir your kind words! || This place is a revelation for ravioli lovers, delivering divine flavor combinations in a cozy and inviting environment—each bite is a taste of perfection! The owner is truly lovely, exhibiting immense care and providing top-notch customer service that made the experience even more memorable. || Thank you so much dear Alexander! || My focaccia pompei was delicious! Fresh pressed lemonade. Bright & welcoming atmosphere in the market with lovely staff. The manager gave me some tips for traveling around Lisbon. Highly recommend for lunch or dinner! Next time I’d try the nduja ravioli 🌶️! || Thank you so much - see you next time! || Food was very fresh made and ingredients are no doubt delicious! We were happy to have one pasta here ! || Thank you Nicole - great to hear! || Holy friggin’ yes! This was some top tier pasta, 10/5 some of the best pasta I’ve had in years. Cured my head and my stomach with its sauce. || I’m DEAD. These were so good. The carbonara omg. The duck ravioli. OMG. Just go… || Thanks Hannah! Come back again soon! 🍝 🇮🇹  … || Truffle ravioli is filling and delicious 🤤 || An all around amazing experience: authentic and tasty Italian food with many options for lunch to dessert and very friendly service. One of the best Italian food experiences in Lisbon || Amazing place! Tremendous food specially the ravioli funghi e tartufi and the sorrento focaccia. Also the lemon juice is 10/10 very refreshing! The personal always energetic and sympathetic || RAW SEWAGE! The smell coming from this place was unbelievable. Do not recomend. || This is a great place to get a quick lunch! I come here each time I visit Mercado de Campo de Ourique. Delicious! :) || Thank you so much Jacqueline! || Soooo unbelievably delicious! 10/10! || The most amazing ravioli we may have ever had! The mushroom truffle ravioli was so good! || Overated and super specific sewage smell coming from cooking area, might need to investigate that.

Sensational, and truly authentic family run Portuguese tasca, which I can't recommend highly enough. Food and drink were home-made from scratch, and Isabel (daughter) gave fantastic recommendations and shared the family's passion for good, traditional food! (Sorry, this is the only photo I have to share ) || Wow!   Five different mains, all yummy.  Only had room for 2 puddings with 5 spoons.  They were amazing too.  Thank you! || Now I understand what people mean when they say “Portuguese cuisine is among the best in the world”. The lovely people who run this establishment will make you smile, with the quality (and quantity!) of the food and with their pleasant demeanors. The husband appears to be the chef, an expert at grilling and cooking every type of fresh meat and sausage you can think of. And on certain days he has the freshest fish and bacalhau ready to cook for his hungry guests. The wife (I presume, forgive me if that is not the case!) is the host and server, adeptly taking and fulfilling orders, making recommendations, and making all the guests feel at home. If the tasty food and reasonable prices don’t keep you coming back here regularly, their smiles and positive attitude will!  I had a very relaxed lunch with rustic bread, cheese, olives, more delicious red wine than I could drink, a hearty plate of tender succulent meat with rice and fried potatoes, dessert (the most delicious pudim I’ve had in Portugal!), café, and a very special post-meal digestif (liquor) for under €20, including a voluntarily gratuity.  It’s a very intimate and charming space. On prior occasions I’ve passed by, it was full at lunch, but I was lucky to have a table all to myself on a quiet Wednesday after a holiday.  Please eat here. If you’re a visitor, don’t be afraid of trying out your Portuguese (or using your favorite translation app, if necessary). When in doubt, just smile and say “Boa tarde! Queria comer comida típica portuguesa” and be prepared to answer a few simple questions with a nod of the head and a “sim, por favor” or a shake of the head and “não, obrigado”. Be adventurous! Don’t worry. Whatever you get will taste great and will be so reasonably priced. They want your repeat business.  So, come here hungry, and expect to leave here stuffed and a bit tipsy 🤭 like I did. And tell your friends about it. They’ll be envious! Bom apetite! || Perfect! Lisbon people eat here. Familiar manners and treatments. Don't expose too mch your tourist ness. They are working and you must adapt to their menu. Food fantastic, like your granny back home. || The very beat of portuguese traditional food. Like eating in a portuguese home. The owner, Manel, is a charming character. Highly recommended. || Great local food, no tourists, just plain simple (and delicious) bacalhau. Loved it! || A real traditional tasca. Not everyone will enjoy but the food..... Oh the food.... || Portuguese cuisine at his best

It’s truly a gem, an accidental find on our walk from the nearby park. You might miss it from the street but we were glad that there’s a sign out that that attracted us. The menu changes daily and today we had the soup w rice, beans, tomato stuffed with tricolor quinoa and fresh salad on the side. Every ingredient is so well matched with each other. I love the light balance of acidity with sweet flavor together with the richness of the beans. The coriander soup is as fresh and light as it’s flavorful. The chef is humble yet humorous too! I meant to order the meal to share but I ended up having it all to myself! That’s how delicious it is to me. We also ordered their homemade chocolate apple cake and it’s another highlight as it’s moist, rich and light at the same time. The price is very reasonable for the lunch set. I can’t wait to be back again! || Hi Kris! We’re thrilled to hear such good feedback. Thank you so much and hope to see you again soon! :) || Very tasty plant based food, great value for money and friendly service - this little restaurant is well worth a visit! My wife and I each enjoyed fruit juices, veggie soup, main (one spinach dish and one soya chucks dish), dessert and coffee, costing about €25 in total. We loved the option to try a bit of everything, when deciding between different mains and desserts! We will definitely return :) || Hi David! Thank you so much for your kind words. Hope to see you again soon. :) || Cute cafe tucked away from the busy street with delicious vegan and vegetarian offerings.  Delicious coffee and expresso.  Staff are friendly and helpful.  Recommended! || Hi Mark! Thank you so much for your kind review! Hope to see you again. :) || Cozy, welcoming, with very nice service. Very clean. The food is fresh, vegetarian or vegan options only. The pastel de nata is just delicious. Prices are very affordable for the quality of the meals. Highly recommend || Hi Christian! Thank you for your kind review. Hope to see you again. :) || What a lovely place! And the staff is super friendly. Had coffee and sweets but will definitely go back for some food || Hi Mariana! Thank you so much for your kind feedback. Hope to see you again soon. :) || Very friendly welcoming neighborhood place. The food is excellent and freshly prepared. And the menu changes daily which is amazing. My new favorite local spot. || Hi Robert! Thank you so much for sharing your experience with us! Hope to see you again! :) || You HAVE TO have lunch here! Delicious, wholesome, creative and healthy food. You can tell that everything is made with love and knowledge. You can get a plate that has a little bit of each dish of the day. Dogs are allowed in the outside area. || Hi Raquel! Thank you for your kind review. Hope to see you again. 😊🙏 … || Great service, amazing chocolate cake! The owner is very kind and heartwarming. || Hi Madalena! Thank you so much for your review. Hope to see you again. :) || Delicious vegetarian food and super friendly staff! Perfect spot for lunch. Highly recommended. || Hi Ihor! Thank you for sharing your thoughts with us. Hope to see you again. 😊🙏 … || A small, very good vegetarian place in the same street as the Casa Fernando Pessoa. Sympathetic owner offers a combined plate of the 2 daily plates, so you have a taste of both. Also tasteful soup. Really good quality, and unbelievable cheap. || Hi Jan! Thank you so much for leaving such a kind review! Hope to see you again soon! :)

place_name: Empada brasileira em Lisboa - De Além Mar
reviews_content: I could eat their empadas for the rest of my life, that's how good they are! No exaggeration. Everything freshly made || This makes us so happy to read! 🥹💛 Everything is truly made fresh, with a lot of care, love, and that homemade touch that crossed the ocean with us. Thank you so much for the kindness — our doors are always open for you to come back anytime! ✨🥟 || Two year old business with an adorable kitchen where everything is made. I tried the curried chicken version and it tasted great but m”2 peeves is the soggy bottom of the pastry shell & the top part of the shell came off. The little edible label on top is a novel touch but could look more creative and part of the design. Lovely service. || Hello!  Thank you so much for your visit and for your kind words about our space, service, and of course, the curry chicken empada — we’re so glad you enjoyed it! 💛  About the crust: our empadas follow a traditional Brazilian recipe and are made 100% by hand, one by one, by us. We don’t mass-produce, so slight variations are part of the charm — it's all about honest, homemade food, crafted with care and love.  As for the edible label: it’s actually one of our most recognizable and unique touches! It’s already quite innovative, and many people know us specifically for this little detail that adds both identity and flavor in a fun, thoughtful way.  We appreciate your feedback and hope to welcome you back soon — always with warm smiles and fresh empadas waiting for you! 😊🥧 || We had coffee and a sweet Empada. It was delicious and the place is very charming. Also the apple muffin was very fresh. || Hi Negin! Thanks a million 💙 … || The kindest and warmest Brazilian ladies making some of the best empadiñhas we’ve ever had! || The very best coffee place I've ever been to in Campo de Ourique. The finest traditional portuguese and brazilian pastries around. || One of the best coffees I’ve ever had in Lisbon and a delicious caramel cake. || Dear Andre, thank you for your review, it is very important to us! || The best place in Lisbon to try traditional pastries from Portugal. Super friendly service. Highly recommended. || Amazing brazilian and portuguese treats for good prices. Worth trying the pastel de nata! || The best "empadinha" ever! Not only the traditional one (chicken) but also the "new (very successful! ) experiments". The "empadinha" is amazing, but I have to mention that everything I ate there so far is simply delicious! The staff is very friendly and welcoming too. || Exeptional quality food. Great chicken pies and accessible prices. The service was exeptional and everyone was very sweet. Great atmosphere and bonus points for the brazilian music.

Wonderful place with lovely owners. Food was amazing and they are so friendly. Wish I lived nearby! Will return when I go back to Lisbon! || I found this place to serve tasty honest traditional Portuguese dishes. the wine list was also very good and the suggestion to accompany our meal was fantastic. If there is a point of criticism is in the deserts which I didn't think were at the same level as the rest of the meal. || Wonderful food and wonderful service! Staff are friendly and prices are very reasonable, would definitely recommend || Excelent! Top quality food but book a table always. Lots of business people but still relaxed || This is one of these places where you are very much welcomed until you sit on a table. Then everything is changing. I enjoyed the food but the service was not professional. The waiter was watching his phone instead of paying attention to customers. We needed to go to him and order. So far the worst experience in Lisbon as all other restaurants I visited were awesome and on lower prices. || We apologize for the inconvenience, but that day we had a hospital emergency with one of our kitchen staff members, which is why the service was delayed.  Sincerely,  The Solar dos Duques team. || Amazing! The place is modern but not overwhelming, very relaxed. The food was great, since it was Saturday we ordered the Cozido à Portuguesa for two and it was delicious. The service was the best, very cordial and welcoming; they were so proud of their dish and I see why. Prices are very reasonable so don't waste your time anywhere else! || Wonderful lunch with great service. Will come back again next time we’re in Lisbon! Petra was lovely, welcoming, and suggested a great wine to go with our delicious meal. || Really good food and welcoming environment. Top notch, totally recommend to everyone in Lisbon. It’s usually filled with locals so you know the food is authentic! || The absolute best pica-pau you'll ever find! Not to mention the service. Every single dish in this place is just amazing! I have brought loads of friends from abroad there and all of them were mesmerized. Solar dos Duques is my favourite restaurant in Lisbon and I wouldn't recommend people to go anywhere else before going there. It is the measurement with which all restaurants should be measured against. And Petra is the best! || Good food, excellent service. The alheira was melting in the mouth good. Their wine recommendation was great too.

This was our second time in Lisbon and found a delicious Espetada place. The Espetada Do Lombo was super delicious, similar to the nice restaurant we tried in Madeira last year. The service was exceptional and very very accommodating for English speakers. Would recommend and will Come back again.  We also had the cheesecake and the chocolate cake. Both delicious. || Real authentic Food ! No more words needed || What an incredible experience! This was my first time dining at a traditional Madeira restaurant. I decided to try the espetada, and it was so different when they left the skewer on the table, just like in the photos. The meat was tender and delicious. However, the highlight of the meal was definitely the pão de caco, a traditional garlic bread from Madeira. Overall, the restaurant exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend this restaurant for a  Madeiran dining experience. || Andre (Our waiter) its one of the kindest persons we have met here in Portugal. The food is amazing!! I will come back no doubt about it! || It is one of the typical portuguese restaurants, but VERY SPECIAL! The stuff members are attentive and positive; there is a good variety of dishes, most of them are “MUST HAVE” to try in Portugal (a lot of restaurants don’t have such a variety) and they are made PERFECTLY. The space is nice and clean, design is also typically portuguese, but was definitely made with taste ; ) || Great food, I ordered the tuna steak and it excelled my expectations. Staff was friendly and helpful even if you dont speak portuguese. The only "negative" point is the price of the dishes (>15€) but the quality compensates it. || The food was delicious and the service was really friendly. We came here since it was recommended by a local and we ended up coming here twice. || Lovely place to have a meal in traditional Portuguese environment. Great food especially the skewers. Really good service and friendly staff. Definitely recommend a visit. A bit pricey but worth it! || A nice restaurant in Lisbon with typical Madeira Island dishes. You can get Poncha here. || It was a great experience. It is a family owned I believe and the service was very friendly. I got there early on and wasn't disappointed. The food was amazing. The veal was perfectly cooked and had plenty to eat even though it was half a portion. It came with fries and rice. The food came fresh off the oven. The desert was awesome too. In particular I loved the homemade wine. It was delicious. Definitely recommend it. || We had a lovely evening. The food was truly delicious and very tasty. Our waiter João was superb and super helpful. He gave us plenty of recommendations. Everything was so nice... Very authentic. Loved it!! || Best restaurant in Lisbon to eat typical food from Madeira. Amazing service and food. || Excellent food and service! || I was really looking forward to going to this restaurant, not regrets whatsoever. Staff is lovely, such a warm treatment you receive. Food was delicious, roasted potato was the star of the dinner. ~25€ per person, with appetiser included. I will definitely come by again. || I am a bit sad because I cannot give them 6 stars! The place is really nice, clean and the staff is very friendly. The food is fantastic! I've been to Madeira in the past and I can tell you this one is legit, really genuine. The food is affordable and now they updated their menu and they have vegetarian dishes as well. But don't be fooled, this restaurant is for the fish and meat lovers! Try the dessert: queijada da madeira - it's soooo good! || In terms of quality would be a 4*. Good quality, but I want to notice the super-patience and professionalism they showed. They recommended we should ask less food than we initially wanted, because we ask too many. Recommended for tourists, because I felt that they are going to be honest always! The food is the typical food that a portuguese would eat any day. || Food is delicious, great portions, comes along with massive side dishe. Prices are moderate. || I had visit this restaurant on a group dinner, the food It was good but th service was truly bad. The waiter that attends us took so much time in everything, take to much to brings us drinks, the porpotion of food is for a kid, they serve on plate and you can request more, it was a very small portion. After that the rudeness was an constant an experience for me to not repeat or recommend to anybody on a group. || Mixed feelings about the local, service and food, and I don't want to sound mean. Bottom line is don't go as a lonely foreigner since the waiter gets very unsecured with strangers (I guess he is kind of agitated by nature). Rather visit as a small party and share dishes while making your own opinion

place_name: Água Pela Barba - Campo de Ourique
reviews_content: I am studying to become a cook at the Escola de Hotelaria e Turismo de Lisboa, which is located not far from the restaurant.  In our marketing class, we were given an assignment to write a marketing plan for a restaurant in Lisbon. I spent quite some time thinking about a place that I really like but that is not very well known, and I chose Água Pela Barba.  When I started reading more about the restaurant, I found out that they recently opened a second location, which happens to be close to my school. For the analysis, I decided to focus on this new location, especially because I had never visited it before, even though both places have the same menu.  I arrived right at opening time. Since the restaurant was empty, the staff told me I could choose any table I liked. I ordered saffron rice with shrimp. As many reviewers mention, the amount of rice is not proportional to the number of shrimp - and this turned out to be true :)  For one person, the portion of the main dish is very large, but of course I still finished it.  The rice has a slightly sour and salty taste, which for me is the perfect “risotto-style” flavor. The shrimp are lightly fried and taste very fresh, with a fresh texture as well. It feels like this natural, clean flavor is something you don’t find very often. Overall, the dish is not heavy or overly rich - it tastes light and well balanced.  The dish was prepared quickly, in about 15–20 minutes. I was the only customer there, and the staff were very polite and friendly.  I think this place is better suited for dinner or for a business lunch with someone, as the restaurant promotes the idea of sharing food (and the portions for one person are quite large). || The staff was superb, the food was amazingly fresh and flavorful, and the space was beautifully decorated. A great experience where no detail was left behind. Will return for sure! || We had fried fish tacos and quinoa main dish. They both were so delicious! The staff was also nice. Definitely we will go again to try other food! || Atmosphere was so nice, staff were kind too. Thanks for everything || Thank you Furkan! 🛟💥  We hope to see you soon again!  … || Unfortunately I got sick the following night - I didn’t digest the ceviche… The place, service and cooked fishes were good but the I am skeptical about the raw ones.  I would suggest them to change the music playlist also which wasn’t great. || One of the best places in Lisbon! Everything is amazing from the starters to the deserts! You guys deserve higher reviews! || Music (noise?) very loud! On top bad quality sound equipment makes it worse. Sad for the food is good, service is nice and the decor quite pleasant. || Super rude waitress. We have reserved a table and showed up a bit earlier and it was clear that they had tables yet she treated us in a super rude way. || Exquisite dishes and amazing service || I had been to Água pela Barba in Bica several times, but this was my first time at the one in Campo de Ourique.  The food is very good, everything is very well prepared. We ordered several dishes to share, including the cuttlefish risotto. The flavor was incredible, but it was a shame because there was very little cuttlefish. Otherwise, nothing to complain about, especially the crab baos and the raw fish tacos which were perfect.  The service is exceptional and I must mention Evandro. This gentleman not only provides excellent service, but is also very friendly and made the experience much better :) We felt very welcome, thank you.  It was a great experience, definitely to be repeated. || A very good experience at this restaurant in the heart of Campo de Ourique. The menu is well-prepared and uses high-quality ingredients, and the service is very attentive. I recommend the sapateira bao, the salmon taco, the burrata with shrimp, and the tiramisu. I will definitely return. Reservations are recommended. Dinner only, although they now also serve lunch on Saturdays. || Very pleasant restaurant! The menu is sea-oriented, but with a modern and elegant touch. Relaxed atmosphere and very attentive staff. I recommend it!! || We went for lunch and loved it, the food is really very good, with lots of flavor and perfectly cooked. It's not exactly a cheap restaurant but the price-quality ratio is great. My favorites were the fried eggs with minced tuna and the shrimp risotto. || Solid 7.5/10 We ordered the raw fish tacos, the star of the night! The scallops were good, but not wow. As for the crab baos, although tasty, I wish the bread hadn't been fried (it should have been plain). The cuttlefish risotto with grilled squid had too little squid - too much rice for the disappointing amount of squid - it could have been much more balanced, especially for the price of €25. The cocktails, Pisco Sour and Espresso Martini, were both great!! Overall, a good atmosphere and a good space for a dinner for two or with friends 😊 || Ideal for sharing. Great snacks, atmosphere and service! For me, one of the best options for those who want to have dinner on a terrace in Campo d'Ourique! || A very nice restaurant, excellent flavor and taste, very generous portions (the plate was full). Mirco, the waiter, was very friendly, available, and attentive to the customer. Excellent service; we 100% recommend this restaurant and will definitely be back for our next vacation. Thank you! || I came for dinner and had a really good meal. The staff was very kind and smiling. And from the tables you could even see the kitchen. Very satisfied. || Great tacos, mushroom skewers, and risotto. || Restaurant with a super pleasant atmosphere. Great food, very tasty, and excellent service.

It took them 2 hrs to get the mains on the table and when we complained about the long wait … || We were supposed to have free entry, but staff kept everyone waiting outside until after the deadline. When we were finally let in—just two minutes late—we were told we had to pay. While we were still deciding, the doorman suddenly acted …

In short, the night girls are not pretty and the place is exploitative. I went to the place by myself and ordered food and drank. In short, I had 2 beers and a shrimp dish. The price was 80 euros, but the reality was 30 euros. I do not recommend the place. The treatment is very good because of the money. It is normal. || Best night club in Lisbon. Must try the menu. Awesome food at late hours. Especially the pica-pau with cream sauce and the prawns in garlic. || Nice place but the waiters are not helpful and the girls are not the best || Excellent restaurant and club!! Highly recommended! || Ok but as all nightlife in lisboa is fulled of dealers || very nice , a bit expensive || Great club, interesting selection of girls || Nice girls & drinks..😁 … || I don’t recommend this place

Liboakot is genuinely one of the most unforgettable places I have visited in Lisbon. It is not a bar, not a club, not a hostel, but something in between that somehow captures the best energy of all three. The people there are incredibly warm and welcoming. You walk in and within minutes you feel like you have known everyone for years.  The atmosphere is wild in the best possible way. The parties go hard. Music everywhere, laughter, people cooking random things at strange hours, crazy stories starting in one room and ending in another. It is chaotic, but the kind of chaos that makes you smile for days after. They do make a lot of noise, so if you are looking for peace and quiet, this is not the place. If you want to feel alive, you are in the right spot.  You will probably drink more alcohol than planned. It feels like a rite of passage there, so be ready and pace yourself. Once you enter Liboakot, time becomes blurry. You forget the outside world. You meet people you never expected to meet. You share moments that feel completely out of this planet.  It is not a tourist attraction. It is more like a hidden dimension of Lisbon life. Everyone should experience it once. It is unique, warm, messy, human, and honestly one of the most legendary things you can do in this city || Hi, this place is a very welcoming and warm community. You can really be yourself here and express yourself without feeling judged… it’s such a good place for peace and self growth. And there are also amazing chefs who really make food that fuels your body and is good for the soul! I recommend this place so much if you ever feel the need to talk to someone. ✨✨✨ || A truly unforgettable spot. From the moment you walk in, the warm welcome makes you feel instantly at home and before you even know it, you officially become a GALÈREEE, part of the place’s unique spirit. Everything is always impeccably clean, the atmosphere is cozy, and the décor is full of charm. The team is incredibly kind, fun, and genuinely attentive, and there’s often a bit of spontaneous chaos that makes each visit feel special. It’s the kind of place you step into for a break and end up staying longer just because it feels so good. Absolutely a must-visit! || An absolute must-visit. The welcome is so warm. Always really clean, amazing folks, and unexpected entertainment at random hours, zero complaints. A quiet and cozy place with an amazing decoration. I would 100% recommend for anyone who is coming to Lisboa! || A place you really shouldn’t miss. The Team Croûtons is fantastic, everyone brings its own spice which greets you with genuine warmth. You might even stumble upon some spontaneous entertainment at unexpected times. It’s a peaceful, cozy spot with a décor that perfectly reflects this place vibe. I’d absolutely suggest it to anyone visiting Lisbon! || There’s something truly magical happening in this historical place. Somehow 11 of us historical statues ended up here together, and we get along soooo well it still feels unreal. Every day is filled with warmth, laughter, and the kind of growing friendships you don’t stumble upon often.  Every little corner is decorated with our own strange, original touches (nothing fancy, just full of soul) and it makes the whole place feel alive. The atmosphere couldn’t be better, it’s the kind of vibe you feel the second you walk in.  Highly recommend, whatever this historical place is, it’s special.  Sous melo, sous drama, become a galère whenever you enter an orteil in the commu with pumpin🤙🤙🤙 || If you’ve ever wondered what living inside a nightclub would feel like, look no further. The Belgian roommates here are dedicated professionals in the field of partying — truly committed to the craft. Music? Loud. Guests? Many. Sleep? Optional. A great place to stay if you enjoy chaos with a side of good beer. || A human, social and wonderfully unpredictable experience…  Days always more productive than the last: managing to start a load of laundry before noon, spending 45 minutes debating who touched the thermostat, and considering “going to buy bread” a mission worthy of an action movie😭🤣🤣 It was truly a pleasure to spend time in this place; we laughed a lot in an unpredictable atmosphere.  Special mention to Jules, a bit of parmesan in a raclette: unexpected, but we love him anyway😏😄😄 || Good old memories, don’t know if I should add photos and videos as google is offering me to || If Google allowed 100 stars, I’d still ask for more.  I had the best time of my life here and that’s saying something considering I literally opened my arcade sourcilière like a discount stunt double,  Blood? Drama? A majestic eyebrow split? Yes, all included. But fear not: they were the first to heal me, comfort me, patch me up, and basically treat me like a fallen hero returning from battle.  Their vibes were so strong they could probably power the Lisbon tram system for a week. I don’t know what they put in those drinks, but I was seeing colors I’m not even sure exist.  Highly recommend — 10/10 would injure myself here again for the vibes of these magnificent people.

Great time meeting Alex and everyone. Great energy as a pub host. Really impressed as it was my first time doing this. Loved the atmosphere 👌. I'd recommend every other pub crawl inspire to be more fun like Alex's crawl 😁 || For anyone that is trying to go out in Lisbon at night, be safe and actually meet new people and go to lots of bars and at the end a club? This Pub Crawl is the best one in Lisbon, Alex is the soul of it, the guide that everyone needs. He pays attention to everyone, doesn't leave anyone behind and he's pretty funny. This is where fun begins. || This pub crawl is golden. I Went back for second time. Nice atmosphere and vibe is created and maintained by Alex. Great guy and superb dancer. Challenge him for a dance 🕺 🫶🏾 || Had an amazing time on the Purple Lisbon Pub Crawl, and Alex was the highlight of the night! Super friendly, knowledgeable, and kept the energy high all evening. He made sure everyone was having a blast and showed us some great spots around the city. Highly recommend this crawl, especially if you want a fun night out with cool people || Excellent night out, we visited 3 bars, and a club with the PubCrawl group.  Alex was a great host, explained how everything would work and worked hard to make sure everyone was having a good time. The bars we went to had great vibes and drinks were flowing. Met some cool people from all over the world, danced a ton, and definitely got a taste of Lisbon nightlife. If you're looking for a fun way to explore the city after dark, highly recommend this crawl. Thanks Alex! || What an unforgettable night in Lisbon! This pub crawl was the perfect way to discover the city’s nightlife, meet new people, and enjoy great drinks. Our hosts were so friendly and energetic - they made everyone feel welcome right from the start)  If you’re in Lisbon and want an evening full of laughter, music, and good company, I couldn’t recommend this pub crawl more - an absolute must have to do! || Alex is spectacular. You are always safe and will have an amazing night. FYI I'm a local and joined for my friend that's visiting and we ended up going twice! || The pubs and the people you meet meanwhile were great, our guide alex was super easy going, and lead us to the right places!
