This is the first stop on my trip to Lisbon and I'm very happy indeed. || As travelers in Lisbon and natural wine lovers, we found this wine bar exceptional. We like the concept of no wine menu, just talk with the very kind, welcoming, calm, and knowledgeable sommeliers about your wine preferences, and they will let you try different wines until you find what you are searching for. I described the sommelier as “calm” because I mistakenly knocked the bottles of wine, which spilled about a glass on the floor, but he was genuinely calm and friendly. Their wine choices are great, and we were super blessed with what we tried. There are few food choices, but it's great for an after-dinner visit. || I loved this wine bar so much! It is vibrant, full of good wine choices, there is a park next to it where you can sit and enjoy your drink. Price per glass ranges from €6 to €20. The staff is cool, they let you sample wines before ordering and they also give you good recommendations. You can take tour glass to the park, but you need to leave a deposit. || Black Sheep Lisboa is a gem — an intimate, stylish wine bar with an outstanding selection and truly knowledgeable sommelier (also very handsome) bartenders. The staff pair wines with just the right notes and stories, making each pour feel curated. Cozy atmosphere, great small plates that complement the wines, and excellent recommendations whether you prefer natural, classic or adventurous bottles. A must-visit for anyone who loves wine and thoughtful service. Highly recommended. || Lots of wonderful memories at my favorite wine bar in Lisboa over the years. Yes the wine is always amazing, but the people even more so. Warm hearts always welcome you at Black Sheep—what makes it special. Obrigada || Amazing place I just discovered with a friend. We went to the side of the bar and were welcomed warmly. The bartender has a real knowledge about wine, switched between English and Portuguese with the two of us without any issue and has even told us more about the history of the bar and the owner.  Can’t remember the name of the bartender, but can’t wait to come back for moments like this || Black sheep is a gem. I loved that when I asked if "we could get weirder" with wine recommendations, we were brought a series of incredibly fun and funky wines. Black sheep delivers on everything -  local art, great wine recommendations, and unbeatable vibes. || What a shame. I moved to Lisbon the year this place opened, and I’ve watched it lose the soul it once had.  Tonight we went to Black Sheep for a friend’s celebration - 3 glasses, a few bottles, nothing complicated. When my friend left early, she returned her glass to the bar and even texted me to say so. Later, the staff insisted one glass was “missing” and refused to listen or consider anything we explained. We were charged for a glass we had already returned.  And here’s the thing: I understand the deposit system and why they use it. But when the system fails, the customer pays - even when the bar will inevitably find the glass later. That’s not just rigid, it’s getting money for something that wasn’t actually lost.  It wasn’t about the amount. It was the attitude: zero trust, zero curiosity, zero willingness to engage. Just a robotic “no.” It feels like customer care has been replaced by profit-first thinking.  If you want natural wine in the neighborhood, go to Magnolia or bring your own bottle to Praça das Flores. Black Sheep used to feel alive. Now it feels indifferent - guided more by turnover than by hospitality. || I cant give less than five stars. I went for the first time and got impressed by the service. They really know what they are talking about! They have a large variety of wines. Black sheep is usually crowded and almost impossible to have a seat on weekends. The tip here is to get there earlier so you can be able to have a full tasting experience while listen to the amazing stories of each bottle of wine you try! || Wonderful tiny wine bar serving “whatever we have open at the minute!” They let you taste a ton of wines to find one you love, and staff are super nice & knowledgeable. It can get packed so visit on a week day or just be patient. Totally worth it— the wine and vibes are amazing.

I’m the type of traveler who seeks out oyster bars in every country I visit. In Lisbon, there seem to be two main ones in the city center, and this spot definitely stands out. Unlike the more formal venues, here you can truly enjoy the oysters in a relaxed, casual atmosphere that lets their natural flavor shine.  Their signature sauces are absolutely unique — flavors you simply can’t find anywhere else. The three bartenders were all incredibly kind and attentive.  And above all, the cocktails here are unlike anything you’ll get elsewhere. If you love oysters and enjoy a good drink, this is a place in Lisbon you must visit. || If you’re into great cocktails and fresh oysters, this place is an absolute must! The drinks are expertly made, and the oysters are always top quality.  Anyone who loves tasty drinks and oysters will definitely fall in love with this spot! || Really nice and friendly staff! "Oyster hour" between 18-19 when they cost 1.5 EUR each. Great drinks both on and off the drink menu. Recommended! || Very cool bar serving excellent in house and classic cocktails. We had recommendations for cocktails from the staff and they were excellent. Very prompt and attentive service. Oysters were incredibly fresh. || Im a place person, so not only i look for a good drinks but also the general vibe. This place hit every spot with excellence. Awesome team, awesome tunes, really original and outstanding oysters. Their mocktails are to die for. Whenever i want to chill out or bring friends i always have this place in my mind. || Great bar with wonderful drinks, both classic and exclusive like the one with mezcal. || Our favourite place in Lisbon! The oysters are perfect, cocktails inventive and strong. Staff are always helpful and great music. || Absolutely amazing, great atmosphere, perfect oysters, great cocktails. That’s one of the must bars! || Very good cocktails and very weird place to have an oister. Si with this purposal they won our curiosity. And honestly we gave it a go and it was weird, but very cool.  Definetly will come back! || Great service, oysters were amazing, music and ambiance highly recommended

A beautiful little bar in Lisbon. The decor is straight out of a movie. You walk in and forget where you are. It is an intimate space and I recommend booking in advance if possible. The prices are ok ok the cocktails and I thought they were generous on the amounts. Definitely work a stop! || Hi Donnie, Thank you very much for your visit and kind rating.  See you soon 🍾🍾 … || Fantastic little bar. Hidden amongst houses you need to ring the door bell and you're taken out of Lisbon and into a drinkers where time stands still. Decorated with traditional artworks and decor this place is a must for even just a night cap. Host was friendly and service was excellent || Hi Samantha, thank you so much for your visit and kind words. See you soon. Cheers 🍷🍹 … || Strange place, mostly English speaking people come with non-english staff. Drink menu consists of very old-fashioned cocktails, I guess keeping with the theme. It is a very photogenic space, small, quiet so when you talk everyone can hear. I guess it was fine for one visit. I would not come here for dinner, didn't look like they have a "real" kitchen. || Hello Jane, Hello! Procópio thanks you for your visit and informs you that we are a bar classified as a shop with history by the Lisbon City Council, having existed as such for 53 years and not as a restaurant. Our staff, in addition to English, communicate in French, Spanish, Catalan, German and of course Portuguese. Regarding our clientele, we are a bar frequented mostly by Portuguese people, with a small presence of native speakers of foreign languages. See you soon, Cheers 🍸🍸 || What a great intimate place!! Love the decoration ❤️ || Hello House, Procópio thanks you for your visit and kind review. See you soon! Cheers 🥂🥂 … || We loved this place, went on our first night is Lisbon and returned for more drinks on another night. Friendly service, good prices, fabulous cocktails in a fun atmosphere. Bravo 👏 || Hi Matthew, thank you so much for your kind and inspiring words. It's comforting to have feedback from our customers. See you soon, and we look forward to your next visit. Cheers 🍸🍾🍸🍾 … || Great spot for a cocktail! A bit hidden from the main street, after passing by the cute outside area the red door reveals this cozy 1920s inspired cocktail bar. The tables and seats are nice comfortable, the decoration is fun and campy, the menu offer a wide range of drinks that are made pretty fast, the price is fair. || Hi Nathan, thank you so much for your kind words and review. See you soon! Cheers 🥂 … || A fun little bar tucked away in Lisbon filled with interesting decor in a warm, wooden setting. Great drinks and kind service. The crowd is very local so if we respect that, you should be good. || Olá John, I'm glad you liked our space and had fun. We strive to make Procópio a magical place where the clients have the best service and great drinks. Until next time Chears ✨️🍾✨️ … || Good ambiance inside and outdoors. Located in a calm and quiet neighborhood of Lisbon. The lady owner is very friendly and knows how to receive guests/customers. Drinks are reasonably priced and so as the food. Minor cleaning of the area and sofa can be done for optimum cozy bar experience || Dear Mundo, Thank you for the evaluation and nice words. It was lovely to have you here. Hope too  see you soon!🥂 … || What a lovely place. Little door (akin to an house), to knock on in order to get in. Very friendly atmosphere, great service, not expensive. Try the local drinks you won't be disappointed. Absolutely tip top, with a lot of history about the place (think 1890s for planning purposes etc) It's a must visit. || Thank you so much for your kind words and beautiful photos. We are happy you had such a great time with us. Hope to see you soon! Cheer's 🥂 … || Proscopio bar is warm and cozy with an old English styled antique type setting. The place is dimly lit and there are a few small tables and chairs spread out throughout the bar. It’s like stepping back in time. There is seating outside as well as inside. The service is good and the staff was nice. We ordered the Pisco sour and an Aperol spritz. Both drink were pretty good and overall we had a nice time here. Thumbs up for Proscopio bar. || Thank you for your nice words. We are truly happy you had a wonderful time with us. Cheers 🥂 …

Had an amazing lunch here! The food was delicious and full of authentic Portuguese flavor — everything tasted homemade and fresh. The staff were super friendly and made us feel right at home. You can tell it’s a place locals love, and for good reason. Definitely one of the best meals I’ve had in Lisbon — highly recommended! || Visited twice on a very time limited trip. Totally recommend for authentic old school Portugese food served as if you are dining with your own family (if you have a kind family that's interested in the taste of the food that they serve you). || Called Imperial, but everyone calls it “Tasca do João” because of the amazingly kind hearted man, João, who runs the restaurant with his wife and daughter. All the food is exceptional, and all the waiters are genuinely interested in if you are enjoying yourself. João is up every early morning, to open the restaurant and smiles at everyone walking by. I love this place so much. Please give this kind old man some customers, you won’t regret going, and trust me, you will want to go back! || This place is absolutely perfect! As a chef of 25 years I can say that I had one of the best things I have ever ate here. It is simple, honest and amazing cooking. The service is perfect and everything about the restaurant is great l. Can’t wait to come back every time I’m in Lisbon. || Thank you Michel Robins || This was the best meal I’ve ever had in Lisbon. The traditional Portuguese food was simple yet perfect and the owners were supremely accommodating. I cannot wait to go on my next visit! || Amazing spot! The food was absolutely delicious; real, authentic homemade Portuguese dishes full of flavor. The hospitality was just as memorable. The older host, despite a bit of a language barrier, kindly guided us not only through the menu but also showed us how to properly enjoy the dishes. Both the food and the warm welcome made for a truly special experience. It’s a perfect place if you want something authentic and a break from the more touristic spots. Will definitely stop by again next time I’m in Lisbon. || This is one of the best tascas in Lisbon. The food is spectacular, from the famous chanfana (a stew of tender goat meat simmered in an insanely delicious sauce) to the seasonal sardines. The bolo de bolacha is also fantastic. It’s a towering slice, layered with cream instead of butter, so you feel like you can get away with eating another. Another highight about this place is the heartwarming hospitality provided by Sr. João and his family. They were so incredibly friendly when I dined here last year and, when I returned again this year, not only did they remember me but offered me a glass of wine on the house. It’s no wonder this place is so beloved by Lisboetas. || Typical family-run Portuguese restaurant, where you can eat simple and abundant traditional dishes. The hospitality made us feel at home. The owner is a bomb full of energy! I hope we’ ll return one day || This was one of our favourite dining experiences. The food was spectacular - we had the goat stew - and we felt like we were welcomed like family. A wonderful place to visit at with wonderful people. || The experience one has in this restaurant is beyond eating. 2 Portuguese men serving textbook execution of seasonal and local recipes. I'm sure the kitchen team is just as amazing as the front, considering how great even the side rice was.  Thank you for telling your story through food the way you do!

Great for a quick stop and a beer. The owner was a very nice guy. || The best spot for drinks and beer 🍻 Lovely owner ♥️ … || Amazing beer joint :) || I don’t even know what this place is. Very nice. || Nice prices, lovely host! And he really does look like Rudy Giuliani. || Great Kiosk to enjoy beer and Peanuts. Great Service. Enjoy going here || Amazing place for cheap drinks! The owner is a lovely elder man. Totally recomend ❤️ || Even Rudy Giuliani doesn't know the location of his secret bar! || This is the nicest place in Lisbon to have a drink and enjoy the time || very nice spot running by a very cute gentleman. highly recommended

Wow. 🤯 this Bar is AN EXPERIENCE! It felt like walking into an escape room themed around the 1920s–1930s (the kind that completely pulls you into its story and atmosphere).The effort put into the design and decoration is unmatched! (You can even catch little sneak peeks of the Halloween elements, so perfectly blended into the space.)  The service was personal and respectful. I wanted a Sex on the Beach, but they didn’t have the ingredients, so I asked to be surprised with something similar and it turned out quite yummy.  Music is always important for me when choosing places, and when we were there, they were playing relaxing sort of jazz, super chill and perfectly fitting for the luxurious, slightly historical vibe.  The cocktails were around €13 each, if I’m not mistaken (not cheap, but not too expensive either). Honestly, I didn’t mind paying that, because it felt like I was paying for the experience as much as the drinks.  Really recommended if this is the vibe you’re looking for it nails it perfectly! || Atmosphere: 8.5/10 The Royal Vessel Bar blends a cozy restaurant-style atmosphere with subtle ship and pirate-inspired design touches. Music is at a good level, the backbar stands out as the focal point, and seating is well arranged with both bar counter spots and group tables.  Drinks: 8/10 Recommendation: Iberica The menu comes in a red book-style format—simple, but stylish. Selection is small, yet the cocktails are well-executed with good flavor balance. Glassware is above average, though presentation overall remains basic with no garnish and no coasters.  Service: 6.5/10 Water isn’t served on arrival. The team is friendly and professional, but attentiveness leaves room for improvement. Reservations aren’t needed. Prices lean slightly above average for Lisbon. || I celebrated my birthday at this bar, and it was absolutely amazing! The atmosphere is incredible - cozy and stylish, with dim lighting that creates the perfect mood for a relaxed evening.  The cocktails are top-notch 🔥 creative, well-balanced, and beautifully presented. I was especially impressed by the wide selection of not only cocktails but also mocktails. the non-alcoholic options are just as flavorful and thoughtfully crafted.  There are also some light snacks available, which pair nicely with the drinks. I’ll definitely be coming back, this place is perfect both for special occasions and a chill night out with friends. || The best non-alcoholic cocktails in Lisbon. I fully recommend to try Virgin porn star and Saint margarita. The bartender was very kind and attentive. I will definitely come back to try the other cocktails || Beautiful, atmospheric bar with décor that feels straight out of a Fitzgerald novel. The Mist of Sintra was fresh and tasty, but the Silk Road was my favorite! || It’s a very classy bar with beautiful authentic interior. Small, but very very cozy. Cocktails were great and the bartenders were friendly, funny and professional. They almost don’t have classic cocktails on the menu but they are happy to make ones if you ask. I loved the atmosphere of the bar and I am definitely going to return! || We had such a great time at the bar, huge thanks to Zhenya from Uzbekistan! He made the evening unforgettable. Every cocktail he suggested was perfect for each of us, like he instantly knew what everyone would love. We ended up chatting in Portuguese, English, Russian, and Ukrainian, it was such a fun mix and the vibe was amazing.  Zhenya even made me a special cocktail, not from the menu, just based on my preferences, and it turned out incredible. 🍸 Definitely one of the bars, we'll come back to and recommend to our friends! || Super sad I discovered it one day before leaving… it is a must! Just share what you want, the atmosphere is beautiful and the cocktails are amazing! Thank you! || I had a fantastic experience at The Royal Vessel Bar. Not only are the cocktails genuinely amazing, but the staff were absolute stars. There was a girl who was clearly very drunk and being bothered by a creepy guy who wouldn’t leave her alone. As soon as the team realised what was happening, they stepped in straight away and were exceptional — calm, professional, and completely on it.  They handled everything with real care and escalated it to the authorities in exactly the right way. I’d gone over to check on her too, and the staff even thanked me and gave me a drink for helping. Honestly, such a brilliant bar on every front — fantastic drinks, great atmosphere, and a team who genuinely look out for their guests. Couldn’t recommend it more. Five stars. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Great cocktail card and lovely staff, the best atmosphere. Besides ordering things from the menu, you can also ask to make a custom cocktail to your liking. One of my favorite places in Lisbon.

Delirium Cafe was created for those who like Belgian ales and other strong beers alike. … || Fantastic bar with such an incredible selection of beers! I'm a big fan of Belgium beer so coming here was a must for me. There is a wide selection of beers to choose from, including non Belgium beers for those wanting … || Nice craft beer bar. Loads of high quality beers for reasonable price. They have Table service 😊 Only thing it's was pretty chilly inside. We had to keep our coats on. We visited late December. … || I loved this place. The beer and food are delicious and fresh. The staff was busy on Saturday night, so I had to wait for drinks. But the interior, the tables on the balcony, and the music are great. I will definitely come back! || Simply amazing! The place is amazing, friendly, the beer options are insane, and they're soooo good. Raul gave a crashcourse on biers and proposed the best ones I ever tried. Thank you! Will come back (if possible) times again! And they have a nice pool. Canadians, hear me out: this is the place to be! || Nice place to chill! Especially when the weather is good and you can sit on the tiny balcony. First time we went here, many beers were not available (it was a Monday night). The second time they did have everything we asked for (Friday night). || This is a fantastic place in the center of the city, great selection of beers, nice calm atmosphere. It’s got a price tag with it but not extortionate. … || One of the nicest pubs I've ever visited in my life. Beautiful ambience and top Belgian beers. The only problem I have is the price. It doesn't have to be much more expensive than in Belgium. Nevertheless, a recommendation from me for this beautiful place || I found this place on recommendation from my travel company. It was just the right place to spend a hot Monday afternoon after a long day of travel. I chose a quaint short table with two stools in window, open to the street. The menu was … || A lot of beers to drink, great food and service. If you’re visiting Lisbon and want o to drink good beers and eat well that’s the place. || One of my favourite pub chains of all time! Such a great selection of beer, all of which can be browsed via the QR code on each table. This is also how you can pay your bill. However, orders must be placed with the staff, all of whom are … || It's been years since I've had this beer, my taste buds have definitely changed. I don't like sweet beers. Nice place to people watch and I think the pool table is free. || Famous beer! Never disappoints. No wait. Great view. Great service. || Very nice staff in a place which has a great atmosphere and some awesome balcony. The food is huge and very delicious. They have a lot a beers on tap and also in bottles. Very-very recommended! || I didn't have any of the food, but the atmosphere and location was great || Not at the same level as the cafe in Brussels but still very very good.  Great interiors and atmosphere and top top beers! || Poor - very poor. From a brusque and unfriendly welcome to be told to ‘dance, dance’ by a passing manager to trigger the motion sensors in the loos (no soap by the way - ugh), I just felt very unwelcome. There are far better craft beer pubs in Lisbon - I’d give this one a miss. || Loud, lots of people, good drinks, quick service, many TVs to watch the food, very friendly staff and great decor. A brilliant night out at Delirium in Lisbon. || visited this bar last night and had an absolutely incredible experience. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the staff made the night truly special. There was one employee in particular who stood out — incredibly kind, attentive, and … || I went to Delirium cafe excited thinking there was a beer Cantillon but unfortunately they didn’t have any.. here’s what i had.. the food was good and service is interesting: the seat you, the menu is online then you order with a waiter then you pay online.

The churros are amazing. Recommed also club sandwich. The staff are very kind. Beautiful experience and beautiful view || Thank you for your feedback Tanz, we are glad you enjoyed it. Hope to have you around again soo :) || After the Time Out Market Paulicarus found this small roof top venue. Only holds about 40. Madge bought me a cairphreni (?) Pleasant enough cocktail. A nice breeze and a lovely waitress. Toilets on way in on ground floor. || Super great ambiance! The music was so good and perfect for a beer on a sunny rooftop 🌞 As a tourist, I loved the chill ambiance and the good beer. The bartender was super great, service was quick and personalized. I love to chat when I'm traveling and that's what I had. I highly recommend if you want to have a drink to good ambiance on a rooftop. || This place has a soul! This place is a co-opt with the church to fun community initiatives. The owner of the bar convinced the priest to let him  open the church Terrance as a bar to help fund the church programmes like the youth group, drama club, church services and more. || This terrace is the perfect spot if you love good food and great cocktails. It’s cozy, vibrant, and ideal for bringing friends. Highly recommend! || Good to know that the famous San Ginés chocolateria is in Lisbon with their famous churros with chocolate and also a rooftop! Will be back A LOT! 🥰 || Amazing small and cozy bar! Recommend for large groups that want to take over a whole bar! || Head to 1894 roof garden for a really chill vibe, cool people and super friendly bar tender - shout-out to Patricia who chilled our beer glasses to ice cold! It was our first time but we will be sure to be back and we are excited to work our way through the rest of the drinks and food menu!! A relaxed fun vibe in what we think is the heart of Lisbon! We will be bringing our friends next time! || Amazing bar. Carla treated us so well, the playlist was perfect and the drinks were immaculate! || Thank you for your feedback Chris! I will ensure Karla gets it, I’m sure it will make here day ;) || sweet, cozy rooftop bar with great cocktails and tapas. They also serve Madrid-style churros and chocolate. Service was impeccable and very friendly.

Great food and nice portions. Staff is super nice from the man that serves to the really sweet woman working at the bar. And the food is so good. I had a robalo with potatoes and a really good mixed vegetables situation. Two thumbs up. || The Cantinho is relaxed and feels local. The food is great and Rodrigo offers all attention to deliver a local foody portguese experience. || An unassuming neighbourhood restaurant that really delivers on both food and service. Every dish was perfect, quality ingredients cooked with skill. Warm, friendly and professional easy going service made for a memorable family meal || fantastic place, the steak and bacalhau are superb, but my favorite is still the Polvo || Tried dining in (family and guest entertainment), take out and delivery countless times. Dog friendly owner with English speaking staff. Steady home made gourmet delight with authentic Portuguese ingredients. Been entertaining guest here so many times with only amazing feedbacks. It might not be the most mind-blowing Portuguese dining experience ever, but it is that good old classical steady, reliable home made charm that not just my tongue - but  my stomach also -  can trust. The magic that keeps me , my family and friends coming back. || Delicious food. We don't speak Portugese, but the staff was very helpful to us and offered to translate the menu. || Super recommend! Great cozy spot to have a drink and a bite. Very nice service too! || My worst meal in Portugal!  We ordered food from this place via Uber Eats and we couldn't eat it. We threw most of it away unfortunately.  The cod fish was frozen (not fresh) and not fully cooked, it tasted horrible. It was served with some spinach, again from the freezer and was not fully cooked.  Shrimps were also frozen and of terrible quality.  Shame that they serve such a poor quality to their customers. || This place is a hidden gem in campo de Ourique! Every dish is delicious but the best is the picanha with pineapple! The owner Rodrigo is an amazing host and entrepreneur! I love it this is one of our regular !!!! || Second visit this year! Very delicious Portuguese octopus. Although some price increase compared to earlier this year (inflation, of course), the octopus simply was  very good, just a little over burnt today.

place_name: Red Nose Natural Wine Bar and Shop
reviews_content: A hidden gem in the heart of Campo de Ourique.  On a hot summer’s day, we stepped into this cozy little wine shop and were … || Red Nose Bar is the spot if you’re into wine and good times. They’ve got an awesome selection— sip whatever and everything they suggest, tastes good, you’ll find something special. … || Very groovy wine bar. No wine menu, so you tell the host what wine you are after, they give you a few to try and you chose the one you want - loved it! The wine glasses are really nice too - which always makes the wine taste better 😅 … || Very cosy wine bar, we had our first natural wine here thanks to the kind staff! || Great selection of European wines. I tried Portuguese wines and got excellent recommendations. Unfortunately, I didn’t get a chance to try the food. || Thank a lot! We are refreshing our tapas menu soon and hope you will back to try with cool wines! || Gorgeous natural wine bar in the charming Campo de Ourique area of Lisboa! I loved the choice of wines — including excellent non-alcoholic options — and the relaxed, welcoming atmosphere created by the team. The sommelier will help you … || Very nice wine bar (natural wines mostly). Good choose of the different wines, which you could try and choose the better for you. … || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're thrilled that you enjoyed our selection of natural wines and the food pairings. Wishing you all the best and hope to see you again soon! || It's always a good idea to pick one glass or bottle of natural wine here. Friendly staff, good vibe and any kind of taste could be satisfied || Top notch service, not only incredibly knowledgeable and professional, but also relax and extremely generous, with an impressive offer and fair and clear prices. Relax environment and very enjoyable experience. Highly recommended if you are looking to try good quality wines from all over the world! || Thank you for your kind words! We're thrilled to hear that you enjoyed our relaxed environment and global wine selection, and we can't wait to welcome you back! || The staff is very lovely and they have a great selection of good wines! I cannot recommend this place enough🙌🏻 … || Great selection of wine and not only limited to natural wine! Staffs were friendly and helpful! This shop deserves more appreciation! || Thanks a lot, really appreciated || Nastia was an amazing host, great wine selection and delicious Kurdish food pop-up. Great experience overall || Well, what can I say? I really liked it here. It's very friendly, and the selection is excellent! Thank you — let's stay in touch! || Very interesting selection of wines, with a particular focus on the natural category. || Grazie! Obrigada! Thank you so much! || Great spot to try cool wine and food! || If you like natural wines the selection here is impressive. Mind you they don't come cheap. || Amazing viby place with quality natural wines and the most kind attentive knowledgeable service from Sergei 🙏🏼 … || Great selection of local and foreign natural wine, tasty and fresh dishes , nice music, jazz/funk genre, soft redlights inside and a cosy environment with welcoming owners. Recommended! || Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed our selection of natural wines, dishes, and the cozy atmosphere we strive to create at Red Nose. Your recommendation means a lot to us. Looking forward to welcoming you again soon! || Great wine, owner and even sparkling water! Friendly and also got to try their new menu which was ace || Highly recommend, so glad we found this place on our last night in Lisbon. Great selection of wines, tasty food and very friendly service. Can’t wait to go again next time we are in Lisbon. || Thank you so much. Hope to see you again soon!

A cute little outdoor place to grab a bite and/or tasty beverage while passing time or waiting for the tram. The staff is very friendly. The atmosphere with the background music is very relaxing. || this place, its kind of end of the line. Literally, end of the line 28 of the tourist tram. Small plaza, a playground and a cemetery. Nothing much else. And then there is this Quiosque, an oasis with something to drink and to nibble. Food is prepared fresh by 2 friendly women. Really relaxed in there after this tram ride in narrow streets. Highly recommended if you are looking for some Portuguese pastries. There is a restroom and an ATM. This place deserves a nice building instead of a container || Local place for food and drinks, nice look, tasty burgers and cool amtosphere || They are sooo nice and the food is amazing, i would recommend the burgers and the burrata salad || I cannot give 6 stars for the outstanding service! It was a pleasure to drink, eat, rest, talk and enjoy! Thank you so much for making our day special! Hope this place will be there once we get back here next time! ♥️ || Absolutely lovely quiosque. The service by all employees was great. Everybody had a smile on their face. While what we had was simple (4 cheese tostada), it was also delicious!  The place is well decorated and the music was great! || Surprisingly good! While waiting for the 28 tram, we had the Italian salad and avocado toast.. delicious. Price is good, service is also great. || Friendly.  Cold tap.  Vodka.  Orange cake. || Best quiosque in town!!!! So cozy in winter and so fresh in summer!!!! Service is great, food is amazing and the staff it’s just (how it should be) incredible, the best In town literally 🔥 thank you so much for an amazing experience! || Surprisingly excellent little place for a nibble and drink. Simple fare, made fresh and served with a smile and good attitude.

Fantastic find, quirky, delicious cocktails and amazing staff who explained the cocktails we ordered. Nibbles served with drinks and a small drink provided with the bill. A small, wonderful place with an outdoor seating area also. || Great cocktail bar. Whole experience from start to finish is made fantastic by the host who ensures you're always receiving top quality service. Cocktails are all unique and full of character. The space and atmosphere is perfect. Well worth a visit for anyone in Lisbon || The cocktails and ambiance were amazing! Not surprised as they are the same owners as Paradiso in Spain. I had the Negroni which was the best I ever had. The service was warm and helpful, we had such a good evening here. I’m sure they will be very busy soon so get a table now while you can. || Lovely bar. The drinks all had themed twists and clearly well thought out, tasting great too. The server we had was a delight; attentive, held great conversation with us and talked us through the drinks. || This place isn’t just a bar — it’s an experience. Each cocktail is a bold, imaginative creation that pushes the boundaries of mixology, blending unexpected ingredients with stunning presentation.  The staff are passionate, the vibe is electric, and the creativity is off the charts. If you're looking for a cocktail adventure, this is a must-visit when in Lisbon!  Thank you Davide for a fun evening filled with incredible cocktails and a great conversation. We will be back! || This little bar is right across from Numa Lisbon Rato & a grocery store and next to a synagogue! Salsa music was blasting on the outdoor patio when I rode by on an e- bike & I just had to stop to see what it was all about. At first glance I didn’t notice but there are many non- alcoholic drink options which is amazing for those of us who don’t drink! The flavors were incredible and the host is so friendly. He is Italian. While I was there I heard a variety of languages including English (UK & US) and Spanish. What an incredible experience. The only down side is that everyone smokes on the patio. || We had the absolute pleasure of visiting this charming little cocktail bar and it became the highlight of our trip. The tip here is to get there earlier so you can be able to have a full tasting experience while listen to the amazing stories of each bottle of wine you try! || Wonderful tiny wine bar serving “whatever we have open at the minute!” They let you taste a ton of wines to find one you love, and staff are super nice & knowledgeable. The owner are so kind and knowledgeable about wines. The place is great to sit and have a glass of wine and even talk to people around you. The environment is super social and you never know who you’re gonna meet. Love this place. Seriously a hidden gem of Lisbon. Whether it’s there wide range of great low intervention wines or just their friendly charm you will surely find you’re welcome here. || Tiny natural wine bar with the best staff! Get a wine to have inside on a stool at the bar, or get a reusable takeaway cup from them to sit in the square across the lane! || Great wine bar. Pick up a glass , walk into the garden 🪴 play with a few dogs 🐕. What more can you want! Oh they charge a deposit for the wine glasses which I think was odd considering it’s plastic glasses. || Amazing experience! Staff is super friendly, professional and knowledgeable about wines (and they can carry 6 bottles in their hands at once!). Cozy ambiance and reasonable prices. No menu as they change assortment all the time and recommend you personally which wines you could like. || One o Lisbon's best Wine Bars... fantastic hosts and lots of wine and champagne... great new place, modern and just right next door to the old classic Black Sheep... Great wines, great champagne, great crew and great multicultural atmosphere... Must not miss! Cheers 🥂🍷🍾🥳 || This review is long overdue! One of my favorite places in Lisbon, a wine bar that feels like home. The staff is amazing, knowledgeable and the nicest people. You can even go by yourself and I’m sure you’ll make a new friend! Don’t go expecting a wine list, stay open to their suggestions, let them know your likes and dislikes and I’m sure you’ll be happy! || Don’t come in looking for a menu! Come in looking for a wine journey and experience! We had such a great time here with the knowledgeable staff who asked preferences and then blew our minds with some excellent wine choices and service!  Love those cheeky washrooms as well. Lol. || Adorable little wine bar. The owners are incredibly knowledgeable in local Portuguese wines, which you will most likely miss if you don't visit this amazing wine bar. Would highly recommend making a stop before or after your dinner at least once, as we went twice! We also purchased a bottle of our favourite sparkling wine we've ever had.  Drink by the glass, enjoy a tasting curated by the Sommelier or take home a bottle of your favourite. Which ever choose you won't be disappointed! || Thank you for your lovely review! We're glad you had a good time in Lisbon. See you next time! || I can’t say enough good things about this wine bar. They serve mostly natural wine and will find you something you like, every time. The people who work here are some of the best people I’ve met. They’ve all become very close friends with me, just like they do with most. They know so much about wine and really care to make sure you drink wine that you like.  If you’re in Lisbon, stop by. It’s worth it and I promise you won’t be disappointed. || Wonderful place . You know is packed for a good reason . This is the place to go to have awesome wines . Everyone working here is amazing and they have done an amazing job making this place so beautiful. I had a great time tried delicious wines and just overall the best wine bar I have seen . || Cute tiny little wine bar that’s down to earth. You tell them what you like and every single time they let you try three different wines to pick! They’re friendly but not fake and will tell you all they know about each wine. Not an intimidating wanky wine bar! || Provides different kinds of the wine tasting. And their staff would introduce the detail information of the wine. Reasonable price. || Our friendly uber driver recommended this place to us and it was a hit! Great little bar with some inside seating but also a to-go counter where you can just grab a bottle of wine and some plastic cups to drink it with your friends out on the street! Great selection of wines and they let you try them all before you decide on one. Super friendly and not expensive. Great vibe on the lively square right outside so we actually preferred to get the bottle to go and drink it on the street! Absolutely recommend this place for anyone who loves wine! || Fantastic in every regard. Friendly, knowledgeable staff who are happy to chat to you and guide you through the selections available (which are varied and delicious). The space is cool and trendy, but no one is concerned with other guests or appraising them; everything is super relaxed. Had an absolutely delicious orange pet nat from Aprt3.  The little kiosk where you can grab a glass to drink on the street/park is super cool too.  Absolutely our new favourite in Lisboa || The best wine bar that I have ever been to. Incredible service, knowledgeable staff, fantastic wines that you cant get anywhere else. I know lots of folks mentioned taking a bottle and sitting outside. I think for locals, with friends, thats a great option. For visitors and wine enthusiasts, definitely try to snatch an inside seat. Talk to the staff and try a bunch of wines || Loved this wine bar. The staff were extremely knowledgeable and appreciated that you could order by the half glass, which allowed me to try more delicious wines. You can also take your wine across the road to a little park. || Couldn’t get over the bartenders/ sommeliers who take you through a wine tasting tour from behind the bar as they guide you towards the glass that’s right for you. Huge shout out to ‘Anu’, made it a great experience for myself and friends. || Probably one of the best wine BARS in the world, always an  amazing atmosphere,  very knowledgeable staff and no doubt the best wine selection in portugal. When I return to lisbon I will plan my stay according to the days that they are open 😁 … || OMG! I don’t know how is it possible that I haven’t reviewed my favorite wine bar! Shame on me! Amazing people, big knowledge, huge passion and great wines. The best wine bar in the world! || Great experience and some very good wines. You can say what type of wine you like and the bartender lets you taste some before making a choice. We love trying cocktail rooms wherever we go, tried this one and it REALLY hit the spot. Best owners, very kind, great vibes - extremely relaxed. The drinks were solid - will hold their own against any cocktail room anywhere. We had the smoky margarita, negroni, a Caribbean inspired drink (forgot the name) and the Black Forest.  Shout out to the Black Forest, that was one VERY well made drink! Completely recommend. Host made us taste her favorite drink - I think it was called the Nikkei Milk Punch and I must say that one was extremely well balanced and beautiful as well.  Best part of the space for us were all the 🐶s visiting, completely made our evening! || Atmosphere: 8/10 Located in Lisbon’s Graça district. Very chill, home-style vibe—cozy, comfortable, music at a good level. Backbar is okay. Seating is limited: no bar counter, a few indoor tables, plus some patio seats.  Drinks: 8.5/10 Recommendation: Black Forrest, Pineapple Express Menu is simple. Selection is decent. Flavors are good. Coasters are nice; glassware is average; garnish is nice. Presentation is okay overall, with unique ice on select serves.  Service: 8.5/10 Water on arrival. Team is friendly, professional, and attentive. Prices are average for Lisbon. Reservations not needed. || Proper crafted cocktails in a small, cozy and we'll appointed space. Joanna and Peter create lovely drinks and provide personal service. I had a lovely milk punch which was perfectly balanced.  Its a good idea to make reservations. We will definitely go again. || Booked Onda to grab a quick pre-dinner drink and we ended up going a bit early and I’m so happy we did!  We got to try four different cocktails and they were so good and so creative! The space was also really cool - loved the decor and the owners were really sweet. || Had an amazing time here and really enjoyed getting to know the owners and hearing their stories and recommendations.  We loved it so much we closed out both of our nights in Lisbon here.  If you are looking for a great cocktail and a relaxing chill atmosphere this is the place to go! || This was hands-down our favorite cocktail bar in the city. It’s a laid back atmosphere where the husband/wife owners attend to the customers with passion and dedication. It’s clear that they love what they do. In my opinion, this establishment is better than Red Frog. The Nikkei Milk Punch was my favorite. You won’t find anything like it elsewhere; it’s one-of-a-kind. Don’t pass up the opportunity to visit, but do make a reservation. || What do you know about cocktails? 🍸✨ Forget everything you think you know! 😎 Because here, a whole new world will open up to you — a world of amazing flavors, aromas, adventures, and people who are truly in love with what they do! 💫🌍💃  Every sip is a little journey 🌴🍹 — through taste, through passion, through creativity! 💥 Whether you’re into something classic, bold, or totally unexpected, they’ll create the perfect cocktail just for you! 🍒🍍🍋  This place isn’t just about drinks — it’s about emotions, art, and pure joy! 💖✨ So dive in, explore, and let yourself be amazed by this ocean of cocktails! 🌊🍸🔥  Cheers to unforgettable moments! 🥂😄🍹 || Thank you so much for your visit and review. We hope you can come by this week for the tasting experience before you go home. 🍸🍸🍸 … || I’ve gone to Onda multiple times, and have always had a nice time.  I lived here as a student (American so do take that into account with my opinions on prices) for about a year and visited multiple times throughout my stay. A few times I went for drinks (sometimes alcoholic and sometimes not, they have amazing options for both) and once for a cocktail making class which was a super fun experience!  It’s a place to go if you want nice cocktails. They’re well made and super unique, so though they aren’t the cheapest, the prices  are by no means unreasonable and are on par with a lot of other places I’ve been to. I loved the smoky margarita, as well as the Thai infused alcohol (I don’t remember the name) which was one of the best cocktails I’ve had.  Would recommend and planning on going again soon as I’m visiting for the holidays! || I can't speak too much to the food but I can speak to the lovely couple who own the place and took us on a journey of many cocktails. Easily a true highlight of Lisbon and something I would recommend anyone who enjoys the finer spirits and what magic they might contain. Do yourself a favor take a friend or six to the cocktail flight, and if you enjoy whiskey talk to Peter the owner into giving you a master class in Whiskeys around the world. || Drinks are crafted with perfection. Flavor explosion balanced with eased shoulders. Cheers for the memorable experience.

Great craft beer bar, it's a bit out of the way and the approach feels a bit grimy but worth trying it out. The lady behind the bar was very cheerful and helpful and the beers were delicious. There was a considerable din (loud music) coming from the neighbours but we still managed to hear each other. It's a fun location with a great choice. || Once you have climbed the steep and narrow streets surrounding this place, you deserve a cold one. This is really your neighborhood bar! Super friendly service. I had expected maybe a few more beers on tap, but what the taps don't have you can easily find on cans in the fridge. So sip and enjoy and see if you can spot something you know from the over-plastered fridge! || We weren’t particularly impressed by the beers on offer (I prefer strong/dark beers of which there were none) and the stronger beer I tried a taster of and then ordered was off (NEiPA). Hence we only stayed for one drink where as we would usually have stayed for two/three. A disappointing experience but would return again to see if the beer offering has improved. || Thanks for taking the time to leave your feedback. We really appreciate it. We usually always have a dark beer on tap, most often a Stout or a Porter. In fact, at the moment we’re the only craft beer bar in Lisbon serving a Nitro Stout properly poured with nitrogen and its dedicated tap. In addition to our tap list, our fridge is always stocked with a wide selection of dark styles in cans and bottles from great breweries. While our taps rotate frequently, we always try to keep a balanced selection that covers many styles. Hopefully, next time you visit, we can help you find something that fits your taste better from our full menu, we’ll be happy to have you back! || We stopped in while walking around Alfama and we are glad we did. A great selection of beers especially to change up after drinking Super Bock and Sagre.  Service was also very good. || Realy nice place to have superb beer! The bartender was nice, knew about the beers very well, was able to help with choosing and offered samples to taste. Selection of 10 beers on tap and many more bottles/cans from the fridge, including non-alcoholic ones. || Our first night in Lisboa and we were on the search for a real ale pub. After arriving by tube into the city we tried desperately to find this pub walking through dodgy streets and up hundreds of steps when finally we came across this extraordinary pub in a traditional street with tight knit terraced houses with washing hanging out the windows. It is a cracking pub. We were so relieved to find it and the guy who was running it ( sadly whose name I can’t remember ) was a perfect Portuguese host …. So funny and so knowledgeable and his English was so good. Teenagers were hanging around in the street outside and I’m sure we saw a real life gangster getting into his Mercedes…. Such a cool vibrant area of Lisboa. We absolutely loved it…. || A nice corner bar with tasty national craft beers. Friendly bartender from Brazil and UK. Ling tall tables seating with stools. Good Wi-Fi. Rideshare drivers got close. Tasty chicken empanadas, baked, not fried. || Great discovery for a craft beer fan. Nestled up and away from the main touristy areas, one can find excellent local (Portugal) craft beers along with imported brews. I sampled a pils and a NEIPA, from Beerfreaks, and the latter was excellent. Much better than what I could have expected in Europe.  They also have a nice collection of imported bottled and cans in the fridge. || Thanks for the review!! 😍😍😍 … || Great little beer spot. As Americans from a beer centric city, we were impressed with the variety on menu. Bartender was a great! Happy Hour was a nice plus. || I loved it here. All in all, i loved it, and would sincerely recommend.

Miradouro da Senhora do Monte offers one of the most impressive views in Lisbon and was a real highlight for us as Canadian visitors. The walk up is a bit of a climb, but the payoff is absolutely worth it, with a sweeping panoramic view over the city, the river, and the surrounding hills that feels both peaceful and unforgettable. It’s less crowded than some of the more central viewpoints, which makes it a great place to slow down, take photos, and simply enjoy the moment. Whether you visit at sunrise, during the day, or at sunset, it’s a beautiful spot that truly captures the charm and character of Lisbon. || Miradouro da Senhora do Monte is pure magic. Perched high above the city, it offers one of the most stunning panoramic views of Lisbon. As the sun begins to set, the sky transforms into a canvas of gold, pink, and violet—leaving you absolutely speechless. The peaceful vibe, the soft breeze, and the gentle hum of the city below create a moment of stillness that feels almost sacred. This vantage point offers one of the most stunning views of the city, perfect for capturing the essence of Lisbon's charm in just a one-minute video! It’s an ideal spot for photography enthusiasts and anyone wanting to soak in the city’s beauty from above.  Getting there involves a leisurely 20-25 minute walk from the city center. Do note, however, there are many stairs and steps along the way, making it best suited for intermediate and advanced walkers. Or do a TukTuk tour and add this to your sightseeing itinerary.  Pro tip: Visit during sunset for a mesmerizing experience as the city glows in golden hues. Also, bring some snacks or a drink; it’s the perfect spot to relax and enjoy the view.  As one of the highest points in the city, Miradouro da Senhora do Monte is more than just a view—it's a moment to savor Lisbon in all its splendor. The view stretches across the entire city — from the castle to the river — and is especially impressive around sunset.  A peaceful spot to take a break from the busy streets below and appreciate Lisbon from above. Definitely worth the walk. || Amazing panoramic view from this beautiful spot. Looks over the city and the coastline with all the infrastructure of the city. Great for sunsets and photos. || A stunning view of the city. It's a bit of a tiring walk uphill but if your prepared for it its nice to explore the area. There's plenty of space for pictures when you reach it. I'd definitely recommend checking it out for an atmospheric view and pictures if you have time. || An amazing viewpoint looking over the city and towards the river. Lucky enough to have such a beautiful day, in the middle of December, to see this panorama. Well worth visiting for the WOW factor alone. Plenty of photo opportunities from here. || One of the best few points of Lisbon. Gorgeous photos of a sunset and there’s a beautiful church right next to it so that you can go in at no cost, but you can make donations. I took an electric bike to see the place since it’s very uphill, so I don’t recommend walking.  I suggest taking the tram 28 up. || I arrived there during the sunset moment and lots of people already sit along the railing. It was nice to stay sometime here to oversee this red rooftop buildings and with the light, the city looks astonishing 😃 … || American Traveler here. Our tuktuk guide stopped here and you can see why. It's so gorgeous! You get a good view oh the city. There are restrooms nearby though I didn't try them.

This church is different from most in Lisbon. In 1959, a large fire destroyed the roof and many wooden parts. The heat was so strong that the stone columns cracked and turned black. You can still see the damage today. The church was not fully restored on purpose. The scars were left as a reminder of what happened, instead of being hidden. It is simple, quiet, and very powerful — a place that shows history exactly as it is. || We were walking around Lisbon exploring all the sights for several days while we were waiting to join our cruise. We passed by this church and went inside to explore.  It was very old and very beautiful.  So ornate especially behind the alter. Please note that the base 13th century church has been rebuilt several times over the centuries due to fires and earthquakes. Many tourists were there taking pictures along with a lot of worshippers.  A very peaceful place in the middle of a busy city. || Old church with special legacy but forsaken by caring elites some.time.ago and badly needs renovating - about to start. Very unique style circle within circle. Very spiritual I felt. Had a volunteer lady assisting who was devout and delightful humour. A visit for heartfelt comforting of the soul. || Igreja de São Domingos – Lisbon. - Is a symbol of resilience, uniquely displaying the "scars" of the 1959 fire and earlier earthquakes, which gives its restored interior a haunting and powerful atmosphere. Despite multiple devastating events, it has been repeatedly rebuilt and reopened, preserving its complex history within its architecture and decorative styles. || Fabulous church with an astonishing story. Earthquakes, fire, you name it, this church has gone through a lot over the centuries! A must stop in Lisbon as the architecture of this church is simply amazing. || Very nice Church and place of worship, very old (dedicated in 1241) and damaged by various earthquakes, yet still standing with almost all the original glorious splendor of past centuries. The red ceiling is quite symbolic, together with the stones of the floor. I went early to the 6:00PM Mass and 15 minutes before it began, there were still plenty of tourists taking pictures and speaking loud. But as the Mass time got close, the temple got the silence proper for prayer and recollection of religious people. The liturgy was beautiful, with the proper dignity. The pipe organ makes beautiful sound waves through the old Church walls. Today (Sept. 28, 2025) was the Gospel of the rich man and the poor Lazarus (Luke 16:19-31). The priest delivered a beautiful sermon, balanced between the aspects of social obligations for the rich and wealthy people, and the moral implications for everyone to look around and identify the poor at the gates of their comfort zones, summarizing the message in the line that "often, wealth makes blind." Right in the midst of downtown Lisbon, this is a pearl of a monument since the 13th century and a place where we breathe already a bit of eternal peace if we are able to listen the old stones of the walls and floor, the gospel messages, as well as our own consciences in the hectic of the modern world of social responsibilities towards the poor. || Igreja De S Domingos is a beautiful and peaceful church, I visited when Mass was going on, on Easter Sunday. It was completely full! Unfortunately I had an appointment so could not stay, and because it was Mass, I could not go all around the interior as I wished. || Visited the Church of Saint Dominic and was really struck by its burned and worn interior. The atmosphere is intense and dramatic, giving a unique glimpse into its history. Definitely one of the most memorable churches I’ve seen in Lisbon || One of the most stunning churches that one can visit in Lisbon. This church was affected a very big earthquake a few centuries ago, and a fire relatively recently. The renovation and maintenance of some of the remaining seem quite impressive. A must-visit place. || Very cool, great history, worth going out of the way for because it is one of the most beautiful churches I've ever been in, the charred stone gives a sense of power greater than any church adorned with art and gilded intricacies

This is one of the most beautiful sunset spots in Lisbon. The view over the city and the river is truly stunning, and the atmosphere becomes magical as the sky turns warm shades of orange and pink. Just avoid the path of picture 4 where the stairs are steep and there are a lot of hobos living in tents, they are harmless but the steps are their toilets so just imagine… || What an amazing view point..you can see panoramic view of the city..definitely recommend for a visit || Best spot in Lisbon to watch the sunset. It’s definitely a climb up winding streets and many stairs, so go prepared with a bottle of water but once at the top you won’t regret it! If you can avoid the main street I would recommend it, we took some side streets and walked up a beautiful staircase with art work on the way to the top. || I’ve been to Lisbon 3 times now and stayed for 2 weeks this trip & this is by far my FAVORITE VIEWPOINT! There’s often someone playing music which elevates the vibe too. Highly recommend anytime of day! The best panoramic view of Lisbon for me. || Miradouro da Graça offers one of Lisbon's most stunning panoramic views, best experienced during the golden hour. There is a quiosque on spot for a drink. But don’t ignore the stairs down, it’s a little art adventure || Stunning viewpoint!! Very easy to reach here from different points of the city center. I would recommend at first starting from Santa Apolonia to visit Alfama, and from there it’s not even 10 minutes. Later, you can also visit the Castle given that it’s pretty close too. Possible to easily spot on historical landmarks from this miradouro. Lots of cafes and bars are nearby, if you would like to.

A rare find in Lisbon it seems, a quiet shaded park. It had picnic benches with tables, benches in the shade, grass to lie on, a cafe and is very peaceful.  Having said that it does feel like it needs some attention as much of it is run down and the prevailing smell of urine is not so appealing with your lunch || While the view of Lisbon from here is undeniably beautiful, the park itself has sadly declined. The atmosphere is calm, with plenty of shade, open green spaces, and a small café to grab a drink. A wonderful place to unwind and escape the city’s busy streets for a while. || Having just arrived in Lisbon, we dropped off our bags and got our hike on. We ended up at this great park to relax in, and one of the few that had a playground. We thoroughly enjoyed listening to the dogs playing in the wide-open green space above the playground, one even sounded like a turkey gobbling along. || Very cute little park with stunning views. There is a wee cafe/bar in it with a toilet, a children’s play area and plenty of green space to lie down and relax. Also has amazing views || It’s nice to have a park, but the many many dogs leave behind a lot of dog poop. Even if picked up, this makes your clothes and blanket dirty, and I mean really dirty. Even worse, millions of flies. || Nice little park - an oasis in Graca. There’s a big grassy bit where dogs run around. Be careful of the dog poo though! There’s also a little kiosk for drinks and snacks too || One of the best parks in Lisbon. The view is great, the atmosphere is chill and cool. There’s always a lot of cute dogs running around. City view is nice but we were really disappointed about no way out anywhere except the entrance (don't believe google maps, there is no direct "green" trail).

good place to have a drink, and also bigger than other wine bars in the area so it’s great for big groups. we got really good wine recommendations from the girls, who were also super nice. the atmosphere is beautiful, i loved the turntable and the record shelf :) || Great wine bar. We booked a table online. Waitress was very friendly and spoke good English. We had a few glasses of orange wine, the cheese platter, hummus, smashed potato, carrots and it was all delicious. The food was absolutely amazing. Great service great wine. Highly recommend for the experienced foodie! Antoine was amazing! || BomBomBom is a cozy gem in Lisbon with a fantastic selection of unique wines and a warm, inviting atmosphere. I loved the creative touch of the vinyl shelf – you can buy records or enjoy DJs spinning sets on vinyl. A perfect mix of wine, music, and ambiance. || Stumbled upon this place randomly and we thought it was just a wine bar with great jazz music…turns out it’s our new Mecca for cuisine. Whoever the Michelin star people are they need to get here and give this place ALL of the Michelin stars ASAP. The food was absolutely incredible and of course the wine was as well. We loved it so much we needed to come back on our very last night so we could savor the flavors of the food and wine one last time. || Thank you for your words Aly ! 🙏 … || Wine bar with amazing food in a cosy atmosphere. They have great music, and it is good for both cosy nights indoors and on summer evenings in the terrace. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. I love this place and keep coming back! || Thank you Catarina 🙏 … || Nice choices of food and wine. However not the best place to go when you are hungry as portions are very small. Can recommend visiting for drinks with a little bit of something fancy on the side. Service very friendly. || Lovely spot in Lisbon. Excellent wine selection, great music, and delicious food. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, thanks to the lovely couple running the place ! || Thank you Othman, it was a pleasure to have you with us ! || This can't be a jazz bar! No jazz bars have food this good. So, this is an amazing restaurant that has jazz. Try to make the monthly Sunday session, but come nevertheless. The food is actually crafted by actual chefs with actual taste for balance and constructed dishes...how novel! The wines, by glass or more, are eclectic and thought through...the service, perfectly personal.. not plastic, not clingy. The vibe is as now as the kid on the billboard that you have no idea who it is, what they do, or why they're on the billboard. But that's not to say you'll be judged... you'll be welcomed as if you were a great jazz musician, regardless of age or more age.... or even my age. || Hi, thank you so much for your words! It means a lot to us ! Indeed we are not a jazz bar 😊but we do love Jazz among a variety of music. The live jazz session is a monthly event at the moment indeed. Hope to have you back anytime soon !  … || Would Return.  I really really wanted to love this place. Cool love DJ, amazing small plates for sharing, affordable wines. Perfect. Finally the perfect wine bar.  Unfortunately the server was begging for tips at the very end. "I just want to make BIG clear, service is not included". " A lot of people don't know" Okay. So what? Go work in the US or Canada?  Beef Tongue - sublime. Seared at the very end， tender throughout, perfect wine accompaniment. The sticky rice/potatoes thing at the bottom? SO GOOD. I enjoyed visiting this church and attending Mass. || The Church of Our Lady of Penha de França, built on one of the highest points in the city known as Cabeço de Alperce, is one of Lisbon's most original churches. Its construction began in 1597-98. In 1601 it was given to the Augustinian hermits. Between 1625 and 1635 a new temple was built to replace the previous one. In the 18th century, the church underwent further renovations, completed in 1754, which were severely damaged by the earthquake the following year, and subsequently rebuilt with the support of the Marquis of Marialva. In the 20th century it became a parish church. The cult of Our Lady of Penha de França originated from a legend about a lizard that spread throughout Brazil and the East through Portuguese navigators. Notable features of the church include the atrium, staircase, octagonal interior, marble cladding in various colors, the altarpiece, images, and the sacristy with its 18th-century tilework.
