I said to them that it didn’t make sense to force a woman to sit alone at a bar…even if it changed the pairing up of the seats. There where three men seated together right next to us. Needless to say it was weirdly unwelcoming for a bar. The people at the door and serving the drinks were pleasant. Again, the view is pretty. || Beautiful park in Lisbon on evening new year eve || Nice park/square across the street from Parliament.  Has one of those fun cafes that serves coffee, food and alcohol. Old people playing bocce ball, a comically inadequate ramp for the mobility impaired, classic Lisbon! || Great garden in the middle of the city || Zero grass, but it's enclosed. At least there were a few dogs for Ginger to play with, || Serra da Arrabida,  the beachs is beautiful , the ocean calm and clear but very cold. || Nice quiet relaxing park || Lovely to walk in and relax in the sunshine || There is a colony of adorable cats living in little houses || The Jardim das Francesinhas, also known as Jardim Lisboa Antiga, is a small geometrically designed garden on Calçada da Estrela, next to the Assembly of the Republic and the São Bento Palace, bordering the Higher Institute of Economics and Management. The Convento das Francesinhas (Francesinhas Convent) stood on this site until the late 1930s, when it was demolished to make way for an entertainment area built during the Lisbon festivities in 1935. This is where the nickname Jardim das Francesinhas comes from. Later, in 1949, the garden was inaugurated with its current geometric layout, featuring the statue of Leopoldo de Almeida, "A Família" (The Family), in the center.  On the lower level, there is also a charming kiosk with a terrace and a monument alluding to the Portuguese mathematician Bento de Jesus Caraça, who died a year before the garden's inauguration. On the upper level, there is a memorial dedicated to the musician Zeca Afonso.  All areas are very well landscaped and maintained. Despite its small size, this garden inspires us with the beauty of its landscape architecture, rigorously designed and in harmony with the imposing buildings representing the Portuguese Republic located nearby. || It's a nice place, you can sit in the shade on a bench, the only thing is that the stone benches need some padding. || I love this park, it's a pleasure to sit in it! We threw most of it away unfortunately.  The cod fish was frozen (not fresh) and not fully cooked, it tasted horrible. It was served with some spinach, again from the freezer and was not fully cooked.  Shrimps were also frozen and of terrible quality.  Shame that they serve such a poor quality to their customers. || This place is a hidden gem in campo de Ourique! Every dish is delicious but the best is the picanha with pineapple! The owner Rodrigo is an amazing host and entrepreneur! I love it this is one of our regular !!!! || Second visit this year! Very delicious Portuguese octopus. Although some price increase compared to earlier this year (inflation, of course), the octopus simply was  very good, just a little over burnt today.

Truly amazed! We were just hungry and our expectation was a bit low. How can one get 5/5 pasta in a small market? We were wrong! The ravioli and pasta came out one of the best pasta we ever ate! Just saying as a person who had very good pastas in Italy! Would go here again! || Maybe my issue with this place were the expectations that I had.  I read many fantastic coments saying they were life-changing Raviolis, spectacular flavor and things like those.  And, don't get me wrong, they are definitely good Raviolis. Maybe not just so life-changing, to be honest. Especially if you're not around, I'm not sure it's that worth actually moving around the city just to try them.  But they were good, I want to emphasize that. || AMAZING 🤩 their raviolis were so good and rich, good portion to fill you up! Really flavourful and goes well with their special lemonade! Definitely worth trying ! || Thank you so much dear Yuqing! || Best food - get the pesto linguine - it’s insane it tastes like it came straight from Italy - the environment is so cute and lovely as it’s in a market and the servers and cooks are so kind !! Support , support , support!! || The truffle ravioli is one of the best things I've ever tasted.  So rich in flavor.  The sauce was incredible.  Perfect sauce to ravioli ratio too.  As someone who likes meat, I usually go with some kind of protein but I didn't miss it with this dish.  Can't wait to go back.  Really nice people running it too. || Thanks so much Jonathan for your review and positive feedback! We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed, and can’t wait to have you back! Give our fresh pasta dishes a try next time 😉  … || Wow first time I’ve seen 5 star across the board. To be honest it’s justified. From the staff who is super friendly to the relative decor which is pleasant then to the food which is amazing. I could eat 3 portions but then I would destroy my gym efforts. Anything you get will be amazing. Even the lemonade. 6 stars || We rode the 28 tram to the end of the line, arriving about 12:30 pm, and made the shirt walk to the Mercado. Delighted to find this Italian food. Despite the informal atmosphere, the host was full of friendly, interesting conversation... told us the ingredients for the pasta come from Italy, and are then made in a commercial kitchen in Lisbon.  My husband had the Ravioli Bolognese and I had the Pozzuoli flatbread sandwich - both delicious! Highly recommend for the friendly service and the food. || Thank you so much fir your kind words! || This place is a revelation for ravioli lovers, delivering divine flavor combinations in a cozy and inviting environment—each bite is a taste of perfection! The owner is truly lovely, exhibiting immense care and providing top-notch customer service that made the experience even more memorable. || Thank you so much dear Alexander! || My focaccia pompei was delicious! Fresh pressed lemonade. Bright & welcoming atmosphere in the market with lovely staff. The manager gave me some tips for traveling around Lisbon. Highly recommend for lunch or dinner! Next time I’d try the nduja ravioli 🌶️! || Thank you so much - see you next time! || Food was very fresh made and ingredients are no doubt delicious! We were happy to have one pasta here ! || Thank you Nicole - great to hear!

The Museum of Illusions in Lisbon is a nice place to visit, especially if you’re looking for something fun and a bit different. Some of the illusions are really clever and make you stop for a moment to figure out how they work. The whole museum is not very big, so you can go through it quite fast, but it’s still enjoyable.  It’s a good spot for kids because they can interact with a lot of things and take fun photos. Adults will also find a few rooms and tricks quite interesting. Overall, it’s a quick and enjoyable visit, and worth passing by if you’re nearby or looking for something entertaining to do. || Hi Kinan,  Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review! 😊 We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the clever illusions, the interactive elements, and the fun photo opportunities — and thank you as well for sharing your photos, they look great! While the museum can be explored relatively quickly depending on the pace, we’re glad you still found it entertaining and worthwhile.  Thanks again for visiting and for capturing such nice moments with us! || Omg what a gem this place is. It's sooo quirky and interesting absolutely worth a visit. I'm soo glad we went and ignored the negative reviews. The staff are soo engaging,  soo polite soo helpful. We had a wonderful visit thank you. If your contemplating going don't think any longer just get going! Pink street is a 10 min walk away for after you've seen this amazing place! || Hi Sasha,  Wow! Thank you so much for your amazing review! 😊 We’re absolutely delighted that you enjoyed your visit and appreciated the quirky illusions and our friendly team. Your kind words mean a lot to us, and it’s wonderful to know you decided to come despite the mixed reviews — we’re so glad it was worth it!  Enjoy the Pink Street and the rest of your time in Lisbon! || Loved it! Was a really fun (although short) time. The museum is not big, so it took us 50 minutes to do the full tour and re-do some of the activities || This place is amazing. Lots of staff around to answer any questions and take photos if you are a solo traveler. Definitely worth the entrance fee and definitely worth visiting. || Hi Luke,  Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed the museum and that our team could help make your visit enjoyable, even as a solo traveler. Your kind words about the experience and value mean a lot to us! || The Museum is a chain around the world. They are all similar in layout as there are only so many optical illusions out there. The cost for a family of four was 47€, which considering you can only spend about 20 minutes looking over the exhibits, is a fairly high price. However, if you have young children, they will be amazed at some of the illusions they’ll see. There is even a gift shop at the end where you can bring home brain-twister toys or souvenirs to remember your visit. Recommend if you’re looking to get out of the heat for 30 minutes, just don’t expect an entire afternoon here! || Hi Mo, Thank you very much for your visit, your review. We're glad your family had a good time 😊 … || Very fun and informative place, the museum is interactive and is suited for taking pictures, whilst still being a great place to go just to see the illusions. There are many activities and illusions and great photo ops. || Hi Inf,  Thank you so much for your fantastic review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you found the museum both fun and informative, and that you enjoyed the interactive illusions and photo opportunities. It’s wonderful to know you appreciated the experience from every angle! || I'm sorry. There was no one at the entrance. There were 55 minutes left before closing. Little girl was crying. They didn't let us in. Ridiculous!! change your way. staff to be trained.  in other European cities, different treatment. || Hi Mone,  Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re truly sorry for the frustration you experienced, especially with a child involved. We understand how disappointing that must have felt.  However, we’d like to clarify that we cannot allow new entries after a certain cutoff time before closing. This is to ensure every visitor has enough time to enjoy the full experience safely and comfortably. Our ticketing system automatically blocks sales and entry after this time, precisely to avoid situations where guests would not be able to complete the visit properly.  We’re sorry for the inconvenience this caused and appreciate your understanding. If you’re still interested in visiting, we’d love to welcome you back during opening hours so you can fully enjoy the museum experience. || Great experience with the family, fun photo opportunities, great to get out of the heat and explore. || Hi Panit, Thank you so much for your kind review! 😊 We’re delighted you and your family had a great time, enjoyed the photo opportunities, and found the museum a nice escape from the heat. … || Very funny, mindblowing for the brains of young and old. Emplyees friendly and willing to explain || Hi Annegreet,  Thank you so much for your lovely review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you found the experience funny and mind-blowing for both young and old. Our team will be very happy to know their friendliness and explanations helped make your visit even better! || I found this so fun and enjoyed this interactive and interesting experience, the Illusions are great, get fab photos while learning and have a good laugh. The staff were super friendly and helped take photos of us. When we went, the morning slot was full, so we had to wait around half hour till next slot, which was fine as the museum is in such a main area you can easily wonder round, have a coffee or snack near by, for example. || Hi Jennifer,  Thank you so much for your fantastic and detailed review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear that you found the experience fun, interactive, and interesting — and that you enjoyed the illusions, the laughs, and the photo opportunities. It’s also wonderful to know our team helped make your visit even better with their friendliness and support with photos.  Thank you as well for your understanding regarding the short wait between slots — we really appreciate your patience, and you’re right, the central location does make it easier to enjoy the surroundings in the meantime.  We’re really happy you had such a great time with us!

place_name: Locals & Nomads Natural Wine Bar & Shop
Locals & Nomads Natural Wine Bar & Shop

reviews_content: In love with this place! I’m so happy we came across this wonderful place: great coffee in the morning and amazing wine and food in the evening. Went there with my friends and had the best time. The staff is so nice, and the food is really tasty, which is not that common in great wine places. We even had the burrata twice!! Totally recommend! || Oh my..  the food was simply perfect. A beautiful balance of simplicity and flavour that made every bite irresistible (I could hardly keep from licking my fingers). The quality of the fish was so good, the cheeses were just as perfect, and the wines carefully selected. The atmosphere was warm and inviting as if you are sitting in a living room, and to top it all off, the owner was incredibly sweet and welcoming. Such a special experience. I can’t wait to return. || Oh, thank you so so much for such a kind compliment! We wish to have you here soon again! || Beautiful summer evening with Cesar and Katya (owner)! Incredible bright and light red wines, great stories, and lovely ambience. Hidden gem! || This cozy wine bar in Lisbon is a great spot for natural wine lovers. They have a well-chosen selection and serve tasty small plates to go with it. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the staff is friendly and happy to help with recommendations. A perfect place to unwind and try something new! || Thank you so much! Hope to see you again soon) || Priviettttt!!! Honestly, this is the best place ever. A beautiful wine selection, all curated by my dear boss and friend, Ekaterina. A very chill yet classy terrace with an amazing view of the Red Bridge. Come by for some great wines and lovely snacks! || Wonderful little spot off the main path, with a cozy quiet atmosphere. Everything I had here was fantastic quality and it's apparent everything is lovingly made. Great ingredients and combinations, and great wine choices. The couple running it are also very pleasant. Will definitely be back! || Thank you very much ♥️ See you soon again;) || A very cozy place with incredibly delicious food and equally great wines.Katya was a wonderful host, friendly and attentive, which made the experience even more special. Definitely a wine bar I’d happily return to. 🤤😍 || The staff of Afterhours really made the difference for me. I reached out to them to plan a birthday dinner and they were very friendly and adapted themselves to all my requests. It was also great to have the whole space for ourselves, really allowed conversation to flow and we loved the food and the evening ! Definitely an experience to repeat ☺️ || Nice little wine bar with a beautifully curated natural wine list - from Açores to Georgia and beyond. We stumbled in by accident  because we needed to charge our phone, turned out to be a great surprise. Definitely coming back to explore more of what’s on offer! || Thank you so much! We glad you enjoyed it! And of course we hope to see you soon:) || Delicious food and a cozy atmosphere in a beautifully designed space. Great location, and on a rainy day we had the whole place to ourselves, enjoying the owner’s warm attention :) || Super cozy and welcoming, loved the environment! The food was delicious and the wine was also amazing, definitely recommend for a casual bite / drink in Lisbon || Thank you so much, Mónica!) Hope to see you again soon! || cosy, unique place run by a super friendly and beautiful couple exceptional selection of wine and perfect quality fresh made starters area is super cosy with amazing sunsets for a chill and relaxed leisure  highly recommend || Thank you! Always happy to have you! || Amazingggg! Cesar our server was an absolute GEM and made our experience all the better. Truly one of the sweetest people we met in Lisbon when visiting. The natural wine was so good and refreshing for a hot day and the small bites we delicious. Exactly what we needed! Beautiful space and view too! || Thank you so very much! Can’t wait to see you again:) || The most cozy and atmospheric wine bar in Lisbon. Guys chose each wine individually and put together a cool snack menu. Try anchovies and burrata with persimmon. || Thank you so much! Glad you like it! || Literally one of my favorite wine place! Perfect wine list with combination of appetizers which always served from heart . Love it! || Thank you very much! Hope to see you soon) || The selection of wine is amazing. The personnel were super friendly and helpful. I personally think that if you're looking for a place to enjoy some wine tasting while having a joyful chat between friends, you won't find a better spot. Truly a recommendable place and I am sure I will go back. || Thank you Pedro, glad you enjoyed. || It's been a long time since I felt as comfortable and welcomed as I do at After Hours. It's one of those rare gems that instantly makes me feel at home. Ekaterina and João are such warm and genuine hosts, and their hospitality makes the experience really special. The food is delicious, the wine selection is fantastic and the fact that they welcome dogs makes it all the better. Without a doubt, one of my favorite places in Lisbon! || Thank you so much! We can’t wait to host you again:) || Natural wine bar specializes in local producers in Portugal. Amazing selection and the owner is friendly to answer all your questions regarding wine as she is a professional Sommelier herself. They also have fresh snacks for small hunger. Space is small but super cute and cozy. And the crowd seems relaxed and friendly to chat too as well. Highly recommend! || Thank you so much! We are hoping to see you soon again ♥️ || Amazing atmosphere and great wine. Service was always amazing and very friendly. || I'm a neighbor and I love to go there to relax and have some great wine and delicious light food. Very nice staff and love the music too.

A wine bar literally the size of my bedroom! The guys behind the bar are very knowledgeable and helpful, so a good glass or two or wine is guaranteed.  This is the first stop on my trip to Lisbon and I'm very happy indeed. || As travelers in Lisbon and natural wine lovers, we found this wine bar exceptional. We like the concept of no wine menu, just talk with the very kind, welcoming, calm, and knowledgeable sommeliers about your wine preferences, and they will let you try different wines until you find what you are searching for. I described the sommelier as “calm” because I mistakenly knocked the bottles of wine, which spilled about a glass on the floor, but he was genuinely calm and friendly. Their wine choices are great, and we were super blessed with what we tried. There are few food choices, but it's great for an after-dinner visit. || I loved this wine bar so much! It is vibrant, full of good wine choices, there is a park next to it where you can sit and enjoy your drink. Price per glass ranges from €6 to €20. The staff is cool, they let you sample wines before ordering and they also give you good recommendations. You can take tour glass to the park, but you need to leave a deposit. || Black Sheep Lisboa is a gem — an intimate, stylish wine bar with an outstanding selection and truly knowledgeable sommelier (also very handsome) bartenders. The staff pair wines with just the right notes and stories, making each pour feel curated. Cozy atmosphere, great small plates that complement the wines, and excellent recommendations whether you prefer natural, classic or adventurous bottles. A must-visit for anyone who loves wine and thoughtful service. Highly recommended. || Lots of wonderful memories at my favorite wine bar in Lisboa over the years. Yes the wine is always amazing, but the people even more so. Warm hearts always welcome you at Black Sheep—what makes it special. Obrigada || Amazing place I just discovered with a friend. We went to the side of the bar and were welcomed warmly. The bartender has a real knowledge about wine, switched between English and Portuguese with the two of us without any issue and has even told us more about the history of the bar and the owner.  Can’t remember the name of the bartender, but can’t wait to come back for moments like this || Black sheep is a gem. I loved that when I asked if "we could get weirder" with wine recommendations, we were brought a series of incredibly fun and funky wines. Black sheep delivers on everything -  local art, great wine recommendations, and unbeatable vibes. || What a shame. I moved to Lisbon the year this place opened, and I’ve watched it lose the soul it once had.  Tonight we went to Black Sheep for a friend’s celebration - 3 glasses, a few bottles, nothing complicated. When my friend left early, she returned her glass to the bar and even texted me to say so. Later, the staff insisted one glass was “missing” and refused to listen or consider anything we explained. We were charged for a glass we had already returned.  And here’s the thing: I understand the deposit system and why they use it. But when the system fails, the customer pays - even when the bar will inevitably find the glass later. That’s not just rigid, it’s getting money for something that wasn’t actually lost.  It wasn’t about the amount. It was the attitude: zero trust, zero curiosity, zero willingness to engage. Just a robotic “no.” It feels like customer care has been replaced by profit-first thinking.  If you want natural wine in the neighborhood, go to Magnolia or bring your own bottle to Praça das Flores. Black Sheep used to feel alive. Now it feels indifferent - guided more by turnover than by hospitality. || I cant give less than five stars. I went for the first time and got impressed by the service. They really know what they are talking about! They have a large variety of wines. Black sheep is usually crowded and almost impossible to have a seat on weekends. The tip here is to get there earlier so you can be able to have a full tasting experience while listen to the amazing stories of each bottle of wine you try! || Wonderful tiny wine bar serving “whatever we have open at the minute!” They let you taste a ton of wines to find one you love, and staff are super nice & knowledgeable. It can get packed so visit on a week day or just be patient. Totally worth it— the wine and vibes are amazing. || This is one of those charming spots in a city that will instantaneously make you feel like a local. The owner are so kind and knowledgeable about wines. The place is great to sit and have a glass of wine and even talk to people around you. The environment is super social and you never know who you’re gonna meet. Love this place. Seriously a hidden gem of Lisbon. Whether it’s there wide range of great low intervention wines or just their friendly charm you will surely find you’re welcome here. || Tiny natural wine bar with the best staff! Get a wine to have inside on a stool at the bar, or get a reusable takeaway cup from them to sit in the square across the lane! || Great wine bar. Pick up a glass , walk into the garden 🪴 play with a few dogs 🐕. What more can you want! Oh they charge a deposit for the wine glasses which I think was odd considering it’s plastic glasses. || Amazing experience! Staff is super friendly, professional and knowledgeable about wines (and they can carry 6 bottles in their hands at once!). Cozy ambiance and reasonable prices. No menu as they change assortment all the time and recommend you personally which wines you could like. || One o Lisbon's best Wine Bars... fantastic hosts and lots of wine and champagne... great new place, modern and just right next door to the old classic Black Sheep... Great wines, great champagne, great crew and great multicultural atmosphere... Must not miss! Cheers 🥂🍷🍾🥳 || This review is long overdue! One of my favorite places in Lisbon, a wine bar that feels like home. The staff is amazing, knowledgeable and the nicest people. You can even go by yourself and I’m sure you’ll make a new friend! Don’t go expecting a wine list, stay open to their suggestions, let them know your likes and dislikes and I’m sure you’ll be happy! || Don’t come in looking for a menu! Come in looking for a wine journey and experience! We had such a great time here with the knowledgeable staff who asked preferences and then blew our minds with some excellent wine choices and service!  Love those cheeky washrooms as well. Lol. || Adorable little wine bar. The owners are incredibly knowledgeable in local Portuguese wines, which you will most likely miss if you don't visit this amazing wine bar. Would highly recommend making a stop before or after your dinner at least once, as we went twice! We also purchased a bottle of our favourite sparkling wine we've ever had.  Drink by the glass, enjoy a tasting curated by the Sommelier or take home a bottle of your favourite. Which ever choose you won't be disappointed! || Thank you for your lovely review! We're glad you had a good time in Lisbon. See you next time! || I can’t say enough good things about this wine bar. They serve mostly natural wine and will find you something you like, every time.  I didn’t think I liked natural wines, but I was proven wrong on my first visit. Let’s just say, since then, I’ve been back almost every night.  The people who work here are some of the best people I’ve met. They’ve all become very close friends with me, just like they do with most. They know so much about wine and really care to make sure you drink wine that you like.  If you’re in Lisbon, stop by. It’s worth it and I promise you won’t be disappointed. || Wonderful place . You know is packed for a good reason . This is the place to go to have awesome wines . Everyone working here is amazing and they have done an amazing job making this place so beautiful. I had a great time tried delicious wines and just overall the best wine bar I have seen .

A highlight of my visit in Lisbon! Great place to sit with friends and try different wines. Shout out to Coração who made great recommendations and was so kind. We loved everything we had! 10/10 recommend. || Thank you thank you thank you Caroline ❤️ || Great wine bar with a good selection of wines by the bottle. And our server recommended excellent options by the glass based on our preferred taste palette. It was a chill vibe and we really enjoyed the place so much that we even took a bottle of wine home. (We didn’t eat anything so that’s why I didn’t rate the food, but it smelt delicious.) || Amazing Tira. Hope to see you again soon ✌️ || We had a really great evening here! The sweet little bar belongs to Senhor Uva and the team has so many good wines on the list - we were surprised to find rather unknown gems like La Grange aux Belles. This is one of our favorite winemakers but it's very small and we don't see it often.  The team is super nice and friendly. They make you feel welcome right away. The place is in a great spot next to the park too.  We tried some of their small plates and they were all very good. The oysters were delicious and you can see they put effort into making everything nice. It's perfect for sharing while you drink wine.  What we also liked how easy it was to talk to other people there if you want to. It feels friendly and relaxed – a bit like a community approach, but you can also just sit quietly if you prefer. Not many places get this right.  Thank you to all the staff for such a nice evening. We will be back soon!  Katja & Sven || This makes us very happy Sven. Thank you so much for the support!!! || Amazing natural wine bar, with superb vegetarian small plates menu. The staff are super helpful and knowledgeable. Highly recommended and great value! || Thank you so much Graeme!! || We had two fantastic evenings here. Lovely and very knowledgeable staff, who recommended the perfect two wines to us. The bread and butter was just incredible. A real highlight of our stay in Lisbon. Highly recommend if you like natural wine and a relaxed atmosphere. || So amazing to read Ben. It was a pleasure meeting you and welcoming the crew. Have a great time in Lisboa ✌️ || We spent an incredible seven hours at this wine bar. The wine selection was top-notch, and the lovely terrace provided the perfect setting to enjoy it. The service was exceptional, with the owners themselves ensuring we had a wonderful time.  Though we hadn’t planned to eat, the food was too tempting to resist, and we ended up trying almost everything on the menu. Each dish was fantastic, perfectly complementing the wines.  such a fun memory —we can't wait to return! || Thank you Helena, it was great to meet you guys and we greatly appreciate your support. See you soon 🙏 … || Thank to Coração for an incredible experience! They are very knowledgeable of the wines and will help you find exactly what you're looking for. The food is also exceptional - you cannot go wrong with anything on offer ❤️ || Amazing Kelly, Thank you for the Love!!! || Came for a bottle of good natural red wine. Got an amazing recommendation and a delicious cheesecake magically packed for me even though they don’t do takeaway. The best! || Used to be one of my favorite places. Good wine. Great food. Unfortunately lately service has become very poor. Grumpy staff, poor to no advice when it comes to choosing wine. || Ola Alexandra. We appreciate that you enjoyed what we did and hopefully can continue doing. It does happen for us as well to go through challenging moments and difficult services. Maintaining consistency is one of the biggest quest in our industry and we will keep on doing our best as always. Hope to catch you for another visit in the future ✌️ || What a gem! This natural wine bar offers a truly original selection of superbly crafted wines. The atmosphere feels just as natural and welcoming as the wines themselves. Perfectly located next to the beautiful Estrela Park, it’s a spot that feels perfect in so many ways. || Awesome Hannes. Thank you for visiting us 🙏 …

Stopped in for a late afternoon pick-me-up. Enjoyed a lovely white port and a delicious soft cheese. Added bonus, the wine list explains the various wine regions and wines of Portugal. Lovely people too. A delightfully spent 40mins. || Thanks for your feedback. || My husband and I visited Portugal last month, and, on our last night in Lisbon, we happened upon Lisbon by the Glass.  The place was inviting, especially the second floor, with amazing views of the city.  We were assisted by Princika, and she was awesome!  She explained each port and laid out the glass and bottles for us so we can take a picture.  This place was an absolute find!!  We recommend it highly if you are in Lisbon.  It certainly capped off our Portugal vacation perfectly.  If we ever find ourselves back in Lisbon, this place will be a repeat! || Great wine selection and truly welcoming service  This place has a really exciting and diverse wine list. We had already eaten, so we just came by for a couple of glasses and to explore something new – and we were not disappointed.  The staff have great knowledge of the wines they serve, and made the experience feel personal and authentic.  On top of that, the service was outstanding – warm, friendly, and attentive. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates good wine and genuine hospitality. || Thanks dear Christina for your feedback. || After feeling lost of an evening when it came to food, we came across this place and decided to change it up. Unknown to those walking on the street below, this tiny frontage from the street includes a gorgeous upstairs seating area giving lovely views of the city's East hills. However the view is not what you came for, we chose a 3 wine tasting menu with the charcuterie, cheese and pate board serving as more then enough for 3 adults. Wines were all Portuguese with background's explained and personal preferences included. Service was immaculate throughout and really has opened our eyes to the world of Portuguese wines. || Thank you Sam for your feedback . || We stumbled upon this place after dinner one evening.  Off the praca up some stairs is this little gem. Take a seat up stairs and enjoy Lisbon through their magnificent picture window.  enjoyed selecting wines to suit our tastes and definitely knew her stuff because we had some delicious Portuguese red wine and a platter of local cheese.  If you like wine,  like Lisbon, like tapas then you must find this place, sit back and enjoy. || Absolutely amazing service the staff here really know what they are talking about when it comes to the wines they are presenting to you.and top floor is breathtaking. Highly recommend 👌 || Thanks for your feedback . || Amazing experience, the staff were so knowledgeable in recommending wines and cheese. Also the best, most scenic place to enjoy an aperitif 🍷 || Thanks for your feedback . || This is a nice little spot with beautiful views on the second floor. The staff was extremely helpful, kind and educated us on the fortified wines we were tasting. We did not have any food so cannot really comment on that. || My wife and I went here for wine and cheese tasting, and we had a superb experience! The staff was so nice and even had us taste the wines being served to us before filling our glasses. She also explained in detail the background of each wine bottle she served us.  The cheese was amazing. We ordered the 5 types of cheese, and the cow cheese was unforgettable. We even ordered a second time, this time with just the 2 types of cheese we preferred!  The view of Lisbon from where we sat was breathtaking, even at night. The space was cozy and had good aesthetic.  We loved our experience overall! Definitely going back here whenever we're back in Lisbon! || Thanks for your feedback. || Cute place with a nice selection of wine. There's an upstairs seating area with a decent view of the city. They have some lite bites you can order as well. || Definitely one of the highlights of our time in Lisbon was spending a few evenings with the owner and crew of this quaint wine bar. They know their stuff. I highly recommend a port tasting. We bought one bottle for home. Excellent service, professional and most important, FUN! from Kingston Ontario CANADA || We got the big tapas plate for 41€ and 2 x wine tastings. We weren't sure if the big plate would be enough for 3 people, but it fit perfectly. The staff were friendly and professional, the tapas plate was amazing, the wine was good and the view was absolutely fantastic. The wine tastings were with 3 different wines and were served by the staff very professionally and told very well. They test-tasted two wines each round before deciding on which they wanted. The new wines came with no rush , so there was time to actually enjoy the wine, the food, and the conversations. We recommend the restaurant for so many reasons. We can't find anything negative about the restaurant, the food or the staff. They even went out of their way when I thought I had lost my phone and helped look for it and even gave me a phone to try and call it. We will definitely go there again if we visit Lisbon again. || Hello Dear Tine ,  Thank you for the incredible 5-star rating. Your feedback motivates us to keep raising the bar and sets the standard for excellence in everything we do. We’ll continue working hard to make every interaction . Once again thanks. || We found this place on our last night in Lisbon and regret not finding it sooner. The wine selection was great and the service really good. Lots of information about the wine and really friendly. If you happen to stumble across this place whilst walking up, or down, the steps- stop and go in. It’s great. || Thanks dear Emma for your feedback . || Fantastic place with a large selection of wines. Great option of tasting different wines. Nice service with professional knowledge. Very pleasant place. Definitely worth a visit!! || Great tasting experience of local Lisbon wines and other regional Portuguese wines. They carry brands/wineries of wines and fortified wines that you can't buy elsewhere -- so enjoy here knowing that it is a special tasting and the staff is knowledgeable about their many dozens of wines. We had the charcuterie platter with meats and cheeses -- good variety, but not the most flavorful we've had while in Iberia.  Recommended to sit upstairs to enjoy the views day or night, especially of St. George's Castle. || Hello Dear Mark   thanks for all your insight. Appreciated || I popped in one hot afternoon. I enjoyed excellent wine by the glass in very good condition. The cheese platter and meat selection was delicious. Beautiful views over the city and a cool breeze. Great service and friendly staff. I highly recommend. Obligato Lisbon by the glass 🍷 || our bar server was very friendly and knowledgeable about the wines. we enjoyed our wine tasting there! || Thanks Dear Aubrey for your positive experience in Lisbon by the glass.appreciate for sharing your feedback || Fantastic views and wine selection! Make sure to go upstairs for the view.  4 stars because the cheese plate was NOT good. It looked pretty but the cheese had zero flavor and the bread was grainy. Meat was ok. || Really cool place with vast selection of Portuguese wine. || We came here from a recommendation on a walking tour and had a nice experience. We were lucky to have a seat upstairs near the window which had an incredible view of Lisbon. We ordered some boar pâté which was not my favorite due to the texture, cheese platter, and the wine tasting.  The white was was very refreshing with some acidity and floral notes. The red wine was very full bodied and paired well with the heavier cheese. The staff were extremely helpful and kind. Would definitely recommend, especially if you can get the view upstairs!

So far it’s the best wine bar i have been in Lisbon. We just saw it from outside and wanted to try. you shouldn’t go as a big group if you wanna sit because they only fav few bar chairs inside. We asked for white wine but they made us taste bunch of wines and explained all the stories behind those wines. It was such an experience. They also told us they are changing their wine collection every week. So we loved the place!!! || Laid back and intimate, this is a fantastic natural wine bar in a great location! Jamie was incredibly knowledgeable and welcoming, happy to share his insights and have a chat.  My partner and I only had time for one glass each, but he generously let us taste a few extras, all of which were excellent! If I’m ever back in Lisbon, I’ll definitely return, and I’ll be recommending it to friends visiting the city as well! || Some places are just pure serendipitous joy. I love finding places like Salty. Jamie and all the patrons I met were kind and equally happy to be in that moment. I think anyone that finds themselves enjoying the delicious wine on offer should savor not only the unique and fantastic wine they are tasting, but also a very wonderful slice of kind and warm hospitality in central Lisbon. Love love love. || Absolutely love this little wine bar in Lisbon. The staff (Jamie, Nicole, Zane) are so friendly, welcoming, knowledgable about the natural wine they serve and just wonderful to talk to. The place is small and very cozy. Good tunes are usually playing and the atmosphere is very social. You feel like you are at an old friend’s house catching up over a glass or two of fabulous natural wine. This will be a regular spot for me on all future trips to Lisbon. It is truly a special place, mainly due to the outstanding staff! || Called into this cool little wine bar prior to a dinner reservation and wasn’t disappointed. Jamie looked after us, it was good to run into another Australian in Lisbon. Tried some nice wine and place was a great vibe. Would highly recommend. || What a Gem. Amazing options and such a broad spectrum of different wines. Jamie was amazing and made our night. We originally wanted to stay for one drink and ended staying until closing! || Randomly walked in and it was a great way to end the day out! Jamie knows exactly how to engage with his customers and make them feel at ease. Wonderful customer service, friendly, and a beautiful, quaint spot. The atmosphere was so relaxed, yet brilliantly engaging. We shall definitely be going back, and I would recommend this place to anyone who wants an intimate yet fun experience trying out natural wines. Mind you, I don't drink alcohol, but my partner was served a wonderful selection and I was offered many delicious non-alcoholic alternatives. || A very cozy place with great wines. Nicole was lovely and extremely attentive. She made us feel at home! Great music and energy, we'll be back :)) || Wandered into Salty on a solo date day—and what unfolded felt like one of those rare, serendipitous moments you don’t plan for but never forget. The space was warm, intimate, and effortlessly inviting. I didn’t catch his name, but to the bartender: thank you for an experience that felt both grounding and quietly transcendent. The wine was incredible, yes—but it was the conversation, honest and unforced, that stayed with me long after. A true hidden gem, found by chance, felt like fate  With love, A grateful Toronto, Canada traveller || Such a cozy wine bar in a vibrant neighborhood in Lisbon. We had delicious wine, thanks to David’s guidance, and great conversation. Felt right at home!! || My wife and I stopped in and had a wonderful experience. Each wine recommendation by Jaimie was fantastic. || Really cozy wine bar right in the middle of the action. Good wine selection and a mini clothes store on the back. They also own Salty Floor in Belem which I knew previously and really enjoy. Super convenient having the same good wine just in the city centre. || Jamie is an amazing guy with great personality. Would love to visit again when I’ll be back in Lisbon || Great little wine bar, by a fine gent named Jamie. Thanks so much for the company and your knowledge! || Randomly stumbled upon this great little spot. Nicole was warm and welcoming. A well curated wine list. || Salty is exceptional; you could go to other wine bars but you would miss out on the personal and genuinely thoughtful service. You will not find another place that has the care, attention to detail and consideration of your own personal tastes in Lisbon - believe me, I've tried. Please go, take the recommendations and drink some delicious wine. || We stumbled upon Salty Lisboa after dinner and had a wonderful time so we came back again for more. The wines are great, come with personalized recommendations/tastings and are reasonably priced. It’s newly opened, locally owned and full of knowledge. || Randomly walked in this lovely and intimate place. Beautifully curated wine selection, music and great vibe. Ask David to guide you through the list to find the perfect bottle. Highly recommend || Had the most amazing time there. Nicole was super on point when recommending the wines and explaining it. 10/10 || Tasty wine recommended by the lovely Nicole! Amazing cozy place, will definitely come back soon || Great cocktails and small plates. Well located in a popular area surrounded by wine bars and brunch spots. || Enjoyed the place. Worth to go! Tried by glass and bought a bottle. || Very nice hidden gem in lisbon, extremely nice guy at the bar and perfect wine! || The bartender is incredibly nice & the wine fantastic! Big recommendation || Absolutely delightful. And Jamie knows his stuff and is a great host. || cool little wine bar, great verity of Natural wines! || Really thoughtful and intimate experience, the wines were great as well || David was amazing - fantastic natural wine, great vibes and very knowledgeable. Highly recommend this wine bar 👌 || Super cute winebar Amazing Service and heartful || Great wine selection with cozy atmosphere || Thanks to Carl for his knowledge and cheerfulness during the tasting. || really cool, cozy and well located! it’s one of my new favorite places for sure. || Jamie was a great host || Low key and great wine selection. || Good selection of wines and fresh snacks || Our 2 year was napping and my wife and I were looking for a spot to get a glass of wine. Couldn’t have had stopped at a better place than this! Jamie was so welcoming and knowledgeable about all the wines. We stayed to have a couple of glasses of delicious wine and just chatted with him. Would definitely recommend this place! Whenever in Lisbon this is a must! || Amazing and cosy little hidden gem in the heart of Lisbon. Came here on a whim passing by on a rainy evening and instantly felt at home, Alex’s wine recommendations were fantastic every time! Really made my evening || I love exploring wine bars in Lisbon, and Salty won me over! The place is very cozy, has a wonderful wine list, and Nicole's service was impeccable!

A hip tiny wine place. The wine itself was good and the cheesecake delicious. The place has room for just a few guests so it’s surprising they don’t greet you and come out with a menu. 10€ for a good glass of wine is okay, but some information about the wine should be shared when it’s a higher price range. || Funky, small space to grab a glass of organic wine and sip while watching the trams go by.   Ask your knowledgeable server about the wines.    It was pricey but worth the overall vibe.   You may not have a place to sit. || The wine selection and cozy vibes are immaculate. Got an orange wine recommended by the girl at the from and it was unreal! || My favorite wine bar in Lisbon and Cascais🥂 They have one of the best selections of wines and champagnes in town—and sometimes even offer rare gems, which I really appreciate. It’s the perfect spot to unwind with a glass at the end of the week and chat with interesting guests from around the world. || Holy wine is such a cute intimate wine bar! The worker was so helpful in picking the perfect wine for each of us, and the atmosphere was very cozy! || Great tiny and cozy natural wine bar in the heart of Lisbon where both local and tourist find their perfect glass of wine that suit their taste. The Sommelier is very knowledgeable and helpful. However we found the natural wine choices were more safe less funky “ as a brave natural wine lovers we were hoping for more surprises”. Try red vino verde from Peluda and have a great time. || The most wonderful place for a glass of wine in Lisbon 🍷🍷🍷  Small place, loads of vibe. Maria the host is WONDERFUL. We loved her. She knows so much and you learn a lot just talking with her. She is really nice!!  There is place on the street for you to hang or a few stools inside! Music is great also. || A cozy little wine bar with an excellent selection and great chats with a truly knowledgeable sommelier. The perfect spot to relax and enjoy something special in every glass. Cheers from sunny Valencia! || My favorite place in Lisbon! Holy wine-holy place! There is a cozy atmosphere, very professional, and nice barmen. You are always offered a special natural wine. I was glad to visit this bar because I'd never tasted such an amazing wine before. Recommend 100%! || We had a fantastic experience at holy wine today. Christina who served us (hope thats spelt right) was amazing and gave us loads of info of the natural wines we tried. She really took the time to get to know us and find out what we liked. The bar was done beautifully and had a really intimate and personal that was reflected in the way they treat their customers. Be careful you dont miss it though as we almost walked straight past it! We had a couple glasses each and left with a bottle of sparkling rose and an orange wine to take home. If you are a wine fan and in lisbon Holy Wine should be at the top of your list. 🍷 || Thank you guys, it was our pleasure!🥂🤍 … || One of the best wine places I've been to. Such a great wine selection, attentive service and delicious food. Sommelier Eugenia is very cute and a great professional. Definitely recommended! 🤩 || Absolutely loved the place! Friendly staff, a very good selection of natural wines and the atmosphere is great. Since the bar is very small it makes it easier to meet people from all over the world there! Highly recommend ❤️ || Very high standards wines, highly recommended 💯 || Amazing tiny wine bar. We arrived 10 minutes before it opened and so glad we did as there are only 6 seats. Wine was fantastic and affordable, as well as meat/cheese boards and other snacks. 10/10 would highly recommend. || Each drop of natural wine was like manna from the wine gods. Can't fault any of the wines. The bar tender was knowledgeable and knew exactly how to cater for each person's tastes. Would love to see how they go adding some non alcoholic drinks into the list. Love how low key the place was and right next to a tram line which had lovely old trams passing by. || A nice stop on the way to / from Basilica da Estrela, if you need an excuse. Not a "pub" (stunningly inadequate word to describe the place). Very small, a hole in the wall, "tiny". Those not accommodated inside enjoy the outdoors. While not cheap, very popular.  Knowledgeable host, nice selection. Don't forget to ask for your bowl of organic potato chips: crispy and not salty (for a change).  Highly recommended.  Enjoy!  Hope this helps. || We are always looking for quirky interesting wine places. Normally the owners are super excited about the wines they are offering and explaining everything and making you feel like you are drinking something special while learning more about wine. This was unfortunately not the case here. The selection might be great - we will never know - but the service lacked excitement and explanation (“it’s a white from Portugal, it’s an orange wine from Spain” - ehm..). || Hole in the wall kind of place and the service was great. No menu but the hostess asks you what you like and makes a recommendation. You try it and then you get a glass or bottle! Mostly just 4 seats outside || 6 seats in a small space with plenty of space outside to sit on the curb. Server was knowledgeable and we just asked for his recommendations and let him pick our wine. Super cool space! || We walked away… Greeted with a cold ‘you are not welcome here’ attitude and no warmth. The vibe was cold, rude, and exclusive … not to mention dramatically overpriced We were excited see this place and try some fun wines, but we were not even granted the standard service procedure of being explained the wines, let alone any kind of hospitality. We got two glasses of pet Nat, which we were charged 20€ for, regardless of the fact that the bottle had /8€ written on it with marker. We sat, had 3 sips of our wine, before leaving our glasses on the bench and walking away. Don’t waste your time, energy, or money on this vibe hole

Wow. 🤯 this Bar is AN EXPERIENCE! It felt like walking into an escape room themed around the 1920s–1930s (the kind that completely pulls you into its story and atmosphere).The effort put into the design and decoration is unmatched! (You can even catch little sneak peeks of the Halloween elements, so perfectly blended into the space.)  The service was personal and respectful. I wanted a Sex on the Beach, but they didn’t have the ingredients, so I asked to be surprised with something similar and it turned out quite yummy.  Music is always important for me when choosing places, and when we were there, they were playing relaxing sort of jazz, super chill and perfectly fitting for the luxurious, slightly historical vibe.  The cocktails were around €13 each, if I’m not mistaken (not cheap, but not too expensive either). Honestly, I didn’t mind paying that, because it felt like I was paying for the experience as much as the drinks.  Really recommended if this is the vibe you’re looking for it nails it perfectly! || Atmosphere: 8.5/10 The Royal Vessel Bar blends a cozy restaurant-style atmosphere with subtle ship and pirate-inspired design touches. Music is at a good level, the backbar stands out as the focal point, and seating is well arranged with both bar counter spots and group tables.  Drinks: 8/10 Recommendation: Iberica The menu comes in a red book-style format—simple, but stylish. Selection is small, yet the cocktails are well-executed with good flavor balance. Glassware is above average, though presentation overall remains basic with no garnish and no coasters.  Service: 6.5/10 Water isn’t served on arrival. The team is friendly and professional, but attentiveness leaves room for improvement. Reservations aren’t needed. Prices lean slightly above average for Lisbon. || I celebrated my birthday at this bar, and it was absolutely amazing! The atmosphere is incredible - cozy and stylish, with dim lighting that creates the perfect mood for a relaxed evening.  The cocktails are top-notch 🔥 creative, well-balanced, and beautifully presented. I was especially impressed by the wide selection of not only cocktails but also mocktails. the non-alcoholic options are just as flavorful and thoughtfully crafted.  There are also some light snacks available, which pair nicely with the drinks. I’ll definitely be coming back, this place is perfect both for special occasions and a chill night out with friends. || The best non-alcoholic cocktails in Lisbon. I fully recommend to try Virgin porn star and Saint margarita. The bartender was very kind and attentive. I will definitely come back to try the other cocktails || Beautiful, atmospheric bar with décor that feels straight out of a Fitzgerald novel. The Mist of Sintra was fresh and tasty, but the Silk Road was my favorite! || It’s a very classy bar with beautiful authentic interior. Small, but very very cozy. Cocktails were great and the bartenders were friendly, funny and professional. They almost don’t have classic cocktails on the menu but they are happy to make ones if you ask. I loved the atmosphere of the bar and I am definitely going to return! || We had such a great time at the bar, huge thanks to Zhenya from Uzbekistan! He made the evening unforgettable. Every cocktail he suggested was perfect for each of us, like he instantly knew what everyone would love. We ended up chatting in Portuguese, English, Russian, and Ukrainian, it was such a fun mix and the vibe was amazing.  Zhenya even made me a special cocktail, not from the menu, just based on my preferences, and it turned out incredible. 🍸 Definitely one of the bars, we'll come back to and recommend to our friends! || Super sad I discovered it one day before leaving… it is a must! Just share what you want, the atmosphere is beautiful and the cocktails are amazing! Thank you! || I had a fantastic experience at The Royal Vessel Bar. Not only are the cocktails genuinely amazing, but the staff were absolute stars. There was a girl who was clearly very drunk and being bothered by a creepy guy who wouldn’t leave her alone. As soon as the team realised what was happening, they stepped in straight away and were exceptional — calm, professional, and completely on it.  They handled everything with real care and escalated it to the authorities in exactly the right way. I’d gone over to check on her too, and the staff even thanked me and gave me a drink for helping. Honestly, such a brilliant bar on every front — fantastic drinks, great atmosphere, and a team who genuinely look out for their guests. Couldn’t recommend it more. Five stars. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ || Great cocktail card and lovely staff, the best atmosphere. Besides ordering things from the menu, you can also ask to make a custom cocktail to your liking. One of my favorite places in Lisbon. || I had the privilege of hosting my birthday party here, and Eugene, Ali, and the entire team couldn't have been more accommodating, welcoming, and helped make a memorable night to celebrate with friends. The venue is amazing, and the IPAs and cocktails on offer are truly spectacular -- unlike anything else in Lisbon. 10/10, no notes, and you mustn't miss! Thank you! || One of my favorite cocktail bars I’ve been to in a long time. Great vibe and intricate details. The drinks were delicious and perfectly balanced and the bartender Eugene was so friendly and helpful- it was interesting to hear his background on a lot of the cocktails! || Ahoy Mary Claire!  Your words just dropped anchor right in our hearts — thank you for this treasure of a review! It’s an honor to be counted among your favorite cocktail bars. We put our soul into every detail, from the ropes to the recipes, and we’re thrilled it showed.  Eugene sends his warmest regards from behind the helm — he’s always ready to share a story behind every pour. You’re welcome aboard anytime the tide brings you back to Lisbon!  With gratitude from the crew, The Royal Vessel || Menus in a book, cocktails like art, and a bathroom that’s part boat, part Alice in Wonderland fever dream. Come for the drinks, stay for the “wait… what is happening?” vibe. || A truly atmospheric spot with excellent cocktails. Don’t hesitate to ask the bartenders to mix something unique that’s not on the menu — they’re great at creating custom drinks. The playlist deserves a special mention too — really cool vibes all around. Highly recommend! || Hands down one of the BEST bars in Lisbon. A women-owned bar that has one of the coolest interiors— dim lights, burning candles held in wine bottles with the wax dripping gloriously down, mirrors in carved wooden frames and leather covered books adorn the exposed stone walls, and a heaven like sky mural covers the ceiling. AND THE ART DECO CHANDELIER??? Lord have mercy, the design feign in me loses it ever time I see it. The  bartenders are always amazing and most importantly— consistently so, every drink is made with the best of the best of the best! Also for those who appreciate really well executed Mexican cuisine with a twist? Please please support Cantina dos Flores, brought to you by the lovely ladies who are behind Royal Vessel <3 || Was solo tripping in Lisbon and stumbled across this gem. Absolutely lovely service, bar tenders are really attentive and create some of the best tasting cocktails I’ve ever tried. Pro tip ask them for their favourite drinks and get ready to be pleasantly surprised. You’ll leave feeling like you’ve made new friends. || Absolutely worth it: the drinks, the mood, the class. Know your drinks when you come here 🍷 ask for Renat || Was really excited to check this place out because friend had heard it was a great bar. Ordered a drink and never got it. 30 mins, Alessandro… come on man don’t take out a bad night on us || Dear Samuel, We’re truly sorry to hear about your recent experience — that is definitely not the standard of service we strive for. Thank you for bringing it to our attention. We understand how disappointing it must have been to wait for your drink and never receive it, especially on a night you were looking forward to.  We would love the chance to make it right. If you’re open to it, please contact us at royalvesselbar@gmail.com so we can personally follow up and offer you a proper welcome on your next visit.  We value every guest and your feedback helps us improve. Warm regards, The Royal Vessel Team || Visting motethen 5 to expect to good qulity , naan burned , Food are just making hote in owen even its is cold and services are patahtic my review vest on 5 time visit || Amazing drinks and the bartenders Eugene and Renato made us feel at home. Overall a beautiful place with a good atmosphere for deep conversations. Love this spot :)

really cool spot! great for people watching. very relaxed vibes with a tonne of wine and other drinks (including non alcoholic drinks) available.  staff were all super lovely and friendly, service was great.  i only got some olives and hummus to eat, both of which were lovely. got some aperol spritz to drink which were also great. || Very great wine selections. If you are preparing WSET, it is a good spot to do the practice! It is very tranquil. The music is great. The staffs are very friendly. I like it. A great wine bar. || Highly recommend- the staff are very kind and happy to take the time to talk to you about their wine and Portugal in general. The vibes are nice, air conditioned inside which is bonus in the summer heat. Wine is also very affordable for the quality that they serve. || Price point will depend on how much you consume. Many varieties available by the glass, as well as dozens of bottles. Great wine bar! || I love the wines there and the staff is so friendly. Always the best recommendations for my wine taste. Get the cheese board, olives and bread with olive oil. So good. I wish they would have a bit more on the menu, but anyway I love this place. || Hi Alina, thank you so much for your kind words ! Since your visit we have added few new suggestions to our food list, including delicious tartines, so don't hesitate to come back to try them ! || Cute and atmospheric wine bar with a great selection of Portuguese wines. I really loved the interior and you can sit outside on a terrace.  I would recommend trying a glass of orange.  Friendly staff and great service, totally recommend ✨ || This is a great place for cheese and wine!  They really make you feel welcome even though I knew nothing about wine. They explained the wine types and patiently gave me suggestions based on my preferences.  The waiter was awesome, and the wine and cheese was just as awesome. The goat cheese was AMAZING!  GREAT PLACE! || Really lovely spot to grab and drink and/or take away a bottle. The staff are incredibly knowledgeable about Portuguese wines; I really appreciated how patient they were when examining the different regions and varieties. Would definitely recommend popping by! || Thank you so much Caylin ! We are happy to read that you enjoyed our recommendations :) || happy hour 17-19u: 4,5 for two roses. || Cute little wine bar, great staff and good small plates of food. Beautiful Portuguese wines on the list.

The Museum of Illusions in Lisbon is a nice place to visit, especially if you’re looking for something fun and a bit different. Some of the illusions are really clever and make you stop for a moment to figure out how they work. The whole museum is not very big, so you can go through it quite fast, but it’s still enjoyable.  It’s a good spot for kids because they can interact with a lot of things and take fun photos. Adults will also find a few rooms and tricks quite interesting. Overall, it’s a quick and enjoyable visit, and worth passing by if you’re nearby or looking for something entertaining to do. || Hi Kinan,  Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review! 😊 We’re delighted to hear that you enjoyed the clever illusions, the interactive elements, and the fun photo opportunities — and thank you as well for sharing your photos, they look great! While the museum can be explored relatively quickly depending on the pace, we’re glad you still found it entertaining and worthwhile.  Thanks again for visiting and for capturing such nice moments with us! || Omg what a gem this place is. It's sooo quirky and interesting absolutely worth a visit. I'm soo glad we went and ignored the negative reviews. The staff are soo engaging,  soo polite soo helpful. We had a wonderful visit thank you. If your contemplating going don't think any longer just get going! Pink street is a 10 min walk away for after you've seen this amazing place! || Hi Sasha,  Wow! Thank you so much for your amazing review! 😊 We’re absolutely delighted that you enjoyed your visit and appreciated the quirky illusions and our friendly team. Your kind words mean a lot to us, and it’s wonderful to know you decided to come despite the mixed reviews — we’re so glad it was worth it!  Enjoy the Pink Street and the rest of your time in Lisbon! || Loved it! Was a really fun (although short) time. The museum is not big, so it took us 50 minutes to do the full tour and re-do some of the activities || This place is amazing. Lots of staff around to answer any questions and take photos if you are a solo traveler. Definitely worth the entrance fee and definitely worth visiting. || Hi Luke,  Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed the museum and that our team could help make your visit enjoyable, even as a solo traveler. Your kind words about the experience and value mean a lot to us! || The Museum is a chain around the world. They are all similar in layout as there are only so many optical illusions out there. The cost for a family of four was 47€, which considering you can only spend about 20 minutes looking over the exhibits, is a fairly high price. However, if you have young children, they will be amazed at some of the illusions they’ll see. There is even a gift shop at the end where you can bring home brain-twister toys or souvenirs to remember your visit. Recommend if you’re looking to get out of the heat for 30 minutes, just don’t expect an entire afternoon here! || Hi Mo, Thank you very much for your visit, your review. We're glad your family had a good time 😊 … || Very fun and informative place, the museum is interactive and is suited for taking pictures, whilst still being a great place to go just to see the illusions. There are many activities and illusions and great photo ops. || Hi Inf,  Thank you so much for your fantastic review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you found the museum both fun and informative, and that you enjoyed the interactive illusions and photo opportunities. It’s wonderful to know you appreciated the experience from every angle! || I'm sorry. There was no one at the entrance. There were 55 minutes left before closing. Little girl was crying. They didn't let us in. Ridiculous!! change your way. staff to be trained.  in other European cities, different treatment. || Hi Mone,  Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re truly sorry for the frustration you experienced, especially with a child involved. We understand how disappointing that must have felt.  However, we’d like to clarify that we cannot allow new entries after a certain cutoff time before closing. This is to ensure every visitor has enough time to enjoy the full experience safely and comfortably. Our ticketing system automatically blocks sales and entry after this time, precisely to avoid situations where guests would not be able to complete the visit properly.  We’re sorry for the inconvenience this caused and appreciate your understanding. If you’re still interested in visiting, we’d love to welcome you back during opening hours so you can fully enjoy the museum experience. || Great experience with the family, fun photo opportunities, great to get out of the heat and explore. || Hi Panit, Thank you so much for your kind review! 😊 We’re delighted you and your family had a great time, enjoyed the photo opportunities, and found the museum a nice escape from the heat. … || Very funny, mindblowing for the brains of young and old. Emplyees friendly and willing to explain || Hi Annegreet,  Thank you so much for your lovely review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear you found the experience funny and mind-blowing for both young and old. Our team will be very happy to know their friendliness and explanations helped make your visit even better! || I found this so fun and enjoyed this interactive and interesting experience, the Illusions are great, get fab photos while learning and have a good laugh. The staff were super friendly and helped take photos of us. When we went, the morning slot was full, so we had to wait around half hour till next slot, which was fine as the museum is in such a main area you can easily wonder round, have a coffee or snack near by, for example. || Hi Jennifer,  Thank you so much for your fantastic and detailed review! 😊 We’re thrilled to hear that you found the experience fun, interactive, and interesting — and that you enjoyed the illusions, the laughs, and the photo opportunities. It’s also wonderful to know our team helped make your visit even better with their friendliness and support with photos.  Thank you as well for your understanding regarding the short wait between slots — we really appreciate your patience, and you’re right, the central location does make it easier to enjoy the surroundings in the meantime.  We’re really happy you had such a great time with us!

A great playground right next to a quiosk. Perfect for a weekend or afternoon meet up with friends while the kids play. || This is a playground in the park, with slides, swings, climbing nets, and other play facilities. || Nice place to relax and get a drink or snacks with kids playground || Nice atmosphere. Clean. Right next to the kiosk that has a bathroom. Several different areas. The spider web area is my son's favorite. There's also a small slide and swings. Lots of local children and tourists too. || Nice park. Several areas, with some shady spots and even one next to a kiosk. || Plenty of opportunities for play and always open. It tends to be crowded on weekends and late afternoons, but children can easily move around on the swings, etc. || Various devices for children to enjoy. Equipment without significant degradation. || Safe, with different toys, a safe and well-frequented environment. It has a water fountain and sand for the children; my daughter loves it. || It could have a few more attractions. But even so, the children enjoy it. || There's nothing better for a child than playing outdoors. The park is great. || Very fun and well-equipped park. It's a shame that the older children destroy the equipment meant for the younger ones. || Sometimes quite crowded, but very good for taking children. || Good park for children, unfortunately very close to the road. || Great for children, it's a shame it needs more cleaning. || Not very suitable for children. || There's a small playground for children, and a kiosk nearby where parents can have coffee and a snack while their child plays. || A good children's playground in Campo Grande, next to Avenida da Igreja. || Good space, but needs more frequent cleaning. || Wonderful space, perfect for relaxing! || Currently, the park is closed due to the lockdown. || Pleasant park with some shade. || Perfect for a short stroll. || Very good for spending a nice afternoon. || Good variety of equipment. || An oasis in the middle of the avenue.

place_name: Parque Infantil do Campo dos Mártires da Pátria
reviews_content: It's a rather boring playground. It is somewhat worn and only suitable for very young children 4-6 years. However, there is a park in the area with free-range chickens and ducks. I give this place 2 thumbs up. 👍👍 … || Decent park. The ducks and chickens are quite the sight to see. Places to sit whether on park benches or stone halfwalls. Smoking shouldn't be allowed in the vicinity of the playground. place_name: Parque Infantil do Parque de Jogos 1º de Maio
reviews_content: its  one if The  best park for playing  kids and spend  leisure  time  with beloved  one || A wonderful playground. Suitable for both toddlers and older children. Well equipped, clean and entertaining playground. Plenty of slides, swings and play structures for smaller kids plus more challenging play structures for bigger kids. This is my first time seeing little pebbles as the playground floor, and my daughter loved it. There are decent swing sets for babies and older kids, and also a climbing structure in another area. For the rest the playground is nice with cool slides and climbing stuff || Not sure why this playground gets such high marks (aside from the lovely surroundings). This is a kid favorite too.  Next to the play areas is a kiosk/cafe serving up everything you want - tostas, pastries, snacks, ice cream, wine, beer, cocktails. The kiosk has one small bathroom. place_name: Parque Infantil da Avenida Duque d'Ávila
reviews_content: So far without success, we continue our search for a smoke free playground in Saldanha. That’s right, so far we haven’t been able to visit a Saldanha playground without the air being filled with cigarette smoke smell. This one, being very small, and being set up between not one but two outdoor cafes seems to be particularly notorious. We tried different times of day, and even when none of the cafes was opened, you could be sure to find at least one parent smoking right next to the fence.  Our toddler sadly even found used cigarette  buds on the playground floor, which made us really angry.  We truly cannot fathom how so many people/ parents can be so thoughtless and inconsiderate. Having traveled to and lived in many different countries, Portugal, and in particular Saldanha takes the crown when it comes to inconsiderate smokers, imho. || Cute little park with just enough to keep kids entertained. Lots of places around to get snacks too! Wish there was a swing set. || Where you can meet your lover for lunch. Real quick! || Small, but fun is guaranteed for your kid. Well kept. || Small park but central location || A small park designed to delight children, while their parents can grab a drink at the kiosk next to it while they play. || Very nice place. It was missing a park for pets. || Excellent park for children up to 4 years old. Avoid going during the hottest part of the day as there is no shade. || Good for taking a child, and there's a bar next door, so you can have a few drinks too. || Enclosed playground with a slide and climbing ladder. Park for children ages 3 to 7. Recommended. || Good park for children, but it could have more shade. || A pleasant space close to everything, perfect for being with children or enjoying the outdoor seating area. || If a child runs into the road, at least put some metal barriers by the side of the road. || Reasonable play area for children in the center of Lisbon. || Lots of animal droppings, unfortunately. || Because it's public and very good. || Only intended for children up to 4 years old. || New and pleasant space.

Eduardo VII Park is one of the most beautiful and relaxing green spaces in Lisbon. The park offers stunning panoramic views over the city and the Tagus River, making it a perfect spot for photos, walks, or simply enjoying the scenery. The wide paths are ideal for walking or jogging, and the well-maintained gardens add a peaceful atmosphere away from the busy city streets. One of the highlights is the impressive geometric garden design and the viewpoint at the top of the park, which provides a breathtaking perspective of Lisbon. The park is also very spacious, so it never feels overcrowded, even during busy hours. There are benches throughout the area, perfect for resting and enjoying the surroundings. Eduardo VII Park is great for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. It’s close to the city center and easy to access, making it a must-visit for anyone exploring Lisbon. Whether you’re looking for a quiet place to relax, take a walk, or admire the city from above, this park is definitely worth a visit. || We were in Lisbon for several days while waiting to start a cruise with NCL.  We stopped at the north end of this magnificent park and walk all the way to the southern end.  Lots of great views and spots for wonderful pics.  Several monuments along the way. || Parque Eduardo VII is a beautiful park with stunning views of the city and the river. It's beautifully maintained, with plenty of greenery and spacious walkways. It's a great place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city, take beautiful photos, and simply enjoy the atmosphere. A must-see if you're in Lisbon. || It's quite an amazing space. Whether it's chilling, or events, or testing your photographic prowess, it fits the bill. There are usually tourists and residents generally around, and it's more lively during celebrations like Christmas. || It's a very beautiful and large park, perfect for a peaceful walk surrounded by nature. The view from the top of the park is spectacular. Depending on the time of year, there may be more or fewer tourists. On a sunny day with good weather, it's well worth a visit. || A great view of Lisbon from here, you can see the whole layout and scale looking down towards the river. Relaxed and friendly atmosphere as you view the scenery and monuments. You also get an excellent view of the planes coming into Lisbon. || A beautiful public park in Lisbon, Portugal with great views over the city. The top is great for photos. Good for a walk, sit and have lunch or a drink, or have your dog play around. || Wonderful Christmas Atmosphere! We visited Parque Eduardo VII during the Christmas season, and it was a fantastic experience. The Christmas market (Wonderland Lisboa) created such a pleasant and fun atmosphere. It’s a great spot, especially for young people and families, with plenty of amusement park rides, games, and festive food stalls. The park itself is beautiful, and the view from the top is breathtaking. Highly recommended if you are in Lisbon during the holidays! || Parque Eduardo VII is one of the best spots in Lisbon to enjoy a peaceful walk and take in a great view of the city. From the top of the park, you can see all the way down to the river and the Praça Marquês de Pombal. It’s a lovely place to relax, especially at sunset. The park is also very close to El Corte Inglés, so it’s easy to combine a visit with some shopping or a coffee break nearby. || What a great parque / jardim in central Lisbon. Plenty of spaces to walk and sit with many great restaurants, cafes , and quiosques nearby to enjoy the warm Lisbon sun || Iconic park in central Lisbon. You can get the hop on bus at this location or just walk all the way up from the roundabout to get a nice view of the city and take a picture near a Lisboa sign. || A beautiful park! You can exercise, enjoy nature, and relax. It’s very well maintained! || Beautiful lookout over the city towards the water. If you like vistas, definitely a must see. Also check the smaller part of the park across the road (more north), for a super cute cafe near a small pond. || It is a beautiful public park in Lisbon, Portugal. The park occupies an area of 26 hectares (64 acres). The park was built in the first half of the 20th century to restore public green space. The park's central strip, covered with grass, is flanked by long Portuguese paved walkways. The park is at a gradient from the top observation deck you can see it well. Well manicured lawns and hedges. The top of the park is a has the Monument to the Carnation Revolution, flanked by two sets of two obelisks. Car park nearby and easy walk to observation deck. Wear comfy shoes, take water, wear hat, sunscreen. Great place for photography || Very large sloping park mainly put over to trees and grass. Lovely view from the top across the city. Interesting sculpture here too. || Scenic views with many diverse places to sun, shade, relax and explore.
